dab brgya dang bachu pa' dkar chag tshesgra mdo/ tshog (212)3530 brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo bzhugs so// 3mtshams sbyor lnga pa/ 3ming gi rab tu byed pa/ 3dbyangs kyi mtshams sbyor/ 4rang bzhin du gnas pa'i mtshams sbyor/ 4gsal byed mtshams sbyor/ 4rnam par bcad bya'i mtshams sbyor/ 5rnam dbye dang je'i cho ga rnams bshad pa/ 5dbyangs kyi mtha' can/ 5skyes pa'i rtags/ 5bud med kyi rtags/ 6ma ning gi rtags / 7ha sa'i mtha' can/ 71

/gas pa:re rtab/thab/ 7bud med kyi rtags/ 8zung :deng :sgo sdomabakas/ 8yutshodu yasmadu kyi cho ga 9mi za tshad rnga /re 1sde/ 9(3tshad ——tshad 1) 1)cad/ 9byed pa can gyi rab byu byed pa/ 10tshig rdzud kyi rab byu byed pa/ 10de phan gyi rab byu bya ba/ 11kun nas bshad pa'i rab byu byed pa/ 13byed pa ngo 'i rab tu byed pa/ 13dngos po dang las kyi rab tu byed pa/ 15shog gyur gyi rab tu byed pa/ 15smon par byed pa'i rkyen/ 16de ring ma yin pa'i 'byung 'gyur gyi don gyi rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa/ 16'byung 'gyur gyi rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa/ 16bya ba shor ba'i rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa/ 17byung zin gyi rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa/ 17dngos ngo/ dang las kyi rab tu byed pa/ 17yadra rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa// 17yadra 'jig pa'i mtha'i rab tu byed pa/ 18rkyen dang sbyor ba'i rab tu byed pa/ 18kun nas bsgyur ba'i rab tu bya ba/ 19byings dang nye bsgyur sbyor tshul bshad pa/ ༷ ༷ 19kṛtpa la sogs pa'i rab tu bya ba/ ༷ 202

slob dpon a nu ཿ tis mdzad/'phags yul gyi paṇḍi ta pa la bha dra dang /go kyu la shā tha mi pa mched kyi ba7'a drin la brten pa'i lo tsā ba bee dakhrer rigs kyi thig le 'dar ba lo tsā ba ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun 'grub kyis pho brang chen po ngo/ ta lar bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(23) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(25)3531 brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po dbyangs can byu ka ra ṇa'i 'grel pa rab tu bya ba gsal ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 26mtshams spyor lnga pa/ 26ming gi rab tu byed pa/ 26dbyangs kyi mtshams sbyor/ 30rang bzhin du gnas pa'i mtshams sbyor/ 24gsal byed mtshams sbyor/ 36rnam bcad kyi mtshams sbyor/ 39rnam dbye dang de'i cho ga rnams bshad pa/ 43dbyangs kyi mtha' can/ 43skyeb 25'i (1thabathab/ 43bud med kyi rtags/ 63zug ning gi rtags/ 69ha sa:re zugathapar can/ 76rtegs pa:re rtags/ 76bud med kyi rtags/ 98zub :deng gi rtathanas/ 10zhesabarjod pa'i rtags yutshod asmad gnyis kyi cho ga 1093

:ba zi tshad tshab/re 1sde/ 115bud med du sgrub pa'i rkyen/ 118byed pa can gyi rab tu byed pa/ 124rnam dbye bdun po'i 'jug yul dper brjod dang bcas te rim par /bsdogatshod /pa/ 1rtenatsama'aphros don rnams bshad pa/ 129'phros don thor bu ba bshad pa/ 131tshig sdud kyi rab tu byed pa/ 135zugam zab pas/gcad ngas/ 135dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa// 1 5bsdu ba drug rim par bshadapa/ 135dang po/ mi zad par gyur pa/'i bsdu ba/ 135gnyis pa/ de'i skyes bu'i bsnyu ba/ 139gsum pa// bzlas dbye'i bsdu ba/ 140bzhi pa / phyogs gnyis pa/'i bsdu ba/ 143lnga pa// 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba/ 144drug pa/ la sa 'dzin gyi bsdu ba/ 1'ananyer mkho'i cho ga ci rigs pa thun mong du bshad pa/ 1nade phan gyi rab tu bya ba/ 153kun nas bshad pa'i rab tu byed pa/ 172byed pa bo'i rab tu byed pa/ 172dngos po dang las kyi rab tu byed pa/ 203shog gyur gyi rab tu byed pa/ 209smon par byed pa'i rkyen/ 227de ring ma yin pa'i 'byung 'gyur gyi don gyi rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa/ 229

'byung 'gyur gyi rkyen kyi rab tu byed pa/ 231bya ba shor ba'i rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa// 234byung zin kyi rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa/ 235dngos po dang las kyi rab tu byed pa// 245yadra rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa/ 250yaja 'jig pa'i mtha'i rab tu byed pa/ 257rkyen dang sbyo ra ba'i rab tu byed pa/ 260kun nas bsgyur ba'i rab tu bya ba/ 276byings dang nyer bsgyur sbyor tshul bshad pa// 278kṛtu la sogs pa'i rab tu bya ba/ 291slo ba dpon a nu bhū tis ma dzad/'phags yu la gyi pa/ṇḍi ta pa la bha dra dang / bo ku la nā tha mi shu ma ched kyi drung du gzhung 'grel 'di so sas la sbya ngas pa/sa cung zad tsam mees pa / 'dar ngag dbang phun tshoṭa lhun grub kyis pho brang chen po ngo ta la ra bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(326) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(353)3532 mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos 'chi ba med pa'i mdzod ces bya ba skad gnyis sbyar ba bzhugs so// 354dang po/ mtho ris la sogs pa'i skabs yan lag dang bcas pa bshadapa/ 3ga 4ma111 ris kyi sde/ 35tsams 'og gi sde/ 38ga gnyis pa/ sa gzhi la sogs pa'i skabs bshad pa/ 3935

thab:re 1— tshacad/ 393gong khyer gyi sde tshan/ 395ri'i sde/ 398nags dang sman gyi sde/ 399seng ge la sogs pa'i sde/ 419:sgo'i sde zhesan/ 424bram ze'i sde tshan/ 42rgyal rigs kyi sde/ 4gorje rigs kyi sde tshan/ 464dmangs rigs kyi sde tshan/ gre7gsum pa/ gzhan dbang la sogs pa'i skabs bshadapa/ na3bye brag gzhan dbang gi sde tshan/ rga3'dres ma'i sde tshan/ go6don sna tshogs kyi sde tshan/ 502mi zad pa'i sde mtshan/ 534rtags bsdus pa'i sde tshan/ 542'chi ba med pa/'i seng ges mdzad/nga ṇḍi ta ra po smisto tsand+ra'i zhal snga nas/ yar lung pa grags pa rgyal ma— gyis/bal yul shā bu'i grong rṣa du bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(545) bsdura'abras re'u mig(554)3533 'chi med mdzod ces bya ba/ 555skabs dang po/ 555mtho ris kyi sde tshan/ 555sa 'og gi sde tshan/ 575

skabs gnyis pa/ 580sa'i sde tshan/ 580grong khyer kyi sde tshan/ 581ri'i sde tshan/ 583nags dang sman gyi sde tshan/ 584seng ge la sogs pa'i sde tshan/ 597mi'i sde tshan/ 601bram ze'i sde tshan/ 613rgyal rigs kyi sde tshan/ 618rje rigs kyi sde tshan/ 628dmangs rigs kyi sde tshan/ 636skabs gsum pa/ 640gzhan dbang gi sde tshan/ 640'dres ma'i sde tshan/ 650don sna tshogs kyi sde tshan/ 653mi zad pa'i sde tshan/ 674rtags bsdus pa'i sde tshan/ 676'chi ba med pa/'i seng ge 'es bya bas mdzad/pa/ṇḍi ta chen po kritī shrī'i zhal snga nas/ yar lungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ bal yul rnga bu'i grong rṣa du bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(681) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(687)3534 'chi ba med pa'i mdzod kyi rgya cher 'grel pa 'dod 'jo'i ba mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ 6887

mdor bstan pa/ 688rgyas par bshadapa/ 7༷1bsdus don/ 701yan lag gi don/ 703skabs dang po/ 703mtho ris kyi sde tshan/ 703sa 'og gi sde tshan/ 811skabs gnyis pa/ 823sa 'i sde tshan/ 823grong khyer gyi sde tshan/ 827ri'i sde tshan/ 828nags dang sman gyi sde tshan/ 830seng ge la sogs pa'i sde tshan/ 853mi'i sde —/ 860bram ze la sogs pa'i sde tshan/ 876pa/ṇḍi ta rab 'byor zla bas mdzad/dpal zha lu'i btsun pa/ 'gos lo tsā ba gsu ma pa/ daspe slo nga dharma pā la bha dra zhis bya bas bsgyur cing legs pa ra gtan la phab/bsnyur mchan/(882) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(883)3535 'chi med mdzod kyi rgya cher 'grel pa 'dod 'jo'i ba mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 884mdor bstan pa/ 884rgyas par bshad pa/ 89༷skabs dang po/ 89༷mtho ris kyi sde tshan/ 890

sa 'og gi sde wo/ 959skabs gnyis pa / 970sa'i sde tshan/ 970grong khyer gyi sde —/ 974ri'i sde tshan/ 976nags dang sman gyi sde tshan/ 978seng ge la sogs pa'i sde tshan/ 1000mi'i sde tshan/ 1008bram ze la sogs pa'i sde tshan/ 1023slo ba dpon rab 'byor zla bas mdzad/rgya gar kyi mkhan ngo tīrti tsand+ra dang / yar 'u ngas pa grags pa rgyal ma— gyis/ bal yu la yam bu'i grong rṣa du bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1026) bsnyur 'bras re'u mig(1028)3536 snyan ngag me long 1029le'u dang po/ 1029le'u gnyis pa/ 1039le'u gsum pa// 1072slo ba dngo/na dbyug pa can gyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po snya na ngag mkhan chen po shrī lasgyu7 ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dache slong shong ston gyis dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang rja ngo ra bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/de rjes dpa nga lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pas go dka' ba'i cha shas su gyur pa rnams dang don che ba rnams la 'gyur bcos bgyis pa la phyis snye thang blo brtan bzhi pa/sa legs par 'gyur bcos bgyes/9

bsdur mchan/(1090) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1101)3537 sprin kyi pho nya zhes bya ba/ 1102snyan ngag mkhan rṣa po nag mo'i khol gyis mdzad/kha tsho pa ṇḍi ta snyan ngag mkhan rṣa po su ma na shrī dang / zhu rṣa gyi lo tsā ba mang du thos pa/'i dge slong byang chub rtse mo dang / lo tsā bar gtogs pa lung rigs smra ba nam mkha' bzang pos dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen ngo ra bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1129) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1133)3538 sdeb spyor rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ 1134bṛtta 'asgyu da pa/ 1134zuganyam nga :re bṛtta/ 1134phyed mnyam pa'i bṛtta/ 114༷mi mnyam pa'i bṛtta/ 1141kha sgo'i bye brag 1141rkang bzhi 'phel ba'i bye brag 1142steng 'gro'i bye brag 1143dal 'gro'i bye brag 1144bhāti 'chad pa/ 1145'phags ma'i ste( ti/ 1145ro langs can gyi dzā ti/ ༷ 1146phyi mo mnyam pa'i dzā ti/ 1147zwasta ra la sogs pa 'chad pa/ 11rgartsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad marṣa pa/ rin phi 10

'byung gnas zhi bas mdzab/sa gsum na 'gran zla bral ba'i thams cad marṣa pa/ ra po byang chub rtse mo'i zhal snga nas bsgyur/rla ra yang bla ma de nyid dang skyes bu dam pa rnam sa kyi bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa'i dge slong nam mkha' bzang pos bsgyur ba las/ rla ra yang zha 'u lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang ngo/sa dag par bcos/bsdur mchan/(1151) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1151)sde sbyo ri che so3539 ba ra na na 'byung gnas bzhugs // 1152bṛtta 'chad pa/ 1152mnyam pa'i bṛtta/ 1152phyed mnyam pa/'i thratta/ 1158mi mnyam pa'i z-itta/ 1160kha sgo'i bye brag 1160rkang bzhi 'phel ba'i bye brag 1161steng 'gro'i bye brag 1162dal 'gro'i bye brag 1162ṭwāti /racha/da pa/ 1163'phags ma'i dzā ti/ 1163ro langs can gyi dzā ti/ 1165phyi mo mnyam pa'i dzā ti/ 1166pās ra la sogs pa 'chad pa/ 1167rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad marṣa pa rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad/'di ni shākya'i dge slo nga 'jig rten mig rin phi chos skyong bzang pos bris/11

bsdur mchan/(1172) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1172)3540 sdeb spyor rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ 1173zitta /rasgyu tshad /ba/ 1173cabastonasgyu / tshos:re (byetta/ 1173phyed mnyam pa'i z-itta/ 1196mi mnyam pa'i bṛtta/ 12༷0/ba 14/re bye) rngothupa/ 1200rkang bzhi 'phel ba'i bye brag 1202steng 'gro'i bye brag 1205da' 'gro'i bye brag 1207bhā/ste /ram tshad tshab/ 1208'phags ma'i ste( ti/ 1208ro langs can gyi dzā ti/ 1214phyi mo mnyam nga/'i dzā ti/ 1216zwasthā ra la sogs pa 'chad pa/ 1216rtsod pa/'i dus kyi thams cad marṣa pa rin chen 'byung gnas 'i ba'i zhabs kyis mdzad/chos ldan ra za ba dang / yar klungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur/slad kyi thams cad marṣa pa ra po byang chub rtse mo 'i zhal snga nas bsgyur ba la sa/ sla ra yang bla ma de nyid dang / skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa'i dge slo nga nam ma kha' bzang pos skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang ngo/ dpal ldan blo gros brtan pa'i phyag bris kyi rgya dpe la gtugs nas/ dpa la e'i chos grwa rṣa por bsgyur cing zhus te dag par bgyis/12

bsdur mchan/(1227) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1238)na541 ches ngab /sgrozang /) 13pa ngab6) pa//stepa/ pa// 1239mkhas pa chen po stag sde ba seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi sras kyi thu bo/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ sgong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1247) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1248)35442 (pe 1go /ba/rgya rngon/)/ma tsho / 12'tshomakhas pa chen po gnas brtan ye shes dpal bshes gnyen gyis ma dzad/yi ge bcu gnyis pa'i tshigs bcad bcu gnyis pa ya mu na yan chad/ shong ston lo tsā ba chen ngo/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur te 'phro la lus pa las shong ston de nyid kyi brgyud pa/'i slo ba ma dpang lo tsā ba dge slo nga dpal ldan blo gros brtan pa sa/ slob dngo na shākya rakṣi tas mdzad pa/'i 'grel pa/ la brten nas/ yongs su rdzogs par bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1268) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1270): dkar chag bi zur mchan/ deb 'di'i chos tshan (3530)pa 'i mdzad byang dang 'gyur byang ni sde bstan da7ra chag ltar bkod pa dang / chos tshan (3439)pa 'di ni chos tshan (3438)pa dang 'gyur gcig kyang 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gnyis la sgra lci yang mtshon pa'i rtags dang ri mo sogs yod pa'i dbang bis chos tshan logs su bkod pa dang / de yang pe cin par ma ha cang mi gsal bas/ sna ra par la ga'i bzung nas bsgrigs shing / de la yi spe nor ba dang mi gsal ba mang yang / gna' dpe ji ma ji bzhin 'jog dgos pa 'i rtsa don ltar bcos ma phod pa ra ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/ yang chos tshan (3540)par yi ge sgrig stangs kyi dbang gis sgra byu yang mtshon pa'i re'u mig 'ga' re yi ge'i drang thad du sgrig ma btub pa/ra 'og tu bkod yod pa la 'dab rtags kyis mtshon par byas yo da//3

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ swa ra swaste byā ka ra ṇa sru tra/ bod skad du/brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo/ 'phags ma dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo//a i u ṛ dza mtshungs pa rnams so/ /thung ngu ring po plu tas phye ba rnams 'dra ba'o| /lhag ma 'jig rten las grub pa 'dir bshad do/ /e i o ②au mtshamasasnyesbyor gyi yi ge rnams so/ /gnyis po rnams dbyangs so/ /a bor ba nā mi'o/ /ha ya ④wa ra la/ nya ṇa na nga ma/ dzha bhā dha gha bha/ dza ḍa da ga ba/kha pha tsha ṭha tha/ tsa ṭa ta ka pa/ sha ṣa sa/ thog ma dang mtha' ma dag gis so/ /ha sa gsal byed rnams so/ /dbyangs nyams pa gsal byed do/ /bya ba'i ched du'o—/ /gang zhig itpa kyi ming can de ni dbyi'o/ /yi ge mi mthong ba phyis pa'o//yi ge rnam par 'gog pa ni dbyi ba tsam mo/ /gnyen dang 'dra ba ni ā ga ma'o/ /dgra dang 'dra ba ni kun nas bsgyur ba'o/ /dbyangs bar na med pa'i ha sa 110—3

rnams ni yang dag par sbyor ba'o/ /ku tsu ṭu tu pu sde pa rnams so/ /a rā etu o nā mi'i yon tan no/ /ā ādra e ①au 'phel ba'o/ /mtha'i dbyangs la sogs pa ṭi'o/ /mtha' las sngon ma u pa jo'o/ /pha rol tu yang dag par sbyor ba sogs med pa'i thung ngu ni yang ba'o/ /zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las ming gi rab tu byed pa rdzogs so// //dbyangs la i phra'o/ /ha sa las ra ha ma yin pa'i ha sa rnams so/ /dzha bha la dza ba rnams so/ /dbyangs kyis dman pa pha rol tu yang dag par sbyor ro//ra las ya yang gnyis so/ /u sbra'o/ /ṛ dra'o/ /lo wa'o/ /e a lnga'o/ /o a lnga'o/ /gsal byed la dbyangs mtshamasasnyesbyor ba ma yin no/ /e ā lnga'o//au ālnga'o/ /tshig mtha'i phra sbra dag yang na dbyi'o/ / etpa otu ③dag las atu'o—/ /'dra ba'i yi ge 'dus pa la ring po'o/ /a i la e'o/ /u la o'o| /ṛ adra'o/ /la lar ādra du'o/ /'-i a lnga'o/ e dang i la i'o/ /o dang au la lo'o/ /oṣṭha dang o tu'i o yang na'o/ /zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las dbyangs kyi mtshams ④sbyor rdzogs so// //a rmā las ma yin no/ /āo spru e gnyis nyid las so/ /a o ni pā ta'o/ /plu ta'o| /rgyang ring por 'bod pa'i ṭi la plu ta'o/ /zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las rang bzhin du gnas pa'i mtshams ⑤sbyor rnams rdzogs so// //tsa pa las a ba la dza ba'o/ /nya ma la nya ma yang na'o/ /tsa pa las sha ni 110—4

tsha'/ /ha'i dzha bha rnamasasheso/ /sa tu'i sha tsu rnams la sha tsu 'o/ /sha las ma yin no/ /ju rnams kyis ⑧stsu'o/ /tu'i la la la'o/ /mthar gnas la gnyis su dbye'o①/ /ṣa la ma yin no/ /mtha'i ṭu las so/ /na las tsha ta lasakra'o| /sha las tsaka ④yang na'o/ /thung ngu las dra ṇa ⑤mra dbyangs la gnyis so/ /tsha yi'o/ /kha sa la dzha sa rnams kyi tsa pa'o/ /ma ni rjes su nga ro'o| /tshig mtha' dang dzha sa rnams la yang na'i'o/ /ya pa la ya ma yang na'o//ya ba la pha rol la ya ba la yang na'o/ /rnyi sdeb sbyor la'o/ /zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las gsal byed mtshams 0sbyor rnams rdzogs so// //rnam par bcad bya'i sra'o/ /sha ṣa sa la yang na'o/ /ku pu dag la ṅka thashedag yang na'o/ /pā tsa'i pa ti la sogs pa rnams la'o/ /a han gyi rā tri ma yin pa la dra'o/ /a las a la u'o/ /ha pa la'o/ /ā las a ba la dbyi'o| /dbyangs la phra nyid yang na'o/ /sgosra las so/ /nā mi las dra'o/ /u ṣasra kyi burtse la dra'o/ /re pha'i rang bzhin can ni kha pa la yang na'o/ /ra las so/ /ra la dbye ste ring po yang ngo / /sa dang e ṣa las ha sa la'o/ /zhes pa brda spyod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las rnam par bcad bya'i mtshamasayesbyor te mtshams ⑨sbyor lnga pa rdzogs so// //rnam dbye'i ⑩mtha' can ni tshig go/ /rnam dbye med pa ni ming ngo / /si au dzasra/ amra au shasra/ ṭā ṭwāṃ rnyisra/ nge dzñā bhyasra/ nga bi rgyu bhyasra⑩/ ngasra osra āphra/ ji osra supra rnams so/ /sra dra dag gi rnam bcad do/ /aphra 110—5

si yis two a haṃ ngo / /gnyis tshig la yu ba ā ba dag go/ /au.āpo'o / /dzasra kyis yu yo ba yo mo// /gcig nyid la twadu mdu dag go/ /apo sa rbha la ā'o / /shasra kyi na'o/ /ṭā ji dag 'a/ e'o/ /nge yis/ tu bhyamra ma gyi 5 ngo / /bhyasra skyomra mo/ /nga si bhyasra dag gi shā'o/ /ngasra/ kyi ཿ ta ba ma ma'o/ /st+waṃ ā kai ngo / /yu judu asma du dag la drug pa/ bzhi nga/ gnyis nga/ rnams kyi te me bapo kau bsra nasra dag bro/ /a/mra/ kyi tā mā dag sgo/ /dang ngo/ 'a ma/ yin no/ /tsa la sogs pa rnams/ kyis kyang ngo / /jes nga/ brda sprod nga dbyangs/ can gyi mdo 'a sa yu/ṣṭhadu asma du kyi cho sa rnam/sa/ rdzogs so // //tsa 'a so gas/ nga/ ni pā/ ta'o/ /skrumra/ la sa/ spyi 'a tsitpa 'a sogs/ nga 'o/ /pra 'a/ so/gas nga nyer bsgyur ro/ /byings/ la thog ma/'o/ /de rnam/sa/ mi zad nga/'o/ /ghā 'a sogs nga/'i mtha' rnam/sa/ kyang ngo / /mi zad nga 'a sa/ rnam dbye rnams/ 'jig bo/ /zhes nga/ brda sprod nga/ dbyangs/ can gyi mdo las/ mi zad nga/'i sde rnams sdogs so // //a dza sogs las kyang āpra'o / /kāngu/ 'a/ atro kyi i'o/ /thung ngu yang na'o / /na ṛ asnyu la āodra 'o/ /i a dag —gi dbyi'o/ /sre ṭā u ṛtro las so/ /na da la sogs nga/ 'a/sa so/ /ind+ra sogs las ā byādra/ yang ngo /u pa dhā ya ma yin pa las rigs 'a/'o/ /rang lus la yang na'o/ /ma nu sogs kyi i yang ngo / /pasbya la sogs pa las so/ /pra ṭī ṭī la sogs pa'i sgra ni ni pā 110—9

ta'i mtha' 'o/ /u las yon tan la yang na'o/ /utra las u'o①/ /yu banu las ti'o/ /zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las bud med kyi rkyen rnams rdzogs so// //rtags kyi don la dang po'o/ /bod pa la 'ang ngo / /bhosra rnams so/ /lhag ma rnams bya ba'i las/ byed pos bsgrub pa'i thabs/ sbyin pa'i snod/bye zhing lhung ba/ 'brel pa rten du gyur pa'i dngos po dag la'o/ /dus dang lam bar mtshams ⑤med pa la'o/ /byed pa po gtso bos bya ba nus pa'i sgrub byed la'o / /mi byed pa dang lhan cig pa dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang / bor ba dang logs su bkar ba dang rje bo la sogs pa rnams las so/ /kta la sogs pa ma yin pa'i kṛtpa snekyi byed po dang las ④dag la drug pa'o/ /dran pa'i las la'ang drug pa'o/ /'jigs pa'i rgyu ⑤la'ang lnga pa'o/ /rgyu dang rab tu sbyor ba la drug pa'o/ /'di 'drar yod pa la gsum pa'o/ /gang gi lus kyi rnam 'gyur la'o/ /skyed par byed pa'i rang bzhin la'o/ /ādra la sogs pa sbyor ba la lnga pa'o/ /'khrugs pa la sogs pa'i sbyor ba la'ang ngo / /ma gus pa la drug pa dang bdun pa dag go/ /gzhan las bshad pa'i dang po'o/ /sdeb sbyor las ni si sogs thams cad du'o/ /zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las byed pa can gyi rab tu byed pa rnams rdzogs so// //ming rnams kyi phan tshun bsdu ba yang ngo / /de yang drug tu dbye'o/ /mi zad pa snga ma ni mi zad par gyur pa'o/ /bsdu ba dang rkyen dag la'o/ /de ni ma 170—10

ning ngo / /mi zad par gyur pa las so/ /mtshungs pa ma yin pa la ya thā'o/ /atro las ātpa ①ma yin pa'i aphra'o/ /ṭā ⑧ji dag yang na'o/ /logs su bkar ba'i don la yā btu yang ngo / /am ③la sogs pa de'i skyes bu'i'o④/ /pā na'i yang na'o/ /na2 la'o/ /na a'o/ /dbyangs la ana'o⑤/ /dang gi don la zlas dbye'o/ /phyogs gnyis pa dang zlas dbye la gcig nyid do/ /grangs thog ma can ni phyogs gnyis pa'o/ /phyogs gnyis pa la mnyam du 'dus pa'i atpa la khyupra'odu—/ /gzhan gyi don la 'bru mang po'o/ /ind+ra la sogs pa dag las kyang ma yin no/ /pra dzasheme dha dag la a sukra'o/ / dharma las ana'o⑧/ /gzhan gyi don la'o/ /skyes pa bzhin yang na'o/ /go yi'o/ /ṭa a ḍa ka rnams so⑨/ /na'i yang na'o/ /mnyam pa'i don la las 'dzin pa'o/ /ming dang kṛtu ⑩las kyang bsdu ba'o/ /sa ha la sogs pa rnams sa la sogs pa'o/ /ku'i katu'o/ /skyes bu la yang na'o/ /'ga' zhig tu dbyi ba ma yin no/ /zlas dbye las dang po yang ngo / /phyogs dang grangs kyi ming can la'o/ /zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las tshig sdud kyi rab tu byed pa rnams rdzogs so// //bu brgyud la and+ra'o/ /dbyangs dang po'i nu2 ⑪'go ba la'ang 'phel ba'o/ /dbyangs la u dang o'i ⑫apra'o/ /and+ra la ṛ ⑫urā'o/ /drang srong ma yin pa la atpa la i2'o⑫/ /garga/ na ḍa/ a tri bud med kyi pi z-i swa mṛ ⑫la sogs pa rnams la rgyalge.ā ya ṇa e yand+ra bhā ya yang ngo / /mang po nyid la 'ga' zhig tu 'jig ⑪go/ /lha dang 'di'i don la'o/ /la lar gnyis ka la'o/ /nd+ra ⑫'gro ba las yang na'o/ /tsa tudra kyi tsa dbyi'o/ /a n+ya gyi dkra'o/ /byed pa po 110—11

ritpashelas supra la'o②/ /apra med pa la sa'i sra la tu'o/ /u pa dma thung ngu'i'o//zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las 'byung 'gyur gyi rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa rnams rdzogs so// //bya ba shor ba la supra'o/ /zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las bya ba shor ba'i rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa rnams rdzogs so// //byung zin pa la si'o/ /pa la dā la sogs pa las so/ /si la ā dang bidu las so/ /usra la ā dbyi'o/ /mā las aṭa'i'o/ /dha la'ang si dbye'o/ /pa la ṇa 'gro ba'o/ /si la'o/ /iṭa las yīṭa snela'o/ /thung ngu las dzha sa la dbye'o| /idra gi si la gī yang na'o/ /dzha sa las so/ /idra la yang na'o/ /iṭa med pa'i nā mi las 'phel ba'o/ /dzha sa la dṛ sha rnams kyi adra ni dra'o/ /si sī dag la'o/ /lo 'gro ba dang bu ṣa sogs la nga'o/ /ha sha ṣa rnams kyi mtha' las sakra'o④/ /zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las byung zin gyi rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa rnams rdzogs so// //byed pa po ma yin pa las ta1 la ind+ra'o⑤/ /dbye'o/ /u pa dma thung ngu las so/ /atu las yukra'o/ /zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las dngos po dang las kyi rab tu byed pa rnams rdzogs so// //ha sa dang po las phul du byung ba la yadra ste gnyis kyang ngo / /yadra la'o/ /110—17

yul paṇḍi ta/ /ma hā paṇḍi ta pa la bha dra dang paṇḍi ta go ku la shā tha mi tha/ mched kyi gsung rgyun dri med legs bshad ltar/ /phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dngos kun 'du ba'i gnas/ /rgyal khab chen po po ta la ru bsgyur/ /'on kyang bdag blo byis pa'i ngang tshul gyis//ma rtogs 'gal 'khrul mchis na thog med kyi/ /mi dge sdig pa'i tshogs dang chab gcig ①par/ /mi 'chab nongs pa'i yid kyis mthol ②zhing bshags/ /'dir 'bad dge tshogs dung dang pad rtsa ltar/ /gcig tu dkar ba'i 'od phung 'bum phrag gis/ /skye rgu'i blo yi mun pa rab bsal ④nas/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob pa dang / /rnam dag brda sprod gzhung gi bcud bsdus pa'i| /tshig nyung don rgyas legs bshad snying po 'di/ /mkha' la nyi zla'i bgrod pa ma chad bar/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig/ // sarba maṅga lo/ /④bsdur mchan/3 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉snga〈co 〉rdzar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo bzhugs/zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈snar 〉masaka ②〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉thatshams ④〈〈co 〉ra /4 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / sde〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra tshalas/ ①〈〈pe 〉rabata yota/ ④⑤〈〈pe 〉skoratshams/5 ①〈〈co 〉ram/ ②〈rteco 〉tsā/ ①〈〈pe 〉rabyi'o/ ④〈〈co 〉sgrog ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉—/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thatshalas/⑦〈〈co 〉7/ ⑧⑨〈dzwape 〉〉〈'ar 〉motshams/ ⑩〈〈co 〉rabye/ ⑪〈〈co 〉〉byus/6 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈dzwasnar 〉ngasra/ ②〈'ar 〉ra'o/ dzee〈〈co 〉wām/ ④〈〈snar 〉rdza/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉70/ rjo〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaga'o/ ⑦〈〈co 〉ma ṭa'o/ /—/7 ①〈〈snar 〉〉shas/ sne〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dku'o/ ④〈〈pe 〉dku/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra 'i/ ༷〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṣa'o/ ⑦〈〈co 〉ra/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉'an/8 ①〈dzwape 〉sko〈snar 〉8'i/ dzee〈〈snar 〉tha/ dzee〈〈pe 〉〉(〈snar 〉ra / (9〈〈snar 〉'ata/ ⑤〈〈co 〉7las ༷〈〈pe 〉〉pu/ dzwa〈snar 〉༄/ 〈〈co 〉tha/ )〈〈snar 〉zas/ cha〈〈snar 〉la/ ⑨rte〈snar 〉tsā rī/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉dkun/110—23

༄ga /brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po dbyangs can ṅgā ka ra ṇa'i 'grel pa rab tu bya ba gsal ldan ces bya ba bzhugs so//①༄4/ /oṃ swaste pra dza bhyaḥ bla ma dang ngag gi dbang phyug 'phags ma dbyangs can ma la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab yangs mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer brgya phrag gis/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde chu skyes gzhon nu'i tshal//legs byas 'dzum dkar phyogs bcur bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /rnam 'dren phyag na padmas dge legs stsol/ /mtha' yas shes bya'i chu gter las 'khrungs shing / /rnam dpyod ngag gi dpal ster lhag pa'i lha/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs rje'i 'od dkar gyis/ /bdag blo'i utpal rab tu rgyas par mdzod②/ /tshul 'di rtogs na shes bya'i gnas kun la/ /thogs pa med pa bde blag bgrod pa'i lam—/ /bcu phrag rig gnas kun gyi dang po mchog /rnam dag brda sprod gzhung 'dir 'jug par rigs/ /de yang 'dir brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po dbyangs can byā ①ka ra ṇa zhes bya ba 'phags ma dbyangs can mas slob 110—26

dpon chen po a nu khyu ti la dngos su stsal ba'i gzhung / 'grel pa slob dpon de nyid kyis mdzad pa dang bcas pa 'di nyid la 'jug par bya ste/ rgya gar skad du/ su rasheswaste byā ka ra ṇa sru traḥ bod skad du/ brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo/ 'phags ma dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pra ṇa mya pa ra mānd+ra dzwalgebā la dhī thrarnyi sirtse ye/ /sā ra swa ñtsā mṛ rdzu kurbe pra kṛ yo nā ti bista re/ /mchog gi bdag nyid la ni rab ⑧btud de/ /byis pa'i blo gos 'phel bar bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mtsho ldan mas mdzad rab tu bya ba rnams/ /shin tu rgyas min go bder brtsam par bya/ /ind+ra dolhapi ya myurnyan ya yuḥshalda bā ra dhiḥ pra kṛ yī ta su kṛsgo su kṣa mo bāhūṃ na raḥka dzee/ /gang zhig sgra yi chu gter dag gi mtha'| /dbang po la sogs kyis kyang ma spobs pa'i/ /de yi rab tu bya ba rdzogs par ni/ /mi yis brjod par bya ba ji ltar bzod/ /de la yang thog mar yi ge so so'i ming dang brda ma bshad na/ phyis gzhung mangs skyon dang rtogs dka' ba dang / brjod mi bde bas mtshams ④sbyor gyi thog mar ming dang brda gzhag par bya ste/ a i u ṛ lo sa mā nāḥ a i u ṛ lo ⑤mtshungs pa rnams so/ /yi ge de rnams la mtshungs pa zhes cho ga 'byung ba'i phyir du ming du btags so/ /hra swa dīrgha plu ta bhedāḥs brnaduḥ thung ngu ring po plu tas phye ba rnams 'dra ba'o/ /a sogs mtshungs pa'i yi ge de rnams la a ā alhalta bu thung ngu ⑦ring po rlu ta ste yun tshad kyi dbye bas gsum gsum du yod do/ /lo kātstsha ṣa su sirnyi ri ti bakhyu ti⑧/ lhag ma 'jig rten las grub pa 'dir bshad do/ /ring thung gi tshad sogs gzhung 'dir dngos su ma bshad pa'i lhag ma 'jig rten dang bstan bcos rnams la grags shing grub pa rnams 110—27

kyang 'dir bshad par bya'o/ /de yang / gcig gi yun tshad thung ngu dang / /gnyis kyi yun tshad ring po ste/ /gsum gyi yun tshad plu ta/ /byed kyi yun tshad gsal byed do/ /de rnams re re la yang / sgra skad gsangs mthon por 'don pa u dātta dang / bar bar 'don pa swa ri ta dang / dma' bar 'don pa a nu dātta ste gsum gsum yod do/ /e i o au sand+ra kṣa rā ṇi/ e i o au mtshams ①sbyor gyi yi ge rnams so/ /yi ge de rnams la mtshamasasnyesbyor gyi yi ge zhes bya ste thung ngu med pa'i ring po dang shin tu ring po nyid do/ /u bha yo swa rāḥganyis po rnams dbyangs so/ /a yig la sogs pa lnga dang e yig la sogs pa bzhi po rnams la dbyangs zhes brjod par bya'o/ /a brdza nā mi naḥ a bor ba nā mi'o/ /a yig bor ba'i dbyangs rnams la nā mi zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar dbyangs rnams kyi brda chad bshad nas/ da ni gsal byed rnams kyi brda chad brjod par bya ste/ ha ya wa ra la nya ṇa na nga ma dzha rte dha gha bha dza ḍa da ga ba kha pha tsha ṭha tha tsa ṭa ta ka ba sha ṣa sā bye tā rgyu/ ha ya wa ra la/ nya ṇa na nga ma/ dzha bhā dha gha bha/ dza ḍa da ga ba/ kha pha tsha ṭha tha/ tsa ṭa ta ka pa/sha ṣa sa/ thog ma dang mtha' ma dag gis so/ /thog ma'i yi ge dang mtha'i yi ge brjod pas de gnyis kyi bar gyi yi ge rnams go bar byed de/ de yang / ha sa zhes pa'i gsal byed yongs rdzogs dang / a yig la sogs pa'i mtharasnyeha sa bzhag pas/ a i u ṛ tpa ④e i o au/ ha ya wa ra la/ nya ṇa na nga ma/dzha bhā dha gha bha/ dza ḍa da ga ba/ zhes pa rnams la a ba so sor bsdu ba/ tsa ṭa ta ka pa rnams la tsa ba so sor bsdu ba/ dzha bhā dha gha bha rnams la dzha bha so sor bsdu ba/ dza ḍa da ga ba rnams la dza ba so sor bsdu ba zhes pa lta bu/ thog 110—28

ma'i ①yi ge la mtha' ma'i yi ge sbyar ba gang dang gang byung ba'i skabs su de dang de'i bar gyi yi ge rnams gzung bar bya'o/ /ha sā byañdza nā ni/ ha sa gsal byed rnams so/ /gong du bshad pa ltar thog ma'i ha yig dang mtha' ma'i sa yig smos pas de'i bar gyi yi ge rnams go bas gsal byed la ha sa zhes brjod par bya'o/ /swa ra nyi dzwa byañdza rgo/ dbyangs nyams pa gsal byed do/ /ha sa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge dbyangs med kho na la gsal byed zer ro/ /kāryā yeta/ bya ba'i ched du'o/ /ha sa rnams la srog tu a yig zhugs pa ni kha nas brjod bde bar bya ba'i ched du'o/ /ya gye ta saṃ tshwa tamya lo paḥ /gang zhig ita kyi ming can de ni dbye'o/ /rkyen dang byengs sogs gang la yang rjes 'brel dbyi ba de la ita kyi ming can zhes zer te de ni dbyi'o/ /barṇa darsha rna lo paḥ yi ge mi mthong ba phyis pa'o/ /barṇa bi ro ho lo pa sha /yi ge rnam khrupar 'gog pa ni dbyi ba tsam mo| mi tra ba tā ga ma/ gnyen dang 'dra ba ni ā ga ma'o/ /sha tru ba dā de shaḥ dgra dang 'dra ba ni kun nas bsgyur ba'o/ /swa rā dzwa ta ri tā ha sāḥsaṃ yo gaḥ dbyangs bar na med pa'i ha sa rnams ni yang dag par sbyor ba'o/ /dbyangs bar na med pa'i ha sa gnyis dang gsum la sogs pa brtsegs pa de la yang dag par sbyor ba zhes brjod par bya'o/ /ku tsu ṭu tu pu baṭwāḥ ku tsu ṭu tu pu sde pa rnams so/ /ku zhes pas ka sde go ba lta bu u yig srog tu zhugs pas rang rang gi sde pa'i yi ge lnga po yongs su gzung ①bar bya ba'i don no/ /a re do nā mi no gu ṇaḥ ar etpa o nā mi'i yon tan no/ /nā mi'i yi ge rnams kyi nang nas ar etpa o ste yon tan gyi yi ge rnams 'byung ngo / /ā ri au dṛdhiḥ④ā ādra ske au 'phel ba'o/ /ā ādra/ i/ au ste 'di rnams la 'phel ba'i 110—29

yi ge zhes bya'o/ /anta swa rā dijiḥ mtha'i dbyangs la sogs pa ṭi'o/ /mtha'i dbyangs la sogs pa'i yi ge rnams la ṭi'i ming can zhes bya'o/ /asgyund+ra rba u pa jo| mtha' las sngon ma u pa dhā'o/ /mtha'i gsal byed srog med kyi sngon ma'i dbyangs de la u pa dma zhes ming du btags so/ /a saṃ yo gā di pa ro hu swa la ①ghuḥ pha rol tu yang dag par sbyor ba sogs med pa'i thung ngu ni yang ba'o/ /yang dag par sbyor ba dang / rnam bcad dang / rjes su nga ro rnams pha rol na yod pa dang ring po rnams ni byu ba yin la/ yang dag par sbyor ba sogs pha rol na med pa'i thung ngu rnams ni yang ba'o/ /kha sna gnyis ka nas brjod dgos pa nya ma so sor bsdu ba rnams dang / gzhan yang yi ge mtha' dag la sna ldan gyi rigs kyang yod la/ a ku ha rnam bcad mgrin pa la skyes sogs kyang ngo / /i ti swa ra swaste byā ka ra ṇa mya sru tātt+waṃdzñā pra kri ya sa mā bhāḥ zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las ming gi rab tu byed pa rdzogs so// //de nas mtshams ①sbyor gyi cho ga rnams bshad par bya ste/ i ye swa re/dbyangs la ilnga'o/ /pha rol tu dbyangs kyi yi ge gang rung zhig yod pa la tshu rol tshig mtha' la sogs pa'i i yig ni phra⑧ru 'gyur te/ da dhi ān ya zhes pa bzhag /iphra/ ha selha— ④saḥ has las ra ha ma yin pa'i ha sa rnams so/ /dbyangs las pha rol gyi ra yig dang ha yig ma yin pa'i ha sa de ni ha sa'i yi ge pha rol la gnyis su 'gyur te/ dhra ⑤yig gnyis brjod/ dzha snye dza bāḥ dzha bha la dza ba rnams so/ /tshu rol dzha sa'i yi ge rnams dzha bha so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge pha rol la dza ba so sor bsdu ba'i yi ger 'gyur te/ /dha yig gong ma 110—30

sde pa gcig pa'ishegrangs mtshungs pa'i da yig tu bsgyur/ swa ra tī rna pa re ②ṇa saṃ yo rdzu/ dbyangs kyis dman pa pha rol tu yang dag par sbyor ro/ /tshu rol gyi ha sa dbyangs med rnams pha rol dbyangs saṃ ha sa dbyangs ldan gang yod pa de la yang dag par sbyor te/ rim par drangs pas/ dargyu na ya/—zho longs shig /zhes pa grub/ go rī a traḥ zhes pa bzhag /rnga yig gnyis su mi 'gyur/ /rā rya bo dwoḥ ra las ya yang gnyis so/ /dbyangs sngon na yod pa'i dra yig las pha rol gyi ya yang gnyis su 'gyur bas/ ya gnyis brjod/ chu la ko ba'i rigashepas re pha steng du 'gro ste/ rim par drangs dralgeyig steng du bris/ gochu traḥ—dkar mo 'dir/ na nyi a traḥ zhes pa la/ na hya traḥ—'diramed/ de bzhin du mdo gzhan gyis bsgrub dgos pa yod na yang / mdo de dag gzhung 'dir blangs te bsgrub par bya ba yin gyi/ mdo gzhan rnams spong dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /u waṃ/ usbra'o⑤/ /dbyangs pha rol la tshu rol gyi u yig ni lnga yig tu bsgyur te/ ma dhu a traḥzhes pa la/ ma— traḥ—zang 'dir/ ṛre/ṛdra'o/ /dbyangs pha rol la tshu rol gyi ṛ yig ni rnga yig tu 'gyur te/ pi z-i and+raḥ zhes pa la/ pi trarjaXḥ—pha'idon/ lo lo/ lowa'o/ /dbyangs pha rol la tshu rol gyi lo yig ni lnga ⑦yig tu 'gyur te/ lo a nu brnyaḥ la nu brnyaḥ— yig jes su 'byel pa/ e a phra⑧/ e alnga'o/ /dbyangs pha rol la e yig ni alnga zhes par 'gyur te/ ne a dzwa/ na ya rna/—'dren byed de mig /o.alnga/ o asbra'o—/ /dbyangs pha rol la o yig ni alnga zhes par 'gyur te/ bho ati/bha ba ti/—yodapa'amadangos po/ go la sogs pa'i pha rol tu akṣaḥ la sogs pa byung na bar du a yig ā ga ma brjod par bya ste/ a yig ā ga ma byin pas/ go 110—31

akṣaḥ ga bākṣa①ཿ—ba lang mig ste skar khung / go ind+raḥ ga bend+raḥ—ba lang gi dbang po ste khyu mchog/ go a dzeedzi rna/ ga bā dzi rna/—ba lang gi pags pa/ swa āo ri tī / swe ri bhā/—rang 'dod ma ste smad 'tshong ma/ pra ubyeḥ spra bhāḥ—brtan pa lus rgyags pa'am 'jigs pa med pa/ akṣa spru nyi hā/ akṣiṃ hi rtswa/—dmag sde chen po gcig gi ming yin te/ji skad du/ khri phrag dang — glang bo che/ /gsum 'gyur shing rta dpa' bo 'bum/ /rta ni 'bum phrag bcu rkang thang / /bye ba sum cu rtsa drug 'jug /mas nyi tsā zhes par brngod/ na byañdza rgo swa rā sadhe yāḥ gsal byed la dbyangs mtshams ①sbyor ba ma yin no/ /gsal byed pha rol la tshu rol gyi dbyangs rnams mtshams ④sbyor bya ba ma yin no/ /yang / skabs la lar ya yig la dbyangs dang 'dra ba'i cho ga rnams lam gyi tshad brjod pa sogs dmigs bsal 'ga' zhig tu byed pa yang yod de/ go yu tiḥ zhes pa la/ ga byu tiḥ—rgyangagrags gnyis/ lam gyi tshad brdod pa sogs ma yin na bya ba med pas/ go yu tiḥ—b.langabasres pa/ nyid do/ /i āphra/ ma āphra'o/ /dbyangs pha rol la i yig ni ālnga ⑤zhes par 'gyur te/ nee a kaḥ tsā ya kaḥ—gtsobo/ au ā wa/ lo āsbra'o / /dbyangs pha rol la au yig ni āspra zhes par 'gyur te/ to i ha tā bi ha/—dedaga'adi/ sborlo pasha pā pa dādhe/ tshig mtha'i yā lnga ༷dag yang na dbyi'o| /tshig mthar gnas pa'i aphra la sogs pa rnams kyi phra yig dngashespra yig dag yang na dbye bar bya ste/ te ā ga ⑧tāḥzhes pa la/ ta ā ga tā/—de rnams tshur shog /—ta yā ga tāḥ tasmi ā sa rna zhes pa la/ tasmra ā sa rgo/—khyodal gdan/ tasmra yā sa rgo/ pa ṭo i ha zhes pa la/ pa ṭa i ha/—mkhasapa'adi/—pa ṭa bi ha/ a sau ind+raḥ zhes pa la/ a sā ind+raḥ—'didag dbang bo/—a sā bind+raḥ spyir btang phyis pa la slar mtshams ⑨sbyor bya ba ma yin la/ yang sdeb sbyor sogs 110—32

nā mbi/ a mbi las ma yin no/ /a dasra 'gyur ba'i a mbi zhes pa ni mtshams sbyor thob pa ma yin te/ a mbi a di tya/skyinyi ma'adi rnams/ mtshalas rmyesbyor mi thob pas de nyid du gnas pa lta bu'o/ /yī dī twe/ yī 1spru e gnyis nyid las so/ /ma bhā sdeb la sogs pa bor ba'i tshig mtha'i khra yig dang u yig dang e yig gnyis kyi tshig la 'jug bzhin pa de yang mtshams phyasbyor thob pa ma yin te/ abhe a traḥsnyeme dag 'dir/ pa ṭu a traḥsnye mkhas pa dag 'dir/ ma le ā na ya/— 'phreng ba dag longs shig / zhes pa lta bu'o/ /ma ṭī pa sogs ni/ ma ṇi/ i ba/ ma tsā ba/snyenor bu 'dra ba—/ ro da sbo/ i ba/ ro da sī ba/snye gnam sa 'di/ daspa tt+waṃ/ i ba/ dasba tree ba—/ snye khyoshug ri —'di/ dzā yā ba tī i ba/ dzā yā ba tī ba/— 'byor pa 'i bdag po 'di/ māyā pa tt+waṃ i ba/ mā yā pa tree pa/snyesgyu ma'ibadag po 'di/ chasani pā 7taḥ a rma rgo pā ta'o/ /a yig dang o yig ni pā ta rnams dang dbyangs gcig pu pa rnams kyang mtshams spyor ba thob pa ma yin te/ a e waṃ ma n+ya se/— khyod 'di ltar bsam/ no a tra sthā ta bye / ——'dir ma sdod/ a a pe hi/— de tshur shog /i ind+ra pa shya/— 'di dbang ngo/ bltas/ sngo utt+waṃṣṭha—/ snyephagi longs/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /plutaḥ plu ta'o/ /plu ta las kyang mtshams 9sbyor ba thob pa ma yin te/ he de ba dāttalha e hi/snyekye lhas byen tshur shog /dru rā dā hā de ṭiḥplu taḥ rgyang ring por 'bod pa'i ṭi la plu ta'o/ /rgyang ring por 'bod pa dang / skad gsangs mthon por klog pa dang / ngu ba dang / glu len pa sogs kyi ṭi la plu ta thob bo/ /i ti swa ra swaste byu ka ra ṇa su sru tāttha kṛ tisthā na sarnyi ༄ sa mābhāḥ zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las rang bzhin du gnas pa'i mtshams sbyor rnams rdzogs so// ///10—35

sbyohra swa dīḥswa re/ thung ngu las du ṇa na dbyangs la 2 gnyis so/ /u pa jo thung ngu las tshig mtha'i dra yig dang lnga yig dang na —yig rnams ni dbyangs pha rol la gnyis su 'gyur te/ pra tyadra i rda/ pra tyaji rda/snyeso sor mchod pa 'di/ su gaṇa i rda/ su gaṇḍi rda/snyegayog 'khor bzang ngo 'di 'am tshogs bzang ngo 'di/ rā dzan/ i ha—/ rā dza: ha/— rgyal ngo 'di 'am gsal ba 'di/ tshaḥ tsha yi'o/ /u pa dhwa thung ngu las tsha yang gnyis su 'gyur te/ tab/ tsha tram̐/ zhes pa la/ ta ba tshwa tsha tram̐ / kha se tsa bā dzha sā ṭwāṃ/ kha sa la dzha sa rnams kyi tsa pa'o/ /kha sa pha rol la dzha sa rnams kyi tsa pa rnams su 'gyur te/ ta batstsha tram̐/snye khyodakyi gdugs/ 'ga' zhig tu ring po las kyang gnyis su 'gyur bar bshad pas/ sle ka tshaḥsletstshaḥ— dga' ba 'joms te kla klo/ sthā tshaḥ dhītstshaḥ —ngotsha ba/ mo nu swā raḥ ma ni rjes su nga ro'o/ /tshig mtha' dang ha sa pha rol la ma ni rjes su nga ror 'gyur te/tapo / ha sa ti/ tai ha sa ti/— degad mo dgod/ pa ṭupo bṛ thā/ pa tsu bṛ thā/ — mkhas rmongs sam mkhas la don med/ naston ba dādhe dzha se/ beetshog mtha' dang dzha sa la yang na'i'o/ /tshig mtha' dang dzha sa pha rol la yang ma dang na yig ni rjes su nga ror 'gyur te/ ya shān si/ ya shaṃ 4 si/snye grags pa/ rnam/sa/ pa yān se/ pa yī si / — 'o ma rnams sam chu rnams/ pumra/ dzñā/ sum̐ dzñā/snye skyesapa dag /kamra saḥ shaṃ saḥ/snye'akhar 8 ba'am khro 'di/ ya mā ya pa su bā/ ya pa la ya ma yang na'o/ /ya pa pha rol la rjes su nga ro ni ya ma rnams su 'gyur la/ de yang ya pa'i nang gi 'dra ba rnams su 'gyur te/ tai ka ro ti/ taṅka ro ti/— de gyis shig /tai ta no ti/tarnya no ti/snyede la thags thogs — rshag /saṃ dzā na ti/ saṣṭha na ti/snyelegasapa ra skyes/ yapa la pa re ya ba khā bā/ ya ba la pha rol la ya ba la yang na'o/ /rjes su nga ro ni ya ba 710—38

la pha rol la ya ba la rnams su yang na 'gyur te/ saṃ yantaḥ sabodhaḥ—shing rta'i kha lo ba/—saṃ yantaḥ saṃ batma raḥ sasbatma raḥ—dus kyi'o//—saṃ batma raḥ1tshanda si/ rnyi sdeb sbyor la'o/ /sdeb sbyor las sha ṣa sa ha ra rnams pha rol la rjes su nga ro ni lo du 'gyur te/ ba yi so māḥ ba ya snra so māḥ—dengazlab/ saṃ hi tā| sa lo ①nyi tā/—yang dag par phan pa'am kun nas phan pa/ haṃ ra biḥ ta lo ra baṃḥ—de la nyi ma/ haṃsaḥ ha skyod saḥ—ngang pa'i rgyal po ste don med cing yon tan phul du byung ba'i don/ byed ti swa ra swa ste byā ka ra ṇa sa ②sru tājuñdza na sarnyi gas mābhāḥ zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las gsal byed mtshamasalgesbyor rnams rdzogs so// //de nas rnam bcad kyi mtshams ⑤sbyor rnams bshad par bya ste/ bi sardza smi ya su saḥ rnam par bcad bya'i sra'o/ /kha sa'i yi ge pha rol la rnam bcad ni sra yig tu 'gyur te/ kaḥ ta no ti/ kasta no ti/—gang 'thas rjopar byed/ kaḥtsa ra ti/ kashtsa ra ti/—gang spyod par byed/ sha ṣa se bā/ sha ṣa sa la yang na'o/ /rnam bcad ni sha ṣa sa pha rol gyi gzugs su yang na 'gyur te/ kaḥ she te/kasgo te/—su nyal/ kaḥ ṣaṇḍi/ kaṣṭhaṇḍi/—dum bu gang byed/ kaḥ sādhuḥkasgyu byuḥ—gang legs/ kuspruḥṅkaspyo bā/ ku pu dag la ṅka po ⑦dag yang na'o/ rnam bcad di ka sde dang pa sde'i yi ge kha sa'i nang tshan pha rol la rim pa bzhin ṅka dang po dag tu yang na 'gyur zhing / ka dang pa ni brjod pa'i don te/ kaḥ ka ro ti/ kaṅka ro ti/—ci byed dam gang byed/—kaḥka ro ti/ kaḥkha luḥ kaṅka luḥ—ngan pa gang/—kaḥkha luḥ kaḥ pa ṭha ti/ kapo ⑧ṭha ti/—gang klog par byed/—kaḥpa ṭha ti/kaḥ pha la ti/ katha la ti/—ganga'abras bu byed/— kaḥpha la ti/ bā tsa su ba tyā da 110—— 39

yaḥ bā tsa'i pa ti la sogs pa rnams la'o/ /bā tsaḥl sogs pa'i mtha' ni pa ti ①la sogs pa pha rol la ming gi sgra brjod pa la sra yig tu 'gyur la/ de yang ni pā ta ste/ bā tsaḥ pa tiḥ pā tsaspa tiḥ—khruba'ibadag po/ pa naḥ pa tiḥ pa naspa tiḥ—nags bdag ste seng ge/ thra hatu pa tiḥ dṛ haspa tiḥ—rigs ③byed bdag po ste phur bu/ kā garaḥraḥ ka raḥ kā ra ska raḥ—byedapapo/ pā raḥ ka raḥpā ra ska raḥ—mchogagi byed pa bo/ tatpa ka raḥ taska raḥ—chomarkun/ bhāḥ ka raḥ bhāska raḥ—'odabyed de nyi ma/ ha ritpa tsand+raḥ ha ribyu ཿ—'phrog byed zla ba'am rgyal po seng ge zla ba/ 'di dag mtshon byed de/ gzhan yang mdo gzhan nas bshad pa'i ni pā ta rnams kyang de dag gi lugs bzhin du bya'o/ asgo ro rā tri 6/ a hanu gyi rā tri ma yin pa la rnga'o/ /a hanu tshig tu grub pa'i mtha'i rnam bcad ni rā tri la sogs pa'i pha rol ma yin pa la dra ru 'gyur te/ a haḥ ba tiḥ.a harṣa ④tiḥ—nyin mo'i bdag po ste nyi ma/ a haḥ ga ṇaḥ a harga ṇaḥ—nyin mo'i tshogs/rā tri sogs pa zhes pas rā 9 sogs wa dra ru 'gyur ba ma yin te/ a haḥrā troḥ a ho rā triḥ—nyinamatshan/ a haḥ rū paṃ/ a ho rū paṃ/—nyin mo'i gzugs/a tohwakhyuḥ a las a la u la⑤/ a las pha rol gyi rnam bcad ni a pha rol la u ru 'gyur te/ kaḥ azeḥ kophorjaḥ—donagang/ ha bi⑥/ ha ba la'o/ /a las pha rol gyi rnam bcad ni ha ba'i yi ge pha rol la yang u yig tu 'gyur te/ kaḥ ga taḥ ko ga taḥ—gangala'agro/ de baḥ yā ti/ de bo yā ti/—lhathobabo/ ma naḥ ra thaḥ ma no ra thaḥ—yid kyi shing / ā da be loshepa shu| ā las a ba la dbyi'o/ /a yig las pha rol gyi rnam bcad ni a ba'i yi ge pha rol la dbye bar bya ste/ de bāḥ a tpaḥ de bā a tpaḥ— rnams 'dir/110—40

bā tāḥ bārnyiḥ bā tā bādhi/snyerlung—1zhon te dri/ swa re ya two bā/ dbyangs la lnga nyid yang na'o/ /ā yig las pha rol gyi rnam bcad ni dbyangs pha rol la lnga nyid du yang na 'gyur te/ de bāḥ a traḥ de bā ya tra ཿ—— lha rnams 'dir/de bā a traḥ sgo saḥ sgosra las so/ /bhosra bha gosra a sgosra rnams kyi sra'i rnam bcad ni a ba'i yi ge pha rol la dbyi bar bya ste/ bhoḥ e nyi/bho ces hi/snye kye'adir byon/ bha bo/ཿ na ma ste/ chub go na ma ste// — skal ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/a ghoḥ yā hi/ a bho 4yā nyi/snye sdeg pa dengs shig /nā mi no raḥ nā mi las dra'o—/ /nā mi las pha rol kyi rnam bcad ni a ba'i yi ge pha rol la dra 5 ru 'gyur te/ asniḥ a traḥ asni ra traḥsnye me'adir/ pa ṭu9ཿ ya dza te/pa ṭurlu dza te/snyemakhas pa lha mchod/ u ṣa sa ro bu dhe/ uṣas kyi bu dha la ra'o/ /u — ṣas kyi tshig mtha'i rnam bcad ni bu dha pha rol la dra ru 'gyur te/ u ṣaḥbu dhaḥ u ṣarbu dhaḥ —sngon nas gsal ba/ re pha pra kṛ ti/ ka su kha pe pā / re pha'i rang bzhin can ni kha pa la yang na'o/ /re pha'i rang bzhin can te dra las byung ba'i rnam bcad ni kha pa'i yi ge pha rol la yang na dra ru 'gyur te/ gīḥpa tiḥ gīrṣa / tiḥsnye smraba'ibadas ngo// gīpo tiḥ dhū 1ཿ pa tiḥ dhūrsha tiḥ— sa yi bdag po ste rgyal po'am gnya' thag can te khyu mchog /dhū po tiḥ raḥ ra las so ra yig las byung ba'i rnam bcad ni nā mi ma yin kyang a ba'i yi ge pha rol la dra ru 'gyur te/ sthā tāḥ.a tuḥ sthā — tār traḥsnye tho rangs 'dir/(— antaḥ ga taḥ.antarga taḥsnye nang du 'gro/— ri lo po dīrghashtsa/ ra la dbyi ste ring po yang ngo /drayig ni ra yig pha rol la dbyi zhing / dbyangs sngon ma 'ang ring por 'gyur te/pu ṇaspuḥ rā ma te/ pu nā rā ma 7te/—sla ra yang rtsed mo byed/ shuktoḥ rū pyutma nā /5110byed41

bhā ti/ shusri rūphywatma nā bhā ti/—nya phyis dngul du bdag nyid sems so// bee ṣārtse se/ sa dang e ṣa las ha sa la'o/ /sa'i sgra dang e ṣa'i sgra las pha rol gyi rnam bcad ni ha sa pha rol la dbyi bar bya ste/ saḥtsa ra ti/ sa tsa ra ti/—de 'gro 'am ①de spyod par byed dam de g.yo bar byed/ e ṣaḥ ha sa ti/ e ṣa ha sa ti/—'di dgod ②par byed/bee ṣa dā sha ra bhā rā maḥmai ṣa rā dza yu dhisbyi raḥ/ bee ṣa karna ③ma hā tyā shī bee ṣa sgri mo ma hā ba laḥ/ de 'di shing rta bcu pa'i bu dga' byed/ /de 'di rgyal po g.yul ngor brtan pa'o/ /de 'di gtong ba chen po rna ba can/ /de 'di 'jigs pa stobs ni chen po'o/ /spyir btang rnam bcad phyis pa la mtshams ④sbyor ba ma yin kyang bee ṣa zhes pa lta bu sdeb sbyor dang / tshigs bcad kyi rkang pa ma 'grig pa sogs la rnam bcad phyis pa las kyang mtshamasasnyesbyor ba yod do/ /de bzhin du/ ya dukta lorkuki kā ye ha ta dzwa de ba hu lolgebha betu/ se rmā byu ⑧myu da de so ṣā mi tyā ⑨dri nā ma du ṣṭa tā/ gang dag 'jig rten pas bshad 'di dag las/ /rig ⑩byed las ni de 'dra mang po 'byung / /de 'di sa gzhi kun nas ma byin blangs/ /bur shing ma de ⑪zhes sogs nyes pa med/ /kwa tsind+ra dṛstiḥkwa tse da pra ⑫bṛtiḥkwa tsi dī bhā ṣā kwa tsi da n+ya de ba⑫/ ba dherbi dhā dzwa ba hu dhwa sa mbikhyu ⑫tsā turbi ṭwāṃ bā hu la rka ba darnyi/ la lar 'jug ⑫dang la lar mi 'jug pa/ /la lar gdam nga la lar gzhan du 'gyur/ /cho ga'i rim pa mang po yang dag 'dod⑩—/ /sgrub tshul bzhi po ⑫mang du bshad par bya/ /ba1lgeg mo barṇa ⑪bi parya yashtsa dwo tsā pa ro barṇa dubi kā ra nā sho/ dhā tosta daṅgā ti she yalgen yo gasta du tsu te pañtsa bi tt+waṃ ni rust+waṃ/ yi ge glo bur yi ge bsnol ba dang / /gzhan yang gnyis ni yi ge rnam 'gyur nyams/ /byings kyi don de phul byung sbyor ba ste/ /110——42

pa las/ bdun po de la yang gcig tshig gnyis tshig mang tshig gi dbye bas gsum gsum du yod la/ de la yang don tsam bajod pa la rnam dbye dang po rnams 'gyur te/ spyir btang skyes pa'i rtags anyethung mtha' can la/ ༈ de ba si zhes pa la/ i brjod pa'i don/ sro ②bi sargaḥ sra dra dag gi rnam bcad do/ /byings dang ming gi mtha'i dra yig dang sra yig ra sa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge pha rol na yod pa dang tshig mtha'i dra yig dang sra yig dag kyang rnam bcad du 'gyur te/ de baḥ—lha/ de ba la gnyis tshig au byin/ de bo/—lha dag/de ba la mang tshig dzasra ③byen/ de ba/ dzasra zhes gnas pa la/ dza yig dzasra la'o/ /zhes pa'i khyad par gyi don gyi ④'go ba'i ming can yin pas phyis/ring po/ rnam bcad/ de bāḥ—lharnams/ skabs la lar dzasra pha rol las a yig mtha' ⑤can la a sukra ā gam ster bar bshad pas/ de bā saḥ—lharnams⑥/thāza ṇa saḥ—bramaze rnams/ rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig la/ de ba apo zhes gnas pa la/ asna so ra su/ apo shasra dag gi a'o/ /byings ma yin pa'i ming mtha' mtshungs pa'i yi ge las pha rol gyi apo shasra dag gi a yig ni dbyi bar bya ste/ de baṃ/—lhal/ gnyisatshig la/ de bo/—ltag⑦dag la/ mang tshig la/ de ba shasra sdezhes gnas pa la/ shra ⑨yig shasra la'o zhes pa'i khyad par gyi don/ so naḥsum̐ saḥ skyes pa la sa'i na'o/ /skyes pa'i rtags mtshungs pa'i yi ge'i mtha' can las shasra kyi sra yig ni nu yig tu 'gyur ro/ /sha si/ shasra la'o/ shasra pha rol la sngon ma'i dbyangs ring por 'gyur te/de bānu/—lharnams la/ rnam dbye gsum pa'i gcig tshig la/ de ba ṭā zhes gnas pa la/ ṭā yig rjes su 'brel ba ṭā i na'o zhes khyad par gyi don/ ṭi 110—44

na| ṭā i na'o/ /a yig mtha' las pha rol gyi ṭā ni i na zhes par 'gyur te| a i la e/ de be ①na/—lhayis/ gnyis tshig la/ addhi/ bha la ā'o//ming mtha'i a yig ni rnam dbye'i bha yig pha rol la ring por 'gyur te/ /de bā rgyu②/—lha dag gis/ mang tshig la/ byuḥ bha'i bhra ①a'o/ /a yig mtha' las pha rol gyi rnyisra kyi bhra ni a yig tu 'gyur te/ a i la e/ de ba esra zhes gnas pa la/ 'phel ba rnam bcad/ de beeḥ—lha rnams kyis/ a yig mtha' las pha rol gyi bha a ru bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba sdeb sbyor las 'dam kar ④bshad pas/ yang na/ de belgernyiḥ—lha rnams kyis/ kāṇi rnyiḥ—rna ba can rnams kyis/ rnam dbye bzhi pa'i gcig tshig la/ de ba nge zhes gnas pa la/ drarkuyig rnams dra 'go ba'i khyad par gyi don/ de rakra/ nge la a kra'o/ /a yig mtha' las pha rol gyi nge la ⑦akra ā ga ma ster bar bya ste/ kra gnas don/e aphra/ 'dra ba ring po/ de bā ya/—lha'ichedadu/—gnyis tshig la/ de bā rgyu/—lha dag gi ched du/ mang tshig la/ este ba hu twe/ bha sa mang po nyid la e'o/ /rnam dbye'i mang tshig gi bha yig dang sa yig pha rol la a thung mtha' can ni e yig tu 'gyur te/ de be bhyaḥ—lha rnams kyi ched du/ rnam dbye lnga pa'i gcig tshig la/ de ba nga si zhes gnas pa la/ nga si ratpa/ nga si atpa'o/ /a yig mtha' can las pha rol gyi nga si ni atpa tu 'gyur te/ de bātpa/—lhalas/ gnyis tshig la/de bā spyo/—lhadagalas/ mngatshig la/ de be khyuḥ—lha rnams las/ rnam dbye drug pa'i gcig tshig la/ de ba ngas zhes gnas pa la/ ngaspru/ ngasra su'o/ /a yig mtha' las pha rol gyi ngas ni mya ru 'gyur te/ de ba su/—lha'i/ gnyis tshig la/ o si/ os la'o/ a yig mtha'i osra pha rol la e nyid du 'gyur 110—45

te/ e alnga/ de ba yoḥ—lhadagagi/ mang tshig la/ nu ṭā maḥ āpo la nuṭā'o①/ /ming mtha' mtshungs pa'i yi ge las pha rol gyi āpo snel nuṭā ā ga ma sbyin par bya ste/ ṭa yig ṭa 'gro ba dang po'i don/ u brjod pa'i don/ nā mi| nāpo la'o/ /nāpo ⑦pha rol la sngon ma ring por 'gyur te/ de bā ṭwāṃ④/—lha rnams kyi/ rnam dbye bdun pa'i gcig tshig la/ de ba ji zhes gnas ⑤pa la/a i la e/ de be/—lhal/ gnyisatshig la/ de ba yoḥ—lha dgal/ mang tshig la/ki lha ṣaḥsaḥkṛta su/ ku i la la ṣa ru byed de sa'o/ /ka sde dang ikyel so sor bsdu ba sngon ma las pha rol gyi sa yig ni ṣa yig tu 'gyur la/ ⑦yang sgra mdo rnams su brjod bde ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis bsgyur ba ste/ de be ske6/—lha rnamasal/bod pa'i don gyi rnam dbye gsum las gcig tshig la/ ā rma tra bee sirnyi⑨ཿkun tu bod pa la si dhe'o/ /mngon du phyogs pa'i kun tu bod pa'i don gyi si la dhi zhes zer ro/ /sa mā nasterlo polhadma toḥ byings ma yin pa'i mtshungs pa la rnyi dbyi'o/ /byings ma yin pa'i mtshungs pa'i yi ge sngon ma las pha rol gyi rnyi dbyi bar bya ste/ dhi phyis/ kun tu bod pa'i rnam dbye byin pa'i don du he sngon du bzhag /te de ba/—kyelha/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ te de bo/—kye lha dag/ he de ⑩bāḥ—kye rnams/de bzhin du/ gha ṭa/—bumapa/ pa ṭa/—gos/ ma ṭa/—gnas/ stambha/—kab/dṛ pra/—bramaze/ kumbha/—gumapa/ shing /—thrakṣa sogs mtha' yas shing spyir btang a thung mtha' can skyes pa'i rtags thams cad 'di dang 'dra'o/ /a yig mtha' can yin kyang sarba sogs la mi 'dra ba'i cho ga yod la/ sarba sogs ni/sarba/ —thams cad/ bi shwa/—snatshogs/ ubha/—gnyis/ ubhaya/—gnyis min/ a 110—46

so ma pā bhyaḥ—byusra①/ lnga pa gsum la/ so ma paḥ—ngasi②/ som pā ṭwāṃ/— za/so ma pā bhyaḥ—byusra④/ drug pa gsum la/ so ma pa④ཿ—ngasra⑤—so ma poḥ—masra0/ som dzā/—ābra⑦/ bdun pa gsum la/ so ma pi/—ji/ som poḥ—masudzee/ som pā su/—subra/ de bzhin du/ ki khā ⑨la bā/—chu'athung/ shaṃ kha sgyu/—dungabazo ba⑩/ sbrang rtsi 'thung /—ma dhu pā sogs skyes pa'i rtags ā ring mtha' can thams cad de dang 'dra'o// //de nas skyes pa'i rtags i thung mtha' can las ha ri zhes pa'i sgra la dper mtshon na/ de la dang po'i gcig tshig la/ ༈ ha riḥ—'phrog byed/ gnyis byedag la/ byed yu/ byed ni yid spru dag go/ /i thung dang u thung ngu'i pha rol gyi rnam dbye au ⑪gnyis ni sngon ma gang yin de dang 'dra ba'i sī yig dang spru ⑫yig tu 'gyur te/ ha rī/—'phrogabyed dag/ mang tshig la/ e o dzasra/ e ⑫o dzasra la'o/ /i yig dang u yig gi mtha' can dag ni dzasra pha rol la rim pa bzhin e yig dang o yig dag tu 'gyur te/ha ra yaḥ—'phrog byed rnams/ bod pa'i don gyi gcig tshig la/ sgo/ rnyi la'o/ /i ⑫yig dang u yig gi mtha' can ni dhi pha rol la rim pa ltar e yig dang o yig dag tu 'gyur te/ byings ma yin pa sogs kyisalgernyi phyis/ i e/ he ha re/—kye'aphrogabyed/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ ho ha rī/snyesko he ha ra yaḥ—dzasra()/ gnyis pa gsum la/ ha ri/—aza/ harī/— / ha rīnu/—shasra/gsum pa'i gcig tshig la/ ṭā nāste lnga/ bud med ma yin pa la ṭā nā'o/ /bud med kyi rtags ma yin pa'i i yig dang u yig gi mtha' can las pha rol gyi ṭā ni nā ru 'gyur te/ ha ri shā/—ṭā/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ ha ri 110—51

rgyu| — za/ ha ri rnyi①ཿ— sa/ bzhi pa'i gcig tshig la/ nga ta/ nga 'gro ba la'o/ /i yig dang u yig gi mtha' ni rnam dbye dra 'gro ba rnams pha rol la rim pa ltar e yig dang o yig dag tu 'gyur te/ ha ra ye/—de/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ ha ri ṭwāṃ/— bra/ ha ri bhyaḥ/—byus/ lnga pa'i gcig tshig la/nga si nga so ra su/ nga si ngasra dag gi a'o/ /etpa dang otpa dag las pha rol gyi nga bi dang ngasra dag gi a yig ni dbyi bar bya ste/ ha reḥ—ngasi/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ ha ②ri ṭwāṃ/rko za/ ha ri bhyaḥ—byusra/ drug pa gsum la/ha riḥ—ngasudzee/ ha rlo —mas④/ ha rī⑤’/—lhabaX/ bdun pa'i gcig tshig la/ha ri⑦/ ji zhes gnas pa la/ nge ro/ ji ma'o/ /i mtha' dang u mtha' dag las pha rol gyi ji ni au ru 'gyur ro/ /sa tsa ḍitpa/ de yang ḍitpa'o/ /nge au ru bsgyur ba de la ḍitpa ces zer ro/ /ḍi ti ṭiḥ ḍitpa la ṭi'o/ ḍitpa pha rol la sngon ma'i ṭi dbyi bar bya ste/ ha ro/rkoji/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/hazlo —mosra⑧/ ha ri 6/—subra/ de bzhin du/ aldi/—me/ gi ri/—ri/ ra bi / —nyim/ snyan ngag/—ka bi sogs spyir btang skyes pa'i rtags i thung mtha' can thams cad 'di dang 'dra'o// //de nas skyes pa'i rtags ⑨u thung mtha' can la bhā nu zhes pa'i sgra la dper brjod na/ de la yang i e dang u o ru 'gyur ba'i khyad par tsam ma gtogs/gzhung dang sgrub tshul sogs ha ri dang khyad par med de/ dang po gsum la—/ ༈ 'od zer/snyebhā nu⑩ཿ—si/ bhā byu/—ma/ bhā na baḥ—dzasra⑪/ gnyis pa gsum la/ bhā rdu/—aza⑫/ bhānu/—go bhā nunu/snyeshasra⑫/ gsum pa gsum la/bhā nu tsā/—ṭā/ bhā nu rgyu/—sgyuza/ bhānubheḥ— sucha/ bzhi pa gsum la/ bhā na 110 —52

be|—nge/ bhān ṭwāṃ/—sgyubra/ bhā nu bhyaḥ—byusra/ lnga pa gsum la/ bhā noḥ—ngasi/bhā nu rgyu/— za/ bhā nu bhyaḥ—byusra/ drug pa gsum la/ bhā ①noḥ—ngasra/ bhā noḥ—mosadzee/ bhā nu ṭwāṃ/—ābrage / bdun pa gsum la/ bhā no④/—ja/ bhā noḥ—masra/ bhā nu 6/snyesupra/ bod tshig gsum la/ te bhā no/—si/ te bhā ⑤nu/— / he bhā na baḥ—dzasu/ spyir btang skyes pa'i rtags a thung mtha' can thams cad 'di dang 'dra ba'o// //skyes pa'i rtags i thung ༷mtha' can sa khi —grogasapo/zhes pa'i sgra la ni bya ba mi ⑦'dra ba yod de/ dang po'i gcig tshig la/ se ḍā dheḥ dhi ma yin pa'i si ḍā'o / /sa khi'i ⑧sgra las pha rol gyi dhi ma yin pa'i si ni ḍā ru 'gyur te/ siḍā/ḍa ⑨ṭi dbyi ba'i don/ ༈ sa khā/—si/ bod tshig la dhi ma yin pa zhes pas spyir btang ltar bsgrubs pas/ te sa khe/—si/ dang po'i gnyis tshig la/ bee sa khyuḥ sa khi'i ma'o/ /sa khi'i i ni si sogs lnga la i yig tu 'gyur te/ i e/ skyed snyad phra| sa khā yo/—ma/ sdeb sbyor las sa khi'i i bee ru bsgyur ba'i pha rol gyi gnyis tshig au dag ā yig tu bsgyur ba yang na bar bshad pas/ sa khā yā/—skomang tshig la/ sa khā yaḥ—dzasraspyo)/ gnyis pa gsum la/ sa khā yi/—abra/sa khā yo/snyem/ sakhā yā/—au/ sa khāenu/—shasra/ gsum pa'i gcig tshig la/sa khi pa rkyo rīkra/ sa khi pa ti dag la yī ka'o/ /rnam dbye ṭā nge ji rnams gang rung pha rol las sa khi dang pa ti'i sgra dag la/ āoka ⑪ā ga ma yang na 'gyur te/sa khyu/—ṭā/—pa tyā/ ā ga ma glo bur ba yin pas rtag tu ster ba dang mi ster ba 'dam kha can te/ ma byin par spyir btang ltar bsgrubs pas/ sa khi nā/—ṭā/—pa ti nā/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ sa khi ṭwāṃ/ sa khi rnyiḥ bzhi pa 110—53

gsum la/ sa khye/snyenge/snyes kha ye/ sa khi ṭwāṃ/ sa khi bhyaḥ lnga pa'i gcig tshig la/ ṛje/ nga la ṛka'o/ /rnam dbye nga yig dang po can nga 1se dang ngas dag pha rol la/ sa khi dang pa ti'i sgra la ṛkra ā ga ma 'gyur te/ ṛkra byin pas/ sa khye / nga se zhes gnas pa la/ ṛ to nga u/ ṛtpa las nga'i u'o / /ṛ yig mtha' las pha rol gyi nga si dang ngasra dag gi nga phyis pa'i a ni u ru 'gyur te/ de ḍitpa —yin pas ṭi phyis/ sa khyuḥ—ngasi/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ sa khi rgyu/snyesgyum/ sakhi bhyaḥ— sgyusra5/ drug pa gsum la/ sa khyuḥ— ngasra/sa khroḥ— osra6/ sa khāe māṃ/— ā4/ bdun pa'i gcig tshig la/ ji au/ṭi phyis/ sa khi pa ti zhes pas yīka ā ga ma byin pas/ sa khyo /snyeji/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ sa khyodasnyermalnga / sakhi 6/snyesungu /pa ti'i sgra la rnam dbye dang po gsum dang gnyis pa gsum spyir btang ha ri'i skabs dang 'dra la/ ṭā nas 9bzung supra kyi bar sa khi dang 'dra'o/ /yang pa ti'i sgra tshig sdud dang ma 'brel ba rnams gong du bshad pa ltar yin la / pa ti tshig snyud dang 'byel pa ni spyir btang ha ri dang 'dra ba nyid de/skye rgu'i bdag ngo yis/——pra dza pa ti nā/ ṭā/ skye rgu'i bdag po 'i ched du/—pra dza pa ta 'di / —nge/ sogs so/ /4 / i thung mtha' can dī'i sgra la yang mi 'dra ba yod la/ de yang dri — grangs bgrang ba'i skabs dang 'byel ba la gnyis tshig bdun po kho na 'jug ste/dang po'i gnyis tshig la/ dī/ au zhes gnas pa la/ tyadā deṣṭi raḥsnga dom / /ryang sogs kyi si sogs la ṭi a'o/ /tyadu —la sogs pa'i ṭi ni musi sogs rnam dbye pha rol la a yig tu 'gyur te/ ṭi a/ dwo/snyerke gnyis pa'i gnyis 110—5

tshig la/ dwo/—mo/ gsum pa sogs kyi gnyis tshig la rim pa ltar/ dā rgyu/—gnyis dag gis/ dā rgyu/—gnyis dag gi ched du/ dā ṭwāṃ/—gnyis dag las/ dwa yoḥ—gnyis dag gi/dwa yoḥ—gnyis dag la/de bzhin du tri'i sgra la yang grangs bgrang ①ba'i skabs su mang tshig bdun po kho na 'jug ste/ dang po'i mang tshig la/ tri asra ②zhes gnas pa la/ e o dzasra la 'os③/ tu yaḥ—gsumarnams/ gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa rnams kyi mang tshig rnams la/ ṭī1④/—gsum rnams la/ tri rnyiḥ—gsum rnams kyis/ tri bhyaḥ—gsum rnams kyi ched du/ tri⑤khyuḥ—gsumarnams las/ drug pa'i mang tshig la/ tre ra yadra / tri'i a yadra rjongo / /tri'i i yig di drug pa'i mang tshig nuṭa dang bcas pa'i nāpo pha rol la a yang du 'gyur te/ nga yig mtha'i dbyangs 'gog pa'i don/ tra yā ṇḍaṃ⑦/—gsum rnams kyi/ bdun pa'i mang tshig la/tri 6/—gsum rnams la/༈ci tsam⑧/—ka ti'i sgra la yang mang tshig kho na 'jug cing dzasra shasra dag dbye bar bshad pas/ ka ti/—dzasra/ ka ti/—shasra/ ka ti rnyiḥ ka ti bhyaḥ ka ti bhya⑨ཿ ka tī ṭwāṃ⑩/ ka ti 6/ ka ti ni rtags gsum ga 'jug rung ngo / /de rnams kyi skyes pa'i rtags i thung dang u thung mtha' can spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa rnams so// //de nas skyes pa'i rtags khra ring mtha' can las su shrī zhes pa'i sgra la mtshon na/ rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig la/ gzugs mdzes sam dpal lam phun sum tshogs pa⑪/—su shrīḥ—si⑫/ dang po'i gnyis tshig la/ sboddhā to ri la ⑫bo swa re/ byings kyi sī u ngag gi ilnga ubra dag dbyangs la'o/ /byings kyi ngo bor gnas pa'i ming 110—55

la/ swa yi bhu baḥsnyengasra①/ swa yobhu boḥsnye.osra②/ swayobhu ṭwāṃ/snye.ām/ bdun pa gsum la/ swa yi bhu bi/—ji/ swa yibhu boḥ—osu①ཿ swayobhū 6/snyesusdo/bod tshig gsum la/ he swa yi khyuḥ—si/ te swa yo zu bo/— ④/ he su yibhu baḥ—dzasra/⑤se nā nī'i sgra la rnam dbye dbyangs thog ma can rnams la bya ba mi 'dra ba yod de/ dang po'i gcig tshig la/ ༈ sde'i 'dren pa ste dmag dpon/—se nā rīḥ—si/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ sbo bā/ phra 0sbra dag yang na'o| /byengs kyi ngo bor gnas pa'i ming mtha'i āo yig dang u yig gi mtha' can dbyangs gcig pa ma yin pa yi ge gnyis gsum sogs sngon na yod pa/ sngon ma de yang yi ge mang po brtsegs pa ma yin pa/ bha ṣalhu ⑦dang pu nabyu gnyis bor ba'i byu dang dhī'i ⑦sgra ma yin pa rnams ni/ rnam dbye dbyangs dang po rnams pha rol la yīlnga ⑨dang spru lnga ()dag tu yang na 'gyur te/se nā shlau⑩/—sko se nā n+yaḥ—dzasra⑫/ gnyis pa gsum la/ se nā bye/—aza/ se nā rkyo/—yo⑫/se nā n+yaḥ—shasra⑩/ gsum pa gsum la/ se tsā tyā/—ṭā/ se nā rī rgyu/ se tsā rī rnyiḥ bzhi pa gsum la/ se nā bye/—nge/ se nā bhā ṭwāṃ/ se nā nī bhyaḥ lnga pa gsum la/ se nā n+yaḥ—ngasi/ se nā rī ṭwāṃ/ se nā nī byuḥdrug pa'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig la/ se nā n+yaḥsnyengasrarlu/ senā byoḥ—yosra⑩/mang tshig la/ se nā nī sogs las/ āphra la nuṭu dzi—yang na ster bar bshad pas / se nā rtswa ṭwāṃ/—ābra/ se nā ṭwāṃspyo /—ābra/ bdun pa'i gcig tshig la/ā ste⑪ཿ ji'i āmra'o/ /mo rtags āpra kyi mtha' can dang āopra mtha' dang rtswa'i sgra rnams las pha rol gyi ji ni āpo du 'gyur te/ se nā —6/—ji/ gnyis 110—57

pa'o—/ /de yang u mtha'i bya ba ni rtag pa'i cho ga dang ṛ mtha'i cho ga ni mi rtag pa bcos ma'i cho ga yin pas rtag tu rtag pa'i cho ga stobs che bas drug pa'i mang tshig la u mtha'i cho ga kho na bya ste/ krobyu ṭwāṃ/snye āza/ bdun pa gsum la/kroṣṭa ri/snyeji 1/ kroṣṭṛ/ ji / krosnroḥ rmasra / krosbyoḥ rmasra / gronghru 6/ —sungu//bod tshig gsum la/ he krosgo/——si/ te kroṣṭa ro/ he kroṣṭa raḥ de rnams rnams kyi skyes pa'i rtags ṛ yig mtha' can rnams so// //dzā yig dang dza —yig dang e yig rnams kyi mtha' can ni rab tu ma grub bo / 4/ /skyes pa'i rtags i yig mtha' can las su ri'i 5zhes pa'i sgra la mtshon na / dang po'i gcig tshig la/ ri ste/ ri'i sa dang bha la'o/ /ri lta bu'i i yig mtha' ni 7rnam dbye sa yig dang bha yig dang po rnams/ pha rol la ā yig tu 'gyur te / 4/ su rāḥ——nor can/ dbyangs thog ma can thams/ cad la ālnga ru bsgyur bas gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ su rā rngo// rke su rā yaḥ dzasra / gnyis pa gsum la/ su rā 4/—amra / su rā yo/ —cha su rā yaḥ shasra / gsum pa gsum la/ su rā yā/— ṭā/ su rā dzñā/ su rā bhiḥ sogs so// //skyes pa'i rtags o yig mtha' can go'i sgra la mtshon na/ e ro/ o au'o / /si sogs rnam dbye thog ma lnga po gang rung pha rol la rtags mtha' o yig ni au yig tu 'gyur te/ dang po gsum la/ sa/ ba lang/— goḥ —mi / bsha bo /—e/ gā baḥ—dzasra / gnyis pa'i gcig 'dig la / apta si/ amra shasra la'o/ /o yig mtha' ni rnam dbye apo dang shasra pha rol la ā yig tu 'gyur te/ tsā/— amra / gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ gā bo—/ snyerke gāḥsnyeshasras/ gsum pa gsum la/ ga bā/— ṭā/ go bye—/ go bhiḥ/110byed61

can rnams rdzogs so// //༈ de nas dbyangs can mtha' las bud med kyi rtags rnams bshad par bya ste/ de la a yig mtha' can ge ga zhes pa'i sgra la/ ā pa taḥst+ri yī①/ bud med la a la āpra'o/ /a yig mtha' las bud med du brjod pa'i don la āpra rkyen du 'gyur te/ āpra byin/ ge gā zhes grub pa la/ dang po'i gcig tshig si byin/ā paḥ āpra las so/ /mo rkyen āpra byin pa'i mtha' las pha rol gyi si ni dbye bar bya ste/ si phyis/ gi gā/—'gro ldan ma ste chu bo ga—/ gnyis tshig la/ au rī/au khyu'o/ /āpra mtha' las pha rol gyi rnam dbye au ni yī ru 'gyur te/ a i la e/ ge ge/—sko mang tshig la/ gi gāḥ—dzasra②/ kun tu bod pa'i gcig tshig la/ dhi riḥ dhi i'o/ /āpra mtha' las pha rol gyi dhi ni i ru 'gyur te/nye gi ④ge/—si/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ he ge ge/—sko he gi gāḥ—dzasra④/āsthā—/—na kar ko ṭa'i lha mo/ akrā/—'thags byed lha mo/ nor byun ma/—ā1 rnams ni dhi pha rol la āpra kyi mtha' can de thung ngur bsgyur bar bshad pas/ ho ⑤āsba/—si/ he akka/—si/ te abee/—si/ gnyis pa gsum la/ gi ṭwāṃ/—mabrarjo/ge ge⑦/ gi gāḥ gsum pa'i gcig tshig la/ ṭo sau re/⑧ ṭā os dag la e'o/ /āpra mtha' ni rnam dbye ṭā dang osra dag pha rol la e ru 'gyur te/ gi ga ⑨yā/—ṭā/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ gi ga ṭwāṃ/ ge gā bhiḥbazhi pa'i gcig tshig la/ ji tt+waṃ yaṭā/ jitpa ⑩rnams kyi yaṭa'o/ /āpra mtha' las pha rol gyi jitpa ste nge nga si ngasra ji rnams la yaṭa ā ga ma 'gyur te/ ge gā ma/—nge/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ gi gā rgyu/ shaṃ gā bhyaḥ lnga pa gsum la/110—63

ṛ yig mtha' can bud med kyi rtags la mā z-i zhes pa la mtshon na/ de yang thams cad skyes pa'i rtags pi tro'i skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ste/ ༈ma/—mā tā/—si/ mā ta ro/— / mā ta raḥ—dzasra①/ hemā taḥ—si/ mā ta re/—maza/mā ta ro/—ma/ mā ṭīḥ—shasra①/ sogs te shasra ①la ring po nyid las sranur mi 'gyur ba gzhan rnams 'gro'o/ /rgyug mo/—mo rtags swa sre ④sogs ni gong skyes pa'i rtags kadṛ'i skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra'o// //mo rtags i yig gi mtha' can ri zhes pa'i sgra sogs ni skyes pa'i rtags su ri zhes pa'i skabs su brjod pa dang 'dra ste/ ༈ sgrasgrogs/—rāḥ—si/ rā yo/—karā yaḥ—dzasra⑤/ sogs so// //mo rtags o yig mtha' can yang skyes pa'i skabs su bshad pa'i go'i sgra dang 'dra la/ gru/—lo yig mtha' can rna zhes pa lta bu yang glo zhes pa'i skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba nyid do/ /i ti swa ra swaste byā ka ra ṇa mya sru tānd+ra rārnya sdi liṅgābee mābhāḥ/ zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangasangs can gyi mdo las bud med kyi rtags dbyangs mtha' can rnams rdzogs so// //de nas dbyangs kyi mtha' can ma ning gi rtags rnams rab tu bstan par bya ste/ de la a yig mtha' can las ku la zhes pa'i sgra la mtshon na/ dang po'i gcig tshig la/ a to aphra/ a tpa las aphra'o/ /a yig mtha' can ma ning gi rtags las pha rol gyi dhi ma yin pa'i si dang aphra ni aphra du 'gyur la| aphra aphra du bsgyur ba ni ma ning la amra shasra dag 'jig go zhes pa de 110—69

pha rol la 1yang na dbyi bar bya ste/ asmi/ a sbi ni/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ asdoḥ——oskre / asbi 6/snyesurnga / —/ de bzhin du asbi sogs ni/ da dhi/——zho/ saspri——mdung / mig/—akṣ-i la sogs pa mtha' yas so/ / 1 bā ri zhes pa'i rtags la yang ṭā sogs la i atpa 5tu mi 'gyur ba'i khyad tsam ma gtogs aspru 6dang 'dra la/ ma ning gi rtags i mtha' can spyi la'ang bā ri'i cho ga 'di 'jug pa shas che ste/ sa/ chu/——bā ri/ —si/ bā ri bhā/—e/nga zad ṇi /snyedzasra / nga zad/snye.aza// nga mdo sthā/——rke nga rī ṇi/ shasra / nga zad rja/— ṭā/bā ri rgyu/ bā ri bhiḥ bā ri ṇi/snyenge/ bā ri ṇaḥ—ngasi/ sogs so// //ma ning gi rtags khra ring mtha' can la gā ma bhā zhes pa'i sgra la mtshon na de yang / na thu sa ka suhu swaḥ ma ning gi thung ngu'o/ /ma ning gi rtags mtha' dbyangs ring po rnams ni thung ngur 'gyur te/ grong sde'i phra ma mkhan/ gā ma ṇi zhes bsgyur ba la rnam dbye rnams byin pas/ dang po gsum la/ gā ma ṇi/ si/krā ma ṇi —/—au/ gā ma bhā ni/——dzasra / gnyis pa gsum la yang / gā ma ṇi/—amra /gā ma ṇi nī/snye.au/ gā ma bhā ni/snyethasra / gsum pa'i gcig tshig la/ṭā rābukta sum̐sko thu babye/ ṭā sogs la skyes par bshad pa'i skyes pa bzhin yang na'o / /ma ning gi rtags nā mi'i dbyangs mtha' can rnams ṭā la sogs pa dbyangs dang po can rnams pha rol la/ sngar skyes pa'i rtags kyi skabs su bshad pa'i cho ga rnams kyis 5skyes pa bzhin du sgrub pa dang ma ning rang lugs su sgrub 1pa 'dam kha can te/ gā ma ñtsā/——ṭā/ gā ma ṇi nā/—ṭā/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ gā ma ṇi ṭwāṃ/ gā ma ṇi bhiḥ bzhi pa gsum la/ gā ma 110—73

bye—/ nge / gā ma ṇi nee/—— nge / gā ma ṇi ṭwāṃ/ grwa ma ṇi bhya1ཿ lnga pa gsum la/grwa ma juḥ ngasi/ gā ma ṇi naḥ ngasi/ gā ma ṇi rgyu/ grwa ma ṇi bhyaḥ drug pa gsum la/ grwa ma juḥ ngasra2/ gā ma ṇi naḥ — ngasra —/ gā ma ṣyoḥ——masra gā ma ṇi noḥ masra/ gā ma tt+waṃ/——ān4/ gā ma bhā ṭwāṃ/ ā / bdun pa gsum la/ gā ma tt+waṃ/— nge/ grwa ma ṇi ni/——ji/ gā ma ṣyoḥ— rmasra/ gā ma ṇi no5ཿ— asra / krā ma ṇi 6 / — sungu// bod pa gsum la/ te gā ma ṇi/— si/ he gā ma ṇi bhā/snye.au/ te grwa ma bhā ni/——dzasra7/ de bzhin du ma ning gi rtags āo ring / mtha' can thams cad 'di dang 'dra'o// //ma ning gi rtags ā yig mtha' can la so ma pā/ zhes pa la dper brjod na / de yang ma ning gi thung ngu 'os thung ngur bsgyur bas cho ga thams cad a thung mtha' can ku la'i skabs dang 'dra ste/ sa/ si/ so ma paṃ/— 'i ba 'thung / so ma pe / snyezla so ma pā ni/she— dzasra / slar yang so ma paṃ/— amra/ so ma pe/——chu so ma pā ni / — shasra/ / so ma pe na/— ṭā/ so ma pā tt+waṃ/ so ma baiḥ — rnyisra/ so ma pā ya / —nge/ so ma pā rgyu/ so ma pe bhyaḥ sogs so// //ma ning gi rtags la u yig mtha' can la ma dhu zhes pa'i sgra la mtshon na/de yang nā ma'i dbyangs la nupo ster ba kho na ste/ sbrangartsi/ —ma dhu/snyemi/ ma dhu nī/snyechum dhū ni/— dzasra / beer yang / ma dhu/snye.a4 / madhu nī/snye zla ma dhū ni/—— thasra༄ — /ma dhu nā/—— ṭā/ ma byu rgyu/ ma dhu bhiḥ ma dhu de/snye nge 1)/ ma dhu rgyu/ ma dhu bhyaḥ sogs so// //ma ning gi rtags i yig mtha' can la a ti ri zhes pa'i rtags la/ ma ning la thung ngu 'os thung ngur bsgyur la de yang thung ngur bsgyur ba la mtshams ༷110—74

sbyor gyi yi ge rnams kyi i yig dang u yig dag go zhes bshad pas a ti ri zhes par bsgyur bas/ 1 thin tu nor can/ —a ti ri/snye ṅga/ a nyi ri bhā/ — au/ a ti rī ṇi / — dzasradzo/ slar yang / a ti ri/snye arnga/ a ti ri tsā/ rma/ a ti rī ṇi—/ snye shasra —/ a ti ri ṇa/——ṭā/ a ti ri zlo / sogs so// //de bzhin du au yig mtha' can a ti no zhes pa la thung ngur byas pas a ti nu zhes par bsgyur ba la/ 1 gru shinatu lci ba/——a ti nu/ si/ a ti nu byā/ — sko a ti nu ni/snye dzasra—/ slar yang / a ti nu/ — aphra5/ a ti nu bhā/—— e/ a ti byu ni / snye shasra —/ a ti nu nā/—ṭā/ a ti nu ṭwāṃ/ sogs so// //ma ning gi rtags spru ring mtha' can la kha la pū zhes pa'i sgra la mtshon na/ma ning la thung ngu dang / ṭā nas brtsams ma ning rang lugs ltar rnam dbye thams cad la thung ngur bsgyur nas dbyangs thog ma can rnams la numra ster ba dang / skyes par bshad pa zhes pas skyes pa'i rtags la 7pa lū'i skabs su bshad pa rnams yang na bar bya ste/ 1 nganapa/snyekha la pu/—— si/ kha la pu byā/snye au/kha la pū ni/snye dzasra— / slar yang / kha la pu/— alnge/ kha la pu nī/ — yo/ kha la pū ni/snye shasrabye / kha la pu nā/ — ṭā / kha la pā/— ṭā/ kha la pu dzñā/—— rang lugs/kha la pū ṭwāṃ/snyeskyesapa'ilugs/ kha la pu ttaḥ kha la pū bheḥ sogs so// //ma ning gi rtags ṛ yig mtha' can kadṛ zhes pa'i sgra lta bu la yang cho ga thams cad sngon ma rnams kyis rigs 'gre ste/ dang po gsum la/ —/ byed pa—/ snye kadngha /snye si/ kadṛ bhā/— yo/ kadṛ ṇi/snye dzasra rte / gnyis pa gsum la yang / kadngha/snye.apra/ kadṛ bhā/snye.au/ kadṛ 5ṇi/——shasra5/ gsum pa gsum la/kaspyo 1 —/ snye ṭā/ kadṛ ṇa/— ṭā/ kaz-i dzñā/ kadṛ byeḥ bzhi pa gsum la/710byed75

ho—/ snye.au/ te a na ḍā haḥ——dzalnga1/ gnyis pa gsum la/ a na ḍā haṃ/——aphra/ a na ḍā ho/——au/ a nache haḥ— shasra / gsum pa'i gcig tshig la/ a na che hā/snyeṭā/gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ ba sī ra se/ bsra rnams kyi ra sa la'o/ /bsra—/ ——'gebs pa/ srisra /—mtshod snu na/ byesra—/skyi'ajoms pa / byesras/ a na chehu rnams kyi mtha' ni ra sa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge pha rol dang tshig mtha' las kyang du yig tu 'gyur te/ an che bye/ a na zu ddhiḥ bzhi pa gsum la/ a na che he/ a na che tt+waṃ/ a na chebhyoḥ lnga pa gsum la/ a na che haḥsnyengasi6 /a na chebye/ a na chebhyoḥ drug pa gsum la/ a na che haḥ——ngasra/ an che hoḥ—rmasra/ a na che hūṃ/snye.āphra7/ bdun pa'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig la/a na che hi/ a na che hoḥ mang tshig la/ pasra rnams kyi zhes pas/ tro du/kha sa la dzha sa rnams kyi tsa pa 'os du tu/ a na chekhru/1 go du hu zhes pa'i sgra la mi 'dra ba yod de/ dang po'i gcig tshig la/dā derghaḥ da sngon ma'i ghra'o / /da yig sngon na yod pa'i mtha'i hu 9yig ni byings yin na dzha sa'i yi ge dang / ming yin na ra sa'i yi ge pha rol na yod pa dang tshig mtha' las kyang ghra yig tu 'gyur te/ hu ghra/ go dughra/ si zhes gnas pa la/ ā di dza bā māṃ dzha bhānta su dzha bhāstoḥ dzha bha'i mtha' las sngon ma'i dza ba rnams ni dzha bha ste sa dhwa snadag la'o/ /dzha bha so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge mtha' na yod pa'i sngon ma'i dza ba'i yi ge rnams ni byings yin na sa yig dang dhwa zhes pa'i sgra dang / ming yin na ra sa'i yi ge pha rol na yod pa dang tshig mtha' las kyang dzha bha'i yi ge rnams su 'gyur te/ du dzdza/ bā ba sa neeko/ gnas med pa la yang na'o/ /gnas med pa ste gsal byed mtha' can dzha sa'i yi ge ⑩rnams dza 110—77

ba'i yi ge rnams su 'gyur zhing yang na tsa pa rnams su 'gyur te/ ghra gra'am kasi 2 go dhug/snye ba 'job/snyego dhukra/—— si/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ go du ho / — rma / go du haḥ — ngasra / bod pa gsum la/ te go byukra5 /—— si/ te go dhukra—/ — mi/ ho go du ho/snye au/ he go du haḥ— dzasrari / gnyis pa gsum la/ go du haṃ / snye an 7/ go du ho/snye rma/ go du haḥsnye shasra / gsum pa'i gcig tshig la/ go du hā/—ṭā/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ da sngon ma'i gha 'os hu ghra— / dzha bha'i mtha' sogs kyis du dhra/ dzhabha la dza — ba'o sa/ ghra gu/ go dhuhūṃ/ go dhu rgyuḥ bzhi pa gsum la/ go du te/ go dhurgyu/ go dhu ṣṭhaḥ lnga pa gsum la go du haḥ go dhurghaṃ/ go dhuṣṭhaḥ drug pa gsum la/ go du haḥ go du hoḥ go du hūṃ/ bdun pa'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig la/ go du hi/ go du hoḥ mang tshig la/ go dhu ghrarta / su zhes gnas pa la/ kha sa la dzha sa rnams kyi tsa pa 'os/ ghra ka/ ku i la las zhes pas/ sra ṣa/ kra lnga yang dag par spyor ba kṣa'o zhes bshad pas/ go dhu kyu/ —/ yang ma dhu lihu zhes pa'i sgra la'ang khyad par yod de/ dang po'i gcig tshig la/ ho bhāḥ hu'i shwe'o/ /mtha'i ha yig ni byings la dzha sa'i yi ge dang / ming la ra sa'i yi ge pha rol na yod pa dang tshig mtha' las kyang zwa muyig tu 'gyur te/ hu dzdza/ gnas med pa zhes pas/ dza ba'am tsa pa/ sa/ ma dhu liḍa /snye si 5/ nd+ra nga rtsi 'thung pa ste/ bung ba/——ma dhu liṭa— /snye si/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ ma dhu li ho/snye yo/ ma dhu li haḥ— dzasra na/ bod pa gsum la/te ma dhu liḍa 1 / si/ he ma dhu liṭa /snyesi/ he ma dhu li ho/snyechu he ma dhu li haḥ—— dzasra/gnyis pa gsum la/ ma dhu li haṃ/—— alnga/ ma dhu li ho/—— au/ ma dhu li haḥsnye shasra 1/710—78

ra bā ho/—sko mang tshig la/ bā ho bo sha sā do swa re/ shasra sogs dbyangs la bāhu'i 0/bā'i lo'o/ /shasra sogs rnam dbye dbyangs dang po can pha rol la bāhu'i bā yig dbyangs bcas au zhes par 'gyur te/ bā au/ o dang au la au/bhā ro haḥ—shasra/ gsum pa gsum la/ bhā ro hā/—ṭā/ khyu ra bā / bhā ra bādzhaiḥ sogs dang / bdun pa'i mang tshig la/ bhā ra bāzu/༈ tu rā sāhu zhes pa'i sgra la'ang mi 'dra ba yod de/ dang po'i gcig tshig la/ sa teḥṣaḥsārnyi/ sā ha'i sa'i rte la ṣā'o/ /sāhu'i sā yig ni ha 'gyur ba'i rte pha rol la ṣā yig tu 'gyur te/ brgya byin gyi rta/—tu rā ṣāṭu/—si/ tu rā ṣākrekhru/—si/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ tu rā sā ho/—ma/ tu rā sā haḥ—dzasra③/ bod tshig gsum la/te tu rā ṣāṭu/—si/ te tu rā ṣāḍa/snyesi/ te tu rā sā ho/—sko he tu rā sā haḥ—dzasra④/ gnyis pa gsum la/ tu rā sā haṃ/—mabra⑤/ tu rā sā ho/— / tu rā sā haḥ—shas⑥/ gsum pa gsum la/ tu rā sā hā⑦/—ṭā/ tu rāṣā /tu rā ṣādzhaiḥ sogs dang bdun pa'i mang tshig la/ tu rā ṣāzu/༈ ra yig mtha' can la tsa tudra zhes pa'i sgra la mtshon na/ de yang tsa tudra zhes pa grangs ⑧bgrang ba la rnam dbye rnams kyi mang ⑨tshig kho na 'jug cing / dngos po brjod pa'i skabs su ni gcig tshig sogs thams cad 'jug pa las/ re zhig grangs kyi dbang du byas te/ tsa tu rā sgotsa/ tsa tudra gyi shi la āphra yang ngo / /tsa tudra gyi sgra las shi ste rnam dbye dang po lnga pha rol la āphra ā ga ma sbyin par bya ste/ dang po'i mang tshig la/ ༈ bzhi rnams/—tsa tā raḥ—dzasra zhe/ gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa rnams kyi mang 110—80

tshig la rim pa bzhin/ tsa tu raḥ——shasralce/ tsa tubhiḥ tsa turgyaḥ tsa turgyaḥ drug pa'i mang tshig la/ raḥsaṃ khyu yaḥ ra'i grangs la'o/ /ra yig mtha' can grangs kyi don dang 'brel ba las rnam dbye āmra la nu ṭā ā ga ma 'gyur te/ nuṭu ra las ya yang zhes pa'i/ na gnyis/ tsa tuṭwāṃ/snye.apo /bdun pa'i mang tshig la/ tsa tuṣpe/ sogs ta dngos po'i don brjod pa'i skabs su yang des rigs 'gre ste shes par bya'o/ /na yig mtha' can las rā dzan zhes pa'i sgra la/ dang po'i gcig tshig la/na'i u pa jo zhes pas/ u pa dhā ring pokye/ nāsgo no lo —pa sha sgo/ bye ma yin pa la ming gi na dbyi'o/ /bye ma yin pa'i ra sa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge dang tshig mtha' las kyang ming mtha'i na yig ni dbyi bar bya ste/ na phyis/ sa/ rgyal ngo snyerā dzā/snyesi/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ rā dzā kau/snyerma/ rā dzā naḥ—dzasra5/bod tshig la bye ma yin pa zhes pa'i na mi dbyi ba dang ring po mi byed/ te rā dzan—/ snyesi/ te rā dzā rgo/snyesko he rā dzā naḥsnyedzasra/ gnyis pa'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig la/ rā dzā rgodzi/ rā dzā kau/ mang tshig la/ shasra la sogs pa dbyangs la ma ba sogs kyi mdos a phyis/ sa tu'i zhes pas na 2/ dza nyodzña7ཿdzra nywa dag gi dngo/ /dzra yig dang nyu yig yang dag par 'dus pa rgo dzha zhes par 'gyur te/ rā snyoḥsnyeshasra / gsum pa'i gcig tshig la/ rā dzñā/——ṭā/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ dhi ma yin pa sogs kyis na phyis/ phyis pa la ni zhes pas ring por mi 'gyur/ rā dza ṭwāṃ/ rā dza rnyiḥ bzhi pa gsum la/ rā zlo/——nge /rā dza rgyu/ rā dza bhyaḥ lnga pa gsum la/ rā ptaḥsnyengasi/ rā dza kergyu/ rā dza bhyaḥ drug pa gsum la/ rā dzhaḥsnyengasra / rāzloḥsnyemasra/ rārnyi/snye.ā4 / bdun 110byed81

pa'i gcig tshig la/ i ji dag la yang na 'os/ rā rnyi/—ji/ rā dza 1ni/——nge /gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ rārnyoḥ——rmasra/ rā dza su/myu/ de bzhin du/ ya dzwan/——lha mchod mkhan/ atman/snyenga'am bdag /su dharman / — lugs bzang / sogs na mtha' phal cher 'di dang 'dra la 'on kyang /shasra la sogs pa dbyangs la ma bzhes pas ma yig dang ba yig brtsegs pa rnams la a mi dbyi ste/ ya dzwa nā/snyeshasra / ya dzwa nā/ —ṭā/ atma naḥ shasra—/ atma cad—/ — ṭā/ cadabashas cad/ / —/ shwan/——khyi/ yuban/ la nga tsho/ brgya byin/ ma gha ban rnams la ni dang po lnga rā dzan dang 'dra ba la shasra nas brtsams khyad par yod de/ shā deshtsa/ shwa la sogs pa'i yang ngo / /shwa la sogs pa'i ba yig dbyangs bcas ni shasra sogs rnam 5dbye dbyangs dang po can rnams dang / de phan gyi rkyen dang /mo rkyen yīpra dang / yī yig rnams pha rol las kyang u yig tu 'gyur te—/ sa/ shu naḥ— thasra / shu nā/ — ṭā/ sogs dang de bzhin du yu banu 7 la'ang ba u/ 'dra ba'i yi ge 'dus pa la ring po 'os/ 4 / yu naḥ— shasra /pa nā/ —ṭā/ cadags mdo/ /ma gha ban la'ang ba u/ u la o 'os/ sa/ ma gho naḥ——'as / masgo nā—/ ṭā/ ma gha ba rgyu/ ma gha ba bhiḥsogs so/ / ྈ/ na yig mtha' can pa thin zhes pa'i sgra la'ang khyad par yod de/dang po'i gcig tshig la/ i tophotpañtsa su/ lngal itpa kyi atro'o/ /rnam dbye thog ma lnga pha rol la pa thin la sogs pa'i u pa dhwa'i itu ni atpa tu 'gyur te/i a/ pa tho nuṭu/ pa thin gyi nuṭa'o / /pa thin la sogs pa'i tha yig la 110—82

aṣṭanu gyi u pa dmā'i a ni 'di rnams te rnam dbye rnams pha rol la ring por yang na 'gyur te/ aṣṭha ①nyiḥ aṣṭa rnyiḥ bzhi pa'i mang tshig la/ ahā bhyaḥ.aṣṭa khyuḥ lnga pa la'ang / aṣṭha byuḥ aṣṭa bhyaḥ drug pa'i mang tshig la cho ga yang na bar byed kyang gzugs gcig pas/ aṣṭha ṭwāṃ/ bdun pa'i mang tshig la/aṭī su/ aṣṭa su/༈ ma yig mtha' can i daphra gyi sgra la/ dang po'i gcig tshig la/ i da mophoye thu si/ i dpo gyi skyes pa la a yi mo/ /i dpo gyi sgra ni skyes pa'i rtags kyi skabs su si dang lhan cig par a yi zhes par 'gyur te/ ༈ si/—a yo| —'di/ gnyis tshig la/ tyadu sogs kyi si sogs la ṭi a 'os/ i da au zhes gnas pa la/ da su maḥ da'i ma'o/ /tyadu la sogs pa'i da yig ni rnam dbye si la sogs pa pha rol la ma yig tu 'gyur te/ da ma/ o dang au la au 'os/ i mo/—ma/ mang tshig la/ dzasra spru 'os/i me/—dzasra②/ tyadu sogs la bod tshig ni mi 'jug la/ gnyis pa gsum la/i rma/—mabra③/ imo/—sko imānu/—shasra/ gsum pa'i gcig tshig la/ a na ṭa sauḥ ṭa osra dag la a na'o/ /i dpo gyi sgra ni rnam dbye ṭā dang osra ④dag pha rol la a na zhes par 'gyur te/ a nee ⑤na/—7/ gnyis tshig la/ sbyaḥs bha la a'o/ /i dam gyi sgra ni sa yig dang bha yig pha rol la a yig tu 'gyur te/ i ma a bha la ā 'os/ de ring po/ ā rjoṭwāṃ/ mang tshig la/ bhisteḥrnyisra rnyisra 'o/ /i damra dang a dasra kyi sgra las pha rol gyi rnam dbye nyisra ni rnyisra ru 'gyur la de yang bha ar 'gyur ba 'gog pa'i don te/ bha sa mang po nyid la e 'os a er bsgyur bas/ e rnyiḥ bzhi pa'i gcig tshig la/ sarba 110—86

ma la u 'os bsgrubs pas/ a mu yoḥ—mas①/ mang tshig la/ a rī ṣpe/—āza/bdun pa gsum la/ a mu ṣpen/—ji/ amuyoḥ——②/ ambi6/—suspru/ a dasra ③kyi lus 'gyur gzhan ni/ a da saḥkaḥsgyu di brtso④/mtshungs pa la a dasra sdelas ka ste si sogs bzhin no/ /a dasra rjokyi sgra las mtshungs pa'am spyi'i sgra la 'jug pa la/ ka rkyen du 'gyur la de la yang si sogs kyi cho ga rnams ⑦'jug ste/ ṭi a/ du po/ po la u byas pas/a mu ka zhes 'grub pa la sarba sogs kyi bya ba rnams byas pas/ ༈ che ge⑧mo/ —sa mu kaḥ— si/ a mu kau/— / a ⑨mu ke/— dzasra()/ a mu rka/ —mabra/ amu kau/— / a mu kān/—shas⑪/ a mu ke na/—ṭā/ a mu kā ṭwāṃ⑫/a mu kaiḥ— sra/ a mu ka smi⑫/—nge/ a mu kā rgyu4)/ a mu ke bhyaḥ.a mu ka smratpa/—ngasi⑫/ a mu kā spyo/ a mu ke byuḥ a mu ka su/—ngas⑩/a mu ka yoḥ—mas/ a mu ke ṣpe/ a mu ka minu/ a mu ka yoḥ a mu ke 6/i ti swar ⑫swa ste byā ka ra ṇa mya sru tārtse sand+ra⑫ཿpudzre gāḥ⑪sa mābhāḥ zhes pa brda sprod ⑫pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las ha sa'i mtha' las skyes pa'i rtags rnams rdzogs so// //༈ de nas ha sa'i mtha' las bud med kyi rtags rnams bshad par bya ste/de la ha yig mtha' can u pa nahu'i sgra las/ dang po'i gcig tshig la/ ha no dhaḥnahu'i dha'o/ /nahu'i ⑫hu yig ni ra sa'i yi ge pha rol dang / tshig ⑫mtha' las kyang dha yig tu 'gyur te/ hu za/ gnas med pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ ༈ nye bar 'ching chaste lham sgog—u pa natu/—si⑫/ u pa nadu⑪/—si/ gnyis 110—98

ste yī ti sre tsa ta tpā ①batro/ thi tsa tudra dag gi bud med la ti sre tsa ta thra dzā bzhin no/ /tri dang tsa tudra gyi sgra dag ni bud med du brjod pa la rim pa bzhin—/ ti thra dang tsa ta sre zhes par 'gyur zhing mtha'i ṛ⑧yig de yang dzā yig bzhin du ste adra du mi bsgyur ba dra yig tu 'gyur te/ ༈ bzhi/—tsa ta sraḥ—dzasra③/ de bzhin du bsgrubs pas/ gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa rnams kyi mang tshig la/ tsa ta sraḥ—shasra④/ tsa ta thra rnyiḥtsa ta thra bhyaḥ tsa ta thra bhyaḥ drug pa'i mang tshig la/ sdeb sbyor las ṭwāṃ la ring por sgyur ⑤ba dang mi sgyur ba 'dam kha can du bshad pas/ tsa ta thra hūṃ/ tsa ti 1 tsā/ bdun pa'i mang tshig la/ tsa ta sro6/༈ dra yig mtha' can gidra zhes pa'i sgra la dang po'i gcig tshig la/sbobee ha se/ ra ba dag la i u dag gi ha sa la'o/ /dra yig dang bra rjoyig dag gi u pa dhā'i dbyings kyi i yig dang u yig dag ni ha sa'i yi ge pha rol la ring por 'gyur te/ i ring por bsgyur bas/ smra ba/—griḥ—si/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ gi ro/— / gi raḥ—dzasra⑦/ bod tshig la/ te ⑧shrīḥ—si/ gnyis pa gsum la/ gi re/—maza/ gi ro—/—sko gi raḥ—shasra⑨/ gsum pa'i gcig ⑩tshig la/ gi rā/—ṭā/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ dra ba ⑪dag la i u dag gi ha sa la'os/ gīṭwāṃ/ gībhiḥsogs dang bdun pa'i mang tshig la/ gīkhyo/༈ gang ba/—de bzhin du pudra ⑫byudra sogs kyang de kho na dang 'dra'o//—gnya' thag gam sa gzhi/༈ dha yig mtha' can sa midma zhes pa'i sgra la/ gnas med pa dang /110—100
