a mu nī/snye au/ a rū ni/— dzasra / slar yang gnyis pa gsum la / a daḥsnye.apo/ a mu bhā/snye.au/ a spru ni/snyeshasra / gsum pa gsum la—/ a mu nā/——ṭā/ a mū tt+waṃ/ a mbi bhiḥ bzhi pa gsum la/a mu ṣyo/snyenge/ a spru dzñā— / a mbi bhyaḥ lnga pa gsum la/ a mu 6 te —/—ngasi/a mū rgyu/ a mbi bhyaḥ drug pa gsum la/ a mu 6/snyengasrazhe/ amuyoḥsnye.osra /a mbi ṣpe/snye.āpo/ bdun pa gsum la/ a mu 7ṣpen/ a mu yoḥ.a mbi 6/i ti swa ra swa sti byā ka ra ṇa su sru tādha sārnya na sum̐ sa ka liṅga sa mābhāḥ zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las ha sa'i mtha' las ma ning gi rtags rnams rdzogs so// //de nas brjod pa'i rtags yuṣṭhadu asmadu gnyis kyi cho ga rnams bshad par bya ste/ de yang rtags 'di gnyis ni yul pho mo ma ning gsum ka la 'jug cing / gzugs dang cho ga sogs pho mo ma rgong gi dbye ba med pas brjod pa'i rtags zhes bya 9ste/ 1 dang po'i gcig tshig la/ twa ma haṃ se nā/ si yis two a haṃ ngo / /yuṣṭhadu —a smadu dag ni rnam dbye dang po'i si pha rol la rim pa bzhin rtags dang rnam dbye lhan cig par two dang a haṃ zhes par 'gyur te/ a/—two/snyesi/ nga'am bdag —a haṃ /snyesi/ gnyis tshig la/ yu bā bo dī ba tsa de/ gnyis tshig la yu ba ā ba dag go/ /yuṣṭhadu dang a smadu dag ni gnyis tshig pha rol la rim pa bzhin yu ba ā ba zhes par 'gyur te/ yu ba/ au/ ā ba/ au zhes gnas pa la/ ā mo/ au āmra'o/ /yuṣṭhadu dang asmadu dag las pha rol gyi 110byed109

a haṃ nas bdun pa'i yuṣṭha su asmra su'i bar thams cad la sgyur du rung ba ni nges pa ste/ dper brjod tshigs bcad du brjod na/ swā mbi te saḥsnyengasra/ samā ya taḥ swā mbi me māṃ ngasrapra haṃ ga taḥ/ na ma ste ngebha ga band+ra yo de nyi mo ngemokṣa ma bya yo/ khyod kyi rje de legs par byon gyur tam/ /bdag gi rje —1bo yang ni da lta byon/ /bcom ldan khyed la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi zad thar pa bdag la sprul du gsol/ /swā mbi baṃ rmasra 2sa dza hā sauspyoz-iṭī no dā na mas—/— yā tsa māṃ/ /rā dzā baṃ snye dā su te dā rgo dzñā rna no ma byu sru da naḥ/ /gang rgyangs mtho de rje bo khyed dag gi/ /sbyin pa'i khrom 'khrugs 'chos pa bdag gis mthong / /rgyal pos khyed dag la ni sbyin pa byin/ /nged dag la yang ye shes sbrang rtsi dgras/de bo ba rmam ba tā dījurna ra kākau 5lodza nārda naḥ/ /swa mbi bo shkab ya ṭwāṃ rā dzā swā3 mbi kau nee tshosau dza narda naḥ/ /khyab 'jug lha yi 'jug pas khyed dag la/ /skye 'gro'i mchod pas nged dag dmyal las sgrol/ /stobs ldan rgyal po khyed cag rnams kyi rjerte/ /'gro ba'i mchod de nged cag rnams kyi rje/ /na mo bo byusra — ḍa brahma bi zlo bhyo dzñā rna no byusradi ya tt+waṃ dha rgo/ /sā rgo dā shasra tpaḥpra pa shā maḥpa shā mo naḥsnyeshasrache/ su duḥ khe ༄ — na/ /'dud do rnam mkhyen tshangs pa khyod rnams la—/ /ye shes nor sbyin bdag cag rnams la sprul/ /dus kun dga' bar khyed rnams rab tu mthong / /bde dang sdug bsngal bdag cag rnams la mthong /tā mā mā/ aphra gyi tā mā dag go/ /yuṣṭhadu dang asmadu rnam dbye gnyis pa dang lhan cig pa'i gzugs tt+waṃ dang māṃ ni 'dod cing dgos pa yod na rim pa bzhin tā dang mā dag tu 'gyur te/ pa shā mi tā ma aphradā lī tt+waṃ pa shā mā ma aphrad trebhe dka/khyed la bltas na stsos byed kun nas len/ /nged cag la ni myos byed 'jigs 110—113

par mthong / nādo/ dang po la ma yin no/ /tshig gi dang po na yod pa'i yuṣṭhadu dang sna.asmadu rnam dbye dang bcas pa rnams ni te me la sogs par 'gyur ba ma yin te/ dper na/ ngasra—/ —ta ba ye sha tra bo rā dzadma ngasro—/ma te su te sha tra paḥ/ ngasra— /snyeta ba mi tā ṇi yā ni smurma ngasra'um mi tā ṇi tā n+ya pi/ /ji ltar rgyal po khyod kyi dgra bo rnams/ /de rnams bdag cag gi yang nges par dgra/ /nges par khyed kyi gnyen bshes gang yin pa/ /de rnams bdag cag gi yang gnyen bshes so/ /ru dro bi shwe shwa ro de bo yuṣṭha 'amarka kyu la de ba tā/ sa e ba bha ga band+ra tho asmra shkaneeshaṃ pā pa nā sha naḥ/ /drag po sna tshogs dbang phyug lha/ /khyed cag rnams kyi rigs kyi lha/ /de 'dir mgon po bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag cag rnams kyi sdig pa 'joms / /zhes so/ /de bāsmra drwahi dṛ ha re bikṣiṃ&smra trakṣa sarba dā/ saṃ bho da na pa dā da gre na saṃ bha ba ti ba sād yaḥ/ /tshig gi thog ma kun tu bod pa la/ /bas la sogs par 'gyur ba ma yin te/ /kye lha mi yi seṅgas /bdag skyongs shig /dus kun bdag rnams srungs shig khyab 'jug kye/ /tshig gi dang po bod tshig ma yin na bod tshig dang 'brel pa yin kyang bas sogs su 'gyur te/ pā ltu bo dṛ sidha su na kha ṭwāṃ ga la ko ṭa yaḥ/hi ra 5 ka shi porbakṣaḥkṣe tā srekka rmā ru ṇaḥ/ /skyongs shig khyed rnams mi yi seṅge yis—/ /sen mo'i gshol gyi rtse mos 'drob skyong bu/ /gser can byu ni lto ba'i ngos bral ba'i/ /khrag gi 'dam rdzab 'char ka'i dmar po 'dzin/ /tsā di bhi shtsa/tsa la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang ngo / /ca la sogs pa ste/ tsa/ bā/ a /bhe ha / e ba/ e baṃ rnams dang sbyor ba la yang te la sogs par 'gyur ba ma yin te/ ta ba tsa ma ma tsa mi ṭī tsand+ra le khe ba barbha te/ /khrod dang bdag gi 110—114

tsitpa—/ sogs so/ /de'i g.yog 'khor dang tshogs 'dus pa'i don la mchu 'gyur zhing de'i mtha' yang ni pā ta ste/ rā dza na / rgyal po'i g.yog 'khor/ bhasma sa 1 / — thalaba'iphung po/ na ra sa /snyemithams cad/ smra ba'i tshig la 'di zhes tshad bzung ba dang / mang po'i nang nas gcig bzung ba'i don la/ khru bye rī/u ra ri/ u ra rī zhes pa rnams 'jug cing de yang ni pā ta'o/ /༈ dus kyi don/ sa rya/ —demathag—— sa pa ti/ a rya/snye de rang 1/ a dhu nā—/ snye da ni/ i dha nā/snye dalta/ saṃ pra ti/snye da ltanee/— māṃ pra tai/ purbe byuḥsnye sang se/pa re byuḥsnye mnangs/ a bye byuḥsnye gzhes 6 dgus sogs/ ya di/ — dus gang la/snye yarnyi/ta di/—— de'i dus su/snye tarti/ ā shu/snye mgyogs po/ shī — rgyu/—— mgyogs po/ dzha ṭi ti—/ snyemagyogs po/snyedrurṇa sogs kyang ni pā ta'o/ / 1 sthā di ru pa sargaḥ pra la sogs pa nyer — bsgyur ro/ /pra/snye rab/pa rā/snyemachog /a 9snapa snyebral ba'am gnod pa/ sapo—/——rdzogs pa kun tu yang dag /a nu—/ snye rjes su/ a ba/snye kun tu nges pa/ nidra/ — nges pa 'gag pa / dudra/— ngan pa dakhre' ba/rnam—/ snye bi/snye bral/log / kun/snye lha da/snye par/ nges pa /snye nisnye bral ba/ yi/ dhi/snye lhag par/kyang /——phyag pi—/ snye 'ang /yang / shin tu/snye a ti/snye 'das pra— 5/ phul byung / bzang )/ mdzes/ bde/ su/snyerab legs po8/ shin tu/ sa tpa/snye shinatu/ a bhe/snyemangonapar/ so so/—— pra ti/snye thadad/ pa ri/snyeyongs su/ u pa/— nyebaraphan pa/ sogs 'di rnams la nyer 1bsgyur zhes bya ste de rnams dang phyogs mtshungs pa ā bi yang ngo / /praddhā toḥ byings la thog ma'o/ /nyer bsgyur rnams byings rtsal thog mar sbyor ba shas che'o/ /ta da bya yo/ de rnams mi zad pa'o/ /gong du bsten 7pa'i tsa la sogs pa nas pra la sogs pa'i bar de rnams la ni pā 6 ta 'am mi zad pa zhes zer ro/ /110—117

can ni dus rtag tu mo rtags kho na la 'jug pa'i dgos pa ste/ a dzā/—ram/e sha kā/—mamo/ ko ki 'a//—khubyugamo/ bā 'a//—bu mo'am bu mo lo bcu drug ma la ①'jug/shu dru/—dmangs mo/ ga ṇi kā/—smad 'tshong ma/ kā pya taḥ kāpra la atpa kyi i'o/ /ka n+ya kā sogs ma yin pa'i de phan gyi rkyen ka dngos su gnas pa dang bcas pa'i mo rkyen āpra pha ②rol la u pa dhwa'i atpa ni ilgeyig tu 'gyur te/ kā ra ka la/ āpra/ kā ri kā/—byed mkhan ma'am tshig le'ur byas pa/ de bzhin du/ pā ji ④kā/—klog pa mo/ pā tsi kā/—'tshed pa mo/ sogs mtha' las ⑤so/ /ka n+ya kā bumo/sogs ni idra mi 'gyur bar de kha la gnas so/ /nye bsgyur a ba dang a pi gnyis kyi a dgos pa yod na dbyi ba dang ha sa'i mtha' la mo rjorkyen āpra ⑦'jug par drang srong bha gu ris bshad pas/kun tu 'gro/—a ba gā 6/ a pi ⑧dzdza dzwa norayang zhes pa la/ ba gā rgya/— kun tu 'gro/sar yang /—pi jo dzwa zhes pa lta bu dang / ha sa'i mtha' la/ bātsu/ bā tsā/— ngag ma 'am smra ba ma/ nishu/ ni shā/—g.yogamo/ dishra/ di shā/—phyogasam/༈ hra swo bā/ thung ngu yang na'o/ /kau kā ⑨sogs ma yin pa'i sngon ma'i dbyangs ring po rnams ni ka dang bcas pa'i mo rkyen āpra ⑩dang ta rā sogs pha rol la yang na thung ngur 'gyur te/ be ṇi kā/ be ṇi kā/—lan tshar can ⑪ma/ na di kā/ —rgyun can ma ste chu bo/na dī kā/ gre ya si ta rā/—dge⑫legs can ma/—gre ya sī ta rā/༈ nu ṇi āopra/ na ṛ asro la āopra'o⑫/ /rtags na ⑫yig dang ṛ yig mtha' can dang rkyen aṇa gyi mtha' can rnams la mo rkyen āopra ⑫'gyur te/daṇḍinu—/ zhes pa la/ daṇḍi ⑩nī/—dbyug pa can ma/ de bzhin du/ darnyi1/darnyi bhā/—seldanam/ ka rin/ ka ri tsā/—glang chen ma/ mālinu/ mā li rī/—phreng⑩110—119

sogs pa rnams las mo rkyen ā nīpra 1 'gyur te/ ind+ra ddhi/——dbangamo / bha bā bhā—/ snyeskal ldanam/ ngesadā bhā/——drag mo/ sogs so/ / 1 mnyam par bsre ba'i don dang 'brel ba'i āopra pha rol la rtags mtha' yon tan du 'gyur bar bshad pas dper na/ be dā ṭwāṃ tra ya tt+waṃ/ — rig byed rnams gsum rnams/ zhes pa la gsal byed rnam — dbye dang bcas pa phyis khrapra byin yon tan byas pas/ tra yī/——rig byed gsum/ 1 go pā li ka sogs ma yin pa'i pho dang ldan pa la yang mo rkyen yīpra 'jug par bshad de/ (1 dī/ dmangs rigs kyi chung ma/ ga ṇa kri/ —rtsis mkhan gyi chung ma/sogs so/ /go pā la ka sogs la ni āpra sbyar bas/ go pā li kā/ —ba la nga skyong ba'i chung ma'am phyugs rdzi mo/ zhes sogs mang po yod do/ / 1 dzā te ra ye pa dhātpa5/ u pa dhwa ya ma yin pa las rigs la'o/ /u pa dhā ya yig ma yin pa las rigs dang 'brel ba'i bud med brjod pa la mo rkyen yīpra — 'gyur te/ me ṭī/— 'brugamo/ ma hi ṭī/snyematemo/ shu ka rī/— phagamo/ haṃ sī / snyengangamo/ sdom 3ṭī/snyekhyim bya mo/ shāhma bhā/snyebramaze mo/ sogs mtha' yas so / —/ u pa dhā ya yig yin na āpra sbyar bas/ kṣa tri yā/— rgyal rigs mo/ rje rigs mo / snyebai shā bye sogs so/ / 1 na tshod dang po brjod pa dang 'brel ba'i atpa mtha' can las mo rkyen yīpra 'gyur bar bshad de/ ku mā rī/snyegazhon nu ma / ki sho rī/——lo brgyad ma/ ma dzes ma'am bu mo chung ngu /snye ka la bhā sogs so/ /na tshod dang po brjod pa dang 'byel ba ma yin na yīpra mi 'gyur bas/ āpra byin pas/ bṛddhā/snye rgan mo/gnas brtan ma'am ches rgan mo/— sru bi rā sogs dang / atpa mtha' can ma yin na āopra mi 'gyur bas/110—121

gu med de mo gsham/ rnams so/ /pra tī tsā da yaḥ shabhā ni pā rte tyadhe/pra tī ṭī —la sogs pa'i sgra ni ni pā ta'i mtha'o/ /pra tt+waṃ ṭī la sogs pa rnams ni bud med du brjod pa la khrapra kyi mtha' can ni pā ta ste/ pra tī ṭī/— nub/ u dī lnga /snyebyang/ pā ste /— shar/ a bā ṭī/snyesharalho/ sogs so/ / 7 dā ra zhes pa'i sgra ni yul bud med la 'jug pa yin kyang rtags pho rtags kho na yin pas mo rkyen mi 'jug cing rnam dbye rnams kyi yang mang tshig kho na las mi 'jug la cho ngag yang pho rtags kyi skabs ltar bsgrub pa ste/ bud med rnams— snye dā rāḥsnye dzasra5/ bud med rnam sa la/snye dā rān/snye shasra6/ bud med rnams kyis/snye dā riḥsnye rnyisra3 dā re bhyaḥ— bud med rnams kyi ched du/ dā re bhyaḥ — bud med rnams las/ bud med rnams kyi/snye dā rā tt+waṃ/snye.ā // bud med rnams la/ dā re 6/——supra/ 1 borgu ṇatpa / u las yon tan la yang na'o/ /u yig mtha' can las yon tan brjod pa'i don dang 'brel pa la mo rkyen yīpra yang na 'gyur te/pa ṭī/snyemakhasam/snye pa ṭuḥ mṛ dī/ mṛ duḥ——'jam mnyen ma/ ta rtswa/snye lus phra ma/snye ta nuḥ ṛ dzī/snye'ajamaklas ma/snyeṛ — dzuḥ sogs so/ / kau u ta uḥ uspyo lolas spru'o/ /utpa —mtha' las mo rkyen —upra yang na 'gyur te/ paṅgaḥ——kangamo/snye pabyumaḥ bā mo ruḥsnyebarlamadzes ma/—— bā mo rūḥ —/ yu — —nasteḥ yu ban las ti'o/ /yu ban gyi sgra las mo rkyen ti 'gyur te/ yu ba ti15ཿsnyelangatsho ma/ de ltar mo rtags su grub pa 'di rnams la tshig tu bsgrub pa'i phyir si sogs rnams ster ba'i cho ga rnams gong bud med kyi rtags tshig tu sgrub pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar ro/ /i ti swa ra swaste byā ka ra ṇa su sru tāñtsā yaḥpra tya yāsma mābhāḥ zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las 110—123

bud med kyi rkyen rnams rdzogs so// //1 de nas rnam dbye rnams kyi don dang 'jug pa'i yul rgyas par ston pa byed —pa can kyi le'u'i don rnams bshad par bya ste/ li gādzrepra tha mā/ rtags kyi don la dang po'o/ /byings las ming du bsgrub pa'i rkyen byin pas byings las yongs su 'gyur ba/ don dang ldan pa'i sgra'i gzugs de la ming ngam/rtags sam/ sgra zhes bya ste/ rtags de'i ngo bo'am don tsam brjod pa'i tshig tu bsgrub pa'i don la rnam dbye dang po gsum 'jug cing / rtags la sogs pa ste bod tshig la yang rnam dbye'i ngo bo ni dang po nyid de/ dper na/ tshangs pa de — yod pa'o//snyetatmazahma/snyesi/ legs par byed pa legs pa ji tsam/snyesarnyisantaḥ—si/ ki 5yantaḥsnyesi/zhes dang / tshigs bcad du brjod na/ ra bi ra bi rā dza te 5rā dza si/ro ṣādku yemā rī siro — rū ya te/ /bo bhū bye te bhu baṃ khyu pā laḥ——si/ sthā gāṭwāṃ rā ma laglu rṇa / —sko /nyi ma bzhin du gsal byed rgyal po ste/ /khros nas ngu bar byed do gzhon nu ma/ /sa la longs spyod byed — de sa skyong ba/ /sngon dus byung ngo dga' byed mtshan ldan dag /ku mā rāḥsnyedzasro1/ she ra te swe re ro rū kye yadhe tsa nā ra kāḥsnyedzas — /ye gī yadhe dzasra/1tsa gī ta /rtedzñāḥsnyedzasro1snye/ me mṛ yarnyi ru dzā dzi tāḥsnyedzasra zhe — /rang dgar nyal bar byed do gzhon nu rnams/ /ngu bar byed do dmyal ba pa rnams kyang / /glu shes rnams ni glu yang len par byed/ /gang yang rgyal ba 6min rnams 'chi byed nad/1 ā madhe bhe/ tsa/ bod pa la'ang ngo / /mngon du phyogs pa'i don gyi bod pa'i tshig la'ang rnam dbye dang po gsum 'gyur te/ dper na/ tt+waṃ sa 110—124

mudhe ra go binda si/pra sī da pa ra me shwa ra/— si/ /ku mā ro tshesī ra mā sā ṭwāṃ kṣa ma bye 1bho ta pa sri naḥsnyedzasrabyu/ /khyed la rjes su gzungs shig khyab 'jug kye/ /rab baṅgal sprul cig mchog gi dbang phyug kye/ /rang 'dod gdan la 'dug cig gzhon nu kye/ /bzod par mdzod cig dka' thub can rnams kye/ sa/ bho saḥ sgosra — rnams so/ /sgosra4/ bha gosra/ a stosra/zhes pa'i sgra 'di rnams ni bod pa'i don can tshig phrad can te/ kṣa ma swa sgo du sgosrarā rā rgya bha phyebhakasragostu bye na mastu te/ /ā ṭwā sdeṣṭa bho sgosram hā pā rnye bhā ta yā ༄ a sgosra/snyesgo swa gha sma re/ /bzod par mdzod cig dka' bas skyob pa kye/ /skal ldan khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod par bkyi/ /bshad par mdzod cig shes rab chen po kye/ /bdag gi sdig pa choms shig sprug med kye/ 1 she ṣāḥ karle — katram̐ sā dha na yorwa na pā tre bi bye ṣā ba sgo saṃ bant+ra jo ra bha ba yoḥ lhag ma rnams/ bya ba'i las/ byed pa pos bsgrubs (pa'i thabs/sbyin pa'i snod/ bye zhing 5lhung ba/ 'byel6 ba rten7 du gyur pa'i dngos ngo dag la'o/ /rnam dbye lhag ma gnyis pa la sogs pa rnams ni rim pa ltar bya ba'i las la sogs pa de rnams kyi don la 'jug go/ /smras pa/ karta karma tsa ka ra ṇi saṃ /3pra dā rgo ta dzee ba tsa/ /a pā dā nā dhi ka ra ṇa mi tyā hu kā ra kā ni ṣaṭatre—/ /byed pa po dang las dang byed pa dang / /yang dag rab tu sbyin dang de bzhin 'di/ /nges par sbyin dang lhag par byed pa dang / /byed can drug po 'dir ni bshad par bya/ /de yang rnam dbye bdun las drug pa ni 'brel ba'i don ston byed yin pas byed can du mi 'gro la/ byed can drug ni/ /byed po ngo bo tsam brjod pa'i don la dang po/ bya ba'i las kyi don la gnyis panyu /110—125

byed pa'i don la gsum pa① / yang dag par rab tu sbyin pa ste de'i ched du yod nges dang 'grub nges pa'i don la bzhi pa/ nges par kun sbyin pa ste de la byung ba'am 'byung bzhin pa'am 'byung dunges pa'i don la lnga pa/ lhag par byed pa ste chos de la bya ba byed pa'i rtsa ba'i gzhir phya gyur pa'i don la bdun pa rnams 'jug la/ dang po song nas/ sa/ gnyis pa las kyi don la yang dbye ba bzhi ste/ bskyed pa'i las dang /'ong ba'i las dang / 'du byed pa'i las dang / rnam par 'gyur ba'i las dang bzhi ru yod pa las/ las de la zhugs ni zhugs/ zin ni ma byezin/rjes su 'grub ni 'grub nges pa de bskyed pa'i las/ las gang zin cig grub pa de 'ong ba'i las/ sa bon 'debs pa sogs rgyu bsgrub pa dang / de las 'phel ba dang / yon tan dang / skyon dag par byed pa sogs 'du byed pa'i thu las dang / dus snga ma'i gnas skabs kyi du mtshan nyid btang nas slar gnas skabs gzhan gyi mtshan nyid len pa ni rnam par 'gyur ba'i las te/ rim pa bzhin dper brjod na/ ka ṭaṃ aphraka ro ti kā ru ko ④rū apopaṃ drupa shya ti tsakṣu ṣāḥrā rdzu apopāsno ti dharmiṣṭha tsaso oṃ aposu no ti so ma pāḥ bskyed pa'i las/——rtswa la lhas ma byed do rtswa las mkhan/ /'ongaba'i las/snyegazugs la blta bar byas so mig can rnams / /'du byed pa'i las kyi dpe/— rgyal srid rab tu thob po chos ldan pa/ /rnam par 'gyur ba'i las kyi dpe'o// zhi ba bcad par byas te zhi ba 'thung / —/ a bhi taḥdang / sarba taḥ⑩gnyis dang sbyor ba dang / dhikra tse dang spyor ba dang / u parlu pa rlu sogs lan gnyis dang gsum du zlos pa dang spyor ba dang / de las gzhan du yang rnam dbye gnyis pa 'jug pa mthong ste/ gong 1 10—126

bsad / ——bya banus pa'i sgrub byed/ slar yang spre'u rnams kyis g.yul bskyed de/snyebyed papo gtso bo nyid/ /lag pa'i sen mos kyang ni gshog par byed/ bya ba nus pa'i sgrub byed/ —/ rnam dbye bzhi pa'i 'jug yul ni/ sbyin pa'i snod la yang dag par sbyin pa byin pa'i byed pa can la rnam dbye bzhi pa 'jug ste/ rig byed rig pa la ba lang sbyin par byed/ — be da bee nge bi tsā da dā ti/ bstan bcos pa la bu mo ster bar byed/ dza tā ya ngeka ṭwāṃ hūṃd dā ti/ sa/ rnam dbye lnga pa'i 'jug yul ni/ de las de 'byung zhes pa lta bu'i 'byung khungs la 'jug par ma phyazad/ bye ba dang lhung ba zhes pa/ bya zub ni sngar 'byar ba'am 'dus pa slar zhig pa dang gyes pa lta bu dang / lhung ba ni g.yo ba las lhung ba dang mi g.yo ba las lhung ba la sogs pa'i don gyi byed pa can la rnam dbye lnga pa 'jug ste/ g.yo bzhin pa las lhung ba/ — dhā ba tongasi lha shwa da pa tata / — bang rgyug pa'i rta las lhung ngo / / (1 bye ④to mi g.yo ba las lhung ba lhabang si ta zag ti gaṅgā / sa 'dzin las 'bab par 'gyur gang gā/1 rnam dbye drug pa'i 'jug yul ni/ 'di ni 'brel pa gtso bor ston pas byed can la mi gtogs la/ gtso bor 'byel pa dang bdag po'i don la 'jug cing / 'byel tshig la yang gtso phal gnyis las 'brel yul gtso bo la drug pa 'jug pa shas che la 'brel po phal pa ni 'brel yul de'i khyad par 'byed byed nus pa can yin kyang gtso bo phal pa la tshur mi 'brel bas drug pa 'jug pa shas chung ngo / /dper na/ rā dzhaḥngasrarngus pu 'uru kho zlo yaḥ osrapi tro klure tatpā pū dza rgo/ /gu byu phyatt+waṃ āmra shyib tsa rgo pa bye ka bī māṃ āphra hūṃbyer sa ba dwa tsaḥ/ /rgyal bo'i skyes bu bcas pa shes bya ste/ /'dir ni rab tu mchod pa pha mes kyi/ /bla ma 110—128

kyi gsung ni lam pas te/ /dbyangs mkhan rnams kyi ro dang ldan pa'i tshig / sa/ rnam dbye bdun pa'i 'jug yul ni/ gnas dang 'gyur ba'i don sogs la bdun pa 'jug pa las/ gnas la lhag par gnas pa'i don la'ang dbye ba drug ste/ nye bar 'dus pa dang / nye ba can dang / mngon par khyab pa dang / yul can dang / lugs srol can dang / nye bar ston pa rnams la bdun pa 'jug ste dper brjod rim pa ltar/ ka ṭi ngeshe te ku mā rolhaso ba ṭi jigā paḥsu she ra te/ /ti suprale 6 bi rya te 1tai lam̐ hri ༄ —jidi brahma ༄ mṛ tasbra re/ /gzhon nu 'di dag rtswa lhas la nyal la/ / —nyebara'adus pa/ ba lang pa ṭa la ni nyal bar byed/ /—nyebacan/ til 'bru rnams la til mar yod pa ste/ / mngon par khyab pa/ snying la che ngas pa mchog gi bdud rtsi'o/ / yulacan/ yudhe ji sanda hya te dhī rophoṅga lya gre ji ka ri byeṇa sha tai/ /dpa' bo g.yul du go cha lugasasrol gyon par byed—/ /glang chen brgya ni sor mo'i rtse la'o/ / nye bar bstan pa/ —/ 'gyur ba'i don zhes pa ni/ yongs su grub pa'i bya ba zhig la yongs su ma grub pa'i bya ba gzhan zhig yong thang ba'i don la bdun pa 'jug ste/ bharṣa ti jide ba tso ra ā yā taḥsnye lha char la rkun po 'ong ngo / /pa ta hye jishu thumā li ni jipa — 'od 'phreng can shar ba la dgra rdol lo/ /ti tophorā tiḥ/1 dus dang 'byel ba la yang bdun pa 'jug ste/ dbyed dus su khu byug sgra 'byin no / /——ba sadhe jiko ki khā swa re ka ro ti/ / 1 da ni 'phros don rnams bshad par bya ste/ bi nā sa ha na ma ṛ te nirnya ra ṇa swā myu di dzhashtsa/ mi byed pa dang / lhan cig pa dang / phyag 'tshal 170—129

ba dang / bor ba dang / logs su bkar ba dang / rje bo la sogs pa rnams las so/ /mi byed pa la sogs pa rnams dang sbyor ba'i don la rnam dbye gnyis pa la sogs pa rnams 'jug ste/ de yang / mi byed pa la sogs pa rnams dang sbyor ba la gnyis pa/ lhan cig pa sogs la gsum pa/ phyag 'tshal ba sogs la bzhi pa/ bor ba sogs la lnga pa/ logs su bkar ba sogs la drug pa/ rje 2bo dang sbyor ba sogs la drug pa dang bdun pa gnyis ka 'jug ste/ dper brjod rim pa ltar/ bi nā pā paṃ amrasarba pha la ti/—sdeg pami byed pa las 'bras bu thams cad 'byung ngo / /anta re 3 ṇa kṣa bhā aukiñdzi bi te na/snyemig dag dang bral ba la gson pa la ci/ anta rā aphra tt+waṃ māṃ aphra ha riḥ— khyod nyid dang bdag nyid 'phrog byed spangs pa/zhes pa la sogs pa tshig las gzung rngubar bya'o/ / sa/ lhan cig pa sogs ni/ ha sa/— lhanacig /sa dṛ sha/——mnyam pa'am 'dra ba/ — sā ke / sādzha/— mnyam du 'grogs pa/ sa ma rnams dang sbyor ba la gsum pa ste/ mnyam pa / sa ha shi bye ṇa ṭā gu ruḥ — bla ma dang slob ma lhan cig /sa dṛ shasbitro mi tre ṭāṇa/ —nag zla dang sa ga zla ba 'dra/ sā shaṃ na ya nā rgyu ṭwāṃ shra kṣa zla byedantaḥ— mdzes pa'i so ni mig dang mnyam mo//sādzha rnyisra/dha ni bhiz-i taḥ—— nor can rnams dang legs pa po mnyam du bzung ngo / /sā dhuḥ sa oṃ tsande rṇa ṭādi ta phyegu ruḥ——bla ma dang zla ba mnyam du shar ro/ / sa/ phyag 'tshal ba sogs rgo/ na maḥ swa ste/ swā hā/ swa dhāḥ a lam̐—/ ba ṣaṭu rnams dang sbyor ba la bzhi pa 'jug ste/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /—— zug ces sdo/ddhā kyang/——nge / bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zug ces ṭa/ zab nge / —nge / bde legs su gyur cig rgyal po la/snyeswa byā ⑥rā zlo/ —nge/ so mā ya swā hāḥ— nge / zla ba la mchod do/ /pi tho bhyasra ④bhyaḥ —pha mes rnams legs par tshim mo/ /swa dhāḥ nus so gyad la gyad/——alasmaslo ma'i/ ya/——nge / dbang po la 110—130

bstod do// — pa ṣa ḍind+ra rmye ya/snye nge /— / bor ba sogs ni/ ṛ byetaḥdang gzhana.a n+ya snye snadag dang sbyor bar byed pa la lnga pa 'jug ste/ bor ba'am spangs pa/ ye shes spangs pa las grol ba med/— ṛ to dzñā nānda muktoḥngasi—/ khyim las gzhan du glas so// phyi sgyurdo (/ // lnga/ sto/ zabaḥ ngabla/— / bkar ba sogs ni/ mang po nas nges par bzung ba ste de la yang /bya ba dang / yon tan dang / rigs kyi nang nas bkar ba'i dbye bas gsum yod la/ /don de rnams dang sbyor ba la drug pa 'jug ste/ bya ba'i nang nas bkar ba/ kri pa/ ba rā am hūṃ bha ga ba dā rā dhā kaḥ bcom ldan 'das mchod pa ni bya ba kun las gtso bo'o//re/ṣṭhaḥ āpo/ yon tan nas ba7ra ba/ ba/ bye/ gro/: sa spanda ste/ zas/ ba rnams las nag mo 'o ma phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /rigs las bkar ba/ te khye aphra kṣe thog thu'ab (1 zab ta ma/ཿ/ de rnams las rgyal rigs mchog tu dpa'o//1 rje bo sogs dang sbyor ba la ni drug pa dang bdun pa 'dam kha can te / āmra/— ga ṭwāṃ sa/ —— ga nga/ ma āphra bye pa ti/ ba lang rnams kyi rje bo ba 3lang rnams kyi mnga' bdag go—/ /go supra 6 swā mbi go subra ṣṭa bye pa tiḥ/myu/ 'phros don thor bu ba ni/ kadṛ kārya yo raghā do kṛ tai 6 ṣaṣṭṛ/ kta la sogs pa ma yin pa'i kṛta kyi byed po dang las dag la drug pa'o/ /kta la sogs pa ma yin pa'i kṛta sogs kyi rkyen byed pa po dang las kyi don can dang sbyor ba la rnam dbye drug pa 'jug ste/ byed pa'ome//— byā sa ngasra su kṛ tiḥ — rgyal bas byas pa'o/ /bhā ra ta ngasrasu ngasra brashra ba rde/ — bhār ta la thos pa byed/ sma ra to tsa kamee ṣaṣṭṛ/ dran pa'i las la'ang drug pa'o/ /dran pa'i las dang 'byel pa'i don la drug pa 'jug 110—131

cing / gnyis pa'ang 'jug ste/ mā ngasratuḥsma ra ti/snyemadunano// —mā ta ram̐ amra/sma ra ti/ rgyu dang sbyor ba la gsum pa dang lnga pa yang 'jug par bshad de/a ni tyaḥshajaḥkṛ ta ka twe no/snyeṭa gyo/ mi rtag pa'i sgra ni byas pa las so// —a ni tyaḥshajaḥkṛ ta ka tātu/ nga si/ 1 bha ya he to tsa pañtsa mbi/ 'jigs pa'i rgyu la'ang lnga pa'o/ /'jigs pa'i rgyu dang spyor ba'i don la 'ang lnga pa 'jug ste/ ngasi/ — tso rā dī bhe ti/—chom rkun las 'jigs so// // —1ttha bye nga si sa/ tig/ stag las skra ga go/ / lnga (1lnga/ 1nga si shā/sa/ nga si mi/ ta/ཿ thog babs pa/ las lus 'phar ro / 1 ṣeṣṭṛ he tu pra yo ge/ rgyu dang rab tu spyor ba la drug pa'o/ /rgyu dang rab tu spyor ba'i don la drug pa 'jug ste/ ka su ngasra he toḥ—bu mo 'di gang la ster rgyu yin/ 6) ngasra sku/ ka tyā/ sa/ itt+waṃ bhā bee z-i tī ṭā ya/ 'di 'drar yod pa la gsum pa'o/ /'di dang 'di 'dra'o ④zhes pa lta bu 'dra ba'i don brjod pa la rnam dbye gsum pa 'gyur te/ bu dang 'dra bar slob ma la lta/ shaṣyo pu tre 5ṇa pa byu ti/ saṃ sā ra ma sā ra ṇa byung/ (1 tig/ 'khor ba chu shing dang 'dra bar lta'am 'khor ba la snying po med par lta/ sa/ ye māṃ ga bi kā raḥ gang gi lus kyi rnam 'gyur la'o/ /gang la'ang lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyi mtshan nyid brjod pa'i don la gsum pa 'gyur te/ akṣa shā ṭā/kā ṇaḥ mig zhar ba/ pa de ṭā na khañdza⑦ཿ — rkang pa 'theng po/ karte ṭā ṇa pa bye raḥ——rna ba 'on pa/ 1 dza ni kartuḥpra kṛ tiḥ skyed par byed pa'i rang bzhin la'o/ /rgyu gang gi 'bras bu skyed par byed pa'i rgyu de la skyed par byed pa'i rang bzhin zhes 110—132

bya la de'i don la rnam dbye lnga pa 'gyur te/ yasmrattha 1 nga si dzā dzā yadhe tazadme ti / gang la skye rgu rnams skyed nga ra byed nga de ri tshangs nga 'di'o/ / 4/ ā dā ngi yo ge pañtsa mbi/ ādra la sogs nga/ spyor ba la lnga pa'o/ /nyer bsgyur ād la sogs nga/ ma/tshams 'dzin pa'i don du spyor ba la rnam dbye lnga nga/ 'jug ste/ ā pa ṭa li ngu/ tādṛ — phyo ngasi de baḥ/ ba ṭa yi ngu tra tshun lha char 'bebs so / / 4/ de'i 4 don la bzhi pa 'jug nga/ra bshad de/ de yang de'i don zhes pa don shin tu bzang ba sgrub na myur du 'grub nges pa zhig 'a/ zer te/ dper na/saṃ ya mā ngeya shā tai 5 dhadhe na ro dharmā tshongeya saṃ ya saṃ/ /dharja/ mo/ kṣu ngeya me dhā bī dha rgo dā nā nge ya bhukta ya / /sdom brtson ched du thos/ pa 'dzin par byed/ /mi dag sdom brtson chos kyi ched du ste/ /blo dang ldan pa thar ba'i ched du chos/ /sbyin pa'i ched dang zas/ kyi ched du nor/ / 4/ krudhyā 8 di yo gtsa / 'khrugs pa la sogs pa'i spyor ba la'ang ngo / /sems/ 'khrugs pa dang khros nga/ la sogs pa'i don dang sbyor ba la'ang rnam dbye babyu/ pa 'jug ste/ ṭa/ rā nge ya krubye te/ khres nga la sa 'khrus so/ /mi tā ya nge dru hya ti/ grosas bshes la 'khu bar byed/ sdo/ ṇa ba nge te yi ༷ga 'a/ ti/ yon tan ldan nga 'a bsnga sas nga mi byed do/ / —/ kyapra phyis pa la'ang rnam dbye lnga pa 'jug pa ra bshad pas/kyadra/ hadhyāspreng si kṣa te/ khang bzang la sa lta rka bar byed do/ /zhes te khang bzang gi steng du 'dzegs nas phyogs su lta ba'i don no/ /de bzhin du/ ā kyangu/ sa nāspre nga6 kṣa ti/ gdan las lta'o// zhes te gdan la 'dug nas lta ba'i don/ ྈ/ dgos pa las byung ba'i las la sbyor pa la'ang bdun pa 'jug par 110—133

dang / mang tshig la gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig sbyor ba dang / gnyis tshig la gcig tshig dang mang tshig sbyor ba sogs gcig tu ma nges pa sna tshogs yod de / sisnyed dhi dzu ho ti/—zhosbyin sreg byed/ da snro rmyeṭā dzu ho ti/ bram ze'i bdag po rnams gtsang sbra byed do// pu mantu drwahma ṇaspa tiḥ si/ pa tiḥzhes mang tshig gi don la gcig tshig byung ba lta bu'o/ /i ti —swa ra swaste byā ka ra ṇa lya sru tādku ra ka pra kri yā sa mābhāḥ / zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can kyi mdo las byed pa can gyi rab tu byed pa rnams rdzogs so// //de nas tshig sdud kyi cho ga rnams bshad par bya ste/ de yang rnam dbye sogs rab tu bkram pa'i tshig gi sbyor ba rnams nyung ngur bsdus te brjod pa ni tshig sdud ces bya'o/ / 1 sa mā sartswa na ye nā saṃ/ ming rnams kyi phan tshun bsdu ba yang ngo / /don 'gal ba ma yin pa'i ming tshig tu grub pa gnyis sam gsum la sogs pa bsgrigs ④pa'i phrad dang rnam dbye sogs bsdus pas tshig phan tshun ma 'byel ba rnams gcig tu 'brel zhing tshig spyor kyi don thams cad ma tshang ba med par rdzogs shing tshig nyung la sgodon rgyas pa brjod bde ba de ni tshig sdud kyi dgos pa yin no/ /yang chu'i me zhes sam de ni dka' thub can gyi chung ma zhes pa lta bu don 'gal ba rnams la ni tshig sbud kyi bya ba mi 'jug go/ / —/ sa tsa ṣa ḍi dhaḥ de yang drug tu dbye'o/ /tshig sdud de la yang dbye ba drug tu yod de/ mi zad par gyur pa dang / de'i skyes bu dang / zlas 110—135

dbye dang / 'bru mang po dang / las 'dzin dang / phyogs gnyis pa'i bsdu ba rnams yin la/ de rnams las kyang / tshig snga phyi gnyis las snga ma gtso bor gyur pa mi zad pa'i bsdu ba/ tshig phyi ma'i don gtso bor gyur pa phyogs gnyis pa dang de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba/ tshig snga phyi'i brjod bya la gtso phal med pa zlas dbye dang / las 'dzin kyi bsdu ba/ dngos su brjod pa'i tshig de gtso bor mi 'gyur bar de dang 'byel ba'i don gzhan zhig gtso bor gyur pa 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba yin zhing / tshig sdud de rnams kyi nang nas gtso bor gyur pa stobs dang ldan pa ni zlas dbye dang las 'dzin gnyis yin no/ /de ltar tshig sdud drug las dang po mi zad par gyur pa'i bsdu ba ni/ byā'i ( sgra la rnam dbye gnyis pa'i aphra sbyar/ de'i rjes su a dhi kṛ 3tya bha ba ti zhes pa bris pas/ st+ri ya ma dhi kṛ 1tya bha ba ti/ bud med bya ba lhag por yod pa'o// zhes pa 'di la tshig spyor ram ngag ste/ bā kya'am/ bi gra haḥzer la tshig sdud byed pa'i gzhi yin no/ —/ / pūrbaphobya yephobya yī thubha ba/ mi zad pa snga ma ni mi zad par gyur pa'o/ /mi zad pa'i rtags gcig sngon na yod pa de la mi zad pa'i bsdu ba zhes bya zhing tshig sbyor gyi skabs mi zad pa'i rtags de dbus mthar yod kyang bsdu ba byed tshe sngon du 'jog pa ni tshig phrad 37nges tshig gi sgrub pa zhes bya ste/ a bye sngon du bzhag /a dhi ñtsā spyoyapo kṛ tya bha ba ti zhes pa byung ste a dhi sngon du bzhag pas mi zad pa'i bsdu ba yin la/ —/ sa mā sa pra tya ya yoḥ bsdu ba dang rkyen dag la'o/ /tshig sdud kyi bya ba la 'jug pa dang de phan kyi rkyen sogs la rnam dbye'i rkyen rnams dang tshig gi phrad rjes 'brel la sogs pa rnams dbyi bar bya ste/rnam dbye rjes 'byel dang bcas pa phyis pas/ a bye byā zhes gnas pa la de ltar 110—136

rnam dbye rjes 'byel dang bcas pa phyis pas tshig sdud kyi ming thogs shing / de la yang tshig tu bsgrub pa'i phyir si la sogs pa'i rnam dbye rnams ster dgos te mtshon byed du si byen/ sa/ sa na sum̐ sa rka/ de 7ni ma ning ngo / /mi zad pa sngon na yod cing mi zad pa'i bsdu ba byas pa de ni rnam pa kun tu ma ning gi rtags su 'gyur te/ ma ning la thung rngungu 'os/ thung ngur bsgyur bas/ a dhi ste/si / —/ a bya yi bhā bātpa rngu/ mi zad par gyur pa las so/ /mi zad pa'i bsdu ba byas pa'i mi zad par gyur pa de las pha rol gyi rnam dbye thams cad 'jig cing rnam 'gyur sogs bya ba gang yang med pas si 'jig /de'i rjes su don gsal bar byed pa'i tshig kṛ ha kāzlo zhes pa bzhag pas/ a dhi ste kṛ ha kāzlo—/ —— bud med khyim gyi bya ba las lhag por yod do/ /tshig sbyor dang cho ga rnams de bzhin du byas pas/ rā ri ya apo ma ti krārnya/ ches cher 'byor pa dang ldan pa/ zhes pa'i don la/a ti ri ku lo/ ches cher 'byor pa dang ldan pa'i rigs/ nā rna pa apo ma ti krādhe/ gru shin tu non pa/zhes pa'i don la/ a ti nu ja lo/ gru shin tu lci bas chur nub la khad/ —/ ya thā sā dṛ byebye/ mtshungs pa ma yin pa la ya thā'omu/ /dngos po du ma bya ba mi mtshungs kyang tshig gcig tu sbyor ba mi 'gal ba'i don ston par byed pa la mi zad pa'i nang tshan ya thā zhes pa'i sgra 'jug ste/ shatta ma na ti kra mya ka ro ti/— nus pa dang ci 'tsham par rim pas gyis shig /zhes pa'i tshig sbyor la rnam dbye rjes 'brel dang bcas pa phyis a na ti dang don gcig pa'i ya thā sngon du bzhag pas/ya thā shatta/— nus pa ji lta ba/ 1 de bzhin du/ kumbha su sa mbi 'upe zhes pa la rnam dbye rjes 'byel dang bcas pa phyis sa mbi pa'i don nyer bsgyur u pa sngon du bzhag — bum pa'i 'khris su'o//110—137

de babyu/na du/ makṣi kā nā ma/ sha sbrang rnams mi 'byung ngo / āpo/ bha baḥ—— si/zhes pa la rnam dbye phyis/ a bha ba'i don nyer bsgyur nidra sngon du bzhag pas/nirma kṣi rka brta te/ sha sbrang rnams mi 'byung ngo / / —/ gnyis pa de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba ni/ a mā do tahphu ru ṣaḥ amra la sogs pa de'i skyes bu'i 'o/ rnam dbye dang po gsum la de'i skyes bu'i tshig sdud mi 'jug cing amra lkusogs te rnam dbye gnyis pa'i amra nas bdun pa'i supra kyi bar gyi rnam dbye rnams gang rung zhig tshig snga ma'i mtha' na /snyeyod pa pha rol tshig gzhan dang sbyor ba la rnam dbye sogs phyis pa de ni de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba zhes lkubya ste / dper na/ gra aphra mo prabeeḥ —grong la thob bo/ /zhes pa'i tshig sbyor la rnam dbye phyis pas/ gra ma praptaḥ grong la thib 5po/ /de babyu/na du/ dā tre ṭā ṇa khyurghaṃ/ zor bas gcod—/ — dā tra sbyirghaṃ/ yu pā nge ya dā ru/ — kaba'iched kyi shing / yu pa dā ru / z-i ke byusrabhyo bha yi/ — spyang ki las 'jigs so//— thra ka bha yi/ ngas5/ —rā dzhaḥbye pu ru ṣaḥ— rgyal po'i skyes bu 'am rgyal bu'i mi sna/ rā dza pu ru ṣaḥ a suprakṣe 6 shoṇḍaḥ sho la cho lo mkhan/— akṣa shoṇḍaḥ/ 1 skabs la lar amra la sogs pa'i mtha' can gyi tshig de bsdu ba byas nas beer phyi mar spo ba yang yod de/ aljo ji ā hi taḥ me la 'bul ba'i sreg rdzas/zhes pa la rnam dbye phyis snga phyi brjes pas/ ā hi tāsniḥ— me la 'bul ba'i sreg rdzas/de bzhin du/ pubaṃ ⑦alnga bhū taḥsnyesngon nas byung ba'am sngon nas yod pa/ —bhū ta purbaḥ —/ yang bsdu ba'i skabs 'dir tshig gcig tu byed pa'i tshe tshig snga ma na ṇar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can las pha rol gyi tshig phyi ma na ṇar 'gyur ba yang yod de/ sha rā rde āmra/ba rgo/ mda'inags/ zhes pa la/ sha ra ba khaṃ/—— mda'i 110—139

nags—/ de bzhin du/ ā spra rde umab rgo/ aza'i nags/snye.ā mā ba ṇi①/ sa/ pā na lya bāḥ pā na'i yang na'o/ /tshig gcig tu bsdus pa'i snga ma na ṇar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can las pha rol gyi pā na'i na yig ni ṇa yig tu yang na 'gyur te/ su rā yāḥbā rgo/ btung ba bcud dang ldan pa ste chang / zhes pa la/ su rā pā ṇi/ btung ba bcud dang ldan pa ste chang / su rā pā rgo/— / na nyi/ nanya la'o/ /dgag pa'i sgra nanya sngon du 'jog pa de yang de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba zhes bya'o/ —/ /nā/ na a'o/ /tshig sdud kyi bya ba la 'jug pa na nā ka sogs ma yin pa'i dgag pa'i sgra nanya ni a yig tu 1'gyur te/na krāhma ṇaḥ bramaze ma yin pa/ chenas pa la/ yi/ shāhma ṇa/snyebram ze ma yin pa/de bzhin du/ dharme 3bi rudhaḥsnyechos 'joms/ zhes pa la/ chosa'ajoms——a dharmi / gra ha ṇa myu bha baḥ—gza'a'adzin mi 'byung /— a gra ha ṇi/ sogs so/ / —/ a na swa re/ dbyangs la ana'o/ /tshig /pyasdud la dgag pa'i nanya sngon du 'jog pa'i tshig de'i thog ma'i yi ge de dbyangs yin na nanyu ni/ an zhes par 'gyur te/ a shā ngasi da n+yaḥ——rtalas gzhan/ zhes pa la a n+ya kyi don nanyu sngon du bzhag /de an du bsgyur bas/ a na shwa/ rta ma yin nam rta las gzhan/ sa/ gsum pa zlas 'u dbye'i bsdu ba ni/ tsābee dwand+raḥ dang gi don la zlas dbye'o/ /las gnyis la bya ba gcig 'jug pa la phan tshun mi 'gal ba lta bu'i dang gi don gyi bsdu ba ni zlas dbye'i bsdu ba ste/ de la yang spyir bsdu ba dang / bral ba dang gi don dang / spyor ba dang bral ba dang gi don dang /gcig gcig sbyor ba dang gi don dang / kun tu sdud pa dang spyogi don dang 110byed140

bzhir dbye ba las/ byed po gcig gi bla ma'i bstod pa dang dbang phyug gi bstod pa dus gcig tu 'don zhes pa lta bu dus gcig tu sgrub mi nus pa 'du ba dang bral ba dang / byed po gcig gi grong nas bsod snyoms bslangs nas 'ong ba dang ba lang 'tsho zhing 'ong ba lta bu las su bya ba de gnyis phyogs gcig na yod srid kyang sbyor bas bya ba de gcig tu sgrub mi nus pa sbyor ba dang bral ba ste don de gnyis la ni bya byed stong pas zlas dbye'i bsdu ba mi 'jug la/ gcig gcig spyor ba dang kun tu sdud pa ste phyi ma gnyis ni bya byed gang yang nus pa'i phyir zlas dbye'i tshig sdud 'jug pa'i yul yin no/ / kau yang zlas dbye la gtso bo dang dbyangs nyung ba dang i yig dang u yig dang ṛ byeyig gi mtha' can dag dang por 'jog pa tshig phrad kyi sgrub par bshad pas / de yang bsdu bar bya ba'i yul gyi tshig rnams las don gtso phal yod na gtso bo dang / dbyangs mang nyung yod na nyung ba dang / i yig dang u yig dang ṛ yig gi mtha' can yin pa sogs ni sngon du 'jog pa tshig phrad kyi sgrub pa ste / dper na/ rā dzā tsa/ / pu ru ṣa si shtsa/— rgyal po dang skyes bu yang / zhes pa'i tshig spyor la rnam dbye phrad dang bcas pa phyis pas/ gtsobosngon ma/ rā dza pu ru kho/—— rgyal po skyes bu dag /de babyu/na du/ pa ṭuche / si/ guptachu / si/ mkhas pa dang sbas pa yang / yu byeyig thog ma—/ ——pa ṭu gusto/—— mkhas pa sbas pa dag /si asnishtsame dang rlung yang mā ru tashtsa/—— si/ a —thog masnye.asni mā ru to/— merlungadag /bho ghra si tsa bho kyashtsa si/ longs spyod pa po dang longs spyod yang /ṛ thog ma/ sgoskṛ sgo kyo/ longs spyod longs su spyod pa po/ /sdi sitsa pu ru ṣashtsa — si/ bud med dang skyes pa yang / khra thog ma/ sdi bu ru kho/ skyes pa bud med dag /dha bas/ sikha dī rargyu /— si/ shug pa dang seng ldeng yang / dbyangs nyung ba thog ma/ dha ba kha dī ro/— shug pa seng ldeng dag /110—141

— / yang zlas dbye'i bsdu ba la tshig dang po de lha'i ming yin na ring por 'gyur bar bshad de/ ind+rashtsa skyesi z-i haspa ti shtsa —— si/ dbang po dang phur ldubu yang / zhes pa la rnam dbye sogs phyis lha'i ming sngon ma ring po/ iddhā bṛ haspa tiḥ— dbang po phur bu dag / sa/ yang asni la sogs pa'i pha rol gyi so ma la sogs pa'i sa yig dang sha yig ni ṣa yig tu 'gyur bar bshad de/ aghishtsa si so mashtsa — si/me lha dang zla ba yang /zhes pa'i don la rnam rngudabye sogs phyis sngon ma ring po sa ṣar bsgyur bas/aghri sngo mo/ melhazlab dag /de rnams ni gcig gcig sbyor ba ste de dang de 'byel can du sbyor ba yin pas rnam dbye rnams kyi gnyis tshig 'jug pa shas che'o/ /— / yang kun tu sdud pa las gcig dang ldan par 'byung ba la yang na'o zhes bshad pas/ kun sdud kyi ④skabs 'dir gcig gi don dang ldan pa yin pas gcig tshig kho na spyor ba dang dngos po mang po yod pas mang tshig spyor ba yang na bar bya ste/ sha shādzasashtsaku shāshtsapā la shāshtsa dzasra/ dzas/ ri bong dang ku sha dang pā la sha dang / zhes pa'i tshig sbyor la rnam dbye sogs phyis/ mthar gcig tshig dang mang tshig yang na bar byas pas/ sha sha ku sha 5pā la shaṃ/— si/ ri bong rtswa ku sha shing pā la sha rnams—/ tsan ra ṭa/ tshan pa/ 'ab ste/ཿ dzas/— / yang a n+ya la sogs pa'i tshig dang por yod na de la hūṃs ka ā ga ma ster bar bshad pas/ sutshi/ a n+yargyu a n+yashtsa si/ gzhan dang gzhan yang / zhes pa'i tshig sbyor la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis sngon ma'i mthar saka byin pas/yinazlerdophobye〉 / —gzhan dang gzhan/de bzhin du/ pa rashtsa si pa rashtsa/— si/ pha rol dang pha rol/ pa raspa sag re/ si/110—142

pha rol dang pha rol/sa / bzhi pa phyogs gnyis pa'i bsdu ba ni/ e ka twe dī 1 gu dwadzñā/phyogs gnyis pa dang zlas dbye la gcig nyid do/ /'chad 'gyur phyogs gnyis pa'i bsdu ba dang sngar bshad pa'i zlas dbye'i bsru ba'i phyogs gcig la rnam dbye 2 rnams kyi gcig tshig nyid 'jug pa shas che zhing / bsdu ba de gnyis kyi mtha' yang mang po zhig ma ning gi rtags su 'gyur ro/ —/ /saṃ khyu purbo dī gu/ grangs thog ma can ni phyogs gnyis pa'o/ /gang la'ang grangs kyi sgra dang 'bral ba las grangs kyi sgra de thog mar 'jog cing rnam dbye phrad sogs dbyi ba ni phyogs gnyis pa'i bsdu ba zhes bya'o/ 4/ /sa mā ha re atpa yīpra 4dī guḥ phyogs gnyis pa la mnyam du 'dus pa'i ata la yī pa'o3/ /phyogs gnyis pa'i tshig sdud 6kyi skabs 'dir mnyam du 'dus pa'i don can gyi basbu ba'i mtha' ata yin na de mo rtags su byed na byekhrapra 'gyur te/ da shā dzā gā āmramā rde āmra sa mā hāraḥ grong sde bcu rnams mnyam du 'dus pa'o/ /zhes pa'i tshig sbyor la rnam dbye rjes 'brel bcas pa phyis/mthar yī sbyar bas/ grong bcu 'dus pa/ — da sha gā mbi8 / khyupra/ de bzhin du/dzas — nga/stonasna sa ཿ dzas/ sa cha/ —— ta/ me rnams lnga rnams 'dus pa/ me lnga 'dus pa/ — nga/stonaspru ṣkapadzi āphradzā ga dzā sa mā hā raḥ— āphra ba lang rnams lnga rnams 'dus pa'o/ /pañtsa guḥ b.lang lnga 'dus pa—/ tra yā tt+waṃ pa āphra 'a/ āpo ṭwāṃ (sa mā hā raḥ 'bras bu rnams gsum rnams gcig tu tshogs pa//zhes pa la rnam dbye sogs phyis/ tri pha la zhes pa 'di mo rtags su byed na yī lku mi 'jug par āpra ster te/ tri pha khā/ 'bras bu gsum/110byed143

sa/ lnga pa 'bru mang po'i 1 bsdu ba ni/ ba hu bṛ tī ra tyārja/ gzhan kyi don la 'bru mang po'o/ /tshig 2 dngos su brjod pa de'i don gtso bor mi ston par de dang 'byel pa'i don gzhan zhig gtso bor ston pa ni 'bru mang po'i bsnyu ba zhes bya la/ de la yang de ma yin pa'i yon tan can dang / de'i yon tan can gnyis su yod de/ dper brjod rim pa ltar/ ba hu dha rgo se ya su/ sang ci nor ma nga po / zhes pa'i tshig spyor la rnam dbye rjes 'brel dang bcas pa phyis/ pas/nge ma/ yin nga 'i yo na tan/ ba hu dha naḥ noram nga po can/ de bzhin du/ aste dha rgo seya su / bang si nor ma da pa / de ma yin nga 'i yo na tan/ yinaste dha naḥ norarngod nga / lambi tshakarto au kyang sa// sang si rna ba ring ngo das /de'i yon tan can/ 'barjas ma/snadro/ rma ba ring ngo das /sa / 'bru mang po'i bsnyu ba la khyad par can gyi tshig ste rnam dbye bdun nga/'i mtha' can ni tshig phrad las sngon du 'jog par bshad de/ bi she ṣa ṇi aulo hi te nge akṣi au ṭī numra ya su/ khyad nga ra du dam/ra ba'i mib gang bi/ zhes pa'i don la/ lo ti tākṣiḥ mis dam ra ba/ de bzhin du/ kṛ te ji ku sha waṃ si ya lya/ khyim dbe ba gang si/dre/ he ṭa/ tsan 'a/ཿ/ byim dase ba/ 4/ neend+ra di bhyashtsa/ ind+ra la so/gas/ pa dag las kyang ma yin no/ /ind+ra la sogs pa rnams/ dang / tsakra pā ṇi 5 la sogs pa dag las kyang bdun pa'i mtha' can thog mar 'jog pa ma yin te/ si.ind+raḥshe ṣa re ji ya su/ bang ji gtsus na zla ba/ ind+ra she ṣa raḥ btsug na zla ba/ sogs dang / de bzhin du/ tsakre mipā /byeng spyo 55sa// — gang bi 'a ga na 'khor lo/ /tha lnga/ // rtebyeḥ lag na 'khor 'o / casags cas/ / 1 pra dzā me dha yo ra sukra/ pra dzā me dha dag la a suka'o)/ /'bru mang po'i bsdu ba las pra dzā dang me dha dag la a sukra 8 ā ga ma ster te/ su pra dzāḥ— dzas/110byed144

ya gya/snyebazang po'i skyes bu gang gi/ zhes pa'i tshig spyor la rnam dbye rjes 'brang chobacas pa phyis/ mthar a sukra byin/ kra gnas don u brjod don/ i a zhes pas rtags mtha'i a phyis/ si byin/ de yang phyis/ a tu sogs kyis u pa dhā ring pos rnam bcad/ su pra dzāḥ— skye rgu bzang po dārnams/ de bzhin du/ blo gros ngan pa gang gi/ — durme dhāḥ—— dzas/ ya gya/ duche a zhusu ku ṅga dhāḥ——blo gros ngan pa/1 dharmā ④dan/ dharma las ana'o/ /'bru mang po'i bsdu ba las dharma'i sgra la an rkyen du 'gyur te/ su dharmo ya si su zhes pa la/ legs pa'i chos gang gi/legs pa'i chos/—— sa/ dhache//——an si na'i u pa dhā ring po/ —/ a tyāze/ gzhan byu don la'o/ /'bru mang po'i bsdu ba las gzhan gyi edon te sngar mo rtags su grub pa'i ā yī rnams spyir btang la thung ngur 'gyur te—/ byu pa ba tī bhāsi ryā si ya su/ — gzugs ldan chung ma gang gi/ zhes pa'i beetshog rje ra la/rnam dbye sogs phyis/ āpra mtha' thung ngur bsgyur/ —/ sum̐ ba dā/ skyes pa bzhin yang na'o/ /'bru mang po'i bsdu ba las spyir btang mo rtags rnams thung ngur 'gyur bar bshad kyang de'i dmigs bsal tshig dang po yīpra mtha' ni thung rur mi 'gyur ba dang / yang na sngar skyes pa'i rtags kyi skabs bzhin dmāpra gyenyid dbye ba gcig tu ma nges pa sna tshogs yod de/rū pa ba tī bhāzlas—— gzugs ldan chung ma/—— rū pa baddhāzlas ka sthā ṇi sipri thuyā siya mya mdza' mo dge ba can ma gang gi/ ka sto/ bhā khrus yaḥ——mdza' mo dge ba can ma/1 goḥ go yi'o/ /'bru mang po'i bsdu ba las kyang go'i sgra ni thung ngur 'asdomar te/ dzas/snyepañtsag bo dzas ya su/ ba lang lnga po gang gi/ pañtsa guḥ— ba lang lnga/ —/ 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba las grangs dang su dang srebyā ghra sngon ma las pha 110—145

rol gyi tshig gi mtha' atpa yin na dbyi bar bshad de/ sa ha sre sipā dāḥdzasaya su—/ rkang pa stong phrag gang gi/ zhes 1pa'i tshig sbyor la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/grangs sngon ma can las pha rol gyi mtha'i a phyis/ sa ha sra chopātpa/——rkang pa stong phrag/de bzhin du/ sho bha makau pā do au ya gya/ —— gang gi rkang pa mdzes pa dag/ zhes pa'i don la/ su pātpa/——rkangamadzes/ byā sgo au.i ba pā do ma ya lya/ —gang gi rkang pa stag dang 'dra ba/byā ghra pātpa/—— stagarkang / dwo au pā dwo o ya gya/snyerkang gnyis dag gang gi/ dī pātpa/ rkang gnyis / yang dī pātpa/ ces pa la rnam dbye gnyis pa'i shasra 7 —nas bzung dbyangs thog ma can rnams pha rol la u pa dhā thung ngur 'gyur bar bshad pas/long gnyis rnams la/——dī pa daḥ —shas/ ṭā/ —dī pa dā rkang gnyis kyis sogs ④so/ / 1 da ni gong du bstan pa'i tshig sdud de rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i rkyen rnams bshad par bya ste/ ṭā ḍa kāḥ ṭa a ḍa ka rnams so/ /tshig sdud rnams kyi mthar ṭa byel sogs pa rkyen bzhi po 'di rnams 'jug ste/ de yang /ṭa kā rastadru ru kho zlo yolhakā ro dwadhwa e ba tsa/ ḍa kā rasta dwa hu bye ho ka kā roḥsarba to ma taḥ/ ṭa yig de yi skyes bur shes bya ste/ /a yi yi ge 'di yang zlas dbye la—/ /'bru mang po la ḍa yi yi ge nyid/ /ka yig kun la mnyam par 'jug pa'o/ /de ltar rkyen bzhi po de rnams bsdu ba de rnams bye kyi mtha' la 'jug ste/ —/ rkyen dang po ṭa yig gi dpe ni⑦/ a tsis ma si ti mā si ya su/ — gang gi mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ zhes pa'i tshig spyor la rnam dbye sogs phyis pas/ a byuṣṭha ma hi man/ zhes gnas pa la/ rkyen ṭa byin/ ṭā rjes 'brel/ na'i yang na 'os ṭi phyis/ si byin pas/ a byuṣṭha ma hi maḥ —mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ de bzhin du/ atnaḥsnyengs/ nyin mo dang mtshan mo/snye sā yi/ — si/ zhes pa la/ rnam 110—146

dbye sogs phyis/ la lar amra la sogs pa'i mtha' can pha rol tu spo bar bshad pas/ a han rjes su spos/ ṭa byin/ 1 no bā/ na'i yang na'o/ /na mtha' can gyi ṭi ni ya dang dbyangs rkyen pha rol la dbye zhing skabs la lar yang na u pa dhā dbyi ②bar bya ste/ ṭi dang u pa dhā dbyi ba yang na bar byas pas/sā yātna buḥ— nyinamatshan/ — sā yā haḥ de bzhin du bsgrubs grupas/ atnaḥ ngasi/ a pa zer thu — si/nyin mo las gzhan no//— yi pa rātna phyeḥ nyin mo las gzhan no/ /phyag pa 6) thuhaḥ nyin mo'i gung /snye.atnaḥ—— ngasi/ ma bye/ — si/ ma dhyātnaḥ — nyin gung / ma dhyā haḥ yang la lar snga phyi mi brje ba yang yod de/ ka bī as ④ṭwāṃ rā sa dzā/ ṅga/ snyan ngag mkhan gyi rgyal po/zhes pa la/ rnam dbye sogs phyis/ snga phyi ༄/— mi bsgyur ṭa byin pas/ snyan ngag mkhan gyi rgyal po/ — ka bī rā ṭa dzaḥ—— si/ skabs 'di'i rkyen ṭa la ni ṭa 'gro ba'i cho ga mtha' gcig ⑫tu 'jug pa ni ma yin no/ /mo rtags su byed na yīpra byin pas/po/ lnga bsdo /rdo/— snyan ngag mkhan gyi rgyal mo/ /1 rkyen gnyis pa a yig gi dpe ni/ rā dzñā khu.ā ma pūḥ si/ rgyal po'i grong khyer/zhes pa'i tshig sbyor la rnam dbye sogs phyis/ rkyen a byen pas/ rā dza pu raḥ— rgyalapo'i grong khyer/ de bzhin du/ bāstsa si ma 15nashtsa si/ ngag dang yid kyang ngo //bādma na saḥ— ngag yid/ yāṭa dakṣi ṇa suṭa sde di shi ji padzee si/yul lho phyogs kyi lam/ dakṣi ṇa pa thaḥ — lho phyogs kyi lam/ yi/ hasirje rā tritsun/— nyin mo dang mtshan mo yang ngo / /si/ phyag ho bsdo thog/snye nyin mtshan/— / rkyen gsum pa ḍa'i dpe ni/ audwo tsa tra hūṃ)yashtsa/— dzas/ gnyis dang gsum yang /zhes pa'i tshig sbyor la rnam dbye sogs phyis/ rkyen ḍa byin/ ḍitpa ṅkul ṭi phyis pas / dī traḥ — gnyis gsum/ de bzhin du/ lnga dang drug yang / pañtsa dzas/tsa ṣargya/—— dzas 110—147

lnga drug/ padzo a dzas ṣāḥ ba ha ja sra/ gang la rgyal po mang po 3bhe/rnams kyi grong khyer du/— po rā jo dzas no ya sde jiyāṭan uṭa garja ldujib hu rā dzā nga na yi ga rī/ —rgyal po mang po'i 1 grong khyer/ 1 rkyen bzhi pa ka yig gi dpe ni/ ba ha baḥdzas karta ro dzasra yasu/ —gang gi bya ba'i las mang po/ zhes pa'i tshig sbyor la rnam dbye sogs phyis/ rkyen ka byin pas/ba hu kadṛ geko yā gaḥ——mchod sbyin gyi bya ba mang po byed/sa / da ni las 'dzin kyi bsdu ba rnams bshad par 5bya ste/ karma dha ra yastu spyobee/ mnyam pa'i don la las 'dzin pa'o/ /tshig snga phyi'i don dngos po gcig la mnyam par 'jug pa'i don la las 'dzin gyi bsdu ba zhes bya ste/ utpal yang de sngon po yang ngo //— bee lo sitsa ta dutpa lo tsa sizhes pa'i tshig sbyor la rnam dbye sogs phyis pas/ nī lotpa lam̐/ — utpa la sngon po/ de bzhin du/ rāghā tsā sau sil tā si 'a / dmar po yang bye 'di 'khril shing yang / rākta la tā/— 'khril shing dmar po/ pu si mosto sau si ko ki si 3lashtsa/ — pho yang de khu byug yang ngo / /sum̐sko ki laḥ— khubyug po/ zhes pa ste sum̐sra'i kye yang dag par byesbyor ba'i mtha' mi dbyi ba ni/ sum̐sra'i sa kha sa'i yi ge pha rol la mi dbyi bar bshad pas so/ /sa / de nas nyer mkho'i cho ga ci rigs pa thun mong du bshad par bya ste/nāsnashtsa kṛ tā sa mā saḥ ming dang kṛta las kyang bsdu ba'o/ /pra la sogs pa nyer bsgyur dang ming kṛta kyi rkyen can dang ti sogs kyi rkyen can rnams lhan cig par sbyor ba las kyang de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba 'jug ste/ pra kaste ṇa ṭā lho )pā daḥ — phul du byung ba'i smra ba/ zhes pa'i tshig sbyor la rnam dbye phrad dang bcas phyis 110—148

pas—/ pra bā daḥsnye smra ba rab bam smra ba phul du byung / de bzhin du/ kurghaṃ sika ro tī ti/ bum pa byed pa po 'di/ zhes pa'i don la/ kumbha ka raḥ bum pa byed pa po ste rdza mkhan/— / sa hā deḥsā diḥ sa ha la sogs pa rnams sa ①la sogs pa'o/ /tshig sdud kyi cho ga la 'jug na sa ha la sogs pa rnams ni sa la sogs pa rnams su 'gyur te/ sa ha bu tre ṇa ṭa brta te/ bu dang lhan cig tu 'dug ko/ /zhes pa'i tshig sbyor la rnam dbye sogs phyis/ sa ha sa ru bsgyur bas/ sa pu traḥ/ bu dang lhan cig / —/ yang ha sa/ saṃ/ ti rasra rnams ni atsa'i sgra pha rol la rim pa bzhin / sa dhri/ ma si phya/ ti ri rnams su 'gyur bar bshad pas/ sa ha atsu — — zhes pa la sa ha sa bee ru bsgyur/ a tsa dang mtshams sbyar/ si numra/st+ra'i byu sogs dang / yang dag par sbyor ba'i mtha' phyis/ tsu'i ku sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ sadhyathu dra / grogs mchog /de bzhin du/ saṃ atsu/zhes pa la/ sa simyadra / nuphra/ yang dag pa sge/ ti rasra/ atsa zhes pa la/ ti ryadra /— si nuphra dud 'gro rgyags po/ sogs so/ / —/ koḥkatpa/ ku'i katu'o/ /de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba la dman pa dang nyung ngu'i don brjod pa la ku'i sgra ni katu dang ka pa dang kā rnams su 'gyur te/ku ya ṇḍa chenas pa'i don la/ ka duṣṭi/ — drod chung ba/ ka poṣṭi/ — drod chung ba/ koṣṭi/de bzhin du/ ku la ba rde/ zhes pa'i don la/ kabla ba gyekhaṃ/ tshwa lhad can nam tshwa ngan pa/ ma/ nga/ 'ab ngas hā / tshwa lhad can nam tshwa ngan pa/ na/ 'ab nga/ 1)/ 4/ pu ru ṣe bā/ skyes bu la yang na'o/ / skyeskyes bu'i sgra dang sbyor ba'i ku'i sgra ni rang sar gnas pa dang katpa sogs su bsgyur ba yang na bar bya ste/ ku pu ru ṣaḥ kahphu ru ṣaḥ— skyesabungan pa/ ka pa pu ru ṣaḥ— skyesabungan pa/ kā pu ru ṣaḥ110—149

ka① / snye snying dga' ba/ kabye kā laḥ——mgrin nag ste lha drag po/ bāngs tho yustiḥ— ngag gi sbyor ba/ di ngas sho daṇḍaḥsnye yul phyogs kyi dpya khral/ pa byu to ngas ha raḥ lha bzhin du rku ba/ sogs dang gzhan yang 'di 'dra'i rigs rnams rnam dbye mi dbyi yang de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i nang du gtogs so/ / 1 yang tshig sdud la shā ka pābee ba la sogs pa'i tshig dbus ma dbyi bar bshad de/ shā ka bye ཿ—— si/ pri yaḥsi pābee baḥ ldum bu ni mthun pa'i sa gzhi las byung / zhes pa'i tshig sbyor la/ shā ka pābee baḥ— ldum bu ni mthun pa'i sa las byung / de bzhin du/lha mchod pa'i bram ze/— de baḥ si/ pū dza ko si zwahma ṇaḥ de ba drwahma ṇaḥ— lha mchod bram ze/ casab/ba/ cas/ /— / 'chad 'gyur 'di nas brtsams/ du hi tā pu to zhes pa'i bar gcig gcig spyor ba'i zlas dbye'i bsdu ba ste/ de yang / ā deshtsa dzwatwe bye/zlas dbye las dang po yang ngo / /gcig gcig spyor ba'i zlas dbye'i tshig sdud las skabs la lar tshig dang po de dbyi ba yang yod de/ mā sitā tsa pi tā sitsa/ ma dang pha yang ngo // zhes pa'i tshig sbyor la rnam dbye sogs phyis/ tshig dang po ma tre pa/nga khru sa 5pas/ pi ta zer/ phamadag /de babyu/na du/ sgyug mo dang gyos ngo/ yang /— ra/ shushtsa sishwa subyu bye/—si/ shwa su ro/ gyos sgyug dag /tsha bo dang bu dag kyang / du nyi sitā tsa pu trashtsa si pu tro/ bu tsha bo dag / 1 yang zlas dbye'i bsru ba la skabs 'ga' zhig tu tshig dang po ṛtpa mtha' can yin na rngo sna.ā ru bsgyur bar bshad de/ gong gi ma tā tsa pi tā tsa zhes pa la yang na/ ma tā pi ta ro/ — phamadag /de bzhin du/ du hi tā pu kau/ bu tshabo dag /sogs so/ /zlas dbye'i bsdu ba byas pa'i mtha' 'a3/ sarba sogs la 110byed151

cho ga rang lugs dang spyir btang a thung mtha' can gyi sgrub pa yang na bar bshad de / basmra sirtswa shra māshtsa si i ta rītsatsho /—— dzas/rigs rnams dang spyod par gnas pa rnams las gzhan rnams kyang / zhes pa la rnam dbye sogs phyis mthar sarba rang lugs dang spyir btang a thung mtha' can lugs yang na bar byas pas/ batre shra me ta re/—dzas/rigs spyod par gnas pa las gzhan rnams/ barṇa shra me ta rāḥ dzasra/'bru mang po'i bsdu ba la don tha dad du byed pa'i tshig dbus ma de dbyi bar bshad de/ ku mu da'i dri dang 'dra ba'i dri gang gi/——ku mu da su ngasagandha i ba gasmyo siya su / — ngas/ zhes pa'i tshig sbyor la rnam dbye sogs phyis/ tshig dbus ma i ba yang phyis/ nye ba'i tshig garnya sogs kyi mtha' ir bsgyur bar bshad pas mtha' ir bsgyur bas/ ku mu da garnyiḥ kumuda'i dri3/ de bzhin du/ haṃ sa su ga ngasam na si mi ba ga ma rgo siya su/ —ngang pa'i nee 'gos dang ldan pa'i 'gros gang gi/ ngang pa'i ④'gros ma āpra 3 ha tre sa ba/ chab ste//— si/— / dikra saṃ khye saṃ dzñā yī/ phyogs dang grangs kyi ming can la'o/ /las 'dzin gyi bsdu ba la phyogs dang ming gi sgra dang por yod la/ de dang sbyor rgyu'i pha rol gyi tshig kyang gzhi mthun pa'i don can la tshig sbyor sogs mi dgos par thog ma nas tshig sdud kho na byas chog la/ don mnyam du 'jug pa can yin kyang phyogs dang grangs kyi sgra thog ma can ma yin pa/ phyogs dang grangs yin kyang mnyam par 'jug pa'i don can ma yin pa dag la ni thog mar tshig sbyor byas nas de slar tshig sdud kyi cho gas bsdu dgos te/ phyogs dang grangs thog ma don mnyam du 'jug pa ⑦tshig sbyor mi dgos pa'i dpe ni/ dakṣa ṇasni2ཿ— lho phyogs kyi me/ sapta gā māḥ— grongabadun/ sogs so/ /i ti swa ra swaste byā ka ra ṇa su sru tātma mā sa pra kri bye/170—152

bu/ tshig sbyor de bzhin byas pas/ mā z-i swa sī yaḥ— ma'i sring mo'i bu ste sru mo'i bu/ sogs so/ /— / yang / 'ga' zhig 1tu mo rtags las rkyen aṇa 1'jug par yang bshad de/ byu mbi a ba byege / —sa'ibu ste mig dmar/ zhes pa'i don la/ rbha maḥ— aṇa/sa'i bu ste mig dmar/1 luthra hu ④twe kwa tsita/ mang po nyid la 'ga' zhig tu 'jig go/ /rnam dbye mang tshig nyid pha rol la skabs 'ga' zhig tu bu brgyud ⑤la sogs pa'i rkyen rnams 'jig ste/ gārgya/ dzasra/ gtāḥ— garga'i bu rnams/ ā tre ya/ dzasra/ a tpa yaḥ—rgyun shes kyi bu rnams/ bai de ha/ ja sa/ bi de hāḥ——rgyal ngo/ lus 'phags kyi bu rnams/1 de ba te da maze/ lha dang 'di'i don la'o/ /mchod pa lta bu lha'i don dang 'di zhes pa'i don la aṇa 'gyur te/ ijo de sipa tt+waṃ ya āmamya ha ngas pyabi / snyelha dbang po'i sreg rdzas gang gi/ zhes pa'i don la rnam dbye sogs phyis aṇa byen pas / ej-i ha bi/— dbang po'i ched kyi sreg rdzas/ de bzhin du/ so myo de sib tt+waṃ as ya su/snyelha zla ba'i ched du gang gi/ sau rmya aṇa si sogs lha'i don dang /snyezla ba'i ched du/ 1 'di'i don la dper na/ de ba dattarba mi si rda/snye 'di lhas byin gyi don du/zhes pa'i don la/ de ba datt+waṃ/—lhasabyin gyi don du/ zhes pa ste lhas byin gyi don du bzhag pa'i zas dang gos la sogs pa'i don no/ / —/ kwa cis yoḥ la lar gnyis ka la'o/ /rkyen 'phel ba'i rgyu mtshan can pha rol la skabs la lar ming sngon ma dang phyi ma gnyis ka'i thog ma'i dbyangs 'phel bar byed pa yang yod de/ āghi mā ⑦ru ta karmā/ —me la rlung gis las byed/ 1 yang dngos po'i don la'ang aṇa sogs 'jug par bshad pas/ su 110—155

z-id dang su ① bha ga la dngos po'i don du aṇa dang byu byin/ so so'i tshig gnyis ka'i dbyangs thog ma 'phel ba byas pas/ sauhā rde/ mdza' bshes/ sau bhā gye/snyeskal bzang / 4/ ṇi to bā/ ṇa 'go ba las yang na'o/ /gong du brjod pa dang 'chad 'gyur gyi rkyen ṇa ②yig rjes 'brel 'gro ba 'phel ba'i rgyu mtshan can rnams las kyang skabs 'gar 'phel ba sogs ṇa 'gro ba'i cho ga rnams byed pa dang mi byed pa 'dam kha can du byed pa sogs yang na bar byed pa'ang yod de/ a dzo sigirya lkusu / si/ nor dang sa gzhi ldan pa gang gi zhes pa ste dbang phyug chen po'i ming / chenas pa'i don la rnam dbye sogs phyis/ asro bya'aphel ba yang na bar byas pas/ ā dza ga baṃ/ —dbang phyug chen po'am dbang phyug gi gzhul yang 'jug go/ /a dza ga baṃ/ de bzhin du/ ku mu da su ngas gandha si mi ba gasmyo ya si su/— ku mu da'i dri dang 'dra ba'i dri gang gi/ zhes pa'i don la/5 kau mu da gartu/ 'phel ba 'dam kha'i dpe/ ku mu da'i dri dang ldan pa'i dri yod pa me'i bu/— ku mu da gartsu/shā su ra myu yo/— ngas khya.i daphra si gyos po'i 'di/ 'phel ba'i dpe shā subyurya gā ma ④ཿ— 'di gyos po'i khyim—/ bikṣiṃ ri ngas rda thusi beeṇḍa baṃ/ —khyab 'jug gi 'di/ alnga/ 'phel ba'i dpe/ ngas si/ 'phel ba'i dpe—/ bo/ lnga) 2)/ —b.langa'adi/ ba/ dren/—rgya/ 'phel ba mi byed pa'i dpe/——ṭa/ 'ab ngasas/ 6)2)/—— 'di'i rigs—/ —— ku 'u//byu/ 'phel ba mi byed pa'i dpe/ — ro/ṣṭhadu/ bhā pa// khyodakyi'o// twa 3 dī sisku// —'phel ba mi byed pa'i dpe/ yi/smadu/ bhā sa// 'phel ba mi byed pa'i dpe/ ma/dī sku// snyenga'am bdag go/ / —/ tsa tu rashtsa lo paḥ tsa tudra gyi tsa dbyi'o/ /tsa ⑨tudra gyi sgra'i tsa yig ni de phan gyi rkyen ya dang dbyangs rkyen pha rol la dbyi bar bya ste/ tsa tudra/ju / tuṅgi/ bzhipornams/ tsa tudra/ bhā ya/ tu rī yaḥ——bzhi po rnams/ —/ a n+ya su dkra/ a n+ya kyi dkra'o0 / /a n+ya kyi sgra la de phan gyi rkyen dbyangs pha rol las dkra ā ga ma 'gyur te/ a n+ya la/ ddhi ya/ dkra ā 110—156

ga ma byin pas/ a n+ya dī yi/ gzhanagyiphyir/ dkra ā khye ga pa a n+ya kho na la ster kyi gzhan la ni ma yin te/ arbha khudza ra ta/ bhā ya/ arbha dza ra tī sku/—/ phyed rgas pa ste dar yol/ 1 kā ra kā kri ya yuste/ byed po dang bya ba'i sbyor ba la'o/ /byed pa po dang bya ba dang byed pa sbyor ba dang / byed pa dang las sbyor ba dang / byed po — las dang bya ba gsum sbyor ba dang / byed po las dang byed pa gsum sbyor ba dang / byed po las dang bya byed bzhi spyor ba ste/ dbye ba drug po de rnams la and+ra sogs sngar bshad pa'i rkyen de rnams 'jug ste/ kudku me ṭā na rāst+waṃ ba dhe/—/ gur gum gyis btsos pa/'i gos/ thegs palnga/ ro/zug 'ab/ sko/—1 a1 tsho// gur gum gyis btsos pa/ma thu rā yāṭā yāḥngasi ā ④ga taḥ bcom brlag nas 'ongs so// mā aṇa thu raḥsi/ krā 5me bha baḥ gronganayod/ gā myaḥ — 5/ dhū ram̐ ba ha tt+waṃ ti/ — 'phang lo 'dren pa po ste shing rta 'dren pa'i glang / sgo re yaḥ— e ya1/ 'phang lo 'dren pa/ po ste shing rta 'dren pa'i glang / dhū rya juḥ 'phang lo 'dren pa po ste shing rta 'dren pa'i glang / 1 ke rgo ye kāḥka yī na i ya i ka rnams so/ /rkyen ka dang yī na dang i ya 'udang i ka ste bzhi po 'di rnams 'byung ba la sogs pa'i don la 'jug cing /rkyen de rnams la'ang ṇa 'gro ba'i ming btags te 'phel bar byed pa dang mi byed pa yang na bar byed de/ karṇa ṭi ④ji bha baḥ yul karṇa ṭar skyes pa'am 'ongs pa/ zhes pa'i don la rkyen ka 'phel ba yang na bar byas pas/ kārṇa ṭa kaḥ— yul karṇa ④ṭa pa/——karṇa ṭa kaḥ sogs dang /4 / gā mā ngasi dā ga tasi sta kyetra dzā si to bā/— grong sde las 'ongs shing der skyes pa nyid do//zhes pa'i don la rkyen yī na gā mbi ṇaḥ1 grong sde las 'ongs (1shing der skyes pa nyid do//— yang na 110—157

1 mnyam par tshogs pa'i don la ta 'gyur zhing rtags de la yang yon tan thob par bshad de/ tra yā/srapo/ rde hūṃs mā hā raḥ — gsum tshogs pa/ zhes pa'i don la/ tre tā/ — gsum tshogs pa/ de bzhin du/ dza nā āpo māṃ thus mā hā resi rjudza na tā/——skye bo tshogs pa'am 'dus pa/ āb si/1 las kyi don la'ang yaṇa 'jug par bshad de/ zwahma ṇa ngasra celya karmi / snye si/bram ze'i las/ zhes pa'i don la/ shāhmaṣyo/ — bram ze'i las/ de bzhin du/bas snyamaḥngs/ yis rda ka—4/— si/rgyal po'i las 'di/ — bas dre// rgyal po'i las 'di/ — shes ja bye〉/na'i yang na 'os ṭi dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba yang na bar byas pa'o//— / lo nyi tā deḍi di man5/ lo ti ta la sogs pa la i man te thoḍitu'o/ /lo hi ta la sogs pa la dngos po dang mtshan nyid kyi don la rkyen i man 'gyur zhing rkyen de la yang ḍitu ces bya ste dgos pa ni ṭi dbyi ba'i don te/ dmarapo'i mtshan nyid dam dmar po nyid/ lo hi ta gya ngas bha baḥ — si/ zhes pa'i don/ dmarapo nyid—/ lo hi ti mā/— si/ de bzhin du/ yin khorbha khyebaḥ—— ngas si 3/phra mo'i mtshan nyid dam phra mo nyid/— phag/bye nas/ —si/ —/ ṛ ra i ma ṇi/ ṛ'i ra i man la'o/ /rkyen i man pha rol la rtags kyi dang po'i ṛ yig ni ra srog ldan du 'gyur te/ thra thorbha baḥ — rgya cheba'i mtshan nyid dam rgya che ba nyid/ (nos palnga/ mdon 'ab/ pra thi na// rgya che ba'i spumatshan nyid dam rgya che ba nyid/de bzhin du/ dṛ rnyihu bhe/ i man/ brtan pa'i mtshan nyid dam brtan pa nyid/ dra ḍho na/ / si/ jo/ ⑪du/ byug che/na/ mra lnga/ na// si/'jam pa'i mtshan nyid dam 'jam pa nyid/1 ba ho rlo po byu tsa ba hoḥ ba hu las dbyi zhing ba hu'i yang ngas⑫byu'o/ /ba hu las pha rol gyi rkyen i man gyi i dbyi zhing i man sogs pha rol ba hu'ang /rte110—160

bhū zhes par 'gyur te/ ngas/— ba hosgo baḥ— si/ mang po'i mtshan nyid dam mang po nyid/ zhes pa'i don la/ ba hu/ i man rmyezhes gnas pa la/ i phyis/ ba hu yang byu nges badri/zab bas/ mang po'i thumatshan nyid dam mang po nyid/ rje/ ste// si/ 1 asbyaze ma tupra/ yod pa'i don la ma tupra'o/ /ming las yod pa'i don la ma tupra 'gyur te/ go a su aste i ti/ zhes pa'i don la/ ma tupra pa rjes 'byel/ u yig /u ṛta dag las numra mos numra gyi don/ a tu dang sa'i kyesi la 'os ring por bsgyur bas/ go mān/ ba lang ④yod pa'am ba lang can/yang khyen de'i mthar yī ka thosbyar bas/ go ma ṭī/ ba lang yod pa'am ba lang can/de bzhin du/ shrī mān④/——dpal yod pa'am dpal ldan/ shrī ma ṭī/ sogs so/ / 1 a i kau ma twabee/ ma tu'i don la a dang i ka dag go/ /ming las ma tu'i don te yod pa'i don brjod pa la rkyen a dang i ka dag kyang 'gyur te/bai 3 dza yarnyi birya ti ya su/— doshalayodapa gang gi/ zhes pa'i don la/ doshalacan/— bai dza yantaḥ—a/ de bzhin du/ sgyu ma can nam nor can/ mā yi ka khye/ཿ ikra/ sogs so/ / 1 mārnyo pa dhā dwa tī kau/ ma dang a mtha' u pa dhā las ba tu in dag go/ /ming ma yig dang a yig gi mtha' can dang ma dang a u pa dhā na yod pa las kyang yod pa'i don la rkyen ba tu dang in dag 'gyur te/ bha sigo bi rya te ya lya/— ngasrabla /skal ba yod pa gang la/ zhes pa'i don la/ ba tu/ u numra gyi don/ skal ldan nam bcom ldan nam legs ldan/— bha ga nga/na nyuhūṃ/ btu/ de babyu/na du/ yin si/—— dha byā/——nor can/rgyal rigs can/—— kṣu ṭī/—— in si/ dbyag pa can/— 15daṇḍi/ — inasi/ 'dod pa can/—— na/ ༷// in ⑪si/i na si/ da sti// — zhi dul can/ sha rti// anurmozisi/ sogs yi/ mtha' dang / btu.āopra/— na/ kyi ṣa dwa tī(7/snye sa gzhi yod pa'am sa gzhi can/ sogs a u pa dhā na yod pa dang / btu 110—161

rnye kalpaḥ——cung zad yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa/ de bzhin du/ pa ṭu de shyaḥsnyecung zad ma rdzogs pa'i mkhas pa/ ka bi de // pa/ཿ —cung zad ma rdzogs pa'i snyan ngag mkhan/ bo gas rus/ /pā shaṃ sa stiyī rū paḥ kha bsgyur ba la rū pa'o/ /mi mkhas pa mkhas par rdzu ba dang / mi shes kyang shes zer ba lta bu kha bubasgyur ba'i don la rkyen rū pa 'gyur te—/ pā shasto bai yā ka ra ṇaḥ— rdzus ma'i brda spyod mkhan po/ zhes pa'i don la/ bee bhe yā ka ra ṇa byu paḥ/— rdzus ma'i brda sgod mkhan po/1 kutpa yo pā shaḥ smra ba ngan pa la pā sha'o/ /smra ba ngan pa brjod pa'i don la rkyen pā sha 'gyur te/ kuṣpe to bai yā ka ra ṇa④ཿ—— brda sprod mkhan po rdzun du smra ba'am ngan par smra ba/ zhes pa'i don la/ bai yā ka ra ṇa pā shaḥ— brda spyod mkhan po rdzun du smra ba'am ngan par smra ba/ de babyu/na du/ ṭa/ṣpe to yi/ bhi ṣa ka smra ba ngan pa tshig rtsub can/ yi/ bhi ṣa11 shaḥ/kudme to bee 3 yā ka ra kho pa huḥ— brda sprod mkhan po tshig ngan smra ba mang po/ — ba hu pā pya shaḥྈ / byu ta purbe tsa raṭu/ sngon dus shes pa la tsa raṭu'o/ /gang yang sngon gyi dus su shes pa'i don la rkyen tsa raṭu 'gyur te/ pūbaṃ dṛji bi rya ⑦ te ya su—/ — sngon dus shes shing mthong ba gang gi/— dṛji tsa raḥ/ sa/ pā tsurya pi kā ra pra dhā tyā di 6 ma yaṭu/ spyi bungs dang rnam 'gyur dang gtso bo rnams la ma yaṭa'o/ /ston mo byed rgyu'i zas spungs pa lta bu'i spyi bungs dang / bzo bo'i 2las kyi rnam 'gyur dang / gzhan la ma bltos par rang dbang du byed pa gtso bo'i don rnams la rkyen ma yaṭu 'gyur te/ anda pā tsu ra ba smin ya zlo zhes pa'i don la/ mchod sbyin gyi zas spyi spungs 'di/ anda ma yo ya dzha/——ma yaṭa—/ si/ de bzhin du/ mṛ to ngasraspubi ka ra gha ṭaḥ sa'i 'urnam 'gyur bum pa byed/ mṛdma yo gha ṭaḥsnye ma yaṭa/si/ byā hūṃ1pra dhā n+ya ma suskyi ()ti/snye khyim gyi gtso bo bud med 'di yod 110byed164

pa'o—/ / — ñtsā lham yo dzābeeḥ—mayaṭa si/ pūrte na a mṛ ta tsand+raḥ nya gang ba'i zla bas bdud rtsi ste 'u —/ —a mṛ ta ma yaji ཿ— / brda sprod shes nas rig byed kyang klog pa lta bu'i don la rkyen aṇa 'gyur bar bshad de/ byā ka ra khaṃ a dhī te bee ta bee ti bā/ brda spyod bklags shing rig byed kyang rig pa/ zhes pa'i don la aṇa thubyin pas/ byā ka ra ṇa/ asro 5zhes gnas pa la/ sa / na sarnyi sborluṭu tsa/ mtshams sbyor kyi phra bra thudag la ma yin te iṭā uṭa dag go/ /rkyen 'phel ba'i rgyu mtshan can pha rol las 'phel ba byed rgyu'i yi ge dang po de mtshams sbyar ba'i lnga yig dang bra yig yin na thog mar 'phel ba mi byed par/ yi ge thog ma de dang lnga bra so sor phye nas lnga yin na iṭu ā ga ma dang bra yin na uṭa tre.ā ga ma byin te/ de nas 'phel ba so so'i thob ltar bya ste/ byu kyi bra dang ya phye ba'i bar du iṭa 5byin/ de nas 'phel ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ bee yā ka ra ṇaḥ brda sprod bklags shing rig byed kyang rig pa—/ de bzhin du/ swa shwaḥtai bee de ti/— rta mchog der rig go/ /zhes pa'i don la/sau ba shwaḥsnyerta mchog der rig go/ /— / i to dzā tāze/ skyes pa'i don la i ta'o/ /ngo tsha skyes pa lta bu skyes pa'i don la rkyen i ta 'gyur te/ lalja taḥ ngo tsha skyesari8// tri pi taḥ tshim pa/ skyes/gru dataḥ —bkres rngab skyes/ sogs so/ /— / ta ra ta me ya srijoḥpra kakhye/ khyad par du 'phags pa la ta ra ta ma yī ya su/ iṣṭha rnams so/ /gang las khyad par du 'phags pa'i phul du byung ba'i don la rkyen ta ra dang ta ma dang spyi ya su dang iṣṭha rnams 'gyur zhing yī ya su dang iṣṭha gnyis la ḍitpa bzhin du ṭi dbyi bar bya ste/ a ti spusha ye na kṛṣṭaḥsnyeshin tu nag 110—165

sogs pa rnams la logs su bkar ba'am rdzogs pa'i don la rkyen ma 'gyur te/patso maḥ — lngapo'am lnga pa/ sabee ma ཿ — bdun po'am bdun pa/ yi/ṣṭa ma/ཿ — brgyad po'am brgyad pa/na ba maḥ——dgu pa'am dgu po/ 1 e kā da shā deḍo nyuḥ e ka da shan la sogs pa rnams la ḍa'o/ /e ka da shanu la sogs pa rnams la logs su bkar ba'am rdzogs pa'i don la rkyen ḍa 'gyur te/ ḍita la ṭi phyis pas/ e ka da shaḥ bcu gcig pa/1 dī ṭuṣṭha ṭwāṃ dā tra yophoṣṭhaḥ dri tri aṣṭan rnams kyi dā tra yo aṣṭha rnams so—/ /dī dang tri dang aṣṭan rnams kyi ni da 3sha dang spyor tsho —ba la rim pa bzhin dā tra yo aṣṭha rnams su 'gyur te/ dī sogs dā sogs su bsgyur de'i mthar da ④ shan la ḍa sbyar bas/ dā da shaḥ bcu gnyis pa/ tra yo da shaḥ bcu gsum pa/tsa turda shaḥsnyebacubazhipa/1 aṣṭha da shaḥsnyebacobargyad pa/ na ba da shaḥsnyebacu dgu pa/ 1 dzi sha tyā phye derpā ta maṭā byu/ bo sha ti ⑦ sogs la ta maṭa yang na'o/ /dzi sha ti sogs la logs su bkar ba'am rdzogs pa'i don la rkyen ta maṭu 3'gyur zhing ḍa yang 'gyur la ⑨ḍa pha rol la bo sha ti sogs kyi ti nyubye dbyi zhing de nas ḍitpa la ṭi phyis pas/ bo sha ti ta maḥ— nyi shu tham pa'am nyi shu pa/— bo shaḥ ti sha ti ta ma/ཿsnyesum cu tham pa'am sum cu pa/snye ti //ཿ/ —/ sha tā deni hye/ sha ta sogs la rtag tu'o/ /sha ta la sogs pa rnams la logs su bkar ba dang rdzogs pa'i don la ta maṭu kho na rtag tu 'jug ste/sha tata maḥ— brgya tham pa/ sa ha sra tamaḥ—— stong phrag /lakṣa tamaḥ— 'bum phrag /ko ṭi tamaḥsnyebyebaphrag /sogs te grangs med kyi bar ro/ /110—169

chenas palnga/ ro/na la/ ba hu shaḥ 'di lan mang ba'am mang ba'i mtshan nyid can/ —/ ta yā ya ṭo saṃ khyu yo/ grangs kyi don du ta ya a yaṭu dag go/ /dngos po gang la'ang grangs de dang ldan pa'i ched du rkyen ta ya dang a yaṭa dag 'gyur zhing a yaṭa ① la ni ḍi tpa bzhin du ṭi yang dbyi ste/ dī ta si yo/ gnyisapa'am gnyis pa can/ — mas sku'i/ si/ gsum pa'am gsum pa can/ thog /ma 6)/ si/ ya/ sku ( pya / si/ gsum pa'am gsum pa can/ sogs so/ /de dag mo rtags su brjod na yīpra spyor bas/bu mo gnyis pa ma/— 11 ta —— nga/(1/ i a sogs/ tshos ——/ gnyis pa ma/ —— // ———/ snyegasumapa ma/ — ya/ ——/ —/ dzee gha la sogs pa rnams la rkyen i na/ a la/ i ka rnams 'jug pa byebashad de/ rdza bhe naḥ brla/ dza ghā laḥ brla/ dzee ghi kaḥ i a sogs kyi phyis/dza bee na/— bzlas rgyapa'am smra ba/— dza bā laḥ dza bi kaḥ bzlas (snyepa'am smra ba/ dzee gha kā re ṇaḥ— brlamadzes/ — dzee gha ka rā laḥ dza gha ka ri kaḥ —brlamadzes/ sogs so/ /4 / sdi sum̐ rgyu na2 sna ṇi/ spyo thu dag la nanyu snasnyu dag go/ /byā dang sum̐ bye gyi sgra dag la ngo bo 'am legs pa'i don la rim pa bzhin rkyen nanyu dang snand+ra dag 'gyur te/ ste 3rṇa/— bud med mdzes ma/ sum̐ gyi nga ro tshig phrad kyi phyis pa'o// — po st+waṃ/—— skyes pa dpa' bo/༈ sha ṣā 3ni pā tyā ka tyā lkud yi/ lhag ma tshig phrad rnams ka ti la sogs pa'o/ /tshig phrad rnams ni ka /— snatil sogs pa mtha' yas te 'dir ni mtshon byed tsam yin la lhag ma rnams ni 'jig rten du grags pa ltar gzhan las shes par bya ste/ ka tiḥ —jitsam/ ka ti pa yaḥ ji tsam byung / sogs so/ /i ti swa ra swasnyi byā kā ra ṇa su sru tāttadhi ta pra kri yā sa māstuḥ/ zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las de phan gyi rab tu bya ba rnams rdzogs so// //110—171

ྈ/ de nas byings las tshig tu bsgrub ① pa kun bshad kyi rab tu bya ba rnams brjod par bya ste/ 1 jo toḥ byings las so/ /rnam dbye sde lgetshan gnyis las phyi ma 'chad 'gyur ti rka la sogs pa 'di rnams byings kyi mthar spyor bar shes par bya'o/ /— / bhādiḥ byu la sogs pa'o/ /byings ni byu yod pa la'o zhes pa la sogs pa rnams la byings zhes bya'o/ /myu/ sa tsa tri bi dhaḥ de yang dbye ba gsum mo/ /byings de la yang bdag don gyi tshig can dang gzhan don gyi tshig can dang gnyis ka'i tshig can te dbye ba gsum du yod do/ / ྈ/ ā nu 5rātta jitpaḥ a nu dātta 5jitpa dag gi ātpa'o⑥/ /byings gang la'ang a nu dātta ste dbyangs skad gdangs dma' bar 'gro ba ④rnams dang dra 'go ba rnams ni ātpa ces pa da nee pa da ste bdag don kyi byings zhes zer ro/ / 1 nyittha ri te tashtsa u bhe/ nyitpa byedang swa ri ta'i gnyis ka'o/ /byings gang la'ang nyu 'gro ba dang swa ri ta ste sgra skad gdangs 'bring por 'don pa 'gro ba rnams bdag don dang gzhan don gnyis ka'i shyitshig can gyi byings zhes zer la/gzhan yang byings gang la'ang bdag don dang 'byel pa'i sgrub 'bras ston pa bdag don gyi tshig can dang / gzhan gyi don dang 'brel ba'i sgrub 'bras ston pa gzhan don kyi tshig can dang / de dang de'i don gyi byed pa'i tshig 'jug pa ni spyode dang de'i tshig can zhes bya'o/ /4 / pa ra ḍa/7tolhan+yata/ gzhan las gzhan no/ /gong du brjod pa'i 110—172

dang po gsum 'jug cing / nye ba'i tshig de yuṣṭhadu yin na skyes bu dbus ma gsum dang asmadu yin na skyes bu phyi ma gsum 'jug go/ / sa/ karta ri baṃ tsa/ byed po la paṃ yang ngo / /spyir byed pa dang sbyor ba'i bya ba'i don la paṃ ste pa rasmi pa da rnams 'jug pa shas che zhing dngos po dang las kyi bya ba'i don la a rgo pa da rnams 'jug pa spyir btang ngo / /de yang byu yod pa la'o zhes pa'i byings la brta ma na'i skyes bu dang po'i ①gcig tshig tipra byin pas/ byu/ tipra ces gnas pa la/ —/ abra karta ri/byed pa po la apra'o/ /byings bhū la sogs pa rnams la rnam dbye tipra sogs nas bzung dipra sogs kyi bar sde tshan bzhi po pha rol la byed pa po'i don du apra bi kā ra ṇa rkyen du 'gyur te/ apra bi kā ra ṇa byin/ —/ gu rtociḥ yon tan no/ /rnam dbye dang rkyen yon tan 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan can pha rol la byings kyi mtha' yon tan du 'gyur ro/ / —/ a biṭwā dirdi ta/ pitpa dang tā sogs ma yin pa ni ngitpa'o bhu/ /rnam dbye ba yig 'gro ba rnams dang 'og nas 'byung ④ba'i tā tā ro sogs ma yin pa'i rkyen rnams la ni nga 'gro ba'i ming can zhes zer te dgos pa ni byings 5la yon tan mi byed pa'i don no/ / 4/ kri tya byu si/ usra ma yin pa'i kitpa jitpa la'o/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i rnam dbye usra ma yin pa'i kra 'gro ba'i ming can dang dra 'gro ba'i ming can rnams pha rol la byings la yon tan 'byung ba ma yin no/ /des na 'dir apra bi kā ra ṇa pra 'gro ba yin pas/ byings la yon tan/ pra de'i don/ o abra sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ bha ba ti/snyeyod/110—174

gnyis tshig la/ bha ba taḥ dgayod/ mang tshig la'ang bhā bha bar bsgrub tshul sogs gong ltar byas pas/ bha ba/ arnyi zhes gnas pa la/ —/ a de/atpa kyi a dang e'o/ /byings kyi mtha'i atro ni rkyen a yig dang e yig pha rol la dbye bar bya ste/ byings mtha'i a phyis pas/ bha brnyi/ rnams yod/de bzhin du skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bha ba si/ yod/ bha ba thaḥ dag yod / bha ba tha/snye rnamasayod/ skyes bu phyi ma'i gcig tshig la/ bha ba/ mipra ces gnas pa la/ — / /ba mo rā/ ba ma dag la ā'o/ /rnam dbye ti sogs ba yig dang ma yig thog ma can pha rol la byings mtha'i a thung ni ā yig ring por 'gyur te/ bha bā mi phya/—— yod/ ldu de bzhin du gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/bha bā baḥ ngagayod/ bha bā maḥ rnamasayod/ gong du bshad pa ltar de rnams nye ba'i tshig dang sbyor tshul ni/ ming dang skyes bu dang po gsum rim bzhin sbyar bas / si/ snye sa bsdo ja dhā si:she sim/ cas ba ti/— tidra / de rgyal po chos dang ldan par yod do/ /go to byerā dza aukau dmārmi kau au bha ba taḥ tasra/ de dag rgyal ngo/ dag chos ldan dag nga7yod/ dzasra/ te rā dzā no dzasra 5dhārmi kā dzasra bha badhi/—— arnyi/ de rnams rgyal po rnams chos ldan rnams yod/ yuṣṭhadra dang skyes bu dbus ma rnams sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ two sā si dhurbha 67si ba si/ sipra/ spyod legs par yod/ yu ṭwāṃ o sā dhu bha ba thaḥ thasra/ spyod dag legs par yod pa dag /yu yī dzasrasā krudhu bha ba tha/snye tha/ khyed rnams legs pa rnams yod/ skyes bu phyi ma a smad phyadang sbyor ba'i dpe ni/a ha simātma ⑪bi si ddhā bā mi/ mipralku/ nga ni bdag nyid rig par yod/ nged dag bdag nyid rig pa dag yod—/ ā bā aumātma bi do ⑪bha aubā baḥ bsra/ ba ya dzas mātma bi daḥ dzas/ bha bā masra maḥ nged rnams bdag nyid rig pa rnams yod/ sogs so/ / —/ a bya ba dhā nārtso pu ru ṣa bi she ṣaḥ bar ma chad pa las kyang skyes bu'i 110—175

bye brag go/ /ming dang yuṣṭhadu dang asmadu gsum re re la skyes bu dang po dang dbus ma dang phyi ma gsum spyor tshul gong du bshad pa ltar yin la hūṃ / ming dang yuṣṭhadu asmad gsum ga sgrigs pa dang gnyis sgrigs sogs bar ma chad pa las kyang de gsum gtso phal kyi skyes bu gsum po la'ang gtso phal bye brag yod la/ de yang gsum ga sgrigs pa la asmadu gtso bas skyes bu phyi ma dang / gnyis sgrigs pa la'ang asmadu yod na de gtso bas 3snaphyi ma dang / asmadu med pa'i gnyis sgrigs la yuṣṭhadu gtso che bas skyes bu dbus —ma 'jug ste/ sa tsa two tsa sā dhu bha ba thaḥ de dang khyod kyang legs par yod/ zhes pa asmadu med na yuṣṭhadu gtso che bas skyes bu dbus ma'i gnyis tshig thasra byung ba lta bu'o/ /ྈ / bi dhi saṃ bha ba na yoḥyātyā tt+waṃ yumyusthā tt+waṃ yā ta yī yā ba yā me te yā tā mbi ra bhā tha sī yā thā mbi dhwa mbi ye ba tī ma hi/ cho ga 'byung ba'i gnas dag las/yātu—/ yā tāmra/ yusrache/ yāsra/ yā tt+waṃ/ yā ta/ yī/ yā ba/ yā ma/ 1 āo ta/ āo yā tt+waṃ/ yī ran/ ste thasra/ yī yā tsā/ yī bye/ yī ya⑤/ yī ba hi/ yī ma hi rnams so/ /cho ga zhes pa bya ba'i don la nye bar ston pa dang 'byung ba'i gnas te rtogs pas shes pa'i bya ba'i don la rnam dbye yātpa la sogs pa 'di rnams 'jug ste/ pā ṇi pa'i lugs la lidra zer ro/ /de yang gong bzhin/ bhū bha bar bsgrub pa la/ pa rasmi pa da'i byuskyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig yātpa sbyar/ bha ba/ yātpa ces gnas pa la/ —/ yā/a la ya'i'o/ /byings a yig mtha' las pha rol gyi rnam dbye'i kluyā yig ni yī ru 'gyur te/ yā yī/ a 2i la er bsgyur bas/ bha beetpa/de bzhin du gnyis tshig la/ bha be tt+waṃ/ mang tshig la/ bha ba/ yusra 110—176

zhes gnas pa la/ 1 yusra 1iṭa/ yusra la iṭu'o— / /a yig mtha' las pha rol gyi yus —la iṭu ā ga ma 'gyur te/ iṭa byen/ ṭa gnas don/ a i la e/ bha bee yuḥskyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ bha beeḥ bha bee tt+waṃ/ bha be ta/ skyes bu phyi ma'i gcig tshig la/ bha ba/ yī zhes gnas pa la/ 1 yā 4 mi yo/ yāpo i yo mo/ /a yig mtha' khyalas pha rol gyi rnam dbye yī ni i yo du 'gyur te/bha bee yi/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ bha bee ba/ bha bee ma/ de rnams nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ slob mas bla ma bsten pa/'i bya ba byed/ shi ṣyo gu ru shu shu ṣa ko bha beeta/—atpa/ ces pa cho ga 'byung ba'i dpe dang / yāta/ bha bee da sau bee da pā ra go zwahma ṇa tā di ti saṃ bhā ba rgo/ 'di ltar khyod rig byed kyi pha rol tu son na bram ze'o//zhes pa 'byung ba'i gnas kyi dpe'o/ / —/ a shīḥ bre ra 3ṇa yoḥtubhā mantu hi tai tā ni bā ba bā mabhā mā tā maṭwāṃ swā shaṃ ṅgā 3mi bā ba hai bā ma haipra3/ shis byed dang byed du 'jug pa dag la tupra/tt+waṃ antu/ hi tai ta/ ā nipralku/ ā bapra/ ā mapra/1 tt+waṃ ma ā tt+waṃ/ addhāpo/ swa ā thāmra/ dhūm/ ipra/ ā ba haipra/ ā ma haipra ⑪rnams so/ /ma thob pa thob par byed pa sogs bkra shis pa'i don dang 'dod pa dang mthun par bskul ba sogs byed du 'jug pa'i don la tupra la sogs pa 'di rnams 'gyur zhing / pā ṇi pa'i lugs la loṭā zer ro/ /de yang byu bha bar bsgrub tshul gong ltar la/ skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ bha ba—/ tupra ces gnas pa la/ shis byed kyi don la skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig tupra dang skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig hi gnyis ni tā tadra zhes par bsgyur 110—177

rol la de rnams sbyor rgyu'i byings de la aṭa ā ga ma ster bar bya ste/ aṭu byin gnas med pa la yang na'os/ da nyid dang ta 'dam kha can du byas pas/ a bha batpa/hūṃ/ a bha bdu/ de bzhin du bsgrubs pas/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ a bha ba tt+waṃ/ a bha ban/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ a bha baḥ.a bha ba tai/ a bha ba ta/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a bha baṃ/ a bha bā ba/a bha bā ma/ de rnams nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ byolhabha ba tatwand+ra bhetraḥ— kha sang byung ngo byed kyi bu/ sogs so/ /de nas brta ma na la sogs pa de rnams kyi ātma ne pa da rnams byings dang sbyor tshul ni/ e dha 'phel ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la/ brta ma na'i ātma ne pa da'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig ste/ byings mtha'i a brjod don/ byed pa po rngul zhes pas/ apra bi kā ra ṇa byin/ e dha te/ gnyis tshig sogs kun la apra ④bi kā ra ṇa sbyar ba'i e dha zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin bsgrubs pas/ e dha/ā te zhes gnas pa la/ —/ ā dā tha i/ ātu ā tha'i i'o/ /a yig mtha' las pha rol gyi ātu dang ā tha ste ta yig dang tha yig dag dang 'brel ba'i ā ni i ru 'gyur te/ e dhe te/ mang tshig la/ e dhadhe/ de bzhin du skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ e dha se/ e dhe 5the/ e dha bye/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la—/ e dhe/ e dhā ba he/ e dhā ma te/ de rnams nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ dharmā de dha te o da rā rdzu/ chos kyi mtho gyur 6da lta rgyal ngo// —/ cho ga dang 'byung ba'i don gyi byed nee pa da rnams sbyor ba'i dpe ni apra bi kā ra ṇa ster ba sogs gong ltar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po gsum la/e dhe ta/ e dhe yā tt+waṃ/ e dhe ran/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ e dhe thaḥ110—179

pa tsā ba/ pa tsā ma/ 4/ de ring ma yin pa ling gi skyes bu gsum la/ a pa tsatpakye/ a pa tsa tt+waṃ / a pa tsan/ a pa tsaḥ a pa tsa tai/ a pa tsa ta 2/ a pa rtsa/a pa tsā ba/ a pa tsā ma/— / yang ātma nee pa da rnams sbyar bas brta ma na laṭu la/ pa tsa te/pa tse te/ pa tsadhe/ pa tsa se/ pa tse the/ pa tsa bye/ pa tse/ pa tsā ba he/ pa tsā ma te/4 / cho ga dang 'byung ba lidra la/ pa tse ta/ pa tse yā tt+waṃ / pa tse ran/pa tse thaḥ pa tse yā shaṃ/ pa tse tt+waṃ/ pa tse ya/ pa tse ba hi3/ pa tse ma hi/ —/ shis byed loṭā la/ pa tsa zhwatt+waṃ/ pa tse tt+waṃ/ pa tsatt+waṃ/ pa tsa swa/pa tse tsā/ pa tsa bye/ ba tsi/ pa tsā ba hai/ pa tsā ma hai3/ ྈ/ de ring ma yin pa ladra la/ a pa tsa ta/ a pa tse tt+waṃ/ a pa tsanta/a pa tsa thāḥ a pa tse tsā/ a pa tsa tt+waṃ/ a pa tse/ a pa tsā ba hi/ a pa tsā ma hi/ sogs te byings bdag ra7don can la a nee pa da dang gzhan don can la pa rasmi pa da dang gnyis ka'i tshig can la gnyis ka sbyor tshul rnams rigs 'gre ste shes par bya'o/ /⑫ / de nas adu la sogs pa apra bi kā ra ṇa 'jig pa rnams kyi cho ga rnams bshad par bya ste/ —/ a dā derlukra/ adu shel sogs pa rnams las 'jig go/ /byings adu la sogs pa'i sde las pha rol gyi byed pa po'i don can gyi apra bi kā ra ṇa ni 'jig ste/ a da za ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la brta ma na sogs kyi pa rasmi sbyi pa da rnams sbyar/ apra bi kā ra ṇa byin de 'jig /kha sa 110—182

dang po'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig la/ she te/ sha yā te/ mang tshig la/she adhe zhes gnas pa la/ — / shi ngolharnyo ruṭa/ shrī las anta la ruṭā'o/ /byings shīdra hūṃ/las pha rol gyi rnam dbye ātma ne pa da'i anta rnams la ruṭu ā ga ma 'gyur te/ ruṭā byin/ ṭu gnas don/ u brjod don/ —/ ā tophoto da na taḥ atu ma yin pa la ātpa ༄ kyi arnya a ta'o/ /byings a2 sngumatha' ma yin pa las pha rol gyi ātu te rnam dbye a nee pa da'i anta rnams ni a ta zhes par 'gyur te/ adhe/ a te ru bsgyur bas/ she ra te/de bzhin tu bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ sha ṣe/ sha yā the/she bye/ phyi ma gsum la/ sha ye/ she ba he/ she ma he/ cho ga de bzhin du byas pas cho ga dang 'byung gnas lidra gi skyes bu gsum la/ sha yī ta/ sha yī yā tt+waṃ/ sha yī ran/ sha yī thaḥ sha yī yā tsā/ sha yī bye/ sha yī ya/sha yī ba 5hi/ sha yī ma hi/ shis byed loṭu la/ she tt+waṃ/ sha yā tt+waṃ/ she radzñā / she ṣṭa/ sha yā dzee/ she bye/ sha yi/ sha yā ba hai / sha yā ma hai/ 1 de ring ma yin pa ladra la/ a she 3ta/ a sha yā tt+waṃ/ a she ra ta / a she thāḥ a sha yā tsā8/ a she byethu/ a sha skye yi/ a she ba nyi1 /a she ma hi/1 de nas gnyis ka'i ༄5tshig can gyi dpe ni/ byunyu gsal bar brjod pa la'o zhes pa'i byings la brta ma na laṭa sogs kyi rnam dbye gnyis ka sbyor/byings mtha'i nya yig gnyis ka'i tshig can gyi don/ apra 'jig ste/ de la dang po brta ma na'i pa rasmi pa da'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ 1 byu tipra zhes gnas pa la/ — / a bā dā dzī pi tidme/ ta sa ma pra 'gro ba las apra sngon ma 110—184
