la yī'o/ /byings byu la rnam dbye ti sogs ta yig dang sa yig dang ma yig dang po can bra lku yig 'gro ba'i ming can rnams pha rol las apra sngon du byung ba'i yul la yī rkyen du 'gyur zhing / byings de la'ang yon tan thob ste/ āo rngusbyar yon tan byas pas/ bra bī ti/ gnyis tshig la/ byu taḥ mang tshig la/ byu/arnyi—/ zhes gnas pa la/ 4/ nā na pyorbaḥ apra med pa la khru'i lnga 1ma yin no / /apra bi kā ra ṇa phyis pa'i yul las byings mtha'i spru yig ni dbyangs dang po can pha rol la wa yig tu 'gyur ba ma yin te/ byings kyi yī khru sogs kyi ulnga ru bsgyur bas bru brnyi/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ pra bī ṣi/ byu thaḥ byu tha/ phyi ma gsum la/bra bī mi/ byu baḥ byu maḥ— / de bzhin du ātma nee pa da rnams la/ byu te/ bru bā te/ bru 4ba te / — ata ma yin pa la āta kyi asto ata 'os adhe a ter 5bsgyur/ byu ṣe/ bru 6bā the/ byu bye/bru 1bee/ byu bā te5/ byu ma te/ 1 byunya'i lus 'gyur gzhan ni/ bru 9ba ā hashtsa pañtsa ram̐/ byu'i āha ste lnga po rnams kyang ngo / /ti sogs rnam dbye dang po lnga pha rol la byings byu ni āhu zhes par 'gyur zhing tipra sogs lnga po yang rim bzhin/ ṇapra/ a tusra/usra / thabra/ a thus rnams su 'gyur te/ skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/tipra—/ ṇapra/ pra rjes 'byel/ ṇa yig byings la 'phel ba byed pa'i don/byu—/ ā hu 6 ru bsgyur bas/ ā ha/ gnyis tshig la/ tasra/ a tus su bsgyur bas/ ā ha tuḥ mang tshig la arnyi usra su bsgyur bas/ ā huḥskyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/ sipra thapra tu bsgyur bas/ āhu/ tha rkyebhepra 110—185

ces gnas pa la/ —/ ta the/ tha la ta'o/ /rnam dbye tha yig dang po can pha rol la byu 'gyur ba'i ātro'i hu tshoyig ni ta yig tu 'gyur te/ hu tpar bsgyur bas/āttha / gnyis tshig la/ thasra rngu/ a thus su bsgyur bas/ ā ha thuḥrnams so/ /— / gong ma rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas chog 'byung lidra gi pa rasmi pa da rnams la/ byu yātpa/ byu yā tt+waṃ/ byu yuḥ byu yāḥ byu yā rngo tt+waṃ/ byu yā ta/ byu dzee/ byu yā ba/ byu yā ma/ ātma rgo pa da rnams la/ bru dī ta/bru bī yā tt+waṃ/ bru bī ran / bru bī tha phyeḥ bru bī yā tsā/ bru bī tt+waṃ/ bru bī ya/bru bī ba hi/ bru bī ma hi/ shis byed loṭa'i pa rasmi pa da rnams la/ bra bī tu/byu tātpa/ byu tt+waṃ/ bru bantu/ byu hi/ byu tātu/ byu tai/ byu ta/ bra bā ni / bra bā ba/ bra bā ma/ —/ ātma nee pa da rnams la/ byu tt+waṃ/ bru bā tt+waṃ/ bru ba tt+waṃ/ byu ṣa/bru bā tsā/ byu bye/ bra 6bai/ bra bā ba hai/ bra bā ma hai/ —/ de ring ma yin pa lang gi pa rasmi pa da rnams la/ a bra bītpa/ a byu tt+waṃ3/ a bru ban/ a bra bīḥ a byu tt+waṃ/ a byu ta/ a bra baṃ/ a byu ba/a byu ma/ ྈ/ ātma nee pa da rnams la/ a byu ta/ a bru bā tt+waṃ/ a bru ba ta/a byu thāḥ a bru bā tsā/ a byu bye/ a bru bi/ a byu ba hi/ a byu ma phyahi/de rnams ni apra bi kā ra ṇa 'jig pa rnams kyi cho ga dper mtshon tsam brjod pa yin la/ byings hu sogs la ni apra bi kā ra ṇa 'jig par ma zad khyad par gzhan yang yod de/ —/ hwa derdishtsa/ hu nyul sogs pa'i gnyis kyang ngo / /rnam dbye tipra la sogs pa pha rol la yod cing apra bi kā ra ṇa 'jig pa las 110—186

byings hu la sogs pa rnams ni gnyis su 'gyur ro/ /1 sa swa rā dirdi ra dīḥ dbyangs bcas dang po gnyis te gnyis pa ma yin no/ /byings gnyis su 'gyur ba de yang byings kyi dang po'i yi ge dbyangs bcas gnyis su 'gyur la yi ge gnyis pa sogs gzhan rnams ni gnyis su 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /1 ku hotshi ku dang ha'i tsu'o/ /byings gnyis brjod pa'i dang po'i yi ge de ka sde yin na/ rim pa ltar tsa sder 'gyur zhing ha yin na dzha yig tu 'gyur ro/ / sa/ dzha pā māṃ lkudza ba tsa pāḥ dzha pa rnams kyi dza ba dang tsa pa'o/ /byings gnyis brjod pa'i dang po'i yi ge de dzha pa so sor bsdu ba yin na dza ba so sor bsdu ba rnams dang tsa pa so sor bsdu ba rnams su 'gyur la de yang dzha pa'i nang nas dzha bhā dha gha bha rnams rim pa bzhin dza ḍa da ga ba rnams dang / kha pha tsha ṭha tha rnams rang sde'i tsa ṭa ta ka pa rnams su 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na hu sbyin pa dang mchod pa dag la'o zhes pa'i byings la/ brta ma na'i pa rasmi pa da'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig tipra/ apra 'jig /byings gnyis brjod/ ha dzha/ de yang dzar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ dzu ho ti/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams kyang bsgrubs pas gnyis tshig la/ dzu hu taḥ/ mang tshig la/ /dzu hu arnyi zhes gnas pa la/ ྈ/ dwo/ gnyis las so/ /byings gnyis brjod pa las pha rol gyi anta ni a ta zhes par 'gyur te/ dzu hwa ti/ dbus ma gsum laske/ dzu ho ṣi/ dzu hu thaḥ dzu hu tha/ phyi ma'i gcig tshig la/ dzu ho mi/gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ sa/ orba moṭwā lo paḥ ba ma dag la u yang na 110—187

dbyi'o—/ /byings mtha'i gdod ma'i u dang rkyen kyi u ni rnam dbyi ba dang ma dag pha rol la yang na dbyi bar bya ste/ u dbyi ba dang mi dbye ba 'dam ka can du byas pas/ dzu hu baḥ dzu hwaḥ dzu hu maḥ dzu hmaḥ/ 1 de bzhin du chog 'byung ling la/ dzu hu yātpa/ dzu hu yā tt+waṃ/ dzu hu yuṭwāḥsogs so/ / —/ shis byed loṭā'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dzu ho tu/ dzu hu tātpa/dzu hu tt+waṃ/ dzu hwa tu/ sa/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/ tedhiḥ hi'i dhi'o/ /byings hu las pha rol gyi hi ni dhi zhes par 'gyur te/ dzu hu dhi/ dzu hu tātpa/gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ dzu hu haṃ/ dzu hu ta/ phyi ma gsum la/ dzu ha bā ni/ dzu ha bā ba/ dzu ha bā ma/1 de ring ma yin pa lang gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig la—/ a dzu hotpabye / a dzu hu tt+waṃ/ mang tshig la/ 1 a na us/ anu gyi usra so/ /byings gnyis su brjod pa'i pha rol gyi rnam dbye an kyi usra su 'gyur zhing byings las yon tan kyang 'byung ste/ a dzu ha buḥ dbus ma gsum la/a dzu hoḥ a dzu hu tai/ a dzu hu ta/ phyi ma gsum la/ a dzu ha baṃ/ a dzu hu ba/ a dzu hwa/ a dzu hu ma/ a dzu hma/ sogs so/ / sa/ byings gnyis brjod pa ātma de pa da'i dpe tsam brjod na/ o hādra 'gro ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la brta ma na laṭa'i zhu.ātma ne pa da'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig te sbyar④/ byings kyi o bya ba'i don dang nga ātma nee'i don gnyis brjod / ha dzhar bsgyur ba sogs kyis/ dzā hā te zhes gnas pa la/ 1 hra 110—188

swaḥ thung ngu'o/ /byings gnyis brjod pa'i dang po de'i dbyangs ring po yin na thung ngur 'gyur te/ dzā'i a 1thung ngur bsgyur/— / z-i ṭwāṃ lu ki/ 'jig pa la z-inyu rnams kyi'o/ / apra bi kā snar ṇa sogs rkyen 'jig pa la byings che z-inya 'dzin pa dang rgyas pa o hādra 'gro ba/mādra byemachod pa rnams kyi dang po'i a ni i ru 'gyur te4/ a ir bsgyur/— / dī sto lo po nya 5nu brta te spyi kā rashtsa/ gnyis nyid las mi gnas pa rjes su 'jug pa la yī yig kyang ngo / /byings gnyis brjod pa apra 9sogs mi snang ba rjes su 'jug pa las byengs de'i mtha' 7ā yig yin na rnam dbye dbyangs thog ma can dra ༄ 'gro ba'i ming can rnams la ā dbyi zhing / gsal byed thog ma can dra 'gro ba'i ming can rnams la ā de yī yig tu yang 'gyur te/ā yīr kyebasgyur bas/ dzi tī te/ de bzhin du bsgrubs pas/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ dzi hā te/ dzi ha te/ dbus ma gsum la/dzi tī ṣe/ dzi hā the/ dzi tī bye/ phyi ma gsum la/ dzi he/ dzi dhā ba he /dziX tī ma he/4 / chog 'byung lidra la/ dzi tī ta/ dzi tī yā tt+waṃ/ dzi tī ran/ sogs dang / ྈ / shis byed loṭa nyu la/ dzi tī tt+waṃ/ dzi hā tt+waṃ/ dzi ha tt+waṃ/ dzi ṭī ṣa/dzi hā tsā/ dzi tī bye/ dzi hai/ dzi hā ba hai/ dzi hā ma hai/ sa/ de ring ma yin pa lang la/ a dzi tī ta/ a dzi hā tt+waṃ/ a dzi ha ta/a dzi tī thaḥ a dzi hā (—shaṃ/ a dzi tī bye/ a dzi hi nyu5/ a dzi tī ba hi/a dzi tī ma hi/ 1 byings gnyis brjod pa gnyis ka'i tshig mucan gyi dpe ni/ o hāka 110—189

gtong ba la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings la rjes 'brel rnams phyis rnam dbye bdag 1don dang gzhan don gnyis ka sbyor ba las/ dang po pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar cho ga sngon ma ltar byas pas/ 1 brta ma na la/ dza hā ti/ dza tī taḥ dza hi 'uti/dza hā se/ dza hā zhuthaḥ dza ṭī tha/ dza hā mi/ dza ṭī baḥ dza ṭī maḥ/— / chog 'byung lidra la/ dza hā'i ā yig yā pha rol la dbyi bar bshad pas/ ā phyis nas yā la drangs pas/ dza tyātpa ④/ dza tyā tt+waṃ/dza gyuḥsogs so/ / 1 shis byed loṭu'i skyes bu dang po gsum la/ dza hā tu/ dza tī tātpa/dza tī tt+waṃ/ dza ha tu/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/ 1 yīrba khyaho/ hi la i dang khra yang na'o/ /rnam dbye hi pha rol la o hākra'i mtha'i ā ni i ru bsgyur ba dang yī ru bsgyur ba yang na bar bya ste/ dza hi 'uhi/ dza ṭī nyi/ dza tī tātu/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ dza ṭī tai/ dza ṭī ta/ phyi ma gsum la/ dza hā ni/ dza hā ba/ dza hā ma/ —/ de ring ma yin pa lang gi skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig la—/ a dza hātro/ a dza tī tt+waṃ⑦/ mang tshig la an usra su bsgyur bas a dza hā—/ usra zhes gnas pa la/ 1 u myu lo paḥ usra la ā dbyi'o/ /rnam dbye an bsgyur ba'i usra pha rol la byings o hāka'i phyamatha'i ā ni dbyi bar bya ste ā phyis pas/ a dza huḥ skyes bu dbus kyem dang phyi ma la/ a dza hāḥ a dza tī tai/ a dza tī ta/ a dza haṃ/ a dza ṭī ba/ a dza ṭī ma/ sogs dang de rnams kyi ātma nee pa da rnams kyang rigs 'gre ste shes par bya'o/ / 1 de bzhin du che dānyu sbyin pa la'o zhes pa'i byings la yang thog mar pa 110—190

rasmi pa da rnams sbyor te/ byings kyi che yig che 'gro ba'i don/ nyu gnyis ka'i tshig can gyi don/ apra 'jig /gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis ①bsgrubs pas brta ma na'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ da hā sheti/ gnyis tshig la/ da hā 5/ tasra zhes gnas pa la/ sa/ dā snyedeḥ dā la sogs pa'i 'o/ /rnam dbye dra 'gro ba'i ming can rnams pha rol la byings che dānyu skyel sogs pa gnyis brjod pa'i mtha'i ā yig ni dbyi bar bya ste ā phyis pas/ datta/ mang tshig la/da da ti/ de bzhin du bsgrubs pas dbus ma gsum la/ da dā si bhe/ datthaḥdattha—/ da dā mi/ da dwaḥ dadmaḥ/ —/ chog 'byudra ling la/ da tyātpaspru/ da tyā tt+waṃ/ da byuḥ da byāḥ da byā tai—/ da byā ta/ da ṭwāṃ/ da byā pa/ da tyā ma/ 4/ shis byed loṭā la/ da dā tu/dastutpa / datt+waṃ/ da da tu/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/ da dā/ hi zhes gnas pa la/ 1 dzā ho/ dā rnams kyi hi la'o/ /byings dā la sogs pa rnams kyi rnam dbye hi pha rol la byings gnyis brjod pa'i dang po dbyi zhing mtha'i ā yig kyang e 3ru 'gyur te/ de hirngu/ datthatu/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/datt+waṃ / datta/ phyi ma gsum la/ da dā ni/ da dā pa/ da dā ma/1 de ring ma yin pa ladra la/ a da dāturngo bhe/ a datt+waṃ/ a da duḥ a da dāḥ a datt+waṃ⑪/ a datta/ a da dzā/ a da dwa/ a dadma/ de bzhin du/ātma nee pa da rnams sbyor ba las brta ma na laṭā la/ daste/ da dā te/da da te/ dasne/ da dā the/ dadhe/ da de/ da dwa te/ dadma he/ 1 chog 'byung ling la/ da dī ta/ da dī yā tt+waṃ/ da dī ran/sogs so/ /110—191

da dhe/ da dhwa he/ dadhū he/1 chog 'byung ling la/ da dhī ta/ da dhī kṇi yā tt+waṃ/ da dhī ran sogs dang / —/ shis byed loṭa la/ dhatt+waṃ/ da dhā tt+waṃ/ da dha tt+waṃ/ dharlu/ da dhā tsā/ dhazlo/ da hai/ da dhā ba haibye/ da dhā ma hai/ 1 de ring ma yin pa ladra la/ a dhatta/ a da dhā tt+waṃ/ a da dha ta/a dhadmāḥ a da dhā tsā/ a dhazlo/ a da bye/ a da dhwa hi/ a dadhū hi/sogs te/ de rnams kyi rigs 'gre ded de shes par bya'o/ / —/ da ni byings dibra la sogs pa apra kyi yul la ya bi kā ra ṇa 'jug pa rnams kyi bya ba rnams brjod par bya ste/ de yang de bu ste ba dang / mngon par 'dod pa dang / tha snyad dang / sdug gu'am 'du 'god dang / gsal ba dang / bstod pa dang / rmi lam dang / mdzes pa dang / dga' ba dang / myos pa dang / 'gro ba rnams la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings thul brta ma na sogs kyi pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyor te/ brta ma na'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ dipra/ tipra ces gnas pa la/ 1 di bā deryaḥ dipra la sogs pa la ya'o/ /byings dipra la sogs pa'i sde tshan rnams la byed pa po'i don gyi apra bi kā ra ṇa 'i yul la ya bi kā ra ṇa 'jug ste ya bi kā ra ṇa sbyar/ i u sogs kyi mdos ring por bsgyur bas/dī bya ti/ de bzhin du bsgrubs pas gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ dī bya taḥdī byarnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma dang phyi ma la/ dī chobya si/ dī bya thaḥ dī bya tha/dī byā mi/ dī byā baḥ dī byā maḥ1 de bzhin du bsgrubs pas chog 'byung lidra la/ dī byetro/ dī bye tt+waṃ/110—193

dī bye yuḥ dī byeḥ dī bye tt+waṃ/ dī bye ta/ dī bye yo/ dī bye ba/ dī bye ma/ 1 shis byed loṭā tūl/ dī bya tu/ dī bya tātpakhu/ dī bya tt+waṃ/ dī byantu/ di bya/di bya tātpa/ dī bya tt+waṃ/ dī bya ta/ dī byā ni/ dī byā ba/ dī byā ma/ sa/ de ring ma yin pa ladra la/ a dī byatu/ a dī bya tt+waṃ/ a dī byan/a dī byaḥ a dī bya tai zhe/ a dī bya ta/ a dī ṭwāṃ/ a dī byā ba/ a dī byā ma sogs so/ / 1 de nas 6nyu la sogs pa nu bi kā ra ṇa 'jug pa rnams kyi bya ba'i dpe tsam brjod par bya ste/ 6nyu gcod cing brdung ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la brta ma na sogs kyi bdag don dang gzhan don gnyis ka spyor te/ dang po pa rasmi pa da rnams las brta ma na laṭu'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig tipra sbyar byings mtha'i nyu gnyis ka'i tshig can gyi don/ 6/ tibra ces gnas pa la/ — / āryaḥṣṭaḥsnaḥ dang po'i ṣa ṇa ni sa na'o ④/ /byings kyi dang bo'i ṣa yig dang ṇa yig ni rim pa ltar sa yig dang na yig tu 'gyur te/ ṣa sar bsgyur/— / swā dernuḥ su la sogs pa la nu'o/ /6 sur bsgyur bas byings su la sogs pa rnams la rnam dbye laṭā yesogs sde tshan dang po bzhi pha rol la byed pa po'i don gyi apra kyi yul la nu bi kā ra ṇa 'jug ste nu bi kā ra ṇa byin/ —/ nu pa/ nu dang u'i pa la'o/ /rkyen nu bi kā ⑥ra ṇa dang u bi kā lnga ra ṇa gnyis kyi mtha'i dbyangs ni rnam dbye ba 'go ba'i ming can rnams pha rol la yon tan du 'gyur te/ yon tan byas pas/ su no te/ sa/ pā ryashtsa ta thā to su na māṃ/ pra la sogs pa rnams las su dang namra rnams kyi de bzhin yang ngo / /pra la sogs pa nyer bsgyur sa ṣa dang na ṇar 110—194

'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan can sngon ma las byings su la sogs pa dang napo la sogs pa sngar ṣa dang ṇa yig sa dang nar bsgyur ba rnams slar yang de bzhin nyid de ṣa dang ṇa dag tu 'gyur te/ nyer bsgyur a rnyi sngon du gzhag /sa de slar yang ṣar bsgyur bas/ a bhi 6 rte ti/ mngon par gcod cing rdung bar byed/ gong ma rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ su nu ta 7ཿ su narnyi—/ dbus ma rnams la/ su no ṣerngu/ su nu thaḥ su nu tha/ skyes bu phyi ma'i gcig tshig la/ su no mi/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ ba ma dag la zhes pas u dbye ba dang mi dbyi ba yang na bar byas pas/ su naḥ su nu baḥ byedaḥ su nu maḥ sa/ chog 'byung ling la/ su nu yāṭā/ su nu yā tt+waṃ/ su nu yuḥsogs dang / 1 shis byed loṭu'i byeskyes bu dang po gsum la/ su no tu/ su nu tātu/ su nu tt+waṃ/ su nantu/ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/ 1 orpā heḥ.u la sa ti'i yang na'o/ /yi ge brtsegs pa ma yin pa'i rkyen u yig las pha rol gyi ti ni yang na 'jig ste/ hi 'jig pa dang shis byed la tā tadra du bsgyur ba yang na bar byas pas/ su nu/ su nu tātpa/ yi ge brtsegs pa yin na hi mi 'jig pas / dper na byings ta kyu dang twa kṣu lta bu la/ nu bi kā ra ṇa sbyar bas/ta spru hi/ twa spru nyi zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ su nu tt+waṃ/su nu ta/ phyi ma gsum la/ su na bā ni/ su na bā ba/ su na bā ma/— / de ring ma yin pa lang la/ a su notpa/ a su nu tt+waṃ/ a su nan/ a su noḥ a su nu lta/ a su nu ta/ a su na baṃ/ a su nu ba/ a su nu ma/ 1 de nas byed rgo pa da rnams las brta ma na laṭu cel/ su nu te/ su 110byed195

nā te/ su na te/ su nu ṣe/ su nā the/ su 1nu bye/ su dzwa/ su na he/su nu ba te/ su dma te/ su nu ma he/— / chog 'byung lidra la/ su dzñā ta/ su rtswa yā tt+waṃ/ su dzñā ran sogs dang / shis byed loṭā la/ su nu tt+waṃ/ su nā tt+waṃ/ su na tt+waṃ/ su nu ṣa/su nā rde/ su nu bye/ su/ na bai/ su na bā ba hai/ su/ na bā ma hai/ de ring ma yin pa 'a/dra la/ a su nu ta/ a su nā tt+waṃ/ a/ su na ta/ a su nu thāḥ.a su/ nā tsā/ a su nu bye/ a su/ nī/ a su na hi/ a su/ nu ba hi/ a sudma hi/ a su nu ma hi so/gas so// /myu/ da ni ru dha 'a/ so/gas pa na mra/ bi kāsra ṇa 'jug pa rnam/sa kyi cho ga mdo tsam brjod par bya ste/ de yang ru byedra sgrib nga/'o zhes nga/'i byings la/ brta ma na sogs bdag don dang gzhan don gnyis/ ka sbyo ra te/ de 'a dang po nga/ rasmi pa da rnams las/ brta ma/ na'i skyes/ bu dang ngo/'i gcig tshig /tidra/ sbyar byings/ kyi idra dbos/ nga/ dang bcas/ nga/'i rjes 'brel yin pas phyis/ rudhra / tidra / ces/ gnas/ nga 'a/ / ྈ / ru dhā de rnastse// ru dhra 'a/ sogs/ pa rnam/sa la namra/ mo// /byings/ ru dhra 'a/ so/gas/ pa'i sde tshan rnams la rnam dbye brta ma na so/gas/ sde tshan dang ngo/ bzhi pha rol la byed nga/ bo'i don gyi adra/ kyi yu' 'a namra/ bi kā ra ṇa 'jug ste/ namra/ sbyar rkyen gyi ma gnas kyi don te/ ru dang dha'i bar du sbyar/ de'i don gyi ma phyis/ ྈ/ ta thorjaḥ ta dang tha'i tsho dha'o/ /byings/ mtha' dzha bha so/ so/ra bsnyu ba'i pha rol kyi rkyen dang rnam dbye'i ta yig dang tha yig dag ni dha yig tu 'gyur te/ ta dha/ dzha bha la dza ba 'os byings kyi dha da/ ṣa ra ṛ sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ ru ṇadhi / gnyis tshig la'ang / namra sbyor ba 110—/96

la yang na 'os dha du dang ta yang na bar byas pa'i da'i phyogs la da de slar yang na bar bsgyur bas/ a ru ṇatpa/ a ru ṇaḥ a ru ṇadu/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ a zu rghaṃ/ a sum̐ dha/ skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ a ru ①ṇa sgo/a sum̐ dhwa/ a sum̐ sgro/ de nas ātma nee pa de 3rnams sbyor ba las/ brta ma na laṭa 1la/ sum̐ dhe/ sum̐ dhā te/ ldu dha te/ ldu sne/ sum̐ dhā the/ zu rbhe rju /dṛ dhe/ zu dhwa he/ zusgro he/ cho ga 'byung lidra la/ zu dhī ta/ zu dhī yā tt+waṃ/sum̐ dhī rnguran sogs dang / shis byed loṭu la/ lduspyo/ ru ⑥dhā tt+waṃ/ sum̐ dha tt+waṃ/sum̐grwa—/ ldu dhā tsā/ ldu dhī/ ru ṇa byetshu/ ru ṇa dhwa ba hai/ ru ṇa dhwa ma hai 3/de ring ma yin pa ladra la/ a ldudhe shyi/ a zu dhā tt+waṃ/ a sum̐ dha ta/ a ldusgyeḥ.a sum̐ ddhā tsā/ a ldu rghaṃ/ a sum̐ dhi/ a sum̐ dhwa hi/ a sum̐zla hi/ sogs so/ /1 de nas upra bi kā ra ṇa 'jug pa rnams kyi cho ga rnams brjod par bya ste/de yang ta nu yang ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la rnam lku dbye bdag don dang gzhan don gnyis ka 'jug pa la/ dang po pa rasmi pa da rnams las brta ma na'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ tan/ tipra rgyu:ces gnas pa la/ 1 ta nā de rupra/ tanu/ sogs la upra'o/ /byings ta nu la sogs pa'i sde tshan rnams la brta ma na sogs rnam dbye sde tshan dang po bzhi pha rol la byed /5pa po'i don gyi apra kyi yul la upra bi kā ra ṇa 'gyur te/ upra sbyar/pra rmyeyig byings la yon tan 'byung ba'i don yin pas phyis rngu / rnam dbye pa 'gro ba rnams la nu dang u'i pa la 'os yon tan byas pas/ ta no ti/ de bzhin du bsgrubs pas ⑫ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ ta nu taḥ ta narnyi/ skyes bu dbus ma dang phyi ma la/ ta no ṣi/ ta nu thaḥ ta nu tha/ ta no mi/110—198

ta nu baḥ ta naḥ ta nu maḥ tadmaḥ chog 'byung ling la/ ta nu yātpa/ta nu yā tt+waṃ/ ta nu yuḥsogs so/ /kau shis byed loṭā rngul/ ta no tu/ ta nu tātu/ ta nu tt+waṃ/ ta nāntu/ta nu/ ta nu tātpa/ ta nu tai/ ta nu ta/ ta na bā ni/ ta na bā ba/ta na bā ma/1 de ring ma yin pa laja la/ a ta notu/ a ta nu tt+waṃ/ a ta nānu/a ta noḥ/ /a ta nu tai/ a ta nu ta/ a ta na baṃ/ a ta na/ a ta nu ba—/ a tadma/ a ta nu ma/ sogs te ātma nee pa da rnams kyang des rigs 'gre la 62'i skabs dang yang 'dra'o/ / 1 de bzhin du che kṛtra byed pa la'o zhes pa'i byings la'ang rnam dbye bdag don dang gzhan don gnyis ka 'jug pa la/ dang po pa rasmi pa da rnams las—/ brta ma na'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ kṛ tipra ces gnas pa la—/ tan rngu sogs kyis upra/ pra 'gro ba sogs kyi byings la yon tan 'byung bas ṛ adra/ slar yang nu dang u'i pra la'os yon tan byas pas/ ka ro ti/gnyis tshig la/ upra sbyor ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ ka ru/ tasra zhes gnas pa la/ 1 di tya duḥ dra 'gro ba la atpa u'o/ /rnam dbye dra 1'gro ba'i ming can rnams pha rol la che kṛnyu'i ④ka'i srog gi atu 1ni u ru 'gyur te—/ a udra ⑥bsgyur bas/ ku ru taḥ de bzhin du mang tshig la/ kurbarnyi/de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ dbus ma gsum la/ ka ro ṣi/ ku ru thaḥ/ ku ru tha/ skyes bu phyi ma'i gcig tshig la/ ka ro mi/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig ④la/ ba yig dang ma yig pha rol la chekṛnyu'i u yig rtag tu dbyi 110—199

༈ tu dā de raḥ tud sogs la a'o/ /byings tud la sogs pa'i sde tshan rnams las rnam dbye brta ma na sogs sde tshan dang po bzhi pha rol la byed pa po'i don gyi apra kyi yul la a bi tshokā ra ṇa 'gyur te/ a sbyor ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ pa rasmi ba da rnams la/ tu laṭad ti/ tu lijadetu/ tu loṭad tu / a ladratu datu sogs dang / ātma de pa da rnams la/ tu laṭud te/tu lidrade tabye / tu loṭad tt+waṃ/ a tu ladrad ta/ sogs te bsgrub tshul cho ga thams cad byu dang e dha'i skabs dang khyad par med do/ /— / de nas nā bi kā ra ṇa 'jug pa'i bya ba rnams brjod par bya ste/ zu shānyu ④rdzas 'tshong ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la rnam dbye bdag don dang gzhan don gnyis ka 'jug la/ de yang dang po pa rasmi pa da rnams las/ brta ma na laṭā'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ spyetipra ces gnas pa la/ 4/ nāsthādeḥshrī sogs la nā'o/ /byings skru la sogs pa'i sde tshan rnams las rnam dbye brta ma na sogs sde tshan dang po bzhi pha rol la byed pa po'i don gyi apra kyi yul la nā bi kā ra ṇa 'jug ste/ nā sbyar/ ṣa ra ṛ sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ ṭā ṇa ti/gnyis tshig la/ tpā rja tasra zhes gnas pa la/ 1 yī ha se/ ha sa la yī'o/ /nā bi kā ra ṇa'i ā yig ni rnam dbye dra 'gro ba'i ming can ha sa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge dang po can pha rol la yī yig tu 'gyur te/ shrī ṇḍi taḥ mang tshig /shrī zla adhi zhes gnas pa la/ sa / nā taḥ nā'i ātpa'o/ /nā bi kā ra ṇa'i ā yig ni rnam dbye nga 'gro ba'i ming can dbyangs dang po pha rol la dbyi 5bar bya ste/ā phyis pas/ kshi ṇarnyi/ de bzhin du dbus ma gsum la/ tpā rja si/ shrī bhā thaḥ shrī bhā tha/ phyi ma gsum la/ tpā ṇa mi/ shrī bhā baḥ shrī ṭī maḥ/ cho ga 110—201

1 ābyubi karma ṇi/ dngos po dang las la ātu'o/ /byengs las dang bcas pa rnams la las kyi don dang las med pa rnams la dngos po'i don du rnam dbye a nee pa da rnams 'jug cing dngos po'i don la de rnams kyi gcig tshig kho na 'jug la—/ nyer bsgyur gyi stobs kyis bsgyur ba la ni der ma nges so/ /de yang byings las bcas dang las med kyi dbye ba ni/ byings des byed pa'i tshig gi don kho na brjod pa ni las med pa dang / las 1dang byed tshig gnyis ka'i don brjod pa de las dang bye bcas pa'i byings zhes grags pa las/ byings las med pa ni bhū — dang / e dha dang / āsra dang / shīdra la sogs pa ste/ ji skad du / ladzdza satthasbi ti dzā ga ra ṇi dṛddhi kṣa ya bha ya dzre bi ta ma re/ sha ya na kri ḍā ru tsi dīst+yadzee dhwa tu ga rṇa ta ma karma ka mā huḥ/ ngo tsha yod pa gnas pa mel tshe dang / /'phel ba zad pa 'jig pa 'tsho ba dang / /nyal dang rtsed mo 'od dang 'bar ba'i don/ /byings kyi tshogs rnams las med par bshad do/ /zhes pa ste ngo tsha sogs don bcu gnyis po de rnams kyi 4don can kyi byings rnams la ni las med pa zhes bya zhing / de rnams las gzhan pa rnams las dang bcas pa'o /dngos po'i mtshan nyid ni/ ji skad du/ sadmā tram̐ bhā ba liṅge myu da saspriṭaṃ yatstsha kā ra kaiḥ/ dha tāzeḥke ba lo shuddhi bha ba i tya bhi dhī ya te/ yod tsam dngos po'i rtags su 'gyur/ /gang yang byed can rnams ma reg /byings don rkyang pa dag pa ni/ /de la dngos por mngon par brjod/ /ces te byed can drug pa bye gang dang yang ma sbyar ba/ dngos po yod pa tsam ston pa ni dngos po'i don zhes bya'o / / —/ yastsa tukhye/ bzhi po la yakra'o/ /byings las rnam dbye brta ma na 110—204

sogs sde tshan dang po bzhi po pha rol la dngos po dang las kyi don la yakra rkyen du 'gyur te/ ka ①yig byings la yon tan 'gog pa'i don yin pas dbyi ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ bhū ya te bha ba tā/ khyodayin/ e dhya te dhārmi kaḥ chos dang ldan pa/ 'phel/ āsu te u pā sa nee/ nye ba'i gdan la gnas/ shidra gi yakra pha rol la yī a yadra rngo du bsgyur bar bshad pas/ āo a yadra — —/ dra dang ya'i a rjes 'byel yin pas phyis pas/ shabee te khru dre ṇa/ nyal bar byed do dmangs rigs/ yang skabs la lar byings las med pa la'ang las zi can ltar bsgrub pa yang yod la/de yang nyer bsgyur spesngon du byung na ni nyer bsgyur gyi dbang gis las med las can dang las gyecan las med du bsgyur ba dang / gcig tshig kho na 'jug pa la gnyis tshig mang tshig thams cad sbyor ba sogs sna tshogs yod de/ byings las nyer bsgyur stobs che bas nyer bsgyur gyis bsgyur 'gro bas dper na/ hā ra 'phrog pa la 'jug kyang nyer bsgyur gyis bsgyur bas/ bee hā ra gnas pa ā hā ra / zas/ saṃ hā ra/ khongs su sdud pa// pra ti hā ra 'joms pa/ sogs byings kyi don gzhan du 'gyur 'go ba lta bu ste/ nyer bsgyur gyi 3dbang gis/ su kha ma nu byu ya te swā mi nā/— rje bos bde ba rjes su myong bar byed/ zhes tre pa lta bu'o/ /las bcas la las kyi don du yakra sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ ka ṭa ཿkri ya te 11kā ru ke ṇa/ rtswa'i lhas ma'i las byed/two du sa/ kri sa/ se/snye spyod da7'a bas byed do/ /rā gau ba sarā giḥ chags pa dag la sa chags pa/ bral bas nged bde bar byed do/ /su khya haṃ kri ye/ —/ a ya ki/ a yakra la'o/ /byings mtha'i ṛtpa ni rkyen a dang yakra 6pha rol la ridra da du 'gyur te/ dra yig bar mtshams gcod pa'i don te 'og nas 'byung ba'i ya la'o zhes pa sogs 'gog 6pa'i don yin pas dbyi ba sogs 110—205

ltar las nyid byed pa po yang ste/ /byed por bcas pa'i las su rnam par 'dod//las gang byed pas 'jug par ldan pa ste/ rang gi stobs shugs kyi ni gang la yang / /de nyid rab tu grub par byed pa ni/ /bde blag byed pa rang gi yon tan rnams/ /las de byed po nyid dang lhan cig rig /ces pa ste gang bya ba'i las kyi dngos po de byed pa pos rtsol ba chen po mi dgos par bde blag tu 'grub pa de ni byed pa po dang bcas pa'i las zhes zer te/ dper na/ e da naḥpa tsu te swa ya me ba/ 'bras chan tshos te rang shugs kyi/ bhi rya te nyukaṅgi swa ya me ba / dum bur byed do shing rang shugs kyi/ lū ya te ke 2dā raḥswa ya me pa/— rnga bar byed do zhing rang shugs kyi/ zhes pa lta bu ste byings patsu 'tshed pa/ bye didra gnyis su byed pa/ lhakhya gcod pa rnams la yakra sbyar nas bsgrubs 4pa'o/ /yang don gabyug la las kyi tshig gnyis sbyor dgos pa yang yod la/ de yang ṭī/ ngu 3hi/ yātsi/ ru bye/ru tsi/ prakhyu/ bhikṣi/ tsikhya tre sogs la las kyi dza tshig gnyis spyor ba ste/bhānyu thob pa la'o zhes pa'i byings la rkyen yaka sbyar/ de la las kyi tshig gnyis sbyar bas/ na ga re nī ya te nā ga ri neerba nee — —tsaraḥ grong khyer du thob bo grong khyer bas nags spyo da/ de bzhin du/ ṭu yā rtswa 9slong ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la/ sgo dza rgo yā tsu te ya dza ma no yā tsa ke na/ lto zas slo nga bar byed do slong ston gyi sar slong mo pas/ pratstsha dzee shes par 'dod pa la'o zhes pa'i byings la/ grahra sogs kyi slar yang dag pa ra bsgyur ba'o/ /thrarje te pabye rna pa thi ke na/ —'dri bar byed do lam rnams lam zhugs kyis 'grul ba la/ shi bye zla tsaryasta hūṃ3two thrakhye te/— slob mas slob dpon la de kho na nyid 'dri bar byed do/ /de ltar las kyi beetshog gnyis sbyor ba la byed pa dang 'brel pa de las gtso phal gnyis las gtso bo yin no/ /i 8ti swa ra swasti byā ka ra ṇa su sru tādha ba karma pra kri ya sa mābhāḥ/ zhes pa brda 110—208

sprod pa dbyangs can kyi mdo las dngos po dang las kyi rab tu byed pa rnams rdzogs so// // 1 de nas pa rophokṣa rmyel sogs pa rnam dbye sde 2tshan phyi ma drug gi cho ga rnams rab tu brjod par bya ste/ de la dang po pa ro3kṣa ni/ pa rolhakṣa ④ṇa pa tu susbra pa thus ṇasba mā yā ta yi re sa yā the dhwa 5ye ba te ma te/ lkog tu gyur pa la / ṇapra/ a tusra/ usra/ thapra/ a thusra6/ a/ ṇapra/ pa/ma—/ 1 e④/ ā te/ i re/ se/ ā je/ bye/ e8/ ba he/ma te'o/ /byings las gog tu gyur pa'i dus brjod pa'i byed pa'i don la ṇapra la sogs pa rnam dbye bco brgyad po 'di rnams 'gyur zhing / lkog tu gyur pa'i dus de la'ang 'das ma 'ongs gnyis su yod pa las 'das pa la 'jug la 'das pa de yang 'das nas yun ring lon pa'i dus la 'jug pa shas che'o/ /rnam dbye 'di rnams la pā bee pa'i lugs la/ liṭu zhes zer ro/ /— / dīshtsa/ gnyis kyang ngo / /ṇapra la sogs pa rnam dbye bco brgyad po pha rol la de rnams spyor gzhi'i byings de gnyis su'ang 'gyur te/ bhū la/sgog gyur liṭā'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig ṇapra sbyar gnyis brjod pas/ byubyu/ṇapra ces gnas pa la/ — / ādhwarṇa do/ ṇapra sogs la bhū a dag gi ā'o/ /rnam dbye ṇapra la sogs pa pha rol la byings gnyis brjod pa'i dang po de bhū'i u byedang a yin na ā yig tu 'gyur te/ bhū'i spru ā/ thung ngu 'os/ de thung ngur bsgyur dzha pa sogs kyis bha ba/1 byu bo bukra/ byu la bukra'o/ /ṇapra la sogs pa'i rnam dbye rnams pha 110—209

rol las byings bhū la bukra ā ga ma 'gyur te/ pukra byin kra gnas don u brjod don yin pas dbyi ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ ba byu ba/ de bzhin du bsgrubs pas gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ ba byu ba tuḥ ba bhū buḥ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/ ba byu pra ①thapra zhes gnas pa la/ kau krā deṇḍa deḥkṛ sogs las ṇa sogs la'o/ /byings kṛ/ mṛ/ z-i/ thra/ dru/ snrukhru / sru rnams ma yin pa'i byengs rnams las pha rol gyi ṇapra sogs rnam dbye ba sa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge dang po can rnams la iṭā ā ga ma ster bar bya ste/iṭu byin pas/ ba khyu bi tha/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ ba bhū ba thuḥb bhū ba/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas skyes bu phyi ma gsum la/ ba byu ba/ ba byu bi ba/ ba bhū bi ma/ de bzhin du che pa tsagra 'tshed pa la'o zhes pa'i byings la bdag don dang gzhan don gnyis ka 'jug pa las/ dang po pa rasmi pa da'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ patsu/ ṇapra/ ces pa la/gnyis kyang ngos byings gnyis brjod/ sngon ma'i ha sa dang po lhag po'os tsu gong ma phyis/sa / atpa u pa dmā yāḥ u pa jo'i atu'o/ /byings kyi u pa dhā'i a yig ni nyu yig dang nd+ra yig 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la 'phel bar 'gyur te/'phel ba byas pas/ pa pā tsa/ gnyis tshig la/ pa patsu a tusra/ zhes gnas pa la/ sa/ ṇa diḥkitpabye / ṇa la sogs pa ka 'gro ba'o/ /rnam dbye ṇapra la sogs pa pra 'gro ba rnams ma yin pa rnams la rgo ka 'gro ba'i ming can zhes 1 zer ro / 1 lo paḥpa ṭī ki hye tsā lya/ patsu rnams kyi ka 'gro ba la dbyi ste a'i yang 4 110—210

e'o—/ /byings patsu 1la sogs pa rnams kyi gnyis brjod pa'i dang po bsgyur ba ma yin pa'i gdod ma'i a yig yin na yi ge dang po de dbyi zhing a yig phyi ma de yang e bye yig tu 'gyur te/ pa gong ma phyis phyi ma'i a er bsgyur bas/ pe tsa tuḥ de bzhin du mang tshig la/ pe snyetsuḥ skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig la/ sa/ peṭa 4 thapra/ thapra la iṭu snyeyang na'o/ /byings iṭā mi 'jug pa rnams kyi pha rol las kyang rnam dbye thapra la iṭā treyang na 'gyur zhing / iṭa dang bcas pa'i thapra de yang ka 'gro ba'i ming can du yang na bar bya ste/ iṭā yang na bar byas / iṭu'i phyogs la'ang ka 'gro ba'i cho ga dang mi 'gro ba'i cho ga 'dam kha can dzadu byas pas/ pa pa tsi tha/ pe tsi tha/ pa pathi/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ pe tsa thuḥ pe tsa/ skyes bu phyi ma'i gcig tshig ṇapra byel ṇa 'gro ba'i cho ga yang na bar bshad pas 'phel ba byed pa dang mi byed pa 'dam kha can du byas pas/ pa pā tsa/ pa pa tsa/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ pe tsi ba pe tsi ma/4 / ātma ne pa da 9rnams la yang cho ga de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas / pe tse/ pe tsā te/ pe tsi re/ pe tsi ṣe/ pe tsā the/ pe tsi bye/pe spretse/ pe tsi ba he/ pe tsi ma he/byings che kṛnyu —1byed pa la'ang — 2bdag don dang gzhan don gnyis ka 'jug pa las dang po pa rasmi pa da'i nyu snaskyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ sa/ raḥṛ a'o/ /byings gnyis brjod pa'i dang po'i dbyangs de ṛ yig yin na a yig tu 'gyur te byings gnyis brjod/ ṛ a/ ku ha sogs kyis ka tsar bsgyur bas—/ tsa kṛ/ ṇapra/ ces gnas pa la/ ྈ/ dhā tortswa mi naḥ byings kyi 110—211

nā mi'i'o/ /byings kyi mtha' nā mi'i yi ge ni nya yig dang ṇa yig 'go ba'i ming can pha rol la 'phel bar 'gyur te/ 'phel ba byas pas/ tsa kā ra/gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/ tsa kra tuḥ tsa kruḥ/ de bzhin du bsgrubs pas skyes bu dbus ma gsum la/ tsa karba/ tsa kra thuḥ tsa kra/ phyi ma gsum la/ tsa kā ra/ tsa ka ra/ tsa kṛ ba/ tsa kro 1ma/ cho ga de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas ātma rgo pa da'i skyes bu dang po gsum dang dbus ma'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig la/ tsa kre/ tsa krā te/ tsa kri re/ tsa kṛ ṣe/tsa krā the/ mang tshig la/ tsa kṛ bye/ zhes gnas pa la/ sa / na mi nolha tsa tuzlo bho bhāḥ bzhi po rnams ma yin pa'i dha'i nā mi las shwe'o/ /byings thams cad pa'i rnam dbye bzhi po ma yin pa las rnam dbye'i dha yig ni byings mtha' nā mi'i pha rol la bhā yig tu 'gyur te/ dha snyar bsgyur bas/ tsakṛ twe/ phyi ma gsum la/ tsa kre/ tsa kṛ ba te/ tsa kṛ ma he/ nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ rā mo rā rdzu tsa kā ra/ dga' byed kyi rgyal srid sngo na byas so/ / —/ de bzhin du/ a su 'byung ba la'o zhes pa la pa rasmi pa da rnams spyor ba las byings gnyis brjod/ sngon ma'i ha sa dang po lhag po 'os sa gong ma phyis / 'dra ba'i yi ge 'dus pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ ā sa/ ā sa tuḥ ā suḥ ā si tha/ ā sru/ ā sa thuḥ ā sa/ ā sa/ ā si ba/ā se ma/ sa/ kā sā di pra tya yānt+ra dzā kra lcupa raḥ kṛ asra byu rkyen mtha' can pha rol las kā sa la sogs pa rnams la āmra'o/ /byings kṛ asra bhū rnams ṇapra ④sogs kyi rkyen mtha' can dang sbyor ba las kā sa la sogs pa rnams kyi mthar āpo khya110—212

rkyen du 'gyur te/ kā mṛ ngan du smra ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la rkyen āmra/ de la kṛ/ asralku/ bhū rnams ṇapra sogs kyi mtha' can dang sbyar bas/ kā sī tsakre / kā sā mā se/ kā sī ba byu ba/ —/ de bzhin du/ tsa kā mṛ snang byed la'o zhes pa'i byings la/ tsa kā māṃ tsa kā ra/ tsa kā sā mā sa/ tsa kā sī ba bhū ba/4 / dza kṛ gnyid zad pa la'o zhes pa la/ āmra 4byings mtha'i yon tan byas pas/ dza ga dzā tsa kā ra/ dza ga rā mā sa/ dza ga dzā ba bhū ba sogs dang /— / edha 'phel ba la/ e ddhā tsa kre/ e dhā mā se/ e ddhā ba bhū bee/sa / ka la cha shas la'o zhes pa la/ tsu ra la sogs la nyi 'os rkyen nyi'i zhe mtha' can la/ āmra 6sogs sbyar yon tan byas pas/ ka la yī 7tsa kā ra/ka la yā mā sa/ ka 9la yī ba byu ba sogs dang yitā nee pa da rnams la/ ka la dzee tsa kre/ ka la yā mā se/ ka la yī ba byu bee 7sogs so/ /lnga/ bid shes pa la'o zhes pa la/ ā mi bi derna gu ṇaḥ āmra la bid kyi yon tan ma yin no/ /āmra pha rol la byings bid la yon tan 'byung ba ma yin te/ yon tan mi byed/ bi dzā tsa kā ra/ bi dā mā se/ bi dzā ba bhū ba sogs so/ / sa/ spyikṣa lta ba dang mtshan ma la'o zhes pa la/ yīhūṃ tsa kre/ yīkṣu mā sezhe /yīshā ba khyu ba/ khruhu rnam par brtags pa la/ spru hūṃ tsa kre/ u hā mā se/spru hūṃ ba byu be sogs so/ /— / iha rtsed mo la'o zhes pa la/ i hūṃ tsa kre/ i hā mā se/ i hūṃ ba byu bee kyisogs so/ /de nas rkyen sa dang bcas pa'i āmra gyi bya ba rnams bshad 110—213

sa/ khu ba tsagra 'tshed pa la/ bdag gi 'dod pa lo sa 'os/ rkyen sa/gnyis brjod/ sngon ma'i ha sa dang po lhag po'os/ tsā gong ma phyis/ pa patsu / sa zhes gnas pa la/ —/ yaḥse7/ sa la a yī'o/ /rkyen sa pha rol la byings gnyis brjod pa'i dang po'i a yig ni i yig tu 'gyur te/ a i/ tsu'i ku dang ku i la zhes pas/ pi pakṣa zhes 'grub pa la āpo sogs sbyar bas pi paṭwāṃ tsa kā ra/pi bakṣu 5mā sa/ pi baṭwāṃ ba bhū ba sogs so/ / —/ parṇa rigs brjod pa la'o zhes pa la/ tsu ra sogs kyis nyi/ kā sa zhes pas āphra i la yon tan sogs kyis/ barṇa yī tsa kā ra/ barṇa yā mā sa/barṇa yī ba byu ba sogs so/ / —/ de bzhin du ba dha 'ching ba la'o 4zhes pa la nyi āmra sbyor ba sogs kyis/ba dha yī tsakre/ ba dha yā mā se/ ba dha dzee ba bhū bee sogs dang yang ba dha la bdag gi 'dod pa'i don gyis sbyar/ gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/bi bhatt+waṃ tsakre/ bi bhatpā mā se5/ bi bhatt+waṃ ba byu ba sogs so/ / sa/ byings dī hu 6ddhā twe rnams kyi rkyen āmra sogs pha rol la gnyis su brjod pa dang / byings de rnams nyid la ṇapra sogs spyor ba 'dam ka can du bshad de/ nyi dhī 'jig pa la āmra sogs sbyar nas gnyis su brjod pa dang /byings nyid la ṇapra sogs sbyor ba yang na bar byas pas/ āmra dzwasbyar ba'i phyogs la/ bi bha st+waṃ tsa bye/kā ra/ bi bha yā rngumā sa/ bi bha yī ba byu ba sogs dang āmra sogs ma sbyar ba'i phyogs la11/ bi bhā ya/ bi bhya tuḥ bibyuḥ bi bha yi tha/ bi bhe tha/ bi bhya thuḥ bi bhya/ bi bhā ya/ bi bha ya/ bi bye ba kyi/110—215

bi bye ma/ de bzhin du hu sbyin pa dang za ba la'o zhes pa la/ āmra 1sogs sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ dzu ha ṭwāṃ rngutsa kā ra/ dzu ha bā mā sa/ dzu ha ṭwāṃ ba khyu ba sogs dang / āmra byem sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ dzu hā ba/ dzu hu ba tuḥ nu sogs kyis apra ru ④bsgyur ba'o/ /dzu hu buḥ/ dzu ho tha/ dzu ha bi thutha/ dzu hu ba thuḥ dzu hu ba/ dzu hā ba/ dzu ha ba/ dzu trehu bi ba/ dzu hu bi ma/ chez-inya 'dzin pa dang gsog pa la'o zhes pa la/ āmra zusogs sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ bi 8bha dzā tsa kā ra/ bi bha rā mā sa/ bi 1bha dzā ba bhū ba sogs dang āmra tsosogs ma sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ ba bhā ra/ ba dhra tuḥ ba juḥ ba bha nd+ralnga / ba bhra thuḥ ba blu/ ba bhā ra/ ba bha ra/ ba j-i tsu ba/ ba z-i ri ༷ ma/ twe —ngo tsha ba la'o zhes pa la āmra musogs sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ dzi ha yī latsa kā ra/ sngonama'i ha sa dang po lhag ngo/ 'o sar — phyis/ dzi ha yā mā sa/ ziX ha dzee ༄ ba bhū ba sogs dang /āmra sogs ma sbyar ba'i phyogs la/ dzi hā ya/ dzi hri ya tuḥ dzi hri yuḥ/ dzi hra yi tha/ dzi hre tha/ dzi hri ya thuḥ dzi hri ya/ dzi hā ya/ dzi hra ya/ dzi tri yi ba/ dzi hri yi ma/ de rnams ni byings ddhā la sogs pa bzhi po'i bsgrub tshul lo/ / byu/ dzi rgyal ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la/ ṇapra sto/sogs pa rasmi pa da'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig ṇapra sbyar/ dzi ṇapra/ ces gnas pa la/ ྈ/ sa pa ro3kṣa yo dzesaḥ sa dang lkog tu gyur pa dag las dzi'i gi'o/ /rkyen sa yig dang sgog gyur gyi rnam dbye rnams pha rol la byings dzi ni gi zhes par 'gyur te/dzi gi gnyis brjod/ ku ha sogs kyis ga gong ma beer yang dzar bsgyur/'phel ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ dzi gā ya/ de bzhin du lhag ma rnams la/110—216

dzi gya tuḥ dzi gyuḥ/ dzi ga yi tha/ dzi ge tha/ dzi gya thuḥ dzi gya/ dzi gā ya/dzi ga ya/ dzi gyi ba/ dzi lkugyi ma/ sems dran pa nyams pa dang mi bden pa'i rdzun tshig dang dus yun thung ngu rnams kyi don la'ang ṇapra la sogs pa rnams 'jug par bshad de/ bi sngon ma'i la pa nga ro 'don pa la'o zhes pa la ṇapra sogs sbyar cho ga snga ma rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ bi la khā ba/ bi le pa tuḥ bi le puḥ bi la la pi tha/ bi le pi tha/ bi la labee/ bi le pa thuḥ bi le pa/ bi la 'di pa/ bi la la pa bi le bi ba bi le bi ma /nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ sustolha haṃ ki la bi la lā pa/ bdag nyid nyal bas ca co sgra 'byin no// de bzhin du gz-i 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la/ ṇapra/ gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ dza gā ma/ kau ga māṃ swa re / gamra rnams kyi dbyangs la'o/ /byings gamra4/han / dzan/ khanu/ ghasra rnams kyi u pa dhā ni kra 5dra 'gro ba'i ming can dbyangs dang po can pha rol la dbyi bar bya ste/ gnyis tshig dang mang tshig la/dzagla tuḥ dzagluḥ de bzhin du bsgrubs pas/ dza ga mi tha/ dzagri tha/ dza gi tha/ dzagla thuḥ dzagru/ dza gā ma/ dza ga ma/ dzasmi ba/ dzarmi ma/nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar bas/ dza gā mā ga stso daṭī ṇa de shaṃ/ yul lho phyogs la ri byi 'gro bar byed do//1 han 'tshe ba dang 'gro ba la'o zhes pa la/ ṇapra/ han gyi na la gha 'os / ha gha gnyis brjod/ sngon ma'i ha sa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ dza ghā na/ de bzhin du lhag ma rnams la/ dza sna tuḥ dza spruḥ/ dza gha ni tha/dza mbi tha/ dza rghaṃ tha/ dza sna thuḥ dza sna/ dza ghā na/ dza gha na/ dza rgyu ba/110byed217

dza sgri ma/ nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ mu dzā ga nā kadzdza la lo pa lo lo lakhro mu khaṃ sgo dza bi lā pa z-iṅgaḥ/ dza ga hūṃtra pa tā ṇa ta nu tra bhu to dza ghā na hanaṇapra na shaṃ saṃ ka li bā sa byede baḥ/ gcod byed lha min yan lag ma yi mig sman byi/ /dpal mo'i gdong gi pad tshal rnam rol bung ba ni/ /'gro ba'i skyabs dang skyob pa phra bar 'jug pa can/ /kadma nges par bcom pa nor lha'i bu 'di'o/ /dza nī skye ba la'o zhes pa bdag don gyi tshig can yin pas a na ༄ pa da rnams 'jug pa la/ byings mtha'i yī dgos pa dang bcas pa'i rjes 'brel/ gnyis brjod/sngon ma'i ha sa dang po lhag po 'os na gong ma phyis/ u pa dhā yang phyis/ sa tu'i sha tsu'os/ na tra dzra 2 'dus pa tre sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ dza zlo/dza dzñā te/ dza rnyi 4re/ dza rnyi ṣe5/ dza dzñā the/ dza rnyi bye/ dza zlo/ dza rnyi ba he/ dza rnyi ma te/ dza zlo dza gadzdza/ nārdu nātpa/— 'gro bas mchod pa las 'gro ba rnams skyes so// kha na brko 6ba la'o zhes pa la pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyor ba las/byings mtha'i a brjod don/ gnyis brjod/ sngon ma'i ha sa dang po lhag po/ku ha zhes pas/ kha tsha/ kha pa sogs kyis tsha tsar bsgyur ba sogs kyis/ tsa khā na/ tsa lda tuḥ tsa lduḥ tsa kha ni tha/ tsa spru tha/ tsa khaṃ tha/ tsa tna thuḥtsa nda/ tsa khā na/ tsa kha na/ tsa bhi ba/ tsa spru ma/ kyu baṃ tsa khā na pūrta mod / khron pa 'dru'o khron pa mkhan gyis/ sa/ ghaslo za ba la'o zhes pa la pa ra smi pa da rnams sbyor ba las/ gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ dza ghā sa / gnyis tshig la de dang 'dra ba la u pa dhā phyis/ kha sa zhes pas ghragha kar bsgyur bas/ dza krasra/ a tusra zhes gnas pa la/ — / gha sā de saḥṣaḥ110—218

gha ①sa sogs kyi sa'i ṣa'o/ /byengs ghasra la sogs pa rnams kyi mtha'i sra yig ni gra du yig tu 'gyur te/ sra dza/ kra dza 'dus pa kṣa sogs kyis/ dzakṣa tuḥdzakyuḥ de bzhin du lhag ma rnams la/ dzakṣi tha / dza gha si tha/ dza ghasba/dzakṣa thuḥ dzakṣa/ dza ghā sa/ dza gha sa/ dzas ba/ dzasti ma/ 4/ che dānyu sbyin pa la'o zhes pa la/ ṇapra gnyis brjod thung ngu'os thung ngur bsgyur bas/ da dā/ ṇapra ces gnas pa la/ 4 / ā to ṇaṇḍa/ ātpa las ṇapra ḍo'o/ /byings ā ring mtha' las pha rol gyi ṇapra ni ḍo ru 'gyur te/ṇapra ḍo ḍita la ṭi phyis/ ḍa de'i don/ da do/ gnyis tshig la/ da dā/a tu sa zhes gnas pa la/ sa/ ā tolhan pi/ ātu kyi thu.apra med pa la'o/ /byings ā ring mtha' can apra bi kā ra ṇa'i rkyen med pa ni kra dra 'go ba'i ming can dbyangs dang po can pha rol la dbyi bar bya ste/ ā phyis pas da da tuḥde bzhin du bsgrubs pas lhag ma rnams la/ da duḥ/ da rda 1tha/ da de tha/da dā tha/ da da thuḥ/ da da/ da do/ da di ba/ da di ma/ de bzhin du pā btung ba la'o zhes pa la/ pa po/ pa pa tuḥ pa puḥ pa pi tha/pa pe tha/ pa pā tha/ pa pa thuḥ pa pa/ pa po/ pa pi ba/ pa pi ma/ ྈ/ ṣṭha 'go ba las ldog pa la'o zhes pa la/ ṇapra/ gnyis brjod/thung ngu 'os/ thung ngur bsgyur bas/ sba sthā/ ṇapra ces gnas pa la/ —/ na sha sā phyopaḥ sha sa'i ma yin te 3kha pa'o/ /byings gnyis su brjod pa'i ha sa dang po de lhag por gnas par bshad pa las gnyis brjod pa'i dang po'i yi ge de sha sa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge yin na kha pa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge pha rol la sha sa'i yi ge de lhag mar gnas pa ma yin pas/ kha pa'i yi ge de lhag mar gnas te/110—219

pa rasmi pa da'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig ṇapra sbyar gnyis kyang ngos gnyis brjod / sngon ma'i ha sa dang po lhag po'os/ dzra 1gong ma phyis pas/ ya yadzra / ṇapra ces gnas pa la/ 1 ṇa bā do pūrba gya/ ṇapra sogs la dang po'i 'o/ /ṇapra la sogs pa pha rol la byengs yadza la sogs pa dang gra ha la sogs pa rnams gnyis brjod pa'i dang po de saṃ pra sā ra ṇa ste slar yang dag par bsgyur bar 'gyur te/ ya dbyangs bcas idra 2bsgyur bas/ i yā dza/gnyis tshig la'ang de bzhin du bsgyur bsra/ i yadzra/ a tusra zhes gnas pa la / ya rdzu ya ba ra rde z-itaḥsaṃ pra mā ra rde ki ti/ ka 'gro ba la ya dza 1rnams kyi ya ba ra rnams i u ṛtpa rnams su slar yang dag par bsgyur ba'o/ /ṇapra la sogs pa kra 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la byings/ yadzra/ btsu/ swapra/ benyu/byenyu / hwa nyu/ bapra/ bdu/ bsra rnams kyi ya ba ra rnams ni gnyis brjod pa'i dang por ma zad gnyis pa'ang rim pa ltar i u ṛ rnams su 'gyur la/de la saṃ pra sā ra ṇa ste slar yang dag par bsgyur ba zhes bya zhing / spyir slar yang dag par bsgyur ba de yang ra sogs gsal byed kho na mi 'gyur bar dbyangs bcas bsgyur ba yin la/ dbyangs de yang thung ngu yin na i sogs thung ngu dang ring po yin na ring por bsgyur bar bya ba yin te/ ya phyi ma yang i/ 'dra ba'i yi ge 'dus pa sogs kyis/ yī dza tuḥ de gnyis dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas / yī dzuḥ/ yī dzi tha/ i ya dzi tha/ i yaṣṭha/ yī dza thuḥ khra dza/i yā dza/ i ya dza/ yī dzi ba/ yī dzi ma/ de bzhin du bsgrubs pas yi nee pa da rnams la/ spyi dze/ yī dzā te/ āo dzi re/ yī dzi ṣe/ khyu dzā the/yī dzi bye/ āo dze/ yī dzi ba he/ yī dzi ma he/110—221

1 btsu yongs su brjod pa la yang pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyor ba las cho ga de dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ u bā tsa/ spru lhatsa tuḥ spru tsuḥ u ba tsi tha—/ spru tsi tha/ u bsgra ge// spru tsa thuḥ khru tsa/ u bā tsa/ u ba tsa/spru tsi ba/ u tsi ma/ 4/ byu degasal bar brjod pa la'o zhes pa la bdag don dang gzhan don gnyis ka sbyor ba las/ —/ byunyo ba tsi/ byunyu'i ④btsa'o/ /byings 6khya ni lkog gyur gyi rnam dbye dang gzhan yang apra bi kā ra ṇa med pa'i rkyen mang po la ba tsa zhes par 'gyur te/ byu btsur bsgyur bas pa rasmi pa da dgu po bsgrubs gzugs snga ma dang 'dra bas/ u bā tsa/ spru tsa tuḥ sogs dang ātma ne pa da rnams la/ u tse/ spru tsā te/ khru tsi reye/ u tsi ṣe/ u tsā the/ u tsi bye/ u tse/ spru tsi ba he/ u tsi ma he/1 de bzhin du nyi ṣa pa nyal ba la'o zhes pa la'ang pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar bas/ su ṭī pa/ su 6 pa tuḥ su 6 puḥ/ su ṣa pi tha/ su 6 pi tha/su ṣṭabee/ su 6 pa thuḥ su 6 pa/ su ṭī pa/ su ṣa pa/ su 6 pi ba/su 6 pi ma/ nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ su ṭī pa su khaṃ sa kha/ bde bar nyol zhig grogs ngo// sa/ a shudra khyab par byed pa la'o zhes pa'i byings la ātma nee pa da rnams sbyor te byings mtha'i da de'i don u brjod don/ e sbyar bas/ ashra e zhes gnas pa la/ —/ nu ga shaṃ/ ashra rnams la nuka'obyu/ /byings a shung gi rjes 'brel phyis pa'i ashra gyel sogs pa rnams la shog gyur gyi rnam dbye rnams pha rol las byings gnyis brjod pa'i dang po de la nukra ā ga ma ster bar bya ste/ gnyis 110—222

kyang ngos gnyis brjod/ sngon ma'i ha sa dang po lhag po'os/ /shra gong ma phyis/ṇapra sogs la khyu a dag gi ā 'os/ a gong ma ring por bsgyur de la nukra ā ga ma byin/ kra gnas don/ u brjod don/ nyer bsgyur bi dang āng sngon du bzhag de mtshams sbyor ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ byā na she17/ de bzhin du bsgrubs pas lhag ma rnams la/ byu na shā te/ byā na shi re/ byā na shi ṣe/byu na shā je/ byā na shi bye/ byā na she/ byā na shi ba he/ byā na shi ma te/ nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ byā na she bi shaṃ bha ga bān/ sna tshogs rnams la khyab byed bcom ldan no/ /añdzu gsal ba dang mig sman dang mdzes pa dang 'gro ba rnams la'o zhes pa la bdag don dang gzhan don gnyis ka 'jug pa la/ nukra ster ba sogs cho ga thams cad snga ma dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ pa ramee pa da rnams la / ā rgo dza/ ā rgo dza tuḥ ā rna dzuḥ ā dzee dzi tha/ ā rgo dza thuḥ.ā rna dza/ ā rgo dza/ ā rgo dzi ba/ ā rna dzi ma/ ātma nee pa da rnams la/ā rgo dze/ ā rgo dzā te/ ā rgo dzi re/ ā rgo dzi ṣe/ ā rgo dzā the/ ā rna dzi bye / ā rgo dze/ ā — dzi ba he/ ā rgo dzi ma te/ nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ ā rgo bsti bhā kadzdza le na kā tsitpa/ kha cig mig sman gyis mig la byugs so/ / —/ de bzhin du asngo mchod pa byed pa la'ang bdag don dang gzhan don gnyis ka 'jug /byings mtha'i a de'i don/ nukra ster ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas pa rasmi pa da rnams la/ ā nartsa/ ā nartsa tuḥ ā nartsuḥ/ā nartsi tha/ ā nadzre/ ā nartsa thuḥ ā nartsa/ ā nartsa/ ā nartsi ba/ā nartsi ma/ ātma ne pa da rnams la/ ā nartse/ ā nartswate/ ā nartsi re/ā nartsi ṣe/ ā nartswa ze/ ā nartsi bye5/ ā nartselce/ ā nartsi ba he/110—223

ā nartsi ma he kye / sa/ tsitra nyagasog pa la'o zhes pa la pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyor ba las/rkyen sa dang lkog gyur gyi rnam dbye pha rol la byings tsinyu ni yang na ki ru bsgyur bar bshad de/ ki dang tsi 'dam kha can du byas ki ru bsgyur ba'i phyogs la nyer bsgyur nidra sngon du bzhag /de nas 'phel ba yon tan iphra sogs so so'i thob ltar bsgrubs pas/ ni— kā ya/ nishyi kya tuḥ nishyi kyuḥ nishyi ka yi tha/nibyu ke tha/ nishyi kya thuḥ nishyi kya/ nibyu kā ya / nishyi ka ya/ nishyi kyi ba/nishyi kyi ma/ ki ru ma bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ tsi tsā ya/ tsi tsu tuḥ sogs dang / nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ nishyi kā ya tsi re rā dzā/ ring du gnas par gyur cig rgyal po/ grahu nye bar len pa la'ang 4pa rasmi pa da rnams spyor ba las/gnyis brjod/ ku ha dag gi tsu/ ka 'gro ba sogs kyi saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ dza grwa ha/ dza kṛ ha tuḥ dza kṛ huḥ dza kṛ hi tha / dza gra hi tha/ dza kṛ ha thuḥ dza kṛ ha/ dza gā ha/ dza gra ha/ dza kṛ hi ba/ dza kṛ hi ma/ byenyu gnon pa la'o zhes pa la bdag don dang gzhan don gnyis ka 'jug pa las/ nyer bsgyur sam sngon du bzhag /ṇa 5dang pra 'gro ba rnams la/ ṇapra sogs la dang po'i 'os/ gnyis brjod pa'i dang po saṃ pra sā ra ṇa dang / ka 'gro ba'i ming can rnams la/ ka 'gro ba sogs kyis gnyis ka saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ pa ramee pa da rnams la/ saṃ bi byā thuya/ saṃ bi bya tuḥ saṃ bi byuḥ/ saṃ bi bya yi tha/ saṃ bi byi tha/ saṃ bi bye tha/ saṃ bi bya thuḥ saṃ bi bya/ saṃ bi byā ya/ saṃ bi bya ya/saṃ bi byi ba/ saṃ bi byi ma/ ātma nee pa da rnams la/ saṃ bi bye/ saṃ bi byā te/110—224

saṃ bi byi re/ saṃ bi byi ṣe/ saṃ bi byā hūṃthe/ saṃ bi byi bye/ saṃ bi bye/ saṃ bi byi ba he/ saṃ bi byi ma te/ nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ saṃ bi byā rnguya swā dzñā rgo su snyoḥ——legs par shes pas gnon par byed do rang mi shes pa rnams/ —/ bee2 thags 'thag pa la'o zhes pa la pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyor ba las skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig la/ bee/ ṇapra bye ces gnas pa la/ 1 bee nyo ba ya na pi/ apra med pa la be2'i baphra'o/ /byings beenyu ni apra bi kā ra ṇa med pa'i rkyen pha rol la balnga zhes par 'gyur te/ be balnga ru bsgyur gnyis brjod/ sngon ma'i ha sa dang po lhag po'os/ phra gong ma phyis/ ṇapra sogs la dang po'i 'os pa u/ u pa dhā 'phel ba sogs kyis/ u bā ya/ gnyis tshig la gzhan de dang 'dra ba las ka 'gro ba sogs kyis ba gnyis ka ur bsgyur bas/ khru ya tuḥ—/ de bzhin du lhag ma rnams la/ spru yuḥ/ u ba yi tha/ u yi tha/spru ya thuḥ spru ya/ u bā ya/ u ba ya/ spru yi ba/ u yi ma/1 bya dha rdung ba la'o zhes pa la'ang pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyor ba las rkyen kyi thob kyi ya dang po dang gnyis ka idra bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ bi byu dha/ bi bi dha tuḥ bi bi dhuḥ/ bi bi bye tha/ bi bya bye tha/ bi bi dha thuḥ bi byā dha④/ bi bya dha/ bi bi dhi ba/ bi bi dhi ma/1 pradzdza 3shes par 'dod pa la'o zhes pa la'ang ba rasmi pa da rnams sbyor ba las/ pradzdza rngu / ṇapra ces gnas pa la/ —/ saṃ yo gānda )ki twa/ yang dag par sbyor ba'i mtha' las kitpa ma yin no/ /yang dag par sbyor ba ste byings mtha' yi ge brtsegs rngu pa las pha rol gyi sgog gyur gyi rkyen rnams ni ka 'go ba'i ming can ma yin zhing / slar yang dag par bsgyur ba dang / 'phel ba dang /110—225

tā ro/ tā rasra/ tā si/ tāsrusralha / tāsba/ tāsmi/ tāsbasra/ tāsmasra/sa / tā/ tā ro/ tā rasra/ tā se/ tā sā the/ tā bye/ tā te/ tāsba te/tāsma rnguhe rnams so/ /byings las de ring ma yin pa'i 'byung 'gyur gyi don la tā la sogs pa'i rnam dbye 'di rnams 'jug la 'byung 'gyur de yang dus ring po ma yin pa'i nye bar 'byung ba la 'jug pa shas che ste/ pā ṇi pa'i lugs la luṭa zhes zer ro/ / —/ si sa tā sī su pā miṭu/ se sa tā sī supra rnams la iṭu'o/ /rkyen si dang 'dod pa'i don gyi sa dang / rnam dbye tā sogs dang / smon pa'i don gyi sīṣṭa sogs dang / rkyen supra rnams la iṭa ā ga ma ster bar bya ste/ byu yod pa la tā sogs sbyar/ iṭu ā ga ma byin/ yon tan sogs kyis bsgrubs pas / bha bi tā/ bha bi tā ro/ bha bi tā raḥsogs te/ nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ sho bha bi tā rā dzu bhā raḥku mā ra gya/— gzhon nu nang bar rgyal srid la 'jog pa/ra 'gyur ro/ /che ba tsagra 'tshed pa la tā sbyar bas/ patsu tā zhes gnas pa la/nai ka swa rā nu dāṭwātpa/ dbyangs gcig pa la a nu dātta las ma yin no/ /byings dbyangs gcig pa dbyangs de yang a nu dātta ste skad gsangs dma' bar 'don pa las pha rol kyi rnam dbye tā la sogs pa la iṭu ā ga ma ster ba snyem yin te / iṭā mi 'jug /tsu'i ku'os tsa kar bsgyur bas/ baghā/ de bzhin du/pastu 'uro/ paghā raḥsogs so/ /che dānyu sbyin pa la'o zhes pa la/ dā tā/dātāro / dā tā raḥsogs dang / bā btung ba la/ pā tā/ pā tā ro/ pā tā raḥsogs so/ /ci gsog pa la'o zhes pa la pra 'gro ba sogs kyis byengs la yon tan byas pas/ tse tā/ tse tā ro/ tse tā raḥsogs dang / de bzhin 110—230

du bhāṣyo thob pa la/ nee tā/ nee tā ro/ nee tā raḥsogs dang / hu sbyin pa la/ho tā/ ho tā rocho / ho tā raḥsogs dang / che kṛ2 byed pa la/ karta/kartu ro du / karta raḥsogs dang / z-inyu 'phrog pa la/ harta/ harta — ro/harta raḥsogs so ④/ /yā thob phye pa la/ yā tā/ yā tā robye / /yā tā raḥsogs dang / gaslo 4'gro ba la/ ge tā/ gi tā ro/ shaṃ tā raḥsogs so/ /i ti swa ra swaste byā ka ra ṇa su sru tātshwasta neenee pra tyā ya pra kri ya sa mābhāḥ/ zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las de ring ma yin pa'i 'byung 'gyur gyi don gyi rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa rnams rdzogs so// // sa/ de nas 'byung 'gyur dus ring ba'i don gyi rnam dbye rnams kyi bya ba rnams brjod par bya ste/ 1 tyā do bha bi6 tisupra/ ti sogs la 'byung 'gyur la lyapra'o/ /byengs la 'byung 'gyur kyi don brjod pa las rnam dbye ti la sogs pa bco brgyad po la supra 9bar rkyen du 'gyur la 'byung 'gyur de yang ma 'ongs pa dus ring po la 'jug pa shas che zhing supra kyi pra yig ni byings la yon tan 'byung ba'i don te/ pā skyeṇi pa'i lugs la mṛṭu zer ro/ /des na byings byu yod pa la ti sogs supra dang bcas pa sbyar/ si sa tā sī lyapra rnams la iṭā 'os/iṭa ā ga ma byin/ byings yon tan ku i la sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ bha bi byu ti/ bha bi gyitaḥ bha bi 6rnyi/ bha bi 6 si/ bha bi 6 thaḥ bha bi rngu 6 tha/bha bi ṭwāṃ mi phya/ bha bi byā baḥ bha bi byā maḥ1 yadzra ⑫lha mchod pa la/ gya ti sogs sbyar/ tsha sha ṣa ra dza sogs kyis dza ṣar bsgyur bas/ yaṣa/ su ti zhes gnas pa la/ 1 ṣa snye nyu— kaḥse/110—231

'jug ste/ byings mtha'i a swa ri ta ①ste de'i don/ tsu'i ku'os/ dzra gar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ sgokṣu ti/ bho ④khyu taḥ bho ghrarnyi sogs dang / sgokhyu te/ bhogye ⑦ te/ sgoghradhe sogs so/ /i ti swa ra swaste byu ka ra ṇa su sru tāpta bi 6rnyipra tyā ya su pra kri ya sa mābhāḥ zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can kyi mdo las 'byung 'gyur gyi rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa rnams rdzogs so// // 1 de nas bya ba shor ba'am ma 'dzom pa'i don gyi rnam dbye rnams kyi cho ga rnams bshad par bya ste/ 1 supa ④kri yā ti kra me/ bya ba shor ba la myapra'o/ /bya ba shor ba ste dus la ma khel ba'am rgyu tshogs ma 'dzom pa dang / bya ba ma rdzogs par 'phro lus pa dang / bya ba zin ma thag pa'i grub zin gsar ba rnams kyi bya ba'i don la rnam dbye dipra la sogs pa bco brgyad po 'jug cing bar rkyen supra kyang sbyin par bya ste/ pā ṇi pa'i lugs la mṛdra zhes zer ro/ /de lta na khyu yod pa la/ dipra⑤/ bar rkyen myapra/ dipra sogs la aṭa/ se sa tā sī srupra rnams la iṭa bu 'os/ iṭu ā ga ma yon tan sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/a bha bi6tpa sde/ de bzhin du lhag ④ma rnams la/ a bha bi6 tt+waṃ/ a bha bi 6na / a bha bi 6ཿ a bha bi 6 tai/ a bha bi 6 ta/ a bha bi ṣyo/ a bha bi tyā ba/ a bha bi byā ma/ nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ gang du char babs shing rgyal po bde bar gyur/snyeyā dā su bṛṣṭiḥsu rā rdzu tsā bha bi byutpa/snyegrub zin gsar ba'i dpe/de dag tu slong mo bzang po thab par 'gyur/——ta dā su nyi kṣa ma/snyebya ba ma rdzogs pa'i dpe/ bha bi 6tpa/ —/ de bzhin du judzra skyong ba dang za ba la/ a bho kṣutpa⑨/ a sgokhyu tt+waṃ/a bhokṣun ⑩sogs so/ /110—234

1 gaslo 'go ba ①la a ga mi 6tu ④/ a ga mi 6 tt+waṃ/ a ga mi 6na sogs te byings de gnyis nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ 'ongs so grub zin gsar ba dang zas bya bas rdzogs pa/—a bhokhyu rnya bārya rya ga mi 6tpa/—gang dzad ni zas la 'ongs so/ /— / che pa tsagra 1'tshed pa la/ a bakṣutpa/ a ba khyu tt+waṃ/ a ④baghran sogs dang / sa/ dzwa la 'bar ba la nyer bsgyur pra sngon du bzhag pas/ shādzwa le gyitpa⑤ske/ pā dzwa li 6 tt+waṃ bu/ pā dzwa li 6na ⑨sogs te byings de gnyis nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ a paghradzha bārya rya sniḥpā dzwa li6tpa/—zla kyis tshos shig gang du me rab tu 'bar ro / 1 han 'tshe rmyeb la/ han ṛ ta las srapa la'os/ iṭu lge/byin pas/a ha ni 6tpa/ a ha ni byu tt+waṃ/ a ha ni 6na sogs dang / sa/ sha kṛ nus pa la/a shaghratpa/ a sha ghra tt+waṃ/ a sha ghran sogs te byings de gnyis nye ba'i tshig shā bhe dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ a ha ni 6dzha bārya rya pyashaghratpa/——o rang nus pa ji tsam pa ྾sa shig/sogs te rnam dbye'i ngo bo dipra sogs dang rkyen supra a ⑫yig mtha' can yin pas apra bi kā ra ṇa sogs kyi rigs 'gre bas cho ga rnams rtogs bee'o⑫/ /i ti swa ra swaste byā ka ra ṇa su sru tāṅgi yā ti kra ma gya pra tyā ya pra kri /(ziya sa mābhāḥ/zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las bya ba shor ba'i rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa rnams rdzogs so// // 1 de nas 'das pa'am sngon byung ba'i rkyen kyi rnam dbye rnams bshad par bya ste/ sa/ bhū te si/ byung zin pa la si'o/ /byings las 'das pa'am byung zin tsam gyi don brjod pa la ⑫dipra sogs rnam dbye bco brgyad bo 'gyur zhing 710—235

bar rkyen si yang sbyin par bya la byung zin de yang 'das nas dus yun ring song ba la 'jug pa shas che ste/ 1 bhū yod pa la rnam dbye dipra bar rkyen si/ i brjod don/ dipra sogs la aṭa byin pas/ a byusra du ces gnas pa la/ 1 dā de pe/ pa la dā la sogs pa las so/ /pa ste rnam dbye pa rasmi pa da rnams pha rol la byengs dā/ dhā/ sthā/ isro/ bhū/ pā ①rnams las pha rol gyi si ni 3dbyi bar bya ste/ si phyis pas a bhātpazhu/ de bzhin du gnyis tshig la/a bhū tt+waṃ④/ mang tshig la/ a byusra/ an phyezhes gnas pa la/ pa la dā la sogs pa las sos/ si phyis/ rnam dbye dbyangs thog ma can pha rol si phyis pa las byu la bukra ā pya ga ma ster bar bshad pas/ bukra byin ka gnas don/u brjod don/ a bhū ban/ de rnams dang 'dra bar bsgrubs pas/ a khyuḥ.a bhū tt+waṃ/ a byu ta/ a bhū baṃ/ a byu ba/ a byu ma/ nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ a khyudṛṭaṃ3ཿ—sngonachar bab/ che dā2 sbyin pa la'ang de bzhin du bsgrubs pas skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig la/ a dātpa/a dā tt+waṃ/ mang tshig la/ a dāsra/ an zhes gnas pa la/ si phyis/ —/ sthā bi da5ཿ si la ā shyidang bid las so/ /rkyen si phyis pa la byings ā ring mtha' can dang byings bid las pha rol gyi rnam dbye an ni usra zhes par 'gyur te/ an usra su bsgyur/— / u myu lo paḥ us la ā dbyi'o/ /an bsgyur ba'i us pha rol la byings mtha'i ā ring ni dbyi bar bya ste/ ā phyis pas/ a duḥ lhag ma rnams la/ a dāḥ a dā taipya / a dā ta/ a dzā/ a dā ba/ a dā ma/de bzhin du che dhā2 'dzin pa la/ a dhātpa/ a dhā tt+waṃ/ a dhuḥ 1tre a dhāḥ110—236

bsgrubs pas/ a dhu kṣatpa/ de bzhin du/ a dhukṣa tt+waṃ/ a dhukṣan sogs so/ / 4/ li hā ro myang ba la'ang sngon ma ltar bsgrubs pas/ a li kṣatpa/a li kṣa tt+waṃ/ a likṣan sogs so/ / sa/ bishu 'jug pa la/ a bikṣatpa/ a bikṣa tt+waṃ/ a bikṣan sogs dang / —/ kṛṣa 'gugs pa'am gshor gtod pa la / a kṛkṣatpa/ a kṛkṣa tt+waṃ/ a kṛkṣan sogs so/ /i ti swa ra swa ste byā ka ra ṇa lya sru tā dhū ta pra tyā ya pra kri ya sa mābhāḥ / zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las byung zin gyi rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa rnams sdogs so// // sa/ de nas dngos po dang las kyi don sogs kyi rnam dbye 'jug tshul rnams rab tu brjod par bya ste/ sngar bshad zin gyi dngos po dang las kyi don gyi 'jug tshul dang cho ga rnams ni byings thams cad pa rnams kyi cho ga yin la/'dir byings phyed pa rnams kyi dngos po dang las kyi 'jug tshul te/ de yang gong byings thams cad pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar 'dir yang ātma dza pa da rnams 'jug pa las/ nyer bsgyur a nu sngon ma'i bhū yod pa nal/ shog gyur liṭa'i ātma 4nee pa da rnams sbyar/ gnyis kyang ngos gnyis brjod/ ṇapra sogs la byu a dag gi ā 'os/ spru ā/ thung ngu'os/ de thung ngu / dzha ba sogs dang / bhū la bu kra'os/ puka ā ga ma/ kṛ sogs las ṇapra sogs la'os/ ba sa dang po can la iṭa sbyor ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a nu ba bhū be/ a nu ba bhū bā te/ a nu ba bhū bi ri/ a nu ba bhū bi ṣe/ a nu ba byu bā the/ a nu ba byu bi bye/ a nu ba bhū bee/ a nu ba bhū bi ba he/ a nu ba byu ba ma he/ nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar 110—245

ba'i dpe ni/ su kha ma nu ba bhū ba de ba daste na/—lhas byin gyis bde ba rjes su myong bar gyur cig / ྈ/ che pa tsaṣa 'tshed pa la'ang gnyis brjod/ sngon ma'i ha sa dang po lhag po dang / patsu rnams kyi ka 'gro ba la dbyi ste a'i yang e'o sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ pe tse/ pe tsā te/ pe 2tsi re/ pe tsi ṣe/ pe tsā the/ pe tsi dhe/ pe tsa/ pe tsi ba te/ pe tsi ma te/ —/ de bzhin du ta nu yang ba la te rgo/ te nā te/ te ni re sogs dang / sa/ man la/ me nee/ me nā te/ me ni re sogs so/ / sa/ ḍū bānya sbyin pa la patsu sogs min pas a er bsgyur ba sogs mi byed pas/ da de/ da dā te/ da dī re sogs so/ /— / ṣṭha gtsang bar byed pa la/ saste/ sasthāte/ sasni re sogs te/ tshig grogs dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ baṃ pā sa ra si rā me ṇa yaskṛ tai shīta yā 5sa ha/ ya di dzā nā se ta twa 6da sasne haṃ sa bi lā sa yā/ padma'i mtsho la dga' byed dang / /gang du shī ta lhan cig rtse/ /gtsang byed gang dang gang yin pa/ /de der ngang pa rnam par rol /sa / mee dang dzre dga' ba zad pa la'ang mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge rnams kyi /ā'os e ā/ gnyis brjod thung ngu'os thung ngu dang / sngon ma'i ha sa dang po lhag po kuha dag gis tsu'o sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ dzagle/ dza glute /dzas re sogs dang / de bzhin du/ 1 masle/ masmra te/ mambi re sogs so/ /byings dbyangs kyi mtha' can rnams dang han dang grahra dang dṛ sha la sogs pa rnams la dngos po dang las kyi don la/ si sa tā sbo/ supra rnams iṭa dang bcas pa rnams ṇa 'gro ba'i ming can du byed pa dang mi byed pa 'dam ka can du 110—246

bshad de/ a nu sngon ma'i bhū la smon par byed pa'i rnam dbye sīṣṭa sogs sbyar iṭā byen ṇa 'gro ba'i phyogs la 'phel ba dang / ṇa 'gro ba ma yin pa'i phyogs la yon tan 'dam ka can du byas pas/ a nu bhā bi ṭīṣṭa/ a nu bhā bi ṣpe yā st+waṃ/a nu bhā biṭī ran sogs dang / a nu bha bi ṭīṣṭa/ a nu bha bi ṭī yā st+waṃ/ a nu bha bi ṣpe ran sogs te/ nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ su kha ma nu bhā bi ṭīṣṭa bha ba tā/ khyod kyi bde ba rjes su myong bar gyur cig / sa/ de bzhin du shīng nyal ba la/shā yi bhāṣṭa sogs dang sha yi ṣpeṣṭa sogs so/ /1 che kṛnya byed pa la/ kāri ṭīṣṭa sogs dang / ṇa 'gro ba ma yin pa'i phyogs la iṭā mi 'jug pas/ kṛ ṭīṣṭa sogs so/ / 1 de bzhin du/ a nu sngon ma'i byu la de ring ma yin pa'i rnam dbye tā sogs la'ang iṭu byin ṇa 'gro ba dang mi 'gro ba 'dam ka 2can du byas pas/a nu bhā bi tā/ a nu bhā bi tā ro/ a nu bhā bi tā ran/ a nu bhā bi tā se sogs sam/ a nu bha bi tā/ a nu bha bi tā ro/ a nu bha bi tā raḥ a nu bha bi tā se sogs so/ / —/ 'byung 'gyur gyi rnam dbye rnams la'ang yang na bar byas pas/ a nu bhā bi byu te sogs sam/ a nu bha bi6 te sogs so/ /de bzhin du bya ba shor ba'i don gyi rnam dbye lyapra dang bcas pa'i dipra sogs la'ang 'phel ba dang yon tan yang na bar byas pas/ a na bhā bi 6 ta/ a na bhā bi bye tt+waṃ/ a na bhā bi6 ta sogs sam/ a na bha bi gyi ta/ a na 4bha bi 6 tt+waṃ/ a na bha bi 6 ta sogs te/ nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ a na bhā bi 6 ta twa ya ta two ya rya rnge gyitpa/— rjes su zhugs shig gang du a de kho na nyid nyan pa la/110—247

byings ha sa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge dang po can la phul du byung ba dang yang yang gi don la byings byings su sgrub pa'i rkyen yang 'gyur zhing / rkyen yang pha rol la byings de'ang gnyis su 'gyur te/ bhū la yadra nga ātma na 1pa da spyor ba'i don/gnyis brjod/ dzha ba rnams kyi dza ba dang tsa ba 'os/ bhrabra/ byu bhū ya zhes gnas pa la/ sa/ ya ji / yadra la'o/ /byings kyi dang po nā mi'i 2dbyangs ni rkyen yang pha rol la yon tan du 'gyur te/ yon tan byas pas/ bo bhū ya/ —/ sadhā tuḥde byings so/ /yang la sogs pa'i rkyen sbyar ba de la'ang byings zhes zer ro/ /des na byings de tshig tu bsgrub napa'i phyir rnam dbye rnams sbyor ba las/ apra bi ka ra ṇa spyor ba sogs gong ltar bsgrubs pas/brta ma na laṭa la/ bo bhū ya te/ bo bhū ye te/ bo bhū yadhe sogs dang / chog 'byung ling la/ bo bhū ye ta/ bo bhū ye yā tt+waṃ/ bo bhū ye ran sogs dang /shis byed loṭa la/ bo bhū ya tt+waṃ/ bo byu ye tt+waṃ/ bo bhū yadzñā sogs dang / de ring ma yin pa lang la/ a bo bhū ya ta/ a bo byu ye tt+waṃ/ a bo bhū yanta sogs so/ /de bzhin du bhudzra skyong ba la—/ bo bhu bye te/ laṭa/ bo bhu dzre ta / —ling/ bo bhu bye tt+waṃ/ 'oṭa/ a bo byu dzu ta 'angasogs so/ / ྈ/ byuṣa rgyan la/ bo byu 6 te/ laṭa/ bo bhu bye ta/ ling/ bo bhū 6 tt+waṃ / —loṭa/ yid bo ra gyi ta lang/sogs so/ / ྈ/ mu ha sems nyams pa la/ mo mu hya te/ laṭa/ mo mu bye ta/ leng/ mo mu hya tt+waṃ/ loṭa/ a mo mu hya ta langasogs so/ / ྈ/ li ha ro myang ba la/ le li hya te/ laṭa/ le li bye ta/ lang/ le li hya tt+waṃ / loṭa/ a le li hya ta langasogs so/ /170—251

sa / hu sbyin pa la/ dzo hu ya te/snyelaṭa/ dzo hu yeta/—ling/ dzo hu ya tt+waṃ / — loṭa/ phyag jo hu ya ta langasogs so/ / sa/ bid shes pa la/ bee bi rya te/—laṭa/ be 1bi bye ta/——ling/ bee bi rya tt+waṃ / loṭa/ a bee bi rya ta yangasogs so/ / —/ che pa tsaṣpe 'tshed pa la yang gnyis brjod/ sngon ma'i ha sa dang po lhag po/ —/ ā taḥ ātpa'o/ /byings gnyis brjod pa'i dang po'i dbyangs a thung ni rkyen yang pha rol la ring por 'gyur te/ pa gong ma ring por bsgyur bas/pā pa ༄ te/ laṭa/ nga/ pa dre ta/ ling/ nga/ pa 4) tt+waṃ/ 'oṭa/ phyag pā ba 4 ta ngang sogs so/ / sa/ de bzhin du paṭha gsal bar brjod pa la/ pā pa ṣṭha te/ la ṭa/ pā ba bye ta/ ling/ pā brgya tt+waṃ/ loṭa/ phyag pa/ bye 5ta langasogs so/ /sa / byings dbyangs dang po can la'ang / aṭa/ a sha /spruwunywa/ṛ 6sogs la yadra 'jug par bshad de/ 4 / aṭu 'gro ba la yadra gnyis brjod pas / aṭā aṭā ya zhes gnas pa la/ — / swa rā deḥpa raḥdabyangs dang po'i pha rol lo/ /rkyen yang sogs pha rol la byings kyi dang po dbyangs rkyang pa yin na gnyis brjod pa'i gsal byed de yang mi dbyi zhing dbyangs dang po de las pha rol gyi dbyangs phyi ma de slar yang gnyis su 'gyur te/ a phyi ma slar yang gnyis brjod / 'dra ba'i yi ge 'dus pa la ring po sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ a ṭā 7ṭu te/ laṭa/ phyag ṭābyeta/ ling/ yid ṭā rgya tt+waṃ/ loṭa/ stos ṭā rgya ta lang sogs te7/ nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ a ṭā rgya te j-i byeṣṭaḥ——phul du byung ba'i ci brtol/110—252

tsa bhā ska rya tt+waṃ/ —loṭa/ a tsa nī ska rya ta langasogs so/ / sa/ tsar g.yo ba la yang sbyar/ gnyis brjod/ sngon ma'i ha sa dang bo lhag po sogs kyis/ tsa tsadra/ ya zhes gnas pa la/ tsa ra pa lo 1 rudzñā mya/tsa ra pa 2la dag gi a'i yang uta'o/ /byings tsa ra dang pha la dag gi yang pha rol las byings gnyis brjod pa'i dang po la nukra ā ga ma 'gyur zhing mtha' ma'i a yig kyang u yig tu 'gyur te/ nuka byin/ a ur bsgyur bas/ rtsa tsurya te / la ṭa/ rtsa tsurle ta/ leng/ rtsa tsurya tt+waṃ/ 'oṭa/ a rtsa tsurya ta langasogs dang / sa/ de bzhin du pha la rdzogs pa la/ paṃ phu lya te/ 'aṭa/ paṃ phu bye ta4/ leng /paṃ phu bye tt+waṃ5/ loṭa/ a paṃ phu lya ta 'angasogs so/ / sa/ ḍū kṛ2 byed pa la yang sbyar bas/ kṛ ya zhes gnas pas6/ 4 / ṛ to riḥ ṛ ta kyi ri'o/ /byings ṛ yig mtha' can ni yang pha rol la ri ru 'gyur te / ṛ ri gnyis brjod sngon ma'i ha sa dang po lhag po/ ku ha dag gi tsu/yang la 'os yon tan/ ya la'os phyi ma ring por bsgyur bas/ tse bī ya te/ laṭa/tse skru ye ta/ ling/ tse shā ya tt+waṃ/ loṭa/ yin tse shrī ya ta ngangasogs te/ yin ti sha ye na ka ro tī ti 'di phul du byung bar byed do zhes pa'i don la/ tse shrī ya te/ 'di phul du byung bar byed do/ /sa / de bzhin du z-inywa 'phrog 7 pa la/ dze dī ya te/ laṭa/ dze sthā ye ta / leng / dze dī ya tt+waṃ/ —loṭa/ a dze twe ya ta langasogs dang / thranywa mchog gyur la/be rdo/ kyang te/ laṭa/ bee rdo/ sku/ ta/ ling / bee rdo/ sa tt+waṃ/ loṭa/ yi/ nge rdo/ pa/ ta lang sogs te/ a ti sha ye na bṛ no tī ti 'di phul du byung bar gang ba'am shin tu gang ba'o zhes pa'i don la/ bee dzrī ya te/ 'di phul du byung bar gang ba'am shin tu gang ba'o/ /110—256

1 mṛng srog gtong ba la/ me sī ya te/ —laṭa/ me sī ye ta/—ling/ medmāya tt+waṃ / loṭa/ a me smyu ya ta langasogs te/ a ti sha ye na mri kyeya te shin tu shi ba'o zhes pa'i don la/ me sī ya te/—shin tu shi ba'o/ /— / che dā hra sbyin pa la yang / dā sogs kyi i'os ā i gnyis brjod/ yang la 'os yon tan/ ya la'os phyi ma ring por bsgyur bas/ de dī ya te/ laṭa/de dī ye ta / ling/ de dī ya tt+waṃ/ loṭa/ yid de dī ya ta/ lang / —/ de bzhin du pā btung ba la/ pe dzī ya te/ laṭa/ pedzī ye ta/ ling/ pe rpā ya tt+waṃ/ loṭa/ a pe dzī ya ta langasogs so/ /i ti swa ra swa sti byā ka ra ṇa su sru tā rya dma tyā ya bra kri ya sa mābhāḥ/ zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las yadra rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa rnams rdzogs so // // sa/ de nas yang rkyen 'jig pa rnams kyi bya ba rnams bshad par bya ste/ —/bā n+ya tpa lu ga nu brta te/ gzhan la 'jig pra —yang na rjes su 'jug go/ /kṛtpa sogs kyi rkyen ukra dang sbyor ba ma yin pa'i gzhan la yang na 5yadra 'jig pra'i 6cho ga rjes su 'jug go/ / sa/ a na bi tsa 7ha sā tro / a pra med pa'i ha sa las kyang ngo / /yang 'jig pa'i cho ga de byings gang la'ang a pra bi kā ra ṇa med pa byings mtha' ha sa'i mtha' can yin pa de las 'jug ste/ byudzra skyong ba la phrang gnyis brjod/dzha pa sogs kyi bha ba/ sngon ma'i ha sa dang po lhag po/ yang la'os yon tan/yang 'jig /yang 'jig pa la byings thams cad pa'i rnam dbye pa rasmi pa da rnams 'jug pa las/ brta ma na'i skyes bu dang po'i gcig tshig tipra sbyar bas/110—257

sa/ de ring ma yin pa lang la/ sa ma dzā gha ṭītu/ sa ma dzā ghaṭā/ sa ma dzā ghaṭaṃ/ sa ma dzā gha ṭuḥ/ sa ma dzā ghaṭīḥ sa ma dzā ghaṭa/ sa ma dzā ghasgo/sa ma dzā ghaṣṭa/ sa ma dzā gha ṭaṃ/ sa ma dzā ghaṭī/ sa ma dzā gharja sogs te/a ti sha ye na gha ṭa te phuladubyung ba'i zhes pa'i don la/ saṃ dzā gha ṭī ti/ rtsed mo byed/sa / nyer bsgyur phroṃ 1sngon ma'i byu 3yod pa las kyang brta ma na phraṭa la/saṃ bo bha bī bha/ saṃ bo sgo ti/ saṃ bo bhū taḥ saṃ bo byu ba ti/ saṃ bo bha bī ṣi/saṃ bo bho ṣi/ saṃ bo bhū thaḥ saṃ bo bhū tha/ saṃ bo bha bī mi/ saṃ bo bho mi/saṃ bo bhū baḥ saṃ bo bhū 4maḥ/ sa/ chog 5'byung ling la/ saṃ bo bhū yā tā6/ saṃ bo bhū yā tā/ saṃ bo byu yuḥsogs so/ /sa / shis byed loṭā 7la/ saṃ bo bha bī tu/ saṃ bo bho tu/ saṃ bo bhū tātpa8/saṃ bo byu tt+waṃ/ saṃ bo bhu ba tu/ saṃ bo byu hi/ saṃ bo khyu tātpa/ saṃ bo bhū tai/ saṃ bo byu ta / saṃ bo bha bā ni/ saṃ bo bha bā ba/ saṃ bo bha bā ma/ sa/ de ring ma yin pa lang la/ sa ma bo bha bītu/ sa ma bo bhotu/ sa ma bo byu tt+waṃ/ sa ma bo bha buḥ/ sa ma bo bha bīḥ sa ma bo sgoḥ sa ma bo bhū tai/sa ma bo byu ta/ sa ma bo bha baṃ/ sa ma bo byu ba/ sa ma bo bhū ma/ sa/ che kṛnyu byed pa la yadra / gnyis brjod/ kṛ kṛ ya zhes gnas pa la/yang 'jig /byings ṛ yig mtha' can dang ṛ yig u pa dhā can la yang 'jig pa las gnyis brjod pa'i dang po de la/ rukra te.ā ga ma dang rikra ā ga ma dang rī ā ( ga ma gsum po gang rung zhig 6ster bar bshad pas/ ā ga ma gsum po byin/ kra zhuganas don/ ru'i u brjod don yin pa'i phyis/ ku ha 110—260

kaḥsnyergya khra dang 'dra bar zlos ste bya rog go/ /zhes pa'i don la/ she na ya te kā kaḥ rgya khra dang 'dra bar sgom ste bya rog go/ /de bzhin du paṇḍi tā ya te mūbee mkhas par rlom ste blun po sogs so/ /rkyen yadra pha rol la ming mtha'i sa dbyi bar bshad de/ abee ras la yadra sra phyis ya la'os ring por bsgyur bas/ abee rā ya te ku rū pā/— chu byung mar tsham ste gzugs ngan ma/de bzhin du/ odzā ya te durba la/— shugs can du rlom ste stobs ngan/ khanywa/——byol por sgom ste gong ①po/snyeya te phaṅgaḥ bye pa yasra sogs kyi mtha'i sra yig ni yadra pha rol la dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba zhu'adam ka can du bshad pas pa yā ya tre ta kre/ —'o mar rlom ste dar ba'o—/ /——pa ya spru te ta kre sogs so/ / 1 rkyen gnyis pa ya'i 'jug tshul ni/ ā tsā re u pa mā nātra yaḥ nye bar 'jal ba'i kun tu spyod ④pa la ya'o/ /ming las nye bar 'jal ba'i rlom sems kyi kun tu spyod pa'i don la ya rkyen du 'gyur zhing ya pha rol la ming mtha'i a yang āo ru 'gyur te/ pu tra zhes pa'i ming la ya sbyar a yīr bsgyur bas/pu ṭī ya zhes 'grub pa la/ brta man sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyor ba las/a pra bi kā ra ṇa sbyor ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ pu tra mi ba ā tsa ra ti shi 6 mu ba dhyā ⑤ya zhes pa'i don la/snyemakhan pos slob ma bu dang 'dra bar kun nas spyod par byed/snyeputī ya ti shi byu mu pa dhyā ya sogs te de bzhin du/ bigruḥpra sād i ba ku bye bigruḥpra sā dī ya ti ku bye slong mo bar khang chung khang bzang du sgom mo sogs so/ / 1 rkyen gsum pa sa'i 'jug tshul ni/ itshwa ṣyoyā mātma naḥsaḥ bdag nyid 'dod pa la sa'o/ /byings la bdag nyid 'dod pa'i don las rkyen 'gyur te/ 1 bhū yod pa las/ sa las gnyis kyang ngos/ gnyis brjod/ thung ngu 'os de thung ngu / dzha ba sogs kyi bha ba bu byu ṣa zhes gnas pa la/ brta ma na 110—263

sogs pa rasmi pa da rnams sbyar/ /1 buḥse/ u ṛ'i sa la'o/ /gong du 'dod pa'i don gyi rkyen sa la iṭu ā ga ma stedra bar bshad kyang / de'i dmigs bsal byings u yig dang ṛ yig mtha' can dang gra ha dang gu ha sogs kyi pha rol gyis la iṭu ā ga ma ster ba ma yin te/ iṭā mi 'jug / —/ nā ni ṭi se/ sa iṭu med pa la ma yin no/ /rkyen sa iṭa ā ga ma med pa pha rol la byings la yon tan 'byung ba ma yin te/ yon tan mi byed pas/bu byu ṣa ti/ 'aṭa/ bu byu ṣeṭa/ ling/ bu bhū ṣa tu/ —loṭa/— bu bhū ṣa tātra/ lang/a bu bhū ṣatra sogs so/ / 1 de bzhin du tsiyi gsog 1pa las/ tsiyi'i tsa ka ru bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba 'dam ka can du byed pas/ gnyis brjod/ tsi ki sa'am/ tsi cis zhes gnas pa la/ sa / se dīrghaḥ sa la ring po'o/ /'dod pa'i don gyi rkyen sa pha rol la byings thung ngu yin na ring por 'gyur te/ i ring por bsgyur bas/byu1 ༷/ ṣa ti/ laṭa/ byug lnga/ ṣa ti/ ling / byu1 ༷/ ste ta/ ling / mun ste/ ste tra/ ling /tsi khri ṣa tu/ —loṭa/ tsi lnga/ṣa tu/ a tsi khri ṣatpa/ lang/ yi/ tsi lnga/ ṣatpa sogs so/ / —/ dzi rgyal ba las/ 'dod pa'i don gyi rkyen sa dang lkog gyur gyi rnam dbye rnams pha rol la byings dzi ni gi ru 'gyur bar bshad pas/ dzi gir bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ dzi gīṣa tisnye / dzi gī ṣeturtse/ dzi gī ṣatu/ dzi gī ṣa tātpa/ a dzi gī ṣatra sogs so/ / kau de bzhin du yu 'dren pa la/ yu yu ṣa ti/ —laṭa/ yuyu speta/— ling /yu yu ṣa tu/ —loṭa/ — yu yu ṣa tātra/ lang/— a yu yu ṣatpa lang/sogs dang / —/ hu 110—264

don la/ pu tra kyeka mya ti bu 'dod par byed sogs so/ / 1 ka ra ḍo tsa yaḥ byed pa la'ang ya'o/ /byings kaṇḍa la sogs pa rnams las byed pa'i don la'ang rkyen ya 'gyur te/ kaṇḍa ka ro ti zhes pa'i don la/kaṇḍa ya ti sogs so/ / sa/ nyiḍiṅka ra ṇi / byed pa po la nyi ḍa 'gro ba'o/ /ming gi byings gha ṭa la sogs pa rnams la byed pa po'i don la rkyen nyi 'gyur zhing nyi de la'ang ḍa 'gro ba'i ming can zhes bya'o/ / sa/ nyi tt+waṃ hra swe5/ nyi nyid la thung ngu'o6/ /spyir btang nya 'gro ba la 'phel ba thob 7kyang de'i dmigs bsal rkyen nyi la 'phel ba mi 'byung zhing byings kyi dang po'i dbyangs de ring po yin na thung ngur 'gyur te/ sa/ gha ṭa la nyi/ de ḍa 'gro ba yin pas ṭi phyis/ 'phel ba mi byed/ apra bi kā ra ṇa sbyar yon tan sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ gha ṭa ya ti bumapa byed sogs te/ gha ṭaṃ ka ro ti bumapa/byed zhes pa'i don la/ gha ṭa ya ti bumapa byed de bzhin du/ ma hāhaṃ ka ro ti chenapobyed do zhes pa'i don la ma ha ya ti/ chenango/byed do/ /baha thob pa la nyi/ba ha spru bhā ru bsgyur bas/ spru ḍho ka ro ti thob nga/ra byed do zhes pa'i don la/ u bhā ya ti/ thob par byed do/ / —/ thra thā deraḥ thra tha sogs kyi ra'o/ /rkyen nyi pha rol la byings dṛ tha sogs kyi dbyangs ṛ ni ra ru 'gyur te/ bṛ tha la nyi ṛ radra bsgyur bas/ pra tha ya ti sogs so/ / 1 de bzhin du dṛ 6bhā la/ dra bhā ya ti sogs so/ / 1 byings la rang gis byed pa'am gzhan byed du 'jug pa'i bya ba'i don 110—271

hre pa ya te/ 1 de bzhin du llī la/ nyi pukra ā ga ma byin/ llī pa i ①zhes gnas pa la—/ e/ i ā'o/ /skru nas lī'i bar gyi byings de rnams kyi i yig dag ni pukra pha rol la ā ru 'gyur te/ klu pa ya ti sogs dang / 1 de bzhin du rīng nyan pa la/ rā pa ya ti sogs dang / 1 a dhi sngon ma'i id klog pa la/ a dhyā pa ya ti sogs dang / shrī na mjal ba la/ krā pa ya ti sogs dang / 1 dzi rgyal ba la/ dzā pa ya ti sogs dang / 1 lī rnam par 'khyams pa la/ nyer bsgyur ba'i 1 sngon/ bi lā pa ya ti sogs so/ /1 pa ta sogs la nyi pha rol las pukra gi yul la yukra ā ga ma ster 1bar bshad de/ 1 pā btung ba la/ nyi sbyar yukra byin pas/ pā ya ya ti sogs so/ / 1 bhāng nyal ba la/ nyi sbyar yukra byin/ shing gi rtag tu yon tan nos/i e/ mtshams ④sbyor gyi yi ge sogs kyis de ā ru bsgyur bas/ shā ya ya ti sogs dang / 1 de bzhin du sho phra mor byed pa la'ang mtshams khyasbyor gyi yi ge sogs kyis o ā ru bsgyur bas/ shā ya ya ti sogs so/ /1 tpānyu pyi dang dhūnyu dag la nyi pha rol la nukra ā ga ma ster bar bshad de nukra byin pas/ dzrī spyoṇa ya ti sogs dang / dhū spyon ya ti sogs so/ /1 dzā spu na sogs kyi dbyangs nyi pha rol la yang na thung ngur bsgyur bar bshad de/ 1 dzñā khongs su tshud pa la/ nyi sbyar/ pukra lku ā ga ma byin thung ngur bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ⑪ba 'dam ka can du byas pas/ dzñā pa ya ti sogs sam—/ pta pa ya ti sogs so/ /110—273

— / dzā na la sogs pa rnams kyi pukra dang bcas pa'i sa pha rol la is su bsgyur ba dang mi bsgyur ba 'dam ka can du bshad de/ is su ma kye bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ iṭu ā ga ma byin pas/ dzi dzñā rngupa yi ṣa te rngu sogs dang / is su bsgyur ba'i phyogs la nyi dang iṭu ④mi 'jug gnyis brjod pa'i sngon ma phyis/phra gekra sogs kyis isra'i sra yang phyis ring por bsgyur bas/ dzrībee pya ti sogs so/ / —/ tsu rā dernyiḥ tsu ra sogs la nyi'o/ /byings tsu ra ⑦la sogs pa rnams las rang gi bya ba'i don la nyi rkyen du 'gyur te/ — / tsur rku ba la/ nyi sbyar / apra bi kā ra ṇa/ yon tan sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ tso ra ya ti sogs so/ /1 de bzhin du pā la bsrung ba la/ pā la byeya ti sogs dang / ྈ / tsi ṭī 'du shes la/ tsi ta ya ti sogs dang / tsi ti dran pa la/ i 'gro ba sogs kyi nupo byin pas/ cis ya ti sogs dang / —/ artsa mchod pa la/ artsa ya ti sogs dang / tsu ra sogs nyi mtha' can la/ ātma rgo pa da byernams kyang 'jug par bshad pas/ tso ra ya te ⑪sogs kyang ngo / / 4/ nye ra da tyadī tsa/ nyi dang adra las gnyis kyang ngo / /byings las 'das pa tsam gyi don brjod pa la nyi mthar adra rkyen du 'gyur zhing adra dang lhan cig pa'i nyi pha rol la byings de gnyis su'ang brjod par bya la rnam dbye'ang de ring ma yin pa ladra rnams sbyor te/ tsudra la/ nyi/ adra / dipra gnyis brjod/sngon ma'i ha sa dang po lhag po/ aṭa sngon du sbyar bas tsa/ a tsu tsudra/ i ad ces gnas pa la/ 1 nyeḥ nyi'i'o/ /'das pa'i don kyi skabs 'dir rkyen ka nga 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la nyi ni dbyi bar bya ste/ nyi phyis/110—274

apra kyi yul la/ dib sogs kyi ya dang / 4 ① sogs kyi nā 'dam ka can du byas pas/ 1 dzñā khongs su chud pa la/ dzā ya ti sogs sam/ dzā nī te ②sogs so/ / 1 de bzhin du dzan skye ba la'ang / dzā ya ti 1sogs sam/ dzā rī te ④sogs so/ /1 shu baḥsh-i/ shu'i (kho/ /byings shu ni ⑤apra la sogs pa pha rol la sh-i zhes par 'gyur te/ shu thos pa la su sogs kyi nu bi kā ra ṇa shu z-i rngu ru bsgyur bas/shri rṇa ti sogs so/ /kau pā dehu swaḥ pū la sogs pa'i thung ngu'o/ /byings pūnya la sogs pa rnams ni apra sogs pha rol la thung ngur 'gyur te/ 1 (2 nom pa la/ nā bi kā ra ṇa thung ngur bsgyur bas/ pu nā ti ④sogs so/ /i ti swa ra swa ste byā ka ra ṇa su sru ⑧tā dā de sha prakri ya sa mābhāḥ zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las kun nas bsgyur ba'i rab tu bya ba rnams rdzogs so// // sa/ de nas byings dang nyer bsgyur sbyor tshul sogs bshad par bya ste/ni bi shā deḥni las bi sha sogs la'o/ /nyer bsgyur ni las pha rol kyi byings bi sha sogs la rnam dbye ā nee pa da rnams 'jug ste/ bi sngon ma'i bi sha 'jug pa la/ ni bi she ⑨ te nges par 'jug par byed sogs so/ / 1 bi pa rā rgyu dze/ bi pa rā dag las dzi la'o/ /nyer bsgyur bi dang pa rā 0 dag las pha rol gyi byings dzi rgyal ba las rnam dbye ātma nee pa da ⑫rnams 'jug ste/ bi dza ya te/snyernam par rgyal bar byed/ pa rā dza ya te/snyemachog tu rgyal bar byed/110—278

par gnas par byed/ ab tiṣṭha ①te/snyekun tu gnas par byed/ prati ṣṭha te/snyerab tu gnas par byed—/ upa tiṣṭha te/snyenye bar gnas par byed/ bi tiṣṭha te rnam par gnas par byed sogs so/ / 1 u dī sgyi ⑤ta ba/ u tpa bi dag las ta pa la'o/ /nyer bsgyur utu dang bi dag las pha rol kyi ta pa la'ang ātma nee pa da rnams 'jug ste/ utta pa te—/ snyeshin tu gdung bar byed/ pi ta pa te rnam par gdung bar byed sogs so/ / 1 ā ngo ya ma ha naḥ.āja las yapo han la'o/ /nyer bsgyur āng las pha rol kyi yaphra dang han dag la'ang ātma 1 ne pa da rnams 'jug ste/ yapo la/ā yatstsha te kun tu 'gog par byed sogs dang / ā sngon ma'i han 'tshe cheb la/ 1 lo pasta nu datta māṃ/ a nu dātta rnams dbyi ba nyid do/ /byengs mtha'i a nu dātta ste skad gsang ⑤dma' bar 'don pa nya ma so sor bsdu ba rnams ni dzha pya sa'i yi ge ka nga 'gro ba rnams pha rol la dbyi bar bya ste/ ā ha te/—kun tu sgrun par byed/āspyo te/ ya te/ ā ha se/ ākyā the/ ā ha bye/ stospyo④/ ā haṃ ba te/ā haṃ ma te sogs so/ /1 u tashtsa rasgyu lduge/ utpa las tsa ra la 'don pa la'o/ /nyer bsgyur utu las pha rol gyi tsa ra g.yo ba las 'don pa dang bcas pa'i don la ātma de ⑨pa da rnams 'jug ste/ utstshar ⑫te sru tram̐/snyespyod cing gzhung 'don par byed/ rnam dbye gsum pa'i mtha' can dang sbyor ba'i saṃ sngon ma'i tsa ra la'ang ā nee pa da rnams 'jug par bshad de/ a shwe ⑪na saṃ tsar te/— rta yis kun tu spyod par byed/ rā the na saṃ tsa ra te/snyeshing rtas kun tu spyod ⑫par byed/ byā ba pa ri bhyaḥkri yaḥ bi a ba pa ri rnams las kshi la'o/ /nyer bsgyur bi dang a ba dang pa ri rnams las pha rol gyi shrī ⑫ la lnga nee pa da rnams 'jug ste/ bi shrī 1 te/—rnam par 'tshong bar byed/ a ba shrī bhā 110—280
