dipra sogs kyi ya bi ⑫ kā ra ṇa u ba dhwa ring por bsgyur bas/ shā mya ti/ dā mya ti sogs dang / — / de bzhin du/ ta mu ngan sems la/ tā mya ti sogs dang /bhra mu/ kra mu/ kla mu/ tra si/ tru ṭi/ laṣa/ bhāshra/ shā sha rnams la apra bi kā ra ṇa dang ya bi kā ra ṇa yang na bar bshad de/ 1 bhra mu g.yo ba la/abra dang ya 'dam ka can du byas/ ring por bsgyur bas/ sthā ma ti sogs dang / bhā mya ti sogs so/ / —/ de bzhin du/ kla mu ngan sems la/ klu ma ti sogs dang / klu mya ti sogs so/ /ྈ / dudza log par spyod pa la rkyen nyi sbyor bar 3bshad de/ dru ṣa ya ti sogs so1/ / sa/ skroḥ ya la o'o/ /rkyen ya pha rol la byings kyi o yig ni dbyi bar bya ste / — / do dum bur ④byed pa la dipra sogs kyi ya/ o phyis pas/ rya ti sogs dang / —/ de bzhin du/ sho phra mor byed pa la/ shya ti sogs dang / 1ṣe mtha'i las la/ mya ti sogs so/ / 1 po ru raḥ pu'i ri udra'o/ /bu ste byings pa sde'i yi ge sngon na yod pa'i ṛ yig ni ka nga 'go ba'i ming can pha rol la udra du 'gyur te/ 1 mṛng srog 'dor ba la/ /'dod pa'i don kyis ṛ spu udra gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ mu sprurṣa ti sogs so/ /mṛng ⑥la sa rkyen dang shog gyur kyi don la pa rasmi pa da rnams 'jug par bshad pa las/ sa rkyen bstan zin la/lkog gyur la/ ma mā ra sogs dang / de gnyis las gzhan du ātma nee pa da rnams 'jug pas/ mri ya te sogs so/ /110—283

rnams yin la de rnams la a bhyasta zhes sngon gyi thub pa rnams kyi ming du btags so//asto'i na dbyi ba dang / an usra bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ 1 tsa kā sre lhasnang byed la/ tsa kāsnyi/ tsa kā staḥtsa kā sa ti/ a tsa kā suḥsogs dang / 1 dzā kṛ gnyid sangs pa la/ dzā garti/ dzā kṛ taḥ dzā gra ti/ a dzā ga duḥkhusogs dang / 4 / da ri dā de ri dā ④lo pashtsa di ti/ da ri dā ④sogs kying 'gro ba la itpa ste ā dbyi ba yang ngo / /byings da ri drwa sogs kyi ā rgo rkyen dang rnam dbye nga 'gro ba'i ming can ha sa dang po can la i ru 'gyur zhing dbyangs dang po can la ā de ni dbyi bar bya ste/ 1 da ri dru ngan 'gro la'o zhes pa la/ da ri dā ti/ da ri dri ti/ da ri ⑤ dra ti sogs so/ / sa/ shās rjes su 'thor ba la/ shāste/ shiṣṭaḥ shā ⑥sa ti sogs dang / 1 yī ḍi shoḥ yīḍa yīsha dag las so/ /byings āoḍa dang yīshra dag las pha rol gyi rnam dbyes yig dang bye dag la iṭa ā ga ma ster mubar bya ste/ 1yīkre ⑧bstod pa la/ āorbhe/ āo ḍā te/ yī ḍa tebye/ yī ḍi ṣe0 / yī ḍā —)the/yī ḍibye ⑫/ khyu ḍi/ yī ḍa te/ yīrja ⑫ he sogs dang / —/ de bzhin du/ āoshu mchog gi dbang phyug la/ yīṣṭi/ yī shā te/ khra sha te/ yī shi ṣe/ khra shā the/yī shi dhī rngusogs so/ / 1 o ro/ u'i ma'o/ /yu sogs byings mang po zhig gi mtha'i u ni rnam dbye ba 'go ba'i ming can ta yig dang sa yig dang ma yig dang po can pha rol las au ru 'gyur ro/ /— / yu nu ru stu bhya āorpā/ yu nu ru stu rnams las yīdra yang na'o/ /byings yul sogs pa 'di rnams kyi u ni rkyen bshad ma thag pa'i tshad nyid de rnams tshang 110—285

ba pha rol la au ru bsgyur ba dang yang na o ru 'gyur zhing o ru bsgyur ba'i phyogs la yīdra ā ga ljum ster bar bya ste/ dra rjes 'brel/ audang o 'dam ka can du byas pas/ 1 yu spel ba la/ yo ②ti sogs sam/ ya bī ti sogs so/ /1 de bzhin du 1nu ded pa la/ no ti sogs sam/ na wā ti sogs sa/ / kau ru sgra la/ ro ti sogs sam/ ra bī ti sogs so/ / 1 byunyu bstod pa la/ sto ti sogs sam/ sta bī ti sogs so④/ /nga 'gro ba rnams la bya ba lhag po 'u med pas/ yu taḥ du/ yu brnyi sogs so/ /1 lo pa bee nu dātta ta rgo/ tan rnams kyi a nu dātta dbyi ba nyid do/ /byings ta nu la sogs pa rnams kyi mtha'i a nu dātta ste nyam so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge rnams ni kra dra 'gro ba'i ming can dzha sa'i yi ge dang po pha rol la dbyi bar bya ba nyid de/ 1 hanu 'tshe ba la/ hadhi/ ha taḥ sna ti sogs so/ / 1 na maḥnamra la'o/ /napo bi kā ra ṇa pha rol la'ang byings kyi nya ma'i yi ge rnams dbyi bar bya ste/ 1 hidma 'tshe ba la/ rurnya sogs kyi naphra sbyar dra dbyi ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ han ste/ tist+waṃḥhidmarnyi sogs so/ / 1 bhadzra ⑦bsnyen pa la/ napo bi kā ra ṇa sbyar bas/ bha nakto/ dzhaktaḥsgo dzasti sogs so/ / sa/ a pi rañdza rda sha ṣe dza 6 rdzudu/ apra la rañdza rda shra ṣañdza ṣṭañdza rnams kyi'o//apra bi kā ra ṇa pha rol la byings rañdza la sogs pa 'di rnams kyi u pa dhā'i na yig ni dbyi bar bya ste/ rañdza la/ ra dza ti/ ra dza taḥr dzasti sogs dang / —/ de bzhin du/ da sha ti/ sa dza ti/ swa dza ti sogs so/ bi don bā māṃ tyā dī māṃ ṇa bā dirpā/ bing las tipra la sogs pa dgu rnams ni ṇapra la sogs 110—286

dbye rnams sbyar bas/ smin pa/ra byed dam 'tshod par byed/snyepā tsa kaḥ si/ pā tsa kau/ pā tsa kāḥsogs so/ /de bzhin du/ pog par byed/snye pā ṭha kaḥ —si/ byed do// — kā ra po/ཿ —si—/ yodapar byed/ bhā ba ma/ཿ —si/ gcod pa/ra byed/——'u/ba ma/ཿ si/ sre bar byed/—lha/ ba kaḥ— si—/ dag par byed/ // ba kaḥṅgasogs so/ /1 nā myu ba dhwaṅkaḥ nā mi'i 3 u pa dhā las 2 ka'o/ /byings nā mi'i yi ge u pa dhā can la kṛṭu sogs ming du sgrub 4pa'i rkyen ka 'gyur te/ 1 kṣipa byed du 'jug pa la/ kaka yig yon tan 'gog pa'i don/ si/ kṣi paḥ byed du 'jug /au5/ kṣi poḥ kṣi pāḥdzas sogs dang / de bzhin du/ ṅga/ dhadaḥ 'jom/sa pa/ra byed/ se/ tshidaḥ dum/ bur byed/ sogs so/ /byings dzñā khongs su chud pa la'ang rkyen ka 'jug par bshad pas/ si/ dzñāḥshis 6 pa ra byed/ dzño/ sau 7 / dzñāḥdzas sogs so/ / sa/ pa tsi rgo di gra hā di ra yu ṇi na/ pa tsi nandi gra hā sogs la a yu ṇi ni'o / /byings pa tsi sogs dang nadzdza sogs dang gra hā la sogs pa rnams la rim pa bzhin rkyen a dang yu dang ṇi ni rnams 'gyur te/ a pa tsaḥ/ si /'tshod pa ra byed a/ nge pa/ཿ/ rig pa/ra byed/ a ba pa/ཿ si /brjod pa ra byed/ a/ 2de 1 baḥ sirtse bar byed dam lha/ a/ si / ces baḥbasnyen pa ra byed casags pa/nga / sa/ yu /— nanda na si/dga'abar byed/ yu / ra ma/ ṇaḥ/ dga' bar byed dam rtsed mo byed/yu—/ // cha naḥ glidaga' bar byed dam rtsed mo byed/ yu / kra ma ṇaḥ mi/dga' bar byed dam rtsed mo byed/yu—/ a rda naḥ/ si'ajoms par byed/ yu/— ma rda naḥ/ mi 'joms pa/ra byed/ sogs dang / ru sgra la/ yuṇa/ —/ rorlu ṇaḥ ru la yu ṇa'o/ /byings ru la rkyen yu ṇa 'gyur te/ ṇa 110—293

—/ tapa gdung ba la/ ṇa/ tā paḥ gli gdung bar byed/ 1 pa thi la 11 ba 'a// ṇa/ pānd+raḥ si 'go byed dam lam/ 1 karle aṇa/ las la aṇa'o/ /byings las las dang sbyor ba'i byed pa'i don la aṇa 'gyur te/ si.a/ ku rghaṃ kā raḥ sibumapa byed/ gradzdza kā raḥ glegs bam byed/ 1 ā to ḍaḥ/ ātpa laḍa'o/ /byings āta 1mtha' can las las dang sbyor ba'i byed pa la rkyen ḍa 'gyur te/ ḍa yig ṭi dbyi ba'i don/ ḍa/ dzñaḥḍa/ si shes pa—/ nga/ཿ ṣka 'thung ba/ ḍa si/ —sharaḥ/2 sbyinang / casab/sa cas/ / 1 nāsdi tsa/ ming la'ang ngo / /ming sngon na yod pa'i byings la'ang ḍa rkyen du 'gyur te/ go sngon ma'i dā sbyin pa la/ ḍa/ go daḥ ba la nga sbyin/ de ngasaḥ/zug du / norasbyin/ dha zug nga/ཿ/ ḍasi/ ḍa/ —— ngasaḥ si nyis 'thung / ḍa/ ཿ/ ja ཿ si/nyis skyes—/ ḍa— 11 ston11ཿ rsha khyim gnas /shu tsi gtsang sbra la'o zhes pa'i byings sngon —ma'i dru 'gro ba la ḍa ṭi phyis pas/shu ca dra zhes gnas pa la/ 4 / shu tsaḥshu dre/ shu tsa'i dra la shu'o5/ /byings shu tsa ni ming dra pha rol la shu zhes par 'gyur te/ shu tsa shu ru bsgyur bas/ shu draḥ——gtsang sbra song ba ste dmangs rigs so/ / 1 u ra saḥlo po musthā/ u rasra kyi dbyi zhing mupo yang na'o/ /ḍa rkyen can gyi ming dang spyor ba la u rasra kyis dbyi zhing mupo ā ga ma yang na ster te/u ra gaḥ— zang 'gro ste sbrul/— u ram̐ gaḥ 1 bi hā ya so bi ha tsa/ bi hā ya sa'i bi ha 'ang ngo / /ḍa rkyen can gyi ming dang sbyor ba la ming gi byings bi hā yas ni bi ha zhes par 'gyur zhing mupo ā 110—295

bā au ru bsgyur bas/ bhā ro haḥsogs so/ /༈ sa hoḥṣaḥsā dhi/ sa ha'i sā hre la ṣa'ang ngo / /rkyen biṇa pha rol la byings sa hu ni sāhre zhes par 'gyur ba'i sa yig ni ṣa yig tu 'gyur te/ tu rā sngon ma'i sahu lhan cig la/ piṇa 'phel ba la/ hu hre/ bi phyis sa ṣar bsgyur bas/ lhanacig mgyogs/—tu rā ṣāṭā①/—si/ tu rā sā ho sogs so/ /༈ mo no dma taḥ byings kyi ma'i na'o/ /byengs mtha'i ma yig ni rkyen ra sa ⑦so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge pha rol dang tshig mtha' las kyang na yig tu 'gyur te/bra sngon ma'i sha mu dang da mu nye bar zhi ba la/ biṇa 'phel ba/ bi phyis/ ra sa la nar bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsgrubs pas/ pra shān①/—rab tu zhi ba'am rab tu dul/ pra shā mo④/ pra dānu/—rab tu zhi ba'am rab tu dul/ pra dā mo sogs so/ /༈ a byu tadzha be kṛ bhā ste yo ⑤ge rtswaḥrjo byung ba ma yin pa las kṛ byu asra sbyor ba la rtswa'o⑦/ /byung nas yun ring 'das pa'i don ma yin pa'i sar byung gi don la kṛ khyu as sbyor ba la bar rkyen rtswa ske'agyur ro/ /༈ rtswa drirgha tpāsbyo su/ rtswa la ring po ste a'i yang āo'o/ /rkyen rtswa ⑨pha rol la byengs dang ming gi mtha'i dbyangs thung ngu ni ring por 'gyur zhing mtha' a yig yin na a de yī ru yang 'gyur te/ a mi thu dzwa ⑫mi thu dzwa ⑪kṛ ya te a nee na mi 'khrig pa las 'khrig par byed zhes pa'i don la/ mi thu na dang ka ra ṇa'i bar du rkyen rtswazhatsu yig rtswa la ring po sogs kyi don/ bi'i 'os ⑫bi phyis/ a yī ru bsgyur bas/mi thu nī ka ra rṇa mi 'khrig pa las 'khrig par byed sogs dang / de bzhin du bhū dang sbyor ba la/ a shuklaḥshuklaḥbha ba ti dkar po min pa dkar por song zhes pa'i don la/ shu khri bhā baḥ⑫dkar po min pa dkar por song sogs dang / asra dang sbyor ⑫ba la a sa hā yaḥs hā 110—298

yo bha ba ti lhan cig ma yin pa lhan cig par gyur to zhes pa'i don la/ sa hā yī rtswa sgyutpa lhan cig ma yin pa lhan cig par gyur to sogs dang / a he tuḥte tuḥkṛ te rgyu med pa la rgyu byas so zhes pa'i don las he tū kṛ haṃ ①rgyu med pa la rgyu byas so rtswa sogs so/ /༈ rtswa sa lo pashtsa/ rtswa las dbyi ba'ang ngo / /gsar byung gi rkyen rtswa pha rol la sngon ma'i mtha' sa yig yin na dbyi bar bya ste/ utpa sngon ma'i ma nasra la rtswa sra phyis a yī ru bsgyur bas/ sa bhā bhā baḥ—skyo bar gyur to/ /yang skabs la lar rtswa'i ②don la rkyen ḍā ster bar bshad de/ 7/①—duḥkhā rjoka ro ti/rkosdug bsngal bar byed/ /7—bha dru ka ro ⑤ti bzang por byed sogs so/ /༈ ā te ma nipra kwa nipra ba ni paḥ ātpa la ma nipra kwa ni pra ba ni pra'orjo/ /byengs ātu mtha' can la ming du sgrub pa'i rkyen ⑦ma nipra dang kwa nipra dang pa nipra rnams 'gyur te/ su sngon ma'i dā la ma ni pra pra rjes 'brel i brjod don/su dā man zhes 'grub pa la rnam dbye sbyor ba'i cho ga gong rā dza na ltar bsgrubs pas/ su dā mā ⑧si legs pa'i sbyin pa byin sogs so/ /1 sthā sri/ sthā rnams kyi yī'o/ /byings sthā gā bā rnams kyi mtha'i a yig ni kipra ⑨ma yin pa'i rkyen kra 'gro ba'i ming can pha rol la sī ru 'gyur te/ su sngon ma'i sthā dang pā la kwa nipra/ pra rjes 'byel/ na'i i brjod don/ kra yig kra 'gro ba'i khyad ⑫don/ ā khyu ru bsgyur bas/ legasapar gnas/—susbyibā/rkosi/legs par 'thung /—su spru bā sisogs dang / dā la/ ba nipra/ pra ⑪rjes 'brel/na'i i brjod don/ khyu mbi sngon/ sa gzhi sbyin par byed/—byu mbi dā bā/—si/ skabs la lar ā yig mtha' can ma yin pa la'ang ma nipra sogs 'jug ste/ legs pa'i las/—sukarmā/—si/ legasapar thos/—su sharmā sisogs so/ /110—299

mi byed pa 'dam ka can du bya ste/ pra sngon ma'i byutpa la kta iṭā/ yon tan yang na bar byas pas/ pra dro ti taḥsnyerab tu gsal bar byas/ pra byu ti taḥ de bzhin du/bad la kta/ kra 'go ba'i phyogs la slar yang dag par bsgyur ba dang / kra 'gro ba ma yin pa'i phyogs la rang gnas byas pas/ u di taḥ — smrabar byed/ ba di taḥ ru de taḥ— mchi ma 'dzag par byed/ ro di taḥ/ mu ṣi taḥ 1 rkubar byed/ mo ṣi taḥkṛ hi taḥ— bzung bar gyur/— gra hi taḥ nu di taḥ byed du 'jug/ no di taḥ bi di taḥsnyerigapar byed/bee di taḥ— rig par byed/sogs so/ /kau ki taḥ ka 'gro ba la'o/ /byings ṛ yig mtha' can dang u yig mtha' can dang / shrī rnams las pha rol gyi rkyen kra 'gro ba'i ming can la iṭā ā ga ma 'gyur ba ma yin te/ yu taḥ bsres 4so/ /nu taḥ ded do/ /byu taḥ byung ngo //smṛ 5taḥ dran no/ /shrītaḥ'abyor pa/ra gyur sogs so/ / 1 ā dī di taḥ ā tpa yītpa 'gro ba la'o/ /byings mtha' ātpa spyodang yītpa ཿ 'gro ba las kyang pha rol gyi rkyen kra 'gro ba la iṭa 'gyur ba ma yin no/ / —/ ṭī tt+waṃ takra brta mā neepho pi/ nyi itpa 'gro ba la da ltar ba la taka kyang ngo / /byings nyi dang itpa rjes 'brel 'gro ba la da ltar ba'i don la rkyen takra 'gyur zhing iṭu yang ster ba ma yin no/ /1 dasta tsusu no dashtsa/ da las ta'i na ste da'i yang ngo / /byings da yig mtha' can las pha rol kyi rkyen ta yig ka 'gro ba'i ming can ni na yig tu 'gyur zhing byings mtha'i du de yang na yig tu 'gyur te/ nyi mi dā snum pa'am bsres pa la—/ nyi — sna.itpa 'gro ba la zhes pas/ takra/ nyi de'i don ātpa āotpa 'gro ba la'os/ /iṭā mi 'jug byings mtha'i ā de'i don/ de las zhes pas/110—303

sa/ kwa su kā kau ṇa bee batpa/ kwa su kā na dag ṇa pa e bzhin no/ /byings la kwa su dang kā na rkyen du 'gyur zhing rkyen de gnyis kyang don dang bya ba so kwa su ni lkog gyur gyi rnam dbye par smi 1 pa da ṇapra sogs dang 'dra la kā na ni ātma de pa da a thusogs dang 'dra ba nyid de bhi dir gnyis su byed pa la/ kwa su ka yon tan 'gog pa'i don/ u num gyi don/ gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bsgrubs pas / bi bhe dān/ 'byedapar byed/ de bzhin du/ kṛ la tsa kṛ bā na/ byas so/ /yang kṛ la kā na/ ka yon tan 'gog pa'i don/ gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis/tsa krā ṇaḥ— byasaso/ /de bzhin du han la/ 'tshe ba byas / dzaghi bān/ ka su iṭu si/ 'tshe ba byas/ ja ghā naḥkānasogs so/ /1 sha tre —shā kho tibra te batro kri yā yī/ bya ba la sha z-i shā na dag ste tipra te bzhin no/ /byings las bya ba'i don la rkyen sha tre dang shā na dag 'jug la rkyen de gnyis kyi cho ga sogs sha 5tre ni brta ma na'i pa rasmi pa da ti 6pra sogs dang 'dra zhing shā na ni ātma nee pa da'i te sogs dang 'dra ba nyid de/ pa tsa la sha tre ṛ num 7 gyi don/ sha khyad don/ 'tshedapa/ra byed/ pa tsan/ si/ de bzhin du/si—/ paṭhan / klog par byed/ gi la/ smra bar byed/ ba/ yan/sisogs so/ /— / mu gā neephotaḥ ā na las atpa la mukra'o/ /rkyen ā na ste shā na pha rol la byings a yig mtha' can 9 la muka ā ga ma ster bar bya ste/ pa tsa/shā na/ sha khyad don/ mukra ā ga ma byin pas/ pa tsa mā naḥ —'tshod par byed/ de bzhin du/ pi ba mā naḥ —'thung bar byed/ ya dzamā naḥmachod pa/ra byed sogs so/ /yang ma na la shā na/ tan sogs kyis u bi kā ra ṇa de brar bsgyur bas/ ma nā naḥgus par byed sogs dang / sa/ ā se rā na yī/ āsra las ā/ na'i khra'o/ / 110—307

byings ātpa dang ṛtpa kyi mtha' can las byung zin gyi don dang 'brel ba'i ngang tshul sogs kyi don la rkyen ki 'gyur zhing byings de gnyis su'ang brjod par bya ste/ātpa mtha' la/ pa piḥ—'thungs zin pa'i tshul/ da diḥbyinapa'i ngang tshul sogs dang /ṛtpa la/ tsa kriḥ—byas pa'itshul/ smras pa'i tshul/rkob briḥ dza hriḥphrogs pa'i tshul sogs te/ji skad du/ rā maḥso masbra pirya zlo da dinā ①byu kri rasgru lta/ yā dza ṭwāṃ ba bri rā dza hriḥpuṇḍa ri ka ma hā dī dzānu/ dga' byed mchod sbyin la ni zhi ba 'thungs/ /ba yi sbyin pa rmad du byung ba byas/ /bka' yis mchod sbyin byed po ②bos te 'ongs/ /gnyis skyes chen pos pad dkar dus ston no/ /༈ sā do ṇḍa dayaḥ uṇa la sogs pa ni rtag tu'o/ /byengs la rkyen uṇa la sogs pa rnams ni 'das ma 'ongs da ltar ba sogs dus thams cad la rtag tu 'jug ste/ kṛ2 la/ uṇa ṇa 'gro ba la 'phel ba byas pas/ kā ruḥ—byed pa po/ bā 'go ba la/ uṇa/ ātu la yukra ā ga ma byen pas/ bā yuḥrtag par 'gro ba ste rlus sogs so/ /uṇa'i sogs khongs dzeernams ni/ kruṣa sgra sgrog rjopa la/z-i| yon tan ju sogs kyis/ kroṣṭa/—ce spyang / abra bsrung zhing skyong ba la/rkyen mukra ka 'gro ba la/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇar bsgyur/ kra de'i don/ u brjod don/mtshams ⑤sbyar bas oṃ zhes so/ /ang bden par 'gro ba la rkyen ma ni ṇa/ ṇa 'phel ba'i don/ nu'i i brjod don/ ā tma/—bdag nyid/ gre hi thra dhi la ma ni ṇa/༈ ma rgyu pa dhwa ya ṛ raḥ ma ni la u pa dhwa'i ṛ ra'o/ /rkyen ma ni pha rol las byings kyi u pa dhā'i ṛ yig ni rar 'gyur te/ ṛ rar bsgyur bas/braza/ —chen po dang 'phel ba dang grags shing grub pa dang tshangs pa dang srog can rnams la/ brabyu/—'phelab/12 ⑦'dzin pa la rkyen ma yon tan byas pas/ dharmaḥ—'chang bar byed dam chos/110—311

yin pa'i las ngan pa'i don la rkyen ke li ma 'gyur te/ rnyi dir la ke li ma/ ka yon tan 'gog pa'i don/ bye de li saṃ kabye/ shing gshog ma legs ༄1pa/ de bzhin du/pa tse li saṃ ābhā kuṇḍacung zad btsos te gzhal/sogs so/ / sa/ shaṃ pra bi bhyo bhu bo cheḥ shaṃ pra bi rnams las byu la che'o/ /shaṃ dang pra dang bi rnams las pha rol gyi bhū la uṇa sogs kyi rkyen che 'gyur te/ ḍa ṭi dbyi balnga/ ro/na/ ma/ (1ཿ 'i ba thob/ pra (1ཿ khyabapa dag/ bi (1ཿ ma/nga' bdag / —/ yu ba ha gi bhyo nipra/ yu bahu a gi rnams las nipra'o/ /byings yu dang bahu dang a gi rnams las uṇa sogs kyi rkyen nipra 'gyur te/ yo niḥ skye gnas—/ ba sgo ཿ — 'tshed cing 'gro ba/ akṇiḥ ya na la ga med nga ra 'gro ba ste me/ sa/ i di tsa di sha ki 5ru di bhyo raḥ i di tsa di sha ki ru di 6rnams las ra'o / /byings i di dbang phyug tsa di bsil ba sha ki nus pa ru di mchi ma 'dzag pa rnams las uṇa la sogs pa'i rkyen ra 'gyur te/ ra sbyar/ itpa 'gro ba sogs kyi numra byin pas/ ind+raḥ dbang ngo / tsand+raḥ baṅgal byed de zla ba/ shaṃ kraḥ nus nga / ru draḥ drag ngo// yang puṣa rgyas pa la rkyen pa dang la sbyar bas/ putpaḥ me tog— pu6ཿ pha la dang spru la rkyen a sbyar bas/ pha lo/ 'brasabu/ spru lo/ rtsa ba/rusags so/ / —/ uṇa da yopho pa ri mi tāḥ7 uṇa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa'o/ /'dir bshad pa rnams ni mtshon byed tsam ste gzhan uṇa la sogs pa'i rkyen ni dpag tu med pa yod do/ /de rnams ni uṇa sogs khongs — dang bcas pa mtshon byed tsam mo/ /7 tu ma ta daṭwā yo bha bi 6 ti/ 'byung 'gyur las de'i don la tuphra'o 110—313

byings las ma 'ongs pa 'byung 'gyur gyi de'i don la rkyen tuphra 'gyur te/ sgo hūṃ krā dza ti/ bzos nas 'gro/ pa ṣṭha tu mibye/ 'dodapa ltar klog /rtswa tu mi ha ta khrus byas nas rtse'o rusags cas/ /sa / gha2 bhā bee/ dngos po la ghanyu'o/ /da hūṃ byings las dngos po'i don brjod pa la rkyen ghanywa 'gyur te/ ྈ/ tse 2dzoḥka go ghi ti/ tsa dza dag gi ghra 'gro ba la ka ga dag go/ /byings mtha'i tsa yig dang dza yig dag ni rkyen ghra 'go ba'i ming can pha rol la rim pa bzhin ka dang ga ru 'gyur te/ patsu la/ ghanyu/u pa dhā 'phel ba tra de'i don/ tsu ka ghra yig de'i don/ pā kaḥ tshos pa 'am smin nga /tya dza la/ tyā gaḥ byin can/ ya dza la/ yā gaḥ mchod nga// bha dza la/ bhā gaḥ 'byed do/ /yu dzidra spyor ba la/ yo gaḥ.iṇa rnala'abyor 'gro ba la/ nandi sogs la yu'os/ rkyen yu dang ghanyu — 'dam ka can du byas pas/ a ya rna/sto/ yaḥ 'gro ba/ de babyu/na du/ bhū 'a// yu bha ba rna/ bden pa/'am yod pa// bhā baḥ ghaṣyo—/ dā dang pā la/ yu dā rgo/ sbyinabya/ dā pa// ghanya ātro 'a yu ka ā ga ma byin/ pā ni / 5 'thung bya/ pā yaḥghanya ātro la yu ku ā ga ma byin sogs so/ /ྈ / saṃ dzñā ya ma karta ri tsa byed po ma yin pa'i ming la'o/ /byings las byed po'i don ma yin pa'i dngos po dang las dang / ming brjod pa la'ang rkyen ghanyu 'gyur te/ pra ti dang ādra sngon ma'i hriṣyo 6la/ bra tyā hā raḥ —so sor bsdu ba/ྈ / swa rā daḥ dbyangs las a'o/ /byings dbyangs kyi —mtha' can las byed po'i drodon ma yin pa'i dngos po sogs kyi don la rkyen a 'gyur te/ saṃ sngon ma'i cis la a yon tan byas pas/ sañtsa yaḥ——sdudapa'am bde ba/ de bzhin du/na yaḥ thobapa// sta baḥ —bstod pa/ na raḥ'adod pas rnam par g.yo ba ste mi sogs so/ /110—314

sa/ ma dzā/ mad rnams la'o/ /byings mad la sogs pa rnams la'ang byed po ma yin pa'i dngos po sogs kyi don la rkyen a 'gyur te/ ma tsho dī rang ba la/ma daḥ——yi rang ba/ pra ma daḥ rabatu stsos pa// de babyu/na du/ sha ma/ཿ zhib/ da maḥde baḥ —'di ni sna tshogs pas rtse byed de lha/ bi ṣayaḥ khyad par gyi 'ching ba/ 1 sprukto gha naḥ ghan las sra ba la'o/ /byings ghan las sra ba dang yongs su gcog pa'i don dang 'grel 4ba la rkyen a 'gyur te/ da dhi sngon ma'i han la a ha na ghan ru bsgyur bas/ da bye gha naḥ zho srab stezho gar ngo / de bzhin du/senta sab gha naḥlanatshwa —gcog bo sogs so/ / sa/ barṇa bi parya 7yashtsa/ yi ge bsgyur ba la'ang ngo / /phul du byung ba'i don gyi yi ge phan tshun bsgyur ba la'ang rkyen a 'gyur te/ hidma 'tshe ba la a ha dang sra phan tshun bsgyur bas/ sidhaḥ'atshe ba phul du byung ba ste seng she sogs so/ / 1 ṭī to thuḥ ṭu 'gro ba las a thu'o/ /byings ṭu yig rjes 'brel 'gro ba la dngos po sogs kyi don la rkyen a thu 'gyur te/ ṭu bee mṛ g.yo ba dang ṭu kṣe thra lag pas 'phen pa la/ be pa thuḥ 'dar ba/ kṣe pa thuḥ'aphen pa sogs so/ / sa/ ḍi daste maka ta tt+waṃ te/ che 'gro ba las de 'das pa la tri maka'o/ /byings che rjes 'byel 'gro ba las byings de 'das pa'i don brjod pa la rkyen tri ma kra 'gyur te/ khu kṛnyu la/ kṛ tri mo gha ṭaḥ —bumapa byas/ de bzhin du/ che j-inyu la/ saṃ z-i shetri mo yutt+waṃ/ dmag tshogs 'khrugs so/ /che pa tsadza la/ paghri saṃ pha waṃ 'bras bu smin no sogs so/ / ྈ/ natrī/ naṭa ki dag go/ /byings las dngos po'i don la rkyen naṭā dang ki dag 'gyur te/ ya ṣṭṛ mchod pa la naṭu/ yatnaḥ— sdomabartson/ de bzhin 110byed315

raḥsnyebadeb byed/ yuṭā/ —yī ṣa byo dha naḥ cung zad 'thabasarte / yuṭa/ duzlo dha naḥ 'thab dka' ba—/ bde bar 'thab/——su yo dha naḥyuṭa sogs so/ / 1 ta byu nī yo/ ta bya ā — ya dag go/ /byings byu la sogs pa rnams la ma 'ongs pa'i dus brjod pa'i don la rkyen ta bya dang ā bhā ya dag 'gyur te/bha bi ta dre// —'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / bha // nī yaḥ sto/ si ta dre// gnas 'cha' bar 'gyur ro— / lhas na/ —— sku// karta dre// byed pa ra 'gyur/ ka shes bhā sku// gra hi ta dre// 'dzin pa ra gyur— gra hā dī yo sogs so/ /sa / swa rā ryaḥdabyangs las ya'o/ /byings dbyangs mtha' can la rkyen ya 'gyur te/ kṣe yi/— zad bya/ dze yi/ rgyal bya/ nee yo thob bya sogs so/ /yang byings kṣi dang dzi la ya sbyar ba'i kṣa boḥzad nus dang dzaboḥshil nus zhes pa'ang nus pa'i don tshig phrad du bshad do/ / —/ pu sha kātro/ pu sha ka las so/ /byings pa sde'i yi ge'i mtha' can dang sha ka sogs la'ang rkyen ya 'gyur te/ la bye/ thob pa / ya bye/ 'khris pa// dza bye / bzlas nga// shakya/ nus nga// sa hūṃ/ dga' ba/ ru phyu dad pa/ dang 'dod pa dang ma/dzes pa sogs so/ / —/ yī tsā taḥ ātro las yī'ang ngo / /byings ātpa mtha' can la'ang rkyen ya 'gyur zhing ya pha rol la ātpa de yī yig tu'ang 'gyur te/ dā la ya ā yī yon tan byas pas/ de yi/ sbyinabya/ de bzhin du/ zlo yo/ shes bya/ pe yi 'thung bya sogs so/ / —/ ṛ ha sāṭwābye ṇa/ ṛ ha sa'i mtha' las sgyaṇa'o/ /byings ṛ yig dang ha sa'i mtha' can las dngos po sogs dang 'byung 'gyur gye don la rkyen rgyaṇa 'jug ste/ kā: / —las/ pāṅgi/— sgribapa'am 'gabs pa/ bābye/ gsong por smra ba/ hā 110—317

ghā'o / /mi zad pa'i nang tshan a lo dang kha lu dgag pa'i don can sngon ma'i byengs las kyang rkyen ghā 'gyur te/ a laphyu ghā/ mi za'o/ /padza —khalūghā smra 'phro chod sogs so/ /kau ghā seṭa ki dā/ iṭu dang bcas pa'i ghā ka 'gro ba yang na'o/ /spyir rkyen ghā ka 'gro ba yin kyang iṭa dang bcas pa'i ghā nika 'gro ba'i ming can du yang na par bya ste/ bi di tā/ rig nyo'am/ shes so / / bee di twa sogs so/ / sa/ u di taḥghā betpa/ utu 'gro ba las ghā ste iṭa yang na'o/ /byings utpa rjes 'brel 'gro ba las kyang rkyen ghā 'gyur zhing iṭa ā ga ma ster ba 'dam ka can du bya ste/ i 6 'dod pa la/ i ṣi tā/ iṭī/ 'dod pa/ nyid/ bsu nges par gnas pa la/ u ṣi tā/ uṭī nges nga ra gnas sogs so/ /ྈ / sa mā se kyapra/ bsdu ba la kyapra'o/ /byings las tshig sbud dang 'byel ba'i byed pa'i don la'ang rkyen kyapra 'gyur te/ saṃ bye tya ka ro ti/—kun nas 'phel bar byed/ praṇa mya gatstsha ti phyag btsal nas 'gro bar byed sogs so/ /— / yang kha cig tu nanyu spyor ba la'ang rkyen ghā spyor bar bshad de/ a dzi tā / a kṛ tā/ a daṣṭha sogs te/ ji skad du/ a dzi tā shā tra bārba rpān kṛ tā bi ma lo ya shaḥ/ a daṭwā mitta mabee bhyaḥka dzee dzre brnyi bhū dzdza taḥ/ dgra rnams kun las rgyal bar ma 'gyur bas/ /dri ma med pa'i grags ldan mi byed cing / /don kun rig phyir sbyin pa mi gtong na/ /sa 'dzin 'tsho ba'i gtam yang med par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /yang rkyen kyapra pha rol las byings sngon ma de thung ngu yin pa'i bar rkyen nyi la yon tan byed par bshad de / nyikyadra pa ri ṇa ma skro byuste yongs su btud nas zas za sogs so/ /yang dus dang 'brel pa la yang rkyen kyapra 110—321

sa/ barṇa ṭwā raḥ yi ge las kā 4ra'o/ /yi ge so so'i mtha' las de dang de'i yi ge zhes rang bzhin brjod pa'i don la rkyen kā ra 'gyur te/ a kā raḥ a yig / ka kā raḥ kayig /tsa ka raḥ——tsayig /ṭa kā raḥ ṭayig /takā raḥ— ta yig /ba kā raḥpayigasogs so/ / 1 rā di pho bā/ ra las i pha yang na'o/ /ra yig las de'i rang bzhin brjod pa'i don la i pha yang na 'gyur te/ re phaḥ— rayig/ ra kā raḥ —/ lo kātstsha ṣa su sidhaḥ lhag ma 'jig rten las grub pa'o/ /sngon du bshad pa ltar brda spyod pa'i tshul gyi cho ga sogs nye bar mkho ba rnams bshad zin gyi / 'dir ma bshad pa'i lhag ma 'jig rten dang bstan bcos la grags shing grub pa rnams kyang de dag tu shes par bya'o/ / 1 i ti swa ra swaste byā ka ra ṇa su sru tāskṛ dā da yaḥpra kri ya sa mā bhāḥ/ zhes pa brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo las kṛtpa la sogs pa'i rab tu bya ba rnams sdogs so// //— / swa rū pārnyolhanu bhū tyā diḥshasdophobhā rya tra sārja kaḥ/ sa maska rī shu ṭwāṃ tsa kre pra kri yī tsa tu ro tsi tt+waṃ/ thog mtha' rjes 'byor rang bzhin bzang po yis /'dir ni don bcas sgra la zhugs byas te/ /mtshungs par spyod ldan dge bar byed pa yis/ /rab tu bya ba gsal ldan bshad zin to/ /a ba tā dwo ha ya shrī baḥka ma khā ka ra yī shwa raḥ/ su rā su ra na rā kā ra ma dhu pā spru ta paṃ ka dzaḥ/ khyod la srung bar mdzod cig rta mgrin kye/ /dbang gi mnga' sgyur — phyag na padma yis//lha dang lha min mi la phan par ni/ /sbrang rtsi 'thung zibs chu skyes bzhin du skyongs//de ltar ngag gi dbang phyug 'phags ma dbyangs can mas gnas lnga rig pa'i slob 110—323

dpon chen po a nu khyu ti swa ru pā tsarya ste rjes su 'byor pa rang bzhin bzang po la dngos su stsaX ba'i brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos chen po dbyangs can byā ka ra ṇa zhes grags pa'i gzhung / slob dpon chen po de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa rab tu bya ba gsal ldan zhes pa dang bcas pa 'di yang / lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba yongs kyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po 'phags pa phyag na padma nyid gdul bya'i snang ngor gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs pa ①don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen pa chen po ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes gzhung 'di la lha mthong lo tsā ba'i phyed 'gyur tsam gyi legs po zhig yod tshod du 'dug pa deng sang dpe rgyun dkon zhing phyis su bsgyur ba dang / yig sna kha shas 'dug kyang gzhung don go dka' ba dang slob dpon a nus mdzad pa'i 'grel pa'i dgongs don dang ma 'brel ba sogs 'ga' re 'dug pas/ khyod kyis paṇḍi ta mched kyi gsung rgyun ltar 'di bzhin sgyur cig ces bka'i gnang ba thob par brten—/ rnam 'dren dam pa 'di nyid kyi gzhal du med pa'i bka' drin las 'phags yul nub phyogs ku ru kṣetu bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs pa gnas lnga rig pa'i ma hā paṇḍi ta ba la bha dra dang / paṇḍi ta go kyu la nā tha mi shra mched kyi drung du gzhung 'grel 'di sogs brda sprod pa'i rang ④lugs la sbyangs pas cung zad tsam shes pa bka' 'bangs kyi tha ge chung gtsang stod 'dar gyi nor 'dzin yangs par se'i rigs las skyes pa ngag dbang phun tshogs ldun grub bam/ tshe dbang rab brtan rdo rjer 'bod pa'i rmongs brtul snyom ④las pas/ me mkha' rgya mtsho la 'das lo drug cu skor bcu dang nyag sum cu rtsa brgyad bsre ba sna tshogs dbyig 5 110 324

bsdur 'bras re'u migasgra mdo/ (32)110wa 353

༄ / /mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos 'chi ba med pa'i mdzod ces bya ba skad gnyis sbyar ba bzhugs so/ /1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ a ma ra ko ṣa nā ma/ na mo buddhā ya/ ya su dzñā ༄4/ /bod skad du/ 'chi ba med pa'i mdzod ces bya ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na da pā sirnyo ra gā gting dha myu na agha sdig pa 'am skyon gha gu shāḥ/ /se ba bstan pa'am bsnyan pa se bya gang gi gting mi rtogs pa mkhyen brtse yi/ /rgya mtsho skyon med yon tan mi zad pa/ /de ni dpal dang tā ma kṣa yo dhī blo rām shri ye tsā mṛ tā ya tsa/ 1 1 /sa mā z-i tyā n+ya tand+ra ṇi bdud rtsi'i ched du yang / /blo ldan rnams kyis bsten par bya ba yin/ /rgyud gzhan rnams ni bsdus byas saṃ kṣi bye ཿ pra ti saṃ skṛ taiḥ / / saṃ pūṇḍi mu tsu te ba sgo nd+ra ma liṅgā nas—/ /mdor bsdus legs sbyor sde rnams kyis/ /ming dang rtags ni rjes bstan pa/ /yang dag rdzogs par nu shā sa rna/ 2 sa/ /pā ya po rū pa bhe de na sā ha tsarlustso ku tra tsita/ /byā punda brjod par bya/ /phal cher gzugs kyi dbye ba dang / /la lar de khyad sgrub las dang / /kha cig lhan pudma shaṃ zlo yanta dzwa sha ṣa bi dheḥkra tsita/ 3 —/ /ste dā khyu nā ya na dwo dwo de ka se kho cig spyod las kyang / /pho mo ma ning shes par bya/ /tha dad rtags rnams ma brjod pa'i/ /dbye ba 110—354

na saṅka ra 'dres pa dang 'chol ba dang phyag dar/ /kṛ tophotra bhinda liṅgā nā ma nukyā nātho ma bshad pa'i ched du 'dir/ /zlas dbye byas min gcig lhag min/ /rim pa ma rtogs 'dres pa min/ /dṛ kye te/ 41 /tri lisgyu dhri ṣi ti pa rda mi thu nee tu dwa yo ri ti/ /ni ṣirnya liṅge pe rtags gsum pa la gsum zhes tshig /gnyis la 'khrig ces rtags bkag pa/ /lhag ma'i don yin du mtha' ṣādzee twadhā thā di na pūttha bhāka 5 /dang / /a bye tha dang po snga cha min/ /ྈ / swa ra bya ya swa rga nā ka tri di ba tri da pā la yā ཿ / /1 lha gnas kyi spyi ming / mtho ris 'god med mi zad gnas bzang dang //bde skye med ldan sum rtse skabs gsum gnas//su ra lo ko dro di po dwo ste yo skru bee tri piṣṭa ya/ 6 /lha yi 'jig rten rol sa mkha'/ /gnyis mo ma ning gzhi gsum pa/ /— / a ma rā nirdza rā de bā ste da sā bi buddhāḥsu rāḥ/ /su barpā ṇa byu sa / lha'i spyi ming / 'chi med rgas med skabs gsum lha/ /rnam par sad dang bcud ldan dang / /tshigs ma na saste di bee pā di bo ka saḥ/ 7 sa/ /ā di te yā di bi ṣa do le khā bzang yid bzang sum rtsen dbang / /mtho ris snang byed mi sbyin bu/ /mkha' spyod legs bris mi a di ti nanda nāḥ/ /ā di tyā ṛ bha bophoswa sthā a madhyā a mṛ tārnya saḥ/ 8 1 /babyā sbyin dga'/ /ā di'i bu dang ṛ yig bu/ /gnyid med mi 'chi bdud rtsi zas / /me zhal dang ni mu khāḥkra tu byu dzo gīrpā rja dā na bā ra yaḥ/ /bṛnd+ra ra kā de ba tā ni pu mchod sbyin zas/ /tshig gi mda' can lha min dgra/ /tshogs bzang ba dang lha rnams nyid/ /skyes si bā de ba tā ste st+waṃ/ 9 /pa'am lha mo bud med la'o/ /— / ā di tyā bi shwa ba sa bstu ṣi tā bhā swa rā ṇi khāḥ/ /ma hā rā dzi ka 1 lha'i rigs kyi/ nyi ma sna tshogs nor lha dang / /dga' ldan dang ni 'od gsal rlung / /phreng chen grub 110—355

sā dhyāshtsa tu dāshtsa ga na de ba tāḥ/ 10 sa/ /bi tyā dha ro lhabee ro yakhyo rākṣa sa pa drag po ste/ /de rnams tshogs pa'i lha rnams so/ /rig 'dzin chu skyes gnod sbyin dang / /srin po garnyarbha kinda rāḥ/ /pi shā tso gu hya kaḥsirnyo byu te phombi de ba yo na yaḥ/ 11 /dri za mi 'am ci/ /sha za gsang ba grub pa dang / /'byung po 'di rnams lha las byung / / sa/ a su rā tree tya tree te ya dha nu dzend+ra ri dā na bāḥ / / shu 4/ lha min gyi/ lha min sbyin skyes bcud mi ldan/ /gzhu skyes sbyin byung dbang po'i dgra/ /pa kra shi byā di ti shu tāḥpūttha de bāḥsu ra dī ṣaḥ// 12 //sangs slo ba ma sbyin byed bu/ /sngon gyi ru sta su tra shi shu pā la mas bu'i byis nga lha dang lha la sdang // // ྈ/ sa rba dzñā ཿ su ga to shu zlo dha rma rā dza sta thā ga ta ཿ / /4/ sa ngas rgyas spyi'i/ kun mkhyen bde gshegs/ sa ngas rgyas dang / /chos/ kyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs //sa ma nta bha dro bha ga bādmā ra dzikhro ka dzidzhai na ཿ / / ṣa ḍa bhe rnyo kun tu bzang po bcom ldan 'das / /bdud 'du' rgyal ba 'jig rten 'dul / /mngon shes drug ldan da sha ba lophodwa ya bā dī bi nā ya kaḥ/ /bye brag tu thub pa 'i mu beend+raḥshrī gha na stobs bcu pa/ /gnyis med gsu nga ba rnam pa/ra 'dren/ /thub pa'i dbang po dpal stug 1dang / /ston pā tā mu niḥshākya mu ni tu yaḥ/ /sa shākya sau haḥsadrwarja sidha so sgo da nishtsa saḥ/ /pa thub pa nyid rnams so/ /shākya thub dang don kun grub/ /shākya seṅge zas gtsang sras / /gau ta martswakka bsnushtsa mā yā de bī su tashtsa saḥ// //go ta ma dang nyi ma'i gnyen/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul sras/ rnams/ so// //4 / bradmātma bhūḥsu ra byeṣṭhaḥ 2 pa ra meṣṭṛ bi tā ma haḥ/ nyi ra bye gasgo 4 / tshangs pa bdag skyes lha la sa rgan/ /mchog la gnas dang mes po dang / /gser gyi mngal dang lo ke shaḥswa yi byushtsa tu rā ṇa naḥ/ /dhā tāja yo nidra hi kho bi riñtsiḥka 'jig rten dbang / /rang byung gdong bzhi 'dzin byed dang / /padma'i skye gnas nyes can dang / /sna tshogs 110—356

ma khā sa naḥ/ /sraṣṭha pra dzā sa tibye dhwa bi dhā tā bi swa mṛsbi dhiḥ// //sgrub byed padma'i gdan/ /sbyin byed skye dgu'i bdag po dang / /rig byed rnam byed sna tshogs byed// //— / bisngurnu rā ya ṇaḥkṛhā bai kurjo biṭwā ra shra bāḥ.ashwaza jos/ /dā mo da ro z-i ṣpe — / khyab 'jug nag po sred med bu/ /rtul mo'i bu dang rna ba legs/ /dbang po'i dbang phyug me tog ke shaḥke sha bo mā dha baḥswa byuḥ/ /tree tyā ri puṇḍa rī kā khyo go bisdo ga lto—/ /sgra 1can gsod dang sprang rtsi'i bu/ /rang skyes sbyin dgra pad dkar mig /mkha' lding rgyal ru ḍa dhwa dzaḥ/ /dzī tāsbra rolhasgro ta māṃ gī bi shwakle byeno dza nāsgo naḥ/ /u mtshan glang rdzir grags/ /mi 'dzag gos ser rwa gzhu can/ /sna tshogs sde dang 'gro ba 'joms/ /steng pend+ra ind+ra ba ra dzashtsakra pā ṇishtsa turtu dzaḥ / /padma nā sgo ma dhu ri gi dbang po dbang gzhan skyes/ /lag pa bzhi pa 'khor lo'i lag /padma'i lte ba sbrang rtsi'i dgra/ /purpā su de bste bi kra maḥ/ /de ba kri nanda na sau riḥshrī pa tiḥpu ru 'dug gnas lha dang gom gsum gnon/ /lha mo dga' byed dpa' bo'i rgyud/ /dpal gyi bdag po skyes ṣetta maḥ/ /ba na mā lī ba li dhwadhī shaṃ sā rā ti ra sgolhakṣa dzaḥ/ /bi shwa bu mchog /me tog phreng ldan stobs ldan 'joms/ /'khar ba'i dgra dang 'og dbang skyes/ /kun bha raḥkai ṭa bha dziju dhuḥshrī batpa lañtsa naḥ/ /ba ke su de bolhasu dza na kaḥs 'gengs lha min 'joms pa dang / /sdeb byed dpal gyi be'us mtshan/ /'di yi pha ni nor lha ste//e bāphon ga rjudund+ra bhiḥ/ /ba la bha draḥpra lasba spyo ba la de bophosgo tā gra dzaḥ/ /rnga bo che ni a na ka /stobs bzangs dang ni rab 'phyang gsod/ /stobs lha mi 'dzag sngon skyes dang //re ba tī ra ma no rā maḥkā ma pā lo ha khā yu dhaḥ/ /bhā lāsba ro ro nyi nam gru'i bdag po dga' byed dang / /'dod skyong gshol gyi mtshon cha dang / /gos sngon can dang snar ma'i bye yasgyu lto ko mu ṣa lī ha lboḥ/ /saṅkarṣa ṇaḥtpā ra pā ṇiḥkā liṭī bu—/ /tā las mtshan dang gtun shing can/ /thong ldan legs 'gugs lag na gshol/ /klu 'joms 110—357

bhe da no ba luḥ// //dang ni stobs ldan no// // kau ma da no ma dma tho mā ra pra rlu dmo mbi na ke ta na ཿ / /sa/ bdud kyi mngon brjod/ spyos byed yid srubs bdud dang ni/ /rab stobs nya yi tog can dang //kanda stso da stso kopho rna ga kā ma pañtsa sa raḥ sma raḥ / / sha sba rā rirma tshangs 'joms snyems byed lus med dang / /'dod pa dran pa mda' lnga pa/ /sdom pa'i dgra dang na se dzaḥku su me 6 ralhan n+ya dzaḥ/ /putpa dhanā ra ti pa tirma ka ra yid la sa skyes/ /me tog mda' can gzhan ma skyes/ /me tog gzhu can dga' ma'i bdag /chu srin dhwa dza ātma byuḥ/ /bra hma srubee shwa ke tuḥ myu da ni rudha u ṣā pa tiḥ / /rgyal mtshan bdag las byung // tshe tshangs spong i dang 'gro ba'i tog /ma 'gags pa dang u ṣi'i —1bdag/: de yi du ni u ṣa'i bdag /tshangs spong ma 'gags sna tshogs tog /khyab 'jug gi chung ma'i ming / lallī padmā la yā padmā ka ma khā shrī ha ri bri yāḥ// //mtshon byed de shrī dang 'dam pa 'i che'o / /pa dma dang 'dam pa 'i tshe ka ma khā chu rgyan du'o/ /dpal mo'i dpal gnas padmo can/ /chu — rgyan dpa'/ mo 'phrog byed yum// //1 khyab 'jug gi phyag mtshan gyi shaṃ kho lakhro pa teḥpāñtsa dza nashtsa kre su darsha naḥ// —/ dung can lnga skyes dpal mo'i bdag /'khor lo legs mthong can dang ni/ /kau mo da shī gā nga khasgo nanda ka kostu bho ma ṇiḥ// //rkastu bha sa rten pa ra byed pa/ tīrte bhā dza dang sa rengs pa ra byed pa ra ka ④ru ṇa sgyu bsgyur ta skyegayung drung ngam dga' ba 'khyil bar sngon lo tsā dngha ba rnams kyis bsgyur ba de'o/ /sa mos dbyug pa ral gri dang / /dga' byed sa rten nor bu'o// // —/ ga rudmā na ga ru ḍa sthā rgo bai na te ya kha ge shwa ra ཿ / /1 mkha' lding / 'dab bzangs dug 'joms skar mig bu/ /'dul skyes mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug dang //110—358

nā gārnya ko bisngu ra thaḥsu paṇḍiḥpanda gā sa naḥ// //khyab 'jug shing rta klu mthar byed/ /rkang mi 'go za gser 'dab can// // 1 sha sgru rī shaḥ pa shu pa ti ཿ shi ba shu lbo ma he shwa raḥ / / 1 dbang byug /bde 'byung dbang ldan phyugs bdag dang / /zhi ba mdung thogs dbang phyug che//khyu shwa ra saspru āo shā na shaṃ ka rashtsand+ra shi kha raḥ/ /khyu te shaḥkhaṇḍa pa ra dbang phyug gsod byed dbang dang ldan/ /bde byed gtsug na zla ba dang / /'byung po'i dbang po dgra shugi rī sho gi ri so mṛ ḍaḥ / / mṛ kyu ñdza yaḥ kṛ ti bā sāḥ pi nā sta'i dum/ /ri dbang rir nyal tshim byed dang / /'chi ba las rgyal gzig gos can/ /skyo med gzhu tī pra ma thā dhi paḥ/ /u graḥka parje shrī karjophopa ti kasteḥka pā la z-idang rang 'joms ཿbdag /drag shul ral can dpal mgrin dang / /mgul nag thong pa 'chang ba taḥ—/ /bā ma de bo ma hā de bo bi rū pākṣast+ri lo tsa naḥ/ /kṛ pā nu re tā mattha sto dang / /g.yon phyogs lha dang lha chen po/ /sna tshogs mig dang mig gsum pa/ /kun mkhyen me yi khu ba dhū rdza ṭi dzrī la lo hi ta ཿ / / ha ra ཿ sma ra ha ro bha rga can/ /ral ba'i khur can sngon dmar can/ /'phrog byed dran 'joms 'joms pyabyed dang //sbya sbra krast+ri pu rānta kaḥ/ /gi gā dha ro3nta ka ri puḥkra tu dhwadhī bṛ ṣa spyan gsum grong khyer gsum mthar byed/ /gaṅgā 'dzin dang long ba'i dgra/ /khyu mchog rgyal mtshan mchod dhwa dzaḥ/ /byo ma ka sho bha bo dzrī maḥsthā rku ru dra u mā pa tiḥ/ /ka pasbyo31sbyin 'joms/ /nam mkha'i skra can srid dang 'jigs/ /gnas can drag po u ma'i bdag /chus gang su dza ṭā dzñā ṭaḥpi nā golhadza gā baṃ dha nu/ /pra ma thāḥsruḥpā ri ṣa dā bra sthā dag byed ral pa bcings/ /skyo med khyab dang sgra ldan gzhu/ /de yi 'khor ni rab 'joms dang //sgyu byā stu mā ta raḥ/ /bi bhū tisgu ti ri shwarya ma ṇi mā di ka maṣṭa tshangs ma la sogs ma mo rnams/ /khyab bdag khyab byed dbang phyug la/ /phra ba la sogs brgyad dang 110—359

dhāḥ / / //ldan—/ / // 1 u mā kā tyā ya bhā go rī kā lī te ma ba tī shwa ra / / —/ u ma'i ming / dka' zlog ka tya'i bu mo dang / /dkar ser skya mo nag mo gangs ldan ma//shi bā bha bā bhā ru dā bhā shadrwa bhā sattha saṃ ga khāḥ/ /a pashlau pāb tī dund+ra mṛ ḍā dbang mo zhi ma srid ma dang / /drag mo gsod ma kun la shis/ /ri skyes rdzong gnas lo ma ①med/ /chis nī tsaṇḍi kāmbi kāḥ// //byed gtum mo 'gro ba'i ma// //1 bi nā ya ke bi sna rā dza dwo mā tu ru ga ṇa dha pāḥ 3 / /1 tshogs bdag gi ming / log 'dren bgegs kyi rgyal po dang / /ma gnyis pa dang tshogs kyi bdag/a gye ka danta he radza lasbo da ra ga dzā na nāḥ// //mche ba gcig pa ha la gnas/ /lto ba 'phyang dang glang po gdong // //— / kā rti ke yo ma hā se na ma ra dzadmā ṣa ḍā na na ཿ / /sa gzhon nu smin drug gi bu'i ming / smin drug bu dang sde chen dang / /'dam bu'i tshal skyes gdong drug pa//padzee tī rgo da naḥskandaḥse nā rī raghi byurgu haḥ/ /bā hu le yastu ra ka dzi ri skyes dga' byed skem byed dang / /sde dpon me skyes sbed byed dang / /mang po las skyes sgol byed ju shā khaḥshi khi bā ha naḥ / / ṣārja tu raḥ sha spyi dha raḥ ku mā raḥ'adul—/ /gtsug phud can zhon sa ga skyes/ /ma drug pa dang mdung thogs dang / /gzhon nu dang ni groñtsa dā ra ṇaḥ// //khrung khrung 'joms// //— / ijo ma ru tā dma gha bā bi ḍo dzāḥ pā ka sā sa na ཿ / / thra 1 brgya byin gyi ming / dbang po lnga ldan mchod byed dang / /khyab stobs dang ni byun pa 'joms/ /rgan 110—360

dhi shra bāḥsu nā bhā raḥpu tu tū taḥpu re da raḥ/ /dzijuzlo kharṣa bhaḥlas nyan dang shis brjod nyan/ /gang po 'bod dang grong 'joms dang / /rgyal byed nus ldan legs bris sha kra sha ta ma rtse rdi ba sba ti ཿ / / sru tā mā go tra rnyi dma dzrī bā gtso—/ /mchod sbyin brgya pa mtho ris bdag /legs skyob ri 'joms rdo rje can/ /dbyig ldan sa bo bṛ tra hā bri ṣāḥ/ /bāstotpa tispu ra pa tirba lkukhā rā tiḥsha ṭī pa 'phel 'joms char 'beebs dang / /gnas kyi bdag po lha yi bdag /stobs ldan dgra dang bde sogs tiḥ—/ /dzambha bhe dī ha ri ha yaḥswā rāṭa na mu tsi sru da naḥ/ /satho bdag /rmugs byed 'joms dang 'phrog byed rta/ /mtho ris rgyal po grol byed 'joms/ /yang nda no du rgyu ba na stu rā ṣā ṭa me gha bā ha na ཿ / / ā kha ṇḍa laḥdag rgyu dang bzod dkas rengs/ /gzhan snyems bzod dang sprin la zhon/ /kun 'joms mig stong sa ha pākṣa ṛ bhu kṣu sta 3su tu pri yāḥ/ /pu lo ma dzā sha ṭīnd+rabhā nag rī twa ma ṛ yig skyes/ /de yi btsun mo spu gang skyes/ /bde sogs dang ni dbang mo'o/ /grong khyer 'chi ba ra ba tīḥlegs brjod zer/ /ha ya ustsoḥshra bāḥsru to mā ta lind+randa rgo ba rgo/ /tyātpā sā do med ldan te/ /rta ni mthor thos kha lo pa/ /mā ta li yin dga' byed ni/ /tshal te khang bzangs rnam bee ④dza yadho dza yantaḥbā ka sā sa niḥ/ /i rā ba tephobhra mā tai ga i rā ba ṇa bhra mu rgyal byed/ /rgyal byed dang ni smin 'joms bu/ /sprin gyi glang po sa srung bu/ /mtsho skyes dang ni chu babee bhāḥ/ /hru di ni badzra masdi sthā ta ku li shaṃ rbha du re pa biḥ/ /sha ta ko ṭiḥ'adzin glang / /sgra sgrogs rdo rje mo ma yin/ /lag nyal 'bigs byed thog dang ni/ /rtse mo brgya pa sgra swa ruḥshaṃ bo rda bho li ra sha nidwo yoḥ/ /byo ma yā rgo bi mā no.āoṃ nā ra dā byā srucan bde/ /sgogs zhum za byed gnyis dag go/ /mkha' theg mkha' gnas mo ma yin/ /lha yi drang srong rarṣa yaḥ/ /sthārlu dhasthā de ba sa bhā bi yu ṣa ma mṛ tai su dhāḥ/ /manda me sbyin sogs/ /chos bzang lha yi mdun sa dang / /btung rnams bdud rtsi bde par 'thungs/ /chu 110—361

ki dī bi yo gi gā swand+ra dī su ra dīṅgha kāḥ/ /me ruḥsu me ru he mā dī ratna bo dal 'bab mtho ris klung / /nam mkha'i gi gā bcud rings so/ /lhun po ri rab gser gyi ri/ /rin sā nuḥsu rā la yaḥ/ /pañtsa te de ba ta ra bo mand+ra raḥpā ri dzā ta kaḥ/ /sand+ra chen brtsegs dang lha yi gnas/ /lnga po lha yi ljon shing ste/ /mand+ra ra ba rgya mtsho skyes/ /legs khyab naḥkalpa dṛkṣashtsa thu si bā ha ri tsanda naḥ/ /santa ku mā ro bee ① dhā traḥswadang ni dpag bsam shing / /ha ri tsasdon skyes pa po rtags ⑤yang / /tshangs pa'i gzhon nu rnam byed bu//rbe zhe tyā pa shī bhā su toḥ/ /nā sa tyā bā shi kau da sru bā shī nee yo tsa tā shu byeḥ/ /mtho ris sman pa la rta'i bu/ /sna skyes tha skar skyes pa dang / /kun 'gyed tha skar skyes gnyis dag/ste yāsbra hu ṣṭabee ra saḥ swarbe shā uttha sī mu khāḥ/ /hā hā hu hu bye chu skyes mo ste mang po'o/ /mtho ris smad 'tshong dbang chen sogs/ /sbra ngan spangs dang dbyangs ba mā byā garnyadhā ste di bo ka sī// //'dems sogs/ /gnas skabs gsum na dri za'i glu// // 1 aghi bee shā na ro ba nniṭī ti ho tro dha nañdza yaḥ/ /kṛ spru ṭa yo 1 me'i mngon brjod/ 'khyog 'gro me dang rnyed za dang / /byin za nor las rgyal ba dang / /chu yi skye nirdzu la no dzā ta bee dāsta nu na pā taḥ/ /brnyiḥsuṣṭha kṛṇḍa baṭwā sho gnas 'bar ba can/ /skyes thob lus mi skyong ba dang / /shing 'phel skem byed lam nag dang / /'bar ba'i tsisko ④sha u ṣarbu dhaḥ/ /ā shā yā sho thra ha byu nuḥkṛ pā nu bā ba koskra can snga dro sad/ /rten za 'od zer chen po dang / /chung byed smin byed 'tsho byed dang / /rta dmar rlung gi phon laḥ/ /ro hi tā sho bā yu sa khā shi khā bā nā shu shukṣa ṇiḥ/ /hi ra 5 re ta hu grogs po dang / /gtsug phud can dang rtswa zan dang / /gser gyi thig le bsreg rdzas za/ /sreg byed ta bhusda ha no ha bya ⑤bā ha naḥ/ /sabhā khyurda mu nāḥshu krabye tra mtshun gyis thob byed dang / /'od bdun nyer zhi mya ngan byed/ /sna tshogs 'od zer 'od nor can/ /dag 110—362

bhā nu bi bhā ba suḥ/ /shu tsi rasprutta modzee stu bā ḍa bo ba ḍa bā na laḥ/ /bsne byed chu mkhris brang skyes dang / /rgod ma skyes dang ma rta'i me/ /lha mchod gnyis so 'bar ba dang / /me drwayodzā la tī lā brtsirte tiḥshi khāste yo/ /tri 6 sgu bo gophoghi ka ṇaḥsaṃ tā paḥlce yal me 'bar ba dang / /nyal ldan 'di ni mo yin no/ /gsum rnams me stag me skar dang / /shin tu saṃ dzwa rasga moḥ// //gdung ba tshang can mtshungs// // 1 dha nd+ra rā dzāḥpi z-i ba tiḥ sa ma ba rte pa re ta rāṭa ཿ/ / kṛ 1 gshin rje'i ming / chos kyi rgyal po pha gshin bdag /mtshungs 'jug gshin gyi rgyal po dang / /mthar tarnyo ya mu nā bhā ⑫tā sha ma no ya ma rāṭa ya maḥ/ /kā lo daṇḍa dha raḥshādha de byed ya mu na yi spun/ /zhi byed gshin rje gshin rje'i rgyal/ /grangs can dbyug 'dzin mtshun gyi lha//bo bai ba shwa tonta kaḥ// //nyi ma'i bu dang mthar byed do// // 1 rākṣa saḥkau ṇa paḥkra byāttha byu dophoshra pa ā sha raḥ/ /rā triñtsa ro 1 srin po'i mngon brjod/ srin po ro zan sha rjen za/ /sha za khrag 'thung kun du rgyu/ /mtshan mo rgyu dang rā tri tsa raḥ karbu ro ni ka ṣātma dzaḥ/ /yā tu dha naḥpu5 dza no nainam la spyod/ /sna tshogs mdog can gsod bdag skyes/ /'gro 'dzin bsod nams skye bo dang / /rje to yā tu rakṣa sīḥ// //bden bral rjes 'jug srung ba pa// // 1 pra tse tā ba ru ṇa ཿ pā shī pā da sādza ti ra bee ti ཿ / /1 chulha'i ming / mchog sems mchog sbyin zhags pa can/ /chu skyes bdag dang chu bdag go/ / 1 shwa sa naḥsparsha no ba yurmā ta ri shā sa dā ga tiḥ/ /thra ṣa 1 rlung lha'i ming / dbugs 'byin reg ldan ma mos 'phel/ /rtag 'gro rta spre dri len dang / /dri bzhon 110—363

da sho garnya ba ho ganta bā hā ni khā shu gāḥ/ /sa mbi ra mā ru ta ma rudzdza gatpā ṇa sa mbi rlung dang myur 'gro dang / /'gro byed rgyug byed yang dag rgyug /g.yo ba'i rang bzhin 'gro ba'i srog/ra shāḥ/ /na bha shwabye ta pa ba na pa ba mā na pra bhañdza nāḥ/ /pā rto3pā naḥnam mkha'i bdag po 'gro ba pa/ /gang phyed gang ldan rab 'joms so/ /srog dang thur sel mnyam sa ma nastso dā na byā no tsa bā ya baḥ/ /sha rī rasthā i me ri hasta ra shī tu ra yaḥganas dang / /gyen du rgyu dang khyab byed rlung / /'di rnams lus la gnas pa'o/ /skyong byed rgyug byed gya daḥ/ /dza bo3tha shrī st+waṃ twa ri tai la ghu kṣi pra ma re dru tai/ /sa twa ram̐ myur 'gro dang / /mgyogs 'gro shugs ldan de nas ni/ /myur mgyogs la gor skyen pa yu da/ /cig car tsa pa lo tūṇḍi ma bi lambi ta mā shu tsaḥ/ /sa ta tepho nā ra tā shānta sarnya tā mi thogs de ma thag /skad cig mi 'gor dar tsam mo/ /kun tu rgyun du ngal med dang / /mtshams tā bi ra tā ni shaṃ/ /ni tyā na ba ra tā dza shra ma su thā ti sha yo bha baḥ/ /med bar med rgyun mi 'chad/ /rtag tu ltos/ med res/ 'ga' min/ /de nas phul phyin 'bad pa dang //a ti bee la bhri shā tya rja ti ma tro sthā 1 ḍho ni sgo ram̐/ / tt+waṃ gru kādhā shin tu drag po te bor dang / /'bung bdo mthar byed shin tu gzhungs// /nan tar nges par brtan ni tānta ni gā bhā bā shwe dṛ ṭwā ni tsaḥ/ /llī bee shī ghā rya sa twa sthādhri ṣe ṣpe bhe pos kyang / /tsam med sri med nges 'bad dang / /sems med myur sogs ma ning ngo / /sems yod rya gā mi ya taḥ// //rnams/ la gsum kar 'byung // //— / ku be ra rgya sba ka sa kho ya kṣa rā ṭa gu hya ke shwa raḥ / /sa/ rnam sras kyi ming / lus ngan dang ni mig gsum grogs/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po gsang ba'i bdag/ma nu bye dhand+ra dha na do rā dza rā dzo dha nā bye paḥ/ /kinda re sho bai shra ba ṇaḥmi yi chos ldan nor sbyin dang / /rgyal po'i rgyal po gter gyi bdag /mi 'am ci dbang rnam thos bu//110—364

po la ste rmyen ra bā ha naḥ/ /yakṣe ka dzi gi la bi la shrī da puju dza nee shwa raḥ/ /'od yangs tsha bo mi la zhon/ /mchod sbyin mig skya e la'i rgyud/ /dpal ster bsod nams skye bo'i dbang //a phyodmā rgo tsi tra ra rja pu trastu na la kyu ba raḥ/ /nee lā saḥsthā na ma la sna tshogs shing rta de yi tshal/ /bu ni dpal mos mtshan pa can/ /rtse ba'i gnas dang grong khyer ni/ /kā pūmbi mā rgo tu pubee ki/ /sthātt+waṃnda raḥkithru ru ṣa stu ram̐ ga ba da no gzhal med khang mkha' gnas me tog can yin no/ /mi 'am ci dang skyes bu'am ci/ /rta yi gdong can 'gro ma yuḥ/ /ni dhirtswa se ba byebye dāḥpadma shaṃ khā da yo ni byeḥ// //mgyogs so/ /gter dang mdzod kyi dbye ba la/ /pad can dung can la sogs gter// //— / byo di bo dwo ste yā ba bye byo ma pu ṣka ra rma ba ram̐ na sa/ nam mkha'i ming / lha rtsen rol gnas gnyis po mo/ /'gro med kun khyab rgyas byed dang / /sgra bho3danta rī kṣ-i ga ga na ma nahaṃ su ra baṭwā ra khaṃ/ /bi yabyisngu ba rda bā sgrogs mkha' dang bar snang dang / /kun 'gro mtha' med lha lam gnam/ /mi g.yo ba dang khyab 'jug tu sum̐ sru kā sha bi hā ya mbiḥ / / di shastu ka ku bhaḥ kā ṣṭha ā shāshtsa gnas—/ /kun gsal rnam gol skyes bu'am/ /phyogs dang nyi ston gsal gnas dang / /kun khyab ha ri tashtsa tāḥ/ /drwa tsu bā ṭī pra tī tsusthāḥpūttha dakṣi ṇa pa— māḥ/ /utta 'phrog byed nyid kyang ngo / /snga dro gung dang phyi dro phyogs/ /shar dang lho dang nub dang ni/ /byang gi rā di gu dī ṭī myuji byuntu tri 6 dikta beḥ/ /irjo bye ba byāḥpi tra pa tinairje phyogs ni steng yin no/ /phyogs rnams gsum pa rnams su 'gyur/ /dbang po me dang gshin rje bdag/to ba ru kho ma ru taḥ/ /ku bee ra yī sha pa ta yaḥpūdrwa dī ṭwāṃ di shaṃ bden bral chu dang rlung lha dang / /lus ngan dbang ldan bdag po rnams/ /shar phyogs la sogs rim kra mā taḥ// //bzhin gnas// //110—365

sa/ e rā ba taḥpuṇḍa rī ko bā ma naḥku mu dolhañdza naḥ/ putpa dantaḥ1 glang po'i ming / mtsho skyes pad dkar phyir log khrus/ /sa mos gsal byed me tog so/ /sa kun la sānd+ra bye maḥsu pra tī kashtsa dig dzaḥ// //grags cha mdzes te/ /'di rnams phyogs kyi glang po'o// //1 ka ri kho ྅ blu muḥka pi lā dzi ga khāphonu pa mā kra māta/ /tā mra kahā 1 glang mo'i ming / glang mo chu 'dzin dmar ser dang / /ser skya dpe med rim pa las/ /zangs rna ma su bha dadzñā rtsa ga nā tsāñdza nā ba tree/ /rgo bā bya yi twa pa di shandi shond+ra dang so legs ma/ /yan lag mdzes dang gsal byed do/ /ma ning mi zad phyogs min rnams/ /phyogs bye bi di kaste yī/ /a bhyanta ram̐ twanta rā lañtsakra bā lantu maṇḍa lam̐// //dbus phyogs bral mo yi rtags/ /nang dang phyi rol min pa la/ /khor yug dang ni mu khyud can// //1 abyu mme gho bā ri bā haḥsta na yi hphuttha nyu lā ha kaḥ/ / dhā ra —/ sprin gyi ming / chu 'dzin chu 'beebs chu khur dang / /sgra sgogs chu yi bzhon pa dang / /rgyun 'dzin dha ro dza la dha rastaḍi tānd+ra ri dosru z-i rngo ta// //rlan 'dzin glog can dang / /chu sbyin gsher 'dzin tsha zer 'joms / —/ gha na dzī mū ta mu di ra dza la musbo ma yo na yaḥ / kā rda —/ char sprin gyi ming / chu rtsa dga' byed chu 'gyed dang / /du ba'i skye gnas chu skyar gnas/ /sprin gyi bi bhā me gha mā la tri 6 me gha bha beesnri yo/ /sta ni tai ga4 tai me gha nisgo phreng ba zhes pa dang / /sprin skyes chu las byung ba gsum/ /'brug dang sgra chen sprin gyi sgra/ /sgra can ṣe ra bi tā di tsa/ /saṃ bā sha ta hra da hru di bye rā ba tyaḥkṣa ṇa pra bhā/ /ta ḍiblo nyid la sogs pa'o/ /bde 'thung dang ni sgra brgya pa/ /sgra 'gyed chu skyes skad cig 'od/ /glog dang rnam dā ma — bi byustsoñtsa zhul tsa pa khā pi tsa/ /sgurdza thu badzra niṣpe ṣe ma ④gha gsal 'khyug byed dang / /skyod byed sdod med nyid kyang ngo / /thog gi sgra dang rdo rje'i sgra/ /sprin gyi 'od 110—366

byo ti ri rasma daḥ/ /ind+ra yu tt+waṃ shakra dha nu ta de pa ṛ dzu ro nyi ṣṭṛ/ /briṣṭṛ zer chu 'dzin skyes/ /dbang po'i mtshon cha brgya byin gzhu/ /de bzhin drang 'khyog ces bya'o/ /char pa barṣarnyabyi ghā tephob gā hā ba gra ho sa mo/ /dhā ra saṃ pā ta ā sā raḥshī ka zhod dang de yi gegs/ /than chen char 'gog mnyam pa'o/ /rgyun 'bab yongs lhung drag char ro//rophomyu ka ṇaḥsre tāḥ/ /bsgo pa lastu ka ra kā me gha tstshandephonni dudri rna/ /char rdul chu rdul chu yi zer/ /rdo rje'i char dang ser ba dang / /sprin 'khrigs nyin par yul ngan no//antaspyo bya ba dhwa sum̐ si twadhadhi ra pa bā ra rṇa/ /a pi dmā nati ro dhwa na pi mun pa 'thibs po skyes bu yi/ /mi mngon mi gsal ba dang ni/ /sgrib pa dang ni g.yogs pa dang //dhā na tstsha da nā ni tsa// //mi snang ba dang khebs pa'o// // 1 hi māṃ shu shtsand+ra mā shtsand+ra i nd+ra ཿ ku mu da ṭwāṃ dha ba ཿ / / bi 1 zla ba'i ming / bsil zer sim byed ga pur dang / /dbang po ku mud gnyen byed dang / /bdud dhu su ddhā shuḥsu ṭwāṃ shu ro ṣa dhī sho ni sā pa tiḥ/ /adzdza dzee bā dṛ kaḥso mo glo rtsi'i 'od dang 'od dkar can/ /rtsi yi dbang po mtshan mo'i bdag /'tsho byed chags byed rgya mtsho skyes//mṛ tsā kaḥka lā ni dhiḥ/ /dī dza rā dzaḥsha sha dha ro nakṣa tre shaḥkṣa pā 'grib byed cha gter ri dwags mtshan/ /gnyis skyes rgyal po ri bong 'dzin/ /rgyu skar dbang po mtshan ka raḥ/ /ka lā tu ṣe ḍa sho bhā go bisbo byā maṇḍa la tri 6/ /bhitt+waṃ mor byed/ /cha shas can dang bcu drug cha/ /gzugs brnyan mo min dkyil 'khor gsum/ /dum bu sha ka la khaṇḍi bā pu myarnyorghaṃ sa mephoṅga ke/ /tsadhri kā kau mu dī byisgyu pra sā cha nus dum phyed dang / /phyed phyed mnyam pa'i yan lag can/ /zla 'od kun phan sim 'od do/ /rab da stu pra sha nda tā / / ka lo ka kau lāñtsha na ñtsa tsi dzee ghra tsa ladangs rab tu gsal ba dang / /bdag can nyams can mtshan ma can/ /rtags can mtshan nyid mtshan 110—367

kṣa ṇi/ /su ṣa mā pa ra mā so bhā sho bhā kārnyi dku tishtsa biḥ// //byed can/ /kun mdzes mchog tu mdzes pa dang / /mdzes sdug legs dang ngo mtshar ro/ //— / a ba shā ya stu bee hā rastu ṣā rastu nyi rgo hi rma / / pā sa ri byi/ a ba shā ya ba mo ste/ /tu ṣā ra ni gangs skyes dang / /char skya khu 'phangs gangs skyes dang / /mchod le yi ma hi kā tsā tha ti mā byā nyi ma saṃ ha tiḥ/ /bhā tai gu ṇi tatpa daṭwāḥsu bya de nas kha ba ldan/ /kha ba tshogs pa gangs yin no/ /bsil ba'i yon tan de don 'dra/ /bsel ṣpe maḥsi si ro dza ḍaḥ/ /tu ṣā raḥshī ta laḥshi to hi mamabhā n+ya lo dang bser dang grang zhing 'khyags/ /lhags pa lhags ngar lhags ngar dang / /bdun po gzhan gyi rtags ga kāḥ/ /sgru ba autpā na pā diḥsthā da gasbyaḥkumbha saṃ bha baḥ/ /bee tā ba ru can no/ /brtan gnas dang ni rkang rten snebu/ /ri bos 'phangs dang bum pa skyes/ /grogs po chu lha'i ṇi ra gye ba lo hūṃ ṣā mu dā sa dhambi bhā/ /nakṣa tra mrikṣ-i bhand+ra rā tā ra kā bu de bzhin/ /zil gnon rgya can chos mtshungs ma/ /mi rgyu skar lhung 'gro byed 'od can dang / /skar byu che bast+ri yī/ /dākṣu ya byephoshwe — tyā di tā rā a shwa yu galhashwa bee/ /rām dkar po 'phur byed mo/ /gsal ba'i bu mo tha skar sogs/ /skar ma rta ldan rgod ma can/ /sgrub dhā bi shā khā bu bye tu se khyu ti stso shra biṣṭha yā/ /sa mā dha nijoskru ཿproṣṭha ba dā bha byed nyid ni sa ga'o/ /rgyal ni grub pa tshim byed do/ /mon gru nor ldan dag mtshungs 'gyur/ /khrums ni dra pa dāḥste yaḥ/ /mṛ gshīste smṛ ga shi rāsta sminde ba gra hā ya bhā/ /i lwa khāsta 3khyu ba lang rkang pa mo/ /mgo ni ri dwags mgo zhes bya/ /de la lo yi thog ma'o/ /de yi steng phyogs 'gro ro de she tā ra kā ni ba sarnyi yāḥ// //ldan gyi/ /skar ma rnams ni gnas pa'o// // sa/ z-i ha spa ti ཿ su rā tsādro gīspa ti dhi ṣa rto gu ruḥ / / dzī ba 1 phur bu/ lha bdag lha yi slob dpon dang / /dbyangs bdag blo ldan bla ma dang / /'tsho byed 110—368

st+waṃ gi ra so bā tsa spa ti— tra shi khaṇḍi dzaḥ// //phur bu smra ba'i bdag /sna tshogs gtsug phud can gyi bu// // 1 shu gro de tya gu ru kā bya u shā nā bhārga baḥka biḥ// //1 pa bsangs/ dkar po snyan dngags lha min bla/ /'od can pa sangs snyan dngags bu// //1 aṅgā ra kaḥmyuta ku dzo rbha mo lo hi tāsgo ma ṭī su taḥ// // sa/ mig dmar/ mig dmar sa skyes sa las byung / /lus dmar dang ni sa gzhi'i bu// //1 ro hi ṇi yo budhasgo myabee mo sau ri sha nashtsa ro// // 4/ lhag pa/'i lhag pa zla skyes snar ma'i bu/ /spenapa 'i nyi skyes dal 'gro mtshungs pa'o// // —/ ta mastu rā huḥswadhā nuḥbee hi ke yo bi dhuntu daḥ/ /sabeeste yo ma rī tsu sa/ sgra gcan mun can sgra gcan mtho ris mdzes/ /seng ge mo'i bu zla ba 'joms/ /'od zer can tri mu khāshyitra shi ṣa ṇḍi na ཿ / / rā shī nā mu da yo la sna dhe tu me sogs drang srong ni/ /bdun po sna tshogs gtsug pud she can/ /khyim rnams 'char ba dus sbyor te//ṣa thra ṣā da yaḥ// //de ni lug dang glang la sogs// // sa/ sru raḥ srurlurya mā di tya dā da shātma di bā ka rāḥ / / bhā ska 1 nyi ma'i ming / nyi ma 'od 'gyed bsten bya dang / /mi sbyin skyes dang bcu gnyis bdag /nyin ra haska ra bhra spyopra bhā ka ra bi bhā kā rāḥ/ /bhā swa byi bha swatmabhā shwa ha ri da byed 'od byed snang byed dang / /rab tu gsal byed rnam gsal byed/ /'od ldan rnam gsal rta bdun shoṇḍa rasma yaḥ/ /bi kasto nāryā martaṇḍa bdud las rgyal zhes brtag gnyis su 'brog 'umis bsgyur mi hi pa—/ /rta ljang can dang 'od zer can/ /rnam bsgyur mchod 'os mngal na sdug /cha ཿ'beebs 'od rā tu ṇa pū ṣa ṇaḥ/ /rlu ma ṇista ra ṇirmi trashyi tra bhā nurngi ro tsa naḥ/ /'gro gso byed dang / /nam mkha'i nor bu sol byed bshes/ /sna tshogs 'od dang rnam snang byed//110—369

bi bhā ba su gra ha pa tist+ri ṣā sba ti ra ha rba tiḥ / / bhā nuhaṃ saḥ'od kyi nor can gza' yi bdag /'od zer bdag po snang byed bdag /'od can 'joms byed 'od sa ha tpā shusta pa naḥs baṃ tā ra biḥ/ /mā ṭha ra dzi ga lo daṇḍa shtsazlo shoḥstong pa/ /gdung byed 'od 'byin 'od zer gzugs/ /gnas byed dmar ser dbyug can gyis/ /nyi ma'i pā ri pāsgyi kāḥ/ /sru ra sru to3ru ḍonyabyu tuḥkā su pirga ru ḍā gra dzaḥ/ /pa ri 'od la yongs su bskol/ /nyi ma'i kha lo skya rengs dang / /brla med 'od srung khyud sngon skyes/ /yongs bee ṣastu pa ri bye ru pa srurya ka maṇḍa le/ /ki ra rṇa pra ma yu khaṃ shu bskor yongs su dkris pa dang / /nye ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /'ded byed 'od byed nam mkha' ga bhaste 1 ṇi j-i ṇḍa yaḥ/ / bhā nuḥ ka ro ma rī tsiḥ sdi sum̐ sa yodri 'jal—/ /phyogs 'gro 'od 'go chu 'thung phod/ /gsal ba 'od byed srin bu 'joms/ /mo dang skyes bye tiḥtri yīḥ/ /skruḥpra bhā ru gu tsi twesthā bhāsba bi byu ti dībee yaḥ/ /ro bu gsal byed mo/ /'od dang gsal ba snang ba sgron/ /snang gsal 'od dang 'od zer dang / /'od tsiḥsho tsi ru bhe llī bee sthā kā sho byo ta ā ta paḥ/ /koṣṭi ka boṇḍasme doṇḍaṅka mdangs gsal sgron ma ning ngo / /mun sel mun 'joms mtshan mo sel/ /cung dro bag dro dro tsam dang //droṣṭadhri 6 tabi ti/ /tiglaṭī āoṃ kha rantabla tt+waṃ ga treṣṭha ma rī tsi kā// //dro ba de ldan gsum yin no/ /tsha ba rab tsha tsha drag go/ /de bzhin byug rgyu ri dwags sred// //— / kā lo disgo bee — hā pi sa ma yo bya tha bakṣa ti/ /pra ti babye 4/ lo'i ming / bgrang bya dus dang slar byung dang / /nye bar 'gro dang de nas ni/ /phyogs rtsa 'phel i maste twe ta rā 2 byāste tha yadrwa yoḥ / / gha sro di nā ha — ba 'grib 'di gnyis mo/ /de sogs tshes bdag gnyis dag go/ /mun bsal nyin mo bya spangs bsal//ru llī bee di bā sa ro/ /pra kyu ṣe3harmu khaṃ ka lya mu ṣaḥpra byu ṣaḥrpā a yang na ma ning rtse nas 'joms/ /mun dngas nyin 1mo rab sad sred/ /nam langs pa dang rab snga 110—370

pi / /pra bhā tañtsa di nādhetu sā yi sartsu pi z-i pra sruḥ/ /pāsnra pa gsal—/ /nyi ma'i mtha' dang dgongs mo dang / /thun mtshams dang ni pho skyes so/ /snga dro phyi dro nyi rā ṇḍa ma dhyāṭwā ste saṃ dhya ma tha sharba rī/ /ni shā ni shrī tha bhā rā triste ma'i gung / /thun gsum de nas bya bral dang / /bsam gtan gnas dus mtshan mo dang / /yā mā kṣa ṇa dā kṣa yāḥ / / bi bhā ba rī ta ma shī ju ra dza rī yā mi thun gsum dal ster bsam pa spangs/ /snang bzlog nam dang rdul dang ni/ /thun sbyor chags nī ta mbi/ / ta mi shā tā ma shī rā tri rdzubyu tsadhri ka hūṃ yā nī tā / /dus snang med dang / /mun mtshams mun pa'i nam dang ni/ /snang mtshan zla ba dang ldan pa/ /ā gā mi ba rta mā nā ha rlu kyā yā nni shi pa kṣi bhā / /: ma 'ongs da ltar gnyis ldan pa'i/ /mtshan mo de na phyogs ldan no/ /: mtshan mo dang bcas nyin mo ni/ /phyogs bcas kun 'gro'i lam yin no/ /zhes 'gyur khyad byung /ga ṇa rā tram̐ ni sha ba hū ཿbra do sngo rā dza byā mu khaṃ/ /asto rā tra mtshan mo tshogs pa zhag rnams dang / /mtshan mo'i dang po nam gyi gdong / /nam phyed mtshan ni shrī tho dwo dwo yā ma pra ha ro sha mo / / sa pa rba saṃ dhi ཿ pra phyed gnyis dag gnyis/ /thun dang mel tshe gnyis dag mtshungs/ /tshigs dang mtshams dang tshes ti pa tpa ñtsa da bye dma da nta ram̐ / / pa kṣu dho pa ñtsa da bye dwo ཿ po ṇḍi mā gcig dang / /bco lnga yi ni mthar thug pa/ /phyogs kyi mtha' ma bco lnga gnyis/ /zla ba gang ba sī pya tu pūṇḍi mā/ / ka lnga ṭī de pālhanu ma tiḥpurte rā kā ni sā ka 'jal byed rdzogs/ /cha nyams rjes 'gro gang ba dang / /mtshan phyed mtshan mo mthong bar rirju—/ /a mā bā myu twamā ba st+ra darshaḥsrudrend+ra saṃ ga maḥ/ /sā dṛbyend+raḥsi byed—/ /gnam stong lhan cig byed dang mthong / /nyi ma zla ba lhan cig gnas/ /zla mthong zla ba gzhon nī bā lī sa naṣṭind+ra ka lā ku huḥ/ /u pa rā go gra ho rā hu graste twesdo tsa nu'o—/ /zla ba nyams dang cha nyams so/ /nyer 'tshe gza' ni 'jug par byed/ /nyi ma zla ba gza' 110—371

she mu thi ma ti ཿ / / pre sgo pa la bhi shtsatt+waṃ bi nd+ra ti ba da rnyebye tse dang shes rab nyal slong blo gros/ /yid ldan mthong dang dmigs ldan sems/ /legs rtogs go shes ta nāḥ/ /dhīspyo ra ḍā ba tī me dhā saṃ lku kalpaḥkand+ra mā na saṃ/ / tsitta sems pa'o/ /mi brjed 'dzin nus dran bzang po/ /kun rtog dang ni yid kyi las/ /sems kyi bho go ma na sthā ra shtsastso saṃ khyu bi tsa ra ṇa ཿ / / a dhyā hā ra sta rga longs spyod yid kyi las/ /dpyod dang bgrang dang rnam par dpyod/ /lhag par dpyod dang rtog ge spru ho bi tsi kiṣṭha tu saṃ sha yaḥ/ /saṃ de ha dā pa ro tsā tha sa mo niṇḍi ya dang / /rtog dang the tsom som nyi dang / /neem nur dang ni yid gnyis dang / /de nas mtshungs pa nishtsa yo/ /mi byā dṛṣṭirtswaste ka tā byā pā do dro ha tsinta rna/ / sa gtan phebs des/ /log par lta ba med pa pa/ /gnod sems 'tshe bar sems pa dang / /mtshungs mo se ddhā nta rā dhā rnyo bhā rnyi smi byā ma ti sgo ma ཿ / / sa bi dā gruḥ pra pa grub mtha' bzung ba'i sems/ /'khrul pa log shes nor ba'i sems/ /khas len phyogs bzung dam ti dzñā rgo ni ya mā shra ba bye saṃ shra bāḥ/ /e gī ka rā byu ba ga ma pra bca' dang / /nges pa mnyan bya yang dag thos/ /bdag gir byas dang khas blangs dang / /so sor ti shra ba sa mā dha yaḥ/ /mokhyo dhīdzñā snyen ma n+ya tra bi dzñā rgo shilpa sast+ra yoḥ/ /mnyan bya ting nge 'dzin/ /thar dang blo dang shes pa gzhan/ /rnam shes bzo dang bstan bcos so//mu sti kai ba lya ni sthā ṇa gre yo di ཿ gre ya sā mṛ tai / / mo sgo3 pa grol ba ma 'dres mya ngan 'das/ /rab bsngags nges legs 'chi med dang / /thar ba dang ni spangs pa'o//brgophothā ④tshwa na ma bi byā hasma tiḥst+ri yī/ /rū paṃ shasdo ra sa sparsha garsāshtsa de nas mi shes ma rig dang / /bdag gi blo gros mo yin no/ /gzugs dang sgra dang ro dang reg /dri ste bi ṣa yā a mbi/ /go tsa rā idhri yāṅgāshtsa z-i ṣpe shaṃ bi ṣa yīnd+ra yi/ /'di rnams yul rnams so/ /spyod yul dang ni dbang don dang / /yul can yul dang dbang po dang //110—375

karme dhri kyeyantu pā yā di ma no nee tā di dhī jo yi/ /tu ba ra sta kā ṣā yophobyā las kyi dbang po kha la sogs/ /yid dang mig sogs blo yi dbang / /chu rten bska ba mo min no//ma dhu ro la ba ṇaḥka ṭuḥ/ /tiktophoslashtsa ra sāḥsum̐ se tadma khru 3ṣa ṭa pi tri 6/ /mngar dang lan tshwa tsha ba dang / /kha dang skyur dang ro rnams ni/ /skyes bu de ldan drug po'ang gsum//bi mardorje pa ri ma lo gadhe dza na ma no ha re/ /ā mo daḥso ti niṭwā rī bā tsu liṅga rnam nyed sbyar spos dri dang ni/ /skye bo'i yid 'phrog kun mos dang / /ring 'gugs brjod bya'i yon tan twa mā gu shāta/ /sa mā kabhā tu nirta rī su ra bha ghā ṇa tadzdza rjaḥ/ /iṣṭa gandhaḥsu min / /mtshungs pa 'bod byed ring du khyab/ /dri bzang sna tshim 'dod dri dang / /dri zhim legs garnyiḥmyu dā mo dī mu kha bā sa naḥ/ /pū ti garnyi stu durgarnyo bi shaṃ sthā dā ma garnyi yata// //'thul kha la chags/ /rul dri dang ni dri ngan no/ /mi gtsang ba dang bsur dri'o// //sa / shukla shu bhra shu tsi shwe ta bi sha da bye ta pā ṇḍa rāḥ / / a sa/ dkar po dag byed dkar gsal dang / /mdog dkar gzhan gcod dkar snum dang / /skya ba dā taḥ si to go ra ba lakko dha ba lophordzu naḥ/ /ha ri ṇa pāṇḍa bsangs dag mdog yid sdebs dang / /mdog dkar mig stobs dkar dang sgrub/ /skya ser ser skya raḥpāṇḍa rī ṣatpāṇḍa stu dhū sa raḥ/ /kṛsgo nī lā si ta shā ma kā la shā ma la dkar skya'o/ /cung skya dang ni 'ol kha'o/ /nag po sngon po dkar min dang / /sngo bsangs mdog nag me tsa kāḥ/ /dzī to go ro ha ri dā bhaḥpa khā sho ha ri to ha ri ta// //nag lhang dang / /ser po ser shang yung nga mdog /ljang gu ljang ser lo ma'i mdog/ //1 ro hi to lo hi to rakta sho ṇaḥko ka na datstsha biḥ/ /a byagha 3rā gasta — / dmar po le brgan khrag gi mdog /dmar ba utpal dmar po dang / /mi gsal dmar rtsa skya ru ṇa ཿ shwe ta rakta stu pā ṭa laḥ / / shya ba sgyurka pi so dhū mra dhū ma rengs mdog /dkar dmar 'dres pa dmar skya'o/ /ser nag dang ni nag ser ro/ /dmar nag dud 110—376

lo kṛṣṭa lo nyi te/ /ka ḍā raḥka pi laḥpiṅga pi saṃ go ka dru piṅgā lo/ / tsi ka mtshun kha'o/ /gser mdog ser skya skyer kha dang / /dkar ser dur kha gi wang mdog /sna tram̐ kedhī ra kaṣṭha ṣa sha ba le tāshtsa karbu re/ /gu ṇi shuklu da ya kyeḥthu si gu tshogs zal po 'dres ma dang / /khra bo kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /yon tan dkar po la sogs pho/ /yon ṇi bo gāstu tadma tiḥ// //tan rtags can de ldan 'gyur// //— / sho bhā sho ṇa tha pi sadhī piṅga khā ha ri ṇi twe yi/ /ha ri tai 1 dkar dmar ma dang dmar dkar ma/ /de nas dkar ser dmar ser ma/ /dkar gser ma ni nītta ta dzee tā bye nī bye tā mi tā tsa sā/ / nī le ba ste bā 3 nāmbi ljang mo'i tshul/ /de bzhin sna tshogs khra mo dang / /sngo ljang ma yang de yin no/ /nī la gos kyi ming nyid nī lī pā 5 1 ṇi ni tso ṣa sgo / / ro hi bhā ro hi tā ra ghra lo dam—/ /rī lī srog chags sman pa dag /dmar mo ro hi tā dang ni/ /ro nyi tsā dang lo nyi bhā/ /de hi — lo hi tā tsa sā/ /lo hi ti kā lo hi ni kā ④ rā ga ta khye ko pā bzhin lo nyi tā yang ngo / /lo hi ti kā chags mdog gam/ /lo hi ni kā khros mdog ste/ /de sogs skyes di nā pi bā// //pa'i rtags kyang yin// //4 / bra dhī tu bhā ra tree bhā ṣā gīrpāghā ṭwā sa ra swa tī/ /byā hā ra uttarla pi haṃ 1 tshangs byung bhā ra ta yi skad/ /sgra dang brjod pa dbyangs can dang / /tha snyad gsung dang smra ba bhā ṣi tai ba tsa rgo ba tsaḥ/ /a pa rja shophopa shasdaḥgyatshwa ste sasdastu bā tsa dang / /gtam dang lo rgyus tshig ces bya/ /zur chag dang ni sgra nyams pa/ /rjod byed bstan bcos sgra kaḥ / /ting su banta tsa yo bā kyi kri yā bā kā ra kā bee tā/ /khru tiḥbyā bee da la ni/ /ting su ba yi mtha' can tshig /bya ba dang ni byad ldan pa/ /thos pa mo'o rig byed man 110—377

artswa yast+ra yī dhand+ra tu tabyi dhiḥ/ /ste yā mṛkrā ma ya dzu ṣpe i ti bee ngag /gsum po de ni chos su sgrub/ /snyan dngags nges brjod mchod sbyin lo/ /'di gsum rig byed dā st+ra ya st+ra yī ཿ / / shi kṣe tyā di shu te ra ṅga ma ṅgā ra pra gsum pa yin/ /bslab sogs bslab pa rtog pa/ nges tshig /brda sprod/ sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis thos pa'i ṇa bo sa mo / / i ti hā sa ཿ pu rā thra tta mu dā tta tyā st+ra yan lag ste/ /oṃ yig pra ṇa ba dag mtshungs/ /sngon rabs sngon du byung ba'o/ /u dā ṭwā sogs ya swa rāḥ/ /ā rtswa kṣi kri daṇḍa byā tt+waṃ tarka bi byārja shāst+ra yoḥ/ /ā gsum dbyangs rnams/ /rtsod pa dang ni chad pa'i lugs/ /rtog ge rig don bstan bcos dag /gtso khyu yi ko ba ladzñālbā pu rā khaṃ bañtsa lakṣa rde/ /pra brnya kalpa nā ka thā pra bo'i ngag ni bka' lung ste/ /sngon rabs mtshan nyid lnga yin no/ /rab sbyar rtog pa gtam rnams dang //bachi kā pra he li kāḥ/ /smṛ tistu dhand+ra saṃ hi ta sa mā z-i tistu saṃ gra haḥ/ /brda 1yis ston dang go dka'o/ /dran pa chos dang bcas pa rnams/ /legs par bsdus dang bsdus pa'o//sa ma myu tu sa ma sārba ki ba daṭī dza na shu tiḥ/ /bāṭwā pra z-iṭībrittanta tshig sdud pa dang bsdus pa'i don/ /gang zhig brjod dang skye bos thos/ /gtam dang lo rgyus kha skong u danta sgyu da thā hwa yaḥ/ /ā khyaṅge a rnyi dhā rna tsa nā ma dhe yañtsa dang / /bka' mchid yin te de nas ni/ /ming dang zhes dang mtshan dang ni/ /mngon par brjod dang nā ma tsa/ /hu ti rā kā ra ṇa hā rna saṃ hu tirba huḥbhi kṛ tāḥ/ /bi bā ming du brjod/ /'bod pa dang ni skad gtong dang / /yang dag 'bod pa mang pos bos/ /rnam par do bya ba hā raḥmyu du ba tyā sastu bādru khaṃ/ /u porsā ta u dā hā raḥrtsod dang tha snyad dang / /nye bar 'god dang smra ba'i sgo/ /nye bar 'jal dang dper brjod do/ /mna' sha ba du rgo sha pa thaḥpu mān/ /pra sgolha nu yo gaḥdṛ sgo tsa pra ti bākyotta re sa me/ /dang gos 'don skyes bu'o/ /'dri dang rjes sbyor shes 'dod do/ /slar smra ba dang lhan cig mtshungs//110—378

mi byā rbha yo gophosgyu khyu na ma tha mi byā bhi shaṃ sa rgo/ /a bhi shā log par mngon sbyor ngan brjod dang / /de nas log smra sun 'byin dang / /mngon 'dod legs paḥpra zla da stu shajaḥmyu da nu rā ga dza/ /ya shaḥkritt+waṃḥs mā dzñā tsasta baḥsto par smra ba yi/ /sgra ni rjes chags skyed pa'o/ /snyan dang grags pa yang dag shes/ /bstod tshig trand+ra tiḥstu tiḥ/ /ā mre ḍi ta dīste rukta muñtsizlu ṣṭantu sgo ṣa rja/ /bkur tshig bsngags pa smra/ /skyor 1tshig gnyis gsum brjod pa'o/ /sgra co gsang mthon po skad po che//kā kuḥste yāmbi kā ro yaḥsho ka bhā tyā di bhi dhwa neeḥ/ /a patsā kṣe pa cong ④skad mo dang rnam 'gyur dang / /mya ngan 'jigs sogs las byung sgra/ /mi bsngags sdigs tshig nirpā da pa ri bā dā pa bā da bta/ /u pa gro sho dzu gusgyu tsa kund+ra rgond+ra tsa nges par rgol/ /yongs smod sun 'byin khro tshig dang / /gshe ngudang smod dang brgyad pa dang / /rngan garta ṇi/ /pā ru 6 ma ti bā daḥtyādzhaṭwā nadhwa pa ka rā gīḥ/ /yaḥs ninda u pā phyar dang ni tshig rtsub dang / /mngon smra tshig ngan dma' 'bebs tshig /gang de skyon ni nyer dmigs lambha sta tra sgyutpa ri bhā ṣa rde/ /ta tra tā kṣu ra ṇa yaḥsgyu dā kro she mai thu rna pra tiḥ/ /pa—/ /de la yongs su brjod pa'o/ /de la g.yo ba gang yin pa/ /ā gro sha ni 'khrig tshig yin/ /sthā dā bhā ṣa ṇa mā lā baḥpra lā pophonarba kasbra tsaḥ/ /a nu lā po mu hudhā sngo bi khā paḥkhams bde dang ni 'dri ched do/ /la ba lo pa don med tshig /rjes su smra ba yang yang smra/ /mya ngan ba ri de ba rgo/ /bi pra lā po bi ro sgottaḥsaṃ khā po bhā ṣa ṇambi thaḥ/ /tshig dang gdung ba'i tshig /tshig 'gog 'gal ba brjod pa'o/ /phan tshun brjod dang smra ba'o/ /su pra khā paḥsu ba ca ⑤na ma pa khā pastu ni tna baḥ/ /sande sha bāsthā tsi 'gal ba dang di shin tu bral/ /shin tu legs smra legs par brjod/ /gsang tshig gsang ba'i gtam kai sgyu bye ste ⑥ dāstu tri jutta re/ /u ṣa tī bā ga kasthā bhā sthāṅka dang ni/ /tshig gi skyes dang tshig spring dang / /ngag gi dbye gsum phyi ma la/ /mi dge'i tshig ni sdig pa 110—379

spyo tu shu bhādzre kā/ / a tya rja ma dhu ram̐ shā tt+waṃ saṃ ga tai dzdza da yo yin—/ /dge ba'i tshig ni legs pa'o/ /shin tu snyan dang zhi ba dang / /legs par smra dang yid la ga maḥ/ /nibyu raspa ru ṣe gā bye twa shrī ①lo sre dṛ taspri ye/ /sa byelhatha bab—/ /khro ba'i tshig ni tshig rtsub bo/ /mtshang 'dru ba dang mtshang slong ngo / /drang gtam dga' saṃ ku la klisne khya pa raspa ra sa rā ha te/ /lubee ba ṇḍi pa rda grastanni byed bden pa dang / /de nas 'gal dang rang tshig 'gal/ /phan tshun 'joms par byed pa'i tshig /ra st+waṃ twa ri to di tai / / amyu kṛ tai sa ni jo ba ma ba rghaṃ sgyu da yig 'bru tshig mi gsal dang dig /tshig stabs myur du brjod pa'o/ /chu 'thor gtam dang mchil narba kai/ /a na kṣa ra ma bā lcu sgyu dā ha dantu za lku ṣārba ke/ /a tha gtam mo/ /'byel med dang ni don med gtam/ /yi ge med dang brjod bya bral/ /don stong tshig dang mbiṣṭa che ma bi sbaṭaṃ bi ta baṃ twa 5dṛ taspra tsaḥ/ /sa tyanta thā mṛ tai bye brdzun don can/ /de nas mi gsal mi mngon tshig /de nyid med dang slu ba'i tshig /bden dang de sa mya ga spru ni tri 6 tadma ti ghu/ /shasde ni nā da ni na da dhwa zuni spyo na bzhin mi slu dang / /yang dag 'di rnams gsum de ldan/ /sgra dang nges sgogs grags pa dang //ra ba swa nāḥ/ /swā na nisgo ṣa nidra da ni swā na ni swā nāḥ/ /a ra bā sgrogs pa ca co ku co dang / /lhang tsher nges sgrogs nges sgra dang / /ding 'ur dang ni shu sgra sgogs//rā ba saṃ rā ba bi rā bā a tha marma krag krog raḥ/ /swā ni te bast+ra patsā māṃ byu ṣa smos grag skad 'don dbyangs rnams so/ /de nas shod sgra sho sgra ni/ /gos dang lo ma rnams kyi sgra//ḍā nāntu shiñdzi tai/ /ni kā kho ni kwa ṇa kā naḥkwa ṇaḥkwa ṇa na mi tya pi/ /bī ṇa rgyan rnams dang ni sil khrol sgra/ /pi wang sgra ni ni kwa ṇa/ /mi gsal kwa ṇa kwa ṇa sgogs/ /pi wang yāḥkwa ṇi te pā deḥpra kā ṇaḥpra kwa ṇa da yaḥ/ /ko lā ha laḥka la ka la ste raṭwāṃsthā sgrogs pa la sogs pa/ /mi gsal pra kwa ṇa la sogs/ /ca co dang ni ku co dang / /dud 'gro'i sgra ni 110—380

ra bī ra ka ru ṇartse ta hā su bha yā na kaḥ/ /bī bhatpa ro dre tsa ra sāḥdapa' dang snying rje dang / /rngam dang dgod dang 'jigs su rung / /mi sdug pa dang drag shul nyams//shri gā raḥshu tsi ru dzwa laḥ/ /urlu ha barbha no bī raḥkā ru tram̐ ka ru ṇa1 rja/ /sgeg pa gtsang dang 'bar ba dang / /spro ba 'phel ba dpa' ba yin/ /snying rje thugs rje brtse ba dang //kṛ pā da ya su nu kaspra ྅bee nu gro sholhapya tho ha saḥ/ /hā so hā dbang byed brtse ba — gtong dang rjes su brtse/ /rjes su khro ba nyid kyang ngo / /de nas dgod dang suñtsa bī bhatt+waṃ bi kṛ tai tri ṣi rda dwa yo/ /bisma yobyu ① ta mārtswaryañtsi tra ma bzhad gad mo/ /mi sdug mi legs dag ni gsum/ /'di gnyis ngo mtshar rmad byung dang / /mtshar che pya tha bye ra baṃ / / dā ru ṇa byu ṣa ṇa st+ri ṣṭha stso pya ra mbha yā na phul byung de nas ni/ /'jigs rung mi bzad 'jigs par byed/ /sngangs byed skrag byed 'jigs pa ka —/ / bha yaṅka raspra ti bha yo ro drand+ra gra ma mbi tri 6/ / tsa dang / /'jigs sde 'jigs can 'jigs par byed/ /drag po drag shul 'di rnams gsum/ /bcu turda sha da ra tā sau dzñā ti ṭwāṃ byesthā dhwa saṃ bha yi/ /bi kā ro mā na so bhā bo bzhi dngangs skrag nyam nga dang / /bag tsha sā dhwa kun nas 'jigs/ /yid kyi rnam 'gyur bhā ba yin//lhanu bhā ba bhā ba bo dha kaḥ/ /garbolhabhi mā nolhahaṃ kā ro mā na— tta sa munda a nu nyams su myong bhā ba khong du chud/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal nga rgyal khengs/ /ngar byed sems nyid khengs tiḥ—/ /a nā da raḥpa ri bha baḥpa ri bhā bsnyi raskyi yāḥ/ /ri ṭalhab mā na nāphob pa'o—/ /ma gus yongs smod zil gnon dang / /mi rtsi zhum byed mi mchod dang / /mi gus mi shes dzñā a ba he la ma srukṣa rṇa/ /mand+ra kṣ-i twest+ra yā bī ḍā ladzdza sā pa tra pā n+ya taḥ/ /kṣurnyi brnyas dang smod/ /mig dman 'tsher ngo zhum pa dang / /'dzem dang ngo tsha de gzhan 'dzem/ /bzod pa ste tikhyolhabhi dhyā tu pa ra shwe bi ṣa ma z-i hāḥ/ /akṣurnyi rīdhyā sru yā tu do dang ni nus pa'o/ /brnab ④sems pha rol nor ma chags/ /mi bzod pa ni phrag dog go/ /yon tan 110—383

nismo kau kṣe ḍastu ga ra lambi ṣe/ /sum̐ sillī bee tsa kā ko la kā la kyu ṭa ha khā ha khāḥ//shun pa'o/ /dug dang rus pa la sogs so/ /skyes pa ma ning kā ko la/ /ha lā ha lā nag po brtsegs//sā roji kaḥsolki ① ke yo brahma pu traḥpra dī pa naḥ/ /dā ra do batma nā bhashtsa (pya bi ṣa mi gsal rngub dang khrag gi dug /tshangs dug rab gsal 'joms byed ster/ /bu ste dug dbye 'di snye dā a mbi nab/ /bi ṣa bai byo 1rdzu gu li ko byā la gā tyā hi tuṇḍi kaḥ/ /myund+ra ra kastu rnams dgu/ /dug gi sman pa dug sel dang / /sbrul 'dzin dang ni sbrul khas 'tsho/ /dmyal ba dang ni na ra ko ni ra yo durga tiḥste yī/ / ta dhe dāsta pa nā bī tsi ma hā ro ngan 'gro'i mthil/ /'dod 'bras bral dang ngan 'gro'o/ /de yi dbye ba tsha ba dang / /mnar med ra ba ro ra bāḥ/ /saṃ ghā taḥkā la sru trabye tyā byāḥs tāstu nā ra kāḥ/ /dang ni ngu 'bod che/ /ngu 'bod bsdus 'joms thig nag sogs/ /sems can dmyal ba las skyes ni//pre tā bai ta ra bhā sind+raḥsthā da la ṭīstu ni rje ④tiḥ/ /biṣṭi rā dzreḥka ra rja tu yā yi dwags rab med chu bo che/ /dpal min pa dang phun tshogs min/ /gzhan byus 'asprul dang ngan khyab po//ta bhā tī khyabra bee da nā/ /tpā phyaḍā bā dhā bya thā du dza kyemā mā na sri pra sru ti mnag dka' mi bzod tshor ba bdo/ /zug rngu zug gzer na ba dang / /sdug bsngal yid 'grogs skye las rdza / /sgyuṅka ṭaṃ kṛ ldutstsha mā bhe lo tri ṣe ṣpe ste rya gā mi yata// //skye—/ /bro 'tshal gcod sbyor 'jigs pa len/ /de rnams gsum du dbye bas 'gro// //1 sa mu drophobye ra kyu sā raḥpā rā bā raḥs ritpa tiḥ/ /u da nā nu da dhismintuḥ 1 rgya mtsho chu 'dzin zla bas 'phel/ /pha rol 'grib dang chu klung bdag /chu srel dang ni 'bab sa ra swā dmā ga ro lha ṇḍi ba ཿ / / ra tna ka ro dza la ni bye ryā ldan dang / /chu can mtsho can dug can mtsho/ /rin chen 'byung gnas chu gter dang / /chu srin daḥpa ti ra ṭwāṃ pa tiḥ/ /ta gya pra bhe dā spyi rā do la ba rto dasta thā pa re/ /ā pāḥbadag po chu bdag go/ /de yi rab dbye 'o ma'i mtsho/ /ba tsha'i rgya mtsho de bzhin gzhan/ /chu ni mo ste 110—387

sta ra ṇi sta riḥ/ /u che bantu bla tūbaḥko laḥsro tombu sa ra ṇi swa taḥ/ /dang sgrol byed sgrol/ /rkyal dang chu dbal 'phyan 'dzin no/ /rgyun dang rab 'bab 'bab chu'o//ā ta rasta ra pa bye sgyusbyo shā kā ṣṭhambu bā hi bhā/ /māṃ ya tri kaḥpo ta ba ni gru btsas mnyan pa'i gla yin no/ /chu klung dang ni shing 'bab chu/ /gling gzhan rgyu dang gru yi tshogs//kkaṇḍi dhā rastu nā rngubi kaḥ/ /ni yā ( ma kāḥpo ta ba hāḥkyu ba ko gu ṇa bṛkṣa kaḥ/ /no rlung yor thogs dang gru ba'o/ /bya ra ba ni grus 'gro ba/ /steng na yon tan shing las so/ /gru skul kā daṇḍaḥkṣe pa bhā sde da ri traṅka ④ṇi yā ta kaḥ/ /yā na pā trantu bond+ra bi bha bee sā mu dri dbyug pa 'phen byed yin/ /gru skya dang ni g.yob byed do/ /gru yi bzhon pa dang ni gru/ /rgya mtsho'i yadhri 6ཿ/ /sā mu dri ko smam nu ṣyosgo dzā tā do kauḥsā mu dri kāḥ/ /llī be adzha nā rdzas dang 'byor pa'o/ /chu mi dang ni rgya mtsho sa/ /gru sogs skyes dang gru chung sa/ /sgrol byed gru phyed ma baṃ nā borte a tī ta kau ke3ti nust+ri 6/ /a bhriḥbyā kāṣṭha kubyā laḥshe ka pā trantu se tsa rgo//ning ngo / /bsgral zin gru ni a ti nu/ /shing gi tog tse gru sbyar mo/ /chu gzhong dang ni chu 'thor snod//stu ṣa gā dhāttha sarjophotstshaḥka lu sngophonatstsha ā bi la/ /ni snaṅga dī re ga: gting med gsum ste gtsang dang dngas/ /'dam khu mi dngas rnyog pa can/ /gzhol dang zab mo gting ra mu tā rgo tabyi parya ye/ /a gā dha ma ta la gya saṃ ke brte dā sa dhī ba ro/ /rings so/ /de las bzlog pa tshad yod do/ /gting med dang ni mazil mi rag /rkyal chen chu mi nya ba'o//ā nā ya6 ཿras skud kyi nya rgya purmi dzā waṃ sha na'i skud pa/'i nya rgya st+ratstsha na sru tram̐ ba bi tra ko/ /matma dhā — dol dang nya yi rgya yin no/ /lcags kyu dang ni nya 'bigs so/ /sgyug ma'i nya rgya ku bee ṇi/ /ku bee ṇi sthādma ḍi sa madhya bee dha rgo/ /thra 3thu ro mā dzha ṣe marmyo mbi no bai shā ri rdolhaṇḍa dzaḥ//mchil pa dang ni nya 'dzin no/ /spu rings nya dang dzha ṣa nya/ /sgong skyes rnam 'phyo go cha can/ /bi sā raḥs ka lbo tsā tha ga ḍa kaḥsha ku khārbha kaḥ/ /sa ha pra rdatthaḥbā jo na u lū 'gro ldan rnam par skyong ba dang / /de nas sha ku lārbha ka /mche ba stong ldan khri can dang / /steng 'phyo 110—389

bī shi shu kaḥs mo/ /na la mbi nashyi li tsi maḥproṣṭṛ tu sa pha rī dwa yoḥ/ /kyu byis pa gsod dag mtshungs/ /na li'i nya dang tsi li tshim/ /rgyab can dang ni bar chad gnyis/ /sgo dāṇḍa maṣṭha saṃ ghā taḥpo tā dhā na ma tho dzha ṣāḥ/ /ro hi to mabyu raḥsā lo rā dzre baḥs ku nga'i nya phran 'dus pa la/ /po tā dmā na de nas nya/ /ro nyi ta dang maṅga ra/ /rdo rje can dang ti mi laste miḥ/ /ti mo gi khā da yartswa tha yā dzā shi dza la dzanta baḥ/ /taddhi dāḥshi shu mā ro dra nya—/ /nya 1mig la sogs de nas ni/ /yā dzā shi ni chu skyes so/ /de yi dbye ba byis pa gsod//saṃ ka bo ma ka rā da yaḥ/ /sthādku lī ra karka ṭa kaḥkyumme ka ma tha sram dang shabyu chu srin sogs/ /sdig pa dang ni karka ṭa/ / 'di dag chu'i srog chags rkang mangs/ /rus katstsha po/ /gā hophob hā ro na kra stu ku: ro tha ma tī la tā/ /gaṇḍa pa daḥsbal bul 'gro katstsha'o/ /'dzin khri chu yi srin rings so/ /na kra chu srin bum pa'i mgo/ /sa yi 'khri kizhu lu ko ni hā kā go dhi kā sa me/ /rakta pā tu dza lo kā yī st+ri yī bhū sdi shing sa srin tal/ /da byid go dhi ka mtshungs so/ /khrag 'thung srin bu bad pa'o/ /mo ni mang tshig dza lo ka sa/ /mughra sgo ṭaḥmosteste yī shustiḥsaṃ kha myuṅkambu ra ste yo/ /kyu dra saṃ khāḥsaṃ bad pa'o/ /mu tig skye gnas mu tig phor/ /dung ni gasru ra te mo/ /dung phran dung gi sen mo'o//kha na khāḥsamyu kā dza la shukta yaḥ/ /bhe ke maṇḍa ka barṣa bhū sā lū ra bee ba dardu rā/ /'bu skogs can dang sgrugs pa'i bu/ /'phyo 'gro sbal pa dbyar skyes dang / /sā lū rkyal can dardu ra//shi lī gazle pa dī bhe tī barṣa ṭī ka ma ṭī du liḥ/ /maṅga ra gya pri yā sh-idhī drartswa mā dīrgha sa 'bu phra mo tal phran no/ /sbal phran dang ni char skyes so/ /rus sbal phra mo du li'o/ /nya yi dga' ma ko ṣi kā/ /dza lā sa yā dza lā dhā rā sta tā gā dha dza lo hra daḥ/ /ā hā bstu ni pā rgo sthā rwa can ma/ /nya phyis nya skyogs zhes bya'o/ /chu yi gzhi dang chu nyal lo/ /de la gting med chu hra dang //du pa kyu pa dza khā sha ye/ /sum̐ gye ṭwāṃ dhuḥpra tī kyu paḥ.u da pā rgo tu sum̐ si bā/ /nee chu yi skyang skyong lteng ka 'khyil/ /khron pa chu nyal skyes bu'o/ /khron chu khrus chu kyu pa'o/ /chu dong yang 110—390

meste kāphosu bī nā ho mu kha brnya ①na ma su yata/ /puska ri sgyuntu khā tai myu na pho yin no/ /khron pa'i rtsig pa tri ka'o/ /bī nā ha ni kha khyer ro/ /rdzing dang de yi chu la ni/ /ā khā dā khā tai de ba khā ta ka/ /padmā ka rasta ḍā goñtsā kā sā raḥs ra shrī sa raḥ/ /ta dang lhas bkang dang / /padma'i 'byung gnas sgra ldan dang / /mo min chu yi snying ldan dang ④//bee santuḥpa lwa 1la.āoṃlba sa ro bā tpā tu dīsgo kā/ /khe yantu pa ri khā dhā rdzing dang mtsho dang lteng kha dang / /rdzing bu ltang lteng rdzing mo che/ /rdzing rings 'obs dang yongs bskor rastambha st+waṃ ya tra dhā ra rde/ /sthā dā la bye bā la mā bā la mā bā yotha na chu—/ /drangs pa'i chu dang yur chu dang / /btsugs shing chus bskor bskrun shing chu/ /de nas gtsang dī sa ri ta/ /ta ram̐ gi nī shi ba li nī ta ṭi — hra di nī dhu rī/ /po 'bab chu dang / /dba' rlabs can dang nya lcibs can/ /ngogs can dang ni sgra ldan sgrogs//sho ta swa tī dī pa ba tī sra badhī nisna gā pa gā/ /gaṅgā bisngu pa dī 'bab ldan dang ni gling ldan ma/ /gzhol 'gro rgyun ldan mtshor 'bab po/ /gaṅgā khyab 'jug rkang pa dza snu tan yā su ra nisna gā/ /bhā gī ra ddhi tri pa tha gā tri sho tā dīṣṭha sru ra dang / /dza snu'i bu mo lha yi chu/ /skal ldan shing rta lam gsum 'gro/ /rgyun gsum 'jigs byed bu mo pi—/ /ka liṭī srurma ta na yā ya mu nā sha ma na shwa sā/ /re bā tu narma dā so modzha bā dang / /nyi ma'i bu mo kā lismi/ /zhi ba'i sring mo ya mu nā/ /re bā dang ni narma dā/ /zlas byung ri bo'i me ka la kastsa kā/ /ka ra to yā ba dā byā rā ba hu dā mee ta bā hi byā/ /si ta drustu bu mo dang / /lag chu dang ni rtag tu
