ta ṣṭa twa ṣṭi ta byu kṛ te / / bee bye ta rmye tstsha dri to bi dwo bi nda bi zin la khad dang bsregs dang tshig /bzhogs dang bzhur dang chung ngur byas/ /phug ⑤dang brtol dang sto zhubi tsā ri te/ /nind+ra bhe bi ga tā ro kau bī lbo nee bi dru ta dru to/ /phug pa byas/ /rnam dpyad brtag dpyad rnam par bye/ /mdangs med bkrag med mdog ngan no/ /stug po sidhe bya ni britta nitparjo dā ri te bhinda bhe di to/ /khru tai gyu ta mu tai tse 'thug po dru ta'o/ /grub pa zin pa rdzogs pa'o/ /gses pa phye ba dbyes pa'o/ /dog pa ti tri ta yarnye tu sarnya te/ /myu darti te na ma pyi ta ma na si ta ma pa tsā pi rnal ma ran ma gnas/ /thabs kyi rgyu rnams brkyang ba'o/ /mchod pa bkur ste rim gro dang / /bsnyen tārtsi tā pa tsi tai/ /ba ri ba shi te ba ri bathu ta mu pā shi tai tso pa tsa ri tai tsa/ /saddhā pi bkur dang ni ri mo byas/ /zhabs thog zhabs 'bring bkur ba'o/ /rab tu tsha dang gdung tastu tasto dhū pi ta dhū pā yi to tsa dru ṇashtsaḥ/ /z-isgo matta skṛptaḥpra hlandaḥpra mu di ba dang / /sems sdug sdug bsngal tsha ba dang / /yid dga' sems dga' tshims dang rangs/ /rab tu taḥpyo taḥmā na shā/ /tstsha.oṃ tai lū rgo kṛ rtu dā tai di tai tshi tai thrakto/ /srast+waṃ dga' dang mnyes pa'o/ /bcad pa gtubs pa bregs pa dang / /bkas pa bye ba phral ba dang / /'thub pa dhwa st+waṃ bhra st+waṃ ska oṃ pa oṃ thu sgo tai ga li tai / / larbha pā bye bi rghaṃ bhā bi dang ni gcod pa'o/ /bcom pa dang ni zhig dang nyams/ /brlag pa chud zos zags dang nyams//ta mā sā di tai tsa khyu tañtsa/ /aṣpe ṣi tai ga bee ṣi ta ma nī ṣṭi mārgo thob pa rnyed pa phrad pa dang / /dngos rnyed thob pa rnyed pa'o/ /tshol ba rjes tshol lta ba dang / /lam tai mṛ gi tai / / ānd+ra sānd+ra klirghaṃ ti mi tai sa mu nda mu tta ñtsa / /rtogs pa dang myul ba'o/ /sge'u gsher rlon pa rlan can dang / /bangs so thags can sge'u gsher rlon/ /tā tai tā ṇi rakṣi ta ma bi ta go pā yi tai guste/ /a ba ga ni ta ma ba ma tā skyabs dang skyob pa srung ba dang / /sbed pa sgrib pa sbas pa'o/ /brnyas pa rngan can tsho khyod 110—495

tadmā bye ga myu sru ra pa raspa rāḥ/ /sā ka spyo saṃ ga bañtsa nee pā ra ya ṇa pa rā ba de dag tu/ /'gro ba'o phan tshun min pa rnams/ /tshogs pa zla yi tshig la ni/ /pha rol 'gro dang pha ya ṇi/ /ya dṛsgo swe ri tā te tu shu tyā tā sthā bi la kṣa rṇa1/ /sha ma rol brten/ /dbang du byed dang rang dbang byed/ /rgyu stong gnas dang mtshan nyid bral/ /zhi dang thastu sha maḥshārnyirwarnyi stu da ma tho da maḥ/ /a ba dā rṇa kand+ra thratt+waṃ kā mya dul dang des pa'o/ /bzod dang nus dang thub pa'o/ /rtogs brjod sngar gyi las 'jug go/ /'dod dā ṇa pra bā ra rṇa/ /ba sha kri yā sasba da rgo spru la kand+ra tu kānd+ra ṇḍaṃ/ /bi dhu ba ṇi bi pa sbyin pa rab mchog go/ /dbang byed dbang du sdud pa dang / /rtsa ba'i las dang las su bya/ /g.yo ba dhu na dzwa tapo ṇḍaṃ dzrī ṇa nā ba rgo/ /paryābyeḥmyutpa ri tā rṇa hasta bā ra ṇa mi tya 2 pi//dang ni 'dar bar byed/ /ngoms — pa dang ni tshim pa'o/ /chog pa yongs bsrungs lag pa 'gebs/ /se ba khaṃ sī ba khaṃ sru birbe da raḥsgu ṭa māṃ bhi dā/ /ā kro shā na ma bhi ṣe 'tshem pa tshem bu sbyor ba dang / /'dra ba gcod pa gtum pa'o/ /khro ba dang ni mngon par khro/ /gaḥse bo dwo bee da nā na nā/ /sa mūtstsha na ma bhi byubye ryādzñā bhi kṣurja nālhadha tshor ba myong ba nyams su myong / /brgyal ba mngon par khyab pa dang / /slong ba bsod snyoms 'dod don nā—/ /brja rgo tstsha da neelhatha dzwa ā nanda na sa bhā dza nee/ /ā thratstsha ṇa ma slong / /gcod pa dang ni gse ba'o/ /de nas gnyis po dri rmad rgyadang / /khams bde mi bde 'dri thāsnra yaḥsaṃ pra dā yaḥkṣa ye kṣi yā/ /gra te gā ho ba shaḥkārnyo rasprusthā ba'o—/ /de nas man ngag sdom pa'o/ /zad pa dang ni rdzogs pa'o/ /len pa dang ni blangs pa'o/ /ṇi ra ṇaḥkwa ṇi byu dang mi gsal smra'o/ /bya sgo bee dhi pa tsā pā ke ha bo hu to mdangs can dang ni 'tsher ba'o/ /bsrung ba dang ni skyabs pa'o/ /'bugs pa 'bigs pa tshos pa ba ro dṛ sto / / o ṣa ཿ blo ṣe na yo nā ye rje ni ñdzu zlo 'u bhra smin—/ /'bad pa dang ni sgon pa'o/ /mchog dang rab dang sreg dang tshig /mdun ma gros dang 110—497

mo blu mo/ /swā ti dṛ rnyo pra thā khyu to z-iṣṭiḥdṛkto ①sra baḥsru be/ /mṛ dhā sa rgas 'khogs pa/ /nor 'khrul rgyas dang 'phel ba'o/ /rab tu grags dang grags pa'o/ /reg pa dang mṛ sgo spa ra khaṃ sbu ra ṇi pra mi to pra mā / / pra sru ti pra ni 'byar ba'o/ /'bab lhung 'phel ba yang dag 'phel/ /'phro dang spro ba tshad ma tsha/ /rab skyes sa resbyo te pā ghā raḥkla ma thaḥkla me/ /uṅka sgolhati sa ye khru sarnyiḥ'abung dang ltung dang ltung / /ngal ba dang ni dub pa'o/ /shin tu ba dang phul du phyin/ /'byar ba bye ṣā bi ṣa ya ā sha ye/ /kṣi pā yī kṣe pa rte gīṇḍigi gero gu ra ṇa murya me/ /dang ni 'khyud pa'o/ /yul brten pa dang 'phen dang 'phul/ /ri dang ri bo rnam 'tshe gnod/ /und+ra ya unda ye shā yaḥshra ya nee dza ya nā dza yaḥ/ /ni gā do ni ga de mā do ma de 'degs pa bstod pa reg rten no/ /rgyal dang rgyal brjod dbyangs rgyags khengs/ /gyen du ubye ga uza me/ /bi ma da rna pa ri ma lolhabyu pa paste ra rku gra bskyod dang steng du bskyod/ /rnam par nyed dang yongs su nyed/ /mngon par skyed dang rjes su haḥ —/ /ni gra hasta dī rudhaḥtyā da rbha yo ga sta bhi gra haḥ/ /muji 'dzin—/ /mi 'dzin de dang 'gal ba'o/ /mngon par sbyor dang mngon par 'dzin/ /khu tshur brnyastu saṃ gra ho ḍisbe ḍa ma ra bi bla bo/ /brnya rna pra si tirtswa raḥbacings dang yang dag bzung / /chom po jag pa srang ba'o/ /'brel pa skyes dang spyod pa'o/ /nad pa sparshaḥspraspyo pa tabee ri/ /ni kā ro bi pra kā raḥmyu da kā ra st+riṅga iṅgi tai/ /reg bya rlung nad dang / /gnod byed nyes pa byed pa'o/ /dgongs pa dang ni don len dang / /pa ri ṇa mo bi kā ro dwo sarme tsa kṛ ti bi kri ye/ /a pa hā rasta yongs su 'bab dang rnam 'gyur gnyis/ /sar me byed dang rnam par brje/ /'phrog pa dang ni bsogs pa tsa yaḥs mā hā raḥs mu tsa yaḥ/ /pra tyā hā ra u pā dā na bi hā ra pa dang / /mnyam par bsdu dang kun tu sogs/ /so sor sdud dang nye bar len/ /spyod lam bzhi 110—498

stu pa ri kra maḥ/ /a rnyi hā rolharbha gra ha rgo nirta rolhabyu karṣa rṇa/ /snod skor ba'i rim① / /mngon par bsdus dang mngon par len/ /bsdu ba dang ni mngon par 'dren//a nu hā rophonu kā raḥsgyu darja — 7sgyu pa ga me bya yaḥ/ /pra bā ha tu pra dṛtt+waṃ rjes su 'gyed dang rjes su sgrub/ /de nas song zin mi zad pa/ /'jug pa dang ni rab tu 'bab/ /sthāttha geb ho ga ma rgo ba hiḥ/ /bi yā mo bi ya mo yā mo ya maḥsaṃ ④yā ma saṃ ya mo//'byung dang 'jug dang 'gyu ba'o/ /mtshe ma zung ma 'khrugs ma dang / /sbyar don zung dang bubs dag go//hi dmā ka tshwa bhi tsā ra myu dzā ga ryā dzā ga rā dwa yaḥ / / bi spyolha rnya rnam 'che'i las dang mngon spyod do/ /gnyid med gnyid chags gnyid yin no/ /bgegs dang bar rā yaḥpra kyu haḥmyu dru pa spyo3rnyi kā shra yo/ /nirbi she u pa bho gaḥchad grub pa'i bgegs/ /'byung po nyer 'dus mchod cing 'dug /nges par 'dug dang nye bar spyod//myutpa ri saryaḥpa ri kri yā/ /bi dhu ram̐ tu pra bi bye sngolhatta pā yashtsanda rjes su byed dang yongs su byed/ /lhan cig mi gnas spangs te 'gag /dgongs can 'dun pa nges ā sha yaḥ/ /sa kṣe pa rṇa sa ma sa rgo paryā ba sthā bi ro dha rgo/ /pa ri saryā pa rī sā raḥdon min/ /mdor bsdus pa dang bsdu ba'o/ /mi mthun pa dang 'gal ba'o/ /yongs su brkyang dang myu dā snga tā sa nā sbri ti ཿ / / bi stu ro bi gra ho byā sha ཿ sa tsa brkyang ba'o/ /'gro 'jug stan dang gnas yin no/ /rgya che yangs pa cher yangs so/ /de yang 'usgra shaja gya bista ra/ /myudmarda rgo sasthā ha rgo bi nā shaḥsgyu da darsha rna/ /saṃ sta baḥyis rgyas pa'o/ /byug pa dang ni bsku byug go/ /nyams pa dang ni mthong ba med/ /shes pa dang ni myutpa ri ⑥tsa yaḥpra sa rastu bi sarba rgo/ /byā bā kastu pra yā maḥsthātmanni byeḥyongs su 'dris/ /khyed pa dang ni rnam par khyed/ /nges tshig dang ni rab tu nges/ /nye 'khor nye logs sanni karṣa ṇa/ /la bolhabhi khā bo la ba nee nispyo baḥpa ba nee pa baḥ/ /prastu baḥsthā dag dang ni/ /rnga ba 'breg pa 'bal ba'o/ /nges 'byed 'phyar dang 'khrab pa'o/ /gnas skabs dang 110byed499

da ba sa raḥsru tra beeṣṭa rna/ /pra dza naḥmyu du pa sa raḥpra sa raḥpra ṇa yaḥs mo dhī ni skabs yin no/ /thags spun son pa snal ma dkri/ /she sbyor 'khrig dang tshogs pa mtshungs/ /blo shattarniṣka mophobyā tu saṃ kra mo durga sañtsa raḥ/ /pra byuttha maḥpra yo gārjaḥpra kra nus dang ni chu srol lo/ /mo min zam pa bgrod dka' zam/ /'khrug phyir 'jug dang rab sbyor don/ /maḥmyu du pra kra maḥ/ /sthā da sthā dā na mursā ta ā ram̐ bhaḥsambha masta rā/ /pra ti brnyaḥkhom pa dang ni mgo 'ju ba/ /'ju ba rtsom pa ā ram̐ bha/ /tam tam tur tur bar chad gegs/ /pra tiṣṭastolhab nā yastu ni pā ta rgo/ /u pa lambhasta nu bha baḥs mā lasto be le pa rgo/ /'og min 'og tu lta ba'o/ /sngon shes beer yang 'phel ba'o/ /bsku byug dang ni byug pa'o/ /bi pra lasto bi pra yo go bi mambhasta ti sadzdza rgo/ /bi shā bstu pra bi khyu ti ra bee kṣu rjes chags dang ni sbyor ba'o/ /sbyin ster rnam grags rab tu grags/ /mel tse ba dang so pa'o/ /nges klog pra ti dzā ga raḥ/ /ni pā ṭha ni pa rjo pā bye te ma ste mo sa munda nee/ /ā dī na bā shra bo kle nges brjod 'don pa'o/ /bangs dang gsher bangs rlon pa'o/ /kun nas dman dang zag nyon she me la ke saṃ ga saṃ ga mo/ /saṃ bī kṣa rṇa bi tsa ya rgo mārga ṇi mṛ ga rja mṛ gaḥ/ /pa ri ramongs—/ /tshogs pa 'dus pa 'phungs pa'o/ /lta ba 'tshol ba myul nyu 'tshol lta/ /yongs 'khyud mbhaḥpa ri ṣi gaḥsaṃ bye ṣa u pa gyu ha rgo/ /nirbaṇḍi bye rgo tu rgo dhyā rgo darsha nā lo ka ni kṣa ṇi//yongs 'byar yang dag reg /nyer 'dzin nyer lta rtog dang gzir/ /snang bar byed dang lta ba'o/ /pra tyā khyu rgo ni ra sa rgo pra kyā de sho ni rā kri tiḥ/ /u pa sā yo bi shā yashtsa paspye ya phyir rgol zlog pa 'gog dang 'gegs/ /rnam grangs ming gzhan ming rim sha ya nārba kau/ /att+waṃ rgo tsa dzha tī yā tsa dzdza bhā yā tsa 1 torja ke/ /myusbya tyā so bi parlu so bya don—/ /skyug bro btsog pa skyug bro don/ /bzlog pa phyir bzlog rnam bzlog tya yashtsa bi parya ye/ /parya yolhati kra masta sminda ti pā ta u pa tya yaḥ/ /pre ṣa ṇa yatma mā log /'gongs pa 'phyangs pa rgal dang 'phar/ /pre ṣa ṇa ni gang bos nas/ /de la 110byed500

nu 6 rka dṛ rde/ /gā ma tā dza ṭwān tā dhū mya pā shā gā lya thra tha1 thaka /a pi tshoms mi rnams kyi/ /grong tshoms skye tshoms du ba mnom/ /zhag tshoms ga rtse so so'o/ /stong tshogs shā ha shra kā rī ṣa bānd+ra shā tharba ṇa di shaṃ/ /saṃ tīṇḍi brgaḥ// //dang ni lci me tshogs/ /go cha'i tshogs zudang rig byed sogs/ /'dres ma'i sde tshan no// // —/ glo nā nārbaḥke pi kānta di brgo ṣe bā tra tītt+waṃ tāḥ/ /byu ri pra yo glo 'dir ni sna tshogs don gyi sder/ /byed ngo/ rnams la dang ngo/ gsum/ /de yi 'jug yul rnams la bzhi/ /sbyar bas rtogs par bya ba'o/ —/ /sna tshogs don la ka mtha' sogs/ /sde tshan gyis ni 'dir grags so/ /mang po la sbyor gā ye ye 6 paryā ye ṣa pi te 6 te/ /ā ka she tri di be nā ko lo kastu bhu ba ne dza gang gang la/ /rnam grangs la sbyor de dang de/ /nā ka nam mkha' skabs gsum la/ /lo ka sa gzhi skye bo nee—/ /pa bye ya sha se tsa shlau kaḥsha rekhaṅge tsa sa ya kaḥ/ /dzee bu kau krospru ba la—/ /shlau ka rkang bcad grags pa la/ /mda' dang ral gri sā ya ka /ce spyang chu bdag dzam bu ru ṇi thra thu kau tsi pi ṭārbha rngukau/ /ā lo kau darsha no byo to bhe rī pa ṭa ha mā na kau/ /ka /sna nyeg byis pa thra thu ka /mthong 'od dag la ā lo ka /rnga chen rnga rings mā na ka /u ga tsi pyatna yo re kaḥka lo ko3ṅgā pa bā da yoḥ/ /takṣa ko nā ga bsnya kyo rarkaḥsga ṭi phang pa rtags dag i ka'o/ /rtags mtshan ngan smra ka lo ka /klu dang shing 'jog takṣa ka /arka shel ka srurya yoḥ/ /mā ru te be dha se bradzñā thu phophyashi kaḥka shi rophombu noḥ/ /myuhphu lā kastutstsha dang nyi ma la'o/ /kaḥni rlung dang tshangs nyi ma/ /kai ni mgo dang chu dag la/ /pu lā ka ni spun stong dang //dhā bye saṃ kṣe pe bhakta settha ke/ /u lū ke ka ri ṇaḥputstsha spru lo pādhe tsa se tsa kaḥ//bsdus dang zan gyi snyigs ma la'o/ /pe tsa ka ni 'ug pa dang / /glang po'i mjug ma'i mtha' nye la'o/ /ka maṇḍa lo tsa ka ra kaḥsu ga te tsa bi nā ya kaḥ/ /kibyu haste bi taste tsa shu ka kri spyi blugs ser ba ka ra ka /bde gshegs log 'dren 1 ya ka /kisku khru dang mtho la'o/ /shu ka srin 110—502

ṭi tsa bṛshtsa kaḥ/ /pra ti ku le pra tī kast+ri ṣe ka de she tu pu su yo/ /sgyudhū ti kantu khyu bu sdig sgrul lo/ /pra ti ku ni mi mthun phyogs/ /gsum yin phyogs gcig pho 'di yin/ /byu ti ke nimbi ka tre rte ①bhūskṛ ṇi pi tsa/ /byeji kā yañtsa gho pe tsa ko shā ta kya ni tikta dang / /rā ma ga pur li ga dur/ /zla ba'i 'od zer dag dang ni/ /gong bu sgrag can ko shā tha kaphe le/ /se ti tsa kha di re so ma balkaḥsthā da tha 3sihla ke/ /ti la kalke tsa pi ju rkya—/ /de nas kaspal seng ldeng dkar/ /zla ba'i shun pa de nas ni/ /sihla 'ba' cha pi rgyu ka/ko bādhī shaṃ rā ma che pi tsa/ /dbang chen ma tend+ra guggu lū lū ka byā la gā hi 6 kau shi ka /bāḥ rka ni shing kun kyang / /mchod dbang gu gul 'ug pa dang / /sbrul 'dzin rnams la kau shi ka /rughra pa saṃ kā swā tai kaḥswaspe pi kyulla kast+ri 6/ /dzee ba tri kaḥs shī ke pi khu re bee shwa nang tsha 'jig pa a tai ka /nyung chung kṣulla pe/ gsum mo/ /yun ring 'tsho ba ri bong mtshan/ /rta rmig su brta kaḥ/ /byā sgo pi puṇḍa rī ko nā ya bā tyā ma pi dā pya kaḥ/ /shā lā bṛ kāḥzlum po brta ka /puṇḍa rī ka gzig pad dkar/ /smad pa mi ni yang 'od can/ /shā lā bṛ ka spre'u ka pi kro ṣṭa shā na ཿ swa rte pi ge ri ka / tpā ḍā bee pi bya li shaṃ myu dang / /ce spyang dang ni khyi yin no/ /btsag dang gser la gi ri ka /bya li ka ni gzir ba'i don//da lī kai twa thra yephodṛ te/ /shī khā na yā ba nu ke dzwa shalke sha ka la balka le/ /sāje a lī ka ni mi mdza' bsnun/ /ngang tshul rjes 'gro a nu ka /shaske dum bu shing shun la/ /gser srang sha te su basmra māṃ he st+ya ro bhū ṣa rte pa le/ /zong ṭaṃ ka'i ming dī nā re pi tsa niskospyo brgya rtsa brgyad dang ni/ /gser dang brang gi rgyan dang srang / /tha snyad la yang nisko'o/ /mo min kabee kagophobyā sa ma le na soḥ/ /daste pya tha pi nā kolhaste shu la shaṃ ka ra dri ma dang / /sdig sems khengs pa rnams la yang / /de nas pi tsā ka zhes pa/ /mo min mdung dha na noḥ/ /dhe nu kā tu ka re rngoñtsa me gha dzā le tsa kā li kā/ /kā ri kā pā ta ṭwāṃ z-isbyoḥbhe dang bde byed gzhu/ /ba bzhon glang mo dhe nu kā④/ /char sprin u ma kā li kā/ /zug rngu 'grel pa kā ri 110—503

kaṇḍi kā kaṇḍi byu ṣa ṇi/ /ka ri ha st+waṃ gu lo padma bī dza ko ṭwāṃ tri byutta re/ /kā—/ /kaṇi kā ni rna rgyan dang / /glang mo lag pa'i sor gdub dang / /padmo'i sa bon ze 'bru'o//thrand+ra kau byu pi mu khyu bee ke mu khyu n+ya ke ba lāḥ / /myubye snyi ke kauklu bṛnd+ra ra ka gzugs ldan gtso/ /e ka gtso bo gzhan ma 'dres/ /ko klu ṭi ka tshul 'chos dang / /ṭi ko tshe yartswa dru re ri tekṣa ṇaḥ/ /khā lā ṭi kaḥpra bhodhā ba dbyu kārlu kṣa mashtsa yaḥ//tshe gnya' shing gang tsam du lta ba'i dge slong bzang po/gang yang ring du mi lta ba/ /lā khā ṭi ka gtso sems mthong / /'ga' zhig mi nus pa la yang / /bhū z-inni tasba ba la ya tsa kre 6 ka ṭa ko3ste yo/ /sru tsa gre duṣṭa sa twe tsa ro ma mo min ka ṭa ka ni ri/ /mtho ba gdu bu 'khor lo la'o/ /khab rtse gdug pa'i sems can dang / /spu zing hākṣe tsa kaṇḍa kaḥ/ /kānd+raḥ// //byed pa kaṇḍa kaḥ/ /ka'i mtha' can rnams so// // sa/ ma yu khabyāṅka ra dzā la swa li bā ṇi shi lī mū kho/ /shaṃ kho ni sgo la khā ṭābyā mar me srin 'bar ma yu kha/ /shi li mu kha bung ba mda'/ /shaṃ kha gter dpral rus dung la/ /kambi nabyādzre yephopi khaṃ/ /1 ṇi dzwa le a pi shi khe/ /khārnyaḥ/ /kham ni bar snang mo dbang la'ang / /'od dang 'bar ba'ang shi khe'o/ /kha'i mtha' 'o/ /shi la bṛkṣiṃ na gā ba go/ /ā shu go bā yu bi shi kho sha rārka bi ha gāḥkha gāḥ/ /ri shing 'gro med a go'o/ /ā shu go ni rlung dang mda'/ /mda' nyi 'dab chags kha gā'o/ /pa tai go pa kṣi srurlo tsa yu gaḥkra mu ka dṛnda yoḥ/ /pa sha bo pi mṛ gā be gaḥpra bā pa tai ga ni bya nyi ma/ /yu ga kra mu mu ba zer tshogs pa dag /phyugs dang ri dwags mṛ ga'o/ /be ga len dang ha dza ba yo ra pi/ /pa ra gaḥkau su me re ṇi rtswa bhā yā do ra dza su pi/ /ga dze pi nā ga mā rgyug pa la'o/ /ba ra ga ni me tog ze/ /khrus tshal dang ni rdul la yang / /glang po klu dang drang srong gi/ /ta ṅgā ba shā gaste la ke pi tsa/ / sargaḥ swa bhā ba nirmokṣa ni shtsa gtum po rnams la mā taṅga/ /yig zur dpyal thig a ṭwāṃ ga /sarga rang bzhin nges grol dang / /nges 110—504

swa bhā bo brahma baṣpe tsa/ /sha kro ghā ta ka maste sgo bakhye kāsdo gha nā gha nāḥ/ /rang bzhin tshangs pa lus la yang / /brgya byin gsod byed glang spyos dang / /char sprin gha nā gha nā'o/ /a bhi mā nophoṭwā di dbye dzñā nee pra ṇa ya ho sa ①moḥ/ /gha no me ghi sprutt+waṃ gu ṇi tri a bhi mā na nor sogs kyi/ /dregs pa shes pa yid gcugs 'tshe/ /gha na sprin dang lus yon tan/ /6 rūtt+waṃ ni ranta re/ /i naḥsrurle pra rbha rā dzwa mṛ gāṅge kṣa tri ye dṛ pe/ /mkhregs dang bar med la'o gsum/ /i na ⑤'od dang nyi ma la'o/ /rī dzan ri dwags mtshan ma dang / /bā ṇi byo na rta tī ma ste shra ba dhyā ma pi bā hi bhā / /rgyal rigs mi yi bdag po la'o/ /gar mkhan stsos ma pā ṇi rgyo/ /chu dang dmag ni bā hi bhā/ /hā di ṣyo badzra ta ḍi to band+ra yā ma pi kā mi nī/ /twasde ha yo ra pi ta nuḥsru gnam lcags glog la hru di nī/ /shing dang bud med kā mi smi/ /pags pa lus dag ta nu'o/ /sru tsā nāphobye dzi twe kā pa tsa/ /kra tu bistu ra yo rasdi bi tā rna tri 6 tutstsha ke/ /mande3tha 'og tu lce 'phyang ba/ /bi tā rgo ni mchod sbyin dang / /rgya chen mo min spun stong dman/ /de nas ke ta ke ta rgo kṛ tree ke tā bu pa ni mant+ra ṇi/ /bee da ta two ta po bra hma bra sthā dzwa byas zin/ /rgyal mtshan dang ni nye bar 'bod/ /rig byed de nyid dka' thub tshangs/ /tshangs pa bi praḥpra dzā pa tig /u ha nee tsa hirlu do sru tsa ṇi pi tsa garnya rgo/ /byañdza rgo lāñtsha rngurgo bram ze skye dgu'i bdag /spro ba dang ni 'tshe sogs dang / /phra ma la yang gan dha rna/ /byañdza ④rna ni rtags shra khru niṣṭhanā ba ya be ṣa pi/ /ā tañtsa ⑤āoṃ pra tī bā pa dza ba nā pyu ya nāṭwā mtshan dang / /sma ra tshod ma cha shas rnams/ /ā tañtsa rna bskrun chu dang / /bang dang rang nyid don rkaḥ / /st+rasko lī rna lo ka bā de yudhe pa shwa hi pa kṣi rde/ /sthā durlu rgo niḥs ra ṇi ba la'o—/ /kau li rna ni skye bos smod/ /phyugs sbrul rngu bya rnams 'khrug pa la'o/ /ud yā rna ni grong phyi rim/ /na bhe de pra yo dza nee/ /a ba kā she sbi to sthā rgo tpā ḍā ba pi de ba nags dbye skye tshal rab dgos la'o/ /sthā rna dben gnas gnas dag la'o/ /rtsed mo sogs la'ang de ba 110—516

hma tri lo tsa no/ /kukṣi byu ṇarbha kā gadhā srambha pra ye pi tsa/ /sthāddhirja 3 dund+ra bhiḥsum̐ se dang spyan gsum pa/ /garbha mngal dang mngal nang byis/ /bi srambha ni yid ches mthun/ /rnga ni dun du 2bhi myu dakṣe dund+ra rnyiḥste st+waṃ/ /sngadma hā ra dza ni skru baṃ ku surghaṃ ka ra ke pu mān/ /kṣa tri skyes so/ /cho dbang gi zer lo dun du rnyi ste mo/ /tshon chen ma ni ku surghaṃ/ /spyi blugs la ni skyes bu'o/ /rgyal ye pi tsa nā bhi tsa nā rbhartswa su ra rbharga bee tsast+ri st+waṃ/ /sa bhā saṃ sa di sa bye ṣe tri ṣṭa rigs lte ba nā nyi skyes/ /su ra nyi ni ba la nga mo/ /sa bhā tshogs dang yid ches chos/ /gsum bdag rmyakṣe pi babee bhaḥ/ /yid ches balla bha/ /bha mtha'o/ /ki ra ṇa pra gra ho rismra ka pi ste ko bla baṃ ga mo/ /itstsha mo no bha bo kā rasmi 'od dang rta yi srab/ /bla mchod 'gro ba ga mo sbal pa spre'u/ /'dod dang yid skyes kā mo shorlo byo go pa rā kra mo/ / dhasthāḥpu ju ya ma tyā ya swa bhā bā tsā ra mo'o—/ /pa rā kra ma gzhan gnon dpa'/ /dhasthā bsod nams gshin rje rigs/ /rang bzhin spyod so ma pāḥ/ /u pā ya pūrba ā rambha u pa dhā tsā pyu ba kra maḥ/ /ba ṇi ka dang zla ba'i ltung / /thabs dang sngon ma rtsom pa dang / /go rims u pa kra ma'o/ /tshong lam grong pa thaḥpu ram̐ bee do ni ga mā nā ga ro ba ṇi ka /bee 4 ga mo dwo ba khyer rig byed la/ /ni ga ma'o grong khyer gyi/ /tshong lam ni ga ma ste gnyis/ /rā ma stobs ldan le rā mo byā la tsā ru si te tri 6/ /sha ju di pūrbo dṛnde pi gā maḥdang ni sngo/ /mdzes dang dkar po gsum yin no/ /sgra sogs sngon sbyor tshogs gā ma/ /rnam par krārnyo tsa bi kra maḥ/ /gusmo rugru bhya she nāshtsa lā miḥswa mṛ ku laste yoḥ/ /kṣi ti kṣustsoḥganon pa bi kra ma/ /gubee nad dang zhi ba dmag /yā mi bu mo rigs ldan mo/ /kṣa ma rigs dang kṣa mā yu ste kṣa me shaste hi te tri 6/ /tri gu myu mo ha ritt+waṃkṣiṃ shā mā myu tshwa bzod pas/ /nus dang phan pa la ste gsum/ /myu ma gsum yin 'phrog byed nag /shā ma rlung dang 110—519

dzdza ni rā ma yo/ /ātma bā na nu pe toṭwādarjo pu bye tu tsārba pi/ /rū pyaḥpra med yon tan can/ /bdag ldan nor bral argyo'o/ /pu rgya yid du 'ong ba la'ang / /rū bya dga' shastu rū pe pi ba dā byo balgu bā ga pi/ /tyā yā pi ma dhyalkuḥso sum̐ tu sunda re sho ma dang gzugs la'o/ /ba dā spyo ni ngag mnyen pa/ /ma rgya bar ma rigs pa la/ /so rmya gdu bu zla ba de ba tai/ /sattha dzha bye ṣa rdo bai tyā bātma kā mashtsa hritstsha yo/ /pha la ka spyo ṇa yorbha bye lha—/ /bee byā kun mkhyen sman pa la/ /bdag dang 'dod pa thotstsha rnga / /bha bya dge dang 'bras bu la/ /yogya saṃ pra ti ke tri 6/ /yo gya shin tu rigs pa la/ /ya mtha'o/ /ni ba hā ba sa ro bā ro saṃ sta ro pra sta rā dhwa ro/ /gu ru gītpa ti pi tā rdzu dā pa tshogs dang re mos/ bā ra'o/ /saṃ sta ro ni mchod sbyin 'a ma/ /gu ru phur bu pha la sogs/ /dā pa ro yu ga saṃ sha yo/ /pra kā ro bhe dā sā dṛ bye ā kā rā 2 bo gi ta kṛ tī/ /ki shā rū ro ni dus the tshom/ /pra kā ra ni dbye ba dpe/ /ā kā ra —ni lus tshul byad/ /ki shā ru ni gra dhā n+ya shu ke 6 ma ru dha na dha ro/ /a dra yo dru ma shi khārmāḥñtsā sta nā sto pa yo — dha ro//ma mda' snyem/ /ma ru mya ngam thang dang ri/ /a dra shing dang ri nyi ma/ /pa yo dha ra nu ma sprin/ /dhūddhā ri dā ṇa bā thra tā bā li hast+waṃ sha baḥka rāḥ/ /pra da rā bhaṅga nā rī rughā zla dhwadhā ri ni lha min 5'khor/ /dpya sdud lag pa 'od ka rā/ /pra da ra ni 'joms byed dang / /bud med rked a sruḥka tsā a pi/ /a dzā ta sh-iṅge goḥkā le tre pya sma khrurpā tū ba ro/ /nad dang ni mda'/ /a pra skra dang zur yin no/ /rwa med ba lang dus dang ni/ /sma ra med pa tū pa ro//su brte bi rāḥpa ri ka raḥpazlo ka pa ri bā ra yoḥ/ /mughā shurnyo tā raḥsthānd+ra ro bā yo rā ni nor te 7gser la yang / /pa ri ka ra skyil krung 'khor/ /mu tig dag pa tā ra yin/ /khra bo rlung gsum pa tri 6/ /karbu relhatha bra ti dzñā dzi sambi dā pakhru saṃ ga raḥ/ /be da bhe de karbu ra/ /de nas dam 'cha' g.yul dang ni/ /rig pa gamon pa saṃ ga ra/ /rig byed bye ba dag dang ni/ /170—522

tstshanda yoḥswe raḥshu dhra mudhīpta shukla yoḥ/ /'dod swe ra'o/ /shu khyu snang gsal dkar po'o/ /ra mtha'o/ /tsū ḍa ki rī ṭaṃ ke shāshtsa saṃ ya tā mo la rte yast+ra yaḥ/ /dru ma pra bhe da mā haṃ ga gtsug phud cod pan skra dang ni/ /saṃ ya tā rnams rngo la/'o gsum/ /shing gi rab dbye glang po dang / /kāṇḍa putpā ṇi tpā la baḥ/ /kṛ tānd+ra nee ha soḥkā lashtsa tuze pi yu ge ka liḥ/ /myudku mda' dang me tog rpā 'u 'o/ /mthar byed dus dag kā la 'o/ /dus bzhi'i tha ma ka li'o/ /ri dwags bye brag ram̐ ge bi ka ma laḥpā bā re tsa pi kadza laḥ/ /ka ro pa hā ra yoḥpu si ba liḥpā bye ga ka ma la / /gos/ dang sna ma bu kasba la / /rgyal sdud ba 7 skyes bu'o/ /srog chags lus la sa skyes pa dzephost+ri yī/ /sgo lya sā mabye si bye 6 ba lo nā kā ka shī ri ḍoḥ/ /bā tū laḥsum̐ 2 si bā tyā mo/ / /stobs dang nus/ nga/ dmag dadu/nga rnams / /ba lo skyes bu bya rog thogs/ /bā tū 'a ni rlung tshubs dang //yā ma yo bā tā sa te tri 6/ /bhe rya liṅgaḥsha che byā laḥsum̐ si shā pa da sarba yoḥ ma rlung nad can no rtags gsu ma mo/ /byu la g.yo sgyu rtags/ bye brag /skyes bu gzig dang sbrul/ la'o/ /ma 'a mo lolhabyā pā ba bikkiṭwā n+yaste shu lo ru gā yu sgo/ /shaṃ kā ba pi dwa yoḥkhri laḥpā li ra gruṅka min sdig pa dang / /dri chen dang ni dri ma'o/ /tho shu la ni zug rngu mtshon/ /phur bu me lce tī la'o/ /pā paṃ tta 6 phreng ba/ /ka lā shinye kā la bhe de pyu li sa khyu ba lbo a pi/ /abhyamyu bi kṛ li zur rtags sna sha' rnams/ /ka 4lā bzo dang dus kyi dbye/ /ā li dpang po phreng ba gra' / /bi 'a chu to bee 5 lā kā la marlu da yo ra bi/ /ba 6hu khā kṛti kā gā bo ba hu lolha ghiḥpho si to tri mtsho'i rnam 'gyur dang / /dus dang tshul lugs rnams la'o/ /ba hu la ni byun drug dang / /ba la nga me dang 6 / /lī lā bi lā sa kri ya yo ru pa lāḥsharka rā a pi/ /sho ṇi telhambha saṃ tī khā lam̐ mū la nag po gsum/ /lī wā sgeg dang bya ba la/ /rdo dang gyo dum u pa lā/ /khrag dang chu 'a mā bye shi pā bha yoḥ/ /dzā la sa mū ha ā nā yo ga bākṣa 7 ra me tog 'ga' re dang lhan cig pa sa zer kā tī lā lo/ /rū 'a dang po rtsa ba'i don/ /dzā lam̐ tshogs pa nya dol dang / /dra sgo dang ni dra ba 710byed526

ba pi/ /shī la swa bhā ba sabye te sa bye he tu kṛ te pha lo/ /tsha dirne tra ru dzoḥllī baṃ sa rū he la'o—/ /shī la rang bzhin tshul khrims so/ /'bru dang rgyu byas pha lo'o/ /steng g.yogs dang ni mig nad dang //pa ṭa landa nā/ /a dhaḥswa byu pa yo rand+ra ta lo st+radzñā mi she pa lam̐/ /auṭwā ma7me zer na le pi ma ning tshogs pa pa ṭa lo/ /'og dang mthil ni ta lo'o/ /sha dang zang zing pa lo'o/ /sa chu 'og ni pā tā lo tse 1 lo bstelhadha me tri 6/ /ku ku lo shaṃ ku bheḥṭīrje swa bhe nā tu tu ṣā pā tā 'a / /tsa lo gos dang tshangs me gsum/ /ku ku lo ni phur bu rtsang / /bkram pa dong na le/ /niṇḍi te ke ba la mi ti tri liṅge twe ka kṛsgo yoḥ/ /paryābye kṣe ma dang phub ma'i me/ /nges par byas/ pa ke ba la/ /rtagar/ gsum gasbug dang ma lus pa/ /yongs pu ju ku sha lam̐ shikṣa te tri 6/ / pra bā byi ru la rmā ku re pyasdi tri 6 su thob dang bde ba dang / /bsod nams bslab pa ku sha lo/ /gsu ma mo myu gu pra nā 1'a / /mo min gsu ma rdzu lo dza ḍi pi tsa/ /ka rā lo — dantu ro tu ṅge tsā ro dakṣe tsa pe sha laḥ/ /mūrtephorbha po sna lo glen/ /ka rā la ni dma' dang mtho/ /mdzes dang mkhas pa pe sha la / /rmongs dang byis pa ke bi bā laḥmyuslo lashtsa la sa z-iṣṭa yo/ /bā la ste/ /lo la sred dang g.yo ba la / la mtha'o/ /de bo dā bo ba shā ra ju ba byā dzadma hā ro bha bo/ /madri sa hā ya sa tsi bo pa ti shā de bo dā bo nags 'brog 5me/ /skye dang dbang phyug bha ba'o/ /blon po lhan cig sa ci'/ /bdag khaṃ na rā dha bā/ /a ba yaḥshi la me ṣānā ā dzñā hā nā dhā rā ha bāḥ/ /bhā baḥs twa po grogs mi dha bā'o/ /a bi ri bo lug nyi ma/ /bka' bsgo 'bod dang mchod sbyin rnams/ /ā ha bā 'o swa bhā bā dzha pā ya tse ṣṭhatma dzadma pu/ /sthā dutpā de pha le puṣpe pra sa bo bhā ba ni/ /sems can rang bzhin dgongs pa dang / /sems dang bdag skye rnams la'o/ /skye ba 'bras ga rbha mo tsa nee / / bee bi shā sepho pa tna bee pi ni kṛ tā ba pi ni bu me tog dang / /mngal nas btsas pa pra sa ba/ /yid mi ches dang ngan pa dang / /nyes byas rnams 110—527

snu baḥ/ /uṣpe kā marṣa yo ri tsā pra sa re ma ha utpa baḥ/ /a nu bhā baḥpra kyang ni snu ba/ /mthor 'gro spyo dang 'dod pa brkyang / /mchod pa rnams la utpa ba/ /a nu bhā ba rtogs bhā bee tsa sa tāñtsa ma ti nishtsa ye/ /sgyu dzdzadma he tuḥpra bha baḥsthā rgo dro pa lasnya pa dang / /dgongs pa blo gos nges pa la/ /bra bha ba ni skye dgu dang / /gnas dang don thob 'byung ye / /sgru bo bha bhe de llī be tu nishyi te shā shwa te tri 6/ /swa dzñā tā bātma ni swe gnas so/ /sgru ba rgyu skar dbye ba dang / /ma ning nges dang rtag pa gsum/ /swa ni gnyen dang bdag tri spyo mbi yā swolhaste yārnya ne/ /ñtsā ka ṭī ba st+ra 1 badhe pi byā bī pa ri pa ṇi pi tsa/ /dang ni/ /st+waṃ 2ni gsum ste bdag dang ni/ /swa ni mo min nor yin no/ /rī bī bud med rked gos mdud/ /shi bā go rī phe ra bee pi dwo dwo ka la ha yu gla yo ཿ / / dra tshong ba'i zong rnams la yang ngo / /shi bā dkar mo ce sbyang ngo / /dwo dwo 'thab mo zur rang bzhin/ /dra byā sna bya ba sā ye pi sa twa mashrī tu dzantu 6/ /khri baṃ na thu sa rka shaṇḍi bā tsu bya zad dang rdzas la'o/ /sa twa mo min sems can no/ /skru baṃ ma ning za ma ste/ /brjod bya'i rtags can bye bee ga ma bi kra ces/ /rnam par gnas / /la mtha'o / /dwo bi sho bai shya ma nu rdo dwo tsa rā bya 3ma rta bhi ma rospa sho/ /dwo rā shī puñdza me ṣā gnyis/ bi rsha rje rigs mi dag go/ /gnyis/ bang chen mngon spyod pa sho/ /gnyis/ rā shī phung po rdzu dwo 4baṃ sho ku la maska ro/ /ra haḥpra kā sho bī kā sho nirbe sho bhri ti glazerabho ga yoḥ//lug sogs khyem/ /baṃ tho rigs dang 'od ma'o/ /dbeen dang gsal ba bī kā sho/ /sa dang longs spyod rang be sho//kṛ tādhe thu si tī nā shaḥgru dra karṣa ka yo st+ri 6/ /pa de lasmre ni mestephopa de shaḥmathar byed skyes bu tī nā sha /ser sna dang rgo mkhregs pa gsum/ /a pa de sha gnas mtshan rtags/ /myu dku sha maplu tsa/ /da shā basthā no ka bi dhā pyu sha trozlo pi tsā ya tā/ /ba shāsdi ka ra bhā pha 3ku sha rtswa dang chu la yang / /da sha gnas skabs rnam mang po/ /sa sha sred pa ring po'o/ /ba shā glang mo dbang du 110—528

thārbabye ya tha ta rja/ /sgo re ba tu pu na dzee tse rya ba dhā ra ṇa ba ji lta'i don dang ji bzhin ltar/ /sruḥdang e ba tu pu naḥ/ /bee dang tsa dang i ti ni/ /dmigs kyi dbye tsa kāḥ/ /pā ga tī tārja shaṃ nu na ma ba bye ni shtsa ye dwa yo/ /sasbattha rṣapho ba ba'i tshig yin no/ /pāg ni 'das pa'i don yin no/ /byu na los kyang nges pa gnyis/ /lo dang lo'o phyi re twarpā gā me 1 ba swa ya mātma nā/ /aspe byā tsind+ra ha kyu—ཿpra yo bhū sbya tso dru te ma gting / /a ma de bzhin rang dang bdag /nyung dang dma' ba che dang mtho/ /mang po phal cher 'gro sha naiḥ/ /sa dā nee hye ba hirpā bye sma titephosta ma darsha nee/ /aste sa twe ru sngoghā dang bul/ /rtag tu rgyun du phyi dang phyi/ /'das dang mi mthong mi mngon no/ /yod dang bdog go khro hūṃ sum̐ prarde ྅nu na ye twa pi/ /hūṃ tarke sgyu du du ṣā rā tre ra ba sā ne na mo na to/ /tshig khru/ /u ni dri dang mnyes gshin tshig /hūṃ ni rtog ge u ṣa ni/ /nam gyi cha smad phyag dang 'dudabye / /pu na rabeelhaṅge nind+ra yī dubyu sabyu pra sharṣa nee/ /sā yi sā ye pra ge pā taḥpra bhā bod pa yang don i ga'o/ /smod dang ngan smra bstod shis tshig /dgongs mo nyi ma nam langs snga/ /sa te ni ka ṣārnyi ke/ /pa rutpa rā dri 4 ṣamolhasdepūrbe pūrba tare ya ti/ /a byātāst+yagacig pa dang karnyi ke/ /na ning bzhi ni da lo deng / /sngon ma dang ni ches sngon ma/ /'dir ni de ring nyi tha pū rbe byā tyā bo pūrbotta rā pa rāta/ /ta thā dha rā tyā n+ya ta re ta rānd+rarbe ma'o—/ /de nas sngon ma'i thun la sogs/ /sngon ma phyi ma gzhan dang ni/ /de bzhin du ni gzhan dang gzhan/ /hya rā da yaḥ/ /u bha ya byu stso bha yedkuḥpa re twa lbo pa re rya bi/ /byo ga tephonā ga sngon ma'i nyi ma la sogs pa/ /nyi ma gnyis pa gnangs nyin mo/ /phyi dro'i thun ni pa re rya/ /kha rtsang 'das pa telhalbo shwaḥpa ra shwaḥshwaḥpa ri ha ni/ /ta dā ta dā bhā da ni cig car yu ga pa dusagacig cha 5de ka ma 'ongs pa/ /nyi thun dang ni gnangs nang par/ /phyi thun de thun de yi tshe/ /dus kun du dang rtag tu dā sarba dā sa dā/ /e tarti saṃ pra tī dā bhā ma dhu nā saṃ pra rda ta thā/ /disde dang / /da lta dang ni da ltar dang / /da dang da lta de bzhin du/ /khyogs dang yul dang dus yin no/ /shar 110—536

sha kā le pūdrwa do shā gu daspra tya gā da yaḥ/ /a bya ya brgaḥ// //la sogs pa sngon ma dang / /phyi ma dang ni gzhan la sogs/ /mi zad pa'i sde tshan no// //sa liṅga shāste sand+ra di kṛtta dhi ta sa mā sa dzeeḥ/ /a nusteḥsaṃ gra rtags kyi bstan bcos dang bcas san sogs dang / /kṛta dang de phan tshig sdud las skyes pa/ /ma ho li ṅge saṃ tī ṇḍi ba di ho nda ye ta / / li ṅga she ṣa bi bye bshad rnams kyis yang dag bsdus so rtags/ /spel ma 'dra bar 'dir ni rtogs par bya/ /gal te khyad byā tpā bi she ṣi rya rya bā bye ta ཿ / / ste yā mbi dru byi rā par rnams kyis ma bkag na/ /rtags kyi lhag ma'i cho ga khyab byed yin1 / /bud med yī dang spru dang ni/ /mi kā tsu yo ni pā ṇi nā ma tsa / / nā ma bi dku nni shā ngal bso dbyangs gcig las med dang / /skye gnas ldan pa'i srog chags ming / /ming dang glog dang ba llī bā bhā di byu na di dha st+waṃ / / a na je rdi gu re kā tho mtshan mo dang / /'khril shing mda' dang phyogs dang sa/ /gtsang po blo gros rnams ni mo/ /ad mtha' na sa pā tra yu gā di byeḥ/ /ta la 2 z-inde ye ni ka rya tra bee rā mai ba gnyis don gcig pa/ /snod dang dus sogs ma gtogs pa/ /ta la 'tshogs pa ya dang i ni karya tra/ /thu ni kā di bun / / spyo bhā bā dā ba niḥttan rtsul skyo po yu dza dgra dang 'khrig pa sogs la bu na'o/ /bud med dngos po sogs la a nistin/ /rtsu' a tsa kyas a yu tsa ngitna shā/ /u shā di 6 ni rū rīshtsa dmā byu darnyi tsa lam̐ sbri re / /ang i nya ni shā/ /u ṇa sogs rnams la ni dang spru dang yī/ /dī ās ud mtha' g.yo dang brtan pa la/ /ta1 choḍā yī pra ha ra khaṃ tse spro ṭwā pābee bā ṇa dig/ /gha nyo nyaḥsā kri yāḥgal te rtse ba'i mtshon cha de yin na/ /khu tshur thal lcag ṇa ni mo yi rkyen/ /gha nya las nya de gal te 'di'i sthābyebyāṇḍa pā tā di phrulgu snye bhā/ /sri rgo pā tā tsa mṛ ga pa tai lo pā ta swa bya ba/ /chad pa lhung ba la sogs spo zla dang / /khra dang ltung ba dang ni ri dwags dang / /mar khu 110—537

dhe ti di ga / byā sthā tpā tsiṣṭṛ shā sthā di bi ba 7 lha pa tsa ye ya di / /'khrungs pa bdud rtsi 1 mo yin no/ /gal te mgrin pa brjod 'dod yin pa na/ /pad rtsa la sogs 'ga' lam̐ kā she pā li kā ṭī kā dhā rgyas 'grel ta myu ru ra dang ma ma tī pañdzi dka' 'grel kāphoṭa bre bo kri//zhig bud med 'gyur/ /lo lo ma kā she beeng sga rtsa ba'i phreng ba pā li kā ṭī kā dhā ta kri/ /pañdzi kā dang lo ka a ṭa tī/si dhra kā shā shā rikrā hi krā pra tsi kosgo pi dzī li kā/ / ti nd+ra tī ka ṇi rṣa na gyi bye brag sngon byu nga ba/ ubee 'bar ba 'am ska ra mda' 'am sgron me ta 'a / chu nga ngu /se dhra'i shing dang smra byed bye'u dang / /skyigs bu sbra nga rtsi 'bar ba grog ma dang / /tind+ra ka'i shing zham mo kā dzha gi su ru ṅgā sru tsi mā tra ya ཿ / / bee tshwa bi ta ṇḍa kā ki rṣa na shing / sa'i 'og tu brgos te 'jul ba / khab rṣa na gyi bye brag ma ju ga sgro/ sma na gyi bye bragabacom tshos/ legs// /phra ma dang ni ma dang 'o/ ma dang / 'bras bu rgol ba phub dang ni/ /phye ma dang ni sha 5rjaṇḍi sā ṭī dru ṇi da rata/ /sā tiḥkand+ra ta thālhasatree nā dī rā dza sa bhā pi tsa/ /dzhabee bad ra rdo/ mi na/ mi na/ ñtsa gas kyi si la rlul na'i gos// /shin tu dga' dang bem dug dang / /de bzhin stan lte rgyal po'i 'khor/ /'khar ba ri mo rī tsadrwa rī pā rī ho rā latpā tsa si byu khā/ /lhakhya likṣu tsa dza che ṣā kṛ dha shrī tsa ma sī rdza rnga kha gcig pa / dus sbyo ra byed/ la ga tu chu hub gcigadus/ sbyo ra dang / /nya rul tshos dang sro ma'i khrus / /chang snod snag tsha kṛdha sī/ /skyes bu nyid la lha dang lha ma sī/ /sum̐ste sa snye dā nu tsa rāḥs parlu yāḥsu rā su rāḥ/ /swarga yā gā dri me min rnams/ /rnam grangs bcas rnams khyad par bcas pa rnams/ /mtho ris mchod sbyin ri dang srin ghā bhi dru kā khā pi sha rā ra ya ཿ / / ka ra ga ṇḍa sgo do rda nta ka ṣṭha dang mtsho/ /shing dus ral gri mda' dang dgra bo rnams/ /lag pa 'gram pa mchu dang dpung pa so/ /110—538

ke sha na kha sta nāḥ/ /addhā hāntaḥspyo seng ge sgra ḍa bhe dā ra tā ntaḥpā ga saṃ mgrin pa skra dang sen mo nu ma rnams/ /aḥ 1 ā'i mtha' can dug bye brag /rā tra mtha' can sngon du khya kā ཿ / / shrī pi ṭwā tyā shtsa ni ryā sā u a ze ra sa nda nta lha bā grangs med rnams/ /dpal snod la sogs thang chu'i rigs rnams dang / /as dang an mtha' 'gog dhi tāḥ/ /ka gro ma se ru dza rgya skyegs tu bast+ra dngos ngo ni hi tā ru ru bi rā ma kāḥ/ /byed med pa rnams/ /ka se ru dang 3 dza tu bstu rnams/ /ma gtogs tu dang ru yis rdzogs pa rnams/ /ka ṣa ṇa bha ma ro bānd+ra ya rya dand+ra a mbi a tha/ /pa tha na ya sa ṭo pādhā ka ṣa ṇa bha mar mtha' nye ba/ /'di rnams gal te ata mtha' yin de nas/ /pa ṭha na ya saṭa mtha' nye go tā khyu shtsa ra shā hwa yā ཿ / / nā st+ya ka rta ri bhā bee tsa rnams—/ /rigs su grags rnams spyod pas bod pa/ rnams/ /ming la byed pa min dang dngos po la'ang /gha nya dzapra na zlo ghā thu tsa/ / beeḥ ka tt+waṃ rī ma ni dzñā bee ko sgoḥ kiḥpā di gha nya a tsa a pa nang ṇa dang gha a thu tsa/ /dngos por i ma ni tsa ka byed ngo/ra lcaḥ/ /pra sogs la sa dang tophon+ya taḥ / /dwotwe phoshwa ba ḍa bā ba shwa ba ḍa bā na sa mā z-i te/ / kāntaḥgazhan la/sa ghu la sa ki/ /zlas/ dbyer a shwa pa/ ḍa ba yin cing / /kun sdud min na a shwa ba ḍa ba'o/ /nyi srurlenu baryā ya pūrbolhayaḥpūrba kophopi tsa/ /pa ṭa zas kartswa nu bā kashtsa ralla la ba'am ri dwags /ma zla ba'i rnam grangs sngon ma can/ /ka mtha' a yang sngon ma can yang ngo / /tsa ṭa mi thung jes brjod la ba dang ka kashtsa ku ṭuṅga kaḥ/ /pu kho spyo khaḥs muṅgaḥshtsa bi ṭa paṣṭa dha ṭāḥkha ṭaḥ/ /koṭwā 'gro ba 'i gnas/ 'do nga / ldo ga kha sbyor rkyen/ spyang ngo mi ngan/ dge ba ring ngo ra sa so gas/ dum bu/dang a nu bā ka dang / /khyim dang mda' ltod murig byed dang / /thum po sdug can dar sra rtsa/ /rdzong ra gha ṣṭa ha ṭwā shtsa pa ṇḍi go ṇḍa ni pi tsiṇḍa pa ta / / ga cheḥ ka raṇḍi la gu ḍo zo chun / tshong 'a dus/ rdog ngo / phon ngo / sto ba / btag sa pa / dang ba /dang khron pa snyan ngag mkhan/ /changs shepa rigs ngan mngal stag sba/ /za ma tog dang dbyug pa dang / /110—539

ba raṇḍashtsa bcings pa ki rṇa ghu ṇaḥ/ /dṛ pags pa ti sī mantaha ri to ro mand+radhī tha budku dāḥ/ /lo ma bsdams pa shing srin bu/ /chu rkyal skra mtshams ljang gu 1dang / /skyugs ltar sgregs pyapa chu bur dang / /kā sman bye brag sa mardophorda ni kundaḥmetogaphe na st+ra po sa zanapū ba kau/ /ā ta paḥkṣa tri ye nā 'khri shing 'gro slong bzod dang ni/ /sbu ba mchod rten gting tshig dang / /nyi 'od rgyal rigs lte ba dang / /dhaḥka ṇa ya kṣu ra ke da raḥ/ /pū ra khu ra pra tsukrāshtsa go la rdogangor byas nyiṅgal puṅga lāḥ/ /mda' dang spu gri gse ba dang / /chu 'phel rmig pa skyur mo dang / /byi phrug mtshal dang gang zag dang / /bee tā la bhabee mtshonamalbāshtsa pu ro ḍā shophotha parbhe saḥmatshon cha/ /kusmra sngo ra bha sabye ba sha kā ro langs gyad dang sta ri dang / /mchod sbyin de nas parbhe sha /rtsab mo dga' ba de bzhin du/ /shing rta ṭā zan zangs haḥpa khrus zangs tai gra haḥ/ /dī tī neephon+ya tsa khā ra 5 paṇḍi shwa bhra nyi mo da shaṃ/ /bshad pa so sor 'dod/ /gnyis dman la'o gzhan yang mkha'/ /dgon pa 'dab ma dong dang ni/ /shrī toṣṭa rmā sa ru bye ra mu khā kṣi dra nor dang dadu/nga bi khaṃ ba la noradang dpung / /ha la he ma shu kha ba chu dang grang dro dang / /sha khrag kha mig khu ba dang / /stobs dang shol dang gser zangs lcags/ /lwa lo ha su kha duḥkha shu bhā shu dzha/ /dza la putpā ṇi la ba ṇa byañdza nā n+ya nu le pa rgo/ /bde sdug dge dang mi dge dang / /chu dang me tog rnams dang ni/ /lan tshwa rlung byan — —yab rjes byug pa/ /ko ṭwāḥsha tā di saṃ khya3tyā bā la kṣa ni yu tañtsa ta ta/ /drusko ma si sus bye ba brgya la so/gas pa'i grangs/ /gzhan yang 'bum dang sa ya dang / /a tsa gnyis pa as i us an nda nta ya da nānta ma katt+waṃ ri/ / tā haṃ sa lo pa tt+waṃ shi ṣṭi ra tram̐ pā ka mtha'—/ /gang zhig byed po ming la a na'i mtha'/ /tra mtha' sa la nye sngon lhag ma dang / /thog mar saṃ khyu yā lha nī tai / / bā tā rya da nti re kā tho ju grangs dang ldan pa'i rā tra dang / /snod la sogs pa a ta mtha' rnams kyi don/ /gcig pa'i ba gnyis gurla kṣu nu sā ra taḥ / / dwo dwo ka tā byā yī bhā bo ba thāḥsaṃ khyulha bya mtshon bya'i rjes 'brang nas/ /zlas dbye'i gcig nyid mi zad gyur pa dag /mi zad grangs las pha rol 110byed540

yatpa raḥ/ ṣa rgyu yā ba hu māṃ tse dī sgo yo saṃ ha to sa bhā/ /shā lārjapi pa tha'o/ /gal te mang na (khya drug pa las tsā rjo ya/ /tshogs pa dang ni 'dus pa'i bisprul/ /khang —don pha rol pa rā rā dza ma nubyā ṭwā da rā dza kā ta / / dā shī sa tt+waṃ dṛ pa sa lha mi ma yin gyi don/ /rā dza min pa'i rgyal po las kyang ste/ /'bangs kyi mdun sa mi bdag mdun sa dang / /ra kṣa ཿ sa bha mi mā di sha ཿ / / u pa rnyo pa kra māṃ ta stso ta srung ba'i mdun sa 'di rnams phyogs tsam mo/ /nye bar shes dang nye bar bgrod pa'i mtha'/ /de ni dang dā di twa pra kā sha nee / / ko pa dzñā ko pa kra mā di kasgo shī na ra nā por rab tu gsal ba rang ④/ /tshangs pa shes dang tshangs pa'i go rims sogs/ /u shrī na ra'i ming can ma su/ /bhā bhe na ṇa ke tsisbyo phobye sa spru he bhā ba karma rtoḥ/ /a danta la kand+ra/ /na ṇa ka tsi ta las gzhan dngos po dang / /tshogs pa dang ni dngos po la sa dag la/ /ata pra tya yāḥ pu ṭu su di nā rgyu twa ha ཿ pa raḥ / / kri yāpho bya yā māṃ bhe mtha'i rkyen rnams bsod nams nyi ma bzang / /dag las pha rol tu ni a haḥ'o/ /bya ba mi zad rnams kyi da kā bye ka twe lha pluthi to ṭa ke/ / tso rtsa pi stso kṛ ta snyu rgo ti sman dbye ba rnams/ /gcig nyid kyang ngo rig byed gar gyi bye brag /ta la 'i 'bras bu dang ni rma bya'i mdongs//rī ṭaṃ ma rma yo dza nee / / rā dza sru yo bā dza pe yo ga rkya nga khyim kyi ka ba thod thod la ke rī ṭa yo da pa sa brtag dang srog gi gnad/ /dpag tshad dang ni rgyal ngo/'i mchod rya pa tsheg sa snye ba ca da rya kṛ to ka be ཿ / / mā ṇi kya bhā 6 si zla sbyin dang / /bā dza mchod pa pe yo tshigs bcad rkang ldan dang / /snyan ngag mkhan byas nor bu dang ni ra ṭī ra ṭī ba ra pa ñdza dzwa ram̐ / / lo kā ya tai ha ri tā lo skad—/ /li khri gos dang chos gos dang ni gur/ /'jig rten rgyang pan dang ni ba bla dang / /bdug bi da la stha la zilamingabāhla baṃ// //rdzas ster ma dang ni gur gum mo// //110—541

punda pudma ka yoḥshe a sngopholharwartsojo rig byed grangs rtsa pi ju ka kaṇḍa kāḥ/ /mo da laduko skyes bu ma ning dag la'o lhag ma yilku/ /phyed mchod 'ba' cha dang ni tsher ma dang / /zas kyi bye brag daṇḍa ka tshong pa 'i stong pa ri ka staṅkaḥsdeb sbyor ram ras ring ngo shā ṭa kaḥkarba ṭopho rbu rdo'ajog daḥ/ /pa ta rgyun chags mthun bral dang / /gos dang brgya grong de bzhin shar dang ni/ /thong ba dang ni nyer sbyor sman kodmo ga tsa ra ka ta mā khā mā la na ḍaḥ/ /kuṣṭha mdzenang la'ang muṇḍa shīdhu bsta 'bru sogs phye mar byas /dpyad dang / /ta mā lā dang grong mtha' ldum ra dang / /ru rta mgo bo'i chang dang bas ta dang / /seng ste ḍi tai kṣe ma kuspyi 'og gi 'al ba saṃ/ / saṃ ga ma sha ta mā yo na tan nā1 sgra dang ni bde dang bum pa dang / /yang dag 'grogs dang brgya tshad mig nad dang / /rgyags dang mi salba lā bya ya tāṇḍa baṃ/ /ka bi yo kand+ra kabyā sa pā ra bā ram̐ yu garnya ram̐/ /zad pa/ dang gar stabs so/ /kha yi sgye dang las dang ras/ bal dang / /pha rol tshu rol dang ni gnya' shing yu ci rnga yo rnag 2 zer pra shrī ba pā tri bee yu sran phye ṣatso sran sogs khu ba ma sa tsi kka sngo nas bye sau/ /'dzin / /mchod sdong pra spri rab mgrin ba dang ldung bzed dang / /ga'u zla ba dang ni chang gi snod/ /a rjatstsha rig byed grangs do 1 tā dī māṃ pu sta bye bee di kai sgru baṃ/ / tarjo kta phyed mchod 'a sogs dang ni mar la sogs/ /skyes pa nyid phyir gang zhig nges par rig /de 'dir mi ha lo ke pi tastso dast+ya stu 4she ṣa bta// //bshad pa min pa 'jig rten na/ /gal te yod na'ang lhag ma bzhin du gyis// //byā sum̐ sa yo ra pa tyanta dī tsa tuḥ ṣaṭwā do ra gāḥ/ / dzā ti bhe dāḥbud med skyes pa dag la'o bu rgyud mtha'/ /gnyis bzhi drug gi rkang ldan brang 'gro rnams/ /rigs kyi pu mā khyushtsasdi yo giḥ sa ha malla kaḥ / /mu nirba rā ṭa kaḥ swā tirbaṇḍi bye brag skyes par kun tu bshad/ /bud med ldan pa rnams kyis lhan cig gyad3/ /thung pa lte ba dang ni sa ri ko dzā ṭa lind+ra 6 nuḥ/ /mū ṣā mṛ bya shing rta mo pā ṭī 'bras bu karkantu dzee ka ṭī ku ṭī khang chung / /sdi na sum̐ na sa ka yodhā ba kri ya yoḥbyuzha tsitsu bu nya/ /gos dang rked pa phu lu'o/ /bud med ma ning dag la'o kha cig tu/ /dngos po bya ba dag la ṣanya dang punya/ /au tsi tya mo tsi tī mi ṭī mi bye buspru gu da z-i taḥ/ / ṣabye nta sthā kla dāḥrigs dang mi rigs dang ni byams pa dang / /mi byams bu nya dang por dper brjod pa/ /drug pa'i mtha' pe nā tshwa ya sā khā su rā ṇi shā ཿ / / sru dzā dṛ se rgo shwa ni yi tshig rnams snga ma can/ /dmag dang grib ma ra ba chang mtshan mo/ /yang na'o dmag gi mi dang sang shaṃ go shā la mi ta re tsa di ka/ / ā ba nda rnyotta ra pa do dī gurtswa dgongs dang / /ba lang rab gzhan 'a 'ang phyogs yin no/ /ab an mtha' sna can tshig rnams phyi ma can/ /sum̐ si nashtsa lu pa/ /dist+ri rdo kha ṭwāṃ tri kha ṭī tsa tri takṣa pi mā na sāta// //ba gnyis pa dang skyes min na yang dbyi/ /phyogs dang khri gsum khri gsum gsum 'jog kyang // //tri 6 pā ṭī pu ṭa 'khar sgod bā ṭī pe ṭī ku ba la 4 dā ḍi mo/ /pa ra liṅga gsum rnams snod dang phur ma dang ni khur/ /sgrom dang utpa/ 'a dang se 'bru'o/ /pha rol rtags ni swa pra dhā nee dwa dre ta hphu ru ṣe pi ta ta / / a rja nd+ra ཿ pā rya lo pā bhā rang gtso zlas dbye dang / /de yi skyes bu yang de don gyi mtha'/ /pra so/gas a lo thob dang rnyed pa dang / /pa nda pūrpāḥ ba ro pa gāḥ / / ta ddhi tā ze dī guḥ saṃ khyu sarba nā ma ta snga snyem can dang pha rol nye bar 'gro/ /de yan don dang po gnyis pa dang grangs// /sarba nā ma de yi mtha' danta kāḥ / / ba hu spru hi ra di dmā sna munni yi ta du dā dṛ tai / /can rnams/ /phyogs kyi ming min 'bru mang po nyid de/ /de yi dper brjod rnams na 6grang bar bya/ /gu ṇa dra bya kri yā yo go pā bye bheḥpa ra gā mi naḥ/ /kṛ 7 taḥ karta rya yon tan rdzas dang bya ba la sbyor ba'i/ /sngon ma can rnams pha rol/ 'gro ba can/ /ming med byed pa po la saṃ dzñā dzee kṛ tyāḥ ka rta ri ka dzre ṇi / / a nā ryand+ra sta na ra ghā rya ze kṛta rnams te/ /las dang byed pa po la kṛ tya rnams/ /des btsos la sogs don la aṇa sogs mtha'/ /110byed543

gnyis pa dang tshogs kyi bdag /mche ba gcig pa ha la gnas/ /lto ba 'chang dang glang po'i gdong / /smin drug bu dang sde chen dang / /'dam bu'i tshal skyes gdong drug pa/ /ri skyes dga' byed skem byed dang / /sde dpon me skyong sbed byed dang / /mang po las skyes sgol byed 'dul/ /gtsug pud can zhon sa ga skyes/ /ma drug pa dang mdung thogs dang / /gzhon nu dang ni khrung khrung 'joms—/ /khyab stabs ①smin pa 'joms par byed/ /rgan bo la nyan shis brjod nyan/ /gang po 'bod dang grong 'joms dang / /rgyal byed nus ldan legs bris gtso/ /mchod sbyin brgya pa mtho ris bdag /legs skyobs ༄ ri 'joms rdo rje can/ /dbyig ldan 'phel 'joms char 'beebs dang / /gnas kyi bdag po lha yi bdag /stobs ldan dgra kyedang legs brjod dang / /rmugs byed 'joms dang 'brog ④byed rta/ /mtho ris rgyal po grol med 'joms/ /yang dag du dang bzod dkas rings5/ /gzhan snyems bzang dang sprin la zhon/ /kun 'joms mig stong ri skyes ldan/ /de yi btsun bye mo spugs gang skyes/ /legs rjod 3ma dang dbang mo'o/ /grong ldukhyer mche ba med ldan dang / /rta ni mtho nyan kha lo yi/ /ma ni yid grub dga' ba'i tshal/ /khang bzangs rnam par rgyal byed dang / /rgyal byed dang ni smin 'joms bu/ /sprin gyi glang po mtsho skyes dang / /sa srung bu dang chu 'dzin glang / /sgra sgogs rdo rje mo ma yin/ /lag ldan 'bigs byed thog dang ni/ /rtse mo brgya pa sgra can bde/ /sgrogs zhum za byed gnyis dag go/ /mkha' theg khyamakha' gnas mo ma yin/ /lha yi drang srong mi sbyin sogs/ /chos bzangs lha yi mdun sa dang / /btung rnams bdud rtsi bde bar 'thung / /chu bo dal 'bab mtho ris klung / /nam mkha'i 110—559

shaṃ gā bcud ldan ri/ /lhun po ri rab gser gyi ri/ /rin chen brtsegs pa lha yi gnas/ /lnga po lha yi ljon shing ste/ /manda ra ba rgya mtsho skyes/ /legs khyab dang ni dpag bsam shing / /'phrog byed tsan dan skyes bu 'am/ /tshangs pa'i gzhon nu rnam byed bu/ /mtho ris sman ཿpa ma rta'i bu/ /sna skyes tha kar skyes pa dang / /kun mkhyen tha skar skyes gnyis dag /chu skyes mo ste mang po'o/ /mtho ris smad 'tshong dbang chen sogs/ /sgra ngan spangs dang dbyangs 'dems sogs / /gnas skabs gsum na dri za'i glu/ /'khyog 'gro med dang rnyed za dang / /byin za nor las rgyal ba dang / /chu yi skya zhu gnas 'bar ba can/ /skyes thob lus mi skyong zhe ba dang / /shing 'phel skems byed lam nag dang / /'bar ba'i skra can snga dro sad/ /rten za 'od zer chen po dang / /chung byed smin byed mtsho byed dang / /rta dmar rlung gi grogs po dang / /gtsug pud can dang rtswa zan dang / /gser gyi thig le bsreg rdzas za/ /sreg byed mtshun gyis thob byed dang / /'od bdun nyer zhi mya ngan byed/ /sna tshogs 'od zer 'od nor can/ /dag byed chu 'khris brang skyes dang / /rgod ma skyes dang ma rta'i me//lha mchod gnyis po 'bar ba dang / /me lce yal me 'bar me dang / /nyal ldan 'di ni mo yin no/ /gsum rnams me stag me skar dang / /shin tu gdung ba tshad can mtshungs/ /chos kyi rgyal po pha gshin bdag /mtshungs 'jug gshin kyi rgyal po dang / /mthar byed ya mu na yi spun/ /zhi byed gshin byed rgyal po gshin / /grangs can dbyug 'dzin mtshun kyi lha/ /nyi ma'i bu dang mtha' can no/ /srin po ro zan sha rjen za/ /sha za khrag 'thung kun du rgyu/ /mtshan mo rgyu dang nam la spyod/ /sna tshogs mdog can gsod bdag skyes/ /'gro 110—560

'dzin bsod nams skye bo dang / /bden bral rjes 'jug srung ba pa/ /mchog sems mchog sbyin zhags pa can/ /chu skyes bdag dang chu bdag go/ /dbugs 'byen rig stildan ma mos 'phel/ /rtag 'gro rta len dri len dang / /dri 'ded rlung dang myur 'gro dang / /skye 'gro'i srog dang 'gro ba'i ngang / /nam mkha'i bdag po 'gro ba pa/ /gang byed gang ldan rab 'joms so/ /srog dang thur sel mnyam gnas dang / /gyen du rgyu dang khyab byed rlung / /'di rnams lus la gnas pa'o pya/ /skyod byed rgyug byed myur 'gro dang / /mgyogs 'gro shugs ldan de nas ni/ /myur mgyogs la gor skyen pa yud/ /cig car ma thogs de ma thag /skad cig mi 'gor dar tsam mo/ /kun du rgyun tu ngal med dang / /mtshan med par med rgyun mi 'chad/ /rtag tu ltos med res dga' min/ /de nas phul 'byin 'bud pa dang / /shin tu drag po'i te bor dang / /'bung brdo mthar byed shin tu gzhung / /nan tar nges par brtan pos kyang / /cing med bri med nges du 'bad dang / /sems med myur sogs ma ning ngo / /sems yod rnams la gsum kar 'gyur/ /lus ④ngan dang ni mig gsum gogs/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po gsang bdag dang / /me 5yi chos ldan nor sbyin dang / /rgyal po'i rgyal po gter gyi bdag /mi 'am ci dbang rnam thos bu/ /'od yangs tsha bo mi la zhon/ /mchod sbyin mig skya e la'i rgyud/ /dpal ster bsod nams skye bo'i dbang pya / /sna tshogs shing rta de yi tshal/ /bu ni dpal mos mtshan pa can/ /rtse ba'i gnas dang grong khyer ni/ /mkha' gnas me tog can yin no/ /mi 'am ci dang ci skyes bu/ /rta yi gdong can 'gro mgyogs so/ /gter dang mdzod kyi dbye ba la/ /pad can dung can la 710—561

sogs gter/ /lha rtsen rol gnas gnyis po mo/ /'gro med kun khyab rgyas byed dang / /sgra sgogs rmyemakha' dang bar snang dang / /kun 'gro mtha' med lha lam gnam/ /mi g.yo ba dang khyab 'jug gnas/ /kun gsal rnam grol skyes bu'am / /phyogs dang nyi ston gsal gnas dang / /kun khyab 'phrog byed nyid kyang ngo / / snga dro gung dang phyi dro'i phyogs/ /shar dang lho dang nub dang ni/ /byang gi phyogs ni steng yin no/ /phyogs rnams gsum pa rnams su 'gyur/ /dbang po med dang ma gshin bdag /bden bral chu dang rlung dang ni/ /lus ngan dbang ldan bdag po rnams/ /shar phyogs la sogs rim bzhin gnas/ /mtsho skyes pad dkar phyir log khrus/ /sa mos gsal byed me tog so/ /sa kun la grags cha 'dzes te/ /'di rnams phyogs kyi glang po'o/ /glang po chu 'dzin dmar ser dang / /ser skya dpe med rim pa las/ /zangs sna ma dang so legs ma/ /yan lag mdzes dang gsal byed do/ /ma ning mi zad phyogs min rnams/ /phyogs dbus phyogs mtshams mo yi rtags/ /nang dang phyi rol min pa la/ /khor —yug dang ni mu khyud can/ /chu 'dzin chu 'bebs chu khur dang / /sgra srogs chu yi bzhon pa dang / /rgyu 'dzin rlan 'dzin glog can dang / /chu sbyin gsher 'dzin tsha zer 'joms/ /chur tsar dgar byed chu 'gyed dang / /du ba'i skye gnas chu skyar gnas/ /sprin gyi phreng ba zhes pa dang / /sprin skyes sprin las byung ba gsum/ /'brug dang sgra chen sprin gyi sgra/ /sgra can nyid la sogs pa'o/ /bde 'thung dang ni sgra brgya pa/ /sgra 'gyed chu skyes skad cig 'od/ /glog dang rnams gsal 'khyug byed dang / /skyod byed sdod med nyid kyang ngo / /thog gi sgra dang rdo rje'i sgra/ /sprin gyi 'od zer chu 'dzin 110—562

skyes / /dbang po'i mtshon cha brgya byin gzhu/ /de bzhin drang 'khyog ces bya'o//char pa zhod dang de yi gegs/ /than chen char 'gog mnyam pa'o/ /rgyun 'bab yongs lhung drag char ro/ /char rdul chu rdul chu yi zer/ /rdo rje'i char dang ser ba'o/ /sprin 'khrig nyin mo ngan byed do/ /mun po 'thib pa'i skyes bu 'am/ /mi mngon mi / gsal ba dang ni/ /bsgribs pa dang ni g.yogs pa dang / /mi snang ba dang khebs pa'o/ /bsil zer sim byed ka bur dang / /dbang po gu ri —mud gnyen byed dang / /bdud rtsi'i 'od dang 'od dkar can/ /rtsa yi dbang po mtshan mo'i bdag /'tsho byed zhags byed rgya mtsho skyes/ /'grib byed cha gter ri dgas mchan / /gnyis skyes rgyal po ri bong 'dzin/ /rgyu dkar rgyal po mtshan mor byed/ /cha dang dum bu bcu drug go/ /gzugs ni mo min dkyil 'khor gsum/ /dum bu cha nus dum phyed dang / /phyed ma mnyam po'i yan lag can/ /zla 'od kun phan sim 'od do/ /rab dang rab tu gsal ba dang / /bdag can nyams can mtshan ma can/ /rtags can mtshan nyid mtshan byebyed can/ /kun mdzes mchog tu mdzes pa dang / /mdzes sdug legs ngo mtshar ba'o/ /char skya khu 'bangs gangs skyes dang / /mchod bya ngan sa kha ba spungs/ /de yi tshogs pa gangs yin no/ /bsel ba'i yon tan de don 'dra/ /bsel dang bser dang grang zhing 'khyags/ /lhags pa lhags dang lhags ngar dang / /bdun po gzhan kyi rtags can no/ /brtan gnas dang ni rkang steng bu/ /ri bo 'phangs dang bum pa skyes/ /grogs po lha mi bu de bzhin/ /zil gnon rgya can chos mnyam ma/ /mi rtsang 5'gro byed 'od can dang / /skar ma dkar po 'phur byed mo/ /gsal ba'i bu mo tha skar 110—563

sogs / /skar ma rta ldan rgod ma can/ /sgrub byed nyid ni sa ga'o/ /rgyal ni grub pa tshim byed do/ /mon gru mnye dang nor ldan yin/ /khrums dang ba lang rkang pa mo/ /mgo ni ri dgas mgo zhes bya/ /de la lo yi dang po'o/ /de yi steng phyogs 'gro ldan gyi/ /skar ma rnams ni gnas pa'o/ /lha bdag lha yi slob dpon dang / /dbyangs bdag blo ldan lha'i bla ma/ /'tsho byed phur bu smra ba'i bdag /sna tshogs gtsug pud can gyi bu/ /mya ngan snyan ngags lha min bla/ /'od can pa sangs snyan dngags bu/ /mig dmar sa skyes sa las byung / /lus dmar dang ni sa gzhi'i bu/ /zla bu gza' lag snar ma skyes/ /mnyam dang nyi bu dal 'gro spen/ /mun pa sgra gcan mtho ris mdzes/ /seng ge'i bu dang zla ba 'tshe/ /'od zer 'gro byed la sogs pa'i/ /drang srong bdun po sna tshogs dang / /khyem rnams shar ba dus sbyor te/ /de ni lug dang glang la sogs / /nyi ma 'od 'gyed bsten bya dang / /mi sbyin skyes dang bcu gnyis bdag /nyin byed 'od byed snang byed dang / /rab tu gsal byed rnam gsal byed / /'od ldan mig gzugs rta bdun pa/ /rta ljang can ni tsha zer can/ / nas 'phyur 1mchod 'os mngal na sdug /char 'beebs 'od 'go gso bar byed//nam mkha' 2nor bu sgol byed bshes/ /sna tshogs 'od zer rnam snang byed/ /'od kyi nor can gza' yi bdag /'od zer bdag po snang byed bdag /'od can 'joms byed 'od stong pa/ /gdung byed 'od 'byin 'od zer gzugs//gnas byed dmar ser dbyug can gyis/ /nyi ma'i 'od la yongs su bskor/ /nyi ma'i kha lo skya rengs dang / /brla med 'od srung khyung sngon skyes/ /yongs bskor yongs su bkris pa dang / /nye ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor can/ /'ded 110byed564

byed 'od byed nam mkha' 'jal/ /phyogs 'gro 'od 'gro chu 'thung phod/ /gsal ba 'od byed srin bu gsod/ /mo dang skyes bu gsal byed mo/ /'od dang gsal ba snang ba sgon/ /snang gsal 'od mdangs 'od zer dang / /'od dngas gsal sgron ma ning ngo / /mun sel mud nyu'ajoms mtshan mo sel/ /cung dro bag dro dro tsam dang / /dro ba de ldan gsum yin no/ /tsha ba rab cha cha drag go/ /de bzhin smig rgyu ri dgas sred/ /bgrang bya dus dang slar byung dang / /nye bar 'gro dang de nas ni/ /phyogs rtsa 'phel 'grib 'di gnyis mo/ /de sogs tshes dag gnyis dag go/ /myun bsal nyin mo bya spangs bsal/ /yang na ma ning rtse gnas 'jog /mun dang sa nyin dang rab sad sreg /nam langs pa dang rab snga gsal/ /nyi ma'i mtha' dang dgongs mo dang / /bsam gtan dang ni pha skyes so/ /snga dro phyi dro nyi ma gung / /mtshams gsum de nas bya bral dang / /bsam gtan gnas dus mtshan mo dang / /thun gsum dal ster bsam pa spangs/ /snang bzlog nam dang rdul dang ni/ /thun sbyor chags dus snang med dang / /mun mtshan mun pa'i nam dang ni/ /snang mtshan zla ba dang ldan pa/ /ma 'ongs da ltar gnyis ldan pa'i/ /mtshan mo de rgo phyogs ldan no/ /mtshan mo tshogs pa zhags rnams dang / /mtshan mo'i dang po nam kyi gdong / /nam phyed mtshan phyed gnas pa gnyis/ /thun dang mel tshe gnyis dag mtshungs/ /tshigs dang mtshams dang tshes gcig dang / /bco lnga yi ni mthar thug pa/ /phyogs kyi mtha' ma bco lnga gnyis/ /zla ba gang ba 'jal byed rdzogs/ /cha nyams rjes 'gro gang ba dang / /mtshan byed mtshan mo mthong bar byed/ /gnam stong lhan cig byed dang mthong / /nyi ma zla ba lhan cig 110—565

gnas / /zla mthong zla ba gzhon nu'o/ /zla ba nyams pa cha nyams so/ /nyer 'tshe gza' ni 'jug par byed/ /nyi ma zla ba sgra gcan gzung / /nyer sgyur bya byed spangs pa'o/ /mi yis bsregs dang ngar bzhin sgyur/ /gcig tu sbyor bas me tog ldan/ /nyin byed mtshan mo byed pa po/ /mig 'dzum bco brgyad de yi gnas/ /de ni sum cu cha shas so/ /de yi sum cu skad cig go/ /de ni bcu gnyis yud tsam yin/ /de ni sum cu nyin zhag go/ /de rnams bco lnga phyogs yin no/ /phyogs ni sngon ma phyi ma ste/ /de gnyis zla ba dkar nag go/ /mchu sogs zla ba gnyis gnyis ni/ /dus tshigs de gsum bgod pa'o/ /nyi ma lho dang byang bgrod ni/ /lo gcig la ni gnyis yin no/ /nyin mo mtshan mo mnyam pa'i dus/ /nyin mtshan mtshungs dang dus mnyam mo/ /me tog ldan pa'i zla ba nya/ /rgyal gyi zla ba gang yin de/ /ming ni rgyal yin mtshungs la sogs / /de bzhin gzhan ni bcu gcig go/ /ri dgas mgo can nus ldan mgo / /smal po zhes bya gsum yin no/ /me tog rgyal zla nus zla gnyis/ /dka' thub mchu zla de nas ni/ /'bras zla dka' thub sbo zla'o/ /nag pa 'dod pa dus sbrang zla'o/ /sa ga sbrang dus me tog can/ /gtso bo spyon zla gtsang ma dang / /chu stod zla ba gro zhun dang / /nam mkha' dang ni thos zla'o/ /byun bzang khyu mchog rkang pa dang / /ba lang rkang dang khrums zla mtshungs/ /tha skar ltad mo'i zla ba dang / /glu dbyangs zla ba smin drug dang / /mang po 'dzin dang smin drug zla/ /dgun stod dgun smad mo ma bhuyin/ /dpyid dang me tog ldan dus dang / /bde byed so ga tsha dus dang / /nges par sregs dang dro ba'i dus / /drod phebs drod 'ongs tsha 3ba'i dus/ /mo/ dbyar mo mang po'i 110—566

chig char 'bab/ /de nas ston ka mo yin no/ /dus tshod drug po 'di rnams ni—/ /pho/ mgo sogs zung rnams rim pa las/ /lo dang bgrang bya 'gro 'ong dang / /'dor byed mo min ston dang mtshungs/ /nyin zhag dang ni zla bas 'gyur/ /bu yi lo yis lha rnams kyi/ /lha yi zung ni stong phrag dag /gnyis ni changs ①pa kalpa ste/ /de dag mi rnams kyi kalpa/ /mtho ris rnams kyi zung rnams kyi/ /bdun cu rtsa gcig /'jig pa'i kalpa pra la ya/ /nyal dang zas dang kalpa'i mtha'/ /mo min reg 'phel skyes bu sbung bye / /bya ngan 'thung dmangs byed dag mdzad/ /rgo byed bzang po spangs sdig pa/ /nongs ri pa nyes spyod nyes byas so/ /chos ni mo min bsod nams dang / /dge ba legs byas khyu mchog go/ /dga' mgu rangs dang spro ba dang / /yi rang dgyes dang mnyes pa dang / /nyams dga' sdig zad zhi ba dang / /mi dge spangs dang legs sgo'o/ /dge dang bsngags 'os zhi ba dang / /bzang po phan thob bkra shis legs/ /skal pa skal thob 'dod thob dang / /ngan sel bde legs mo ma yin—/ /bstod 'os de nas gsum dngos po/ /spyig dang bsod nams bde la sogs/ /shin tu bzang dang phul byung dang / /rab dang mchog dang ltad mor che/ /'di rnams mnyam pa can zhes brjod/ /skal ldan dge ba bsags rgyab can/ /lhas bskos lhas bstan skal ba dang / /mo sngon byas las dang sngon las so/ /rgyu dang byed po sa bon no/ /nges ldan thog ma'i byed pa'o/ /zhing zhes bdag dang skyes bu ste/ /gtso bo rang bzhin mo yin no/ /khyad par dus byas gnas skabs so/ /yon tan snying stobs rdul dang mun/ /skye ba skyed po skyes pa skye/ /nyer bskrun ④ nye bar 'byung rnams so/ /srog can sems can skye ldan 110—567

dang / /skye bo skye dgu lus can no/ /sems dang sems pa snying dang ni/ /sgrog byed 'phrog byed yid byed yin/ /blo gros yid 'dod spobs pa can/ /blo dang shes rab nyal slong dang / /yid ldan mthong dang dmigs ldan sems/ /legs rtogs go shes bsam pa'o/ /mi brjed 'dzin nus dran bzang po/ /rtog pa yid kyi las dang ni/ /sems kyi longs spyod yid la byed/ /dpyod dang bgrang 1byed rnam par dpyod/ /lhag par dpyod dang rtog pa dang / /sems dang the tshom som nyi dang / /neem nur dang ni yid gnyis so/ /de nas mtshungs pa gtan phebs nges/ /log par lta ba med pa ba/ /gnod sems 'tshe ba ba dang ni/ /mtshungs pa grub mtha' bzung ba'i sems/ /'khrul pa log shes nor pa'i sems/ /khas len phyogs bzung dam 'cha' dang / /nges pa mnyan bya yang dag thos/ /bdag gir byas dang khas blangs dang / /so sor mnyan bya ting nge 'dzin/ /thar dang blo dang shes pa gzhan/ /rnam shes bzo dang bstan bcos so/ /grol ba ma 'dres mya ngan 'das/ /rab bsngags nges legs 'chi med dang / /thar pa dang ni spangs pa'o/ /de nas mi shes ma rig dang / /rmongs pa dang ni ngar 'dzin blo/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang / /yul 'di spyod yul dbang 'dod rnam/ /yul can yul dang dbang po dang / /las kyi dbang po kha la sogs/ /yid dang mig sogs blo yi dbang / /chu rten bska ba mo yin no/ /mngar dang lan tshwa tsha ba dang / /kha dang skyur dang ro rnams ni/ /skyes bu de ldan drug po 'ang gsum/ /rnam nyed sbyar spos dri dang ni / /skye bo'i yid 'phrog kun mos dang / /ring 'gugs brjod bya'i yon tan min—/ /mtshungs pa 'bod byed ring du khyab/ /dri bzangs dresna tshim 'dod dri 110—568

dang / /dri zhim legs 'thul kha la chags/ /rul dri dang ni dri ngan no/ /mi gtsang ba dang bsur dri'o/ /dkar po dge byed dkar gsal dang / /mdog dkar gzhan gcod dkar snum dang / /skya bsang dag mdog yid bsdebs dang / /mdog dkar mig stobs dkar dang sgrub/ /skya ser ser skya dkar skya'o/ /cung skya dang ni 'ol kha'o/ /nag po sngon po dkar min dang / /sngo bsangs mdog nag nag lhang dang / /ser po ser shang yung nga mdog /ljang khu ljang ser lo ma'i mdog /dmar po le brgan khrag gi mdog /dmar ba utpal dmar po dang / /mi gsal dmar rtsa skya rengs mdog /dkar dmar 'dres pa dmar skya'o/ /ser nag dang ni nag ser ro/ /dmar nag nga 1kha mchin kha'o / /gser mdog gser skya skyer kha dang / /dkar ser dur kha 'gi ha mdog /sna tshogs zal po 'dres ma dang / /khra bo kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /yon tan dkar po la sogs pho/ /yon tan rtags can de ldan 'gyur/ /tshangs byung bhā ra ta yi skad/ /sgra dang brjod pa dbyangs can dang / /tha snyad gsung dang smra ba dang / /gtam dang lo rgyus tshig ces bya/ /zur chag dang ni sgra nyams pa/ /rjod byed bstan bcos sgra la ni/ /ting su pa'i mtha' can tshig /bya ba 'am ni byed ldan pa/ /thos pa mo rig byed man ngag /gsum po de ni chos su sgrub/ /snyan dngags nges brjod mchod sbyin te/ /'di gsum rig byed gsum pa yin/ /slob sogs thos pa'i yan lag go/ /o 1yig praṇa bo 4bdag mtshungasaske/ /sngon rabs sngon du byung ba'o/ /u dātta sogs gsum dbyangs rnams / /rtsod pa dang ni chad pa'i lugs/ /rtog gi rig don bstan bcos dag /gtso bo'i ngag ni bka' lung ngo / /snying po'i mtshan nyid lnga yin no/ /170—569

rab sbyar rtog pa gtam rnams dang / /brda yis ston dang go dka' bolku/ /dran pa chos dang bcas pa rnams/ /legs par bsdus dang bsdus pa'o/ /tshig sdud pa dang bsdus pa'i don/ /gang zhig brjod dang skye bos thos/ /gtam dang lo rgyus kha skad dang / /bka' mchid yin te de nas ni/ /ming dang zhes dang mtshan dang ni/ /mngon par brjod dang ming brjod ming / /'bod pa dang ni skad gtong dang / /yang dag 'bod pa mang pos bos/ /rnam par rtsod dang tha snyad dang / /nye bar 'god dang smra ba'i sgo/ /nye bar 'jal dang dper brjod do/ /mna' dang gros 'don skyes bu'o/ /'dri dang rjes sbyor shes 'dod do/ /slar smra ba dang ldan tshig mtshungs/ /log par sngon spyor ngan brjod dang / /de nas log smra sun 'byen mngon 'dod dang / /legs smra sgra ni rjes chags skye/ /mchod tshig grags pa yang dag shes/ /bstod tshig bkur tshig bsngags pa smra/ /skyor snatshig gnyis gsum brjod pa'o/ /sgra gsang mthon po skad po che/ /gcong skad mo dang rnam 'gyur dang / /mya ngan 'jigs sogs las byung sgra/ /mi bye bsngags sdogs tshig nges par rgol/ /yongs smod sun 'byin khro tshogs dang / /gshe dang smod dang brgyad pa dang / /rngan char dang ni tshig rtsub dang / /mngon smra tshig ngan rma 'beebs tshig /gang de skyon ni nyer dmigs pa/ /de la yongs su brjod pa'o/ /de la g.yo ba gang yin pa/ /ā kro sha rgo 'khrig tshig yin/ /khams bde dang ni 'dri smad do/ /la pa lo pa don med tshig /rjes su smra ba la yang smra/ /mya ngan tshig dang gdung ba'i tshig /tshig 'gog 'gal ba brjod pa'o/ /phan tshun brjod dang smra ba dang / /'gal ba dang bral④/ shin du legs smra legs par brjod/ /110—570

gsang tshig gsang ba'i gtam dang ni/ /tshig gi skyes dang tshig spring dang / /ngag gi dbye gsum phyi ma la/ /mi dge'i tshogs ni sdig pa yin/ /dge ba'i tshogs ni legs pa'o/ /shin du mnyan dang zhi ba dang / /legs par smra dang yid la 'bab/ /khro ba'i tshig ni tshig rtsub po/ /mtshang 'bru ba dang mtshang slong ngo / /drang gtam dga' byed bden pa dang / /de nas 'gal dang rang tshig 'gal/ /phan tshun 'joms par bya ba'i tshig /yig 'bru tshig mi gsal dang dig /tshig stabs myur du brjod pa'o/ /chu mthor kyegatam dang mchil gtam mo/ /'byel med dang ni don med gtam/ /yi ge med dang brjod bya bral / /don stong tshig dang brdzun don can/ /de nas mi gsal mi mngon tshig /de nyid med dang slu ba'i tshig /bden dang de bzhin mi slu dang / /yang dag 'di rnams gsum de ldan/ /sgra dang ngas sgrogs grags pa dang / /sgrogs pa ca co ku co dang / /lhang tsher sgogs nges smra ba dang / ding 'ur dang ni shu sgra sgogs/ /smros grag skad 'don dbyangs rnams so/ /de nas shod sgra shwad sgra ni/ /gos dang lo ma rnams kyi sgra/ /rgyan rnams dang ni sril khrol sgra/ /pi wang sgra ni ni kā med/ /mi gsal kwa med kwa med sgrogs/ /pi wang sgrogs pa la sogs pa/ /mi gsal pra kwa med la sogs/ /ca co dang ni kun bye co dang / /dud 'gro'i sgra ni bā si tai/ /mo ni sgra brnyan brag cha'o/ /glu dang glu dbyangs 'di nag mtshungs/ /'khor nyan drang srong sa 'dzin dang / /drug skyes bar ma blo gsal dang / /lnga pa zhes bya bdun po 'di/ /rgyu dang mgrin las skyes pa'i dbyangs / /kwa ka lī ni sgra cha phra/ /mi gsal brnyan pa dha ni'o/ /sngags ni zab mo'i dbyangs yin no/ /tā ra mthon po gsum po gsum/ /sa ma nī ni cha 110—571

la gcig /pheg pi wang sgra ni babee kri/ /rnam par spro dang zhan ①pa ni/ /rgyud bdun yongs su bsgrags pa'i sgra/ /pi wang la sogs rgyud kyi sgra/ /rnga la sogs pa sbubs kyi sgra/ /gling bu la sogs bu ga'i sgra/ /sil snyan sgra na rngucha lang sogs/ /rnam pa 'di bzhi rol mo'i sgra bā ti tra to zhes bya'o/ /lnga rngupo 'dir dbye ba/ /rnga rings usnya ka gsum dang / /pa dha ka dang dhaka rdar grags / /'jigs byed rnga dang rnga po che/ /rnga rnga mo mig /ko ṇi pi wang la sogs sgra/ pi wang dbyug pa pra bha la/ /rtsa ba'i shing 'khrog /ki lam pa ni khob pa'o/ /thag pa'i gnas dang 'ching blto ④/ /rol mo'i dbye ba rnams/ /ḍa ma ru dang marku mudang / /ḍiṇḍi dang ni rdza rnga dang / /rnga/ klu rnga dang ni gzhan yang ngo / /gar ma dang ni rol rtsed mtshungs/ /dal dang myur dang bar ma la/ /ta two o sgo gha na rim/ /las cha la/ bya ba'i dus kyi tshad la ya dang ni sa mya'o/ /de nas mo min gar dang ni/ /zlos gar rol rtsed bro dang ni/ /rtsed 'jo dang ni 'cham pa'o/ /rnga gsum gar dang glu deng ༄ —ni/ /rol mo gar bya 'di ni gsum/ /mo gzugs byu ku tma dang ni/ /byu kutma dang zhes bya ba'i gar—/ /skyes bus bud med gzugs bzung na/ /gar gyi tshogs can asgo ka /sring mo'i bdag po a 3buta to/ /bhā ba zhes pa rig ldan no/ /de nas ā bu ka ni phabye/ /rgyal tshab gzhon nu nyid la ni/ /bhar ṭa tā shyir ka zhes so/ /rgyal po bhaṭwā ra ko lha/ /de yi bu bhar ṭwāṃ dā ri ka /lha mo gang la dbang bskur ba/ /gzhan rnams la ni bha ṭī —6/ /a brahma rgya gson mi byed/ /rā dza shā la mnga' ris so/ /am ba ma 'o de nas ni/ /byes pa pā pu zhes bya'o/ /'phags pa la ni ma riṣa/ /sring mo che ba arnyi ka /ni jo zin pa yin te mtshungs/ /haṇḍi 110—572

ha ñdza ha las bod/ /dman dang g.yog mo grogs mo so sor ro/ /e ga ha ro yan lag bskyod/ /byañdza ka ni tshul dag mtshungs/ /zin pa'i yan lag dag ni gnyis / /gsum ni e gi ka dang ni/ /sā tt+waṃ ki mi dran pa'o/ /sgeg dang dpa' dang snying rje dang / /rngam dang rgod dang 'jigs su rung / /mi sdug drag shul dang ni gsum/ /sgeg pa rtsang dang 'bar ba dang / /spro ba 'phel ba dpa' ba yin/ /snying rje thugs rje brtse ba dang / /dbang byed gtong dang rjes su brtse/ /rjes su khro ba nyid kyang ngo / /de nas dgod dang bzhad gad mo/ /mi sdug mi legs dag ni gsum/ /'di gnyis ngo mtshar rmad byung mtshar che dang //phul byung dang ni de nas ni/ /'jigs rung mi bzad 'jigs par byed/ /dngangs byed skrag byed 'jigs pa dang / /'jigs sde 'jigs can 'jigs par byed/ /drag po dang ni drag shul gsum/ /bcu bzhi/ dngang skrag nyam nga bag tsha dang / /sā dhā sa ni 'jigs pa'o/ /yid kyi rnam 'gyur bha ba yin/ /a nu bhā ba rnam 'gyur go/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal nga rgyal khengs/ /ngar byed sems nyid khengs pa'o/ /mi gus yongs smon zil gnon dang / /mi rtsod zhum byed mi mchod dang / /mi gus mi shes brnyas dang smod/ /mig dman 'tsher ngo zhum pa dang / /'dzem dang ngo tsha de gzhan 'dzem/ /bzod pa dang ni nus pa'o / /brnab sems pha rol non 1la chags/ /mi bzod pa ni phrag dog go/ /yon tan nyes sgo a stu ya/ /'grangs dang 'gal snadang rnam par 'gog /yid gdung mya ngan gdung ba mo/ /phyi nas gdung ba rjes gdung dang / /rnam par rnyil ba 'gyod pa'o/ /khro ba 'khrul pa tshig dang khros/ /mi gnas gzhan spun khong khro mo/ /gtsang mar spyod pa tshul khrims so/ /smyo ba sems ni rnam 110—573

par 'phrul/ /dga' dang mos dang yid mthun dang / /sems sbum dga' dang de nas ni/ /'jo dang 'dod dang mngon 'dod dang / /kam dang re ba 'dod spyo dang / /mngon 'dod yid kyi shing rta dang / /'dod dang mngon zhen sred pa dang / /u pa dhi ni chos sems skyes/ /a dhi yid kyi gdung ba'o/ /sems dang dran byed bsam ①mno'o/ /yid gcegs shin tu sems pa mtshungs//spro ba dang ni dga' ba'o/ /de'i brtson 'grus shin tu nus pa'i cha/ /ngan g.yo mo min sgyu dang brdzu/ /khram dang ngan thabs zog dang ni/ /zol dang ngan g.yo bcos ma'o/ /bag med pa dang shes bzhin med/ /ya mtshan ngo mtshar ltad mor che/ /mtshar che ba/ bud med rnams kyi 'jo sgeg dang / /rnam 'gyur rnam 'phrul rol pa dang / /de bzhin skul dang zur gyis ston/ /'di rnams bya ba hā bā'o/ /de rnams las skyes sgeg pa'i nyams/ /rtsed mo kyal ka bzhad gad dang / /ku re min log rtse 'jo dang / /snyad ka 'khyog tshig mtshon pa'o/ /byas bye rtsed rtsed mo kyal ka'o/ /lus 'bab sos dang rdul yin no / /bra la ya ni sems nyams so/ /snyad smra rnam 'gyur sbed pa'o/ /mtshungs pa tab tob 'tshabs pa dag /ga chad rgod dang kun nas dga'/ /yid rgod 'dzum dang bar yin 'dzum/ /spu langs ba spu dga' ba'o/ /dud mo 'cho nge 'chi ma 'dzag /g.yal ni gsum ste dzre dzhai 1rṇa/ /slu tshig bi sasthā da'o/ /nyes pa dang ni 'dred pa mtshums④/ /gnyid dang nyal dang gzims pa dang / /rmi lam legs phab ces kyang bya/ /shin tu /⑤gnyid log rab tu myos/ /byun bsdus bzhin bsdus khro gnyer mo/ /khro bas lta ba mig log go/ /yang dag grub dang rang bzhin dang / /rang gzugs ngo bo nyid dang dngos/ /de nas 110—574

g.yo ba dang ni 'dar ba'o/ /de nas skad cig nyer dga' dang / /mchod rten dga' ston ltad mo'o/ /thos rmyeris kyi sde'o// //'og sa rkang 'og stobs ldan gnas/ /bcud 'og klu yi 'jig rten no/ /bu ga blo bye bug skar khung dang / /khung dang bu gu phu gu dang / /padma'i bu ga gsal ba dang / /mthong ba rlung 'byung mkha' dngos dang / /sa'i mthong bug sgo sa'i sgo gsum/ /mdong byed mo min mun pa dang / /snang med rab rib smag dang ni/ /mun nag mun 'khrigs shin du sdug /mun mdangs she mun za zi dang / /kun khyab dang ni mun khyab po/ /ri gnas kā dru'i bu dang ni/ /de yi dbang phyug lhag ma dang / /mtha' yas nor rgyas sbrul rgyal dang / /de nas/ba lang sna dang thig le'i sna/ /dong gnas nyal byed rlung zas gnyis/ /myur 'gro dang ni chu sbrul lo/ /mtshungs pa/ gral ris dang ni dug med sbrul/ /khri can dang ni rkang bzhi dang / /shun pa rjes dang go cha grol/ /sa la 'khyog dang sa la 'bye/ /lag 'go myur 'gro gya gyu 'gro/ /'phye 'gro mche dug dug 'dzin dang / /'khor lo 'khyog 'gro rnam 'dzin dang / /'khyil pa rkang sbas mig gis thos/ /lto 'phye gdengs can zar bu mgo/ /rgyab rings zas ngan khung du nyal1—/ /brang 'go rkang 5gis 'gro ba dang / /'phel ka gdengs can rlung gi zas—/ /gsum yin sbrul las byung ba ni/ /gdengs ka dang ni pha ni gnyis/ /dug dang rus pa la sogs so/ /mtshungs pa sbrul lkogs shun pa'o/ /mi gsal rngub dang khrag gi dug /skyes bu ma ning kā go skye la/ /dug /nag po'i phung po dug hā la/ /dug dug dug tshangs pa'i bu dug /rab tu gsal dang 'joms 110—575

byed ster/ /bu ste dug dbye 'di rnams dgu/ /dug gi sman pa dug sel dang //sbrul 'dzin dang ni sbrul khas 'tsho/ /dmyal ba dang ni ngan 'gro'i thil/ /'dod 'bras bral dang ngan 'gro 'ong / /de yi dbye ba tsha ba sogs/ /mnar med dang ni ngu 'bod che/ /ngu 'bod bsdus 'joms thig nag sogs/ /sems can dmyal ba las skyes ni/ /yi dgas rab med chu bo che/ /dpal min ba dang phun tshogs min/ /gzhan gyis 'khyol dang ngan khyab po/ /mnag dka' mi bzod tshor ba bsngosgru1/ /zug rngu zug gzer na ba dang / /sdug bsngal yid 'grogs skye las skye/ /bro 'tshal gcod sbyor 'jigs pa len/ /de rnams gsum du dbye bas 'gro/ /rgya mtsho chu 'dzin zla bas 'phel/ /pha rol 'grib dang chu klung bdag /chu sel zhedang ni 'bab ldan dang / /chu can mtsho chen dug can mtsho/ /rin chen 'byung gnas chu gter dang / /chu srin bdag bo chu bdag go/ /de yi rab dbye'o ma'i mtsho/ /ba mo'i rgya mtsho de bzhin gzhan/ /chu ni me bye ste mang po'i tshig /gzhi can dang ni thur du celhang / /'dod byed 'bru phyaphan nor ldan dang / /btung bya chu dang mi 'chi dang / /'tsho byed 'byung byed rten gnas dang / /lus 'ching 'dzag dang gso byed dang / /rgyas byed kun sgo bsnyen byed dang / /btang 'gro skyong byed ltung bya dang / /za byed ltung byed bde ba mchog /sprin gyi me tog sprin kyi bcud/ /gsum gnyis byed pa rnam 'gyur ro/ /dpa' rlabs gnyer ma khrem gnyer rim/ /de nas klong dang dpa' chen 'khrug /steng 'phar dang ni rab 'khrug yin/ /'khyil can 'khor chu chu 'khor dang / /chu thigs thigs pa chu 'thor pho/ /chu yi zer ma mo yin no/ /rgyun 'khyog dang ni gya gyu 'gros/ /yur ba dang ni rnang ma'o/ /710—576

'gram dang 'gog byed chu ngogs dang / /'jugs ngogs dang ni chu 'gram gsum//pha rol tshu rol phan tshun ngogs/ /de yi bar na rgyun lam mo/ /chu bo gnyis ldan mo min zhing / /bar gling gang la chu 'gram dbus/ /chu bos nyer bzhag de ni rgang / /bye ma'i ngogs dang bye ma'i thang / /'bying byed rdzab dang 'dam dang ni/ /mo min 'dam dang 'jim pa'o/ /chu bo sgyur ba chu 'bab sa/ /bud nyudang shwa zhes bya ba'o/ /glu rab rtags gsum gru sgol sa/ /mo gru dang sgrol byed sta ri'o/ /rkyal dang rtsal 'phyan 'dzin no/ /rgyun dang rab 'bab 'bab chu'o/ /gru tsas mnyan pa'i gla yin no/ /chu lung dang ni shing 'bab chu/ /gling gzhan rgyu dang gru yi tshong / /rna ba 'dzin dang gdos pa 'dzin/ /bya ra ba dang grus 'gro ba/ /steng na yon tan shing las so/ /gru sgul dbyug pa 'phen — byebyed yin/ /gru skya du dang ni g.yob byed do/ /gru sbyar mo shing gi tog rtse'o/ /chu gzhong chu 'thor snod yin no/ /gting med gsum ste gtsang dang dngas/ /'dam khung mi dngas rnyog pa can/ /gzhol dang zab mo gting rings so/ /de bzlog dang ni tshad yod do/ /gting ④med mthil la mi reg go/ /rkyal chen chu mi nya ba'o/ /dol dang nya yi rgya yin no/ /lcags kyu dang ni nya 'bigs so/ /spu rings nya dang dzha ṣa nya/ /'gro ldan rnam par skyong ba dang / /sgong skyes rnam 'phyo go cha can/ /de nas/ 'gro ldan sha ku lārghaṃ gacho /mche stong ldan dang nya tha dang / /steng 'phyo byis pa gsod dag mtshungs/ /na la'i nya dang tsi li tshim//broṣṭṛtra srab char gnyis so/ /sgo nga'i nya bran cho tshogs pa la/ /po ta dha (3na de nas ni/ /nya snar ma/ nya yi nya yi nya gral nya/ /rdo rje can dang ti mi nya/ /nya mid la sogs de nas ni/ /yā dzā si ni chu skye'othu/ /de yi dbye ba byed ga tso/ /110—577

sram dang shaṅga chu srin srogasalha/ /sdig pa dang ni karka ṭa/ /gul 'gro ru sbal katstsha'o/ /'dzin 'khri chu yi srin rings so/ /na kra chu srin bum pa'i mgo/ /sa yi 'khri shing sa srin tal/ /dab byig go sgo ka mtshungs so/ /khrag 'thung srin bu pad pa'o/ /mo ni mang tshig pad pa'o/ /mu tig skye gnas mu sto mu tig phor/ /dung ni kambu ra yin mo/ /dung phran dung gi sren 3mo'o/ /'bu lkogs can dang smugs pa'i bu/ /'phyo 'gro sbal pa dbyar skyes dang / /shwa ltung rkyal mchan da du ra/ /sa 'bu phra mo tal phran no/ /sbal phran dang ni tshar skyes 'o/ /ru sbal phran mo du li'o④/ /nya yi bye brag dga' ma rwa can ma/ /nya phyis nya skyogs zhes bya'o/ /chu yi gzhi dang chu nyal lo/ /de la gting med chu hra da'o/ /chu yi skyang skyong lteng phyaka 'khyil/ /khron pa chu nyal skyes bu'o/ /khron chu brus chu ku pa'o/ /chu dong yang na pho yin no/ /khron pa'i rtsig pa tri ka'o / /bī nāḥha dzani kha khyer ro/ /rdzing dang de yi chu la ni/ /ā khā ta dang lhas bskang dang / /padma'i 'byung ldan sgra ldan no/ /mo minaḥchu yi snying ldan rdzing dang mtsho/ /lteng ka rdzing bu ltang lteng dang / /rdzing mo che dang rdzing rings dang / /'obs dang yongs su bskor ba'i chu/ /drangs pa'i chu dang yur chu dang / /btsug shing chus bskor bskrun shing chu/ /de nas gtsang bo 'bab chu dang / /rba rlabs can dang nya lcebs can/ /ngogs can dang ni sgra ldan sgogs//'bab ldan dang ni gling ma can/ /gzhol 'gro rgyun ldan mtshor 'bab po gi gā khyab 'jug rkang pa dang / /dzahphu'i bu mo lha yi chu/ /shing rta bu mo lam gsum 'gro/ /rgyun gsum 'jigs byed bu mo dang / /nyi ma'i bu mo kā liṭīri 7/ /zhi ba'i sring mo ya mu mā/ /re bā dang ni nar ma dā/ /zlas byung ri bo'i bu mo 110—578

dang / /lag pa'i chu bo rtag tu 'bab/ /dpung pa phyin dang dkar 'bab bo /chu bo shi ta brgyar gyes dang / /zhags grol bi pā ṭa ni mo/ /sho ṇa gser gyi lag pa yin/ /drangs chu lung chu chu phran dang / /'dam bu can dang spa can dang / /zla ba'i cha dang dbyangs can dang / /kā bee rī dang 'bab ldan no/ /gzhan yang dbye ba chu 'dras kṇi'adres/ /gnyis po wa ti chu khang ngo / /gsum rnams phyi ma dag la'o/ /lhar bcas rdzing bu'i chu la ni/ /dā bi ka dang sa ra bo /dri bzangs chu tshim 'phro ba dang / /dmar po yi ni mtshams yin no/ /utpā bye la dang stobs ngan no/ /de nas sngon po chu skyes dang / /irnyi ba ra utpal sngo/ /dkar po ku mud ke ra bee/ /shā ldu ka ni de rnams rtsa ba yin/ /chu yi lo ma bum can dang / /chu yi sngon po she 5bā la/ /chu'i sde'o/ /ku mud tshal dang ku mud//ngar ba dang ni sdong bu'o/ /de la sogs pa padma'o/ /yang na pho ni padma 'o/ /sdong bu skyes dang rtsibs 'bigs dang / /utpa la chen 'dab stong dang / /chu rgyan 'dab ma brgya pa dang / /chur nyar 'dam skyes chu yi ro/ /chu skyes mtsho skyes ngur pa skyes/ /ze 'bru'i phreng ldan pus kar chu 'khrungs/ /puṇḍa ri ka chu skyes dkar/ /de nas chu skyes dmar po dang / /utpal dmar po padma dmar/ /sdong bu dang ni ngar pa dang / /de nas mo min rtsa ba dang / /bi sha chu skyes la sogs rtsa/ /padma'i rtsa ba mo min no/ /ka ra ttha ceṭa padma'i skogs/ /padma'i skra dang ke shar/ /mo min no/ /'dab ma 'khyil dang lo ma gsar 5/ /sa bon mdzod dang ze 'bru'o/ /bshad/ mtho ris mkha' dang phyogs dus blo/ /sgra sogs gar dang bcas pa dang / /sa 'og gdengs can dmyal ba chu/ /de rnams kyi ni tshogs bcas bshad/ /sa 'og gi sde'o/ /'chi med seng ge zhes 110—579

pas mdzad pa'i ming dang rtags kyi rjes su bshad pa las mtho ris la sogs skabs dang po yan lag dang bcas pa rdzogs so// //sa yi sde tshan grong khyer dang / /ri bo dang ni nags tshal dang / /sman dang ri dgas la sogs rnams/ /mi dang bram ze rgyal rigs dang / /rje rigs dmangs rigs yan lag bcas/ /nye ba'i yan lag bcas 'dir brjod//sa gzhi skrun byed mi g.yo ba/ /mtha' yas bcud ldan sna tshogs 'gengs/ /'gyur med 'dzin byed rten byed dang / /'chang byed g.yo byed rgyal byed dang / /'od srungs byin dang gnas dang ni/ /kun brjod lhagaser ldan nor 'dzin dang //yangs — —can dbyig 'dzin chu skyob dang / /sa dang sa gzhi skyed byed bzod/ /sa chen zhag gor mchod byed do/ /sa dang mṛ —ti ka zhes so/ /rab dngas sa bzangs yid 'ongs/ /sa gshin 'bru kun skye ba dang / /sa ngan dang ni tsha'i sgo can/ /ba tshwa can dang tshan can dang / /gnyis pa dag kyang gzhan kyis rtags / /thang dang byas pa'i thang ka'o/ /mtshungs pa mya ngan thang dgon pa/ /gnyis te ma bskos ma smos mtshungs/ /gsum ni de nas 'gro ba dang / /'jig rten dang ni gnas rten dang / /sa brten skye 'gro 'jig rten no/ /'di ni bhā ra ta yi yul/ /sa rā ba ta'i chu gang las/ /de phyogs dang po shar dang lho/ /dang po dang ni steng gi phyogs/ /nub dang byang dang / mtha' 'khob dang ni kla klo'i yul/ /yul dbus madhya ma dang ni/ /'phags 'khrungs bsod nams sa gzhi dang / /'bigs byed gangs ri dag gi dbus/ /mnga' ris dang ni skye bo'i gnas/ /yul phyogs dang ni nye 'khor ro/ /gsum ni 110—580
