lhas kyi mthar thug pa/ /'dam bu phar cher 'dam bu can/ /ku mud ldan pa ku mud mang / /spa yi tshal ni spa mang po/ /lo ma rtsa skyes ljang lkupa dang / /'bru skyes pa ni pang gi la/ /chung mang chu dang ldan pa'o/ /pho mu khyud ldan pa de bzhin sgrub/ /mo ni gyo can rdza rdu can/ /gseg ma dang ni rde'u can/ /de la sogs pa'i yul rnams te/ /de bzhin gzhan yang shes par bya/ /bye ma can dang gtsang shod yul/ /char 'bab 'bru rnams phun tshogs skyong / /gtsang po'i ma dang lha yi ma/ /ji ltar rim pa/ /rgyal po bzang ba'i yul dang ni / /rgyal po bzang po dang ldan dang / /gzhan la rgyal po can zhes so/ /bal bhas ni gos thā na kardo /goṣṭṛ rgo ni sngon byung lhag /rnam grangs de rnams sa'i zhor la/ /rdzing dang yur ba mo dang pho/ /grog mkhar grog tshang grog mo'i khyim / /skyes bu dang ni ma ning ngo / /lam dang 'gro bya bgrod bya dang / /shul lam 'jug bya goms dang lam/ /'khor bya dang ni rkang gcig pa/ /shin tu 'jug bya lam bzangs dang / /bden lam mchod par bya ba'i lam/ /lam ngan sdug 'gro bi pa thā/ /g.yon lam kā pa tha ni mthungs4/ /lam med a pa dzee lkuyin no/ /lam 'dom sa dang bzhi mdo dang / /mtha' dang ring po lam steng tredang / /dgon ④ pa bgrod dka'i lam dang ni/ /gabyu ti ni mo rgya grags zung bye/ /na lwa khru ni bzhi brgya'o/ /dril bu'i lam ni khral pa'o/ /de ni grol khyer nyer grol lo/ /sa'i sde mtshan no// //grong khyer mo ste skyong byed dang / /rgyal lam 'bab gnas tshong bdal dang //'jigs med dang ni mi ⑨bskyod gnas/ /gzhan gang rtsa ba'i grong khyer las/ /170—581

grong khyer de ni lo ma'i grong / /smad 'tshong gnas dang 'jug gnas skye bo'i gnas—/ /kun 'jug ha ste tshong 'dus dang / /tshong lam dang ni srang lam dang / /srang dang tshong khang rgya 'grems sa/ /ra ba'i rmang dang 'gram mo min/ /ra ba bskor ba lcags ri dang / /rim pa 'obs tshal mtha' yi mu khyud do/ /rtsig pa mo dang brtsegs pa dang / /rtsig pa'i bar rus tī ka saṃ/ /khang pa khyim dang gnas dang ni/ /'jug bya chags dang gnas gzhi dang / /mtshan mtha' nges 'gro rtag pa dang / /gnas khang phibs 'og 'dun gnas so/ /'dzin gnas skyes bu mang po'i tshig /skyabs 'og dang ni khang khyim dang / /'dug sa khang pa gnyis dag go/ /gnas sa dang ni khyim rnams so/ /khyim bzhi yod pa 'gro ldan no/ /thub kyernams lo ma'i spyil po dang / /rtswa skyes spyil po mo min no/ /mchod rten mchod sbyin gnas dag mtshungs/ /rta yi ra ba rta khang dang / /ā bee shan bzo thuyi gnas/ /pra pā chu yi khang pa'o/ /ma tha slob grwa la sogs gnas/ /gañdza tu ni chang ma'i khyim/ /gadhā gā ram̐ nang gi khyim/ /a ri ṣṭi ni bu btsas khyim/ /glo skar khra ma ga bā kṣa/ /'dun sa mo min skye bo'i gnas / /bsil khang la sogs nor ldan gnas/ /khang bzangs lha dang sa bdag khyim/ /zhal khang mo min rgyal po'i khab/ /'du khang rgyal po'i pho brang dang / /bkra shis ma dang kun bzang dang / /g.yung drung 'khyil pa la sogs kyang / /dbang phyug rnams kyi pho brang gi/ /bkod pa'i rab tu dbye bar 'gyur//sa bdag pho brang mtha' mar ni/ /btsun mo'i khang pa srung ma can/ /dag pa'i mtha' can srung ma can/ /ya them ya phubs mo min no/ /sgo drung sgo mdun sgo rtsa ni/ /phyi rol sgo yi khyams yin no/ /sgo kha sgo phibs 'jug pa dang //110—582

yan lag bzhi mdo srang mdo dang / /shing 'og rdo yi ma them dang / /re bzhi de yi steng du gnas/ /klo'i nyusgo mtha' ma'i sgo yin te/ /phyogs mtha'i sgo ni rtsibs sgo'o/ /chu babs thog gi tha ma dang / /de nas thog dang chu skyob dang / /gdung sgur shing 'khyog thog shing skra/ /phug ron skyong dang bya skyibs can/ /skyes bu 'am ni ma ning ngo / /mo/ sgo dang srung byed sgo mo dang / /stegs bu dang ni snam bu dang / /rta babs mo min sgo yi phyi/ /grong khyer sgo dang sgo mo che//mda' yab grong sgo glang po'i sen/ /de la sen mo gsum yin no/ /sgo glegs sgo rnam mnyam pa'o/ /sgo gtan 'phreng gtan ma ning mo/ /'dzeg skas dang ni them skas so/ /skas ka dang ni ya gang ngo / /phyags ma dang ni dag byed yin/ /rdul dang phyag dar nges 'phangs so/ /sgo mdun — — skyabs 'gro nges 'jug dang / /nges 'gugs so/ /mtshungs pa grong bar grong mtshams so//khyim gyis gzhi khang pa dang / /mo min no/ /grong mtha' nye ba'i grong zhes min//mtshams dang so mtshams gnyis po mo/ /'brog khyem rtsa yi khang pa yin/ /'tshed byed sha ba ri yi khyim/ /grong khyer gyi sde tshan no// //sa 'dzin rtse can sa gzhi 'chang / /mi 'phrogs 'dzin byed tshigs can dang / /ri bos skyob gyen du 'phyur/ /ri dang mi g.yo brag rngo brtsegs/ /'jig rten snang ba khor yug dang / /ri bo sum brtsegs rtse gsum mtshungs/ /nub ri phyi phyogs sa 'dzin no/ /shar phyogs sngon ma'i ri yin no/ /gangs ldan dang ni 'gog byed dang / /'bigs byed dang ni mā lya ya/ /yongs su bskor dang spos dang ldang / /sasgo/ ma la mo/ mi nā ke/ ke khā shaḥshānumā na 110—583

bi—/ kroṇa tā/ mandar/ yī shā naḥki shu ko/ tsibyu she shwa ra/ 'di rnams ri yi bye brag ste/ gzhan las 'byung ngo / /gzhan yang gangs ri rtsegs la sogs / /mi 'gro/ rdo ba sbed byed gor ma dang / /brtsog rmyepo ju po rdun zhe dang rdo/ /brtsegs pa mo min rtse dang rwa/ /rtsang gnas g.yang sa ri gzar dang / /ri zhol mo min ri rtswa dang / /ri ltengs bang rim ri ljongs 1dang / /mo min no/ /chu can chu dang ldan pa dang / /chu 'bab chu sgra can dang sgogs/ /ri sul ngam grog mo min no/ /lha gnas khyams dang phug dang khung / /rgyu dang ri ni nyil ba dang / /shwa dang ri yi bud ces bya'o/ /rkong sa mo ste 'byung khungs yin/ /ri yi rkang pa ri phran no/ /ri rtsa ri 'og sa gzhi dang / /ri steng dang ni sa gzhi mtho/ /ro bo'i khams ni ldong ros sogs/ /btsag ran dang ni khyad par can/ /nags ri nags tshal ma ning ngo / /'khri —shing la sogs rnams kyis g.yogs/ /ri'i sde'o// //'brog dang dgon pa stong pa dang / /stug po dbeen gnas nags tshal dang / /dgon pa chen po nags stug po/ /khyem dang tshal dang nges 'gro dang //skyed mos tshal yin/ /nye 'khor tshal dang byas pa'i nags/ /de bzhin gang du smad 'tshong dang / /tshogs can khyim dang nye ba'i 'tshal/ /shing gi ldum ra can/ /skyes bu rtse gnas skyed mo tshal/ /rgyal po'i gzhi dang nye ba'i tshal/ /yin no/ /de ni lha yi rab dag 'tshal/ /grong khyer mtha' yi bkod pa'o/ /tshang ma phreng ba gral dang ni/ /khrigs chags bkod pa gral rim mo/ /nags dang tshal ni tshogs pa yin/ /myu gu dang ni zha lu skyes/ /shing dang sa skyes yal 'dab can//110—584

ljon pa rkang 'thung chur mi thong / /'gro 'gog shing dang lo ma can/ /sdong po ljon shing shing 'gro med/ /nags ni me tog mtha' mar 'bras/ /me tog med pa'i 'bras ldan nags/ /sman ni 'bras smin mthar 'jig pa/ /'bras bu 'dzin pa mo sham min/ /mo sham 'bras med shing thog med/ /'bru ldan 'bras can shing thog can/ /rab shar nyer bye yang dag rgyas/ /sbub grol rnam phye 'phro ba can/ /me tog kha bye rnam rgyas yin/ /mo sham min sogs gsum yin no / /sdong dum brtan po rtsa gog dang / /yal ga rtsa thur kṣu pa'o/ /sdong po ska ba mgul pa dang / /'khri shing 'gu geng sprelcug ma dang / /'khri shing lo ma yal 'dab dang / /lcug ma dang ni tshang tshing ngo / /'gro med la sogs bskyed pa ni/ /stod dang dzreng —dang blang ba'o/ /mo min mgul dang stod rkang ni/ /rtsa ba yal ga las byung shing / /mtshungs pa yal ga lcug ma ste/ /sdong po'i yal ga yal 'dab dang / /rtsa phran dang ni ral pa'o/ /yal ga'i rtsa ba 'phyang ba dang / /rtsa las 'khri shing rtse mor son/ /mgo dang rtse mo co do ni/ /yang na pho'o/ /rtsa ba rmang dang rkang pa'o/ /snying po rkang mar mtshungs pa'o/ /lpags mo gogs shun mo min no/ /me shing shing bu 'tshong shing ngo / /yam shing 'om shing sreg shing mo/ /khog stong nang can yang ni pho/ /gang bu dang ni snye ma mo / /rtsang byed lo ma grib byed dang / /'dab ma shing lo lo 'dab po/ /yal 'dab mo min yal tshogs dang / /rgya chen go ling mo min no/ /shing sogs rnams kyi 'bras bu 'bru/ /brin haṃ skye gnas rab tu bcings/ /ma smin 'bras bu sha la ṭu/ /me tog skam po bā na ste/ /'di gnyis rtags gsum/ /'gyur dang sbal min ma ning ngo / /gzhon nu dang ni gsar bu pho/ /kha bye ba 110—585

dang gyes pa dang / /bu che tshigs 'chas mo min no/ /mo/ /yid dgas putpa me tog dang / /ku su ma rnams mtshungs pa'o/ /me tog bcud dang me tog ro//me tog rdul dang yid 'ong rdul/ /gnyis dman 'bras 'byung kun/ /a ru ra sogs mo yin no/ /ā shwattha dang bai ṇa pa/ /blakṣa dang nee ya gro bhe①/ /eng gu rda ni 'bras bu 'bru/ /'dzam bu'i 'bras bu rdza ṣādri bye / /dzee bu dzam pa lam yin no/ /me tog rigs la sogs pa rnams/ /rang gi rtags/ 'bru dang 'bras bu/ /bee ḍūrya 5la sogs pa rnams/ /rtsa ba me tog ma ning ste/ /pā ṭa la/byang chub shing dang lo ma bskyod/ /pibee la dang glang po'i zas/ /a shwattha'o ④de nas ni/ /skyur rtsi usnya byettha snyedang / /so ste la gnod skyur mo'o/ /de la zho 'bras me tog 'bru/ so rtse nyams byed ces pa'o/ /u dum bā ra 'dzam bu'i 'bras—/ /mchod sbyin yan lag gser 'o ma/ /yongs 'dus brtol rnga yab can//ku mud lo ma 'dab zung can/ /lo ma bdun po ṣyoshun pa mthug /shā ra dī dang dug lo ma/ /dong kha dang ni rgyal po'i shing / /zhi byed sor mo bzhi pa dang / /'khor lo dang 'dra nad 'joms dang / /me tog phreng byad lo ma bzang / /skyur rtsi chen po so rtse dang / /sgyur mo rdza bhirdzambha la/ /klu shing chu shing dkar po dang / /lo ma kha dang gzhon nu'o/ /skyes bu klu shing skyes snga dang //mtho dang gi 3sar lha yi 'dab/ /yongs bzang dang ni nidza'i shing / /manda ra dang mchod yon 'dab/ /ti ni se dang lyanda no/ /mu khyud shing dang shing rta'i shing / /shin tu gol dang snod shing dang / /sna tshogs byed dang de nas gnyis//tpā ta na ka pi ta no/ /aphra ta'i shing ngo / /sbrang rtsi mngar ba'i me tog can/ /sbrang rtsi shing dang ṭwāṃ bra sru/ /ma dhuṭī lo/ ri skyes ma dhu la ka'o/ /bī lo 110—586

'bras mngar sran sri'o/ /de la ri byung a khyo ṭa/ /karbar lo gnyis yin no/ /g.ya' shing lus po za bar byed/ /pā lā sha dang ki shu ka /lo ma bā ta po tha dang / /de nas sman shing shing rta dang / /sprin gyi me tog bi du la/ /dkar po bī na rbadzi la/ /gnyis po pa ri bya dha dang / /bee du lo dang nā de yī/ /sgyur mo dang ni ta ru shi/ /mdzes pa'i mig sman shi gru dang / /dri sno mig 'dra grol ba can/ /me tog mngar dang shing gru mngar/ /ariṣṭa dang phe ni la mtshungs so/ /bilbe shāṇḍi lya dang ni/ /shi lu sngo dang mā lu ra/ /dpal gyi 'bras bu nyid kyang ngo / /bla kṣe ra tsasbarko ṭi/ /n+ya gro dha dang rkang mangs dang / /ba ṭa'o—/ /zhu mkhan sā bar lo jo'o/ /twe tūrīṭa ti lwa nyed byed do/ /a ma 'dzag byed ro ldan no/ /lhan cig byed pa ā mra zhim/ /bu mkhan ltu khal ki ma ning / /kau shi ka gug gu la 'gengs/ /se lu bad 'joms dkar po dang / /de yi 'dab ma lan mangs po/ /rgyal po byin dang pi yā la/ /sanda kruḍa 3dha nu pa ṭa/ /zab mo kun bzang kathra ri/ /sbrang lo ma dpal gyi lo ma bzang /kāthrarya dang yang de nas gnyis/ /rag chung shing dang skyur shing ngo / /ko ba li/ko lam stobs ngan phe ni le/ /sau ba 3ri ba dang ri sgoḍā dang / /de nas swā du kaṇḍa ④ka /boka ka ta sgang bzar shing / /tshigs mang ba dang stag ki rkang / /e ra ba ta na rang ga /sgyur rtsi sa yi dzambu'o/ /dand+ra ka dang sgur dza kaka /gā 2la skanta rkang mar nag /kā kend+ra spyoku la ka /kā ka pi lu ka /bya rog tend+ra 3ke/go līḍho dza byel/ ghaspyo bā ṭa li/ thar dang grol ba can/ til ka dang kyu ra dang / dpal ldan no/ /dzha mo bi tsul dzñā bu kau/ /dpal gyi lo ma ku da ki/ /rku dhī ke ḍa ryaka ṭa'i 'bras/ /zhu mkhan padzo ka thukhya yin/ /zhu mkhan dmar po 110—587

rgya skyegs dngas byed do/ /byu da pū ṣa kra mu ka /tshangs shing tshangs pa'i dā ru dang / /mtshungs/ nī pa dgas byed ki rda bā/ /gshol ldan dga' bar byed pa'o / /dpa' bo'i shing dang a ru ṣa ka ra/ /me sdong dang bha llaḍa ki gsum/ /garta bhāṇḍi kanda rā la/ /ka tpā tan su pārṣa kāḥ/ /blakṣi stitarnyi ḍi dang bse yab shing / /skyur mo ci bzhur kra rtsi shing / /a sa na bantu pya ka'i me tog dga' byed mtsho byed do/ /spos dkar/ kra rtsi kra rtsi pog dang rna ba can/ /a su saṃ ba ra/gtsang bo'i sra shing dpa' bo'i shing / /dpa' bo'i shing dang ka ku sgo rdzun/ /rā dzā rda phru lā dha kṣe/ /'o ma shing de nas gnyis so/ /i 3gu dī tsha ba shing / /stag pa ri ga shung pa mnyen/ /pi tstsha la dang snying pa dang / /grol ba dang ni tshe brtan dang / /shasma li ni gnyis/ /pi tshwa tu shā la ma lbo/ /tse ṭa ṭi/ ro tsan phung pa shābee li/ /byung bi lwa ④na ku ma la/ /kardza dang ka rañdza ke/ /pri tīrya smu ti kar dza/ /pū tī ka dang ka li kā ra ka /ka rañdza bhe dang tshogs drug makko che3/ /saṃ gā ra dang balla rī/ /ro ṭī ro nyi ta ka mtshun dgahūṃ /se 'bru'i me tog go/ /seng ldeng byes pa'i nu ma dang / /kha di ra danda dhā 3ba na/ /a ri med do sdug pa seng ldeng seng ldeng dang ni seng ldang dkar/ /zla ba'i yal gnyid kyang ngo / /de nas stag 'jug dri za lag /a raṇḍa u ru bri ka /ru tsu ka dang ri mo can/ /tsaz-i dang ni sor lnga pa/ /a maṇḍa 'phel ldan bya ḍa swa bye ka /cung zad zhi dang sa sha mir/ /sha mi sa ku'i 'bras bu zhi ba paṇḍi ta go/ /ma rub kashtsa san kar hā ṭa ka sha lya chang gi shing / /brgya byin rkang 'thung yongs bzang dang / /shing bzang dru ka li saṃ/ /shing ser shun pa tshi can shing ⑪/ /bdun po de ba dā ru yin/ /de nas gnyis po skya nar dang / /pā ṭa ma khā dang 110—588

don yod dang / /kā rasba li 'bras bu'i shing / /me tog rtsa nag lus ngan mig /khre rgod bud med ming can dang / /'khri shing pa la phyag 'tshal dang / /khre dang pri yang gu dang ni/ /'bras shing dang ni 'bras bu can/ /sna tshogs sde dang dri yi 'bras/ /kā re bhā dang dga' byed do/ /sbal ba'i lo ma pa trorla/ /gar byed ka sgo byu ga dang ni/ /ṭu ṇa ka dang gsher shing ngo / /ne tsho sna dang skar ma dang / /me tog /mgul rings kuṭa naṭa/ /sho ṇa ka dang a ra lo/ /ti 6'i bhe 'bras bu sgyur ru ra/ /gsum yin bdud rtsi na tshod byemed/ /rtags gsum pa ni ba rur/ /mig dang tshim byed karṣa'i 'bras/ /'byung po'i gnas dang rtsod pa'i shing / /'jigs sped nad med phan pa can/ /na tshod gimi 'gyur med tshi can bdud rtsi dang / /a ru ra dang gser ldan dang / /sems byed dpal dang zhi ba dang / /ljon pa ser po thang shing / /thang chu shing zhes pa yang ngo / /de nas utpal shing dang ni/ /lte ba can dang yongs nad dang / /la ku tsa dang li gu tsa/ /u hu hu/ pa nas dang tsher 'bras can/ /ni tsul dang chu skyes chu shing / /bya rog u dudza ri kā/ /'bras bu gur ma pa pūr dang //rje ngar sa'abras can/ a riṣṭa dang kun la bzang / /shing kun 'dres 5dang dri ma can/ /'joms byed dang ni nisbra'i shing / /de nas pi sgo nā dang a ga ru//shi byesha pa dang skya bo dang / /thal ba'i snying can zhes bya'o/ /shi ri kha dang chu 'thung dang / /ghaṇḍi lo yang nod nas ni/ /rtsa pe yang dang rtsa pa ka /gser gyi me tog tsaspa'o/ /de yi 'bras bu ka li kā/ /dri yi 'bras bu de nas ni/ /ke pa re dang ba ku la/ /bañdzu lo ni mya ngan med/ /mtshungs pa se 'bru dā ḍi ma//tsaspe ya dang ke sar can/ /nā ga ke sar gser ming can/ /rgyal dang rgyal 110—589

byed rtog pa'i dgra/ /nā de yi dang rnam rgyal shing / /dpal gyi lo ma me gtsug shing / /zhib dang tshogs byed rgyal ba'o/ /de nas bcad skyer brgya byin shing / /bu yi shing dang ri yi phreng / /de yi 'bras bu ka liṅge/ /dbang bo'i nas dang nas bzang 'bras/ /'bras nag smin pa bishā/ /su ṣe ṇa dang lag nyid do/ /nag po'i phung po tā mā la/ /min piñtsha 1dang de nas ni/ /sind+ra ka sind+ra bā re/ /chang gi dang po ni rguṇḍibye sna/ /dbang can yang ngo / /lan bu kha rāg rī de ba tā/ /ḍo sprin zhes pa yang ngo / /dpal kyi lag pa ju ru ṇḍi/ /rtswa rtse shing dang ma lli kā/ /sa'i rkang pa sha ta rnyi ru dang / /so bā sga tā zhunag sa las byung / /she pha pya li ka legs 'bab dang / /ni spyo ṇḍi5dang sngon po can/ /si ta sau dang dkar po dang / /ro zhim 'byung po 'jug /de nas mā ga dhī ga ṇi kā/ /pū thi kā dang asba ṣṭha/ /de ser gser gyi me tog can/ /shin tu grol dang puspyo du ka /spyid ldan sbrang gi shing 'khri shing / /me tog sna ma yid dga' dang dzā ti'o/ /'dab bdun gzhon nu'i phreng ba can/ /chu zla me tog kun pa'o/ /dmar po 3me tog bantu ka /bantu dzre ba yin no/ /nus ldan gzhon nu ta ra ṇi/ /a ma dzeen dang nus ldan che/ /de la dmar po ku chub zuka /de la ser po ku ru ṇa tha ka /sngon po rnyihā kyeganyis dang mda'/ /bran mo tsā nu ⑫sha la sa/ /bee rī ya ka rnyiṣṭa kyeyin—/ /de la ku ru ba ka dmar po dang / /ser po ku ru ba ka dang / /rnyilha de la lhan cig spyod pa gnyis/ /rnga mo ⑫ me tog dza ba dang / /rdo rje'i me tog nyi lo gang / /pra tī hā sa brgyar gyes dang / /gtum ⑫po rta bsod lag pa dpa' / /ka ri re dang kra ka ra/ /tshigs pa dang gnyis so/ /smyo byed dang ni ki ta bo/ /gdul dka' yi dhu tu ra/ /gser gyi me tog ces pa'o mā 170—590

tu la dang myos byed do/ /de'i 'bras bu mā tu la pu traka /'bras bu gang ba bī dzā pūr/ /mdog mdzes mā tu luṅga ka /sa mir ṇa ma ru ba ka /prastha me tog pha ṇa dzā ka /dzas ro dang de nas ni/ /parṇa se khyedang ka ṣṭha ñdza ra ku ther dkar po ardzu ka 'di pā thi khra bo me'i rnguming can/ arga zhes pa ba su ka /a sgoṭa tshogs pa'i gzugs marnya ra dang arka'i 'dag /'di dkar po a larka pra tā pas//zhi ba'i me tog phyugs bdag dga'/ /shing gcig spra ba ba su'o/ /banda shing la za ba dang / /shing skyes 'tshe tshib nyid kyang ngo / /bu zas bcad skye sle tres dang / /rgyud ldan bdud rtsi 'tsho byed dang / /zla ba'i mgul pa yangs pa can//sbrang gi lo ma nyid kyang ngo / /myur ba lha mo sbrang gi ro/ /mor ṭa dang 'od ldan thos—/ /mabyu li ka gzhu shing dang / /shri ṇa go pa ṇi dang / /tpā lu parṇa nyid kyang ngo / /pā thā ma nu spos dkar dang / /bi dhwa kaṇi gnas can dang / /rten dang ro ldan sdong bu gcig /sdig pa'i bram mo pra ṭī nā/ /nag kha mo can tsha ba tsha bas gang ba dang / /mya ④ngan med dang spor dang ni/ /tsha ba'i spor dang nya khris dang / /nag dbye 'khor lo'i yan lag dang / /bya'i zas/ /bdag sbed dzāḍa argya ṇaḍa/ /g.ya' shing pā pri ṣā ya bhā/ /ri 6 proghra shāka shim bi—/ /ka bi katsu shya ma kka ṭī/ /ri mo nye ba'i ri mo can/ /n+ya gro dhi dang khu ba ldan—/ /sdom pa dang ni char 'bab dang / /pra tya kagre tsā su dza gre bhā/ /raṇḍa byi ba'i rna ba'o/ /yang 'og lam she kha ri ko dang / /ṣṭha mā rga dang rma bya dang / /pra tya ka lo ma kri sha'i 'dab/ /ka ṇi tī dang bung bu'i snyi/ /phi ñdza ka dang tshangs ma dang / /padma dang ni bhā rgo dang / /tshangs pa'i mchod sdong me mdag lo—/ /bā le ya shā ka bze ra badhwa ka /rtsod dang bi kas dang ni/ /rdzing gi 110—591

yan lag mtshungs pa dang / /sbal pa'i 'dab ma bhaṇḍi ri/ /bhaṇḍi dpag tshad ṇa 'khri shing / /gze mar ma go ya bā so/ /reg bya sdug dang chu med skye/ /ka ṇa pa ka dngu byed shu/ /byed dang mtha' med dang / /rgya mtsho'i mthar skye reg par dka'/ /bri ṣa ṇi lo ma thag lo/ /sna tshogs 'dab ma spru bakhra kā/ /kroṣṭa badzee seng ge 'jug /ka la si dang rnya ra ni gu ha/ /ni da gī kā spri shrī sta 1mo bri ha tī/ /kaṣṭha ka pā tsong mbi ku li/ /chu ba reg dka' yul skyes kyang / /ram sa shing nag po llī ta ki kā/ /grong skyes sbrang gi 'dab ma can/ /'tshod byed dpal gyi 'bras bu dang / /tun tha tu bhā do lā dang / /sngon po rams so/ /gso ma rā dzā so ma dā 2dzre dang / /'dab bzang zla ba'i sdong bu dang / /kā la me ṣi 'bras nag dang / /bā gu dzre dang rus 'bras can/ /pi pi ling dang nag po dang / /bai di —tī dang ma ga dhī/ /g.yo byed zegs ma sreg par byed/ /grog rked drod sman ko la'o/ /de nas ka ri pi bya lī/ /ka pi bakhra/ shri ya sī dang rtsa shir pho/ /dbyi mo stu tsa bi shaṃ dang / /kā ka tsi gu ñdza nag po/ /pa lo ka sha dri sno khyi yi mche ba dang / /ro ldan tsher mgo kaspyo ka /go gru ra ka nags kyi rā/ /zhes pa yang ngo / /bong nga dkar po blar dug dang / /i ti bi sha nye ba'i phug /a ru ṇa/ rwa can dang ni snan chen no/ /de nas 'o ma 'o ma mtshungs / /rtsa ba brgya pa skud mangs dang / /bhi ru rind+ra rī ba rī/ /ri 6 bshad pa a bhi ru/ /nye shing ba yan tri dang ni nā ra'i bu sha tā pa rī a he ru/ /de nas skyer ba ka le ya ka khu ba ser po da ra bī/ /pa rtsa ④pa tsa shing ser dang / /pardza byā yang ngo / /chu thag dri rtsi 'dud pa drug /go lo mbi dang tshigs brgya pa/ /dkar po gangs dang ldan pa'o/ /sman pa'i ma dang seng ge dang / /bā sa kā 110—592

dang khyu mchog dang / /a ṭa byu ṣa sau ha su/ /ba sha ka dang rta yis so/ /a sbo tā ri'i phreng / /'jug gnon kṇidang ni gzhan las rgyal/ /nor shing dri ldan kāṇḍi kṣu/ /khu byug mig dang grur kṣu rā/ /shā le ya dang khyu ta shi ba/ /gdugs dang mngar ldan mi sī dang / /si ste yā dad bye de nas ni/ /shī ri khaṇḍa rdo rje'i shing / /srug sna hri guḍa thams cad 'o ma can/ /byi dang ga dang don yod dang / /sna tshogs 'bras/ tantul dang srin bu gsod/ /bi rda snyeg pho ma ning / /ba ste bā tyā la ka dang / /dril bu'i sgra dang shā ṇa'i me tog /dgun 'brum ba yin nu ma dang / /dā kṣu ro ldan sbrang gi ro/ /kun mdzes 'byung dang sa bhā hā/ /thu gsum dri bri tā tri bri ta/ /dum bu gsum pa re ba ni//sngon po dang ni ba dzi ④sgo/ /su ṣa ni phyebee nag po dang / /sran chung 'dab ma zla ba phyed/ /kā la me ṣa kā/ /shing mngar dang ni llī ta shaṃkye/ /paji ma dhu shing mngar yin/ /rnam 'joms 'o ma dkar po dang / /bur shing dri dang kau/ṣi ṭu tsa ya si tā/ 'o ma nyung ngu rnam 'joms dkar chen dang / /kṣa 3gi dri can lā ga lī/ /shā dwo chu yi pi pya lī/ /bya'i zas/ rta rgod kā ra bī/ sgrol zu me rma bya'i mdong sa/ lo tsa ma sta ka shesbrul lce sngon po shā ri bā/ mtha' med utpal shi rī tsa/ /yo gya mri dhī gru po bye dang / /laspyo dang ni rgan po'i ming / /'di chu shi bā ra tsu sā chu shing grol a nang shum ta kakhyu lā/ /muṅga'i lo ma mu tpaha ta yang / /baṇḍa ho gu shā siṅga baṇḍa ki du ṣṭa ha ra shi bhā/ /na ku li dang ro zhim dang / /rā sna ⑪dri bzangs nob skyele dri/ /na ku la 'dong rmyesbrul mig pa/ /gdugs can dang ni legs par 'bab/ /rnam 'joms dri dang aṇḍa ma tri dang //sha la'i ⑫mdab dang gnas dang bstan/ /ras bal rgya mtsho'i mtha' can dang / /110—593

gar rmyemya si da ba de re/ /ras bal rgod dang sna ba tyā/ /ro can drang srong khyu mchog go/ /gā ge ru tī klu yi stobs/ /ri ṣā hā swa gadhe dhu kā/ /dhā sā rga ba sgra ldan yin/ /ma hā dza li me tog ser/ /byed sni ba ṭi li kā dzā lī/ /klu yi 'khri shing nyid kyang ngo / /de nas gnyis skyes ha relco/ /re rku ka dang kau na ti dang / /dmar skya dang ni thal ba'i dri/ /e la bā lug me le yo/ /dri bzangs ha ri ba lu shaṃ/ /bā lu ka ñtsa de nas ni/ /bā lang kyang dang mu kunda/ /kunda kun du ru bā lam/ /hri bee ra bar hiṣṭha dī phroṃ/ /ke shā ma bu yi ming can no/ /kā khā bus ra ya bri dha/ /shra'i me tog dkar zhi ba ni tu/ /shi la yo ta la'i lo ma re bye tyā garnya/ /ku tri mu rā garnya rtswa/ /glang chen zas dang legs 'bab dang //dri bzangs ro ldan ma he sthād ni tsa/ /ma bye'abar dang ni su bhi kṣe/ /dhāta khri dang ma ma'i me tog /ka ko la dang zla stobs dang / /e lā ni dku ṭi mang po/ /de nas su smel u pa ku nya tsi/ /ka tuttha rang gi thum po gsum/ /ṭu ṭi rus rta ku ṣṭha bā ri bhā bya/ /byā ṭwāṃ pā ka la rus rta'o/ /drung ④can kun ma'i me tog yin/ /skra can/ de nas bi tunda ka dzñā ṭa ma lā/ /a dzdza ṭa tā lī shi pā tā ma la tī ti tsa pye//pra pho ṇḍi rī shaṃ paṇḍa rya/ /de nas tunda ku beer ka /ku ṇi katstsha kānd+ra la ka /dga' ba'i shing / de nas srin mo gtum mo nor 'phrog kṣi ma du pu tram̐ tshogs pa bzod—/ sbrul gyi mtshon dang stag sen dang / /ka ra rdza dang 'khor lo byed/ /sbubs can byi ru 'khri shing phug ron rkang / /dha ma n+ya dang dzan ke shī/ /ha nu haḍa bil sī ni/ /shughi shi kha khur ko la da lam̐/ /sen mo de nas a ṭa tī ka kṣi mrid sna ba ri kā/ /mri tā la ka yul bzangs rnams su skye ba/ /li ga dur dang tre sha pur nags skyes pa ri pe la baṃ/ /bla ba go pu 'go nar dang / /kye bar mu 110—594

dmar dang mdzes ldan kyang / /pra pund+raḍa ste ḍa'i gling / /da drug gha tsa kra marda ka /padmā dhā ur nā khya/ /me mo dang ni rge'u dang / /de nas sman chen sgog skya dang / /sgog pa a ri ṣa ṭa chen/ /ro gcig pa'o/ /pun rna ba sho thambi①/ /bi tu rna 3su ni ṣanda shaṃsnye/ /bā ta ka dang bsil ba can/ /gzhan gyis mi thub a sha na'i lo ma dang / /yā rā ba tāmbi ka ṭaṃ dī yi rjedang 'od kyi blo gros 'khri shing //bā bhā ka tra pa mā ṇa tā yadhi stobs bzang ④bi khya ka se na dga' byed gri ṣa ṭi bī rā ṭī ba da re yang ngo / /mā 5rka ba dang bhri ga rā dzā/ /kā ka mā tsi bo gen bye no/ /me tog brgya ba gdugs dkar dang / /gdugs bzang mngar mo mi si'o dzre ra nag po kā ra bī/ /sa ra ṇa dang rab tu brkyang / /de yi ka sum̐ bha ra dang / /rgyal po stobs dang stobs bzang dang / /dza nī dza tū ka ra dzā nī/ /dza tu byed dang 'khor los sgyur/ /reg bya bzang de nas sha ṭī dri rtsa ba/ /tshigs drug pa dang kartsu ra/ /pi pa la shā yang ngo / /kā ra bellaka ṣṭha lla ka /su sha bī dang de nas ni/ /rig ldan pa ṭo la tig 3dang / /gsal kuṣṭhaṇḍa ka pha ta si/ /ga go na karka ṭī mo/ /ku ba kha mo ka rgya rtu bī/ /ku ba la bu gnyis po mtshungs/ /ri mo can dang ba la mig /go dusthā dang bī shā la/ /tīn bā ru ṇi/ asgo sna na sru ra ṇa/ kasdo gaṭī ra ni bra bo rgod/ ka lo byu di ka dang / mo min rtsa ba hil mo tsi kā/ sne'u lo ma'i dbye ba yin/ drurba dngar ni tshigs pa brgya/ /stong ldan brtson 'grus bhā rga bye/ /ru ha da ni mtha' med do/ /de nas sā si ta glang spu skyes brgya ldan brtson 'grus/ /gaṇḍa lī bya yi mig /ku ru bin dang sprin gyi ming / /mu sta mon lug mo min no/ /mon lug bzang po kun kyedra'o/ /tsu lā khā dang 'khor lo skyed pa/ /'od ma lpags pa'i snying po dang / /las shing 110—596

shun pa mkhregs pa dang / /rtswa yi rgyal mtshan tshigs pa brgya/ /nas kyi 'bras bu smug rgod 'od/ /gling shing sprin can srubs ldan dang / /sgyug ma dang ni rlung 'bud can/ /'dud pa tshigs pa dang ni mtshams/ /smyug ma mdangs ldan mda' smug snago/ /'dam bu naḍa pho ṭa la shaṃ / /de nas kā sha ma ste yī/ /bur shing dri dang po ṭa ga la/ /pho/ mang po'i tshig la bra wā 4dzāḥ/ /ro ldan dang ni bur shing ngo / /de yi dbye ba puṇḍa dang / /kā ddhā ra ka la sogs pa'o/ /rtswa bī ri ṇa ḍa bī rta ram̐/ /rtswa ba'i u bī ra mo yin no/ /'jigs med na la rda dang ni/ /se bya ma mri ṇa lañdza lā shā yi/ /lo madzdza rka la spyo la/ /sa ba dā ha aṣṭi kā pa je/ /'dam bu la sogs rtswa rnams ni/ /garmu tstsha tra pā la spyo/ /rtswa yi phreng bas yi rtswa/ /sha 6 5rtsa ni gzhon nu'o/ /ghā sa nas can sdong dang rtswa/ /rtswa rnams tshigs pa tri sgyu'o/ /na tyā 'dam bu'i tshogs pa'o/ /rtsa yi rgyal zhes tā la'o/ /nā ri ke rag shol ldan no/ /sgo ṇa ṭā pū shakra sba ko/ /gu bā ka dang ṭha bra ro/ /'bras bu mudhe gha 'di ni/ /tsa hin ta la bcas pa gsum/ /kha rdzu ra dang ke ta ka tā lī kha rdzu rī ni rtswa yi sdong / /nags dang sman gyi sde'o// //seng ge gdong lnga ri dgas dbang / /ral can 'phrog byed ha rya'i mig /stag dang gung dang dri snom dang / /dred dang ri dgas za byed do/ /rdo yi sna can phag pa dang / /sgra ldan ko la po tri dang / /sa brko sa rlog mtshe ra 6can/ /sna ring spu langs ko ṭa dang / /sa zlog ces pa nyid kyang ngo / /spre'u sgug mchod mchod byed dang / /yal ga'i ri dgas gnyer ma'i gdong / /makka ṭa dang mi 'dra dang / /tī sho dang ni nags gnas so/ /de nas dom dang bha la ka /110—597

katstsha bha bee dom mo/ /gaṇa bse dang khaṅgi ni/ /chur 'dres sa nyal rta yi dgra/ /ma he dang ni se ri bhā/ /mo ni zhi bas la rgyu/ /lce spyang ma rungs ri dgas shri gā la—/ /g.yon can gro ṣa rku re ru dang / /ngan g.yo ba dang dzamyu ka /zhum bu byil khrus mkhan dang / /byi ba gsod dang byi ba'i zas/ /gsum po dbyeg gau dha ra/ /godhe tāya dang bdag skyes so/ /gzugs mo ju thur ṣa lya'o/ /de yi spu ni sha la lī/ /sha lbo lo — dang sha la'o/ /bā ta bra mbi rna ba'o/ /'phar ba nags gnas khyi ri dgas gsod/ /ri dgas sa lus rlung gi srog /khri snyan skyes gnas so/ /gzhung nag khri snyan sa li'o / /ru ru kha sha ram̐ ku/ saṃ ba ra ro hi ṣā/ /ba lang rna pu ṣa te e na shā ro hra tā/ /g.yag ri dgas dri za sha ra bha dzā/ /sum rab men ri bong 'di sogs ri dgas dbang po sogs/ /glang sogs phyugs kyi rigs sogs rnams/ /byi ba rkun po 'bigs byed dang / /ri byi byi ba gzhon nu dang / /rtsangs pa kri ka khā sha'o/ /de nas tshangs phran khyim gyi rtsangs/ /sdom ni mo dang thags mkhan dang / /urṇa na bha makkaṭa ka mnyam gol go dang / /rna ba'i chu skyes rkang brgya gnyis/ /rta shig pa dang shu ka ki ṭa/ /lci spur dru ṇi bri bye ka /phug ron dig mnyan ka po ta/ /de nas ri bong za dang khra/ /rna ring bya rog dgra dang 'ug /go go g.yag dang srin bu dang / /byu ghra ṭa dang bha ra dhradza/ /khañtsa rī ṭa ④khañtsa na/ /rgyab dman pyedang ni kaṅka yin//de nas tsaṣa ka shī di bi/ /ka bo ka dzhai ga dhu ⑥sgyu ṭā/ /de nas myu tstsha bha ta ba traka /dā rpāghā ṭa/ de nas khug rta chu nyung dang / /tsā ta ka dang mtshungs so/ /khyim bya dang ni zangs ze can/ /kukka ṭa'i sgra sgrogs pa dang rkang ba'i mtshon/ /mchil pa la biṅga dang / /de yi chung ma tsi ṭa ka /de dag bu ni tsā ṭa kai ra/ /710—598

gzhan gyis 'tsho ① dang gtor ma za/ /bu mo tsaṭa kai ba hi/ /kakka re ṭu srin bya'o / /sreg pa kra ka ro dag mtshungs/ /nags na bde dang khu byug dang / /ki ki la dang si ka yang / /kā ka khwa ta 'chi ba med/ /gtor ma'i mtshag ldan lan cig skye/ /sgra ldan sgrogs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /bya rog nyid kyang ngo / /pho rog dang ni kā ko lo/ /dā tyā ha dang mgrin nag po/ /'ol ba dang ni tsi lo//bya rgod dang ni gri rnyo'o/ /ne tso kun 'gro mtshungs pa'o/ /khrung khrung dang ni groñtsa'o—/ /de nas bya dkar ka — ka'o/ /bya khyung dmar po sā ra sa/ /ngur pa 'khor lo tsakra bāka /gnyis po shing rta'i ming can no/ /chu skyar ka la haṃ yin no3 / /u sha ku rla mtshungs/ /ngang pa bya khyung dkar po dang / /'khor lo'i yan lag ma 'dros gnas/ /ngang pa'i rgyal mo mtshungs rkang dmar/ /ngang pa dkar po ma la nee dang phreng 'dzin zhes/ /yul 'dzin dang ni ngang skya'o/ /sha rā ri bā ṭa ra ḍi / /ba lā kā dang pad zlum mgrin/ /ngang pa'i chung ma ba ra ṭā/ /mtsho dang mtshan nyid dang ldan lo/ /pa 5wang lpags pa'i 'dab ma can / /pa ro ṇḍi dang te la pā yi kā/ /lci sbur sngon po ma kṣi kṣa/ /sbrang ma dang ni sbrang rtsi skyes/ /drog ma ga butt+waṃ kā yin no/ /sha sbrang nags kyi sbrang ma dang / /bra byed de'i rigs ra stso yin/ /gno pa lī ba ra ṭa gnyis/ /tshad 'bru zi gā ri dang ni/ /tsi rti rnyi lli ka dang mtshungs 'di rnams/ /pa taṅga mtshungs phye ma ldeb/ /srin bu med nikhyer nam mkha'i 'od/ /sbrang 'gro sbrang byed ma dhu li/ /sbrang rtsi skyong dang ra yig gnyis/ /me tog 'thung dang bung ba dang / /rkang pa drug dang bhra ma ra/ /sa 'gro rma bya mdongs ldan dang / /mgrin mngon 3dang ni lag 'gro za/ /gtsug pud can dang rtse mo can/ /ke kri 110—599

dang ni 'brug sgra'i gar/ /sgeg pa yang ngo / /ke kā bā bhā rma bya'i sgra/ /mtshungs pa zla gam rma bya'i mdongs/ /gtsug pud rtse mo mdongs dang ni/ /mjug ma'i sgo dang ma ning ngo / /mkha' 'gro mkhar rgyu bi ha ga /mkha' spyod bi tī yas dang ni/ /bya dang gshog ldan nus ldan dang / /sha kunta dang sha ku na//gnyis skyes 'dab ldan sgro can dang / /ba ta ga dang ba ta ta/ /'dab ma'i shing rta sgo nga skyes/ /'gro med la gnas srin bu za/ /ba ske khyer dang lo ma gsum / /byā ḍo bhā bā 'dab ldan dang / /bitstsha na ta mkha' la spyod/ /de rnams bye brag ljang kha dang / /mo gu kā raspyo 3babee ba/ /sreg pa ku ku bhyo lā boge//shang shang tsa ko ra tsa/ /ko ya ṣa ṭo gasbyi ṭi bha ga /brga 5brti ka la sogs pa'o//bya spu gshog pa sgro dang ni/ /'gebs byed lo ma lus skyes so/ /mo ni dpung ba gshog rtsa'o/ /mchu dang gdong ba gnyis mo'o/ /gyen du 'phur dang thur du 'phur / /thad 'phur de rnams mkha' la byed/ /sbubs dang mdzod dang sgo nga'o/ /bya tshang nī ḍa mo min no/ /phru gu bu tsha arbha ka /bu phrug dang ni pri thu ka /gsar skyes shi shu zhes bya'o/ /pho mo 'dus dang 'khrig pa dang / /gnyis gnyis zung dang dor yu gam/ /tshogs la 'dus pa phung po dang / /sasdoha dang bi sar/ /'tshegs pa 'phungs pa dang mi 'dus ṇi kar dang pā tatsā ru/ /yang dag 'dus/ /legs bsags sa mu dā ya'o/ /sa mu da yas ma bā ya/ /bsags pa dang ni gaṇa mo/ /saṃ ha ti dang brin dang ngo / /ni choku ru ma ba kadmā shaṃ/ /de rnams thams cad tshogs pa'i rnams tregrangs so/ /tshogs pa'i dbye ba sde mtshan mtshungs/ /dge 'dun lhan cig skye bo 'dus/ /de yi rigs dang mtshungs pa dang / /dud 'gro khyu dang tshan pa ste/ /skyes bu dang ni ma ning ngo / /dud 'gro rnams kyi 110—600

mtshungs pa'o/ /gzhan rnams kyis mā dza/ /chos mtshungs rnams la ni kā ya/ /phung po spungs pa byur bu dang / /brtsegs pa mo min no/ /phug ron khyu dang nee sgo'i khyu/ /de la sogs pa tshogs pa'o/ /khyim chags bya dang ri dgas rnams/ /shtsa ka dang khyim gnas so/ /seng ge la sogs pa'i sde mtshan no// //mi dang yid hūṃskyes ma nu'i bu/ /shes ldan yid ldan na rā'o/ /skyes bu lnga skyes pu ru ṣā/ /skyes pa ni na ra'o/ /bud med btsun mo stobs med dang / /sbyor byed mi mo mtshams ldan ma/ /'ching byed zur lta g.yon ma dang / /g.yo byed dga' ba'i sa gzhi'o/ /bye brag yan lag mchog ldan ma/ /'jigs can 'dod 3ma g.yon mig ma/ /rab myos sgeg pa yid 'ong ma/ /shin tu sems dang legs ma dang / /dga' ba dga' byed 'khro byed ma/ /de bzhin du ni bha mi ni/ /rab skyes ma dang glang chen 'gros/ /mchog ldan ma dang kha dog mchog/dbang bskur byas dang ma hi ṭī/ /longs spyod gzhan la rgyal po'i btsun/ /bag gsar lag na 'dzin pa dang / /gnyis pa dang ni chos bcas la/ /'gegs byed skyed byed ma dang ni/ /tshig mang po 4ste dā rā'o/ /gnyen 'dun ma dang khyim 'dzin dang / /legs spyod ma dang bden ma dang / /mdzes ma bdag po yi brtul zhugs/ /gnyen byas khyim gsar bag gsar dang / /rigs ldan ma dang rigs skyod ma/ /gzhon nu ma dang na chung ma/ /chung ngu gos med phyes snye'agyur ba/ /bar ma rdul ni mthong ba dang / /lang tsho ma dang dar ma mtshungs//mtshungs pa'i bu chung mna' ma dang / /khyim pa mo dang khyim gnas ma/ /'dod ldan ma dang chags can ma/ /'phyon ma dang ni g.yem ma dang / /110—601

dbeen 'go dus byas shar mor 'gro/ /'khrul byed chags byed 'ching byed ma/ /chags can ma rigs myur ma/ /'dod 'gro dang ni sdig can ma/ /bud med mo sham a bi nā/ /mo sham bu ni gcig skyes ma/ /dga' byed ma dang rnam byed mtshungs / /zla mo grogs mon mnyam ma/ /bdag cag khro dang bcas pa'ikye /mgo skya ma dang rgan mo dang / /shes rab ma dang mkhas mang dang / /shes ldan ma dang blo ldan ma/ /dmangs mo dmangs rigs chung ma yin/ /dmangs dang de ༄ yi rigs kyang ngo / /dmangs rigs chen mo ā dī rī/ /rigs dang skye sbyor mtshungs pa'o/ /'phags pa'i chung ma rje rigs chung / /rgyal rigs chung ma rjes rgyal rigs mo/ /mkhan po'i chung ma'ang mkhan mo dang / /slob dpon chung ma bi tsa swata/ /slob dpon ma ni skyes bu spyor/ /'phags ma dang ni rgyal rigs ma/ /mkhan po'i chung ma mkhan mo dang / /po ṭa pho mo'i mtshan nyid do//dpa' bo'i chung ma dpa' chung ma/ /dpa' bo'i ma ni dpa' skyes ma/ /bu skyes pa dang rab skyes dang / /rab tu btsas dang rab tu 'khrungs/ /bud med gcer bu gos med yin/ /pho nya mo dang kun spyod mtshungs/ /kā tyā yā ni dar yol ma/ /ngur smig gos dang ldan pa'o/ /tha ga pha rol khyim sdong dang / /rang dbang bzo yi las byed do/ /blon mo rgan min btsun mo yi/ /phrin skyel pho brang spyod ma'o/ /ri mo can dang tshogs can ma/ /smad 'tshong ma dang gzugs 'tshong ma/ /de nas de yi gtso mo ni/ /ri mo byed pa'i gtso mo'o/ /dzam can dang kha lo mtshungs/ /mo ma mig mthong lha shes ma/ /de nas rdul dang ldan pa dang / /bud med chos ldan rked nad can/ /khrag dang phreng ba me tog dang / /dus ldan ma dang zla mtshan can/ /rdul dang me tog zla mtshan no//110—602

phru gu chags dang mig blo langs/ /zla mtshan sangs dang nang med ma/ /mngal chags ma dang sprum ma dang / /bu che ma dang lus mi bde/ /tshogs can ma sogs tshogs rnams dang / /sbrum ma gzhon nu ma tshogs rnams/ /slar byung bye ma gnyis grags ma/ /de la sogs pa bye ma'o/ /bdag po gnyis skyes dang bo di dhi 6/ /na mnyam ku ṭu ma bi bhā'o/ /gzhon nu ma skyes ko nī na/ /bu skal bzang bu ni skal ldan no/ /pha rol bud med las skyes ni/ /nal phrug go/ /pha rnams la rten pha la gnas/ /pha yi bu dang skyes pa'o/ /ma rnams la brten de bzhin no/ /mi mthun ma dang mi mdza' skyes/ /de nas 'phyon ma'i bu dang ni/ /nal phrug rigs nyams byes pa dang / /rigs 'chol dang ni byi phrug go/ /slongs mos 'tsho zhing skyes pa la/ /de ni kau la ṭi nee ya 'di/ /rigs bsgyur dang ni bdag skyes so/ /bdag skyes bde 'phel bu dang ni/ /khye'u dang ni ngan 'gro skyob/ /'di rnams mo'o/ /bu mo phan byed thams cad ma/ /bu phrug bu tsha mtshungs pa'o/ /rang skyes ltos byung ma smad do/ /yab dang skyed byed pha dang ni/ /yum dang 'byung byed skyed byed ma/ /bu pho dang ni a ce'o/ /bdag po'i sring mo gnyis 1mo dang / /pahphur tsha bo tsha yug bu bdag skyes/ /chung ma sring mo sde mtshan kyi/ /yā ta ra ni phan tshun du/ /pra dzā ba ti sgud po'i chung / /zhang po'i chung ma mā tu lbo/ /khyo shug min sgyug mo dang / /gyos po zhes pa pha'i yin no / /pha yi spun dang a khu'o/ /ma yi spun dang zhang po'o/ /shā khā chung ma'i spun zla'o/ /bdag po'i spun tsha ba da ba ro/ /swa shra ya ni sring mo'i bu/ /dzā mā tā ni bu mo'i khyo/ /phas mchod pha yi pha dang mes/ /de yi pha dang yang mes po—/ /phyi mo dang ni yang phyi mo/ /mtshul mchod pa dang rigs rgyud do/ /skye 110—603

gnas mtshungs dang ming sring dang / /tshang ya lhan cig skyes rnams mtshungs/ /de yi rigs dang 'byel pa dang / /nye du rtsa lag rang rig dang / /gnyen 'dab rnams ni mtshungs pa'o/ /bdag gi gnyen dang ①nye 'brel te/ /de rnams go rims tshogs pa'o/ /rab tu tsha byed dga' byed dang / /bdag po 'gegs byed rtsa lag byed/ /khro po rnams ni mtshungs pa'o/ /khyo ma shi yi rtsa lag skyes/ /kuṇḍi shi gsog la ka /sring mo lcam mo las skyes dang / /spun zla sring mo blu ti ro ni gnyis ka'o/ /pha ma dag ni pi ta ro/ /pha ma dag go/ /gyos sgyug dag ni shwa shu' ro/ /bu dang bu mo lu tro'o/ /bza' mi khyim thab khyo shug dang / /chung ma khro po de dag go/ /bu rogs sha ma khru ma'o/ /bza' mi khyim thab khyo shug dang / /chung ma khro bo de dag go/ /bu rogs sha ma khru ma'o/ /ulwa lañtsa ka 2lo mo yin no/ /skyes pa'i zla ba skyes dus so/ /mngal dang rum dang 'di rnams mtshungs/ /gsum po'i rang bzhin za ma dang / /ma ning pho ma ning dang ni/ /byis pa bu tsha phru gu 'o/ /dar ma lang tsho shed ldan mtshungs/ /gnas brtan dang ni rgan po dang / /rgan po'i tshogs pa rgan rims so/ /smin dang na tshod yol ba dang / /skra la sogs pa dkar po'o/ /rgas pa dang ni 'khogs pa'o/ /btsas ma thag pa skyes ma thag /zho 'thung dang ni nu ma 'dzin/ /byis pa dang ni shed ma bye/ /gzhon nu na chung shar ba dang / /sgang yol gnas brtan bri rnya dang / /rnyings dang 'khongs dang rgas pa'o/ /lo ldan bcu pa rgan ches pa/ /sngon skyes phu bo dang por skyes/ /phyis skyes nu bo gzhon shos dang / /rting skyes rjes su skyes pa'o/ /sha med nyams chung rid pa dang / /stobs ldan mtshag ldan yan lag rgyas/ /gsus po che dang lto 'phyang dang / /lto lter sprerked 110byed604

sgom gsus rdzing can/ /sna nyeg dang ni sga nyeg dang / /nyeg po dang ni sna gong med—/ /skra 2bzangs skra can skra lo can/ /gnyer gdong skogs gdong mtshungs pa'o / /yan lag mtshang yan lag nyams/ /mi thung bongs chung me'u thung / /sna smyung dang ni sna rings so/ /sna bcad pa dang sna bregs pa/ /rmig pa'i sna dang smig sna can/ /gom rlabs can dang rab 'go pus/ /sgyid 'khris dang ni pus mo 'byar/ /yas 'jog dang ni pus mo 'degs/ /rna ba 'on dang rna mi gsang / /sgur bo dang ni rgyab sgur ro/ /lag sdum lag sor sdum po dang / /mi chung lus po chung ba dang / /zha bo dang ni grum po dang / /skra med ༄ dang ni mgo rdum dang / mi g.yo ba dang gle bo dang / /theng po dang ni gyol ba'o/ /'khogs pa man chad gsum yin no/ /sha khrag nag po sha mtshan can/ /sme ba dang ni nag thig can/ /nad gtsong med dang nad bu med/ /gso spyad sman gyi bya ba'o/ /rtsi dang sman dang bye ṣa bye/ /nad sel 'tsho byed ces kyang ngo / /mo / nad can khams mi bde ba dang / /nyam mi bde ba dang tsha ba dang / /na tsha dang ni mnar ba dang / /khong nad skye ma nad gcong can no/ /rkan skam dang ni sna skam mo/ /sprid pa kṣu ta sprid nad do/ /glo dang lung pa skyigs bu'o—/ /skrags 'bur nag 'bur skrangs pa'o/ /rkang 'bras dang ni phol mig go / /sha khra dang ni shu ba'o/ /g.yan pa pā ma rgad zhishu dang / /khyi rngo za 'khrug rngo shu dang / /'brum bu dang ni phol mig gsum/ /rma ni mo min rmas pa ni—/ /ma ning rtsa yi rma ni pho/ /shu ba'i nang 'udang dkyil 'khor can/ /mdze nad dang ni sha khra dang / /dur nā ma kārṣa si/ /chu 'gags pa dang chu nad dang / /zas len dang khar mi 'ong nad/ /sgyugs pa zas ldog skyug nad dang //110—605

skyes bu skyug pa mtshungs pa'o/ /nad kyi dbye bas bi dradhiḥmo/ /rims dang chu srin tshan par rdol/ /rnge nad chu sri'i nad dang ni/ /khu ba'i sngon rnams rtags gsum mo/ /nad sel nad sel sman pa dang / /'tsho byed dang ni gso dpyad mkhan/ /'tsho ba'i bar bsten ka lpa'o/ /nad sos pa dang nad kyis btang / /nad pa nad can gdung bas gzir/ /zug rngu can dang byu dhi dang / /mi gsal ba dang sdug bsngal can/ /bro 'tshal ba dang mtha' mnyam dang / /me dpal dang ni smyug shu'o/ /'brum bu rkong po rngo dang ni/ /'brum nad yug to arshas/ /rlung dang rlung gi nad can no/ / 'khru sgyug kyedang ni sgyu gzer ro//mig tshag tshag po mig nad can/ /rbasthā 3klende tshag po 'di yang / /smyon pa dang ni dran nyams so/ /bad kan bad nad ka pi'obye/ /lte chen lte 'bur lte mthon no/ /sha khrag dang ni me dbal lo/ /long ba dang ni mdongs pa dang / /brgyal dang 5dran nyams myos pa'o/ /khu ba zla ba thig le dang / /sa bon stobs ldan dbang por 'gro/ /ma yu dang ni mkhris pa'o/ /ka pa dang ni bad kan no/ /mo/ lpags pa dang ni khrag 'dzin no/ /cha shas sha dang māṃ saṃ dang //krums dang kra bya ā mi ṣa/ /sha skam shuṣka rmā saṃ dang / /skams nyid ni gsum gyi rtags/ /khyab gnas mi ldung khrag dang ni/ /dmar dang rma skyes rgyun ldan dang / /snying dang skyes bu hrid ya dang sems/ /tshil dang zhag dang snum bag go / /mgrin pa'i phyi rtsa ltag chu ba/ /bā ḍi bye rtsa ni 'bab ldan no/ /til ske ni glo ba'o/ /klad pa dang ni klad rgyas so/ /rgyu ma'i rdzas dang dri ma'o/ /mo min rgyu ma dang ni pu rī tai/ /mchin pa dang ni llī ha pho/ /de nas chu ba rgyus pa mo / /mcher ba yang kri ta mtshungs 'di dag /kha chu mchi lam lā lā dang / /110—606

mig nang mig gi dri ma'o/ /dri chu dang ni gci ba'o/ /'bab ldan khyab ldan dri ma dang / /bshang ba phyi sa gu tha dad/ /lto snying dri ma boṣā tha mo/ /thod pa dang ni ka pā la/ /mo ma nihūṃ/ rus pa gdung dang g.yo byed do/ /lus kun rus pa shaṃ kā la/ /sgal rus ka she ru kā'o/ /spyi bo'i rus pa ka ro ṭi/ /mo/rtsigs —logs rus pa rtsib ma'o/ /yan lag dang ni pri ti ka/ /cha shas dang ni tshogs pa min/ /de nas tshogs pa lus dang 'dus/ /phung po thos byed gzugs po dang / /rnam 'dzin sku dang khyab pa dang / /ma ning dang ni skyes bu'o / /mo ni mu rti ta nu gzugs/ /rkang pa'i mdun dang brang ba'i phyogs/ /'gro byed dang ni rkang pa dang / /skyod par byed pa mo min 5no/ /de yi mdun sa long dang tshig /rje ngar dang ni ngar gdong dang / /pus mo brla 'og tshig pa dang / /rus tsho zhes pa mo min no/ /nus ldan ma ning skyes bu brla/ /de yi tshigs ni dpyi yin no/ /bshang lam rkub dang 'og sgo'o/ /'doms ni lte 'og gnyis dag go/ /tshang ra dang ni 'phongs nyid dang / /'phongs dang sho ṇi ka ku tī/ /bud med rnams kyi 'phongs kyi ni/ /phyi ma yi 6cha ni tam pa/ /ma ning 3dza gha rgo mdun cha/ /kyu ba kau tu ni tasba sbo/ /gnyis dman ku kunda re'o / /mo ni rkub tshos nyid dang ni/ /ku ṭī pro thā/ mo mtshan 'chad par 'gyur ba'o/ /bha gi skye gnas gnyis dag go/ /rlig pa sgro ba men nā kroḍo 9 lag pa'i bar/ /brang dang nang tshoms byang khog stod/ /phrag pa dang ni lag mgo dang / /dpung pa rnams ni mo min no/ /de yi mtshams ni dza dru bhā/ /lag rtsa gnyis po mchan khung ngo / /rtsib logs mo min de dag 'og /dbus dang rked pa bar ma ni/ /mo min gnyis po'i pha rol gnyis/ /spyod byed 110—607

'bab byed 'jug byed lag /bar tshigs dang ni gru ma'o/ /de yi steng du bar lhu yin/ /lag ngar de yi 'og tu'o/ /'khrig ma lag pa'i mthe chung bar/ /ka ra bho dang lag 1gzhag go/ /byed po lag pa yal ga lnga/ /sdigs mdzub rab tu ston byed do/ /sor mo lag pa'i yal ga'o/ /skyes bu mthe bong ston byed dang / /gung mo ming med mthe chung rim/ /yang srid can dang lag skyes dang / /gcod byed sen mo mo yin no/ /rab ston mthong dang ba la sna / /mdzub mo la sogs rnams la'o/ /mthe bong mthe chung mtho la ni/ /sor mo bcu gnyis lag mthil dag /thal mo thal lcag pra ta la/ /lag mthil sor mo brkyang ba'o/ /de gnyis tshogs pa ya ha ta la/ /pra ta lo ni g.yon dang g.yas / /lag pa cung bskum khyor ba'o/ /de dag sbyar ba snyim pa skyes/ /lag ngar lag brkyang khru yin no/ /khu tshur bcangs pa bcag khru'o/ /a rang ni ni mthe chung brkyang / /de yi khru'o khu tshur bcangs/ /mdom ni dpung pa lag par bcas/ /de dag 'phreng la brkyang ba'o/ /steng du lag pa brkyangs pa ni / /mi jegang lag bcas skyes bu gsum/ /ol mdud pa dang mgrin pa dang / /de nas mgo stegs mgo 'dzin ste/ /kam bu mgrin pa ri mo gsum/ /ltag pa ltag khung ltag chu ba/ /smra byed za 5byed gsung byed dang / /kha dang zhal dang smra ba'i sgo/ /ma ning sna dang dri 'bab dang / /snom byed shangs dang nā sī ka /ya mchu ma mchu zhal g.yogs dang / /gcod byed kyi ni sgo zhes bya/de yi 'og tu kos ko'o/ /'khur tshos dang ni ka po la/ /de yi pha rol za 'gram pa/ /ldad byed gcod byed snyom byed so/ /tā lu zhes pa rkan yin no/ /ro shes ro myang lce yin no/ /mchu yi mtha' ma kha yi gru/ /dpral pa rgyan gnas 110—608

mig 'dzin dang / /mig steng smin ma dag ni mo/ /kyur tsam smin dbus mo min no/ /mig 'bras spyan 'bras hā ra ka /lta byed mig dang 'dren byed dang //mthong byed spyan dang tsakṣu dang / /gzigs byed dri ṣa ṭi zhes pa'o/ /mchi ma mig chu ngus 'byung dang / /a sra dang ni mchi ma'o/ /a paṃ go ni mi mtha' dag/zur mig dang ni yon por lta/ /rna ba sa 1'dzin skyes bu dang / /mo ni thos byed nyan byed snyan/ /yan lag mchog dang mgo bo dang / /dbu dang steng dang ma sta ka /mo minabye / slar skye 'khyil ba skra dang ni / /ral pa kre —sha mgo skyes dang / /tshogs pa skra ldan ke shi ka /rgyan dang skra lo 'khyil pa dang / /de rnams dpral ba'i bung ba dang / /bya rog gshog dang gtsug pud can/ /skra bcings skra yi thor tshugs dang / /de nas me tog bcings pa dang / /sī ya tā ka tsa me tog bcings/ /thor tshugs gtsug pud skra bcings so/ /brtul zhugs ral pas ṭā'o/ /lan bu skral na skra lhas ma/ /ral pa ka tse bi ṣa de/ /pa ṣa pakṣa ha sta dang / /kalpabye de rnams ni/ /ka tsa'i pha rol skra tshogs yin/ /lus skyes bu dang ba spu'o/ /de rgan smre 5ra kha la'o/ /mdzes bcos rgyan bcings nee pa bye/ /sau yi bzo dang mdzes par byas/ /bcu po gsum yin rgyan byed dang / /mdzes chos mkhan dang chas mkhan no/ /mdzes byas brgyan byas bkod cing spras/ /gsal byed mthong byed snang byed do/ /rgyan gyi bya ba brgyan bya la/ /rgyan dang chas dang legs byed dang / /rnam rgyan sa dang maṇḍa rgo—/ /de nas dbu rgyan cod pan ni/ /skyes bu dang ni ma ning ngo / /gtsug gi nor bu spyi bo'i rin chen dang / /ta ra la ni do shal dbus/ /skra yi thag pa pā ri ta byā/ /phung skyu dang ni thudapral ba'i rgyan/ /rna rgyangs tā la'i lo ma yin//110—609

kuṇḍa lam ni rna ba'i rgyan/ /mgul 'ching dang ni ske'i rgyan no/ /'phyang 'phrul dang ni do shal lo/ /pā lo ni ka gser do shal/ /brang gi do shal mu tig spras/ /do shal mu tig phreng ba dang / /lha yi do shal bkod pa ni/ /khris ma brgya dang ldan pa dang / /do shal dbye dang khris dbye bas/ /drug cu rtsa gnyis guta shā'o//nyi shu rtsa bzhi guta shā phyed/ /ba yi nu ma bzhi yin no/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis nyer bzhi bzhi/ /do shal phyed pa drug cu bzhi dang / /nyi shu pa/ phreng ba gcig pa yaṣṭi ka /rgyu skar phreng ba se mo do/ /mu tig nyi shu rtsa bdun no/ /gdu bu lag gdub ka ṭa kai/ /ba la yo ni mo min no/ /ke pū ra ni dbung rgyan mtshungs//e gu lbo ya sor gdub po/ /yi ge'i sor gdub rgya ldan yin/ /gser gyi lag gdub ka ka ṇa/ /bud med rked rgyan me kha la/ gser ska bdun pa rked rgyan dang / /de bzhin ma ning rked rgyan min/ /de nas skyes bu rked pa yi/ /rkang gdub zhabs gdub ma ṭwā ra/ /byu pu ra ni mo min no/ /ngang pa can dang rkang rgyan no/ /g.yer kha dril bu chung ba'o/ /lpags pa 'bras bu srin bu dang / /sprul sogs pa gos kyi rgyu/ /bcu ni gsum ste zas ras dang / /khyo ma la sogs 'bras byung ras/ /ras bal lo la dag dang ni/ /dar dang srin bu'i dbugs las byung / /snam bu dang ni bal gos so/ /gsar pa so ma btags so ma/ /gos gsar na ba saṃ ba re/ /u ta ga ma bī gos ni3/ /gang zhig bkrus pa'i gos bzung ngo / /pa tra u ṇḍa dar gos bkrus zhu/ /gos chen nor po che zhes bya//nang gsal du ku la yi ras/ /gyon gos spyod gos gsum yin no/ /mo/tshig bye mang po la gos gos dag /gnyis/ ring po mā st+waṃ ā ro ha/ /zhing che bi shā la tā'o/ /paji tstsha ra gos rnyings mtshungs/ /zad po dang ni dri ma can/ /110—610

gos dang g.yog ma na bza' dang / /gcer skyob bgo rgyu oṃ ṭha ka /gos bzangs dang gos mo min no/ /gos kyi phung po gos mthug po/ /ni tso la ni smad gos so/ /mtshungs pa la ba snam bu'o/ /bar gos smad gos pā ri dhā/ /sham thabs dang ni thang gos so/ /stong gos bla gos mtshungs pa'o/ /bri ha ti ka de bzhin du/ /saṃ bya na ni stod g.yogs so/ /'doms dkris smad dkris bud med kyi/ /ba mo'i gos dang bu yi ras/ /kha ba rlung po skyob pa'i gos/ /bud med mchog gi smad dkris ni/ /tsaṇḍa ta ka'i sor mo sleb pa'i gos/ /pra pa rda hi sa ta do/ /mo min bla bre steng g.yogs dang / /gur dang sbra zhes bya ba'o / /yol ba dang ni sgrib g.yogs so/ /yongs bcos lus kyi bcas legs so/ /'dag chal khrus rtsi dag byed do/ /dri ma nyed pa utpa da rgo gnyis po mtshungs/ /chur 'khru khrus dang sthā māṃ/ /tsar tsa lus la dri byugs gos/ /dri ma bsang dang dri ma sel/ /dri bzangs dang ni spos byug mtshungs/ /tā ma la 'dab thig le dang / /dbral bar dri yi khyad par bris/ /gnyis pa bzhi pa mo min no/ /de nas gur gum kha che skyes/ /me rtse ba dang mchog ldan dang / /bā hi ka dang ser po dang / /dmar po saṃ ko tsa pi shun dang ldan/ /tsan dan dmar po gur gum mo/ /rgya skyags rakṣu dzantu dang / /ma ning / yā ba hūṃrgya mtshos shing gi nad/ /li shī lha yi me tog dpal/ /ming can/ de nas dza ba kai kā li pa kañtsa ka la nu sar bañtsa/ /de nas nus ldan rgyud can dang / /a ka ru dang rgyal mnyams ༄ —byed/ /dmar po srin skyes a ga ru/ /a gu ru nag a gu ru/ /bkra shis phreng ba'i dri dang ni/ /mchod sbyin spos dang sra rtsi shing / /spos dkar khu ba kun ldan dang / /gzugs mang po dang de nas ni/ /bri ka dhu 170—611

ba sbyar spos so/ /tu ru ṣka dang pi shu ka /pi la yā ba na yang ngo / /de nas pā ya sa dang ni/ /dpal gos bri ka dhū pa dang / /shrī 1rba ṣṭi dang thang chu'o/ /ri dgas lte ba ri dgas tshang / /gla ba de nas ko la ka /ka kko la ka spubs kyi 'bras / /de nas ga pur mo min no/ /gha na'i snying po zla ba'i min/ /'od dkar kha ba'i bye ma'o/ /dri yi snying po mal ya skyes dang / /dpal bzang bye tsandan mo min no/ /tail paṇḍi tsandan dang / /ba lang mgo dang ha ri tsandan dang / /mo min no/ /ṭīl la: pa ṭaṃ ga /chos byed tsandan dmar po dang / /tsandan ngan pa de nas ni/ /dzā tī srubs can dzā tī 'bras bu mnyam/ /ga pur a ga ru dang gla ba dang / /kakko la rnams la mchod sbyin byug /lus kyi byug pa brti'o—/ /barṇa shaṃ ni kha dog byug /phye ma gos dang sbyar ba dang / /dri da'adzin gos ni gsum yin no/ /dri dang phreng sogs legs sbyar gos/ /lhag pa'i gos dang me tog phreng / /me tog phreng ba spyi bo'i ste4/ /skra yi dbus su garbha phyeka /steng du 'phrang dang rtse mong 'phyang / /mdun du la lā bye ma shaṃ ngo / /rab 'phyang drang por mgul du 'phyang / /me tog ga shal se ral kha/ /gang zhig 'phreng bcings brang la'o/ /shī khwa swā nī spyi bor bzhag /bkod pa dang ni chas tsom pa//ā sgo ga ni yongs su rdzogs/ /u pa dhā rgo rgyas yin no/ /nyal ba gzims pa sha yi rgo/ /khri dang nyal khri gzims khri dang / /kha gsum yā ni mtshungs pa'o/ /sder 7'bol chung ngu kand+ra ko/ /mar me dang rab 'bar ba dang / /pi thā dang ni stan yin no/ /za ma tog dang ga'u dang / /pra ti gra ha chil ma'i snod/ /skra shang dang ni so mangs dang / /me long ma gu ra dang dpe/ /rlung yab bsil yab ces pa'o/ /mi'i sde tshan no// //110—612

baṃ sha rtsa khrid brgyud pa'o/ /barṇa bram ze la sogs ma/ /rgyal rigs ra dza baṃ sha'o—/ /sa bon las byung rus yin no/ /rigs chen rigs bzang 'phags rigs dang / /mchog dang skyes bu dam pa legs/ /tshangs par spyod dang khyim gnas dang / /nags na gnas dang dge slong dang / /rnam bzhi lag gnas mo min no/ /gnyis skyes sngon skyes sa yi lha/ /tshangs pa'i bu dang bram ze dang / /tshangs / /'di dag las ni drug ldan pa/ /mchod sbyin la sogs nus pa'o/ /rigs ldan rnams gsal nyes pa shes/ /mdzes ldan blo bzang kun rig dang / /rtogs ldan brtan po sems shes dang / /shes ldan gangs 3can shes rab can/ /paṇḍi ta dang nyes pa shes/ /blo gros can dang dpa' bo dang / /go ba can dang mkhas pa dang / /grags pa dang ni rnam par dngas/ /ring po mthong dang ring po shes/ /thos ldan sdeb sbyor can dag mtshungs/ /u bā dha ya mkhan po'o/ /mngal sogs sbrum byed bla ma'o/ /sngags 'chad byed pa slob dpon yin/ /ā de ṣṭa 'dzin brtul zhugs can/ /yā dza mā na mchod sbyin dang / /zla ba btus pa'i rī kṣi ster/ /mchod sbyin mang byas mchod sbyin ldan/ /ya dzwa mchod sbyin mtho ris 'dod/ /phur bu'i mchod sbyin tha pa ti/ /zla ba'i chang 'thungs so ma pa/ /rigs byed kun la mchod sbyin byas/ /mtho ris kun gyi yon tan no/ /a nu tsān rab brjod kyi/ /rig khyebyed yan lag dang bcas bslabasarka / /bla ma'i bka' yi rjes gnang thob/ /sa mā bri tu/ su tā mngon par khrus thob/ /sgrib byed nyer gnas slob ma'o/ /shi kṣu dang por rtog 110—613

pa bslabs/ /gcig pu tshangs pa'i brtul zhug spyod/ /tshangs par spyod dang bcas pa'o/ /sa tīṭwā ni bla ma gcig /ma 1mdzes a ghi tsi ta'o/ /rgyud pa'i nyer bstan i ti hya/ /mi zad pa nyer shes lnga na mā tyā ngo / /dzñā tā dang po rtsom pa'i rim/ /mchod sbyin sbyin bsreg 3a dha ro/ /mchod sbyin dang ni rgyud bdun pa/ /glog dang sbyin bsregs gsar 'ongs mchod/ /mtshun gsol ba dang gtor ma dang / /de rnams mchod sbyin chen po lnga/ /tshangs pa'i mchod sbyin la sogs zhes/ /tshogs pa 'khor mang 'dus pa dang / /sa bhā 'tshogs zhudang khru dang ni/ /phung po ma ning a sthā rgo/ /ma mo ma rgong 'dus pa'o/ /dang po'i rgyud pa dang po pa/ /'tshogs nas cho ga lta ba'o/ /tshogs pa spyi yi ming ngo / /a dha bye gā dri ho tā ro/ /mchod sbyin sam bid rim pa/ /a sni dhra la sogs pa yi/ /nor spyod mchod sbyin ④yā dzā kā/ /rigs byed sa gzhi yongs su bcos/ /mtshungs pa sa gzhi gru bzhi pa/ /tsa ṭī la ni phyugs brtags shing //bum pa shin tu bskor ba'i khyim/ /srog shing rtse tar ma'o/ /gtsub shing gtsub stan a rṇa gnyis/ /lha yi me dang khyim gyi me/ /ha bā nī yo me gsum pa/ /me 'di gsum la tre tā'o/ /pra ṇa rgyata ni legs sbyangs me/ /me'i ming ngo / /ho me rab tu sbyor ba'o/ /gang zhig khyim bdag sbyin bdag me/ /lho phyogs me ni pra bhā ya te/ /de la sna tshogs bsdebs pa'o/ /de nas me mo swā hā 'o/ /byen za mnyes par byed pa'o/ /me'i chung ma'o/ /bsreg rdzas yam shing dhā bya'o/ /me'i sbrar bye shing ngo / /gā 3ya ṭī la sogs pa'o/ /bsreg rdzas smin byed tsa ru pho//'o ma zho dang sbyar ba'o/ /rlung yab dang ni bsil yab ni/ /ri dgas lpags pa dag las so/ /pri ṣa dā bye zho mar bsres/ /pa ra manda 'o thug go/ /ha bya 110—614

ka ①bye lha mtshun zas/ /dgang gzar blugs gzar la sogs pa/ /zlum bo gru bzhi zla phyed dang / /zur gsum dgang gzar dbye ba'o/ /u pā kri ta dud 'gro ni/ /mchod sbyin ched du gsod par brtags/ /phan tshun zhi dang bsang gtor byas/ /gsod pa'i ched kyi phyugs yin no/ /brjod bya'i rtags can pā mbi ta/ /bsnyen rdzogs bsang gtor byas nas gsod/ /khrus bseg ༄ —rdzas me phud—/ /gsum mo ba ṣe ṭa byas pa'o/ /hi kṣu'i mtha' can mchod sbyin gtso/ /ge las gsod pa ya rnyi yi/ /gsum/ mchod sbyin 'dod las sru rta khā tā dī'i las—/ /bdud rtsi dang ni bi gha sa/ /mchod sbyin lhag ma zas lhag go/ /gtong ba 'bul ba sbyin pa dang / /nye bar 'ged dang gshegs pa dang / /rnam byin brims dang bkram pa dang / /so sor byin dang mngon du bstan/ /'bul ba yon dang me tog go/ /gshin don ste rab gsum yin no/ /tyā do rnya da nyirka/ /pha gshin sbyin pa ni bā ya/ /dad pa de las bstan bcos las/ /sbyin pa dus ston zla dus mchod pa'o/ /nyi ma'i brgyad char mchod byed pa/ /ku ta ya te mo min no/ /tshol ba yongs su tshol ba dang / /rjes su tshol dang kun tu tshol/ /gsol ba dang ni zhu ba'o/ /slong ba mngon par slong ba dang / /yā tsa na dang aza na/ /drug ni gsum ste mchod yon dang / /yon chab don dang / /zhabs bsil rkang khrus chu la'o/ /rim pa las mgron po glo bur/ /gsar 'ongs skyes legs gnas/ /mgron po dang ni gsar 'ongs dang / /mgron — khyim du 'ongs pa'o/ /mchod pa rim gro rgyas byed dang / /legs byed ri mo zhabs 'bring mtshungs/ /gus mchod zhes dang bcas pa/ /bskur ༷ 7ste dang ni bsnyen bkur ro/ /'gro dang 'khyam dang slar yang 'gro/ /spyod lam 110—615

dang ni 'go 'dug go/ /kha bshal dang ni zhal bsil lo/ /de nas thub dang mi smra dang / /mngon rjes mo 'am rim pa dang / /go rim bzhin rim pa'o /go rim min dang bzlog pa dang / /rnam grangs nges dang brtul zhugs mo min no//gso sbyong dang ni bsod nams gso/ /u pa bstam bsnyen gnas so/ /gol ba dben pa'i bdag nyid dang / /tshangs spyod dang ni rig byed klog /de nas thal sbyor rig byed klog /tshangs pa'i thal mo sbyor ba'o/ /klog cing khu chu 'thor ba ni/ /tshangs pa'i thig le'o/ /bsam gtan rnal 'byor stan tshangs stan / /rtog pa'i cho ga rigs so/ /gtso bo dang po'i rtog pa'o/ /rjes kyi rtog pa rjes brjod pa/ /'du byed mngon du 'dzin pa ni/ /nye bar byed dang thos pa'o/ /mtshungs pa zhabs la 'dzin pa ni/ /mngon par brjod pa gnyis pa'o—/ /dge slong dang ni kun tu rgyu/ /drang srong dang ni brtul zhugs can/ /dka' thub dka' spyod pha rol 'dod/ /mi smra ba dang thub pa'o/ /dka' thub dang ni nyon mongs bzod/ /dārnyo rigs ni tshangs par spyod pa'o/ /drang srong bden par smra ba'o/ /khrus byas khrus kyi brtul zhugs can/ /dbang po dul ba sdom brtson des/ /thang nyal brtul zhugs bla khab med/ /gcer nyal dang ni ṭhaṇḍi la/ /de nas chags bral ta mas/ /nyon mongs dang ni bral ba'o/ /gtsang ma dag pa dri ma med/ /lta ba 'dzin pa kun gyi rtags/ /bā lā shā yi dbyug 'dzin dang / /chu stod brtul zhugs can dang ni/ /dzā bha stu dang myug ma 'dzin/ /mo min/ spyi blugs bum pa brtul zhugs snod/ /drang srong stan ni bri ṣpe'o/ /a dzi rgo 1ni ri dgas lpags/ /lpags pa 'dzin pa mo min no/ /bsod snyoms pa dang slong mo ba/ /kha don dang ni bzlas brjod pa/ /khrus 110—616

byas khrus chu sa ba rgo/ /rig byed dang ni gzungs kun gyi/ /sdig pa 'joms pa gsum yin no/ /mthong ba gang dang gnam stong la/ /phyogs mtha' so so'i mchod sbyin byed/ /rtag tu lus sgrub lta ba ni/ /las gang de yin zhi ba'o/ /nges pa gang zhig rtag tu las/ /glo bur ba la bsnyen bkur sgrub/ /u pa bā ti tshangs skud ni/ /lag pa'i g.yas phyogs rab tu dkris/ /bra 1ṭī nā bī g.yon du bkris/ /ni bī tai ni mgul du 'phyang / /sor mo'i rtse mo rta rja lha/ /mje chung rtsa bar tshangs lha'i chu/ /gung mo mtheb mdzub mtshun gyi chu/ /mtheb chen rtsa bar tshangs chu sbyin/ /beengs pa slar 'byung tshangs nyid/ /tshangs pa yang dag ldan pa dang / /lha sogs 'byung ba de bzhin no/ /zad par dka' thub la sogs pa/ /bya spangs bya bral skyes bu'o/ /phal cher/ de nas mnyams dang chu zos mee/ /ku ha nā dang rnyed log dang / /tshul 'chos pa dang bcos pa'o /zwa tyā legs sbyangs kyi sman no/ /lung med brjod par bya ba min/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan ral pa'i rtags/ /grags dman dang ni brtul zhugs nyams/ /nyi ma nub nyal brtul zhugs dang / /nyi ma shar langs brtul zhugs so/ /nyi ma ba dang grol med dang / /shar langs ji ltar rim bzhin no/ /go log skyes bag ma ni/ /phu bo'i bag ma ma blangs pa/ /pa ri bid ti phu bo'i 'o/ /thag ma nye zung mtshungs pa'o/ /de bzhin khyim thab gnyis ldan dang / /u pā ya mā lag stams so/ /'khrig pa gong chos chags spyod mtshungs/ /sde mtshan gsum po chos dang ni/ /'dod pa dang ni don rnams so/ /sde tshan bzhi pa rnam thar ro/ /de stobs bzhi ldan bzang po'o/ /dzā byā mag pa'i grogs pa'o / /bram ze'i sde tshan no// //110—617

spyi bor dbang bskur rgyal ba'i bu/ /lag skyes rgyal rigs rnam par rgyal/ /rgyal pos bdags skyong dang / /mi bdag sa srungs gzhi skyong dang / /rgyal po ma lus kun gyis ni/ /phyag byas lhag pa'i dbang phyug go/ /'khor los sgyur ba sa kun dbang / /mi bdag gzhan ni rgyal phran no/ /dag gis rgyal 'dod mchod sbyin byas/ /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug bstan bcos dang / /dka' 1lung rgyal po dag pa'i rgyal/ /rgyal po'i tshogs pa rgyal po rnams/ /mi bdag rgyal rigs tshogs pa'i rim/ /bka' dbang gros pa blon po dang / /gzhan ni las dang lhan cig spyod/ /blon po chen po gtso bo dang / /blon po dang ni mdun na 'don/ /nang blon spyan dang khrims gcod pa/ /gnyer pa dang ni mig pa'o / /sgo srungs pa dang sgo skyong dang / /sgor gnas bya ra byed pa'o/ /srung ma'i tshogs pa sku srungs pa/ /de nas bka' lung blon po mtshungs/ /gnas brtan dang ni grong dpon no/ /gzhi kha gnyer pa byu ri/ /gser mdzod pa dang gser gnyer pa/ /dngul mdzod pa dang dngul gnyer pa/ /nang mi pho brang nang pa dang / /nang na gnas pa'i skye bo'o/ /btsun mo'i sku srungs ra'i gu can/ /gnas brtan dang ni nyug rum pa/ /ma ning nyams pa za ma mtshungs/ /zhabs thog pa dang 'tsho ba pa/ /yul mthar gnas pa'i rgyal po dgra/ /de yi pha rol bshes yin no/ /u da sī na bar gnas yul/ /rtsa 'dzin dang ni rgyab gnas so/ /gnod byed zhe rngo 'gras dgra bo dang / /brtse can zhe sdang nyes byed dang / /smad byed dang ni mi mthun phyogs/ /mi phyan byed dang shes mi byed /dgrar 'dzin pa dang sha tra la/ /mi 'dzu ba dang pha 110—618

rol rgol/ /phyir rgol dang ni pha rol lam/ /na mnyam mtshungs pa 'gran zla dang / /de nas bshes dang grogs po gnyen/ /byams pa bdun pa gnyen/ /rjes su 'gog dang kha 'gog pa/ /lta nyul dang ni rtog mi ba/ /rtog dpyod pa dang nyul mi dang / /ldom bu ba dang so rtog mi/ /bya gtong dang ni nang yan gsum / /los shes rtsis mkhan lha shes dang / /rtsis pa grangs shes yud tsam thang cig dang / /dus shes pa dang rtsis pa 'ong / /rgyu dang grub mtha' shes pa dang / /sbyin bdag khyim bdag mtshung pa'o1/ /'bris mkhan dang ni yig mkhan dang / /yi ge ba dang le kha ke2/ /yi ge'i gzhi dang yi ge'i gnas/ /yi ge'i ri mo gnyis ni mo/ /skyes kha ba dang pho nya dang / /du tyā de dngos las yin/ /lo sa tshongs 'gron po dang / /lam̐ 'grul dang ni 'dren lam dang //bdag po blon po thugs gces dang / /mdzod dang yul dang rdzong dang ni/ /stabs rnams rgyal po'i yan lag rnams rang bzhin no/ /khab dang pho brang zhes pa dang / /dum dang 'thab dang chas pa dang / /drug ni yon tan no/ /nus pa dang ni mthu stobs dang / /dga' bar byas dang sngags bzlas dang / /zas dang gnas dang 'phel ba dang / /sde tshan gsum po rig pa'o/ /dpung dang mthu brjid can dang ni/ /bang mdzod spya yis gang ba dang / /dbyes dang sdud kha dums dang ni/ /spya 'jam thabs ni rnam pa bzhi/ /khral dang sdud 5dang dbya 6dang ni/ /phra ma skyo ma de nas mtshungs pa dbyes dang phra ma/ /u ba dha ni chos sogs kyi/ /gang zhig yongs su lta ba'o/ /lnga ni gsum mo mu drug min / /gang zhig gsum sogs spyod tshul min/ /dgon dang skye bos dbeen pa dang / /g.yogs pa rgyun lugs med pa dang / /de bzhin dgon pa dbeen 110—619

pa gol/ /drags med/ pa ra ha de'i dngos po gsum/ /mtshungs pa blo thub yid ches so/ /nyams na dman dang ji ltar 'gribs/ /ma nyams rig pa rtog pa dang / /bstan gzugs mtshungs par gnas/ /rigs pa thabs dang thob pa dang / /'os pa 'thad pa mtshungs bzhin dang / /gsum drug /sbed pa dang ni 'chab pa'o/ /'doms pa nges ston nyer bstan dang / /rjes gnang nyer blangs bka' lung ngo / /lugs dang khrims dang yul chos khrims/ /nyes pa nongs can skyon can no/ /mtshungs pa btson dang bcings pa'o/ /rkang gnyis 'gyur chad pa'o/ /thob bya dbya dang sdud kha'o/ /khral bar thob pa sho kham mo min no/ /'bul ba phyag rten skyes zhu rten/ /rnam gzhag mdun 'jog /yo byad la sogs gang zhig rnams/ /sbyin par btsams pa dang rdzas so/ /de yi dus la sbyin pa'o/ /phye 1dus la ni a ya te/ /'di la mthong dang 'di yi 'bras / /phyi mar mthong dang de yi 'bras/ /mthong med me dang chu la sogs//mthong ba rang gzhan dgra bo dang / /sa skyong shin tu 'jigs pa dang / /rang phyogs mthu yis 'jigs pa dang / /pra kri ya ni bka' lung ngo / /rnga yab rab tu rgya chen po/ /mi dbang stan ni stan bzang ngo / /seng ge'i stan ni gser gyi'o / /gdugs dang bsil gdugs rgyal po mi dbang mtshan nyid do/ /bum pa bzang dang bum pa gang / /bhri — gar gser kyi bum/ /dmag khyim dmag ram ning ngo / /mel tshe ba dang nye bar bsrung / /glang rta shing rta rkang thang rnams / /dmag gi yan lag rnam bzhi'o/ /so ldan mche ba stobs dang ldan/ /lag ldan mche ba gnyis pa dang / /mang po skyong dang gnyis mthong 5dang / /glang mo skyes dang dbyug 'dzin dang / /nā 5ga dang ni sa lung nyal/ /glang 110—620

chen byed can yī bha dang / /glang po'i mgon dang glang po'i rgyal/ /nags tshal dga' dang thig le can/ /glang po'i chang dang chang gi cha/ /ka la bha ni glang phyug go/ /glang myos sgra sgrogs glang 1bzi dang / /glang po thrun pa glang po rgod / /glang chu tshogs pa glang po 'dus/ /glang mo ba dang ba lang mo/ /'gram pa kaṭa/ /chang dang glang chang / glang po'i mgo dang lag ldan mgo/ /bum pa dang ni glang 'bur gnyis/ /de dag dbus la bee du skyes bu'o/ /a ba gā ha dpral ba yin/ /dī shi ka ni mig 'bras dag /mig gi zur ni nirlu ṇa/ /rna ba'i rtsa ba tsu li kā/ /'og tu bum pa'i bā hi tt+waṃ/ /pra ti mān mche 2ba'i dbus / /as rgo ni phrag pa'i phyogs/ /padma shaṃ ni kha chu'o/ /pakṣu bhā ga rtsib ma'i cha/ /don ta bha ga mche ba'i rtse/ /shar nub rjed ral sogs phyogs/ /lus kyi pha rol rim pa las/ /to tre 'brid pa'i glang bu'o/ /mā khā rgo ni 'dogs pa'i rka/ /lcags thags and+ra ko dang sgrog /mo min beegs kyu mo min shri ṇi 'o mo/ /'dzeg stegs dang ni ya gdong / /rtogs ldan skye bo dam pa mtshungs / /glang g.yogs lab khabs dang ni/ /stan dang ku tha gnyis dag go// ṭwāṃ te glang bo'i 'dogs pa'o/ /'dren byed chu 'thung myur 'gro dang / /'gro mgyogs rta dang gshog pa can/ /rta dang 'gro byed ha 5ya dang / /sen dhū skyes dang bdun ldan dang / /cang shes dang ni go ling ngo / /rnam par dul dang lags 'gro dang / /ba na'i yul skyes pā ra sī skyes/ /'dar byed skyes dang bā sgo skyes/ /mchod sbyin rta dang me bye'i rta/ /bang pa dang ni lhag par rgyug /rgyab ldan dang ni brten pa'o/ /gi la dkar po ka rka'o/ /shing rta 'dren byed ra tha su/ /rte'u dang ni thor bu'o/ /rgod ma dang ni ma rta'o/ /110—621

bāḍa baṃ rta khyu dang / /gsum yin a shā ni ni gang / /rta yis nyen gcig bgrod pa'i lam/ /ka shyan rta yi rked pa'o/ /rta yi dbyangs/ ze rdog dang ni ze ba'i phyogs/ /rta yi tshogs pa rta khrom 'dre/ /'tsher 'gro phyogs bzhir 'gro ba dang / /yongs bskor mchong 'gro ring du 'gro/ /lnga po 'di rnams rta yi 'gos//rta mchog gtso bo mo ma yin/ /rta khrab dang ni kha lī na/ /mo/ rta mig ma ni rmig ma pho/ /rta 'jug mo min rnga ma 'jug /bā la harta rta rnga snying ngo / /gsum ste nyer 'dre 'dre log dang / /pha rol 'dre dang sa la 'dre/ /theg pa 'khor los 'gro ba dang / /g.yul gyi shing rta yan lag brgya/ /'gro ba'i shing rta / /'di ni me tog shing rta'o/ /'khor lo bzhin pa yul 'jug gang / /rna ba'i shing rta rab 'bab dang / /rta yis 'dren dang mtshungs pa gsum/ /ma ning shing rta sha ka ṭa/ /mo min shaṃ ṭī la bas g.yogs/ /khyogs dang 'degs 'gro zhes pa dang / /do la pra kha la sogs pa/ /mo/ gnyis po stan g.yogs snyag can dang / /stag gis g.yogs pa'i shing rta'o/ /la ba dkar pos g.yogs pa dang / /lyandan dang la ba dkar/ /shing rta can la gos la sogs / /la ba la sogs g.yogs pa'o/ /gsum po gnyis 'thung la sogs la//rabyā shing rta'i tshogs dang lam/ /dhū ni mo dang ma ning shing rta'i gdong / /shing rta'i khong pa ma bas dkar/ /'khor lo shing rta'i yan lag dang / /de yi mtha' dang mu khyud dang / /mo yin pra bye pho/ 'khor lo'i lte ba 'khor lo bsrung ba'i gzer bu ni/ /gnyis ti te a bhā'o/ /shing rta sgrib dang 'thab ra'o//yu gha dha ra gnya' shing 'dzin/ /rjes su 'dren dang dhārba dhaḥst+waṃ/ /gnya' shing 'ching zhing yu ga dang / /thams cad bzhon pa theg pa dang / /khyogs dang 110—622

'khrul 'khor bgrod tebyed do/ /phan tshun 'bab dang len pa dang / /mo min2/bzhon pa pa dang glang po pa/ /glang chen steng na gnas pa'o/ /kha lo ba dang mgo ༄ 'dren pa/ /sna chags —sna khrid kha lo bsgyur/ /g.yas 5sdod lho phyogs gnas pa dag /shing rta'i gnyen zhes bya ba'o/ /ra thi na ni shing rta pa/ /a shā bā hā rta pa'o/ /dpa' dang rtul phod gzhan zil gnon/ /sde srungs dang ni so pa'o/ /tshogs pa sde pa 'dus pa dang / /phung po dmags 6dpung mee ni ka /gang zhig dpung ni stong yod pa/ /de ni stong dpon sa ha tra bya ra ba dang mel che'o/ /dmag dpon dang ni dpon mgo'o/ /gañtsa 7ka ni go na khrab bo/ /gang zhig nang changs can dang ni/ /beer dang go cha lus kyi gos/ /de nas mgo khab tshem bu'i zhwa/ /rmog /de nas lus gos khrab dang ni/ /ya lad brang khabs go cha khrab/ /ka ba tsa ni mo min no/ /go cha gyon dang chas zhugs dang / /go cha ba ra mi ta go/ /gsum ni ma gol la sogs pa/ /go cha dang ni go chogs pa/ /rkang thang rkang dmag rkang 'gros pa/ /pā dā bi ka dang rkang rgyu ba/ /pa da ga dang pa di ka /de nas rkang thang tshogs dang dpung bu chung / /mtshon chas 'tsho dang mtshon cha ba/ /'khrug mi dang ni gsos po mtshungs/ /lag sbyangs rab dgos khyad par can/ /skyes bu rgyu rtsal mkhan/ a ba bā dri bra ṣa ta ko beel/ /kṣudma.āoṃta shā pa kā/ /dha rtswa gzhu can dang / /gzhu thogs pa dang gzhu 'dzin no/ /mda' ba dang ni mda' 'dzin pa/ /shā tta ka dang mdung 'dzin dang / /dbyig pa can dang beer kha ba/ /dbyug pa dgra sta'i mtshon cha can/ /gri pa 1dang ni ral gri'i mtshon/ /mtshungs pa mdung can mdung mtshon can/ /tsa rma'i lag na pug 1— yin no/ /ba tā tī dang 'phyar dar 110—623

ro / /rjes 'jug phyir 'brang rjes su 'brang rjes su yong / /rting 'brang ba dang mtshungs pa'o/ /sngon 'go/ mdun 'gro dang por 'gro/ /sna 'dor ba dang gdong ma'o/ /manda gā mi dal gyis 'gro/ /myur 'gro ba dang rgyug pa mnyam//bang chen pa dang dzā ghi go1/ /mgyogs myur rgyug pa bang / /rgyu dang ni rab tu skyod / /rgyal dang rgyal nu dze tu ngo / /dze ya rgyal bar sems pa'o/ /rgyal ba dang ni dze dā'o2/ /gang zhig dgra yi phyogs 'gro ba/ /de ni a bhya mi bye'o/ /groges ngan pa dang skya lag go/ /stobs chen dang ni gyad mi dang / /gang zhig shin tu rtul phod pa/ /brang spyod u pa si lo'o/ /shing rta ra thing shing rta'i bdag /'dod 'bor dang ni rjes chags 'gro/ /rtag 'gro de bzhin 4rgyun dukhe gro5/ /dpa' dang rtul phod ngo bo la gnon/ /brjid can dang ni rgyal byed pa/ /g.yul na brjid dang legs pa dang / /mtshon chas 'tsho ba la sogs gsum/ /rgyal mtshan dang ni bzhon pa dang / /dmag dpon ru dar sde dang ni/ /dmag dang dpung ni chas pa'o/ /stobs kyi sde dang 'khor lo dang / /tshogs pa rnams ni mo min no/ /dpung tshogs rnams kyi bkod pa ni/ /de dbye dbyug sogs 'khrug shoms so/ /slar 'brang bkod pa phyi ma'o/ /dmag gi rgyab ni yongs 'dzin pa/ /glang dang shing rta re re dang / /rta gsum dang ni rkang thang lnga/ /sa dā ti ka zhes pa'o/ /so so'i yan lag gsum 'gyur gyis/ /kun gyi go rim zhes bya'o/ /ji ltar phyi nas dmag gi sgo/ /gul ma ga rto bā hā bhā / /sde tshan gyi ming ngo / /pri ta nā tsa mu/ a bhā ki bee bcu rnams la/ /a bhā ki byo a khyo nyi/ /phun tshogs 'byor ldan dpal dang shis/ /phongs dang mi 'byor phun tshogs bral/ /mtshon cha lag cha rdeg cha rgyan cha de nas ma yin no/ /110—624

gzhu dang tsā pa dha nu dang / /'dab za mda' 'phen kasum̐ ka /mda' bskyod de nas karṇatyahūṃ/ /kā la papyo mda' yi lto/ /srid sgrub gzhu ni gāṇḍi bo/ /skyes bu 'am ni ma ning ngo / /gzhu yi mchog ma a ṭa nī/ /go dha lag 'brag lag gzan no/ /la sta ka ni changs pa'o/ /gzhu rgyud prad pu rgyud yon tan/ /g.yon brkyang g.yas brkyang la sogs pa'i/ /gnas ni rnam pa lnga zhes so/ /mda' 'phen mtshon cha lakṣ-i ngo / /'phong slob u pa nā sa 'o/ /mda' dang bā ṇa rtse mo can/ /drang 'gro mkha' 'gro myur 'gro dang / / nag phran lam ldan 'bigs byed dang / /gshog ldan mda' dang gnyis/ /lcags mda' nā rā tsā yin no/ /sgo dang 'dab ma gsum phyis/ /ni ra sta ni mda' 'phangs pa /dug can mda' ni li bā kau/ /dong pa mda' shugs du bee ra/ /brtsong rtse mda' 'dzin gnyis dong ba/ /ral gri gcod byed zla 'dzums 5dang / /a si ral gri rdeg cha dang / /maṇḍa la rtse lag pa skyong / /kri 6pā ṇa 'dra/ se ru ral gri'i yu ba'o/ /ral gri'i 'ching thag me kha la/ /phub ni mo min pha la'o/ /tsa rmag yung du lag 'dzin pa/ /thob 'joms byed gha na'o/ /rked gri kar pā li ka /'bigs skyong mdung dang mnyam pa/ /dbyug pa lcags bcings pa ri ghā / /gnyis pa steng ri par shu/ /dgra sta dang ni sta mo'o/ /chu gri gri thung chu ri ka /ral gri phrug gu'o/ /'phang mdung sha lya gser mdung ngo / /mda' bo che ni to ma ra dang mo min/ /thag mdung kun dang sngon ma mo min zhabs thog pa / /sna mdor ko ṭa pa ra/ /kun kyis chas byed sar po gha/ /kun kyis go gyon sdogs byed pa/ /go bsar dzodang ni go cha bsgos/ /rgyal po dmags la mnga' gsol byed/ /gang zhig dmag 'gro de dbang bskur/ /dmag thegs 110—625

bskyod dang ldeg pa dang / /zhugs pa 'gro dang ga ma'o/ /brkyang ba dang ni ru rgyangs 1dang / /pha rol dmag dang 'jug pa'i don/ /nyam mi nga ba dang 'jigs med dang / /g.yul du 'jug tshe mngon bye par dpa'/ /bee tā li ka go byed pa/ /'khor lo can dang dril bu dang slongs mo ba/ /rgyal rabs mkhan ni ma dhu ka /phyag dang stod pa mkhan po dang / /g.yul 'phrod 'khrug dus g.yul ngor zhugs/ /rdul tshub dganyis so mo ni rdul/ /rdul tshub gnyis te tshub ma dang / /phye ma dang ni khyo dā 'o/ /nye bar 'khrugs dang 'gyed pa dang / /'dzings pa dang ni phyogs med dang / /ba dan rgyal mtshan tog dang ni/ /dhwa dza dang ni mo min no/ /dur khrod 'khrug 5 pa'i sa gzhi dang / /shin tu 'jigs pa rab tu ster/ /nga sdang sda zhes sgrog pa/ /bdag sngon mo min/ /mtshar can skyes bu grags pa can/ /nga rgyal can zhes so/ /ngang zhes smra phan tshun 'gran/ /gang zhig 'gran par byed pa'o/ /'tsho ma med thal 'gro rtul phod dang / /stobs ldan dpal dang nyam nga med/ /nus ldan pha rol gnon pa'o / /gyad dang shin du dpa' ba'o/ /dpa' bo'i btung phyeb gang zhig gis//chang 'thungs yul kyi snga phyi ru/ /'khrug ⑥pa 'gyed pa rgyal byed pa/ /'joms pa rab tu 'joms pa dang / /mo dha du byed saṃ khya dang / /g.yul dang sā 2pa rā yi ka /mtshon 'dzings mnyam shi a bee du ka /g.yul du 'thab ma bi gra hra/ /'phrog 'joms dge bral rtsod pa dang / /shin tu 'dral dang saṃ yugs/ /mngon pa nyed dang rdeg gsod dang / /'thab rtsod 'khrug longs sa mu dā ya mo/ /mi bdeg yul 'gyed a ji dang / /sa mi byu ⑨dha zhes pa'o/ /mtshan bral gyad ༄ dādapung 'dzings dang / /tu mu lo ni g.yul du gsod/ /ca co sgrogs pa seng 110—626

ge'i sgra/ /glang mo'i bum pa'i sgra dang ni/ /dud mo ca co dang ding dang / /'bru mang po dang glang bo'i sgra/ /bisthā ra ni gzhu yi sgra/ /'khrug rnga ram pa ro dag mtshungs/ /g.yo rgyu ngan thabs ha tha'o/ /de nas 'khrul dang nor ba dang //mi shes ma ning 1ltas byung dang / /nyer sgyur dang ni mtshungs pa gsum/ /brgyal dang myos dang 'bog pa'o/ /mand+rab dang ni 'tshor ba'o/ /rmas pa dang ni lus nyams so/ /rgyal ba dang ni rnam par rgyal/ /'dras dang rtsen dang slar byed dang / /'khon zhugs pa dang sha 'khon zhugs/ /bros dang zhogs dang bur ba dang / /saṃ dā bā bi dra bo dra baḥ.a ya tā mo/ /bros pa'i ming ngo /g.yul du bcos gzhan rgyal ba dang / /'pham pa dang ni pha rol rgyal/ /yib par nga ni 5skyabs pa'o/ /'joms dang rdeg dang rdung ba dang / /rnam 'tshe dang bsnun pa dang / /bzhus dang nyer gtses mnar ba dang / /nor pa nyed pa gos med dang / /brdung tag 6nges 'joms nges par gsod/ /skad cig dang ni yongs su spangs/ /niṭwā ya rgo / bi sha sa nee/ sā ra khaṃ pra ti ghā ta na / /tatwa sa rgo pra ma tha nee / /dra tha no/ /dzñās nā ni tsa/ a lartswa pa ñtsi / rnam 'joms gtubs dang gcod pa dang / /de rnams ni gsod gcod kyi ming gi rnam grangs so/ /lnga pa dus tshod lta ba'i mtha'/ /skal mjog tshe 'gro mtha' ma dang / /chud 'dza' gnyis te tshe 'da' dang / /'chi ba byed bcings mo min no/ /pha rol 'das dang lnga po rnyed/ /pha rol dang ni yi dgas gnas/ /ro dang tshe 'das gsum zhes so/ /ro thab sgong phub tsi ti mo/ /ka brnya ni mo min te/ /byed ldan mgo med ro yin no/ /dur khrod dang ni gshin gyi nags/ /ro dang sha ba mo min no/ /gdon dang 'byung po 'ching byed do/ /110—627

kā dā ⑫tyā ni 'ching byed gnas/ /skyes bu'i srog ni pā ṇa'o/ /de nas de bzhin 'tsho dang gson pa dang / /tshe ni ji srid 'tsho ba'i dus/ /skyes bu 'tsho byed 'tsho ba'i sman/ /rgyal rigs kyi sde tshan no/ /rlis byung rla skyes 'phags pa dang / /rje rigs sa 'dzin rje'u'o/ /kun 'tsho 'tsho ba bā rta dang / /gson byed so nam ④'tsho 'tshis so/ /gsum yin rmo rko 1 dud 'gro skyong / /tshong dang 'tsho ba'i tshim zhes bya/ /zhabs thogs ④pa ni khyi ⑤yi 'tsho/ /rmo rko rngu dang ni phru zlog dang / /ston thag dang no thon no/ /bya chol ④dang ni slong mo pa/ /ji ltar/ bden pa dang ni tshong dngos po/ /'bun dang skyed dang bde 'tsho dang / /don sbyor 'tshong ngam 'tshong pa can/ /skyi ba dang ni g.yar ba dang / /brje ba dang ni bsgyur bzlog go/ /nor kyi ba dag dang bu lon pa/ /gnyis po rab sbyor len ④mkhan rim/ /tshul min pa dang log 'tsho dang / /'phel ba dang ni gyur 'tshor/ /zhing pa shas pa so nam pa—/ /phru rlog pa dang rmos pa'o/ /zhing dang 'brus sha le yo/ /'bru dang sa lu 'byung ba'o/ /nas dang nas zhing drug cu pa/ /nas sogs 'byung ba'i sa gzhi'o / /ti lhi tai li mon sra gre/ /a ma a tu /lku dzha gha dang / /thog ra mo gī rgo kro dra bī ṇa/ /kṣa ma 'bras skyel khyad par sogs/ /sa bon btsugs dang bskrun pa dang / /btab dang rmos dang bskyed pa'o/ /sum log dang ni lan gsum rmos/ /sum ldog sum rmos de la yang / /nyis log pa dang nyis rmos dang / /nyis dul nyis rmos pa 6la'o/ /dro sgyu snya ⑪ka la sogs bre/ /bye bo adhaka la sogs/ /khā rī tshad can khā rī ka /u tu ma rṇa la sogs gsum/ /110—628

skyes bu ma ni nga dang ni/ /sa gzhi kṣe tra 'bru sa dang / /'bru sa chu ma chu mig can—/ /rmo sa zhing dang sa gzhi tshogs/ /bong ba sa sgong pho/ kro ṭi sha ni bong ba'i dbye/ /lcags dbyig to da na to tram̐/ /tog tse tang ni rko byed do/ /zor ba dang ni rnga byed do/ /brnya yu ba yo ka tra/ /de nas gshol dang rmo byed dang / /gshol dang ha la thod pa dang / /sa gcod 'dral byed gshol dang ni//glang 'joms dang ni rtse mo can/ /gnya' shing gnya' pa'i phur pa dang / /mda' dang gshol gyi dbyig pa'o/ /thong lcag 1dang ni gshol lcags so/ /skyes bu rtod phur 'dogs thag dang / /gang zhig phyugs rnams btags pa'o/ /'bru dkar 'bru dgar 'bru dang bā ṭa la/ /nas dang ya ba mnyam pa'o/ /ma smin ba ni ljang ba'o/ /sran ma sra twe na ku dang / /sran ma'i ming ngo / /ko ra du ṣa kro dra ba/ /bkra shis dang ni sran chung ngo / /mon sran gre'u brgyad pa'o / /nags sran ma/ dkar dang yungs nags ba la khang ka tasba kau/ /don grub yungs kar zas gtsang dang / /gro dang yid legs 'gro ba'o/ /nas dang ku lam ṣa zhes so/ /ca —ṇa ka dang ha ri mand+ra skyes/ /gnyis ni tī le til skyes dang / /ti la piñtsa 'bras med do/ /skye rtse kṣu dhā mngon skyes dang / /rgyal po nag po lha min mo/ /khre dang bri yang ghu ni gnyis/ /u mā zar ma a ta sī / /mā tū la nī bhā ga yā5/ /'bru yi rab dbye a rku skyes/ /ki shu ru dang snyi ma dang / /snyi ma dang ni dog pa'o/ /so ba skogs 6can gongs ma'o/ /stam po kud pa 7rtsa sogs 'bru/ /mgul ba ngar ba kaṇḍa'o/ /ba khā la ni mo min 'bras med sogs/ /srun stong phub ma ma ning ngo / /mo rkogs skyes bu phub ma'o/ /rtse mo mo min 'jam pa dang / /rtse mo rno ba gra ma dang / /110—629

mtshungs pa gang bu gsum phyi nas/ /so ba'i tshogs pa dhā rsā'o/ /gtsang ma dang ni mang byas dang / /sran ma la sogs gang bu'i 'bru/ /snyi ma'i 'bru ni nas la sogs/ /shā la ya dang kal ma sogs dang / /drug cu pa sogs pho 'di rnams / /rtswa yi 'bru dang ni bā rā/ /mo ni ga be durga bee dhu ka'o / /lcags rtse can dang rtun shing ngo / /mo min/ rtun dang 'bru ma'i ma gzhi'o/ /slo ma 'khrab byed mo min no/ /khrol ma dang ni tshags se'o/ /sge dang pha tshi thub po khres / /rtswa thugs rtswa khres dag mtshungs so/ /ro ldan g.yos khang tshang ma'o/ /g.yos dngo/na lag bde'i dpon po dang / /zan 4ma g.yos ma thab kha ba/ /lag bde 'dren thang phyag tshang ngo / /yon tan thab kha ba zas gnyer/ /zas byed pa 'di rnams gsum/ /thab dang skyed bu me thab dang / /tsu li dang ni g.yos sa'o/ /me yi gzhong pa me snod dang / /me yi stegs dang me rdza'o/ /de nas mo min me mdag dang / /me dang mu la bu mu shaṃ zhes so/ /ma ning glang ba jer po dang / /rngod gzhi sdod rdza dang ni mo/ /snod po che dang nor bu can/ /chu yi snod dang ba chu rdza'o/ /za rdza btso rdza g.yo snod snod/ /bum pa gsum yin gnyis gha ṭa/ /bum pa ni pā mo min no/ /kham phor dang ni rdza phor ro/ /snum zan ma dang dul ma'o/ /'khar ba mo min chang snod do/ /ku duḥko sbubs snum snod do/ /ku ru chung ba skyes bu'o/ /kun 'jo snod ni bhaṇḍa'o5/ /snod dang a ma tra snod spyod/ /skyab 9pa srub byed kha dzā kā/ /bzar bu dang ni lag skyogs so/ /mo min lo ma sngo lo ma/ /ngar pa sdong bu chu ba'o/ /spod dang kha dog sgyur byed do/ /tin ti lī ka bse yab dang / /shing skyur de nas pho ba ris//ma ri tsam dang ko la shaṃ/ /nag po drod sman chos kyi sman/ /dzre ra zi ra a dzā dzi 7 //110—630
