zegs ma nag po zi ra bu jo3/ /ka ra bī dang sa dang ni/ /rgya chen nag po zi ra nags/ /sgo bsher dang ni rwa can no/ /de nas gdugs can 'u su dang / /ku snyum bu ru so ba can/ /de nas sga dang sman chen dang / /mo dang ma ning thams cad la/ /gong skyes bi shwa sman dang ni/ /rtsa ba mo skyur mo gra la mā ṣā/ /thug sgyur skyur rtsi a ma la/ /skyur sbyar dang ni kañdzi kai/ /stong 'bigs shing kun me ldan dang / /ho gu dang ni shing kun no/ /de yi lo ma kā rā bī/ /zi ra nag po bā ṣa bika /ka ra bī dang rgya chen no/ /mtshan mo'i ming can spung ba ser / /ha 4ri dra dang yung ba 'o/ /rgya mtsho gang zhig lan tshwa tsha/ /dpyid dus chags pa de dang de/ /rgya mtsho mo min dkar zhing 5zhi/ /mā ṇi mand+ra send+ra skyes / /ro ma ke dang sbyar tshwa 'o/ /smin tshwa kha ru tsha sbyar gnyis/ /tshwa ni mi zad ru tsa ke/ /mar khu las byung me tsa ke/ /ka ra sbu ba hwags dang ni/ /sha rkar dang ka ra dkar/ /'phrul dang 'i las sbyar ro/ /rā sā lā ni gnyes pa'o//tshod ma dang ni ṣṭha rgo/ /rtags gsum bā sa yan chod do/ /rtse byas bsregs sha shu stso 'o/ /btsos pa'i sha ni bee thar ma/ /gya nom pa dang phun sum tshogs/ /dka' bas bsgrubs dang legs par sbyar/ /ltar ltar dang ni mal mul lo/ /legs bsangs pa dang dag byas mnyam/ /snum brngos snum btsos sdi dzwa/ /'dra dang 'khur ba bā si 6ta/ /ma smin pa dang bsru bu zas/ /'bras yos skyes bu mang po'i tshig mnyams pa/ /'bras yos bi pi ṭa ka /yos dang nas brngos mo yin no/ /rdob bu chang bu changs pa dang / /zho zan zho dang sbyar ba'o/ /zan ni mi min bha kā/ /zas dang an na o da no/ /mo min bza' ba zhes pa'o//bza' ba dang ni lto zhes so/ /ro kun dang po khu ba mo/ /'bras bu tsā ma khu ye 110—631

dang / /thug pa khu ba zan las byung / /ya hā hūṃgu dang 'bras thug go/ /thug pa skyo che ta ra lā/ /ga bye — gsum yin pa las byung / /thams cad pa dang baphyi dang / /ba yi rang bzhin mo min no/ /lcu skam dang ni yar dge mo/ /'o ma khye ram̐ pa ya mtshungs/ /'o ma las byung zhod bye sogs/ /dra bye ma chags zhes so//zhun mar zhun ma bsreg rdzas mar/ /ma bzhu ba dang mar gsar dang / /de ni te ya bhā bi rgo / /gang zhig khar chang ba bzhos mar/ /dbyug sgrum dar ba zho dpyang dang / /chu skya chab skya dar ba'o/ /mthi tai ni chu rkang gabyug /chu phyed pa ni nirdza lam/ /zho kha chu ni zho las byung / /pri ni 'o ma gsar pa'o/ /zas 'dod zas 'dod ltogs pa dang / /gās dang ni kham gyi don/ /chu bcas zas dang sā bī to/ /sa gabye bud med dang lhan cig za ba/ /chu 'dod btung 'dod kha st+waṃ skom/ /bzhes pa gsol dgongs gdugs tshod dang / /'tshal —ma za ma zas dang ni/ /kha zas zhes pa dang yang ngo / /'grangs dang ngoms dang tshim nga/ dang / /te la sder zhabs lhag ma'o/ /'dod pa rab 'dod gdung ba dang / /zhen pa chags pa sred pa'o/ /'brog pa phyugs skyong ba lang 'grang / /ba 'jo zho mkhan lcags thogs so/ /ba lang ma he la sogs pa/ /rkang ldan nor ldan gnyis ni phyug phyug go/ /ba ldan go drwa 5phyugs ltas 'chor dang ba lang rgyu/ /nog can bzang po stobs ldan dang / /glang dang khyu mchog bri sha dang / /'dren byed ba lang 'gro byed do/ /nog can tshogs pa u kṣa kai /ba khyub tshogs ba lang 'dus/ /ba'u bee'u bātma ka grus ma'o/ /khyu ba nog chen ma ho kṣa/ /bri sgo 6u kṣa glang rgan no/ /nog skyes pa dang gser 7nog 'chas/ /gnya' 'dul glang gsar 'dra ba'o/ /sha bcad ma ning sbyor ba'o/ /ma rgong 110—632

mkhan po ba dī ra/ /dpung pa'i phyogs ni ba ha'o/ /sa rtswa rteske yi lkog shal lo//sna thag dang ni kha thag go/ /rgyab len 'gro dang khur 'gro ba/ /gnya' shing la sogs bho dha ra/ /gnya' shing glang 'dul ba dang shing rta 'dren/ /rmod byed gcod byed 'phru byed pa/ /gshol ldan rmo glang khal glang dang / /rgal dang khal pa khur 'dren pa/ /gnyis po gcig gi khur theg pa/ /chig theg gcig pus — 'dren pa'o/ /kun gyi khur theg dul ma dang / /khur kun 'dren par nus pa'o/ /ba mo ba dang go ru sru / /mchod byed dang ni ro ldan ma/ /mchod pa mchod yon ro hi ṇi/ /ba lang mchog ni nai ci shī/ /kha dog la sogs dbye ba'i ming / /khra mo dkar po la sogs pa/ /lo gnyis ma dang lo gnyis pa/ /lo gcig ma dang lo gcig pa/ /bee'u med dang ba skam mo/ /a ba to ka bee'u shor / /de dang she dang khyu mchog spyor/ /de na lo bee khur ru ma/ /dus thob 'khor mang dus so/ /prasgo sthā dang ba gsar ro/ /a tsaṇḍa nī dul ma'o/ /bee mangs ma dang le —bee ma/ /bee spun ring ba baṣka 5ya ṭī/ /dhe nu bee'u gsar skyes so/ /sprin pa dang ni 'jo ba de ma/ /nu 'thung 'thung ba'i nu ma'o/ /dro ṇi spyi ra bre chen gzhod/ / 'dogs thag 6'thing thag 7stan byed pa/ /lo re zhing skye ba'o/ /lo btud skye dang slar skye ma/ /u dha ma ning mā rpā rgo/ /btod pa'i shing dang phur pa'o/ /mo min thag pa 'dogs thag go/ /phyug thag rkang thag dā ma ni/ /srub ma srub shing mand+ra na/ /srub ma dang ni zho skya'o/ /srub pa'i ka ba ku tha ro/ /zho rdza srub pa'i rdza ma mtshungs/ /rnga mo rim can rang bzhin lus chen po/ /rnge'u dang ni rnge phrug go/ /rnge'u 'dogs thag shri kha la—/ /shing la rkang pa'i dogs snyepa'o/ /ra dang tshwa 9gī tshe tshe dang / /ra 110—633

dang sba 'phyang ma skyes pa/ /lug dang lto 'phyang ba la ldan dang / /g.yang dkar dang rgo e ḍa kāḥ/ /rnga mo brang 'gro 'tshogs dang khyu/ /rnga khyu gsum 'phyang bong bu 'khor lo can stobs ldan/ /sna chen skad chen kha ra'o/ /gzhan skyes ded dpon nges 'gro 1dkar dang / /tshong dpon tshong pa zong 'tshong dang //zong pa dang ni nyo tshong ngo / /'tshong pa bi kra ko'o/ /nyo bkra yi ka mtshungs/ /btsong bya ba ḍi rje yin no/ /rin dang gzhal bya bkra ya/ /zong dang tshong dngos rtsa nor dang / /rnyed 2pa lhag pa'i 'bras bu can/ /so sor byin dang yongs su bsgyur ba'o/ /brje ba dang ni bsgyur ba'o/ /skyes bus gtams pa byā 4pa'o / /beer blangs dang ni gtad pa'o/ /tshong zong bkram pa ṭwāṃ ngo / /kre ya gzhal bar bya ba'o/ /tshong dang bsgyur ldog nyo tshong sogs/ /gsum/ ma ning bden zong bden byed/ /bden byas mo 'tshod pa dang ni bi kra ya/ /bgrang bya grangs bya bcu ni gsum/ /nyi shu la sogs thams cad gcig /bgrang bya la sogs pa/ /grangs don gnyis dang mong 5po'i tshig /dgu bcu pa ni mo yin no/ /phreng ni brgya dang stong la sogs/ /go rim bcu yi yon tan phyi / /'jal byed tshad byed mnyam byed ces/ /tshad kyi don ni gsum yin no//'jal byed srang dang sor dang bre/ /ma ru lnga sogs mā sha ka /de rnams bcu drug zho gnyis te/ /mo min srang ni dkar ṣa bzhi yin no/ /gser 'jal zho cha gser mig go/ /ku ru bi ta rta yi 6srang / /snyoms byed mo min srang brgya dang / /khur yin nyi shu tham pa ni/ /srang / ā tsi tai ni khur bcu'o/ /shing rta khur rta a tsi ta/ /kārṣa pa na dong tshe yin/ /zangs ma'i dang tshe kābhā ke//mo min bre bo che/ /bzhi cha bzhi pa bcu drug nyi shu ni/ /na 3kuñtsa ka /ku ḍa 110—634

kha dang brel sogs/ /yongs su 'jal byed so so'i/ /rkang pa dang ni gcig cha yin/ /cha dang cha shas 'god pa'o/ /rdzas dang yo byad nor dang ni/ /'byor pa dngos po dkar dang rdzas/ /rin chen zang zing longs spyod don/ /nor bu dang dngos po nyid kyang ngo / /mdzod dang rin chen gser gzugs dang //sgom dang snod ces bya ba'o/ /de dag gang zhig gzhan mdzod dang / /dngul dang de gnyis mā ha tai/ /mkha' lding gshog pa mar ka ta dang / /rdo yi snying dang nor bu ljang / /rin chen dmar po hi ta ka /padma rā ga de nas ni/ /mu tig dang ni mu kā'o/ /de nas bee dru ma ni skyes bu ste/ /byi ru pho dang ma ning ngo / /rin chen nor bu gnyis yin te/ /rdo skyes mu tig la sogs/ dang / /gser dang mdog bzangs 1 ka na ka /rin chen he ma tshong dus 'drim/ /bsreg bya bum brgya gi gā 2skyes/ /bhra ma mdangs ldan sa le sbram/ /skyes gzugs kha dog chen po dang / /mdog ldan 'od byed mchu gser/ /rkang brgyad dang ni mo min no/ /rgyan gser gang zhig ra can dang / /kan shaṃ ces pa 'di/ /mdog ngan tshan dang dngul dang ni/ /khar dzu ram̐ dkar bo dang / /rī rī ming dngar gan mo yin/ /de nas zangs dang shu ste —dang / /kla klo kha dog zangs ma dang / /dusba ṇi'o/ /lcags ni mo min 'tshon byed no/ /gong bu nag po gar bu dang / /rdo yi snying po de nas ni/ /so rdo lcags dreg dri ma'o//mdog can thams cad yang dag lcags/ /lcags kyi bye brag gshol lcags dang / /mching bu g.yu gser de nas ni/ /rgyug byed dngul chu 'ded byed dang / /khu ba'i dbang po zhes bya'o/ /bab lam ni mā he'i rwa/ /lhang tsher ri skyes dri ma med / /chu srol mig sman sau bī re/ /mig sman kā pi ta yā mu rna/ spangs 170—635

ma'i mig sman rtse can mgrin/ /sngon po dang ni rma bya'i mgrin/ /sbangs ma btul 1 ba dārbi kā/ /brtsos pa las byung sbangs ma'o/ /khu ba'i mig sman khu ba'i snying / /'thing dril rdo mu zi dri ldan dang / /shin du dri/ mig sman rigs can ku lad thig /dus kyi me tog me tog ze/ /me tog mig sman poṣka rka / /ba bla ser po tā la mā la/ /ha ri ta la ke/ brag zhun ma rgyari skyes dang / /rdo skyes shing lā dzā tu'o/ /'byor rtsi dri sprin srog canadang / /gor bu ko sa ri bong mnyam/ /rgya mtsho sbu ba phen sbu/ /sind+ra ram̐ dang li khri'o/ /nā ga zho nye mtshon mo stengs/ /ro nye 4tra pu pi tstsha ṭa/ /tshon dang gsha' tse mkhar ba'i rgyu/ /de nas btsag ces bya ba'o/ / le brgan 5me lce tshon chen po/ /zhes pa'ang lug snam bal gos/ /ri bong bal ni sha sha lo ma'o/ /sbrang dang mngar ldan mbi kṣa sogs/ /sbrang snyigs dang ni spra tshil lo/ /ma na ri skyes ldong ros dang / /ldong ros dang ni klu lce ba/ /nee bā lī ni kuṇḍi go la/ /yā ba kṣa nas sogs skyes/ /smin pa de nas/ rgya tshwa kā po ta/ su kha brtsa karya tshu'/ /shi tshwa baṃ sha ro tsa nā/ /myur skyes dkar po pho ba ris/ /mo/ ra ṭaṃ rtsa ba bur shing / /mdung tsa na pa bee lī'i rtsa/ /rtswa ṭi ka shir zhes pa yang ngo / /go lo mi dang 'byung po'i skra/ /pho/ ba trang ga dang tsan dan dmar/ /tshwa ba gsum dang uṇḍa byo ṣa/ /'bras bu gsum ni pha la trika /rje rigs kyi sde tshan no/ /dmangs rigs dang ni phyis skyes dang / /chos snum dang ni byin skyes so/ /kun gtum mthar thug 'dres ma'o/ /sman pa ri mo mkhan la sogs/ /dmangs dang rjes skyes ri mo mkhan/ /sman pa rje'u gnyis skyes las/ /110—636

dmangs dang rgyal 'dres drag pa'o/ /bya bas 'tsho ba rgyal rjes 'dres/ /mā hi 6 ni 'phag 1rgyal 'dres/ /kṣa ta 'phags pa dmangs mo'i bu/ /bram ze rgyal 'dres sru ta'o/ /de yi rjes 'dres 2bee de ha/ /shing rta mkhan po mā hā byā / /ri mo mkhan las byung ba'o/ /kun gtum pa yi skye ba ni/ /bram ze mo dang chos snub las/ /byed mkhan dang ni bzo bo dang / /tshogs pa de rnams gnyis yin te/ /shes nyen mkhan dang bzo ba'i rigs/ /rigs ldan rigs kyi gtso bo dang / /me tog mkhan po mā li ka /bum pa mkhan dang rdza mkhan no/ /zhal ba mkhan po le pa ka /tan tā bā ya thags mkhan no/ /tshem bu ba dang gos bzo ba/ /ri mos 'tsho ba tsi tra kar/ /mtshon cha mkhan dang ral gri mkhan / /lham mkhan dang ni ko lpags —mkhan/ /lcags bzo ba dang lcags mgar ro/ /gser mgar swarṇa ka ra dang / /gser mkhan dang ni gser bzo ba / /dung bzo ba dang dung mkhan no/ /zangs mkhan dang ni zangs mgar ba / /shin mkhan shing bzo shing 'jog pa/ /shing rta byed dang shing 'jog mkhan / /phywa mkhan dang ni khyem shing mkhan/ /khyem gnas dang ni bza' mo'o//breg mkhan skra mkhan mtho ris grags/ /nā pi ta dang mthar gnas pa/ /chos ma dang btso rlag mkhan/ /chang 'tshong ma dang chang 5ma'o/ /ra rdzi dang ni ra skyong ba/ /lta yis 'tsho dang 6lha gnyer ba/ /sgyu ma ba dang sgyu ma mkhan/ /sgyu ma byed dang so sor 'phrog /gar ba dang ni gar mkhan no/ /bud med kyis 'tsho bud med bskyangs/ /bha ra ta zhes gar dang ni/ /rkang pa ba dang gar gyi gtso / /rnga pa dang ni rnga rdung ba/ /lag pa'i sgra dang thal mo rdeb/ /gling bu ba dang gling bu 'bud/ /pi wang pa dang pi wang mkhan/ /'tsho ba tha chad bya ba 110—637

shor ba/ /gnyis/ bya ba snyi ba dang bya rgya pa/ /rngon pa snyi pa shan pa lings/ /gsum / gla mi gla zan las byed pa/ /zho shas 'tsho ba zhes pa'o/ /bang chen pa dang phrin pa'o/ /khur 'dren pa dang khur pa'o/ /rigs med dman pa na rigs dang / /phal pa dang ni so so skye/ /ngan pa dmangs rigs dzābee dang / /chung ba dang ni dman pa'o/ /khol dang g.yog dang bran dang ni/ /dā sa g.yog po tsi ṭa ka /zhabs 'bring snga 'jug bsgo bya ba/ /zhabs thog pa dang yongs su spyod/ /gzhan gsos dang ni btsal bu dang / /gzhan skyes pa dang gzhan gyis bskyangs/ /tha shal lto 'gengs le lo ba/ /ldar pa glan glen mi gsal ba/ /mkhas pa khram pa sgrin po dang / /gsal po grung 1po spyang po'o/ /gtum po skyal 2mkhan glang po dang / / nyin tshe chos med sdig can dang / /khri ra mthar gnas gtum po dang / /ngan thabs pa dang dbye ba ni/ /mon pa dang ni sha ba ri/ /shing shun pa dang kla klo skyes/ /gshed ma dang ni ri dgas gsod / /rngon pas 'tsho dang lings pa'o/ /khyi dang khyi mo sgrogs byed do/ /ri dgas za dang smra byed dang / /khyi ga la dang rngan thabs sbyor ba'o/ /rdos dang snyi thag ri dgas rgya/ /mi dge ba/ khyi mo dang ni shu byā'o/ /rkyag zan phag pa grong gnas so/ /brka ra ni dud 'gro gzhon/ /kun zas ri dgas pa dang ni/ /rngon pa ri dgas mthar byed mo/ /g.yas phyogs rmas pa lus tha yog/yan lag ngan pa/ chom po rkun pa rkun po dang / /srang ba chom rkun 'jab bu ba / /arba gzhan dngu rkun ma jag /rkun nor rkun rdzas choms dang ni/ /rkun rdzas gog nor de nags na/ /rgya dang snying dang / 'ching bya ri dgas bya rnams so/ /'brid zas ngan pa'i 'khrul 'khor ro/ /ri dgas 'dzin dang ri 110—638

dgas 'ching / /zhags pa sgril ma mo dang thag /gsum yin srad bu yin no/ /zo chu khyud dang bum pa'i 'khrul/ /chu 'bab dang ni chu yi 'khrul/ /skyes bu thag bzangs stag ma'o/ /sna lam srad bu tanta pa/ /thags 'thag byu ti mo dag 'dra/ /byug pa zhal ba la sogs las/ /gzugs 1brnyan dang ni 'bag yin te/ /dngos po so la sogs las byas/ /sgrom dang mdzod dang snod bang pa//de nas khur shing gnya' shing ngo / /de nas/ lham dang chags dang bcag lham mo / /mo/ zhabs stegs dang ni rkang btegs so/ /'breng thag 'byeng zhabs ko thag go/ /rta sogs lcag ni kā shā'o/ /gtum po rnams kyi pi wang ni//tsaṇḍa la dang bakhra kri/ /rā nā tsi dang zho cha'o/ /gser dpyod rdo ni ka ṣa'o/ /chan gri pa tra par shu/ /ri ṣi kā tyā li kā sa me/ /'od can lugs skong mu ṣā'o/ /sbud pa ko ba'i sbud pa dang / /gsor dang 'bigs byed ces bya'o/ /chan gre karta ri ni 'dra/ /shing za bzong dang shing 'bigs dang / /ṭi ka rdo ba'i bzong yin no/ /sog le mo min gcod byed do/ /ā ra ko ba 'bigs byed smyung / /lcags skam sbom po lcags gzugs so/ /bzong dang las dang cha la sogs/ /sku gzugs gzugs brnyan pra ti mā/ /ldeng so dang ni slar grib ma//slar byas 'dra dang po ni mtshungs/ /dpa' dang nye bar 'jal ba dang / /brjod bya'i rtags can mnyam dang mtshungs/ /de 'dra de mnyam de dang mtshungs//de yi gzhi 'dzin de 'dra'o/ /phyi tshi gnyer sbyor 'di rnams ni/ /'dra ba mnyam pa mtshungs pa dang / /lta bu dang ni dpe la sogs/ /las sla sgrub sla rngan pa dang / /bya dga' gla dang dge dang ni/ /khur gla —gla dang rin dang ni//yon dang rnyed pa 'ong / /chang dang gshol ldan mnyes pa dang / /hā la yongs 110—639

'bab chu bdag skyes/ /dri mchog rab dngas e rā dang / /ka dasbar yang yongs su thos/ /myos byed dga' byed marya chang / /a ba rda sha chang lpags so//chang tshang chang mal btung ba'i gnas/ /ma dhū bā ra sbrang gi chang / /me tog sbrang chang mā dha ba/ /mngar ldan sbrang gi cha ni gnyis/ /mi re ya dang me tog chang / /bur chang me da ka dang ni/ /sbyar chang mtshungs/ mandha nam ni chang g.yos so/ /phabs dang pho ni chang rtsi'o/ /nying khu bdud rtsi'i snying po dang / /chang ra chang 'thung 1gnas dang ni/ /chang skyogs mo min chang snod dang / /kham phor dang ni tshim byed do/ /cho long rgyan po sho dang ni/ /za rgyan rtsed rgyan mtshungs pa'o / /khas len dang ni gnya' ba'o/ /mgo 'thu ba dang cha 'dzin no/ /shing rtse mo min rgyab 'gyed dang / /ke ta ba dang pa ṇa zhes/ /pa ṇa a kṣa gla ha/ /sho dang cho long pā sha kā/ /yongs 'dren pa rkyang dang khye dang rdo/ /mo min rkang brgyad sho yi stan/ /srog chags sgugs dang sho rgyal po/ /rab tu mang po la sbyor phyir/ /gcig tu bshad pas 'dir gang spyor/ /de las chos gzhan la yang 'jug /rtags kyi mtha' las bsgrub par bya/ /dmangs rigs kyi sde tshan no// //'dir 'chi ba med pa'i seng ges sbyar ba'i ming dang rtags kyi rjes su bshad pa las sa gzhi'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// //khyad par can gyi dbang byed pa/ /spel ma dang ni sna tshogs don/ /mi zad rtags sogs bsdus rnams kyis/ /sde tshan phyi sde 'dren ma rnams/ /mo dang bud med la sogs kyis/ /khyad par can ni gang mthong bas/ /de yi skabs kyi tshogs kyis so/ /yon tan rdzas dang bya ba'i dgra/ /de bzhin de yi 110—640

dbye ba rnams/ /legs byas bsod nams nor dang ldan/ /blo che ba dang bsam yangs so/ /snying du sdug dang yid dga' 'o/ /spro ba che dang dga' ba che / /shes can go can mngon par mkhyen/ /rnam mkhyen nges ldan bslabs shes can/ /nges shes kha byang goms can dang / /dge bzhes kyang bya ba'o/ /mchod pa dang ni rab tu sbyin/ /the tshom yid gnyis ma nges pa/ /yon gnas dang ni mchod pa'i 'os/ /de la sbyin pa'i 'os zhes bya/ /gtong phod dang ni dpal stug dang / /byin rlabs can dang rab tu ster/ /yun ring 'tsho dang tshe ldan no/ /shes nyen can dang stan bcos rigs/ /yongs su rtog dang rgyu mtshan can/ /mchod sbyin dang ni rab tu sbyin/ /yid dga' mgu dang yid rab bde/ /sems dga' 'o/ /yid ngan sems ngan mi dga' ba/ /blo chud zos dang sems myos pa/ /g.yo med drang dang sgyu med pa/ /pu ka khā dang sbyin dang ster/ /de yi pha rol chags dang zhen/ /don 'dod 'dun dang brtson 'grus dang / /shes ldan rgya cher grags pa can/ /rigs ldan rnam shes rnam par thos/ /yon tan nor ldan/ /rang bzhin byas dang mtshan nyid can/ /nor ldan 'byor ldan yon tan can/ /bdag po dbang phyug pa ti dang / /pyug po dpon po gtso bo dang / /dpon mgo mgo 'dren rje bo dang / /lhag par 'phel dang chen por skyes/ /nyug rum nyams pa 'og med dang / /khyi khol srung ma skyes bu'o/ /yan lag mchog ldan gzugs ldan ma/ /mdzes ldan dang ni bud med do/ /nges byed bya ba byed pa dang / /gzhungs byed 'grus par byed pa'o/ /smra mi byed dang lkugs pa'o yid la bcags dang pha lta bu/ /dga' bas brgyan lkubyas bu mo dang / /'ga' zhig sbyin byed 'phags pa'i gnas//110—641

dpal ldan phun tshogs bkra shis dpal/ /mnyes gshin pa dang mthong tshor dang / /brtse ba thugs rje snying rje dang / /dga' bar byed pa mtshungs pa'o/ /rang rgyud rang dbang bdag dbang dang / /rang dbang gzhan kyis ma bzung ba/ /gzhan rgyud gzhan dbang pha rol dbang / /rang dbang med dag bdag dbang min / /gzhan dbang dbang med 'dzin pa can/ /phyags ma dang ni mang pos byed/ /shin tu thogs dang yun ring byed/ /'dres mar spyod dang ci grub byed / /dman dang ngan dang byed 'khos chung / /las nus las shogs che ba dang / /byed mkhas las pa'i ngang tshul dang / /kasthā shi lo yaḥrtalas dpa' ba dang / /mgo thon byed gsos po las byed/ /las mi de yi byed pa can/ /skyes khrus dang ni shing khrus so/ /kums dang sha yi zas dang ni/ /ltogs dang bkres dang bru ba tshwa/ /zas 'dod gzhan zas pha rol zas/ /lto che drod chen dang kha bde/ /snyems las sgyid sgyur dang ni 'jas po gnyis ni/ /bdag 'gengs rang drod 'gengs/ /bdag drod 'gengs pa'o/ /kun za kun gyis 'tsho ba'o/ /'dod can rngo can zhen can dang / /mngon 'dod dang ni sred can dang / /'dra ba 'dod chen yang yang 'dod/ /myos pa dang nir ro ba/ /ma dul ba dang ma zhi ba/ /rgyags pa rgod pa g.yo ldan rengs/ /chags pa 'dod can sred pa can/ /rnge can 'dod ldan sred ldan dang / /mngon 'dod can sgrub can dul 'dzin/ /tshigs rtan/ ā shra ba/ dbang dang rang dgar byed pa'o/ /zhi ba dul ba mnyen pa mtshungs/ /spyi brtol sbobs can dpral sgo can/ /'tsher ba med dang skyengs pa med/ /'dzem med dang ni gdong ngas med/ /'tshar 4can dang ni ngo mtshar can/ /mi brtan srab pa ga 110—642

tsha' / /'jigs can 'jigs rung ma rungs pa/ /brnab sems yid 'dod//khyim chags khyim zhen can/ /dang can ngad chags can/ /ltung 'dod dang ni babs 'dod do/ /phyag byed mngon par smra/ /gsod dang 'joms 'dod rnam par 'tshe/ /'phel 'dod dang ni mun skyes so/ /'phur 'dod dang ni steng 'gro 'dod/ /rgyan 1'dod dang ni rgyan cha 'dod/ /'gyur 'dod yin 'dod / /'khor 'dod 'jug 'dod 'dra ba'o/ /kha 'gog pa dang nye bar mchu 'dod/ /ngag 'dod 'jam dang ni tshig 'jam pa/ /shes ldan rnam dpyod theg le dang / /rnam par rgyas dang rnam par gsal/ /brkyang ba bdal ba rab tu brkyang / /rnam par brkyang / /ma nag nus sron nus bzod pa dang / /rkyen thub tshugs thub bzod pa'o/ /gtum po shin tu khro ba'o/ /gnyid med dang ni gnyid chag go/ /gnyid yur ba dang rab tu 'thibs/ /gnyid 'dod gnyid 'dod gnyid log 'dod/ /'bab 'dod dang ni nyal 'dod mtshungs/ /pha rol kha phyogs gzhan du phyogs/ /'og tu phyogs dang kha bub dang / /lhar 'gro lha la phyogs pa'o/ /sna tshogs 'gro ba kun du 'gro/ /gang zhig lhan cig dus gcig go/ /dud 'gro dang ni 'phred la 'gro/ /smra ba brjod pa zlos pa'o/ /ngag dbang ngag gi bdag po mtshungs/ /gsung ldan gsal po smra mkhas so/ /gtam dang lo rgyus lab bzangs dang / /smra bzangs smra mang gtam mang po/ /kha ngan tshig ngan kha 'chings so/ /nus dang dga' bar smra byed pa/ /ma dag pa dang gtam mi gsal/ /'dra ba kha ngan smras so/ /'bras bu mi gsal gtam mi gsal/ /skad dang sgra/ bstod smra bsngags pa brjod pa mtshungs/ /dig pa lkugs pa glen pa dang / /ma thos pa dang ma bslabs pa/ /mi smra ba 110byed643

dang kha rog pa/ /gcer bu gos med phyogs kyi gos/ /smra ba ngan dang mi gsal ba/ /bton pa dang ni phyung ba'o/ /smod pa dang ni ngan smras so/ /kha rgyal ba dang shags rgyal ba/ /lag yangs dang ni ster 'dod tsho'adra/ /tshig steg dang ni slar smra ba/ /'ching byed phur bu 'gog byed do/ /don med pa dang stong pa thob/ /nyam nga ba dang bag tsha ba/ / byi ba shor sun 'byin kṣu ri ta/ /g.yo ba dang ni sems mi gnas/ /mnar dang gzhan gyis 'tshir ba gnyis / /lag stong dang ni g.yo ba 'dra/ /bag tsha ba dang 'khyor ba'o/ /'chi ltas sun 'byin blo gros can/ /lcag gis bzhus dang 'brab par byed/ /chag bzhus rta yis bsad bya dang / /zhe sdang ni 'khrugs pa'o/ /bsad bya mgo gcod 'di gnyis mtshungs/ /dug ster dug gis bsad bya ba/ /gtun shing gtun gyis brdung ba dang / /sdig spyod dang ni nag po'i las/ /so mi gsod dang rnam g.yeng 'dra/ /skyon 'dzin pha rol nyes pa rtog /sgyu can dang ni g.yo can kyog /rna bar zlos dang phra ma dang / /phra ma dbyes dang bcugs mkhan zhes/ /rnam 'tshe 'joms byed 'tshe ba snyig /ma rungs pa dang ma sbrungs pa/ /mi shes rmongs pa glen pa dang / /'doms pa mi rig mi mtshon pa//'chums pa cha phra ser sna can/ /zhib mo 'dzangs pa srin chos pa/ /nor med bsgrub 5ngan bkren po dang / /dbul po ngan 'gro phongs pa'o/ /slong mo sprang bo lam pa dang / mul po dang ni don 'dod pa/ /nga rgyal can dang haṃ yung ngo //dge ldan dang kau bsod nams can/ /mtho ris skyes dang lha rnams so/ /mi dang phyugs sogs mngal nas skyes/ /drong gsher sha sbrang srin bu sogs/ /bya dang sbrul sogs sgong skyes rnams/ /shing dang sngo sogs sa gzhi skyes/ /sas 110—644

bskrun sas bskyed sa las 'khrungs/ /shin tu mdzes lkudang sdug pa dang / /mdzes dang sdug dang legs pa dang / /bzang po dang ni brjid can dang / /yid 'ong snying sdug mtshar ba dang / /yid 'phrog 'jam dang mdzes pa'o de ni shin tu mdzes pa ste/ /gang gis ltabs chog mi shes/ /mdza' bo snying sdug yid mthun dang / /yid bcugs sdebag phebs mdza' ba'o/ /rigs dman ngan rigs mtshon cha ba/ /mthar gnas sdig can gshed ma dang / /ngan pa tha shal bsham pa dang / /g.yung po dang ni rigs ngan mtshungs/ /dri can mdog nag nyams dang byus/ /gtsang dag dri ma med pa'o/ /ye dag rang bzhin dri med don/ /bkrus dang sbyangs dang bsangs pa dang / /dag byas dri ma med par byas/ /snying po med dang du 'bras stong dang / /stong pa gsog gsob ya ma brla/ /ma ning gtso bo dang po'i sgo/ /dpon dang gong ma mchog dang ni/ /gdong dang mchog dang rab che shos/ /chen po phul byung rtse/dang po rab mchog gong ma dang / /phul byung gya nom shin tu mchog /bla na med dang shin tu mdzes/ /phyis kyi tshig can stag dang ni/ /skyes bu khyu mchog glang chen dang / /seng ge sā rtul dang ni/ /glang chen la sogs skyes bu ni/ /gtso bo'i don gyi spyod yul lo/ /gong ma ma yin dman pa gnyis/ /'og ma dang ni ma rabs so/ /rgya chen yangs dang chen po dang / /rna chen rabs che ma hā ste/ /chen po/ rgyas dang mthug dang sbom dang che/ /chung ba nyung ba cung zad dang / /phra mo bag tsam nyung shas chung / /mo ni cung zad nyung ba dang / /skyes bu phra mo chung ba zegs ma chung / /rab mang mang po dpag tu med/ /tshan can ba hu lo ba snu/ /gang pa khengs pa mang po dang / /bstan pa mang po byung 110—645

ba'o / /brgya la sogs pa'i pha rol gyi/ /pha rol grangs kyi lhag pas brgya/ /bgrang bya gang zhig ga ṇa yi/ /grangs kyi ga ṇi tai de nas/ /'dra ba thams cad pa / /sna tshogs ma lus zad par dang / /mtha' dag kun dang ril po dang / /rangs pa yo gam lus pa/ /sdogs pa cag gi gang ba dang / /dus min pa dang khengs pa'o/ /stug po bar med phung pa'o/ /thor re ba dang col le ba/ /nye logs 1'khor drung na mo/ /glo dang tho 'khor 'dra ba'o/ /phyogs mthun mnyam byed mtshungs par spyod/ /byed bcas mgrin mnyam/ /mtha' gcig pa dang 'jug gcig pa/ /mi bzad pa dang a bya yo/ /yang dag chags dang 'byar ba dang / /shin tu 'thams pa zhes yang ngo / /phyogs 'dra phyogs mtshungs ring dang 'gyangs/ /shin tu ring 'gyangs ches ring dang / /ring po dang ni rgya che ba/ /zlum po ril po zur med sgong / /mtho dang mthon po ring mo dang / /ring dang rtse mo bsgreng dang mtho/ /de nas thung ba dma' ba dang / /mi mtho thung thung 'phang dma' ba/ /rtse min dma' dang thung ba'o/ /yon po kyog po bcu bo dang / /mi 'drang 'chus dang sgur ba dang / /kyog pa kyog kyog dge sgu can/ /mi drang ba dang kyog po'i ming / /drang po thad ka srong sa pa'o/ /'dres ma 'chol pa phyogs gcig min/ /rtag tu kun tu rgyun du dang / /gtan du dang ni chags med pa/ /brtan po mi 'gyur rang bzhin gnas/ /gzugs gcig dus khyab mi 'gyur ba/ /gnas gzhan spyod pa gzhan spyod 'dod//bya spyod byed pa spyod/ /bya byed dang ni bya spyod do/ /g.yo dang ldeg pa 'gul ba'o / /bskyod pa 'khrosas pa yam yom dang / /ldag ldeg shag shig sag sig dang / /yongs su 'gul pa zhes pa'o/ /stong pa dang ni ting 'dzin no/ /110—646

brtan po dang ni mi 'gyur ba/ /sram khregs mi shigs ka tho ram̐/ /mi 'jig mi pheng sran dang ni/ /gong bu dang ni gor ma'o/ /'phel ba rgan po chen po dang / /rnying pa sngon skyes dang po pa/ /rnying ma dang ni yun ring ma/ /gsar ma so ma thog ma dang / /yag ma gzhon nu gsar pa'o/ /rab gzhon shin tu gzhon pa dang / /'jam pa dang ni mnyen dang 'bol/ /rjes 'gro phyi 'breng rjes 'jug dang / /rting 'brang ma ning mi zad pa/ /mngon sum dang ni dbang po'i yul/ /lkog tu gyur dang mngon sum min/ /gcig snga gcig sngon gcig rtse dang / /gcig song gcig mtho gcig dang po/ /gcig rtse sngon du gcig song ba/ /skyes bu la sogs dang po dang / /thog ma dang ngo/ la sogs pa/ /de nas mo dang tha ma dang / /phyi ma rting ma rjes ma dang / /gsham ma dang ni 'phyi shos so//don med pa dang don stong dang / /gsal dang rab gsal dri ma med/ /gzhi 'dzin dang ni spyi yin no/ /re re rkyang rkyang gcig pu'o/ /tha dang don dang gzhan dang ni/ /gcig gnas gzhan pa so so ba/ /tshig mang gcig dbye ming pa dang / / miṇḍa mi 'chang rtab lugs dang tshul la reg pa dang / /'gog med pa dang mi 'gog pa/ /ldog pa dang ni phyir log pa/ /go bzlog dang ni phyin ci log /lus kyi g.yon nis bye ngo / /a bas bye g.yas phyogs so/ /shing rta dang ni saṃ bā dha/ /'dres pa 'chol ba 'dra ba'o/ /bsres pa 'khrugs pa 'dres pa'o/ /skra bregs pa dang bzhar ba'o/ /mnyes dang gsubs dang 'phur ba'o/ /rnam 'bab 'gro dang 'gyur ba'o/ /bar du song dang brjed pa dang / /thob pa rnyed pa mtshungs pa'o/ /ldeg pa 'khyor ba 'gul ba dang / /g.yog ldeg pa dang 'dar ba'o/ /'phul ba 'dod pa bskul ba dang / /bskyod 110—647

pa 'phul ba 'phen pa mtshungs/ /yongs su 'phangs dang 1ldog pa'o/ /brkus pa dang ni brkus pa'i don/ /'phel dang rab tu skye ba dang / /mi 'bab pa dang mi ltung ba/ /rdeg pa dang ni bsnun pa'o/ /smin pa tshos pa yib dang gab//g.yog pa dang ni byibs pa'o/ /zhu ba zhun ma/ byungs pa dang ni phyar ba'o/ /bsgo ba dang ni slob pa'o/ /snom dang bsnams pa myug dang len/ /khrom pa'i chu dang chu dong 'dra/ /bcings pa bsdams pa bsris pa dang / /'gog pa dang ni bcings nga/'o/ /chags pa dang ni zhig pa'o/ /de nas mtshan mo spru rsha tā snang med do/ /rnam par nyams sgo tshos pa dang / /khrel dang ngo tsha 'dzem mdog dang / /'khor ba 'jug pa 'khyel ba'o/ /yang dag 'byor pa sdeb pa dang / /thob bya 'gro bya bsdu ba sogs/ /'gro ba 'bab pa 'gyu dang 'jug /bsdoms nas brjod dang bsdu yig go/ /ngan pa dang ni dman par grags/ /rnam sgrub mang byed sna tshogs so/ /so sor sgrub/ de nas smod dang spyon brjod do / /bcom pa dang ni phye mar byas/ /gsher dang zlon/ /sgra byas/ sgrog byas 'dra ba'o/ /'ching ba 'khyig pa sdom dang mdogs/ /brtod pa dang ni dkris pa'o / /skol ba dang ni bsdu ba'o/ /smin nga/ 'o mar 'o thug tshos/ /myang 'das thub pa'i me la sogs/ /rlung med dang ni rlung mi 'jug /tshos pa yongs smin thul ba'o/ /gshang ba gcib bcag byas pa/ /rgyas pa dang ni gang ba'o / /bus nus pa ni bzod pa'o/ /rgyas btab pa dang ab btab pa/ /nyon mongs bzod pa dul bya ste/ /zhib dang ni dul ba'o/ /slong ba dang ni zhu ba'o / /bsgo ba dang ni slob pa'o/ /g.yogs pa dang ni phug pa'o/ /mchod pa dang ni phul ba'o/ /gang ba dang ni rdzogs pa'o/ /nyon mongs dang ni 110—648

sems srug go/ /zin la khad pa/ bsregs dang tshig ma tshig ma'o/ /gzhogs dang bzhur dang chung ngur byas/ /phug 1dang brdol dang bug pa byas/ /rnam dpyad brtags dpyad rnam par phye/ /mdangs med bkrag med mdog ngan no / /stug po mthug po dru ta'o/ /grub pa zin pa rdzogs pa'o/ /gses pa phye ba dbyes 2pa'o/ /dog pa snal ma ran pa gnas/ /thags kyi rgyu rnams brkyang ba'o/ /mchod pa bkur sti rim gro dang / /bsnyen bkur dang ni ri mor byas/ /zhabs thog zhabs 'bring bkur ba'o/ /rab tu tsha dang gdung ba dang / /sems can sdug bsngal tsha ba dang / /yid dga' sems dga' tshim dang rangs/ /rab tu dga' dang mnyes nga/'o/ /bcad pa btubs pa bregs pa dang / /bkas pa phye ba bral ba dang / /'thub pa dang ni gcod pa'o/ /bcom pa zhig pa nyams pa dang / /brlag pa chus zos zags dang nyams/ /thob pa rnyed pa phrad pa dang / /dngos rnyed thob pa rnyed pa'o/ /tshol ba rjes/ tshol lta ba dang / /lam rtog pa dang nyul/ ba'o/ /sge'u gsher zlon brlan can dang / /bangs po thag can sge gsher rlon/ /skyabs dang skyob pa bsrung ba dang / /sped pa sgrib pa sbas pa'o/ /brnyas pa rngan can tsho khyod dang / /khog chung dang ni yongs gcod do/ /btang ba bor ba spangs pa dang / /'phangs 5pa bsgur ba dor ba'o/ /smra ba brjod pa zlos pa gtam/ /grags pa lo rgyus bka' mchid do6/ /go dang rtogs dang khong du chud/ /rig dang shes dang kun chub po/ /khas blangs dam bcas byed par byas/ /khas 'che chad byas zhal gyis bzhes/ /khas blangs blangs pa'i ming ngo / /snyan pa bsngags pa legs par brjod/ /bstod pa brjod pa sgogs pa dang / /ngag snyan tshig snyan 110—649

bsngags pa dang / /legs brjod grags brjod yon tan brjod/ /zos pa 'chos pa myangs pa dang / /ldad pa mid pa gsol dang zas/ /zos pa'i ming ngo / /shin tu g.yo dang shin tu phra/ /shin tu mchog tu rgya che yangs/ /myur phra mngon 'dod rgya che rgyas/ /mang po shin tu mthar thug don/ /sgrub pa phul phyin byed phul byin/ /mang ba'i phul phyin phyi ba'i phul du phyin/ / thun pa'i 1phul phyin tshogs pa'i phul du phyin/ /sgrub khyab mang lci thung ba dang / /tshogs pa rnams ni phul phyin no/ /bye brag pa gzhan dbang gi sde tshan no// //rang bzhin rkyen la sogs don kyis/ /'dres pa'i rtags rnams shes par bya / /las dang bya ba de dag tu/ /'gro ba'i phan tshun min pa rnams/ /tshogs pa zla yi tshig la ni/ /pha rol 'gro dang pha rol brten pa'o/ /dbang du byed dang rang dbang byed/ /rgyu stong gnas dang mtshan nyid bral/ /zhi dang dul dang des pa'o/ /bzod dang nus dang thub pa'o/ /rtogs brjod sngar kyi las 'jug go/ /'dod pa sbyin pa rab mchog go/ /dbang byed dbang du sdud pa dang / /rtsa ba'i las dang las su bya/ /g.yo ba dang ni 'dar bar byed/ /ngoms pa dang ni tshim pa'o/ /chog pa yongs srung lag pa 'gebs/ /'tshem pa tshim bu spyor ba dang / /'gra ba gcod pa gtub pa'o/ /khro ba dang ni mngon par khro/ /tshor ba myong ba nyams su myong / /brgyal dang mngon par khyab pa dang / /slong ba bsod snyoms 'dod don slong / /gcod pa dang ni bse ba'o/de nas gnyis po dri smad dang / /khams bde 'dri ba/ de nas man ngag sdoms pa'o/ /zad pa dang ni sdogs pa'o/ /len pa dang ni blangs pa'o/ /110—650

mdangs can dang ni 'tsher ba'o/ /srung ba dang ni skyob pa'o/ /sgu dang mi gsal sgra'o/ /'bugs pa 'bigs pa tshos pa smin/ /'bod pa dang ni sngon pa'o / /mchog rab bsregs dang tshig /'dun ma gros dang rgos 1'khogs pa/ /nor 'khrul rgyas dang 'phel ba'o/ /rab tu grags dang grags pa'o/ /reg pa dang ni 'byar ba'o/ /'bab pa ltung ba/ 'phel ba dang ni yang dag 'phel/ /'phro dang spro ba tshad ma tshad/ /rab skye 2'byung dang ltung dang ltung / /ngal ba dang ni dub pa'o/ /shin tu ba dang phul du phyin/ /'byar ba dang ni 'khyud pa'o / /yul 'dren/ 'phen pa dang ni 'phul ba'o/ /ri dang ri bo rnam 'tshe gnod/ /'degs pa bstod pa reg dren no/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba brjod pa dbyangs / /rgyags pa khengs pa/ gyen du bskyod pa steng du bskyod/ /rnam par nye dang yongs su nyed/ /mngon par bskyed dang rjes su 'dzin/ /mi 'dzin de dang 'gal ba'o/ /mngon par spyor dang mngon par 'dzin/ /khur tshur bcings dang yang dag bzung / /chom po jag pa srang ba'o/ /'brel pa skyes dang spyod pa'o/ /nad pa reg bya rlung nad/ /gnod byed nyes pa byed pa'o//dgongs pa don len/ /spyod lam bzhi snod bskor ba'i rim/ /mngon par bsdus dang mngon par len/ /bsdu ba ni mngon par len/ /rjes su bgyid dang rjes su sgrub/ /de nas song zin mi zad pa/ /'jug pa dang ni rab tu 'bab / /'byung dang 'jug dang 'gyu ba'o/ /mtshe ma zung dang phrugs ma dang / /don dang gnyis zung rnam 'tshe'i las dang mngon spyod do/ /gnyid med gnyid chag gnyis yin no/ /bgegs dang bar chod grub pa'i gegs/ /'byung bo nyer 'dus mchod cing 'dug /nges par 'jug dang nye bar spyod/ /110—651

rjes su byed dang yongs su byed/ /lhan cig mi gnas spangs te 'gal/ /dgongs can 'dun pa nges don min/ /mdor bsdus pa dang bsdu ba'o/ /mi mthun pa dang 'gal ba'o/ /yongs su brkyang dang brkyang ba'o/ /'gro 'jug bstan gnas/ /rgya che yangs pa cher yangs so/ /de yang sgra yi bster/ /byug pa dang ni bsku byug go/ /nyams pa dang ni mthong ba med/ /shes pa dang ni yongs su 'dris/ /khyed pa dang ni rnam par khyed/ /nges tshig dang ni rab tu nges/ /nye 'khor nye logs dag dang ni/ /rnga ba 'breg pa 'bal ba'o /nges 'byed 'phyar dang 'khrab pa'o/ /gnas skabs dang ni skabs yin no/ /thags spun dkri sdong snal ma dkro/ /she sbyor 'khrig pa tshogs pa sdom pa 'dra/ /blo nus dang ni chu srol lo/ /mo min zam pa bgrod dka' zam/ /khrug phyir 'jug dang rab sbyor don/ /rtsom pa dang ni mgo 'ju ba/ /'ju ba rtsom pa ā re bha/ /tam tam tur tur/ /bar chad dang ni gegs zhes so/ /'og min 'og tu lta ba'o/ /sngon shes slar yang 'phel ba'o/ /sku byug dang ni byug pa'o/ /rjes chags dang ni sbyar ba'o/ /sbyin ster rnam grangs rab tu grags/ /mel tshe ba dang so pa'o/ /nges klog nges brjod 'don pa'o/ /bangs dang gsher dang rlon pa'o/ /kun nas dman dang zag nyon mongs/ /'tshogs pa 'dus pa 'phongs 1pa'o/ /lta ba tshol ba nyung —ba 'tshol lta'o/ /yongs 'khyud yongs 'byar yang dag reg /nye bar 'dzin nye bar lta rtog pa gzigs pa dang / /snang bar byed dang lta ba'o/ /phyir rgol zlog pa 'gog pa dang / /'geg pa rnam grangs ming gzhan ming rim don/ /sgyug bro btsog pa skyug bro don/ /zlog pa phyir zlog rnam zlog log /'gongs pa 'chongs pa rgal dang 'phar/ /pre 110—652

ṣa ṇa ni gang bos nas/ /de la slar yang bsgo ba'o/ /mchod sbyin mchod pa/bstod pa'i sa gzhi gnyis skyes rnams/ /shing stan shing stegs gang la/ /shing stan shing ni ugha na/ /stasbo gang gis snying 'bigs gsum/ /kun brtol 1mtho ba gang gi sa de la/ /bin dha ka sa me ni ghaḥ/ /byur po phung po/ so ba steng du 'dren pa'i don/ /sgyegs pa gyen zlog gsus pa sgyegs pa la sogs pa/ /nyer 'gro bar ti bir ta ya/ /um rā me / mo min glo lu lud pa lu/ /glo 'khogs lud lud pa 'bod/ /'khogs pa zhes pa tha dad yin—/ /sgyug pa skyu ba sā ti rig byed do/ /de nas rims dang tshad pa dang / /u da dza ni phyugs bsgul ba/ /bya min zhes sogs smod mo'o/ /rgyud mthar de yi tshogs pa/ /au pa ga ba la sogs so/ /bems po sems meed rig med dang / /de bzhin sems med la sogs pa/ /byis pa dang ni bu tsha'o/ /lhan cig 'gro dang dus gcig 'gro/ /gsho'/ tshogs/ bram ze smra ba gnyi'/ skyes/ /gnyis po rtsi ba logs rnams kyis/ /rgyab rnams kyis pādhwa dṛdzre go rim bzhin/ /g.yul sag yul thang g.yul kha'o/ /de nas mi tshoms mi rnams kyis/ /grong tshoms skye tshoms du ba mnam/ /zhag 5tshogs gadhyā so so'o/ /stong tshogs dang ni lci me tshogs / /go tshogs rig byed la sogs pa/ /'dres ma'i sde tshan no/ /sna tshogs don la ka mtha' sogs/ /sde mtshan gyis ni 'dir grags so/ /mang po la sbyor gang gang la/ /rnam grangs gang la de dang de/ /nā ka nam mkha' skabs gsum la/ /lo ka sa gzhi skye bo la/ /rkang bcad grags pa shlauka /mda' dang ral gri sha ya ka /ce spyang / chu bdag dag 6la dza mū kau/ /rna 710—653

nyag /byis pa dag la pri thu kau/ /mthong 'od dag la ā lo go3/ /rnga chen rnga ris mā na ko2/ /phang brtags dag e ka'o/ /rtags dang ngan sgra ka lo kau/ /klu shing 'jog po takṣa ka /shel dang nyi mar arka'o/ /rlung dang tshangs pa nyi ma ka /rlung dang rig byed pa dang nyi ma ka /pho'i rtags so/ /ki ni mgo dang chu la yin/ /phu —la ka ni spun stong dang / /nya dang zan changs rnams la'o / /'ug pa glang chen mjug mi rtsa/ /glang po che'i/ /rtse mo rnams la pe tsa ka /spyi lugs ser ba ka ra ka /bder gshegs log 'dren nā ya ka /ki dku khru dang mtho la'o/ /shu ka srin bu tshang tshing ngo / /mi mthun phyogs ni pra tī ka /gsum yin phyogs gcig po 5'di yin/ /khyu tī rka ni ti ka ta dang / /rām ka pur li gdur/ /zla ba'i 'od zer dag dang ni/ /ga bu sgra gcan ko shā skya / /de nas kaṭa/ pal seng ldeng dkar po/ /zla ba'i shun pa po 7ma yin/ /de nas/ /sil 'ba' cha dang pirgyu ka /bā dhīshaṃ ni shing kun kyang / /mchod pa gu gul sbrul 'dzin rnams/ /kau shi ka'o/ /nad tsha brtag pa a taṅga / /nyung chung kyu lla ka gsum mo/ /yun ring 'tsho ba ri bo mtshan/ /rta rmig zlum po bar ta ga /gzig dang padma dkar po pho/ /som bal ka de nas ni/ /sman pa mi ni yang 'od can/ /shā khā bri ka spre'u dang / /lce spyang dang ni khyi yin no/ /gser la yang ngos dmar dang / /'jir ba'i don yang rgyal sdung yin/ /a lī ka ni mi 'dza' brdzun/ /rang bzhin rjes su 'gro ba'o/ /gnyis/ shal ke mtha' dag shing shun pa/ /gser srang brgya rtsa brgyad dang ni/ /gser dang brang gi rgyan dang srang / /tha snyad la yang ṇi ṣa ko'o/ /mo min/ kalka mo min dri ma dang / /sdig sems khengs pa rnams yang ngo / /de nas pi nā ko/ mo 110—654

min mdung dang bde byed gzhu/ /ba bzhon glang mo dhe nu ka yang ngo / /char sgrin u ma kṣa li kā/ /zug rngu rab tu byed pa mdo 'grel pa/ /kaṇi ka ni sna rgyan dang / /glang mo lag pa sor gdub dang / /padma'i sa bon ze 'bru'o/ /gsum pa phyi ma tshogs gzugs bzangs/ /gcig gtso gzhon dang ma 'dres pa/ /kauklu ṭi ka tshul 'chos dang / /gang zhig nye bar ma mthong ba la'ang / /la khā ṭi ka gtso sems mthong / /'ga' zhig mi nus pa la yang / /mar me srin 'bar ma yu kha/ /bung ba mnga' dug shi lī mu kho/ /shang kha gter dpral rus dung la/ /mo min/ khyo ni dbang po la yang ngo / /'od zer 'bar ba'ang shi khe'o / /ri shing 'gro med a go'o/ /ā shu go ni rlung dang mnga'/ /mnga' nyi 'dab kha gā'o1/ /ba tai go ni bya nyi ma/ /pū ka go yu tshogs pa dag /phyugs dang ri dgas mri ga'o/ /beeg len dang rgyug pa la'ang / /pā ra ga ni me tog ze/ /khrus chal dang ni rdul la yang / /glang chen gtum po nā ga'o/ /mig zur dpral thig a paṃ ga /sarga rang bzhin nges grol dang / /nges pa le'u byas rnams la/ /yo ga go gyon pa dang thabs/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba rigs rnams la/ /bho ga bde dang bud med sogs/ /longs spyod sbrul gdengs lug ngag la/ /khug rta ri dgas skyes bu dang / /khra bo rnams la shā raṅga / /gsum/ spre'u sbal pa mtshong 'gro'o/ /a dzha ṣe ga mna' dang smos shing rta'i lus sogs yu ga'o/ /pho yu go rdzogs ldan dus la sogs/ /mtho ris phyugs dang ngag dang ni/ /rdo rje phyogs dang mig dang ni/ /'od zer sa dang phyugs rnams la/ /mtshan nyid lta zhing pho mo go/ /liṅga rtags dang she pa yo—/ /thi ga gtso bo rtse mo'o/ /mgo dang gsang gnas pa ram̐ shaṃ/ /bha gi 110—655

dpal dang 'dod pa dang / /bdag nyid che dang brtson 'grus dang / /'dun pa nyi ma grags rnams la/ /pa righa ni yongs 'joms mtshon/ /e tshogs pa dang chu yi rgyun/ /rin dang mchod byed argha'o/ /a rghaṃ sdig sdug nyon mongs la//gsum / /'dod dang nyung la la ghu'o/ /kā tsā dra ba'i thag pa dang / /'phying bu dang ni ling thog go/ /phyir log rgya chen pra pañtsa/ /shu tsi me dang zla ba dang / /shin tu gnon pa dag dang ni/ /skyes bu rnam dag dkar po gsum//mngon 'khyung 'dod pa 'ong ru tsi/ /mo ltos 'gro za rma bya khyung / /so dang bram ze sgong gnyis skyes/ /a dzā khyab 'jug dbang phyug ra/ /'brog lhas lam dang tshogs pra dzā/ /chos rgyal rgyal ba gshin rje'o/ /kuñtsa so dang phug pa'o/ /mo min / ba la dzi ni zhing grong khyer/ /la la dzā ni legs par mthong sa mnyam g.yul gyi a dzi'o/ /pra dzā bu rgyud skye dgu'o/ /a badzo dang ri bong 'dzin / /bdag ngo/ rtag la ni dzee gsum/ /skyes bu bdag dang legs rtogs pa / /kṣe ta snyom brjod bya'i rtags/ /lo dzñā 'du shes ming dang ni/ /lag sogs don byed brda la'o/ /nya'i mtha' can/ bya rog glang 'gram ka ra ṭa/ /glang chen 'gram dang ṅkad ka ṭo/ /shi bi piṣṭa nyams pa dang / /lpags pa ngan dang dbang phyug che/ /lha yi bzo ni twaṣṭa 'o/ /diṣṭi lha gnyis 'dus la'o/ /ro bro ku ṭu ka ṭu ni/ /don med gsum mo ser sna rno/ /riṣṭi bde dang mi dge dngos / /e riṣṭi ni dge mi dge/ /sgyu ma mi g.yo 'khrul 'khor dang / /khengs pa bden log phung po dang / /lcags tho ris dang rtse mo dang / /thong gshol rnams la ku ṭa'o/ /mo min tru ṭi sug smel dus dang ni/ /nyung du the tshom rnams la'o/ /rab dka' 1rten pa ko ṭi'o/ /rtsa ba dus spyor dzā ṭā'o/ /110—656

byuji lku'abras bu phun tshogs la/ /dṛṣṭi mkhyen pa mig dang mthung sne/ /iji mchod sbyin 'dod pa'o/ /thraṣṭi 4nges dang mang po gsum/ /keṣṭi sdug bsngal bskyod dka' 'o/ /mkhas dang mi dman nad med la/ /pa ṭu gnyis te brjod bya'i rtags/ /nī la kaste rma bya zhing / /pho kakhye rgyu ma gsus pa dang / /'bru dong khang pa'i 5nas de bzhin/ /nibye byas zin chud zos mtha'/ /kāṣṭha 6 dga' gnas phyogs la'o/ /byeṣṭha rgan dang phul byung la/ /ka nidzre ni chung dang nyung / /daṇḍa khral dang dbyug pa'o/ /gu ḍa rdog pos bud shing bcos/ /bya 7 ḍo sbrul dang sha zan phyugs/ /i ḍa sa phyugs ngag zla bu/ /kṣe ḍa smyug skas spa yi skas/ /nā ḍi dus dang skad cig drug /kāṇḍa dbyug pa mda' dang ni/ /ngan dang sde tshan gnas skabs chu/ /khyu ṇa byis dang ngan gsher can/ /bā ṇa stabs ldan bu dang mda'/ /ka ṇa shin tu phra po brogs/ /tshogs dang 'joms byed ga ṇa'o/ /pa ṇa shi sogs rgyal byas bla/ /rin dang nor la yang de'o/ /yon tan dang ni dngos skyes dang / /rten dang snying stobs dkar po dang / /mtshams la sogs pa gu ṇa'o/ /byar med gnas dang dus bya brag /spro ba dag la kṣa na'o/ /barṇa gnyis skyes la sogs dang / /dkar po la sogs kha dog bstod/ /brte yi ge la yang ngo / /gā ma ṭī ni bre mkhan dang / /skyes gsum mchog bdag rnams la'o/ /urṇa lug sogs bal dang ni/ /smin pa'i mtshams kyi 'khyil pa la/ /ha ri bhā ni ri dgas mo/ /gser gyi gzugs brnyan ser po la'ang / /gsum pa skya bo ha ri ṇa / /lcags dang khyim gyi ka pa la / /trisgo 'dod pa skom pa la/ /smod pa snying rje ghri ṇi'o/ /tshong 'dus lam ni bi pa ṇi/ /chang dang nub phyogs bā ru ddhā/ /ke spyore rku ni glang mo glang / /110—657

dra bi rṇa ni khrims dang skyabs/ /shrī pa rṇa ni padma bum/ /dug g.yul beegs rno tī kṣ-i1/ /ma ning kha ri 2gsum/ pra mā ṇi ni rgyu mtshan dang / /yul lugs bstan bcos 'debs tshad tshad/ /kar ṇi ni sgrub nus dang / /zhing dang lus dbang rnams la yang / /srog chags skye ba saṃ pa ra ṇa/ /dpung tshogs rgyu dang grong khyer rtswa/ /sa mu dhe ra ṇa 'don dang 'khyer/ /'di nas gsum ste bi ṣā khaṃ/ /phyugs kyi rwa dang tsum pa la/ /pra ba ṇa ni mi mnyam dang //dga' dang bzhi mdo rnams la'o/ /saṃ tī rṇa ni dag ma dag /bī ri khaṃ stong tshwa sgo can/ /lha nyi ba swan to'o/ /sa ra swan to gtsang ngo mtshor/ /bya khyung ga rung makṣiṃ dang / /sha kun ni khyim bya bya/ /me skyes du ba ke tū'o / /dzre mu to ni sprin dang ri/ /ha sto lag pa me bzhi'o/ /ma ru to ni rlung 'chi med/ /yadhā glang chen kha lo sgyur/ /bha rtu 'dzin gso ba po/ /gru dang byi bas pa po ta'o//pre ta srog chags mtha' ma ro/ /gza' bye rgyal mtshan ke tu'o/ /sa bdag bu dang bu ta'o/ /sbra ba ti ni shing mkhan dbye/ /sa 'dzin ri dang rgyal po'o/ /spyi bor dbang bskur rgyal rigs la'ang / /ri tu bud med me tog dus/ /khyab 'jug pham pa rya kto/ /sru twa4/ /kha lo sgyur bya ka ta mkhas dang gsal ba'o / /dṛbye 5tā gnyis bstan bcos dpe/ /kṣa tta kha lo sgyur ba dang / /sgong skyes rgyal rigs dmangs 'dres bu/ /britta nta ni rab dbye dang / /bye brag tshogs pa gtam rnams so/ /an rta ni g.yul dang ni/ /gar gnas skye mtha'i bye brag la/ /kra tt+waṃ ta ni gshin rje tredang / /grub mtha' sngon gyi mi dge'i las/ /bad kan la sogs ro dang ni/ /khrag srogs me'abyung ba chen po dang / /de yi yon tan dbang po rnams/ /rdo yi bye brag skra'i skye bye gnas/ /110—658

jo tu yin te khams zhes so/ /ka kṣa nta re btsun mo'i 'khor/ /mi dbang kun kyis spyod yul can/ /kā su nus pa shatta'o/ /mu rti sra dang lus la'o/ /yangs pa 'khri shing pra ta ti/ /bas ṭī ni mtshan mo khyem/ /zad mchod a pa tsi ti'o / /sbo ti sbyin dang gnas dag la/ /irta zug rngu gzhu yi mchog /dzā ti spyi dang skye ba dag /rab spyod bskyod pa yī ti'o/ /rī ti mchod dang gnas dag go/ /shar dang thob pa pā byā'o1/ /ste ta me gsum gsum ldan dus/ /pi wang dbye ba ma ha tī/ /byu ti thal dang phun sum tshogs/ /gtsang po klu yi grong khyer rnams/ /sgog bti de nas ni/ /bde byed grogs po dag dang ni/ /g.yung 'du sa ni sa me to/ /zad dang gnas la khyi ti'o/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer mtshon cha dang / /me rtse 'bar ba he ti'o/ /dzag dī ni 'gro ba dang / /sdeb sbyor bye brag sa gzhi la'ang / /paṃsti gra'/ dang yig bcu'i sdebs/ /'od dang chags pa a ti/ /patt+waṃ 'gro dang skang thang ngo / /rtsa ba gshog dbye pakṣa ti/ /pa kṣa bhe ta yoḥpra kri ti ni skye gnas brtags/ /gang tshogs 'tsho ba bri ta'o/ /se ka tā ni bye gyo dum/ /rig byed thos pa shu ti'o/ /ba ni tā dang dza ni tā/ /ma dang rjes chags bud med la/ /gubhi dong 'bru bug bcas gru/ /dhri ti 'dzin dang blo gros so/ /pri ha ṭī ni bum sman dang / /sdeb spyor dbye ba chen po la'ang / /bud med glang po bā si tā/ /brta 'tsho ba skye bo'i gtam/ /bārte nad med snying po med/ /gsum/ zhun mar mar ni a mṛ ti / /ka la rnyo tai dngul dang gser/ /ni mi tt+waṃ ni rgyu mtshan nyid/ /shu tai bstan bcos pa 'dzin//sdogs ldan rnam grangs thob kri te4/ /a tyā hi tai 'jigs chen dang / /las kyis 'tsho ba mi lta byed/ /rig pas sa sogs dus byu rda/ /sog chags 'das 110—659

dus 'dra ba gsum/ /dṛrte tshigs bcad spyod pa gsum/ /'das dus bstan po zlum po la/ /ma ha ta ni rgyal srid dang / / skye bos rtesmod dang chen po la/ /las kyis 'tsho ba mi lta byed/ /gsum shwe tai dngul dang dkar po la/ /ra dza tai ni do shal dang / /dngul dang dkar po rnams la gsum/ /gsum po de nas dzag ta ni/ /'akro ba dang ni 'khor ba la/ /rakta sngo sogs chags pa la/ /a bad ta dkar po dang / /ser po dang ni dag pa'o/ /lhag lus dkar po se to / /rigs dang mngon par legs sbyar dang / /nus pa a tta nī ta'o/ /de nas legs sbyar zin pa dang / /mtshan nyid u pa te yang ngo / /a nanta ni mtha' yas dga'/ /grags dang yid 'ong pra tī to/ /adha dzā ta rigs skyes blo//bi bi kto ni dag dang dbeen/ /mur tstsha to ni rmongs dang mtho/ /gnyis dag sgyur rtsub shu kto/ /shi dī dkar dang dkar nag 'dres/ /sa tya legs dang rigs/ ldan dang / /dge ba phan byed bden pa'o/ /pu ra skṛ ta mchod pa dang / /dgra dang mngon par rig pa dang / /mngon du bya ba rnams 'a/'o/ /ni bā ta ni rlung med gnas/ /mtshon gyis mi chod go cha la'ang / /dzātaḥskyes dang 'tsho ba thob / /utstsha ta dang utt+waṃ ta 'di rnams/ /mtho dang shar phyogs skye ba rnams//ā dri to ni rtag mchod byed/ /arja brjod bya rin po che/ /dngos po dgos pa tsho rnams la/ /tirja gleng gzhi lung dang ni/ /drang srong mu stegs lci ba'o/ /sa marja gsum nus pa dang / /'dod pa 'byel 'dod phan pa la'ang / /da sha mbi sgo chags nyams rgan/ /bī bye lo dang rtsig pa'o/ /ā sthā dma' ba gnas mthong ba/ /pra sgra mo min sā nu dang / /bye la'o/ /dgongs can dbang byed stso da'o/ /a ba do sprin dang lo lbo3/ /a ba bā do smod 'udang rgongs/ /dā ya 110byed660

do ni bu dang gnyen/ /pā dā 'od zer zhabs dang ni/ /bzhi cha zla med nyi mun sel / /nirpā da na skye bas smod1/ /shā do lham dang myu gu'o/ /brkyang ba ru skad skyob pa rnams/ /ā kranda'o drag po'i g.yul/ /pra sā da ni dngas pa'o/ /su dang zas ster lpags pa yang / /ru dpon brdzi go bandi/ /a mo da ni dga' dang chad/ /gtso bo dang ni rgyal po'o/ /rtags/ /khyu mchog nog rnams ka ku do/ /mo min no/ / so saṃ bid ni mkhyen pa dang / /gsung dag bya byed g.yul ming rnams/ /chos dben u pa ni 6 da/ /ston ka lo ni sha ra da/ /pa rda bya ba skyob pa dang / /gnas dang phun tshogs rkang pa dngos/ /gotpa de ni zhabs tog bre/ /rab gnas thob pa ā ya pa ni4/ /gsum/ yid 'ong sbrang rtsi swā du'o/ /tpā 5du rdo dang 'jam pa dag /rmongs dang nyung dang mi gsal dang / /skal pa ngan rnams manda'o/ /gnyis shā rdo ni rtse mo gnyen pa'o/ /bi sā ra do yongs can mkhas/ /nam mkha' dma' mo/ bya gro dhwa/ /u da se dha lus dang mtho/ /len byed lo 6ni bī ba sgo/ /bi ba sgo yang de bzhin no/ /pa ri bye ni mchod sbyin gyi/ /rngod phur shā khā nye 'khor ro/ /ta ma nyes pa sems nad dang / /byen gyis brlabs pa a bye'o/ /mnyam don sa bon dag dang ni/ /nges pa rnams ni sa ma bye/ /nyes skye a nu bandha dang / /rang bzhin la sogs dbyangs med dang / /gtso bo rjes su 'gro ba dang / /byis pa rang bzhin rjes 'gro'o / /bi dhu khyab 'jug zla ba'o/ /yongs gcod dus dag a bha bye/ /bi bye sgrub dang sngon gyi las/ /pra ni bye ni slong mo spyod/ /budhe rgan dang mkhas pa'o / /skandha yang dag 'tshogs pa'o/ /yul gtsang po khyad a pa sgo/ /sentu cha phran la 'o mo/ /bidhi bi bye rnam pa'o/ /sā dhu dga' ba dang legs pa la/ /110—661

ba dhu bud med mna' ma chung / /su dhā byug pa bdud rtsi sngon/ /sandha rna cha yul tshos so/ /shra dhā blo dang 'dod pa'o/ /madhū chang dang me tog rtsi dang sbrang / /anta long ba mun pa'o/ /'di nas gsum yi nas mukhyo/ /mkhas pa'i nga rgyal khengs pa'o/ /tshangs mnyen shin du g.yo dang nges bstan pa/ /rten dang ring min mthong a baṣṭa bo/ /pra si dhi ni grags dang rgyan/ /nyi ma tsi tra bhā nu'o/ /bhā nu 'od zer 'od kyi byed/ /bhū tādma kau/ 'byung po'i bdag nyid ma lus/ /rmongs dang dman pa sau skye/ /gra ba no 1ni ri dang rdo/ /pa tri kho ni sgro ldan mnga' dang bya dag go/ /shing dang ri ni rtse mo can/ /shi gi rno ni me rma bya/ /pra ti yata na gnyis mnab sems/ /nyer 'dzin de nas sā ngi no/ /gnyis/kha lo sgyur dang rta pa'o/ /bā dzi na ni mda' dang bya/ /ku le pya bhe dzan ni/ /skye ba dang ni skyes pa'i sa/ /de nas hā yan zhes pa/ /lo dang 'od zer 'bru yi dbye/ /zla me nyi ma bi ro tsa nā/ /skra 'khyil bri dzin yin no/ /sna tshogs las dang nyi ma dang / /lha dang bzo dag yin no/ /ā dasnan 'dun pa 'dzin pa dang / /blo gros rang bzhin tshangs pa glang myos dang / /char sprin gha na gha 2na'o / /a bhe ma na don sogs kyi/ /nga rgyal shes pa yid bcugs rnam 'che'o/ /gha na sprin dang gzugs yon tan/ /gsum/ mkhregs pa dang ni bar med do/ /yī na nyi ma 'od zer ro/ /rā dza na ni ri dgas mtshan/ /rgyal rigs mi yi dbang po la/ /pā ṇi byo ni gar ma myos/ /mnyan yod dmag ni bā hi byā/ /hra ji byeni gnam beegs glog /baddhā yā na cha gse can ma/ /lpags dang lus dag lta na'o/ /shu nā 'og tu lce 'chang pa/ /me tog go/ /bī tā rgo ni mchod sbyin dang / /rgya chen mo min sbur 4stong dman/ /de nas ke ta nam byas zin/ /110—662

rgyal mtshan mnyan cog /bee rna de nyid dag ni/ tshangs pa bram ze skye dgu'i bdag /spro dang rnam 'tshe phra ma rnams/ /gharnya rgo ngo / /ā ta ñtsargo bskrun chu dang / /bang dang rang nyid don la'o/ /byañdza rgo ni rtags dang ni/ / smar tshod 1ma cha shas rnams/ /kau lī rgo ni skye bos smod/ /dud 'gro 'thab dang sbrul bya la'ang / /utyā na ni grong phyi rim/ /nags dbye dang ni rab dgos la//dbeen gnas gnas dag sbra rgo/ /gtse ba'i 'tshogs pa de ba rgo/ /u rgo ni skyes mthu can/ /dmag dang sdud nas langs pa la/ /byuttha ni ting 'dzin zad/ /'gal bar spyod pa rnams la'o/ /'chi dang ro bsreg 'gro ba dang / /rdzas dang sbyin pa slar 'ong dang / /phan byed rjes 'gro sā dha rgo/ /natyā ta dzee dras dag pa/ /sbyin dang bcol ba gtad pa'o/ /bya sa rgo ni phun tshogs min/ /nyams pa nyes pa 'dod skye khro skye'o/ /paghra na mig dzee ke sar dang / /te tā tyā she bya chung ba/ /tshes dbye skad cig par ban/ /brtasna mig lpags lam/ /don med gsang ba kau bī rgo/ /mi thu rgo ni 'dus dang dga'/ /pra dha rgo ni mchog bdag blo/ /pradzñā rgo ni blo gros rtags/ /pra sru rgo ni me tog 'bras/ /nidha rgo ni rigs dang nyams/ /kranda nee ni ngu dang 'bod/ /basmre nā lus dang tshad / /khyim dang 'od zer nus mthu dang / /dhā mā mya'o de nas ni/ / bzhi mdo 5grong sgo saṃ sthā rgo/ /phun tshogs rtags ni pra dha na/ /ātstsha nga ni 'gebs sgrib gnyis/ /ā rā dha ni sgrub pa dang / /thob dang tshim pa rnams la yang / /a byejo 6rgo grong khyer dang / /mthu dang gnas/ ratt+waṃ rang rigs rin chen mchog /ba nee chu dang nags khrod do/ /ta li rgo ni mthor dang nyung / /brjod bya'i rtags can de bzhin phyi/ /sā mān ni mtshungs dang gcig /pi shu 110—663

no rgo tha shal dbyen/ /tī kau ma gang dman tha shal/ /bang dang dpa' btar sī no/ /arbha parngo nyes byas dang / /dgra dbang song dang don med byas/ /kakhā sa ni rgyan dang ni/ /rma bya'i mdongs dang tshogs pa la'ang / /pa rī bā sa yongs gcod dang / /ba byubye dang chu gnas pa/ /'jo ba la bdag go po/ /dbang khyab 'jug bri twe rpā/ /bā ṣṭha blangs pa mig chu'o/ /ka shi pū ni zas 1gos gnyis/ /talbonyal ba khang steng chung ma/ /bi ṭa po ni tshang tshing ngo / /mo min pra ta rū pa sa rū pa/ /i rū pa ni/ mkhas pa dang ni yid 'ong ba/ /dbye ba rtags 'di rnams la ni/ /ru sbal mo dang dbyangs can ma'i/ /pi wī katstsha pi yin no/ /bar do bar srid sems can dang / /rta dang lha yo garnyarba//kambu rgyan mangs dung la'o/ /lce gnyis sbrul dang sgyu ma'o/ /pūrba gzhan gyi rtags can te/ /dang po mang tshig sngon la skyes/ /kun bye bum pa glang chen mgo / /ḍi dngha byis nga// /stam sgo ska ba rengs byed la/ /shaṃ bhu tshangs dang spyan gsum pa/ /ra gha mang la dang sems can byis/ /bi shri bha 5ni yid ches mthun / /rnga ni dund+ra 6bhiḥskyes so/ /tshes lo dund+ra bhi ste mo/ /tshon chen ma ning ku sum̐ rghaṃ/ /spyi blugs la ni skyes bu'o/ /rgyal rigs lte ba na bya skyes/ /su ra dzha ni ba lang mo/ /sa bhā tshogs dang yid ches chos so/ /gsum bdag yid ches babee bha/ /bha'i 'o/ /'od zer bra ba ni rargo'o7/ /spre'u sbal ba mchod 'gro'o/ /'dod dang yid skyes kā mo'o/ /pa rā kra mo dpal pa la gnon / /dharmā bsod nams gshin rje rigs/ /rang bzhin spyod dang zla ba'i btung / /thabs dang sngon ma rtsom pa dang / /go rim u pa kra mi'o/ /tshong lam grong khyer rig byed dang / /ni ga ma'o/ /zhi dang bzod pa kṣa ma'o/ / 110—664

ra mo stobs ldan dang ni sngo/ /mdzes dang dkar po gsum yin no/ /sgra sogs sngon spyor tshogs gā 1ma/ /rnam par gnon pa bo kra ma/ /gul mā sran dang yid ches dman/ /yā mi bu mo rigs ldan mo/ /zhi dang bzod ma kṣa ma'o//kṣa saṃ rigs dang nus ldan phan/ /gsum/ gsum yin shā mo 'phrog byed nag /shā mā rlung dang mtshan ma'o/ /la lā saṃ ni mjug ma dang / /mdongs dang rta rgyan gtso bo tog /sughra ma lhag pa'i bdag kyang ngo / /dang po gtso bo bra ma tha/ /gsum bā mo skyogs so yid la/ /gnyis a dha mo ma gang ngan/ /rgas pa dang ni yongs su spyod/ /yā ta yā ma 'di gnyis so/ /myur 'gro 'dab bzang tā raspyo'o / /gnas dang nyams pakṣa yo/'o/ /shwa shu rdzu ni skud po gnyid mo/ /ju dri bye ni spun skyes sgra/ /sārya bye ni 'brug sprin dbang / /arya 'phags bdag rje rigs so/ /ti6 rgyal dang rtsod ldan dus/ /batyā yo ni gnas skabs rim/ /pra tya ya ni gzhan dbang dang / /mna' dang shes nga/ yid ches dang / /rgyu dang bu ga sgra la'o/ /yun ring zhe sdang rjes su gdung / /snyu lo tstsha ya ma tshang dang / /glang chen 'bring du bskyod pa'o/ /sha ma yā ni mna' dang ni/ /spyod dus grub mtha' yang ga rig /nyes rgyu mi dge sngon las dang / /pū dzu gyos po la yang ngo //sanda yo ni dpung rnams kyi/ /phyir gdong rgyab na gnas rnams so/ /tshogs dang 'jug rtsom saṃst+yaya/ /bra ṇa yā ni 'di rnams te/ /yid ches slong ma yid bcugs rnams5/ /sa mutstsha 'gal med kyang / /biṣa yo ni shes bya yi/ /gang gi de la sgra sogs rnams/ /dur kha ba ka' ba ka ṣa yo/ /mo min 'du khang brati shra ya'o/ /gra 6yo phal cher mthar 'byin dang / /dman pa mchod sbyin khro ba la/ /gsang dang dbeen gnas gu hūṃ ngo / /sa tt+waṃ dag tshangs bden pa'o/ /110—665

bī phroṃ dpa' stobs nus pa'o/ /dra bye skal pa yon tan gnas/ /bye ṣa bye gnas dang khang pa dang / /bhā gyi lam dang dge mi dge/ /rta dang gser ni shaṃ ge yī1/ /bi sha sthā ni so ldan no/ /bi ṣā ka pā yī 2ni dpal go ri/ /a bhi khyu ni ming dang mdzes/ /rtsom dang nges byed slob pa dang / /mchod dang bsgrub bya thabs las sems/ /gso dpyad dgu la kri ya'o/ /tsā yā nyi chung mdzes pa dang / /gzugs brnyan tsha ba med rnams la/ /ka kṣa re mig khyem la sogs/ /rked rgyan glang chen dbus su 'ching / /kra tyā bya ba lha dag gsum/ /dbye ba bsgrub bya la sogs kyis/ /dza bya skye bos dmod pa'o/ /dzagha byo ni mtha' sgrub byed / /ngan pa gzhan dbang bakta byo/ /ka phyo nad med yon tan can/ /bdag ldan nor bral ar pyo'o/ /bu bye yid du 'ong ba'o/ /rū bya dga' dang gzugs bzang ngo / /ba dā byo ni ngag mnyan pa/ /rig pa dang ni ma dhya'o/ /sau māṃ gdu bu zla ba lha/ /tshogs dang re mongs bā ro 'o/ /saṃ stu ro ni mchod sbyin la/ /gu ru phur bu pha la sogs/ /dhwa pa ro ni dus the tshom/ /bra kā ro ni dbye dang dpe/ /ā kā rā ni lus tshul byed/ /ki shārū ni so rtser 'dod/ /ma rū mya baṃ thang dang ri/ /a dri shing dang ri nyi ma/ /mo/ nu ma chu ni pa yodha ro/ /dhwa dhā ri ni lha min 'khor/ /sdud dang lag pa 'od gā rā/ /bra da ra ni 'joms byed dang / /bud med rked nad dang ni mda'/ /apra skra dang zur yin no/ /rwa med pa lang dus dang ni/ /smar med pa tū pa ro/ /rin chen gser ni rā zhes so/ /pa ri ka ra dkyil dkrungs 'khor/ /mu tig dag pa tā rā yin/ /khra bo rlung gsum karbu re/ /de nas dam 'cha' g.yul dang ni/ /rig pa gnod pa saṃ ga ra/ /rig byed dbye ba dag dang ni/ /gab tshig gsang 110—666

sngags mant+ra'o/ /mi tro nyi ma la yang ngo / /srog shing dum bum bu swā ru'o/ /tha shal dang ni ba ska ra/ /ā ḍi ba ra rnga dang ni/ /nyi ma glang chen dbang sgrogs so—/ /a bhi hā ro mngon spyor dang / /rku dang go cha gyon pa la/ /pa rī bā ra dgab yang dang ral gri'i shubs dang gos la'o/ /biṣṭa ro ni tshang tshing dang / /ku sha changs pa khro sogs stan/ /sgo srungs sgor gnas pra tī hā ra/ /pra ṭī hā rya mtha' yas so/ /chen po nee'u le khyab 'jug dang / /a byu yin te skya bo gsum / /sā ra dpung gnas cha shas dang / /bkod pa ma ning mchog gsum mo / /du rid ro sho byed dang / /sho rgyal du ro da rang ngo / /g.yul chen 'grod dka' lam dang ni/ /skyes bu ma ning kā ddhā ra/ /mdas ro gzhan dge la / /zhe sdang de bzhin ser sna gsum/ /bar lha yis spel ba dang / /mchog gsum ma ning cung zad dga'/ /baṃ shaṃ ku re smyug ma'i smyug /mo min shing dbye bum pa'o/ /dmag dpung dang ni dmag gi gzhis/ /lag sgud pra ti sa ra'o/ /gshin rje rlung dang dbang po dang / /nyi zla khyab 'jug seng ge 'od//g.yul dang nee tsho sbrul dang ni/ /spre'u sbal pa ha ri ste/ /pho skya bo la ni rtags gsum mo/ /sha rkar ni gyo dum mo/ /yā tā ltad mo 'gro ba'o/ /yī rās dang ngag chang chu/ /ti nd+ra gnyid dang rmugs pa'o/ /dhwa tri ma ma zhing dang ma/ /kyu drwa 1yon po gar mkhan ma/ /smras 2'tshong sbrang rtsi kā ri tī gsum/ /tha dan smod nyung kṣu dzra ngo / /ma tā yo byad nyung dang tshad/ /mā tram̐ kun dang 'dzin pa dang / /tsi tram̐ kun bris ngo mtshar can/ /ka la tram̐ ni chu bo chung / /ma rig 4ldan snod dag pā tram̐ ngo / /pa tram̐ bzhon pa 'dab ma'o/ /nges bstan gzhung ni shā st+waṃ ngo / /sha st+waṃ mtshon dang lcags dag la/ /rtsa phran gos mig nee tram̐ ngo / /110byed667

kṣe tram̐ chung ma lus dag go/ /go tram̐ rigs dang ming la'o/ /sa tram̐ gos dang mchod sbyin dang / /rtag tu sbyin dang nags la'o/ /a dzi ram̐ ni yul dang lus/ /saṃ ba re ni nam mkha' gos/ /tsakre pha rol dmag dang g.yul//akṣa ram̐ ni gol ba'o/ /spyi ram̐ chu dang 'o ma'o/ /gser kyang bhu ri tsan dro gnyis/ /sgo srungs kyang ni ba lang khyem/ /gong bu ri re/ /pug dang nga rgyal ga hwa re/ /dbeen mtha' u pa hū ro'o/ /sngon lag steng ni a gra'o/ /khyim dang grong khyer pu rang ngo / /'dus de nas rabye ni/ /mo min yul dang bar du gcod/ /dar mo min 'jigs dang dong / /badzra mo min pa 1lo thog /tarja gtso bo grub mtha' dang / /thags 'thag 'dris/ /au shī re ni rnga yab yum/ /oṃ shī ram̐ ni nyal ba stan/ /puṣka re ni glang chen sna/ /rnga dang snod kha chu dang ni/ /mtshams dang sham thabs thibs po dang / /dbye ba de don bu ga dang / /bar gyi ma rtogs pa phyi gnas skabs la/ /dbus ma bar gyi bdag nyid dang / /li ga dur ni pa tha re/ /mon lug sgra ni nā ga ram̐/ /shā rba ram̐ ni mun sbug dang //'joms byed dbye ba rtags rnged do/ /gor dmar dang dkar dang ser/ /rma byed u ra 4yin no/ /dza za 5ra ni sran dung gsum6/ /a dha sthā ni mchu yin no / /'dres med gcig ni a gro'o7/ /bya gro kun chags bags ma'o/ /steng byang mchog rnams utta ra/ /a nutta ra de rnams kyi/ /rnam par log de gtso bo yi/ /ring dang pha rol mchog pa rā/ /zhim dang dga' ba ma dhu ro/ /hrū ro sra dang smod pa'o/ /u dā ra ni da dri che/ /i ta ra ni gzhan dang dman//dman dang rang 'dod swe ra'o/ /shu bhra snang gsal dkar po'o/ /ra'i'o/ /gtsug phud cod pan skra dang ni/ /saṃ ya tā rnams mo la gsum/ /shing dang 710—668

rab dbye glang po dang / /tsher ma'i me tog dzī la'o/ /mthar byed dus dag kā la'o / /dus bzhi ldan pa ka li'o/ /ri dgas bye brag ka ma la/ /la ba snam bu kadza la/ /rgyal sdud gtor ma skyes bu'o/ /ba li srog 1chags lus skyes mo/ /stobs dang nus pa dmag dpung rnams/ /ba lam skyes bu bya rog thogs/ /bā dul ni skyes bu rlung / /rlung gi tshogs po rtags gsum mo/ /dbyer med rtags dang g.yo byā la/ /skyes bu gzig dang sbrul la'o/ /ma la mo min sdog pa dang / /dri chen dang ni dri ma'o/ /tri shul ni zug rngu mtshon/ /phur bu me lce kṣi la'o pā li zung rtags rna shal rnams/ /ka khā bzod dang dus kyi dbye/ /a li spangs po phreng ba gral/ /bee la chu yi rnam 'gyur 'phel/ /dus dang tshul lugs rnams kyang ngo / /ba hul ni smin drug dang / /ba lang me dang nag po gsum / /lī lā sgeg dang bya ba la/ /u pa la ni gyo dum dang / /khrag dang chu ni kri lā lo/ /mū la dang po rtsa ba'i don/ /dzā lo tshogs pa dra sgo dra ba/ /shrī lo rang bzhin tshul khrims so/ /'bru dang rgyu byas pa 2la ngo / /steng g.yogs mig dang nad dang ni/ /ma ning tshogs pa pa tra lo/ /po min no/ /'og dang thil ni ta lo ngo / /sha ni pa lo/ sa chu 'og ni pā tā lo/ /tse lo gos dang tshangs ma gsum/ /kuklu lo ni rtsang dang ni/ /kre pa dong dang ri dgas rgya//phub me 'ga' zhig dang ni ke ba la/ /rtags gsum gcig dang ma lus pa /rnam grangs thob dang bde ba dang / /bsod nams rnams la ku shal/ /slob ma zhes pa gsum yin no/ /bra bā la ni myu gu'o/ /mo min gsum po sbrul lam glen / /kā la ni dma' dang mtho/ /mdzes dang mkhas pa le sha la/ /rmongs dang byas zipa bha la ste/ /la'i'o/ /lo la g.yo dang 'dod chen po/ /da bo da 110—669

bo nags 'phrog me/ /skye dang dbang phyug bha bo 'o/ /blon po lhan cig sa rtsi bo/ /bdag po grogs mi dha bā'o/ /a ba ri lu ga nyi'o/ /bka' bsgo 'bod dang mchod sbyin rnams/ /ā ha bā'o/ /bhā ba sems can sring ba dang / /dgongs pa sems dang bdag skye rnams/ /skye ba 'bras bu me tog rnams/ /pra sa ba'o mngal grol la'ang / /yid mi ches dang ngan pa dang / /nyes byas rnams kyang ni tū ba/ /mthor 'gro spro dang 'dod pa brkyang / /mchod pa rnams ni u pa/ /anu bhā ba rtogs pa dang / /dgongs pa'i blo gros nges pa la / /pra bha ba ni skye dgu dang / /gnas dang don thob 'byung gnas so/ /byu ba rgyu skar dbye ba dang / /ma ning nges dang dbugs pa gsum/ /swa ni gnyen dang bdag dang ni/ /sri gsum ste bdag dang ni/ /swa ni mo min nor yin no/ /byā bi bud med rked gos dud/ /tshong pa'i zong rnams la yang ngo / /shi ba 1u ma lce spyang ngo / / byen zwa 'thab mo zur rang bzhin/ /dra phywa zas dang rdzas la'o/ /swa twa mo min sems can no/ /llī baṃ ma ning za ma ste/ /brjod bya'i rtags can rnam par gnod / /wa'i'o/ gsum/ bi sho rje rigs mi dag go/ /gnyis/ spyod pa mngon spyod sbasgo/ /gnyis/ shā rī phung po lug sogs khyem/ /gnyis/ baṃ sho rigs dang 'od ma'o/ /dben dang gsal ba bī kā sho/ /khyab bdag longs spyod ra bee sho/ /mthar byed skyes bu kri nā sha /ser sna dang ni 'khengs pa gsum/ /rgyu thabs mtshan nyid rtags a bde sha /ku sha rtsa dang chu yin no/ /nga sha gnas skabs rnam thumang ngo / /ā shā sred pa ring po'o/ /ba shā glang mo dbang du byed/ /dri sha blo dang mig yin gsum/ /garka 5sha ni dpa' brtul dang / /sra ba dang ni gyong ba'o/ /110—670

pra kā sha ni rab gsal grags/ /byis dang blun po ba li sha /sha'i'ozi1/ /lha dang nya ni mig mi 'dzums/ /pa rū sha ni bdag dang ming / /bya rog nya dang mkha' 'gro tt+waṃ kṣiṃ/ /kakṣiṃ rtswa dang 'khri shing ngo / /a ddhā 6 ni prab 'od zer/ /pre sha 'gyed dang nyed pa'o/ /pa kṣa phyogs dang lhan cig go/ /u: ṣa ni gtsug tor dang / /thod dang cod 2dag la'o/ /brlig pa byi ba mchog dang ni//legs byas khyu mchog bri ṣa'o/ /ko ṣa mo min grol med dang / /ral gri shugs dang don tshogs mna'/ /a kṣe sho dang sho yi stan/ /'gugs pa la'o de nas ni / /a kṣa dbang po sho lus 'dren/ /'khor lo chos lugs rtsod pa'i shing / /gaṣpe bzhin dang lci ba'i me/ /kakṣu 'gram dang brjod bya'o/ /skyes bu dngos bzhin bya ba dang / /po ru ṣe ngo / /baṃ ṣe dug dang chu yin no/ /nyer 'bul sha dag slo ṣe4/ /gnod byed sdig pa ki grwa ṣa/ /char dang 'jig rten khams cha lo rnams parṣa mo min no/ /pre kṣu gar lta shes rab po/ /bhi kṣu gar lta shes rab po/ /bhi kṣu zhabs thog slong dang sla/ /tweṣṭa mdzes dang 'od gsum gzhan/ /nyes kun dag ni kriṣṭa/ /mngon sum bka' lung adhya ka /ru kṣa mi mthun pa dang rtsub/ /ṣa'i'o/ /nyi ma dang skya haṃ sau so/ /nyi ma me 'ong pa sru'o/ /bashlau bye'u lo dag gnyis/ /pung rta mthor di bo kas/ /sgeg pa la sogs nyams dang ni/ /dug dang thig le yon tan chags/ /khaṃ 5ba rnams la ra sa'o//utt+waṃ sa dang a haṃ sau/ /gnyis/ rna ba'i steng rgyan thod la'o/ /lha dang dbye ba rlung dang ni/ /'od zer dngos po rin chen dang / /nor rnams la ni bsu'o / /khyab 'jug kyang ni ba dhwa sa/ /mo nyid ā shī sa nyid ni/ /phan sems sbrul gyi mche ba'o/ /la la sa ni slong dang sred/ /hi sa rku ba la sogs 110—671

las / /pra su ma dang rgod ma'o/ /sa dang nam mkha' ro dang rdzu/ /'od zer kyang ngo / /dī sa 'bar dang ma ning ngo / /artsi sa ni 'od snang mig /spyig dang nyes pa a gha so/ /mkha' 'gro na mnyam pa yas/ /'od dang bshang lam batstsha sa/ /chen po spyo ba te dza sa/ /ra dza sa yon tan mo zla mtshan/ /sgra gcan mun pa yon tan gtams/ /tstshandas tshigs bcad mngon 'dod do/ /ta pas dka' thub la sogs las/ /sa has stobs dang mnyam mgo zla/ /na bhas mkha' 'gro gro zhun na bhās/ /o kas khyim dang rten o kas/ /sa yaḥ'o ma bo so chu/ /e dzas dang ni 'od dang stobs/ /tho tas dbang po gtsang po khyem//te dzas nus mthu sgron ma dang / /stobs dang khu ba rnams la'o/ /bhi dhri 1sa ni rig nga/'o/ /bī bhatma ni rnam 'che'o/ /'di rnams 'phel dang shis/ /ka bhā yo stu gzhon chung / /ba rī yī tu brla dang rab sā dzhai yā na legs shin tu/ /sa'i'o / /'dab ma rma bya'i mdongs brta/ /byis gdon gza' sogs gra ha'o/ /sgo khyung thod dang bskol dang ni/ /nor yu ha'o glang chen so/ /srab thag rta la sogs pa'i srab/ /pra grwa ha dang gra ha yang ngo / /chung ma 'khor bcas len pa rtswa / /mna' rnams pa ri gra hā'o/ /bud med khyim bdag 'dzin pa'o/ /chu so dang ni bud med mchog /a ro he'o byu ha tshogs/ /a nyi sbrul dang lha min no / /me zla nyi ma mun pa 'joms/ /yongs gcod mi dbang yo byad ni/ /pa ri ba rto mi zad phyi/ /a nga chung dang mngon par khyab/ /mtshams don dbyibs dag spyor las skyes/ /a ni mtshams mi spyor ba dang / /dran pa dang ni ngag la yang / /ā ni khro ba zug rngu dag /sdog dang ngan pa nyung du rku/ /byeng ni bsdigs tshig dmod pa dag /tsa ni zhar byung bsdu ba dang / /re re ba 110—672

dang kun las bsdus/ /swa ste shis pa bde legs dang / /bsod nams la sogs shin tu dga'/ /mchongs pa la yang a ti'o/ /swe ta 'dri dang rnam rtog go /tu ni dbye ba dmigs 'dzin pa/ /sa kṛ ta lhan du lhan cig par/ /rā ta ni ri dang sa gcig ngag /nub phyogs phyi ma pashtsa ta do/ /u ta'i don ni brtag dpyad dag /yang dang rtag tu'o don sha shtsa ta/ /sra 1kṣu mngon sum dang mtshungs pa/ /sems sdug rjes su brtse ba dang / /nye bar tshim pa ngo mtshar dang / /snyan cog pa ni pa ta'o/ /hanta dga' dang nyer brtse dang / /ngag dang rtsom pa dug la sogs/ /pra ti mtshon byed khyab 'dod dang / /mtshan nyid la sogs rab 'byor la/ /i ti rgyu mtshan gnas skabs dang / /gsal byed sogs pa sdogs rnams la/ /pu ra stu ta ni shar phyogs dang / /dang po sngon don mdun zhes pa'ang / /ji snyed de snyed sā kabye/ /bar mtshams tshad dang dmigs 'dzin no/ /bkra shis rgyun mi 'chad dang rtsom/ /'dri dang kun la a tho'o/ /de nas/ bṛ ṣa don med bya ba min/ /nā nā sna tshogs gnyis don dang / /nu ni dri ba rnam rtog dang / /phyi ma 'dra dag a nu'o / /'dri ba dmigs 'dzin rjes sgo/ /yid gcugs 'bod pa na nu'o/ /smod dang kun bsdus 'dri ba dang / /brtag pa 'byung 'gyur a pi'o/ /nyer 'jal 'dam kha bā yin no/ /sā mi phyi dang smod pa'o/ /a ma lhan cig sa gcig dang / /shaṃ ni chu dang spyi bo la/ /dpe dang 4yi don e baṃ/ /nu rgo rtog don e baṃ/ /nu rgo rtog don nges pa'o/ /mi smra'i don bde dzee ṣe ngo / /ki ni dri dang smod pa la/ /nā ma ston byed 'byung ba dang / /khro dang khas len ran snyepa'o/ /a lo rgyan dang rnam grangs thob/ /mthung thung dang ni tsheg tshig 110—673

la / /hūṃ na rnam rtog yongs su 'dri/ /sam ya ni nye tshom dbus/ /pu na dang po ma yin dbye/ /niḥni nges tshig dgag pa dag /yin/ pra band+ra ni dus ring 'das/ /nya 1'khor 'byung 'gyur sngon la ring / /u ra u ri tsa da rī / /chu zhing khas len byas dag gsum/ /mtho ris pha rol 'jig rten swar//gtam dang 'byung ba dag gi la/ /dgag pa tshig gi rgyan dang ni/ /shes 'dir 2bcugs pa kha lu'o/ /sa gcig gnyis dang myur ba dang / /thams cad mngon 'gyur abye ta/ /ming dang gsal byed pā du ngo / /mi tho/brdzun dang phan tshun dbeen pa yang / /ti ro bsgribs dang dud 'gro'i don/ /hā ni snyug bsngal mya ngan la/ /a ha ha ni rmad du byung / /sems sdug hi ni rgyu mtshan dmigs 'dzin no/ /don sna tshogs kyi sde tshan no// //rgyun ring yun ring ring po dang / /dus ring po la sogs pa'i don/ /yang dang slar dang slad dang ni/ /slar yang yang yang gcig min mtshungs/ /mgyogs myur rkyen dang yud tsam dang / /de ma thag dang mi sdod myur/ /shin tu nan tar ha las dang / /su dang a ti shin tu'i don/ /so so re re mthar byas dang / /tud hi du ga nā nā bor/ /yata tata gang las de las rgyu/ /thams cad ma yin shaṃ tsi ta/ /ka dā tsi ta ni nam zhig go/ /lhan cig dus gcig mnyam mtshungs ldan/ /mthun phyogs don dang mthun pa'o/ /don med byar med don med do/ /rtog pa rnam rtog brtag pa dang / /'dam kha ci zhig rnam par rtog /tu hi tsa smra ha dang bai/ /tshig gi kha skong don yin no/ /su dang a ti mchod pa'i bya/ /nyin mo thun dang de nas ni/ /nyes mtshan nam 110—674

zhes bya ba'o/ /dud 'gro'i don dang sā tsi phyug /de nas bod pa'i don yin no//byu ṭa tuḍi ga /he hai sgo rnams 'bod pa'o/ /lhan cig pa gcig nyes 'khor ro//ma brtags pa dang ma dpyad pa/ /sngon ma snga ma mdun ma'o/ /swā hā lha yi bsreg rdzas sbyin/ /shri ṣa ta ba ṣa ta rnams bdud rtsi sbyin pa'o/ /cung zad bag tsam nyung chung ngu/ /yi dgas bar do srid pa bar/ /'dra dang ji ltar de ltar dang / /de lta bu dang mnyam pa'o/ /a ho hi dang ngo mtshar ro/ /smra bcad mi smra tuspyo rka/ /sarya cig car de ma thag /bde dang dgyes pa mnyes dang dga'/ /de nas bar dang dkyil dang ni/ /nang dang dbus ma zhes pa'o/ /mthu dang stobs kyi don yin no/ /zung dang phrugs dang da ltar gnas/ /slar dang yang yang drag tu'o/ /med dgag /na/ hi/ a/ dang na/dgag pa med dgag chog tshig go /phyogs phyi ma dang tse sogs tsa/ /de kho na nyid gnyis med dang / /dbyer med gnyis su med pa'o/ /rab ston gsal dang rnam pa yin/ /oṃ dang e baṃ mchog tu 'dod/ /mtha' dag yongs su thams cad kun/ /mi 'dod khas len kā ming ngo / /bsteng tshig khas len a tu tsa / /'gal dang mi mthun par smra ba/ /kañtsi ta myong bar 'dod/ /sdug pa ma rungs ngan pa dang / /rang nyid ji lta ji bzhin ltar/ /shes bzhin brdzun dang mi bden pa/ /ji lta'i don dang ji de ltar/ /sru dang e ba tu/ pu/ naḥ/bai dang tsa dang i ti ni/ /dmigs kyis dbye ba'i tshig yin no/ /pra ga 'das pa'i don yin no/ /byu na los kyang nges pa gnyis/ /lo dang lo'o phyi ma rting / /a ma de bzhin rang dang bdag /nyung dang dma'o che dang mtho/ /mang po phal cher 'gro dang 'gul/ /rtag tu rgyun du phyi dang phyi/ /'das dang mi mthong mi 110—675

mngon no/ /yod dang bdog go khro tshig u/ /u ①ni dri dang mnyes gshin tshig /hā hūṃ la rtog ge u ṣa ni/ /nam gyi cha smad phyag dang 'dud/ /bod pa yang don aṅga'o / /smod dang ngan smra bstod shes tshig /dgongs ma nyi mtha' nam langs snga / /sa gcig pa dang karnyi ke/ /na ning gzhi zhing nga lo dang / /lo sngon ma/na ning gzhi ning da la'o / /de ring 'od de ring gi'o/ /de nas sngon mi bye'athun la sogs/ /sngon ma phyi ma gzhan dang ni/ /de bzhin du ni gzhan dang gzhan/ /sngon ma'i nyi ma la sogs pa/ /nyi ma gnyis pa gnangs nyin mo/ /phyi dro'i thun ni pa re rgya3/ /kha rtsang 'das pa ma 'ong pa/ /nyi thun hūṃdang ni gnangs nang par/ /phyi thun de thun de dus tsam na/ /thabs gcig dang ni lhan cig la/ /dus kun tu dang rtag tu dang / /da lta dang ni de ltar dang / /nga dang da lta de bzhin du/ /phyogs dang yul dang dus yin no/ /shar la sogs pa sngon ma dang / /phyi ma dang ni gzhan la sogs/ /mi zad pa'i sde tshan no// //rtags dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos kyis/ /san la sogs pa kṛ 7ta ta dhi ta / /bsdu ba las skyes ma bshad pa/ /bsdus rtags 'dres bzhin 'di shes bya / /rtags kyi lhag ma khyab pa'i phyir/ /bye brag 'ga' zhig ma gtogs pa/ /u na'i rkyen can rnams ni mo/ /mo ni ā dang spru dang ni/ /ngal gso dbyangs gcig las med dang / /skye gnas ldan pa'i sems can rnams/ /ming dang glog dang mtshan mo dang / /'khri shing mda' dang phyogs dang sa/ /gtsang po blo gros rnams ni mo/ /a mtha' ba gnyis don gcig dang / /snod dang dus sogs ma gtogs pa/ /tal tshogs ga ga 3bye tā/ /'dras 'khrims la sogs 110—676

tsu na'o/ /mo dang bha ba la sogs pa/ /a ni tī rtsu lkul dang / /tsa na kya ba a yu dza/ /a nga i nya ni shā rnams/ /u ṇa la sogs sani byu rī/ /a di ā byu sum̐ g.yo brtan/ /de la rtsed mo'i rteg cha dang / /khu tshur thal lcag ṇa ni mo'i rkyen/ /ghā nyo nya ni de'i bya ba/ /chang pa ltung ba sbo zla dang / /khra dang ltung ba ri dgas dang / /mar khu 'thungs pa bdud rtsi mo/ /mo min cung zad pad rtsa sogs/ /brjod 'dod 'tshed pa'i rkyen/ /gal te na/ lang kā she pā li kā dang / /ṭī ka dang ni dhā ta shī/ /dka' 'grel dang ni bye bo'o/ /sidhwa'i shing dang smra byed bye'u / /i ga bu sbrang rtsi 'bar ba dang / /drog ma nyil du ka'i shing / /zhib mo bcom dang tshos legs dang / /phra ma mādhi lo ma dang / /'bras bu rgol ba phub dang ni/ /phye ma shā bhā gos/ shin tu dga' dang beem dug dang / /de bzhin stan lte rgyal po'i 'khor/ /dzha lla rī/ tsa rtsa rī/ 'khar ba ri mo dus sbyor dang / /nya rul tshos dang srom khrus/ /chang snod snag tsha gri dha sī/ /mo'i rtags kyi dbye ba'o// // skyes bu de dbye rjes su spyod/ /rnam grangs dang bcas lha lha min/ /mtho ris gnod sbyin ri dang sprin/ /rgya mtsho shing dang dus dang ni/ /ral gri mda' dang dgra dang ni/ /lag pa 'gram mchu dpung pas so/ /mgrin skra sen mo num dang / /nyin mo ha yi mtha' can phodzwa/ /dug gi dbye ba/ mtshan mo mtha' dang dang po grangs/ /dpal 'dod la sogs tshon rtsi dang / /dmigs phye ma yin mon lug dang / /dngos po ma gtogs pa yi ni/ /tu dang u la ngal gso dang / /'di rnams nye ba'i mtha' can/ /a'i mtha' can ni 'dir mo'o / /ka ṣa/ ṇa/ bha ra'i rkyen/ pa yi mtha' can gang la ni/ /a/110—677

tha / pa/ tha/ na/ ya/ sa/ ṭa dang pa yi mtha' can pho/ /rigs dang grags 3snapa zhabs dang 'bod/ ming dang byed pa ngo bo la/ /gha nya dza ya rno bye la gha / /a thu tsa dang ltu —dang byed/ /a ni tsa rgo ngo bo nyid/ /ka gha ki ni dang po gzhan/ /zlas dbye rta dang rgod ma dang / /rta dang rgod ma'i bsdu ba rnams / ka yi mtha' can nyi zla dang / /a ya sngon du bzlog pa'o/ /sngon nyid kyang ngo / /mi thung rjes brjod pa la dang / /khyim dang mda' 4stong rig byed dang / /thum sapo sdug can dam 6sra rtsa/ /mkhar dang khron bsnyan dang gsal 7mkhan/ /chungs pa rigs ngan mngal stag sba/ /lo ma bsdabs pa shing srin bu/ /za ma tog dang dbyug pa dang / /chu skyal skra mtshams ljang khu dang / /skyug ldan sgegs pa chu bur dang / /'khri — zheshing 'gro slong bzod dang ni / /sbub mchod rten gting tshig dang / /nye 'od rgyal rigs lte ba dang / /mda' dang sru gri gse ba dang / /chu 'phel rmig pa tsuskyur mo dang / /byi phrug 'tshal dang gang zag dang / /ro langs gyad dang sta ri dang / /mchod sbyin pa pabhri sha dang / /tsab mo dga' ba de bzhin du/ /shing rta bshad pa so sor 'dod / / pho'i rtags sakyi dbye ba'o/ /gnyis dma' — gzhan no mkhas dang ni / /dgon pa 'dab ma dong dang ni/ /kha ba chu dang grang dro dang / /sha khrag kha mig khu ba dang / /stabs dang gom dang gser bzangs lcags/ /bde sdug dge dang mi dge dang / /chu dang me tog rnams dang ni/ /tsha dang rlung yab rjes byug pa/ /bye ba brgya la sogs pa'i grangs/ /gzhan yang 'bum dang sa ya dang / /ka gnyis/ /ma se su sa—ta6/ gang la a ni can dang / /byed po ma gtogs tra mtha' dang / /sa la nye sngon shiṣṭi dang / /mtshan mo 110—678

grangs dang ldan pa dang / /snod la sogs pa a mtha' can/ /don gcig gong du grangs ldan pa/ /bag nyis mtshan nyid rjes 'brang ba/ /zlas dbye gcig nyid mi zad dngos/ /lam grangs mi zad pha rol lo/ /ma ning ngo / /drug cu grib ma mang gnyis grib/ /tshogs pa dang ni dus pa dang / /shā khā don gyi pha rol tu/ /rgyal po mi don rā dza spangs/ /g.yog 'dus dang mi dbang 'du—/ /srung ba 'dus 'dir phyogs ma ni/ /nyer shes nye bar bgrod pa'i mtha' / /de la gnyis nyid rab tu gsal/ /tshangs shes tshangs ba'i go rim sogs / /dug po sīn rā nā ma su/ /bhā ba na dang ṇa dang ka /tsa ta rnams dang gzhan la'o/ /tshogs pa ngo bo nyid dang las/ /a yi mtha' can rkyen rnams so/ /bsod nams nyi bzang nyi ma'i pha rol/ /bya ba mi zad rnams kyi ni / /dbye ba gzhan dang gcig gnyid do/ /rig byed dang ni gar byed brag /ta la'i 'bras bu rma bya'i mdongs/ /khyim dang ska ba thod dang ni/ /srog gi gnas dang dpag tshad do/ /rgyal po mchod sbyin bā dza pe pa/ /tshigs bcad rkang ldan mkhas pas byas/ /nor bu rkang dang sin du rā/ /gos rnying gos dang gur dang ni/ /'jig rten 'gro dang ba bal dang / /bdug rdzas ster ma gur gum mo/ /skyes dum ning lhag ma ni/ /byed mched 'ba' cha tsher ma dang / /zas dbye rgyun chags mthun bral dang / /gos dang brgya grong shar dang ni/ /lhung ba nyer pyod sman dpyad dang / /ta mā lā dang grong mtha' dang / /ldum ra rus rta mgo dang chang / /pu ti seng sgra bde dang bum/ /grogs pa brgya tshad mig nang dang / /rgyags dang mi zad gar dang ni/ /kha'i sgyi las dang ras bal dang / /pho rol tshu rol mnya' shing 'dzin/ /khyed rnams pra gā ba 110—679

༄/ /'chi ba med pa'i mdzod kyi rgya cher 'grel pa 'dod 'jo'i ba mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ a ma ra ko ṣa ṭī kā kā ma dhe nu nā ma/bod skad du/ 'chi ba med pa'i mdzod kyi rgya cher 'grel pa 'dod 'jo'i ba mo zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das gsung gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa mchog chen po brnyes las 'khrungs/ /bdud rtsi rdzu 'phrul yal 'dab ldan/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpag bsam shing / /khyed la me tog 'bras bur shog /gang gā'i chu bo rab 'bab bzhin/ /gang gi thugs rje lam gsum gshegs/ /dpal gyi rgya mtsho bdud rtsi'i gter/ /srid pa'i zla phyed bdag phyag 'tshal/ /srid pa'i mtsho chen de las sgrol byed chos kyi gru/ /snying rje'i dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing las grub gyur pa/ /rab tu dang sems dad pa'i skyo ba rab bskyod de/ /pha rol phyin nas mngon 'dod rin chen thob par shog /bung bas me tog rtsi blangs thigs pa rab bsags ltar/ /gang zhig blo gros bzang po'i btung ba 110—688
