ste / sirnya seng ge ste/ hi se 'tshe ba la/ ri dwags la 'tsho bar byed ces pas atsa rkyen dang thra sngo dar la sogs pas/ dngos dang mtha' phyin du bya'o/ /mṛ gend+ra ri dgas dbang po ste/ nags kyi ri dgas rnams kyi rgyal po yin pas so//pañtsā su ni/ pañtsa lnga dang / a su kha'am gdong ste/ gdong lnga pa'am/ kha lnga pa zhes bya ste/ kha bzhin du rkang pa gnyis dang lag pa dag gis kyang lag ldan gyi bum pa 'gems par bzod pa'i phyir ro/ /ha yakṣa ni/ ha ri/'phrog byed/ akṣi mig la rang gi yang lag las ṣa tsa' zhes pas ṣa tsa sbyar ba ste/de na 'phrog byed mig ces bya ste/ 'di'i mig dmar ser du yod pas so/ /ke sha rī/ ral pa can no/ /ha ri 'phrog byed de ri dgas rnams kyis srog 'phrog par byed pas so// //de nas stag la ming gsum ste/ shand+ra la dang / dī bī dang / byā ghra rnams so/ /de la shādru la ni stag ste/ shrī 'tshe ba la/ spru ra tsa la sogs pa'o//dī bī/ stag gi dbye ba chung zhes bkra ba ste/ de'i lpags pa gnyis pa de ldan pas i ni'i rkyen no/ /spyor ba 'di ni ka ma la shī la'i yin te/ stag phran stag dang byi la sram/ seng ge'i lpags pa mdun byas te/ zhes so/ /bhāghra dri snom ste stag go// //de nas gnyis ni dred kyi ming ste/ ta ru kyu dred ces bya ba khyi chen po dang tshad mnyam pa/ khyi'i dbyibs can phyug dang mi la sogs pa la 'tsho ba byed pa'o//z-i gā dar/ ri dgas za byed do// //phag gi ming la tshigs su bcad pa gcig ste/ ba rā ha/ mchog tu 'joms pas na phag go/ /sru ka /gtsang byed do/ /su tsa gtsang ba dang /110—1001

ka ra byed pa la/ thra kho dar la sogs pas tsa phyis shing / gzhan rnams la yang ngo / /zhes pas su yig ring por bsgyur ba'o/ /dzdzaji/ sgra ldan no/ /ko la po dri/ khyim gtsang byed do/ /ki ri ni sa 'thor byed/ kṛ rnam par g.yeng ba la/ i ka mtha' nye las ki rkyen no/ /ki ṭi/ sa slong te/ de bzhin du ki ṭa'i zhes las ki ṭi'o/ /rdaji/ 'tshe ba can dang / sbyo bhā/sna rings so/ /stabha/ spu gzings so/ /kro ṭa/ sa rlog go/ /khyu dha/sa 'joms so// //ka paṃ nas nags gnas kyi bar gyi spre'u'i ming ste/ ka pi/ spre'u'o/ /sla baṃ ka dang / sla bdag /rgyug 'chong / 'chong phyed dam/ 'phags 'gro'o / shā kha mṛ ga /yal ga'i ri dgas dang / ba lī mu kha/ gnyer ma'i gdong dang / mārka ṭa/ nyi ma dga' dang / bā na ra/ mi dang 'dra ste/bā shapta.a rpārja/ bā'i sgra ni 'dra ba'i don to zhes so/ /kri sha /rlung gi bu rgyud dang ba kau ka pa/ nags gnas rnams so// //de nas bhaphru ka la sogs pa ni/ dom gyi ming ngo // //de nas gaṇḍa ka dang khaṅgi/ dī la sogs pa gsum ni bse'i ming ngo // //tshigs su bcad pa phyed kyi/ ma ha'i ming ste/ lū la pa/ chu 'dros dang / ma hi kha/ sa steng nyal dang / bā ha dīṣa/ rta'i dgra dang / kā pa ra/ ma he dang / so ri bha rnams so// //tshigs su bcad pa gcig gi lce spyang gi ming ste/ shī bla lce spyang ngo / /bhū rim ya/ sa la rgyu'o/ /go ma yu/ ba lang 'tsho byed do/ /mṛ dhurta/rigs khram pa dang / shrī ga la/ ma rungs pa dang / bañdza ka /bslu byed 110—1002

dang / groṣṭi 'bod dbyed dang / phe ru dang / phe ra ba/ ngan g.yo'i g.yon can no/ /dzambu ga /lce spyang ngo // //tshigs bcad phyed kyi byi la'i ming ste/ a tu/ zhum nu dang / rpābā wa bshad pa sped/ bshang ba dug bzhin sbe bar byed pas so/ /māzi ra/ khrus mkhan no / /dzrīṣā rda sha ka /byi ba gsum/ ā khu phyug byi ba'i zas can rnams so/ /ko ka la sogs pa gsum ni 'phar ba'i ming ste/ ko ka mtsha 'am 'phar ba ste / khyi dang tshang mnyam pa'i ri dar ser skya/ go ṭa la sogs pa'i yul du ko ba zhes bya zhing ma la ba la sogs pa'i yul du bi ka zhes grags pa'o// //de nas ri dwags la sogs pa tshigs su bcad pa phyed kyi ri dwags tsam gyi ming ngo / /e ri dwags kyi khyad par brjod pa ste/ de las byung pas e na ya'o/ /ka da li sogs pa drug ni/ ri dwags kyi khyad par rin po cher gyur pa'i lpags pa byung bas ba/ lpags pa'i skye gnas su brjod do/ /ji ltar ri dwags kyi sgra phyug gzhan la spyir 'jug cing / ri ku raṅga la bye brag tu 'jug cing /dper na lcags kyi sgra gser la sogs pa la spyir 'jug pa dang / lcags la bye brag du 'dug pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin tu lpags pa'i skye gnas zhes pa yang /ri dwags spyi dang bye brag tu 'jug go/ /kriṣṭa sā ra la sogs pa ri bong gi mthar thug pa ni khyad par re re'i ming ste/ri dwags gzhung nag go/ /ru ru ni sgra sgrogs so/ /byu 'ung ni nges mchod ces bya'o / /shasba ra ni mchog bde zhes so/ /ko karṇa ni 'di la ba lang lta bu'i rna ba yod pas ba lang rna ba ste/ gonda zhes grags pa'o/ /pri ṣa ta ni/ thig le khra bo can ste/ rin chen mdzod las/ pri ṣa ri dwags khra bo ba'o/ /zhes so/ /110—1003

e ṇa/ tsā tu na ya na/ mig mdzes te/ byin pa thung zhing bong tshod chung ba'o/ /se ṇa ri dwags chung ngu'o/ /zhes koṣṭha'i rgya cher 'grel las so/ /ri shya bi kha tog slob dpon rta dang mnyam pa ste/ 'di rwa gsum pa yin zhing / ro hi tā zhes kyang bya'o/ /tsa ma ra ni g.yag ste/ ma he'i dbyibs can/ yul byang phyogs su skye ba gang gi 'jug ma las rnga yab 'byung ba'o/ /ganta ri dwags kyi khyad par te/ rta sred ces shes par bya'o/ /sha ra bha ni/ rkang pa brgyad pa gyen mig can seng ge yang 'joms pa ste/ bha ra ta ra/ rkang pa brgyad pa mig can/ /sha ra bha ni nags na spyod/ /seng ge 'joms par yang dag 'gro/ /thub pa re ni nges par zhugs/ /zhes so/ /de'i rkang pa bzhi ni gyen du phyogs pa'o / /ga ba ya/ ni ba min te ba lang dang dbyibs 'dra ba'o// //de nas byi ba la ming gsum gsum ste/ u nu tu/ byi ba dang / lū ṣe ka /rkun po dang / ā khu 'bigs byed rnams so/ /mi ri kṣa/ ri'i byi ba dang /bā la spru ṣi ka /byi ba gzhon nu gnyis ni byi phran kyi ming ngo // //sdom la ming bzhi ste/ lū ta sdom dang / tand+ra bā ya/ thags mkhan dang / khru ṇḍanā bha/ bal gyi lte ba can dang / maṅka ṭa ka bam/ spre'u mtshungs rnams so// //de nas bya'i ming la phug ron la ming gsum ste/ ka po ta dang / pā rā ba ta/phug ron dang / ka la ra ba/ ca co sgrogs sam rag snyon// //bya khra la/ ming gsum ste/ sha shā tan ri bong za dang / padhri 'dab chags khra dang / bye na/ bya khra rnams so// //'ug pa la ming gsum ste/ u lū ka /steng gi rna ba can/ udhwa kaṇḍa la/110—1004

pri kho da ra la sogs pas/ u lū ka rab sgyur ba'o/ /bā ya pā ra te/ bya rog dgra ste/ bā ya pa bya rog dang / a rā ti/ dgra'o/ /se tsa ka /'ug pa'o// //dur bya la ming gnyis ste/ lo lhapraṣṭha/ rgyab dmar dang / kang ka'o/ /de nas tsā sha dang / ke ki di bi gnyis ni/ sbu'i mgo/ bai tudma ltar dwangs shing bshog pa bkra ba'i bya/ gser gyi gtsug phud ces grags pa'i ming ngo / /de nas bya shing rta mo'i ming gnyis ste/ sha ta pa dra/ 'dab ma brgya pa dang / dāddhā ghā ṭa/ shing 'joms shing dgra'am shing rta mo ste/ dāru shing dang / aghā ṭa 'joms pa'o// //de nas khug rta la ming gsum ste/ pā raṅga/ khung rta dang / sto ka ka /chu nyung ste/ stong ka nyung ngu dang ka chu ste/ sa yig phyis pa'o/ /tsā ta ka rnams so// //khyim bya la ming bzhi ste/ kri ka bā ku dang / kuklu ṭa khyim bya ste/ zhes sgogs pa'o/ /dā mra tsu ṭa/ zangs kyi gtsug phud can no/ /grong gi byi'u la ming gnyis ste/ tsa ḍa ka /mchil ba dang / ka la biṅga'o—/ / //khu phyug la ming bzhi ste/ ba na pri ya/ nags na dga' dang / pa ṛ bhra ta/ gzhan gyi gsos/ ces bya ste/ bya rog gi bzung nas bso gar byed pas so/ /ko ki la dang / pi ka /khu phyug bo/// //bya rog gi ming la tshigs su bcad pa gcig ste/ kā zhes pa'i sgra sgrogs 110—1005

pas kā ka ste/ bya rog dang / ka ra ṭa/ khwa ta dang / a riṣṭa zhes pa la/riṣṭa 'chi ba'i mtshan nyid de 'di la med pas/ aṣṭi ste 'chi med do/ /ba li suṣṭa / gtor mas gsos pa'o/ /pa kṛtru dza/ lab gcig skyes so/ /dhra lhasgra ldan no/ /ā mar bya sgoṣa/ sgogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /sar bhrita/gzhab gos zhes bya ste/ gzhan khu phyug gi phru gu bzung bas gos par byed pas so//ba libhu ka /gtor ma za byed do/ /bā ya ba/ bya rog ste/ na tshe gnas zhes bya'o/ /troṇa ka la sogs pa bzhi bya rog chen po'i ming ngo / /'ol ba dang /bya rgod dang / nee tso la sogs pa ni rab tu grags pa nyid do// //kung dang / kroñtsa ni khrung khrung zhes bya ste/ koñtsa zhes grags pa'o// //ko ka la sogs pa ni ngur pa'i ming ngo / /kā dasbra dang // //ka la haṃ pa ni chu skyar kyi ming ngo / /bya ku ra ra'i ming ste/ skyo sha/rgyang grags thos dang / ku ra ra/ sgra sgrogs so/ /bzhi ni ngang pa spyi ming ste/haṃ sa/ ngang pa dang / shwe ta ga ru ṭa/ mkha' lding dkar pa dang / tsakrāṅga/'khor lo'i yan lag dang / mā na sau ka pa/ ma dros gnas rnams so/ /rā dza haṃ sa la sogs pa ngang pa'i rgyal po la sogs pa'i ming ste/ ba ra ṭa'i bar rkang pa so so'i ming ste// //de nas lpags bye'u'i ming la/ dza tu ka /pha bang dang / a dzi na pa dra / lpags pa'i 'dab ma'o/ /bhriṅgā rā la sogs pa bzhi ni/ dhibyā ka zhes bya ba'i srog chags gshog pa dang bcas pa/ phal cher dgon par gnas pa/ sos ka tsha ba'i dus su kha nas dzha ti ces bya ba'i sgra sgrogs pa'o// //110—1006

srin bu me khyer la/ kha rgya ste/ mkha' swang dang / bye ti/ dkar 'od dang / ing ga ṇa/ nam mkha'i 'od rnams so// //bung ba'i ming la tshigs su bcad pa gcig ste/ ma dhu brata/ sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhugs dang / ma dhu ka ra/ sbrang rtsi'i byed pa dang / ma dhu legs sbrang rtsi myang dang / ma dhu li ta/ sbrang rtsi skyong dang / dī re pha/ ra yig gnyis pa ste 'di'i ming sbra ma ra la ra yig gnyis pas so/ /srubee li ṭa/ me tog myang dang / bhriṅga/ bur ba dang / tpāṭāta/ rkang drug pa dang / sbra ma dang 'khor lo dang / a li sbrang bu rnams so// //de nas rma bya'i ming la tshigs su bcad pa gcig ste/ ma yu ra/ sa 'gro dang / brti ṇa/ mdong can dang / brti mang pos ldan dang / byā la karja mgrin sngon dang / bhu dzaṅga bhug lag 'gro za dang / shi kham/ gtsug phud can dang / shi khāe tse mo can dang ke tī/ sgra can dang / ma gha nā dā bu la se/ 'brug sgra'i rjes su sgeg pa rnams so/ /rma bya'i sgra skad la ki kri zhes bya zhing / 'jug ma la gnas pa mig gi dbyibs lta bu'i zla kham ni/ me tsag te mdongs zhes bya la/ me tsa ka nag po la yang sngar bshad do// //de nas tshigs su bcad pa phyed dang gsum gyis bya spyi'i ming ste/ kha ga /mkha' 'gro'o/ /bi haṅga/ bi haṅga/ bi hā ya la/ nam mkha' 'gro'a'am/mkha' rgyu'am/ mkha' spyod sogs so/ /sha kudhi bya'o/ /pakṣi/ 'dab chags so/ /sha ku ni/ sha ku na/ sha kun/ rnams kyang bya 'bus ldan no/ /dī dza/ gnyis skyes so/ /pa dra ti/ 'dab ldan no/ /pa dri/ sgro can no//pa tag /'phur byed do/ /pa sa tata/ 'phur 'gro/ pa dra rā tha/710—1007

'dab ma'i shing rta'o/ /aṇa dza sgong skyes so/ /na go ka /shing gnas te/nag 'go med ces pa shing gi ming ngo / /bā dzi ki ra/ srin bu za'o/ /bithra bya'o / /biski ra/ 'dab chags so/ /mbi ṭarbha pa/ tshang skyes so/ /ga tuzlasto / gshog ldan no/ /pitpanta/ 'phur 'od dod/ nabha saṅga ma/mkha' la spyod do/ /de nas hā ri ta la sogs pa bya'i khyad par gyi ming ste/ tittar sogs pa ni sreg pa'i ming ngo / /dzā ba dzre ba/ la sogs pa shang shang ti'u'i ming ste/ dzre bañdza ba ni 'tsho ba'am 'tsho byed ces bya ste/ dug gi 'chi ba 'tsho bar byed pas so/ /garlud ces pa bya la sogs pa bya dang 'brel ba'i ming rnams so// //pa mū ha la sogs tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyis tshogs pa'i ming ste/ pa rū ha/ tshigs pa dang / ni ba ha/ 'dus pa spu dang / khyu ha/ phung po dang / parnyo ha/ tshogs dang / saṃghā ta/ 'dus pa dang / saṃ tsa ya la sogs pa rnams so/ /seng ge la sogs pa'i sde'o// //de nas mi'i sde las/ mi spyi'i ming la/ ma bu6/ mi dang / ma buṣa/yid skyes dang / martu/ shes ldan dang / ma bu dza/ ma nu'i bu dang /ma na ba/ yid ldan dang / na ra/ mi dang / pu mādma/ skyes pa dang /pañtsa dzan lnga skyes te/ sa la sogs pa'i byug pa lnga rnams las skyes pa'o/ /pu ruṣa dang / su ruṣa/ skyes bu'o/ /bṛ mi rnams so// //bud med kyi ming la/ ste bud med dang / yo gti btsun mo dang /a ba lā/ stobs che med ma dang / bā ri mi ma dang / dzī marnyi nī/110—1008

'tshams ldan ma dang / ba rgyu/ 'chi byed ma dang / pra tī pa didhi ni/zhes pa la/ pra tī pa ni ka ṭakṣa/ zur mig gi don te/ zur ldan ma zhes bya'o—/ /bā ma/ g.yon ma dang / pa ni tā/ g.yon byed dang / ma he dang / dga' ston pa gzhi ste/ ma he dga' ston dang / i la/ sa gzhi'o//zhes kaspru ṇa mngon par 'byung ba las bshad do/ /khyad par du zhes pa ni/bud med khyad par can brjod par byed la/ aṅga na/ zhes pa shriṭī ṅgā/lus mchog ma zhes bya ste/ bud med kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan par rab tu shis pa'i rkang pa dang lag pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i lus 'di la yod pa ste/lus bzang ma zhes bya'o/ /zlo ru/ 'jigs can ma ste/ 'jigs pa'i rang bzhin ma'o/ /kā mi ni/ 'dod ldan ma'o/ /bā ma lo/ tsa nā/ mig mdzes ma'o/ /pra ma dā/ rab myos ma ste/ mchog tu rgyags pa'i gzugs dang skal bzang po dag gis bskyed pa'i rnam 'gyur can mo'o/ /bhā ba ni/ sgeg ldan ma ste/ bhā ba ni/ sgeg pa'i spyod pa yin la/ de dang ldan pa'o/ /kāṭwā lus mdzes ma'o/ /gzhon lus ma ste/ shin tu gzhon pa'i lus can ma'o//ni tasbyi bhā/ padma rgyas ma'o/ /sunda rī/ mdzes ma ste/ gzugs mdzes ma phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'o/ /rā ma bhā dang / rā mā/ dga' byed ma'o/ /de nas ko ba nā/ khro byed ma ste/ de lta bu la sogs pa bu med dang 'brel ba'i ming ji snyed pa rtogs par bya'o/ /rā dza swa khā la sogs pa brgyad ni/ rul ldan ma ste/ bu med zla mtshan can mi'i ming ngo / /bu med sbrum ma la ming bzhi ste/ ā band+ra pa tra/ sems can zhugs ma 110—1009

dang gu rbi ddhā/ lus lci ma dang / anta rā mbi/ nang ldan ma dang / ga rī bhā/snying po ldan ma'o// //bu la ming lnga ste/ ātma dza/ bdag skyes dang / ta na ya lus 'phel dang / su bu/ su ta/ pa tra/ rnams kyang bu ste/ de rnams so/ /pha la ming gsum ste/ tā ta/ yab bam/ pha'am/ skyong byed do/ /dza na ka /skyed do/ /pi tā/ srung byed do// //ma la ming bzhi ste/ dza na pa te/ yum mam/ skyed ma dang / bu sbu/mā tā/ 'tsho ma dang / dza na mbi skyed byed ma'o// //sring mo la ming gnyis te/ bhā gi bhā/ sring mo'i che zhe dang / swa sā sring mo'o// //tsha ba'i ming la ni gnyis ste/ naj-i dang / sau ṭī/ bu'i bu'o// //nye du spyi'i ming la drug ste/ la go dra/ rus mtshungs pa dang / bābha ba/'grel ba dang / dzñā ti/ mdzes bshes dang / bantu/ rtsa lag dang / swa gnyen dang / swa dza ba/ rang rigs sam/ gnyen gyi skye ba'o// //gza' mi la ming bzhi ste/ dam pa ti/ gza' mi dang / dzam pa ti/khyo shug ste/ 'di dag gi dam dang dzam zhes pa'i sgra dag ni mi zad pa'i tshig chung ma brjod par byed pa dag go/ /bhāryā ba ti/ khyim thab dang / dzā ya ba tī / bza' mi'o// //byis pa'i ming la rkang pa gcig ste/ shing shu/ byis pa/ shi sha ram̐/bu tsha dang / ṭwāṃ bye/ phru gu'o// //dar ma'i ming la rkang pa gcig ste/ tāru ṇḍa dar ma dang / yob nam/110—1010

bshed ldan nam lang tsho can// //rgan po'i ming la rkang pa gcig ste/ sru bi ram̐/ gnas brtan dang /z-idhe two/ rgan po'o/ /dzre rṇa dang / dza ran rgas pa dang / 'khor ba'o/ /da sha mbi/ bcu pa dang / bye yān/ ches rgan pa dang / lo dgu bcu las gong du 'phags pa ni/ bcu pa'i gnas skabs dang / ches rgan pa'o// //de nas sman gyi spyi ming la lnga ste/ ste ṣa dza/ rtsi pa dang / o ṣa dha/sman dang / bye ṣa bye/ rtsi sman dang / a ga dang / nad med dang / dzā yu / 'tsho byed ces pa rnams so// //nad tsam la ming bdun te/ rug dang / ru dza/ nad dang / u pa/tā pa/ nye bar gdung pa ste/ nad kyis lus dang yid nye bar brdung ba'o/ /ro ga dang / byā dhi dang / ga da dang / a ma ya rnams kyang nad de/ na tsha dang nyams mi bde ba la sogs pa'o/ /de nas bran dang / a ru ni/ rma'i ming ngo // //sman pa'i ming la/ tshigs su bcad pa phyed do/ /ro ga hā ri/ nad 'joms te/ nad 'phrog par byed pa'o/ /ag dam kā ra/ nad sel te/nad med par byed pas so/ /bha ṣag /sman pa'o/ /bai tya/ 'tsho byed che'i rig byed rig pa'o/ /tsi kaṣpe pa ka /gso dpyad mkhan rnams so// //khu ba la ming drug ste/ shu kra khu ba dang / ti dza/ zla ba'am/ gzi brjid dang / te ta spru/ theg le dang bī dza/ sa bon dang / bītya/ nus pa dang / idhri ya/ dbang po rnams so/ /de nas ma yu dang pi tt+waṃ ni mkhris pa'o// //110—1011

ka pha dang shlausma ni bad kan no/ /de nas twaka pags pa ste/ twatsa yang dag par sgrib pa la'o zhes pas/ a rjaghra ra/ khrag 'dzin te/ pags pa'o// //sha la ming drug ste/ pi shi tai cha shes kyi don gyi sha ste/ pi sha cha shas la/kta rkyen no/ /ta ra saṃ/ bsgral bas sha ste/ ṭwā sgol bar byed pa la/ di ba sa bzhin du/ a pa tsa rkyen no/ /mābee/ mchod phyed de/ mā na mchod pa la/haṃ pa'i sgra bzhin du pa'i rkyen no/ /saṃ/ bsgral bas sha te/ pal la/ skyong byed de sha'o/ /kra bya dang / a mi ṣa sha'o// //tshigs bcad phyed kyi khrag gi ming ste/ rudha ra/ khra khyab gnas te/khrag go/ /a thrag /a dhi hri dza/ ti lhag par 'dor byed la/ thra kho da ra la sogs pas a thrag tu bsgyur ba ste/ mtshon ma btab mi thong ba/ btab na lhag par 'dong ba'o/ /lo hi ta dang / rakta ni mar bas khrag go/ /kṣa ta dza/rma skyes te khrag go/ /kho ṇi lta/ rgyun ldan no/ /dmar po'o// //snying la ming bzhi ste/ bukka/ snying dang / agra māstse/ sha mchog dang / hri da ya/ snying po dang / hri ta ces pa yang snying pa bya ste/ lus kyi nang na gnas pa'i sha'i khyad par padma'i rnam pa lta bu kha 'og tu phyogs pa ste/de ltar yang / padma'i ze'u 'bru dang 'dra ba/ bu ga dang ldan pa 'og tu phyogs/de ni snying zhes bya ba ste/ kun gyi skye mched chen po'o/ /zhes pa padma dkar po'i phreng zhes bya ba las so// //lus kyi rtsa la ming gsum ste/ nā ṭi dang / dha ma ni dang / shi ra rnams te/ bu ga dang ldan zhing rlung 'bab pa dang / srad bu bzhin du lus 'ching bar byed pa'o/ /klo ma dang / ma tikṣa/ glad rgyas sam/ glad pa ste/110—1012

mgo bo las pa mar gyi gong bu lta bu/ ghi bi zhes grags pa'o/ /nang na gnas pa'i zas las 'byung ba'i dri ma 'bab pa ni/ snabs la sogs pa rnam pa bcu gnyis te/ de ltar yang / zhag dang khu ba rkang dang khrag /rna yabs bshang gci rnams mtshin ma/ /bad kan dang ni mchil ma rdul/ mi yi dri ma bcu gnyis so/ /zhes so// //gsum gyi mchil ma'i ma'i ste/ pri ṇi kā/ kha chu sa/ pyinta bee dang /lū khā mchil ma'o// //gnyis kyi dri chu'i ming ste/ mū dra/ dri chu 'am/ gcin dang pra pra ba gci pa'am rgyun 'bab so// //usgo ra la sogs pa bshang ba'i ming ste/ usgo ra/ der bya'o/ /a ba ska ra/ khyab ldan no/ /sha ya la 'dres ma'o/ /sha kṛ ta/ 'gro byed do/ /su ri ṣe/ bshang ba'o/ /gru ṭha/ phyi pa'o/ /a rtsa sko/ dri ma'o/ /biṣṭha dang / bi ḍa/ dri chen// //de nas thod pa'i ming la/ ka ro ṭi dang / kaze ḍa dang / ka bā la rnams so// //rus tsam la ming gsum ste/ shī ka saṃ dang ku lya/ gdung ngam/ rus dang / isru/ rus pa'o// //ka le ba ra la sogs pa bcu gnyis ni/ lus spyi'i ming ste/ de la ka lo ba ra'am/ ka ḍi ba ra ni/ khog ba'am/ rus so/ /gā dram/ gong bu'am—/ lus dang / wa suḥ 'dus pa dang / saṃ ha na nam/ tshogs pa dang / sha rī re/ thos byed dang / brja/ gzug po dang / mi graha/110—1013

rnams 'dzin dang / ka ya/ lus dang / de ha/ khyab pa dang / murti/lus dang / ta bu dang / ta byu dang / yang lus te/ snga ma ni/ ta nu rgyas pa la/ me ru'i sgra bzhin/ u rkyen dang / phyi ma ni/ tsa mi ta —/ba dhi rnams las u'o/ /zhes pas u rkyen du byas pa'o// //rkang pa la ming bzhi ste/ pā dang / bad/ 'gro bar byed pas rkang pa dang / tsaraṇa/ rgyu byed dang / a bhe/ 'gro byed de/ a hi/ 'gro ba la / mang po las so/ /zhes pas sren pa'o/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa brgyad par/ a hri zhes ha yig rjes khrid yod de/ gle sha bhu hā hi te ha hu te/ bi hi ti thra ha dro nyi dubye sgo dā ha byā hā bā hi ni tā rwa mbi tā rwa hu bi hi tā padma ha tt+waṃ bee bhā baḥ zhes 'byung ngo // //bud med kyi rtags la ming gsum ste/ u pa sru/ nyer gnas dang /bha ga /cha'am skal pa dang / yo ni skye gnas so// //skyes bu'i rtags la ming bzhi ste/ sha shrī/ pho rtags dang / medra/'jug to dang / me ha na/ chu 'dogs ste gci ba dang khu ba rnam par 'dor ba'o / /zhes/ shi pa sī/ nyams gnas te/ shing nyal ba dang / a sun rkyen dang / phuṭa a ga ma'o// //gsum ni 'bras bu'i sgo nga'i ming ste/ muskospyo lco/ 'bras bu'i sgo nga dang / ko ṣa/ mdzod can dang / bri ṣa ṇa/ sbubs can no// //lto ba la ming lnga ste/ pi byuṇḍi/ gsus pa dang / kukṣi/ dku dang /dza ṭha ra dang / u dar/ lto ba dang / tūnda/ dgang bya ste/ tu na/gang ba la'o/ /a bha la sogs pa bzhin du/ ngan rkyen dang / thung ngu la 110—1014

sogs pa'o// //de nas ta na dang / ku tsa/ ru ma'i ming ngo // //phrag pa la ming gsum ste/ skandha/ phrag pa ste/ rka ma ta rda rkad dha ri karnya—/ zhes pas shaṃ/ mgo bo yin la 'dzin par byed pas phrags ste/ par ska la sogs pas suṭa ā gam sbyar ba'o/ /bhu dza sha riḥdapung pa mgo bo/ i sa phrag pa'o// //de nas lag pa'i ming la/ bhu dza lag pa ste/ spyod par byed pa'o/ /ba hu 'bab par byed pas lag pa'o/ /phra beeṣṭa/ 'jug par byed pas lag pa'o / /doḥzhi bar byed pas lag pa ste/ da mu nye bar zhi bar byed pa la/ṭos rkyen no/ /pañtsa shā kha/ yal ga lnga pa ste/ shing yal kha lnga pa 'dra bas so//sha ya/ lag pa ste/ nyal byed do/ /bā bhā/ lag pa ste/ tha snyad ston par byed pas so/ /de nas/ kurba ra/ zhes pa gru mo yin la/ de'i gong du gnas pa bra gaṇḍa bar lta bu'o/ /gru mo las 'og tu/ prakhyoṣṭha/ lag ngor/de dang lag mgo'i bar/ ma ṇi brnya/ nor bu 'ching ba zhes bya ste/ 'khrig ma'o / /de nas 'the'u chung gi bar/ ka ra bha zhes bya'o/ /'dzub mo'i ming la/ tardza ni/ sdig 'dzub dang / pra ta shī ni/ rab tu bston byed ces bya'o/ /sor mo la/ sgung lī dang / sgung rī/ sor mo dang / ka ra sha kha/ lag pa'i yal ga zhes bya'o/ /'the bong la sogs pa so so'i ming la/ sgung ṣṭha 'the bong ste/ sgung tiṣṭha tai zhes pas/ lus la gnas pas 'the bong ngo // /'dzub mo la/ pra ti shrī nī/slar bshad pa ste/ 'phral kyi tha snyad rab tu ston zhing go bar byed pas so/ /110—1015

ma dhya ma/ gung mo ste/ thams cad dbus su skyes pa'o/ /a bhā mi kā/ming med de/ 'di la ming med pa'o/ /ka naṣṭṛ/ mthe'u chung ste/ thams cad kyi mtha' mar 'gyur bas so/ /de nas sen mo'i ming la/ su nadzha ba/ slar skye ba dang / ka ra ru ha lag skyes dang / na kha dang / na khar/ sen mo zhes pa rnams so// //de nas tshad kyi ming la/ 'dzub mo dang bcas pa'i 'je bong brkyang pa ni/pra de sha /rab tu ston byed ces bya zhing de bzhin du gung mo dang ldan pa'i 'the bong brkyang ba ni/ tā la ste/ mtho gang zhes bya la/ ming med dang / yang dag par ldan pa'i 'je bong brkyang ba ni/ ko ka rṇa ba lang rna ba zhes bya ba dang / mthe chung dang ldan pa'i mje bong brkyang ba ni bi sta ste/ zhes bya ba'i mtha'o// //de nas mgrin pa'i ming la/ kaste/ mgrin pa dang / ga la skye dang /shrīb / mgrin pa dang / sho ro dhi dang / karnya ra/ mgo 'dzin dang /kambu shrīb/ dung 'dri'i mgrin pa dang / dri re khā/ ri mo gsum pa ste/'di gnyis skyes bu chen po'i mtshan can no// //de nas kha'i bu ga la ming btun ste/ band+ra/ smra byed dang / a su/kha dang / ba dan/ smra bar byed dang / tuṇḍa dang / ā nan/ kha'am/zhal dang / la pa ni/ brjod byed dang / /mu kha sgo 'am kha rnams so// //sna'i ming la/ ghā ṇa/ snom byed dang / garnya ba hā/ dri len dang /sgo kho/ sna dang / hā bā dang / nā tpā ka /sna'am shangs so// //mchu'i ming la oṣṭha dang / a dha ra/ ya mchu ma mchu dang / ra da nātstsha dang / so sgrib dang / da sha na pā pa bī/ so'i gos te/ de dag dang 110byed1016

mtshungs pa'o// //de nas gaṇḍa dang / ka po la ni 'khur tshos so// //de nas so'i ming la/ ra da nā/ ldang byed dang / da sha nā/ gcod byed dang / danta/ snyoms byed dang / ro dā/ so rnams so// //de nas ta lu dang / kā ku ma/ rkan gyi ming ngo // //de nas lce'i ming la/ ra sa dzña/ ro shes dang / ral nā/ ro myong dang / dzi hwa/ lce rnams so/ /dpral ba'i ming la/ la khā ḍa/ dpral ba dang / a li ka /rgyan gnas dang go dhi/ mig 'dzin te/ godhe dridha ya te zhes pa/ go mig yin te/ 'dzin par byed do/ /ces so// //mig la ming brgyad de/ lo tsa ni/ lta byed dang / na ya nam/'dren byed dang / nee tram mig dang / i kṣa rde/ mthong byed dang / tsakyu/gsal byed dang / ikṣa bhā/ khyab byed dang / dṛ ka dang / ny-iṣṭa/ snang byed dang / blta byed do// //mgo bo la ming lnga ste/ utta maṅga/ yan lag mchog dang / shi raḥ mgo bo dang / mūrbha 1 na/ spyi bo dang ma sta ka dang / glad pa can no// //skra la ming drug ste/ tsi ku ra/ bsags nas gcod pas skra ste/ tsi sogs la'o—/ /ku ra gcod pa la'o/ /de dag la pri sngo da ra la sogs pas tsi ru ku'o/ /kunda la 'khril ba la'o/ /bā la/ phra bas na skra'o/ /ka tsa/ 'chang bar byed pas skra ste—/ ka tsa 'ching ba la/ a tsa rkyen no/ /ke sha zhes pa la/ ke ma sta/ ke she te/tiṣṭha te/ zhes 'byung ngo / /ke zhes pa mgo bo la zhes pa dang / sha ni she te/ nyal 110—1017

ba'i tsha shes kyi yig ge ste/ mgo bor nyal te gnas pa dang 'dra bas mgo bo nyal te skra'o/ /shi ro ru ha/ mgo skyes so// //ba sru la ming gsum ste/ ta nu ru ha/ lus skyes so/ /ro ma/ ba spu ste / tu ha/ rab tu skye ba la/ blo ma la sogs pa rnams so/ /zhes pas ma ni na rkyen dang / mtha' bya ba byas pas ro ma zhes grub la/ de nyid ka bi ri la sogs pa rnams so/ /zhes pas ma ru bsgyur bas lo ma sru'am ba spu'o// //de nas rgyan gyi ming la/ a lo kā ra/ e waṃ kri yā/ ā bha ra ṇa/ pa ri twe/ bhu ṣa ṇa/ maṇḍa baṃ/ rgyan spyi'i ming ngo // //ku mu ḍa dang / ki rī ḍi/ cod paṇa dang / tsū ṭa ma ṇi/ gtsug gi nor bu dang / shi ro ma bee spyi bo'i nor bu ste/ mgo rgyan gyi ming ngo // //rna rgyan gyi ming la/ kirja ka /ze'u 'bru can dang / nāl patta/ ta la'i 'dab ma dang / kuṇḍa la/ 'khyil pa can dang / kaṇḍa beṣṭa ka /rna ba dkris pa ste de rnams so// //de nas gri bee yaka dang / thi ṇa bhu ṣa/ mgrin rgyan no// //lag gdub la/ ka ḍa ka dang / ba la ya'o// //ske rags la/ med kha lā/ 'og pag gam/ ske rags rgyan can dang /ra sa na/ ro ldan zhes pa gnyis so// //rkang gdub la/ mañdzi rad/ byu sur dang / haṃ sa ka /ngang pa can zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /de nas lpag pa la sogs bzhi ni gos kyi skye gnas te/ gos kyi rgyu yin pas so/ /de la/ twag /lpag pa ste/ shing shun dang zar ma'i ras la 110—1018

sogs pa'o/ /pha la/ 'bras bu ste/ ras bal shing gi 'bras bu las byung ba'o—/ /kṛmi/ srin bu ste/ da ra la sogs pa srin bu'i sbubs las skyes pas so/ /ro ma sbu ste/ ri dgas rabyu zhes bya ba dang / lug la sogs pa'i spu las skyes pa'o/ /na ba asna ra la sogs pa ni/ gos par zhes pa la sogs pa gos gos kyi khyad par ro/ /gos tsam gyis ming la brgyad de/ kanta ka gcer sgrib dang / karja ḍa/ras gos dang / bst+waṃ/ gos dang / ātstsha da rgo/ g.yog sam 'am/dgab tsha dang / bā pa/ bgo ba dang / tse lo/ gos dang / ba sa dzwa/gcer skyob dang / a shu shaṃ/ bog rgyu'o// //mchu dang zheng gi ming la/ dargyu/ ring ba'am srid du'o/ /ā yā ma dang / ā ro ha/ ring ba'o/ /pa ri ṇa ha dang / bi shā la/ zhes che ba'am—/ yangs pa 'am/ rgya che ba'o/ /su tse la/ gos bzang dang /pa ṭa/ dar gos te/ gos bzang po'i ming ngo / /ma nā shi/ gos phye phung po dang / sbrul sha ḍa ka /gos 'thug po ste/ gnyis ni gos rtsegs pa'am sbom pa'i ming ngo // //de nas/ ne tsol dang / pratstsha da pa dra/ smad gos sam dor ma'o/ /ralla ka dang / kasna la/ la ba'am/ snam bu'o/ /pa rī a sgo e shu ka ni/sham thabs sam char gos so/ /pā bī ra dang / utta ra saṃ ga ni/ stod gos sam bla gos so// //de nas/ bi tā rgo/ bla bre dang / uslo ra/ steng g.yogs dang / duṣṭha/gu dang / basthā ba bye/ sbra ste/ gos kyi khyim zhes pa'o// //110—1019

de nas/ pra ti spru rā dang / dza pa ni kā/ yol ba dang / ti riṣka ra ṭwā / mi snang byed de/ yol ba'i ming ngo / /de nas/ pa ri karma/yongs bcos dang / saṃ ga saṃsthā ra/ lus kyi bcas lags te/ thus la sogs pa spyi'i ming ngo / /de la mārī/ 'dag chal dang / maza ni/ khrus rtsi dang / mṛ dza/dag byed do/ /udhatta na dang / utstshad na/ dril phyis te/ rdzas kyi dri ma sel ba'i ming ngo / /sthā nam/ khrus so/ /khā bee ba dang / bee ba/ chur khrus byed pa'i ming ngo /lus la byug pa'i sman dri bzang po'i ming la kaṅga ma/ kiṣṭha dzadma/ kha che skyes dang / aghi shi kha/ me'i rtse mo dang / ba ra mchog ldan dang / babyā ka /mi ldan dang / tpā ta na/ ser po dang / sru tya/ nyi ma dang / saṃ ko tsa/ kun nas 'khums pa dang / pi shu na/ phra ma can dang / de rnams gur ram gyi ming ngo // //dhī ra brtan pa dang / lo hi ta/ dmar po dang / gnyis ni tsan dan dmar po'i ming ngo // //rgya skyegs la ming drug ste/ khākṣu lhas/ rgya skyegs dang / de nyid ka bi ri la sogs pas bsgyur ba'i/ rākṣu de nyid do/ /dzantu/ skye ldan dang / yā ba dang / a lakta/ rgya tshos dang / dru mā ma ya/ shing nod// //li shi la ming gsum ste/ la baṅga/ li shi dang / de ba ku su ma/lha'i me tog dang / shrī saṃ dzñā/ dpal gyi ming can no/ /de nas dzā pa kā/blos pa po dang / kā lī ya/ dus su phan dang / kā la nu pā ri/ dus rjes 110—1020

'brang zhes pa rnams tshong pa la sogs pa la/ kā lī ya zhes grags pa'i shing ser po'i ming ngo /de nas a ka ru'i ming la/ sa mārja shaṃ/ nus ldan dang / baṃ shi ka /rgyud ldan dang / a gu ru/ zhes pa la ghu nā ma tā ta gu ru/ zhes 'byung ste/yang ba'i ming can nyid kyi phyir lci ba'o/ /zhes bya'o/ /ra dzārha/ rgyal po la 'os zhes bya'o/ /lo ha kṛ mi dza/ srin skyes dang / dzaṅga gi/ zhes pa dang /slob dpon bya ṭis/ kṛṇḍa dṛkṣa/ shing nag dang / dṛ bra dṛ ya/ mi bdag dga' byed ces kyang bshad do/ /a ka ru khyad par can la/ a ka ru nag po dang / rma gā li/ bkra shis can dang / mikhra garnyi/ zhes bshad do// //de nas yakṣa ṭu pa la sogs pa lnga ni/ spos dkar gyi ming ngo / /yakṣa ṭu pa / gnod sbyin spos dang / pardza ras thang chu'i spos dang / a rā la/ pra rtsi spos dang / sarna ra sa/ khu ba kun ldan dang / ba hu rū pa gzugs ming ngo /dṛ kā/ dhū ba/ sbyar spos dang / kṛ drim dhu ba/ bcos ma'i spos te/ a ka ru la sogs pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dri'i bstan bcos las 'byung ba bzhin phan tshun legs par sbyar ba/ yan lag bcu pa lta bu'o// //de nas tu ru dang / paṇḍi ka dang / sa zli dang / yā ba dang / zhes pa rnams ba ha la'i ming ngo / /de nas/ shrī shā ba/ dpal gos te/ de la sogs pa lnga ni/ thang chu'i ming ngo // //de nas gla rtsi la ming gsum ste/ mri ga rja bhi/ ri dgas lte ba dang / mṛ ga ma dang / ri dgas chang dang / ka tho ri/ gla rtsi'o// //110—1021

ka ko la la ming gsum ste/ ko ka shaṃ dang / kakko la rka dang / ko sha pha la/ sbubs 'bras so// //ga bur la ming lnga ste/ karngu ra/ nus pa dang ldan pas ga bur ste/kṛ bu/ nus pa la/ ur rkyen du byas pa'o/ /gha na pā ra/ sprin gyi snying po'o / /tsand+ra saṃ dzñā/ zla ba'i ming can te/ zla ba dang ga bur phan tshun/ming gi rnams grangs so/ /si tā bhā/ 'od dkar can/ nyi ba lu kā kha ba'i phye ma'o// //de nas tshigs bcad phyed kyis tsan dan spyi'i ming ste/ garnya pā ra/dri'i snying po dang / ma la ya dza/ ma la ya skyes te/ ri bo ma la ya las byung bas so/ /bhā dwa shrī/ dpal bzang po/ tsan dan na/ tsanta zhes grags pa ste / tshim byed ces bya ste/ cad tshim pa la skruja rkyen no// //tsan dan dkar po la ming gsum ste/ tai la pakṣi ka /til mar 'dab can zhes pa'i tsanda ri bo ma la ya'i phyog gcig nas 'byung ba'o/ /go shīrṣa/sa mchog gam/ ba lang go zhes bya ste/ ba lang bog ba'i rnam pa can/ ma la ya'i phyogs su skye ba'o/ /ha ri shtsan na/ zhes pa la/ ha ri sbal ba ste/de'i dbyibs can gyi ri bo zhig las skyes pas ha ri tsandan zhes bya'o/ /de nas tsandan dmar po'i ming ste/ tai la paṭī/ ti la mar 'dab can ni / pa draṅge/ 'dab ma'i lus can te/ dbus dmar ba'i 'dab ma can rgo / /rañdza nam/ tshos byed do/ /rakta tsandan/ tsandan dmar po'o/ /ku tsandan ni/ tsandan ngan pa'i ming ngo // //de nas dza ti'i ming la/ dzā ti sna ma'am/ pri shing sna ma dang / ko ṣa/110—1022

sbubs can dang / dzā ti pha la/ spos kyi rgyal po'am/ lig she wer zhes pa'o//yakṣa ka rta ma/ mchod sbyin gyi dbyug pa ste/ ga bur dang gla rtsi dang a ka ru dang kakko la rnams sbyar ba'o// //bkod pa rgyan gyi brgyan pa'i ming la/ ratsa nā/ bkod pa dang / sa ri myanta/ chas rtsom pa dang / ā sgo ga dang / pa ri pūrṇa yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /dī pa mar me dang / pra dī pa/ rab 'bar te/ sgron ma'i ming ngo // //gdan la/ tpā ṭha dang / ā sa na'o/ /de nas sa muṅga ta/ za ma tog dang / sambu ṭaka /kha sbyar ram ga'u'o/ /pra pā dha mbi/ skra shad dang /kaṅka ti ka /so mangs te/ ba so la sogs pa la byas pa skra byi dor byed pa'i cha byad do/ /me long la/ daze ṇa dang / ma ku ra dang / ā darsha/ kun mthong zhes pa rnams so/ /de nas/ byañdza nam/ rlung yab dang / ta la dṛtta shaṃ/ bsil yab ces pa ste/ de rnams la mi'i sde tshan no// //de nas bram ze la sogs pa'i sde las/ thog mar rigs tsam gyi ming la/panta ti/ rgyu dang / god gnyis rigs dang / dza nan/ chos 'phrang dang /ku la ru ba rigs dang / a bhi dza na rtsa lag dang / a nu ya/ rjes skyes sam/rjes 'gro dang baṃ sha /rigs rgyud dang / a na bā ya/ tsa khri dang / sadhān/rgyud do/ /rigs de rnams bzhi ste/ bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje rigs dang / dmangs rigs rnams so/ /bram ze la ming drug ste/ dri dza/110—1023

gnyis skyes te/ bram ze dang / bya dang / so rnams la'o a gra/ dzadma/sngon skyes ste/ rigs bzhi thog mar bram ze skyes zhes grag go/ /bhū de dbang pa'i lha'o/ /bā ṭa brta can no/ /bi sra/ bram ze'o/ /shāhma ṇa/ tshangs pa'i bu ste/ bram ze rnams tshangs pa'i kha las skyes par grag go/ /mkhas pa'i ming gi rnam grangs la 'dir nyi shu rtsa gsum ste/ bid bān/rig pa can rig ldan dang / bi biṣṭa ta rnam gsal dang / ro ṣa dzñā/ nyes pa shes dang / sad mdzes ldan dam pa dang / su bye blo bzang dang / ko ba di / ci yang rig dang / budha/ rtog ldan dang / dhīr/ brtan pa dang /pa bhā ṣi snyo/ sems shes dang / pradzñā shes rab can dang sam khya na/ grangs can dang / paṇḍi ta mkhas pa'am 'dzangs pa dang / ka bi/ snyan ngags mkhan dang ddhālān/ blo ldan dang / sru ri dpa' bo dang / kra ta go ba can/kresti / mkhas pa dang / lanta/ barha grags ldan nam/ grags thob dang /rnam par dngas pa'i rnam par gsal ba dang / du ra dadhi/ ring du mthong dang / dīrgha rirsha/ thos ldan dang / sgonda pa/ sdeb spyor shes zhes pa rnams so// //rgyal rigs kyi sde las rgyal po'i ming la/ rā dza/ rgyal po dang / ba ru dza/ dpung skyes te/ rgyal rigs rnams tshangs pa'i dpung pa las skyes par grags pa'o/ /kṣa dre ya/ rma skyob ces bya ste rgyal rigs so/ /bi rā ḍa/bi rnam par rgyal dang / rā ḍa/ gsal ba'am/ rgyal po'o/ /pāze ba/sa bdag dang / smra byug /sa spyod dang / bri pa/ mi bdag dang / byu ba/sa skyong dang / ma tī kṣi ti/ sa gzhi skyong ba'o/ /adhī shā ra/ lhag pa'i 110—1024

dbang phyug ste/ rgyal bran du mas btud pa'i rgyal po dang / tsakra brti/'khor lo bsgyur ba dang / sarpā sgo mo/ sa kun dbang rnams so// //glang po che'i ming la/ brnyi/ so ldan dang / ba la/ stobs ldan dang / hastu/ lag ldan dang / dī ra da/ so gnyis pa dang / a nee ka pa / mang po 'thung dang / dī pa/ gnyis 'thung dang / ma taig dza/glang mo skyes rnams so// //rta spyi'i ming la/ sgo ṭa ka /'dren byed dang / bī ti/ chu 'thung dang / tu ra ga /tu ram̐ ga /tu ram̐ gam/ rnams myur 'gro'am/ 'gro mgyogs zhes bya'o/ /bā dzi gshog pa can dang / bā haṃ/ bzhon pa dang / arna rta dang / garnya rna / 'gro byed dang / ha ya/ rta dang / seddhāb rgya mtsho skyes te/ lan tshwa dang / ral kri yong / /sapta yang bdun ldan rnams so// //rta khyad par can gyi ming la/ ā dzā ni ya/ cang shes dang / ku mānta/gye leng dang / bi nī/ rta rnams 'dul dang / pādhu ba hri ni/ legs 'gro dang / bā na yu dza dang / pā ra tpā ka dang / tīsnadza/ rpā hri kṣa ta ya/ rnams yul de dag tu skyes pa'i ming te/ rim pa bzhin/ bā na'i yul skyes par sig skyes / 'dar byed skyes dang / me ldan skyes zhes bya'o// //phun sum tshogs pa la ming bzhi ste/ sasbra/ phun tshogs dang / sambitta/'byor ldan dang / shrī/ dpal lam/ g.yang dang / lasmre/ phun sum tshogs pa'am/ dpal lam/ shes pa'o/ / lku'achi ba med pa'i mdzod kyi 'grel pa 'dod 'jo'i ba mo zhes bya ba/ slob dpon rab 'byor zla bas mdzad pa las/ bstod kyi cha cung zad bsdus nas bsgyur ba rdzogs so// //110—1025

༄༅/ /snyan ngag me long / 1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ kā 2byu darsha/ bod skad du/ snyan ngag me long / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdong bzhi gdong gi pad tshal gyi/ /ngang pa'i bu mo thams cad dkar/ /dbyangs can ma ni kho bo yi/ /yid la ring du gnas par mdzod/ /bstan bcos snga ma rnams bsdus shing / /sbyor ba rnams kyang nyer mtshon te/ /ji ltar nus bzhin bdag gis ni/ /snyan ngag rnams kyi —mtshan nyid bya/ /'di na kun du mchog rnams kyang 5/ /mchog gi rjes su bstan pa yi/ /tshig rnams nyid kyi drin kyis ni/ /'jig rten lugs la 'jug par byed/ /gal te sgra don snang ba ni/ /'khor ba'i bar du mi gsal 9na/ /'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag 'di/ /smag rum mun pa nyid du 'gyur/ /sngon gyi rgyal po grags pa'i gzugs/ /ngag gi rang bzhin me long thob/ /de dag nye bar 110—1029

mi gnas kyang / /rang nyid nyams pa med la ltos/ /mkhas pas yang dag rab sbyar ba'i/ / ngag ni ngag gi 'dod 'jor bshad1/ /de nyid nyes par sbyar na 2slar/ /sbyor po ba lang nyid rjod byed / /de phyir snyan ngag dag la skyon / /chung bar gyur kyang ci zhig ltar/ /btang snyoms mi bya lus mdzes kyang / /skyon gcig gis ni skal ngan 'gyur/ /skye bo bstan bcos mi shes pas//yon tan skyon dag ji ltar dbye/ /gzugs kyi dbye ba dmigs pa'i skabs/ /long ba dag la yod dam ci/ /de phyir mkhas pas skye dgu rnams/ / bye brag rtogs la mngon dgongs nas/ /rnam bkra lam ldan tshig rnams kyi/ /bya ba'i cho ga nges par sbyar/ /de rnams kyis ni snyan ngag gi5/ /lus dang rgyan yang rab tu bstan/ /lus ni re zhig 'dod pa yi/ /don kyi rnam bcad tshig gi phreng / /de yang tshigs bcad lhug pa dang / /spel ma rnam 6gsum nyid du gnas / /tshigs bcad rkang bzhi de yang ni7/ /z-itta dzā ti zhes rnam gnyis/ /de yi spros pa mtha' dag ni/ /sdeb sbyor gzhung du nges par bstan/ /rig de snyan ngag rgya mtsho ni/ /zab mo brgal 'dod rnams kyi gru/ /grol ba dang ni rigs dang mdzod/ /'dus pa zhes bya de 'dra yiḍa/ /tshigs bcad rgya che sargas bcings/ /cha shas rang bzhin phyir ma brjod/ /sargas bcings pa snyan ngag che/ /de yi mtshan nyid brjod par bya/ /shis brjod phyag bya dngos po ni/ /nges par bstan pa'ang de yi sgo/ /sngon byung gtam las gyur pa'am/ /cig shos legs pa la brten pa/ /sde bzhi 'bras bu'i dbang gyur dang / /mkhas shing yid 'ong 'dren pa dang / /grong khyer rgya mtsho ri dang dus/ /nyi zla 'char ba'i bsngags ⑫pa dang / /skyed tshal chu yi rol rtsed dang / /chang 'thung 110—1030

dga' ba'i dga' ston dang / / ma tshogs pa dang shebag ma dang / /gzhon nu skye dang 'phel ba dang / /gros dang pho nya bgrod pa dang / /g.yul dang 'dren pa dar bas kyang / /brgyan par gyur cing mdor bsdus min/ /nyams dang 'gyur ba dag gis gtams/ /sarga shin tu rgya che min/ /mnyan 'os z-itta legs mtshams sbyar/ /kun du sarga dag gi mtha'/ /tha dad ldan pas 'jig rten mdzes/ /snyan ngag dam pa'i rgyan ldan ni/ /bskal pa'i bar du gnas par 'gyur/ /gang zhig yan lag 'gas dman yang / /gal te sbyar rnams phun tshogs kyis/ /de rig mgu bar byed pas na/ /'di 2ni snyan ngag skyon ma yin/ /thog mar 'dren pa yon tan gyis/ /nye bar bkod nas de yis ni/ /dgra la gnod pa byed ces pa'i/ /lam 'di rang bzhin mdzes pa yin/ /rigs dang brtson 'grus thos sogs kyis/ /dgra bo la yang bsngags byas nas//de las rgyal phyir 'dren pa ni/ /khyad 'phags brjod pa'ang —bdag dga' skyes5//rkang pa med pa'i tshig rgyun ni/ /lhug pa brjod pa dag dang gtam/ /zhes pa de yi rab dbye gnyis/ /de la 'dran pa nyid kyis ni/ /brjod par bya ba brjod pa lo/ /gzhan ni 'dren pa'am gzhan gyis kyang / /rang gi yon tan bsgrags skyon 'dir/ /yang dag don bsngags phyir yod min/ /'on kyang nges pa ma mthong ste/ /der yang gzhan gyis brjod pa'i phyir/ /gzhan gyis brjod dam rang gis zhes/ /dbye ba'i rgyu ni ci zhig yod / /gal te sgo dang gzhan sgo dang / /yid brten sheldan nyid brjod pa ni/ /tha dad pa yi rtags yin na/ /zhar gyi gtam rnams dag la yang / /'phags pa sogs bzhin sgo dang ni/ /gzhan gyi sgo dag cis mi 'jug /lambha sogs sam a —shā sa'i/ /110—1031

dbye ba mthong yang de las ci/ /de phyir gtam dang brjod pa zhes/ /ming gnyis dag gis rigs gcig mtshon1/ /lhag ma brjod pa'i rigs rnams kyang / /'di nyid nad du 'dus par 'gyur/ /bu mo 'phrog dang g.yul dang ni/ /bslu dang dar ba la sogs pa/ /sargas bcings pa mtshungs pa nyid/ /de dag khyad byed yon tan min/ /snyan ngag mkhan gyis bsam byas rtags/ /gzhan du yang ni skyon mi 'gyur/ /'dod don bsgrub la sgo ru ni/ /mkhas pa rnams la cis mi 'gyur/ /spel ma zlos gar la sogs te/ /de dag rnams ni gzhan na rgyas / /thog pa tshigs bcad rang bzhin gang / /tsam bu zhes pa mngon par brjod/ /ngag gi —rang bzhin de dag kyang / /legs sbyar de bzhin rang bzhin dang / /zur chag 'dren ma zhes pa ste/ /rnam pa bzhi ru mkhas pas gsungs / /legs sbyar zhes pa lha yi ni/ /skad du drang srong chen pos gsungs / /de skyes de mtshungs yul can zhes/ / rang bzhin rim pa du ma yod5 / /yul 'khor chen po la brten skad/ /legs bshad rin can 6dag gi mtsho/ /se rus bcings pa rang bzhin gang / /rang bzhin mchog tu gyur par rig / sau ra rwase na go ḍa dang / /lā ḍi 9gzhan yang de 'dra'i skad/ /rang bzhin nyid ces bya ba yi—/ /tha snyad rnams la nye bar 'gyur/ /ba lang rdzi la sogs pa'i tshig /snyan ngag la zur chag ces gnas/ /bstan bcos rnams la legs sbyar las/ /gzhan pa zur chag nyid du brjod/ /legs sbyar sargas bcings la sogs/ /rang bzhin skandha ka sogs dang — / /zur chag o sa ra sogs te/ /zlos gar la sogs 'dres pa'o/ /gtam sogs skad ni thams cad dang / /legs sbyar kyis kyang bcings pa ste/ /rmad byung don can 710—1032

rgya che'i gtam/ /'byung po'i skad kyi 1rang bzhin brjod/ /sgeg dang rol dang stabs la sogs/ /lta 2ba'i don yin cig shos kyang / /mnyan par bya ba nyid ces pa/ /'di yang lugs gnyis dag tu brjod/ /phan tshun dbye ba phra mo can/ /tshig gi lam ni du ma yod/ /de la bai dasgo dang ni/ go ḍa'i khyad par gsal bar zubarjod/ /sbyar ba rab dwangs mnyam nyid dang / /snyan dang shin tu gzhon pa dang / /don gsal ba dang rgya che dang 3/ /brjid dang mdzes dang ting nge 'dzin/ /yon tan 'di bcu bai darbha'i/ /lam kyi srog tu bshad pa yin/ /'di dag phal cher bzlog pas ni/ /go ḍa'i lam dag mtshon pa yin/ /sbyar ba tresrog chung yi ge mchog /lhod pa nyid kyis ma reg pa'o7/ /lhod pa mā khā tī mā la༄ / /lo lā li ka li khā bzhin/ /go ḍa pa yi rjes khrid blos—/ /de 'dod mā la ṭī dā ma/ /lo ghi tai blu ma riḥzhes/ /bee darbha yi 1 spyor lci byed/ /rab dngas ldan pa grags don can/ /zla ba'i mtshan ma utpal gyi—/ /'od kyis mdzes pa rgyas sazhes pa/ /rtogs pa'i skal bzang ldan pa'i tshig /nges tshig yod phyir go ḍa pa / /shin tu grags pa min yang 'dod/ /shin tu dkar min chu las skyes/ /de 'dras mtshan pa 'od dkar can—/ /mnyam pa sbyor ba mi mnyam dralas/ /de ni 'jam rtsub bar ma ste/ /sbyor ba 'jam rtsub bar ma yi/ /yi ge bkod pa'i skye gnas can/ /khu byug ca co sgrog byed cing / /nyar ma rab 'thor dwangs shing dwangs/ /chu rgyun chu thigs kyis bran pa'i/ /ma la ya rlung bdag la 'ongs7/ /tsandan gyis bsgos 7dri ldang zhing / /'jam pa ma la ya yi rlung / /bdag gi brtan 'gog dga' ma ni/ /mchog gi kha yi rlung dang 'gran/ /zhes pa mi mnyam ma brtags par/ /don 110—1033

dang rgyan kyi tūtshogs dag la/ /ltos nas shar phyogs pa dag la/ /snyan ngag lam 'di 'byung bar 'gyur4 / /snyan pa nyams ldan tshig dang ni/ /dngos po la yang nyams gnas pa/ /sbrang rtsi spyod pa sbrang rtsis bzhin/ /gang gis ④blo ldan dga' byed pa'o/ /sgra ni gang dang ci yis kyang / /gang zhig mtshungs par nyams myang chob/ /de yi gzugs sogs tshig nye ba/ /rjes su khrid bcas nyams dang ldan/ /gang tshe bram ze ayodaga' ba yi/ /rgyal po 'di yis dpal thob 'gyur/ /de nas bzung ste chos kyi ni/ /dga' ston 'jig rten 'di ru 'byung 6/ /zhes 'di go ḍa pa kyemi 'dod/ /de dag rjes su khrid la dga'/ /phal cher rjes su khrid pas kyang / /bai dasnya ni 'di nyid 'dod/ /rkang pa rnams dang tshig rnams la/ /yi ge bskor ba rjes su khrid/ / gal te snga ma'i nyams myong ni/ /'du byed rtog byed thumi ring nyid/ /ston mtshan dbu ⑨rgyan zla ba ni/ /kunda'i phon por 'khrul pa la/ /mtshan ma ind+ra nī la mtshungs/ /bung ba'i dpal ni yang dag 'dzin/ /mdzes ma mkha' la zla ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor mdzes pas ⑫bdag gi yid/ /yid srubs kyis mnan brtse med du/ /'joms par brtson pa 'di la ltos/ /zhes pa shin tu mi ring bar thos pa dag ni rjes khrid 'dod/ /dga' ma/ bzhin kyi chu skyes dang / /mtshungs pa zla ba zhes mi 'dod/ /bdag gi lus dang khro ba phra/ /'dod pa rtsub cing mdza' bo ngan/ /khengs pa nyams shing chags pa rgyas/ /rmongs pa skyes te srog rnams song / /zhes sogs sbyor ba rtsub pa dang / /lhod pa yang ni ster bar byed—/ /de phyir de lta'i rjes khrid ni/ /lho phyogs pa rnams ⑪mi sbyor ro/ /skor ⑫ba kho na tshogs pa yi/ /spyod yul zung dang ldan par rig /de yang gcig 110—1034

tu snyan pa min/ /de phyir phyi nas bshad byepar bya/ /nges par rgyan rnams kun la yang / /don gyi nyams dag sbyin par byed/ /de lta na yang grong pa nyid/ /min pa'i 2khur 'di phal cher 'dzin/ /'dod ldan bdag la gzhon nu da ma/ /spyod ni ji ltar 'dod mi byed/ /ces 'di grong pa'i don bdag nyid/ /nyams dang bral ba kho nar byedace/ /g.yon mig 'dod pa gtum po 'di5/ /nges par bdag la brtse ba med/ /khyod la khro med dga' zhes pa/ /grong pa'i don min ro dang ldan/ /sgra la'ang grong pa nyid yod de/ /de ni legs pa'i cig 'ushos grags/ /dga' ba'i dga' ston brjod pa la/ /ji ltar ya yig la sogs bzhin / /tshig gi mtshams sbyor kyis zhugs dang / /slar yang ngag don dag gis kyang / /nges par rtogs byed grong pa ste/ /yā 3bhaḥb taḥpri ya bzhin/ /gzhan la bsnun nas skyes bu ni/ / birya ldan pa'i bi shranta/ /gzhan la bsnun nas skyes bu ni/ /khu ba ldan pa rnam par ngalanee/ /de lta bu sogs lam dag ni// gnyis ka la yang shebasngags ma yin/ /bha ga ba tī bha gi byā/ /zhes sogs kun du khas len nyid/ /de ltar snyan pa 1rnam par phye/ /shin tu gzhon lkepa bshad par bya/ /rtsub min yi ge mang ba 'ditshi/ /shin tu gzhon pa nyid du 'dod—/ /gang phyir thams cad mnyen pa ni/ /sbyor ba lhod pa'i skyon du bshad—/ /sprin kyi phreng ba ldan dus su/ /snyan par sgrogs mapa'i mgrin ldan pa/ /rma bya yi ni mjug ma dag /zlum por byas nas gar byed do/ /zhes pa don rgyas nyid ma yin/ /rgyan yang de 'dra yod min te/ /shin tu gzhon pa nyid kyi dperte—/ /dam pa rnams kyi kha na gnas/ /gas la phyir gzhan dag phal cher ni/ /brjod ⑫par dka' ba dag kyang sbyor/ /n+yakṣas rgyal rigs rnams kyi phyogs/ /110—1035

skad cig gis ni nyams par byas/ /don gsal don brtag mi dgos nyid/ /'phrog byed kyis ni sa gzhi dag /rmig pas bcad pa'i klu khrag gis/ /dmar ba chu yi gter las phyung / /phag pa chen po dag gis sa/ /chu gter dmar po dag las phyung / /zhes pa 'di nyid bstan pa ni/ /brang 'gro'i khrag ni nyubartag dgos nyid/ /lam 'di gnyis ka dag la yang / /rtogs pa'i skal bzang mi ldan zhing / /sgra dang rigs pa las 'gongs ༄ pa/ /'di 'dra phal cher bzhed ma yin/ /gang du 'ga' zhig brjod pa la/ /khyad 'phags ldan pa'i yon tan rtogs / /de ni rgya cher brjod de 4des/ /snyan ngag lam kun pamagon dang bcas / /slong ba rnams kyi bkren pa'i mig /lan cig khyod gdong la lhung ba//lha gcig gnas skabs de yis slar/ /gzhan kyi gdong la blta ༄ ma yin/ /zhes pa nyid kyi ngag 'di la/ /gtong ba khyad 'phags legs par mtshan3/ /lam 'di nyid kyis gzhan dag kyang / /rigs pa mtshungs pas dpag par bya/ /bsngags par 9'os pa'i khyad par dang / /ldan pa rgya cher 'ga' zhig 'dod/ /rol pa'i chu skyes rtse dga'i mtsho/ /gser gyi rgyan la sogs pa bzhin/ /brjid pa tshig sdud mang po nyid/ /'di ni lhug pa dag gi gsos / /tshigs bcad la yang shar phyogs pa/ / 'di nyid dpung dang gnyen du bzhed/ /de la lci dang yang ba rnams/ /mang dang nyung ba nyid spel bas/ /mtho dma' yi ni rnam pa de/ /brjod pa la sogs rnams la blta/ /nub kyi ri mgor lhung ba yi//mtha' dag nyi 'od mal stan can/ /mkhregs pa'i nu ma la gnas pa'i/ /gos dmar g.yo mubazhin chu ldan ma/ /zhes pa brjid dang ldan pa'i tshig /tshigs sabacad la yang shar pa sbyor/ /gzhan dag 'khrugs skyemin mdzes pa yi tshig 110—1036

rnams brjid 3par 'dod de dper/ /chu 'dzin ngos kyi phang na chags —/ /mtshams kyi nyi 'od gos dang ldan/ /chu ldan ma yis su yi yid/ /'dod pas gzir bar byed mi 'gyur/ /mdzes pa 'jig rten don dag las/ /ma 'das 'gro kun la mdzes pa'o/ /de yang gtam kyi ༄ mngon brjod dang / /bsngags pa la sogs rnams la'ang sbyar/ /dka' thub phung po khyod 'dra yi/ /zhabs kyi rdul ni gtsang ma rnams/ /yang dag btab pa gang yin pa/ /de dag kho na nges par khyim/ /skyon med lus can khyod kyi ni/ /lag pa'i 'khri shing bar dag tu/ /nu ma rab rgyas 'di dag gi/ /go skabs rnyed 4par 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes pa khyad par brjod pa yi/ /legs sbyar de dag srid pa nyid/ /'jig rten lugs kyi rjes su ni/ / 'brang ba 5thams cad mdzes par 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'das shing brjod 'dod kyis/ /don gang shin tu bkod gyur pa/ /de yis mkhas pa shin tu ni/ /tshim 'gyur cig shos ma yin dper/ /deng nas bzung ste 7bdag gi khyim/ /lha yi khyim bzhin bsten par 'os/ /khyod kyi zhabs rdul lhung ba yis/ /nyes pa dag ni ma lus bkrus8/ /khyod kyi nu ma 'di lta bur9/ /rnam par rgyas par gyur pa 'di/ /nges par ma brtags byed po yiri / /nam mkha' dag ni chung ngur sprul/ /'di ni ha cang brjod pas na/ /go ḍa pa mul mdzes par brjod/ /'jug pa snga ma gzhan gyi ni/ /lam la snying po nyid du bshad/ /gzhan gyi chos de gzhan dag nyu3la/ /'jig rten lugs kyi rjes 'brangs nas / /gang du yang dag 'dzin byed pa/ /ting nge 'dzin du brjod de mudaper/ /ku mu da ni mig 'dzums shing rke/ /padma dag kyang mig 'byed ces/ /mig gi bya ba bkod pa las/ /de yi rjod byed sgra dag 110—1037

thob / /niju ta dang udhī rṇa/ /skyugs 1sogs phal par 'jug bstan zhe pa/ /shin tu mdzes te gzhan du ni/ /grong ba nyid kyi nus pa bstan 1/ /padmas nyi zer skyugs pa rnams4/ /'thungs nas rdul dmar skyugs pa yi/ /kha yi dag byed zer ma rnamasamu/ /shin tu sgyugs par byed pa bzhin/ /zhes pa mdzes te mi mdzes pa/ /chung ma sgyug pa —byed ces pa'o/ /cig car nyid du chos du ma/ /bkod pa dag kyang 'dod de dper/ /lci ba'i mngal khur gyis ngal zhing / /'khun par byed pa sprin kyi phreng / /'di dag g.yo med stong gi ni/ /phang pa dag tu yang dag nyal/ /grogs mo'i phang par nyal ba dang / /'khun dang lci ba nyid dang ngal/ /zhes pa 'di 7ni mngal ldan ma'i/ /chos mang po rnams gzhan la bstan/ /ting 'dzin zhes bya'i tsuyon tan gang / /'di ni snyan ngag bdog kun te/ /snyan ngag mkhan po don mthun gyi/ /tshogs kyang 'di nyid rjes su 'brang / /de ltar rang bzhin brtags pa las/ /lam ni 'di gnyis rnam par phye/ /de dag dbye ba snyan ngag mkhan/ /so so la gnas brjod mi nus/ /bur shing 'o ma bur sogs kyi/ /mngar ba nyid kyis khyad par che/ /de lta rtamod kyi de brjod par/ /dbyangs can mas kyang nus ma yin/ /rang bzhin gyis grub spobs pa dang / /mang du thos pa dri med dang / /mngon par sbyor ba mi dman pa/ /snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ /gal te sngon gyi bag chags yon tan kyi/ /rjes 'brel spobs pa rmad byung med pa la'ang / /thos dang 'bad pa dag gis ngag bsten na/ /ci zhig ltar yang nges par rjes 'dzin byed/ /de phyir grags 'dod rnams kyis rtag tu ni/ /snyom mulas med par rim pas dbyangs can bsten/ /snyan ngag chung ngu la yang 110—1038

ngal byas mi/ /mkhas pa'i 'dun hūṃs dag tu 'dug la dbang / /snyan ngag me long las le'u ste dang po'o// //snyan ngag mdzes par byed pa yi/ /chos rnams rgyan zhes rab tu brjod/ /de ni da lta'ang rnam rtog ste/ /de dag ma lus sus 'chad nusabye / /'on kyang rnam rtog sa bon ni/ /sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis bstan/ /de nyid rab tu legs sbyar phyir/ /yongs su ngal 'di bdag gi'o/ /lam ni rnam par dbye don du/ /rgyan 'ga' zhig ni sngar yang bstan/ /thun mong dag tu rgyan gyi ni//rigs gzhan rab tu bstan par bya/ /rang bzhin brjod dang dpe dang ni/ /gzugs can gsal byed bskor ba dang / /'gog dang don gzhan bkod pa dang / /ldog pa can dang srid pa can4/ /bsdus dang phul byung rab brtags dang / /rgyu dang phra mo cha dang rim/ /dga' dang nyams ldan gzi brjid can/ /rnam grangs brjod dang kun du phan/ /rgya che bsnyon dor sbyar ba dang / /khyad par mtshungs par sbyor ba dang / /'gal dang skabs min bstod pa dang / /zol stod sanges par bstan pa dang / /lhan cig brjod dang yongs brjes shis 6 / /rab spel de nas dgongs pa can/ /'di dag tshig rnams dag gis 3ni/ /rgyan du sngon kyi mkhas pas bstan/ /dngos po rnams kyi rang bzhin dang / /gnas skabs sna tshogs dngos snyegasal byed/ /de ni rang bzhin brjod pa ste/ /dang po'i rgyan yin rigs sogs (dper/ /mchu ni dmar zhing gug pa dang / /gshog pa ljang zhing mnyen pa dang / /mgrin pa kha dog sum phreng can/ /nee tso 'di dag tshig 'jam ldan/ /mgrin pa'i nang nas snyan sgogs shing bye/ /mig 110—1039

ni kun du 'phrul pa yi/ /phug ron rtse 'dod dga' ma la/ /yongs su bskor nas mchu dag sbyor/ /dga' ma yi ni reg pa 'disakye/ /lus la spu lang bye rgyas pa dang / /yid ni bde bar byed pa dang / /mig dag zum par byed cing 'jug /mgrin sngon lag na thod pa ni/ /gnas pa zla ba'i cod pan dang / /snum zhing dmar ba'i ral pa can/ /khyu mchog rgyal mtshan 'khrungs par gyurasnye/ /rigs dang bya ba yon tan rdzas/ /rang bzhin brjod pa 'di 'dra niche/ /bstan bcos kun 5la rgyal srid nyid/ /snyan ngag la yang 'di dag 'dod/ /ji lta 6ci zhig ltar mtshungs par/ /gsal bar gang du rtogs byed pa/ /de ni dpe zhes bya ste de'i/ /spros pa 'di ni rab bshad bya/ /mdzes ma khyod kyi lag mthil ni/ /chu skyes bzhin du kun du dmar/ /zhes pa chos dpe dngos su ni/ /mtshungs pa'i chos dag bstan phyir ro/ /khyod kyi gdong ni padma bzhin/ /mig dag 7utpal sngon po bzhin/ /zhes pa chos cig 8rtogs byed pa/ /de ni dngos po'i dpe nyid do/ /khyod kyi gdong bzhin padma ni/ /rnam par rgyas par gyur zhes pa/ /de ni grags pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /bzlog pa'i dpe zhes bya bar 'dod/ /khyod kyi zhal bzhin chu skyes te/ /chu skyes bzhin du khyod kyi zhal/ /zhes pa phan tshun khyad 'phags ni/ /rjod par byed 'di phan tshun dpe/ /khyod zhal padma nyid dang mtshungs/ /gzhan ni 'ga' zhig dang yang min/ /zhes pa mtshungs pa gzhan bzlog 9phyir/ /'di ni nges par ༄ 7nyid kyi dpe/ /re zhig khyod gdong padma yi/ /rjes 'gro gzhan yang de 'dra ba/ /gal te yod na de byed 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di ni nges med dpe/ /khyod gdong mdzes pa kho na yis//zla ba'i rjes su 'gro min te/ /dga' bskyed las kyis kyang zhes pa/ /'di 110—1040

'dra bsdus pa'i dpe yang yod/ /khyod kyi zhal ni khyod nyid la/ /mthong zhing zla ba mkha' la mthong / /'di nyid kho na tha dad de/ /gzhan med ces ni ①phul byung dpe/ /de yi bzhin dpal nga nyid la/ /yod ces zla ba snyems mi dgos—/ /padma la yang de yod phyir/ /zhes pa 'di ni rab brtag dngha snadape/ /smin legs gal te padma 'ga'/ /rnam par 'phrul pa'i mig ldan na/ /khyod kyi bzhin kyi dpal 'dzin te/ /zhes pa 'di ni rmad byung dpe/ /lus phra khyod gdong ri bong can/ /zhes btags 1khyod gdong bsam pa yi / /zla ba 'di sa yang rjes su bsnyags6/ /zhes 'di rmongs pa'i dpe ru bshad/ /pad nang bung ba 'khor ram ci/ /khyod gdong la mig g.yo 'am ci/ /bdag gi sems ni rnam par g.yo/ /zhes pa 'di ni the tshom dpe/ /zla ba skyengs byed mdzes pa 'di / /zla bas tshar gcod padma min/ /de phyir khyod kyi gdong nyid do/ /zhes 'di gtan la phebs 3pa'i dpe/ /bsel zer can kyi 'gran 5zla dang / /dpal dang ldan dang dri bzangs kyi9/ /khyod kyi gdong ni chu skyes bzhin/ /zhes pa sbyar ba'i dpe ru bshad/ /mtshungs pa'i sgra yis brjod bya'i phyir/ /mnyam nyid dpe ste ji ltar na/ /skyed tshal phreng 'di bu mo bzhin/ /mdzes ldan sā la kā na na/ /padma rdul mang zla ba 'dzad/ /de dag las ni khyod kyi bzhin / /mtshungs pa la yang khyad par bcas/ /zhes pa smad pa'i dpe ru 'dod—/ /padmas tshangs pa — /mchog tu bskyed/ /zla ba bde 'byung gtsug gis 'dzin—/ /de dag khyod gdong mtshungs zhes pa/ /de ni bsngags pa'i dper brjod do/ /yon tan ldan yang skyon 'gyur /1yang / /zla ba khyod gdong mtshungs zhes pa/ /brjod 'dod bdag gi yid la yod/ /ces pa brjod 110byed1041

'dod dpe zhes rig /'dab brgya pa dang ston zla dang / /khyod kyi gdong /hūṃ dang gsum po ni/ /phan tshun rnam par du 'gal zhes pa/ /de ni 'gal ba'i dpe ༄/brjod do/ /dri ma ldan zhing blun gyur pasacho/ /zla ba la ni khyod gdong dang / /'gran pa'i nus pa nam yang med/ /ces pa dgag pa'i dpe nyid do/ /khyod gdong ri dwags mig gis mtshan/ /zla ba ri dwags nyid kyis mtshan/ /de lta na yang 'di mtshungs nyid/ /khyad 'phags min zhes ngo bstod 3 dpe/ /'di ni bzhin nyid padma min/ /'di khudag bung ba ma yin mig /ces pa rnam gsal mtshungs pa las/ /de ni de nyid brjod pa'i dpe/ /zla ba padma dag gi ni / /mdzes pa las 'das khyod kyi gdong / /bdag rang nyid dang mtshungs par gyur/ /zhes pa thun mong min pa'i dpe/ /padma mdzes pa'i snying po kun/ /'ga' zhig dag tu bsdus pa bzhin/ /khyod zhal rnam par mdzes zhes pa/ /de ni 'byung min dpe zhes rig /zla ba'i gzugs las dug bzhin dang / /tsandan las ni 7me bzhin du/ /zhal 'di las ni rtsub mo'i tshig /ces pa srid pa min pa'i dpe/ /tsandan chu dang zla ba'i zer/ /zla shel sogs bzhin khyod kyi ni/ /reg pa bsil zhes khyad par dag /gsal bar byed pa mang ba'i dpe/ /lus phra khyod kyi bzhin ras ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor las bton bzhin/ /padma'i nang nas phyung ba bzhin/ /zhes pa 'di ni rnam 'gyur dpe/ / 'od kyis nyi bzhin nyi ma yisasgo — / /nyin bzhin nyin gyis mkha' la bzhin/ /rnam par gnon pas khyod la dpal/ /'dzin zhes de ni phreng ba'i dpe/ /gang yang ngag don nyid kyis ni/ /gal te ngag don nyer 'jal na/ /ngag don dpe de bzhin sgra ni/ /gcig dang du mas de rnam gnyis/ /khyod gdong mig ni mi 110byed1042

brtan tshozhing / /so yi 'od zer rab gsal ba/ /'dam ༄ skyes bung ba g.yo ldan ni/ /ge sar dag gis mtshon snebazhin mdzes/ /padma can bzhin lus phra ma / /padma bzhin du de yi gdong / /sbrang rtsi spyod pas bzhin du ni/ /bdag gis 'thungs shing 'thungs shing rtses/ /dngos po 'ga' zhig nyer bkod nas / /de yi chos mthun rab bkod pa/ /mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa can/ /zla bo 4dngos po'i dpe yin dper/ /rgyal po rnams ni skyes gyur kyang / /da lta 5khyod 'dra gcig kyang med/ /yongs 'du dag la rkang 'thung ni/ /gnyis pa nges par yod ma yin / /lhag pas dman pa bya ba yi7/ /cho ga gcig la rab bsdus nas/ /gang smra sa de ni mtshungs pa dag /sbyor ba'i dpe ru bshad de dper/ /pu lo ma dgra mtho ris dang / /khyod kyis sa bsrung mel tshe byed//de yis dregs ldan lha min dang / /khyod kyis 9mi yi bdag po 'joms/ /rgyal po mdzes pas zla ba dang / /gzi byin gyis ni nyi ma dang / /brtan pas rgya mtsho'i rjes su byed/ /ces pa 'di ni rgyu dper dran/ /blo ldan mi dgyes med gang la/ /nges par dpe yi skyon dag ni/ /tha dad rtags dang tshig sal med/ /dman dang lhag pa nyid la'ang med/ /ma ning 'di 'gro bud med bzhin/ /bud med 'di smra skyes pa bzhin/ /bdag gi grogs 'di srog rnams bzhin/ /rig pa rnams bsgrub nor bzhin no/ /sa gzhi spyong ba khyod bzhin du/ /lha yi rgyal po rnam par mdzes/ /tsha zer can gyi nus pa la/ /mi bdag gzi yis 'gong bar nus/ /zhes pa de lta bu la sogs/ /skal bzang nam yang gtang min nyid/ /sbyor ba 'ga' la ngag rig rnams/ /mi dgyes pa yod ji ltar na/ /ngang mo bzhin du zla ba dkar/ /mtsho rnams bzhin du mkha' dri med/ /khyi 110—1043

—bzhin dpa' bo rje la gus/ /nyi ma bzhin du me khyer gsal/ /'di 'dra spangs te mkhas rnams kyis/ /rgyu yang 'dir ni bsam par byos/ /bzhin ltar lta bu ji ltar sgra/ /mthun mtshungs yang dag mtshungs dang mnyam/ /yang dag gsal dang nges par gsal/ /rab gsal gzugs kyi zla bo dang rte / /gnyen po dang ni dgra zla dang / / so sor rtog dang 'gal dang 'dra/ / blta bcas dang ni bslu ba dang / /rigs mthun rjes su smra ba dang / /gzugs brnyan dang ni so sor sdeb—/ /gzugs mtshungs mnyam dang yang dag gzhal5//mtshan nyid mthun 'dra mtshungs pa 6dang / /mthun phyogs dper byas dpe dang rtog /dman dang cung zad dman sogs dang / /rab tu smra dang so sor bzlog / rigs mthun mnyam byas sgra dag dang / /gang yang dman min don can tshig /ri bong mtshan ma'i gdong can sogs/ /'bru mang po yi tshig sdud dang / /'gran dang rgyal dang sdang ba dang / /'khu dang mi mthun sgrogs pa dang / /'thab pa dang rgo 'phya ba dang / /sma 'bebs byed dang smod pa dang / /co 'dri ba dang 'gog pa dang / /rgod dang phrag dog mi bzod dang / /de yi skal bzang 'phrog byed dang / /de yi mdzes pa zum byed dang / /de dag 'gran las tshar gcod dang / /de dag mtshungs las lhag par mdzesari / /de yi rjes su rkang 'jog dang / /de yi nus pa la mu'ajug dang / /de yi rjes 'gro rjes su 'ching / /de yi ngang tshul de 'gog dang / /de yi rjes su byed ces pa'i/ /sgra rnams mtshungs pa gsal byed yinamu/ /tha dad snang min gyur pa yi/ /dpe nyid dag ni gzugs can 'dod tshe/ /dpung pa 'khri shing lag pa ni / /padma sor mo yal 'dab bo/ /lag pa'i tshe'akhri shing sor mo rnams/ /1 10byed1044

yal 'dab sen mo'i 'od zer ni/ /me tog tu gyur dpyid kyi dpal/ /khyod ni nged la mngon sum rgyu/ /zhes pa 'di ni ma bsdus te/ /snga ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can no/ /bzhin zla 'dzum pa'i zla 'od ces1 / /gzugs can bsdus dang ma bsdus pa'o/ /sor mo dmar ba'i 'dab phreng dang / /sen mo'i 'od kyi ge sar can/ /khyod kyi zhabs kyi chu skyes ni/ /sa skyong rnams kyi spyi bor 'dzin/ /sor mo la sogs 4'dab sogs dang / /rkang pa padma nyid byas nas/ /de 'os gnas su rnam bkod pa5/ /'di ni mtha' dag gzugs can no/ /gtum mo glo bur nyid du ni/ /khyod gdong mchu 6yi yal 'dab g.yo/ /rngul gyi chu yi thig 7pa yi/ /dog pa mu tig 'od can 'dzin/ /'di ni rngul chu dog par byas/ /mchu yang yal 'dab nyid byas kyi/ /gdong ni rnam pa gzhan ma 9byas/ /de phyir cha shas gzugs can no/ /gdong pa'i 'dam skyes smin 'khyog —cing / /rngul gyi chu ni zags pa dang / /mig dag kun du dmar ba 'di/ /myos pa'i gnas skabs gsal bar byed/ /'dir ni gdong pa'i cha shas dag /rnam 'gyur ma byas sagadong pa nyid/ /padmar bkod byas des na 'di / /cha shas can kyi gzugs can no/ /mdzes ma myos pa'i mkhur tshos dmar / /mig gi —utpal dmar po can/ /khyod kyi gdong gis skye bo ni/ /'dir sayang dmar ba'i rang bzhin byas/ /'di ni yan lag gcig gzugs can / /de ltar 'dir lani gnyis sogs kyi/ /yan lag rnams kyang rtogs par byatso/ /ldan dang mi ldan tha dad byed/ /gdong 'di 'dzum pa'i me tog 'bar—/ /g.yo ba'i mig gi bung ba can/ /zhes pa me tog bung ba dag /'grogs pas ldan pa'i gzugs can no/ /gdong 'di 'dzum gsher zla 'od dang / /110byed1045

snum pa'i mig gi utpal can/ /zla 'od utpal mi ldan pas/ /ldan min zhes pa'i gzugs can no/ /yan lag can dang yan lag rnams/ /gzugs byas gzugs su 1ma byas la/ /brtan pas mi mnyam pa zhes pa'i/ /gzugs can mdzes pa yin te dper/ /myos pa'i mkhur tshos rab dmar zhing / /min ma'i 'khri 4shing gar byed pa/ /khyod gdong zla ba yid srubs kyis5/ /'jig rten gsum po gzhom 6par nus// /'phrog byed rkang pa dzasnu yi/ /bu mo'i chu bos rtse la btags/ /lha min dogs med lha dga' ba'i/ /dga' ston rgyal mtshan rgyal gyur cig /gang zhig tog gi khyad par kyis7/ /tshogs kyi gzugs ni 'di 'dra ba/ /de ni rkang pa la bkod 'di/ /khyad par dang bcas gzugs can no/ /padma rnams ni mi 'dzum zhing / /nam mkha' la yang mi 'gro ba/ /khyod gdong zla bas bdag gi ni/ /srog rnams 'phrog pa nyid du blta / /zla ba'i bya ba bya min dang / /gzhan kyi bya ba'i bya ba 'dir/ /yang dag bstan te de yi phyir/ /'gal ba zhes bya'i gzugs can no/ /khyod ni zab pas rgya mtsho ste/ /brling ba nyid kyis ri bo yin/ /'jig rten rnams la 'dod pa ni/ /ster phyir dpag bsam rkang 'thung ngo / /'di ni zab pa la sogs pa'i/ /rgyu rnams dag gis rgya mtsho ri/ /dpag bsam —shing yang byed nga/sa na/ /'di ni rgyu yi gzugs can no/ /grogs mo khyod kyi gdong pad ni/ /rā dza haṃ sas ྾nyer spyad 'os/ /dri zhim bung bas don gnyer 'os/ /zhes pa sbyar ba'i gzugs can no/ /gtso bo dang ni phal ba la/ /chos mthun chos mi mthun mthong bas/ /dpe dang ldog pa can zhes pa'i/ /gzugs can rnam pa gnyis 'dod dper/ /myos pas kun du dmar ba yis/ /bkab pa bzhin gyi 710byed1046

zla ba 'di/ /'char 1 ka'i dmar ba phun tshogs pa'i/ /zla ba la ni rab tu 'gran / /lha rnams kyis ni zla ba dang / /bdag gis khyod gdong zla ba 'thung //'di bee gang ba ma yin yang / /'di ni rtag tu dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /mdzes ma khyod gdong zla bas —ni/ /'di ltar gzhan dag gdung byed pas/ /zla ba nyid du brjod min zhes / /'di ni 'gog pa'i gzugs can no/ /gtum mo khyod gdong zla bas kyang / /brtse ba med par bdag sreg pa/ /bdag gi skal ba nyid kyi skyon/ /zhes 'di mnyam 'jog gzugs can no/ /khyod gdong 'dam skyes do ra 'dir/ /smin ma'i 'khri 4shing gar mkhan ma/ /jol sgeg dga' bas gar byed do/ /zhes pa 5gzugs can gyi gzugs can/ /'di ni gdong min 'di padma/ /'di dag mig min 'di bung ba/ /'di khyod so yi 'od zer min/ /'di rnams ge sar nyid yin no6/ /gdong la sogs pa nyid bzlog ste/ /padma la sogs gzugs byas pas/ /yon tan khyad 'phags gsal byed pa/ /de nyid bsnyon dor gzugs can no/ /gzugs can dpe yi rnam rtog rnams/ /mtha' yod ma yin de yi phyir/ / phyogs tsam bstan la blo ldan rnams7/ /ma brjod rjes su dpag par bya/ /rigs dang bya ba yon tan rdzas / /tshig gcig la ni gnas pa yis/ /gal te ngag kun la phan na/ /de ni gsal byed du brjod dper/ /lho yi rlung gis 'khri shing ni9/ /'dab ma rnying pa ldung bar byed/ /dud pa'i lus can rnams kyi yang / /khengs pa gsar du 'joms par nus/ /rgyu'o chu gter bzhi ngogs kyi/ /skyed mos tshal du so can te/ /khor yug ri bo'i khongs su yang / /khyod kyi yon tan kunda dkar / /sngo bsangs nyid do phyogs rnams ni/ /dbyar skyes sprin gyi phreng ba 110byed/047

yis / /sa yang rtswa sngon gsar pa 3ni/ /shin tu gzhon pa'i phreng bas so/ /khyab 'jug rnam gnon la gnas pas/ /dā nu'i bu yi 'byor ba dag /gang du btang zhing lha rnams kyi / /phun tshogs gang na gnas pa blangs/ /zhes pa dang po'i gsal byed bstan/ /de bzhin bar dang mtha' yi yang / /tshig dag bdag gis bstan par bya/ /de dag 'ga' zhig 'di lta ste/ /gar byed ni tsu la phang du/ /glu yang lan no mjug 4sgo can/ /dga' bas rgyas pa'i mig dag kyang / /chu 'dzin la ni gtod par byed/ /dri bzhon dal bu 'gyur byed de/ /zla ba dag kyang me ru 'gyur/ /tsandan byug pa thong ba yang / /mtshon lhung 'khyams pa rnams la'o/ /chu 'dzin gyis 6ni rab gtor chu/ /khyim gyi gtsug phud ldan pa'i tshogs/ /glog gi thag pa g.yo ba yang / /me tog gzhu can dag gis — dpung / /khyod kyi utpal rna ba la/ /'dod pa'i mda' ni mda' stan la/ /ngas kyang sems ni 'chi ba la/ /gsum po 'di ni mnyam du byas/ /dkar phyogs kyis ni 'od dkar can/ /'phel byed de yis mda' lnga pa/ /des kyang chags pa chags pas kyang / /na chung dga' ba'i dga' ston dpal/ /zhes sogs gsal byed yin mod kyang / /snga ma snga ma la ltos pa'i / /ngag gi phreng ba rab ldan rkaphyir/ /de ni phreng ba'i gsal byed 'dod/ /rlung gis gtsubs pa'i chu thigs can/ /sprin gyi salus med dag gis ni/ /a ba le ba 'phel bar byed/ /rngul kyi dag ni sel bar byed/ /'dir ni sprin gyi tshig dag dang / /a ba le ba'i tshig dag gis/ /bya ba 'gal ba ldan pa —de / /'gal ba'i don gyi gsal byed do/ /chu 'dzin dag gi phreng ba 'dis/ /phyogs rnams kyi ni go skabs phrogs /skar ma yi ma— tshogs rnams bzung chu / /110byed1048

deng yang bdag gi srog rnams len/ /gang phyir chu 'dzin phreng ba yi/ /bya ba gcig nyid gsal byed 'dir/ /du ma'i sgra yis nyer blangs pa/ /de phyir don gcig gsal byed do/ /dri yi bzhon 1pa yid 'ong mtho / /sngo bsangs ta ma la yi 'od/ /sprin ni mkha' la rgyu byed de/ /glang chen 'di dag sa la'o/ /'dir ni chos rnams tha dad min/ /sprin dang glang po rnams dag kyang / /rgyu ba nyid kyis 'byel pa'i phyir/ /sbyar ba'i don gyi gsal byed do/ /rnam pa 'di nyid kho na yis/ /gsal byed la ni rnam rtog pa/ /lhag ma rnams kyang rjes mthun par4/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis rtogs par bya/ /gsal byed kyi ni gnas nyid du/ /don skor 5dang ni tshig skor dang / /gnyis ka bskor ba zhes pa yi/ /rgyan gsum po dag 'dod de dper/ /ka daspa ni rnam par rgyas/ /ku ṭa dzoṅka ma 6rab gsal/ /kanda lya ni rab tu bye7/ /ka ku bha yang gyes par gyur / /sprin gyi phreng ba dag gis ni/ /rma bya'i tshogs rnams 'dod ldan byed/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan can gyis deng / /na chung rnams yid 'dod ldan byed/ /kun las rgyal nas de ring khyod/ /btsun mo rnams dang rtse bar byed/ /khyod kyi dgra sde mtho ris song / /lha mo rnams dang rtse bar byed/ /dgag pa brjod pa 'gog pa ste/ /dus gsum la ltos 9rnam pa gsum/ /de nas de yang dgag bya yi/ /dbye ba mtha' yas phyir mtha' yas/ /lus med kyi ni me tog gi / /mda' lngas kun las rgyal bar gyur/ /zhes pa mi srid yang na ni/ /dngos po'i nus pa rnam par bkra/ /zhes pa 'di 11ni rgyu stobs kyis/ /lus med rgyal bar mi rigs blo/ /de ltar gyur bkag de yi maphyir/ /'di 'dra de ni byung ba 'gog /snyan sgrogs snyem dag ci yi phyir/ /rna ba la ni utpal 'dzudaka /110byed1049

las 'di la ni mig zur dag /yongs rdzogs min par sems sam ci /'ga' zhig dkar min utpal la/ /rna bar byed la mdza' bo yis/ /de ltar bstod pas 'gog byed pa/ /'di ni mngon gyur 'gog pa'o/ /jo bo bden par smra bo bdag /gzhan dang tsuspa nas 'phos pa'i1/ /rgya skyegs kyis dmar mig gis ni/ / nam yang mthong bar 'gyur ma lags/ /sngar nyid shin tu khengs ldan mas/ /nam zhig 'di yi gnod pa dag /'byung ba de ltar 'gog byed pa/ /'di ni 'byung 'gyur 'gog pa'o/ /lus phra khyod kyi yan lag rnams/ /'jam pa nyid du gnas pa brdzun/ /gal te bden par 'jam pa na/ /glo bur du bdag ci la gdung / /gang phyir de ltar 'dod ldan gyis / /de dang 'gal ba'i chos kyis 'dir/ /bud med lus ni 'jam pa dag /'gog pa 'di ni chos 'gog pa'o/ /de ni mdzes sam ma yin zhes/ /rnam rig 5'di ni ci las skyes/ /der ni 'od tsam g.yo ba nyid/ /mthong bar 'gyur gyi 6rten ma yin/ /gang phyir gzugs can ma'i ngo mtshar/ /brjod pa 'dod pas 'od ces nga/'i/ /chos 'di khas blangs chos can dag /'gog 'di chos can 'gog pa'o/ /khyod kyi mig dag dmar gyur cing / /mchu yi yal 'dab g.yo ba dang / /smin ma 'khyog ste de lta na'ang / /nyes pa med pas bdag mi 'jigs / /gang phyir mdza' mo mamakhas pa yis/ /'jigs pa yi ni rgyu yi gtso / /rang gi nyes pa 'gog byed pa/ /'di dag 'dir ni rgyu 'gog pa'o/ /mdza' bo dag ni ring na gnas/ /chu 'dzeen bgrod ldan 'di ni 'ongs/ /ni tsu la yang rgyas par mthong / /bdag shi min pa 'di ci gang / /de rgyu chu 'dzin bgrod pa sogasas/ /mi bzad pa dgaster bkod nas/ /'bras bu 110—1050

'chi ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ /de ni 'bras bu 'gog pa'o/ /gal te gshegs na gshegs par mdzod/ /khyod kyi bgrod pas bdag la ni/ /gdung ba yun ring 'byung mi 'gyur/ /'di la khyod ni dogs mi 'tshal/ /zhes pa sne'achi ba gsal byed pas/ /rjes gnang nyid kyi sgo nas ni/ /mdza' bo'i bgrod pa 'gog byed pa / /de ni rjes gnang 'gog pa'o/ /nor ni mang po rnyed 'gyur zhing / /lam du yang ni bde zhing dge/ /bdag srog la yang the tshom med/ /'on kyang mdza' bo 'gro mi bya/ /mdza' bo 'gro bar sbyor ba yis / /rgyu rnams dag ni rab bshad nas/ /dbang nyid kyis ni de 'gog pa/ /'di 'dra dbang gis 'gog pa'o/ /bdag ni gson re stobs dang ldan/ /nor gyi bsam pa stobs ldan min/ /mdza' bo gshegs sam bzhugs lags sam/ /rang gi gnas skabs smos pa lags/ /gang phyir 'di ni chags ldan mas/ / ma gus bzhin du tshig sbyar nas—/ /mdza' bo'i bgrod pa 'gog byed pa5/ /'di ni ma gus 'gog pa'o/ /mdza' bo gal te gshegs na bzhud/ /khyod kyi lam ni shis gyur cig /gang du khyod ni gshegs pa der/ /bdag kyang skye ba nyid gyur cig /de ltar shis brjod lam gyi 7gang / /rang gi gnas skabs gsal byed mas / /mdza' bo'i bgrod pa 'gog byed pa/ /'di ni shis brjod kyis 'gog pa'o/ /gal te khyod 'gro bden nyid na/ /khyod kyis gzhan pa 'ga' zhig tshol/ /bdag ni glags 'tshol 9'chi ba yis/ /de ring nyid du 'gog par 'gyur/ /gang phyir mdza' ba'i dbang gyur mas/ /mdza' bo'i bgrod pa 'gog byed pa/ /tshig rtsub yi ge sngon 'gro can/ //de 7ni rtsub mos 'gog pa'o/ /gal te gshegs na myur du bzhud/ /phyi nas gnyen 'dun 'khrugs pa'i khas/ /110—1051

bsgrags pa'i cho nges 3'gro ba yi/ /gegs —gyur khyod kyi rna bar 'ong / /gang phyir 'dir di mtha' gcig tu / /chags mas grogs nyid byed pa yis/ /mdza' bo'i bgod pa 'gog pa 'di/ /grogs nyid kyis ni 'gog pa'o/ /bzhud ces khyod dgyes brjod 'dod kyang 5/ /bdag nyid dga' bar byed pa'i tshig /ma gshegs zhes pa kha nas ni/ /byung bar gyur la bdag ci byed/ /mi 'dod dngos la 'bad byas pas6/ /'bras bu phyin ci log bskyed pa'i3/ /don med nye bar bstan pa'i phyir/ /de ni 'bad pas 'gog pa'o/ /skad cig lta la gegs byed pa'i/ /rdzi ma bskyod pa la khro ba/ /khyod kyis mdza' la /'gro ba smos/ /bdag ni de yi 'dod pa 'dod/ /gang phyir mdza' ba'i gzhan dbang mas/ /don 'dir nye bar gsal byas nas/ /mdza' bo'i bgrod pa 'gog byed pa / /'di ni gzhan dbang 'gog pa'o/ /mgon po 'bral ba bzod par bgyi/ /gang gis mig bsgos dag la ni/ /'dod pas bsnun du mi mthong ba'i/ /mthong min mig sman bdag la stsol/ /'tsho ba'i thabs ni dka' ba dag /nye bar bkod nas bdag po ni/ /'gro ba 'gog par byed pa'i phyir/ /'di 'dra thabs kyis 'gog pa brjod/ /jo bo khyod kyi zhal nas tshig /bdag 'gro zhes pa nges par byung / /mdza' ba 2dman pa khyod kyis da/ /ma phyin na yang bdag la ci/ /mdza' ba rgyas pas ma bsdams pa'i/ /bdag nyid khro bas mdza' bo yi/ /'gro ba rtsom ྾pa bzlog pa gang / /de sloni khro bas 'gog pa'o/ /ma bsnom bu mo'i rna ba la/ /ma byas chang la ma btab par/ /khyod kyi dgra yi rdzing nyid du/ /utpal sngon po zegs par gyur/ /mya ngan bcas shing tsu utpa la/ /de 'os las ni bzlog byas nas/ /mya ngan 'os pa'i 110—1052

skabs ston phyir/ /'di ni mya ngan gyis 'gog pa'o/ /don 'di sne'aga' yang tshogs ma byas/ /rig pa 'ga' yang ma bsgrubs phyir / /dka' thub 'ga' yang ma bsags pa4/ /na tshod mtha' dag song bar gyur/ /gang phyir 5'di ni tshe song bas/ /don bsgrub 6la sogs 'gog 7pa ni/ /'gyod pa gtso bor ston byed pa/ /'di ni 'gyod pas 'gog pa'o/ /ci 'di ston dus chu 'dzin nam / /yang na ngang pa'i tshogs sam ci/ /sgra ni rkang ḍagadub kyi 'dra ba/ /thos pas de ni chu 'dzin min/ /chos 'di ngang pa la yod cing / /sprin gyi rigs la ma reg pas/ /gang zhig the tshom zlog byed pa/ /'di ni the tshom 'gog pa'o / /bdud rtsi'i bdag nyid padma la/ /sdang zhing snum pa'i dkar 'bras can / /khyod gdong zla ba 'di yod bzhin/ /zla ba gzhan gyis ci zhig bya/ /phal pa'i zla ba la brten pa/ /de mtshungs yon tan bstan byas nas/ /gtso bo'i zla ba 'gog byed pa/ /rnam pa de ltar sbyar ba'i sa'agog /thams cad mnan yang khyod kyis ni/ /rnam gnon tshim pa med pa mtshar/ / 'on kyang sreg 5za 'bar ba la/ /tshim pa dag ni nam zhig mthong / /gang phyir 'dir ni don gzhan dag /de yis chos mtshungs bstan byas nas/ /ya samatshan rtsom pa 'gog byed pa/ /'di ni don gzhan 'gog pa'o/ /sbyin pa po zhes nam yang ni/ /mi dbang khyod la mi slobastod de/ /gang phyir slong bas khyod kyi nor/ /rang gi nyid du bsams nas len/ /zhes pa la sogs 'gog pa ni1 / /rgyu 'gog pa zhes bshad pa ste/ /phyogs 'di nyid kyis rnam par rtog /gzhan pa nyu)dag kyang dpag par nus/ /gang zhig dngos 'ga' rab bkod nas/ /de yi sgrub byed nus pa can/ /dngos po gzhan dag 'god pa de/ /don gzhan 110—1053

bkod par shes par bya/ /kun khyab khyad par la gnas dang / /sbyar ba can dang 'gal ba can/ /mi 'os byed dang 'os pa'i bdag /'os dang mi 'os ldog /pa'o/ /'di yi dbye ba de lta sogs/ /sbyor ba rnams la rab tu mtshon/ /'di rnams rang bzhin gsal bya'i phyir/ /dper brjod 2phreng ba bstan par bya/ /legs ldan 'gro ba rnams kyi mig /nyi ma dang ni zla ba yang / /nub par gyur pa nyid la ltos/ /nges pa la ni su zhig 4'gongs/ /chu 'dzin 'di dag lus can gyi/ /yongs su gdung ba 5'phrog par byed/ /bdag thob min nam chen po rnams/ /gzhan gyi sbug bsngal zhi slad du'o/ /ma la ya yi rlung gis 6ni/ /'jig rten dga' ba skyed par byed/ /dākṣi ju dang yang dag ldan7/ /kun gyi snying sbug ma yin nam/ /mtshan mor byed 'di dri ma dang / /ldan yang 'gro ba dga' ba skyed / /gnyis skyes dbang po skyon ldan yang / /gzhan dag rjes su 'dzin par nus/ /sbrang rtsi 'thungs pa'i mgrin snyan las/ /byung ba bung ba'i sgra dag kyang / /rna bar rtsub pa nyid 'gyur ba/ /'dod ldan rnams kyi sdig 'di 'dra/ /chu skyes 'dab ma'i mal stan 'dis/ /bdag gi lus 'di gdung bar byed/ /bsreg pa'i bdag nyid sreg za dang / /'dra bas rigs pa ma yin nam/ /bsil zer can gyis nyams byed mod/ /dpyid kyis bdag ni ci la gdung / /dri ma can gyis spyod pa'i las/ /dag pas mi 'os pa min nam/ /ku mud ldan yang sreg byed na/ /padma'i 'byung gnas cis mi byed / /zla bas bzung rnams rtsub pa na/ /nyi mas bzung ba 'jam mi 'gyur// sgra 'jug —— pa'am rtogs pa yis/ /dngos bo gnyis ni mtshungs gyur pa/ / de yi dbye sbyib brjod pa gang / /de sani bzlog pa can zhes brjod/ /brten 4110—1054

dang che ba'i bdag nyid dang / /khā ba 5 sogs yon tan gyis/ /khyod dang rgya mtsho mtshungs tha dad/ /khyod lus 'di 'dra nyid kyis so/ /gcig la gnas pa'i chos kyis ni/ / gnyis ka 1la gnas tha dad dag /rtogs pa'i yul du gyur pa'i phyir/ /'di ni gcig gi ldog pa can/ /chu yi phung po dag dang khyod//mtshams las mi 'da' zab pa ste/ /'di ni mig sman dang mtshungs la/ /khyod ni gser gyi 'od can no/ /gang phyir 'dir ni gnyis ka yis / /'byed byed yon tan nag po dang / /ser po dag ni tha dad bstan/ /'di ni gnyis ka'i ldog pa can/ /khyod dang rgya mtsho dudzā ro/ / ma hā satwa te dzaḥbacas /'di yi 4 khyod gnyis tha dad de/ /de ni chu 5bdag khyod mkhas so/ /'di ni sbyar ba'i tshul ldan phyir/ /sbyar ba can zhes gzung 6bar mdzod/ /'gog pa can dang gtan tshigs can/ /gnyis/ po de yang bstan par bya/ /lugs dang ldan zhing brtan 7pa dang / /rin chen 'byung gnas yin mod kyang / /dri ma ldan pa chu srin gnas/ /khyod kyi 'gran zla 'gyur ma yin/ /ri gling rgya mtshor bcas pa yi/ /sa gzhi mtha' dag 'dzin mod kyang / /lag 'gro rnams kyi rjer gyur phyir/ /lhag ma can ni khyod pas dman/ /sgra dag 'jug par mtshungs pa yi/ /ldog pa can ni 'di 'dra ste/ /rtogs par gyur pas mtshungs pa yang / /yod pa de ni rjes su bsgrub / /khyod kyi gdong dang padma ste/ /'di gnyis kyi ni khyad par yang / /padma chu las skyes pa dang / /khyod gdong khyod la bstan skyepa'o/ /ri dwags mig la smin sgeg dang / /myos pa'i dmar bas reg pa med/ /khyod kyi mig ni gnyis po 'di/ /yon tan de dag nyid kyis brgyan/ /snga mar dbye ba tsam zhig bstan/ /'di snani lhag pa nyid bstan mi110byed1055

to—/ /beer yang mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can/ /gzhan dag rab tu bstan par bya / /khyod kyi gdong dang padma dkar/ /rgyas shing dri tshobazang ldan pa ste/ /padma la ni bung ba 'khor/ /khyod kyi gdong la mig rab g.yo/ /zla ba 'di ni mkha' yi rgyan/ /ngang pa 'di ni chu yi rgyan/ /mkha' 'di rgyu skar phreng ba can//chu 'di ku mud rgyas pa can/ /'dir ni zla ba ngang pa dag /dkar ba nyid sogs rtogs pa dang / /mkha' dang chu ni dag pa 2yang / /rtogs par mtshungs pa'i dbye ba byas/ /snga ma la ni sgra ldan mtshungs/ /gnyis ka la yang 4tha dad dbye5/ /bung ba mig la sogs pa mtshungs/ /de phyir mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can/ /rin can snang bas mi 'phrogs shing / /nyi ma'i 'od kyis mi bzlogs pa/ /lang tsho las byung na chung gi/ /mun pas lta ba 'gog par byed/ /mun pa'i rigs las mun pa 'di/ /lta ba 'gog pa nyid kyis mtshungs/ /gzhan dag gis ni tha dad bstan/ /'di ni rigs mthun ldog pa can/ /rab tu grags nga/'i rgyu bzlog nas/ /gang zhig rgyu gzhan cung zad dam/ /gang du rang gi ngo bo nyid/ /ston pa de ni srid pa can/ /ma 'thungs stsos pa'i kā daspa / /ma phyis dri ma med pa'i mkha'/ /drungs par ma byas dwangs pa'i 9chu//'go ba'i yid ni 'phrog par byed / /sman ma bskus par dkar min mig /mnan pa min par smin ma dma'/ /tshon ma bsgus — par dmar ba ni/ /mdzes ma khyod kyi mchu snye 'di'o/ /gang phyir ma 'thungs la sogs skyes/ /myos pa nyid sogs rgyu gzhan can/ /rgyu med dag kyang brjod 'dod pa/ /de la 'dir ni 'gal ba med/ / bsgos pa med 5par kha dri zhim/ /bcos pa med sa par lus po mdzes/ /rgyu med dag tu zla ba dgra/ /rgyu mtshan med par 'dod 110—1056

pa /—grogs/ /bsgos byepa med sogs tshig gis 'dir/ /rgyu ni dngos su rab bzlog cing / /dri zhim nyid sogs ri 'bras bu brjod/ /de phyir de ni srid pa can / /dngos po 'ga' la bsam byas —nas/ /de dang mtshungs pa'i dngos po gzhan/ /bsdus pa'i tshul gyis rjod 5byed pa/ /de ni bsdus pa brjod par 'dod / /bung ba ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /padma rgyas la sbrang rtsi 'thungs/ /dri zhim rgyas pa ma yin yang / /me tog kha ma bye spyor ltos/ /chags ldan bud med dar ma la/ /dga' ba'i rtse dgas 6babyungs pa dag7 /bu mo 'ga' zhig dag la yang / /'dod pa 'phel ba ston par byed/ /khyad par can tsam tha dad cing / /khyad par rnam pa mtshungs pa'ang yod/ /khyad 9par tha dad tha dad min/ /'di ni gzhan pa dag kyang yod/ /rtsa brtan 'bras bu'i khur gyis ni / /slong rnams rtag tu rgyas nga/ra byed/ /grib ma snum 7pa'i ljon pa che/ /'di ni bdag gis yang dag thob/ /yal ga'i khyen ni mi chung zhing / /me tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs/ /dam pa'i grib bsil brtan ldan pa'i/ /shing 'di bdag gi skal bas rnyed/ /gnyis ka la yang skyes bu 'ga'/ /ljon pa nyid kyis nye bar bsngags/ /chos rnams thams cad snga ma la/ /thun mong gzhan la rnam pa gnyis/ /sbrul ngan 'grogs pa dang bral zhing / /rang bzhin kyis ni mngar ba'i nang / /kye ma chu yi gter 'di ni/ /dus kyis yongs su skam par gyur/ /rgya mtsho la ni de mtshungs pa/ /skyes bu'i ldog pa gsal byed cing / /snga ma'i chos ni bzlog pa'i phyir/ /'di ni sngon med bsdus par brjod//khyad par gyi ni brjod 'dod gang / /'jig rten mtshams las brgal gyur pa/ /phul du byung bar mubarjod pa 'di/ /rgyan gyi dam pa yin te dper/ /malpi kā 110—1057

yi phreng tshogs can/ /lus kun khyab pa'i tsandan gsher/ /dkar ba'i gos can sngon 'gro ma/ /zla ba'i 'od la 1mtshon ma yin/ /zla ba'i 'od ni lhag pa nyid / /khyad 'phags ldan brjod de bzhin du/ /the tshom phul byung la sogs kyang / /gsal phyir cung zad bstan par bya/ /dga' ma khyod kyi nu ma dang / /dpyi yi bar na rked pa ni/ /yod dam med ces bdag gi ni/ /the tshom da dung bzlog ma gyur/ /ni tambi ni khyod la ni/ /rked pa yod ces nges par nus/ /'o ma 'dzin pa'i khur gnas pa/ /rnam pa gzhan du srid ma yin / /khyod kyi grags pa'i phung po ni/ /dpag nus min yang 'dir shong ba/ /sa skyong srid pa gsum gye ni/ /khongs dag e ma shin tu yangs/ /rgyan ni gzhan pa dag las kyang / /ngag gi dbang pos mchod gyur pa/ /phul byung zhes ni brjod pa 'di/ /gcig pu nyid ni mchog tu 5brjod/ /sems ldan dag gam cig shos kyi/ /rnam pa gzhan du gnas pa'i tshul/ /gang du rnam gzhan rab rtogs 6pa/ /de ni rab rtog tu rig dper/ /nyin gung nyi mas gdungs nga/ yi / /glang po dag ni mtshor 'jug pa/ /nyi ma'i phyogs gyur padma rnams/ /gzhom par 'dod pa yin nam snyam/ /khrus dang btung dang pad rtsa dag /bza' phyir lag ldan chur 'jug pa/ /de ni 'khon lan blan phyir zhes/ /snyan ngag mkhan gyis/ rab brtags brjod/ /'di ni bdag gi ring ba dag /'gog byed rna ba'i rgyan zhes te/ /khyod kyi mig gis sherna ba yi/ /utpal dag la 7'gongs pa 'dra/ /mig zur char ni lhung gyur pa/ /mig gi 'od kyis utpal la/ /reg pa rtamin yang snyan ngag mkhan/ /de ltar rab tu brtags te brjod / /mun pa lus la 'byug pa bzhin/ /mkha' ni mig sman char 710—1058
