'beebs bzhin/ /zhes 'di yang ngo rab rtog gi1/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa shin tu mang / /'dir ni bzhin gyi sgra yis 'ga'/ / dpe 'di nyid du 'khrul pa bskyed / /ting nga'i mtha' yis dpe ma yin/ /zhes pa yid ches gsung bzlas nas / /dpe dang dper bya nyid dag ni/ /mtshungs pa'i chos la ltos pas na/ /'byug pa 4dang ni mun pa la/ /chos 'di mngon par 5gyur tam ci//gal te 'byug pa nyid 'dod na/ / 'byug ces bya ba dzigazhan pa ci/ /de nyid chos dang chos can yang / /zhes pa ma myos 7'chad ma yin/ /gal te byed pa nges yin na/ /bya tshig la 'di dbang bral 'gyur/ /rang gi bya bsgrub / mi nus pa/ /gzhan kyi ltos byar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang gis 'byug pa 'di dang ni / /mun pa mtshungs zhes smra na yang / /lus la zhes pa ma 'brel te7/ /de yang yon tan mtshungs pa blta/ /dper na khyod gdong zla ba bzhin/ /zhes pas mdzes pa rtogs 'gyur te/ /de bzhin 'byug pa 'di la ni/ /'byug pa las gzhan rtogs ma yin/ /de phyir 'byug pa 'di dang ni/ /mun pa byed po lus kyang las/ /nye bar sbyar don skyes bu yis/ /de ltar rab brtags zhes 'dod bya/ /snyam dang dogs dang nges dang 'dra/ /min nam zhes pa la sogs pa'i/ /sgra yis rab brtags gsal bar byed/ /bzhin gyi sgra yang de dang 'dra7/ /rgyu dang phra mo cha dag ni/ /tshig rnams dag gi sargyan gyi mchog /rgyu ni byed po shes byed de/ /de dag rnam pa du ma dper/ /ma la ya yi rlung gis ni/ /tshetsandan ljon pa gsar 7pa yi/ /yal 'dab skyod par byed pa 'di//kun gyi dga' ba skyed par byed/ /dga' ba bskyed 18par 'os pa yi rang bzhin nye bar sbyar ba 'di1 / /rgyan nyid du ni rab bstan te/ /ldog pa 110—1059

dag kyang 3de dang mtshungs/ /ma la ya yi chu rgyun la/ /reg cing tsandan nags bskyod pa / /rlung 'di 'gron po rnams dag ni/ /nyams par byed phyir nye bar gnas/ /de ltar 'byung ba'i 4rlung gis ni/ /'bral ba'i rims 5las byung gyur pa/ / yid 'ong la sred skye bo 6la/ /nyams pa sgrub par byed par nus/ /'grub par byed dang rnam 'gyur la/ /de nyid la ltos rgyu nyid do //'thob pa'i las la phal cher ni/ /bya ba la ltos 9rgyu nyid do/ /'grub par byed pa'i rgyu dag ni/ /bstan te lhag ma gnyis po yi—/ /dper brjod gnyis/ ni bkod byas nas/ /shes par byed pa bstan par bya/ /lo 'dab gsar 'khrungs nags tshal dang / / 'dab brgya rtarab tu rgyas pa'i rdzing / /zla ba rgyas pa 'dod pa yis/ /'gron po lta ba'i dug tu byas/ /khengs pa goms par bya'o zhes/ /grogs mo mdza' ba'i gnas bkod la/ /bu mo smin 'khrog mig yon gyisas/ /mchu ni g.yo zhing lta bar byed/ /nyi ma nub gyur zla ba mdzes/ /'dab chags rnams ni gnas su song / /zhes pa 'di yang dus kyi skabs/ /go bar byed pa legs pa nyid/ /grogs mo 'dod pas gzir ba'i yid / /zla ba'i 'od kyis mi bzlogs shing / /tsandan chu yis mi bzod pas/ /lus kyi drod kyis gdung bar 'dzin྾/ /zhes pa'i spyor ba rnams la ni/ /yid 'ong shes byed rgyu dag mtshon/ /dngos med rgyu ni yid 'phrog pa/ /'ga' zhig rab tu bstan par bya/ / rig pa rnams 7ni ma goms dang / /blo ldan rnams dang ma 'grogs dang / /dbang po rnams 8ni ma bsdams pas/ /mi rnams rab tu gdung bar 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i gtam kyis myos thu pa song lang tsho yi ni rims dag nyams/ /rmongs pa zad cing sred pa 'phos/ /bsod nams 110—1060

gnas la yid dga' lkubyas/ /nags tshal 'di dag khyim ma yin/ /chu klung 'di dag bud med min/ /ri dwags 'di dag bu tsha min/ /de phyir bdag ni yid dga'o/ /shin tu ma brtags spyod pa ni/ /'phags pa rnams la yod ma yin / /de phyir de dag rnams kyi ni/ /phun tshogs thams cad rtag tu 'phel//skyed tshal sa hā kā ra rnams/ /snye ma ma 'khrungs pa min na/ /'gron po rnams kyi bud med ni/ /til bcas khyor chu sbyin byar 'gyur/ /yod dang med pa'i rang bzhin gyi/ /'bras bu skyed 2pa dag la 'dir/ /sngar med la sogs rang bzhin gyi / /dngos po yi ni rgyu nyid do/ /ring 'bras de dang lhan cig skyes/ /de bzhin 'bras ma thag skyes dang / /rigs 4min rigs pa byed ces pa/ /mtshar ba'i rgyu rnams grangs med do/ /'di rnams 5spyor ba'i lam rnams la/ /btags pa'i 'jug pa la brten pa6/ /shin tu mdzes pa dag mthong ste/ /de yi dper brjod dzee ltar na/ /lus can khyod mig zur ces pa/ /rgyal byed lus med — dag gi mtshon/ /gang de gzhan la rab 'phangs pa/ /de yis bdag gi yid kyang bcom/ /skyes bu lus skyes kyis myos pa'i/ /rnam 'phrul sna tshogs lhan cig nyid/ /bud med rnams la bu mo ni/ /yongs su nub pa'i na tshod skyes/ / sngar nyid ri dwags mig can ma'i/ /chags pa'i rgya mtsho rgyas par gyur/ /phyis nas 'od zer rab 'phro bas/ /zla ba yi ni dkyil 'khor shar / /lha gcig khyod kyi zhabs gnyis po/ /dmar ba'i nyi gzhon la 9reg pas/ /rgyal po rnams kyi lag pa yi/ /padma zum par byed pa ci/ /khyod kyi zhabs sen zla ba yi/ /'od zer kunda dri med rnams/ /sa skyong rnams kyi lag pa yi/ /padma zum par byed la dbang / /zhes pa rgyu yi rnam rtog rnams / /lugs ni 'di 110byed1061

'dra dag tu bstan/ /zur dang rnam pas mtshon pa'i don/ /phra phyir phra mo zhes par brjod1/ /nam zhig 'u cag 'grogs 'gyur zhes/ /tshogs su brjod par ma bzod pa'i/ /mdza' bo rig nas bud med kyis/ /rtse dga'i padma zum par byed2/ /lus skyes dag gis gzir ba yi/ /mdza' bo dbugs dbyung 'dod pa yis/ /padma zum par byas pa las/ /'dir ni mtshan mo 'grogs pa bstan/ /glu yi 'dun sar khyod la mig /gtad pa de gdong chu skyes la/ / dmar zhing gsal ba rgyas pa 5yi/ /mdzes pa ci yang hūṃbyung bar gyur / /'dir yang rang bzhin ma brjod par/ /dga' ba'i dga' ston 'dod pa dag /nges par gnas pa nyid gyur pa/ /phra mo nyid las brgal ma yin / /cha ni cha yi 7dngos po yi/ /rang bzhin nges par gsal ba sgrib / /dper brjod nyid kyis 'di yi ni/ /rang bzhin nges par gsal bar bya/ /rgyal po'i bu mo la chags bdag /spu long rgyas pa 9srung ba pos/ /rig par gyur la kye ma tshal / /bsil ba'i rlung ldan yin par shes/ /ci ltar bu mo mthong nyid na/ /bdag la dga' ba'i mchi ma byung / /rlung gis gtsubs pa'i me tog gi/ /rdul gyis bdag mig sun phyung ngo / /zhes pa la sogs skabs su ni / /rgyan 'di shin tu mdzes pa yin / /kha cig cha la 1 smad pa'am/ /bstod par byas la checha zhes brjod/ /gang yid g.yul kyi dga' ston la/ /'dod pa'i dga' ston salas kyang tshichags/ /gzi ldan lang tsho yon tan can/ /rgyal 'di khrod kyi bdag por 'os/ /brtson 'grus khyad 'phags bstod pa 'dir//smad pa nyid de longs spyod la/ /rgyun du spyod 'dod bu mo yi/ /bsam pa dag ni bzlog par nus/ /gnod pa rab gzhil ⑫nyid kyi phyir/ /gang gis snyan 110—1062

par smra ba bslabasna/ /skye bo 'di ni brtse med g.yo/ /grogs mo de yis bdag la ci/ /skye bo grogs mos rab bstan khengs/ /chags phyir byed par ma nus nas / /skyon ltar snang bas yon tan gang / /snyan par smra ba nyid kyang bstan/ /dngos po rab tu bstan pa rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du rjes ston pa/ /grangs dang rim pa bzhin zhes pa/ /grangs bzhin zhes par rab tu brjod/ /khrus la chur ni rab zhugs ma/ /khyod kyi 'dzum mig gdong mdzes ni/ /ku mud utpal padma yis/ /bskus par nges so gzugs can ma/ /dga' ba mchog tu dga' bar brjod/ /nyams ldan yid 'ong nyams dang ldan/ /gzi brjid nga rgyal skyes pa ste/ /de gsum khyad 'phags dag dang ldan/ /go binda khyod khyem 'ongs pa/ /deng 4bdag dga' ba skyes pa gang / /dga' ba 'di ni slar yang khyod/ /dus kyi 'ongs na 5'byung bar 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i dga' ba bi du ras / /gzhan las min zhes rigs par smra/ /de la 6gus pa tsam gyes ni/ /rab brtan 7'phrog byed shin tu dges / /zla ba nyi ma rlung sa mkha'/ /sbyin sreg byed dang 9me dang chu/ /zhes pa'i gzugs rnams rab 'das nas/ /lha khyod lta bar nged kyis ci/ /mngon sum byas pa'i lha la ni/ /rgyal po dga' ba'i go cha yis/ /dga' ba rab tu gsal byas gang / /de yang dga' bar rjes rtogs bya / /shi ba zhes pa pha rol du/ /gang dang 'grogs phyir bdag 'chi 'dod/ /a brnyi de bdag gis ni/ /skye 'di nyid la ci ltar 'thob /dga' ba nyid ni sngar bstan te/ /dga' ba sgeg pa nyid 'gyur 'di/ /gzugs mang dag dang ldan pas na/ /'di ni nyams dang ldan pa'i tshig7 /gang gis nag mo bdag mdun nas/ /skra nas bzung rta5ste drangs gyur pa/ /110—1063

bsten dka' 1sdig can thob pa 'di/ /skad cig 'tsho bar 'gyur ram ci/ /zhes pa 'jigs sde dgra dag la/ /lta ba'i khro ba mchog gi mthar/ /'dzegs pa drag po'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /'di ni ro dang ldan pa'i tshig /mtshor bcas sa las ma rgyal zhing / /rnam mang mchod sbyin ma byas la/ /slong la nor rnams ma sbyin par/ /sa skyong du bdag ci ltar 'gyur/ /zhes pa spro ba khyad 'phags dag /dpa' bo'i nyams kyi bdag nyid gnas/ /nyams ldan nyid du nus 5pa la/ /tshig 'di dag ni dbang ba yin/ /lus 'jam gang la padma yi/ /mal stan dag kyang rtsub byed na / /lha mo de ni ro khang dag /sreg dzaza ldan par ji ltar nyal/ /zhes pa snying rje rgyas pa yi / /rgyan nyid du ni rab tu bshad / /de bzhin gzhan yang ngam pa dang / /bzhad gad rmad byung 'jigs rung ngo / /rgyu mas brgyan pa'i srin po rnams/ /mgo med ro dang lhan byug tu/ /lag pa sbyar bas khyod dgra'i khrag / 'thung zhing 'thung zhing gar byed do/ /grogs mo me tog ma rnyings ma/ /khyod kyi nu ma'i ngos la ni/ /sen rjes gsar pa chags pa 'di/ /stod g.yogs kyis ni sgrib par mdzod/ /dga' tshal ljon pa 'di rnams kyi/ /'dab ma gsar pa gos bzang dang / /me tog do shal la sogs rgyan / /yal 'dab khang par gyur pa mtshar rtse mo dag la me gnas pa/ /brgya byin gyi ni rdo rje gang / /'di ni dran na lha min gyi//bud med mngal ni lhung bar byed/ /snyan pa —grong ba nyid min skyes/ /brjod bya yi ni nyams dag bstan/ /'dir ni nyams brgyad dbang byas te/ /tshig rnams nyams dang ldan par bshad/ /bdag ni gnod pa byed po zhes/ /khyod kyi snying la 'jigs ma byed/ /bdag gi ral gris muphyir phyogs rnams/ /nam 110—1064

yang gzhom 1par 'dod ma yin/ /zhes pa skyes bu dregs ldan 'gas/ /g.yul du gzhan ni bkag byas nas/ /gtong ba de lta bu la sogs/ /gzi brjid ldan pa 3shes par bya / /'dod don dngos su ma brjod par/ /de nyid 'grub par bya ba'i phyir/ /rnam pa gzhan dag brjod pa gang / /de ni rnam grangs brjod par 'dod/ /sa hā kā ra'i snye ma rnams5/ /gzhan gyi gsos 'dis 6za bar byed/ /de ni bdag gis bzlog par bgyi/ /khyed gnyis dal gyis 7'dug par mdzod/ /grogs mo skyes phran phrad byas nas/ /de dag dus sar dga' ba yi/ /dga' ston bsgrub tu gzhug 'dod pas/ /'ga' zhig de nas song bar gyur/ /bya ba 'ga' zhig rtsom pa la/ /skal ba yi ni stobs las kyang / /de yi sgrub byed phun tshogs gang / /de ni kun du phan par brjod/ /khengs pa gzhom phyir de yi ni/ /rkang pa dag la phyag 'tshal ba/ /bdag la phan phyir skal / ba yi/ /'brug gi sgra ni grags par gyur/ /bsam pa'am ni 'byor ba yi/ /chen po nyid ni bla med gang / /de ni rgya che zhes pa yi / /sargyan du mkhas pa rnams kyis brjod/ /rā ma saṇa yi mgo gcod ཿpa'i/ /bya ba'i khur yang bzod pa gang / /rā saghu'i bu des bla ma yi/ /bka' las 'da' bar nus ma gyur/ /rin chen rtsig pa las 'phos pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan brgya yis bskor gyur pa/ /laṅka'i dbang phyug de kho na/ /añdza na bus dka' bas shes/ /snga mar bsam pa'i bdag nyid che/ /'dir ni mngon par 'byor ba brling / /rgya che gnyis po 'di dag kyang / / rab tu gsal bar nyu mtshon pa yin / /bsnyon dor 7dag ni bsnyon byas nas/ /don gzhan cung zad ston pa ste/ /'dod pa dag ni mda' lnga pa/ /ma yin sgo ldan stong phrag 110—1065

yod / /tsandan zla 'od dal bu yi/ /lho phyogs dri yi bzhon pa 'di/ /me yi rang bzhin spro ba ste/ /gzhan gyi ngor ni bsil zhes grags/ /'dod ldan gyis ni gzhan la de/ /bsil ba rmyekhas blangs bdag nyid la/ /tsha ba nyid du rab bstan phyir/ /'di ni yul la bsnyon pa'o/ /bdud rtsi zags rngupa'i 'od zer can / /zla ba zhes par bdag cag 'dod/ /don gyi bdag nyid 'di ni gzhan—/ /dug zag zer dang ldan pa nyid/ /ces pa zla ba'i zla ba nyid/ /bzlog nas don gzhan bdag nyid ni/ /'dod pas gzir bas brjod pa'i phyir//'di ni rang bzhin bsnyon dor ro/ /bsnyon dor des ni 3sngar nyid du/ / dper brjod rnams la 4rab bstan to/ / 'di yi bsnyon dor dbye rngub rnams//mtshon bya dag la rgya cher mtshon/ /sbyar ba gzugs gcig ldan pa'i tshig /du ma'i don can nyid du 6'dod/ /de tshig tha dad min pa dang / /tha dad tshig 'dra 7rnam pa gnyis/ / u da ya gnas mdzes pa can/ /dkyil 'khor la chags rgyal po 'di/ / mṛ du ka raḥkye'ajig rten gyi/ /yid ni rab tu 'phrog par byed/ /rgyal rigs lam la mi gnas pa༄ / /rgyal po skyon byu 'byung gnas dang / /bsdongs nas skyon mang dag gis bdag /dga' med 'di ltar cis ma mnar/ /rgyu skar lam la rab gnas pa11/ /mtshan mor byed pa dang bsdongs nas/ /srod la yis ni bdag 'di ltar/ /dga' ba med par cis ma mnar—/ /dpe dang gzugs can 'gog pa dang / /ldog pa can sogs spyod yul can/ /sbyor ba gang nyu2du bstan zin te/ /gzhan pa 'ga' zhig bstan par bya/ /'ga' zhig bya ba tha dad min/ /gzhan pa bya ba 'gal min yod / /'gal ba'i las can dag kyang gzhan/ /sbyar ba nges pa can yang 110byed1066

yod / /nges pa 'gog pa'i gzugs brjod dang / /'gal med she'agal ba can yang ste/ /de dag rnams kyi rang bzhin yang / /dpar — —brjod dag las 1gsal bar 'gyur/ /'khyog cing yid 'ong rang bzhin can/ /chags pa gsal bar ston byed ma/ /mdzes mas bsgul ba'i mig dang ni/ /pho nya mos kyang mdza' bo 'gugs/ /yid 'ong chags pa 'phel bar byed/ /'jam zhing myos pa'i gdangs snyan can4/ /khu byug sgra ni thos gyur te5/ /dkar min mig can dag la 'khyud/ /chu ma dang spyor 6'phel ba yi/ /dmar ba rab tu ston byed cing / /tsha zer can ni nub gyur te/ /lus skyes dag ni rnam par rgyas7 / /ral gri nyid la ni sto sha /gzhu nyid la ni 'khyog po nyid/ /mi bdag 'di yi mārga ṇa/ /mda' rnams nyid la gnas pa yin/ /khyod kyis bsrungs la tsher —ma ni/ /padma'i yu ba nyid la mthong / /'on kyang chags can 'khrig pa la/ /'khyud par gyur pa rnams la'ang mthong / /sa 'dzin ka ṭa ka mang zhing / /gzi brjid ldan pa nges par dar/ /mkhas pa skye dgu'i bdag 'byung saste/ /rje bo nus pa 'dzin yang de/ /nyams med yin yang chos spyong min/ /rgyal po yin yang zad mi shes/ /bde byed yin yang lag 'gro med// lha nyid yin yang rnam sad min/ /khyad par rab tu bstan pa'i phyir/ /yon tan rigs dang bya ba sogs/ /gang du ma tshang nyid bstan 5pa/ /de ni khyad par brjod par 'dod/ /me tog gzhu can dag gi mtshon/ /rtsub pa ma yin rno ba'ang mumin/ /de ltar slon yang 'di yis ni/ /sa gsum dag 1 las rgyal bar 'gyur 8/ /'di dag lha yi bu mo min/ /dri za'i rigs las byung ba'ang min/ /de lta mod kyi tshangs pa'i yang / /dka' thub gzhom pa bsgrub nyu 110—1067

par nus/ /khro gnyer dag ni ma bsdus shing / /so yi g.yogs kyang ma bskyod la / /mig kyang dmar por ma gyur pa7/ /dgra yi rigs ni nyams par byed //shing rta med cing glang po'ang med/ /rta med rkang thang med par yang / /zur mig nyid kyis bud med rnams/ /'gro ba gsum po dag las rgyal/ /shing rta 'khor lo gcig pa dang / /kha lo pa nyams rta mi mnyam/ /de lta na yang gzi byin can/ /nyi mas 'gro ba gsum po mnan/ /gzi byin can zhes khyad par las / /'dir 4ni rgyu yi khyad par brjod/ /rim pa 'di yis gzhan gyi ni/ /dbye ba rnams kyang brtag par bya/ /brjod 'dod yon tan khyad 'phags dang / /mtshungs par byas nas 'ga' zhig ni/ / bstod smad don du 5bsgrags pa gang //de ni mtshungs par spyor ba 6bshad/ /gshin rje lus ngan chu lha dang / /mig stong pa dang khyod nyid kyang / /'jig rten skyong ba zhes pa'i sgra/ /yul gzhan med par rnam par 'dzin/ /ri dwags mig dang 'grogs pa dang / /glog gi rtse dga' dag dang ni/ /sprin gyi rtsom pa'ang rang bzhin gyis/ /skad cig gnyis par mi gnas so/ / 'gal zla / sgrub byed slad du ni/ /gang du dngos po 'gal ba rnams/ /yang dag 'grogs par rab bsten —pa/ /de ni 'gal ba bshad de dper/ /ngang pa'i rgyal po rnams dag ni/ /myos pa'i gdangs snyan ca co 'phel/ /rma bya rnams kyi sgra dag ni/ /yid 'ong nyid dang bral bas nyams / /dbyar skyes chu 'dzin dag gis ni/ /nam mkha' yul ngan lta bur spyod / /chags pa yis kyang 'gro ba yi/ /yid ni kun du chags par gyur / /rked pa phra zhing ro smad sbom/ /mchu dmar mig ni dkar ba min/ /lte ba dma' zhing nu ma mtho/ /bud med lus kyis su ma bcom/ /pad rtsa'i lag pa 110—1068

chu shing brla/ /padma'i gdong dang utpal mig /khyod kyi gzugs kyis bdag cag rnams/ /gdung nus min nam lus can ma/ /skyed tshal rlung gis rab bskyod pa/ /tsū ta tsam pa ka yi rdul/ /reg pa min yang 'gron po yi/ /mig las mchi ma 'dzag par nyubyed/ /snyan par sgogs ma khyod kyi mig /nag dkar rjes su dmar ba yang / /rna ba dag la brten pa ni/ /su yi yid brtan nyid du 'gyur/ / nag mo snyan sgogs khyod kyi mig /srid sgrub la chags lta byed kyang / /rna can dag la brten pa ni/ /su yis yid brtan nyid du 'gyur/ /༄sne de ltar rgyan 'di rnam pa ni/ /du ma nyid du rab ri rtogs bya/ /skabs min 'dod pas byebastod pa ni/ /skabs su ma bab bstod pa yin/ /gzhan mi bsten pa'i ri dwags rnams/ /'bad med rnyed par gesla ba'i nor/ /chu dang rtswa yi myug sogs kyis/ /nags rnams su ni bde bar 'tsho/ /rgyal po'i rjes 'brang nyon mongs pa/ /skyo ba'i yid dang ldan pa yis / /skabs su ma bab nyid du 'dir/ /ri dwags spyod tshul 'di dag bsngags/ /gal te smad pa bzhin bstod nas/ /skyon ltar snang ba'i yon tan nyid/ /gang du nye bar thob gyur pa/ /'di ni zol gyis bstod pa 3bshad/ /rā ma dka' thub pa yis kyang / /'byung po'i 3'dzin ma 'di las rgyal6/ /de nyid rgyal po khrod kyis kyang / /'di la khyod ni rgyags ma mdzad/ /sngon gyi skyes bu las bcad nas/ /dpal 'di khyod kyis yongs su spyod / /rgyal po bu ram shing pa'i rgyud/ /khrod kyis ⑪'di ni rigs sam 6ci/ /khyod kyi btsun mo sa gzhi ni/ /lag 'gro'i /—5 longs spyod dag la chags/ /ci slad khrod kyi nga rgyal ni/ /mchog gi mtha' ru 'dzegs par gyur/ /de ltar nye bar mtshon pa las/ /sbyar ba can dang gzhan 110byed1069

dag gi/ /zol kyis bstod pa'i rnam pa rnams rngu/ /rab tu rgya che chomatha' dang bral / /gal te don gzhan 'jug pa yis5/ /de dang mtshungs pa'i 'bras bu 'ga' / /mchog gam mchog min 4ston byed pa/ /de ni nges par bstan pa yin / /nyi ma 'char ba nyid kyis ni/ / padma rnams la dpal ster byed/ /phya phun tshogs rnams kyi 'bras bu dag /grogs po rjes 'dzin bstan pa'i phyir/ /bye zla ba'i zer kyis reg pa na/ / mun pa'i phreng ba nub par gyur/ /hūṃ'aphral la rgyal po dang 'gal rnams/ /ngan pa'i mthar gyur gsal bar byed/ /dzuyon tan las rnams lhan cig gi/ /dngos po brjod pa lhan cig brjod/ /don rnams bsnol ba gang yin pa/ /yongs brjes (yin te de dag dper/ /da ni mtshan mo 'di dag rnams/ /bdag gi dbugs dang lhan cig ring / /zla ba'i rgyan ldan ma rnams kyang / /bdag lus nyid dang lhan cig skye— nye/ /'gron po rnams kyi rmongs pa dang / /lhan cig tsū ⑪ta'i dog pa rgyas/ /de dag mchi ma — dang mnyam du/ /ma la ya yi rlung dag 'bab/ /khu byug sgrogs pa'i skal bzang dang / /nags kyi rlung ni dri bzang dang / /dpyid nyid —skye bo'i kun dga' rnamasas/ /lhan cig dag tu 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de ltar lhan cig brjod pa yi/ /dper brjod 'ga' zhig 'dir byas te/ /yongs su brjes pa'i rang bzhin yang / /nges par bstan ba cung zad bya/ /sa spyod rnams la mtshon bsnun pa/ /ster byed khyod kyi lag pa yis/ /de dag grags pa ku mud dkar/ /yun ring dag tu bsgrubs pa phrogaskye /mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos po la/ /smon pa shis brjod ces ⑫bya dper/ /ngag yid spyod yul ma yin pa'i/ /snang ba dam pas khyod la srungasathu / /rjes 'gro med dang the tshom 110—1070

can / /dag ni dpe rnams nyid la bstan/ /dpe yi gzugs can dag kyang 'dir① / /gzugs can rnams la nges par bsgrags/ /rab rtog cha shas 'di yang ni/ /rab rtog dag gi dbye ba nyid/ /tha dad rgyan rnams bsres pa ni / /spel ma dag tu brjod pa ste/ /yan lag yan lag can dngos kyi/ /skabs dang thams cad stobs mtshungs nyid/ /ces pa'i lugs gnyis spel ma yi//rgyan dag la ni mtshon par bya/ /mdzes ma khyod kyi bzhin gyi dpal/ /padma dag gis 'gog par byed/ /mdzod dang yu ba phun tshogs pa/ /'di la bya dka' ci zhig yod/ /rang bzhin brjod dang 'khyog brjod ces/ /ngag gi rang bzhin tha dad gnyis/ /'khrog por brjod pa thams cad la/ /phal cher sbyar bas dpal rgyas byed/ /snyan ngag mkhan bsam dgongs pa ste/ /snyan ngag grub par gang gnas pa/ / rab sbyor yul gyi ga yon tan can/ /de ni dgongs pa can zhes brjod/ /dngos po yis ni tshig rnams kun/ /phan tshun phan par byed pa nyid/ /don sngudang bral ba'i khyad par rnams/ /ma byas gnas su bsngags pa dang / /brjod rim stobs las dngos po ni5/ /zab mo dag kyang gsal ba ste/ /de kun dgongs pa'i dbang gyur phyir/ /de dag dgongs pa can zhes rig /gang yang mtshams sbyor yan lag dang / /'jug pa'i yan lag mtshan nyid sogs/ /lung gzhan dag tu brjod 'di yang / /rgyan nyid du ni bdag cag 'dod/ /rgya che mtha' yas rab bsdus tshad du gyur pa yi—/ /rgyan rnams dag gi lam 'di nyid ni rnam par phye/ /brjod ④pa'i yul las 'das par yongs su gnas pa yi/ /khyad par rnams ni goms pa rnams kyis zudabye bar nus/ /snyan ngag (me long las le'u 6ste gnyis pa'o// //110—1071

ldan de yang rkang pa yi/ /dang po bar mtha' spyod yul can/ /gcig gnyis gsum bzhi rkang pa yi/ /zung ldan rnams kyi rnam rtog ni/ /thog ma bar mtha' bar dang mtha'/ /bar dang thog ma thog mtha' kun/ / kun du dbye ba las gyes pa/ /de dag tshodabye ba shin tu mang / /de la bya sla bya dka' yang / /'ga' zhig dag ni bstan par bya/ /grogs mo mdza' bo'i skye bo la/ /khengs pa 'di dang 'gogs ma byed/ /bslus pa'i mgrin pa nas 'khyud lakṣe/ /de nyid ngo tsha ldan par gyis/ /ngang pa rnams kyi dregs 'joms pa/ /sprin gyi sgra yis myos byed ni/ /dga' ma dang bcas bud med kyi/ /khengs bral yid la 'jug par byed/ /chu gter bzhi yi ske rags can/ /sa yi lag dpya 'dzin la mkhas/ /khyod nyid thob nas da lta ni/ /skye dgu rgyal po bzang ldan gyur/ /rkang thang shing rta glang po dang / /rta dang bral ba khyod kyi dgra/ /'ga' zhig nags dang gzhan dag ni/ /lha rnams dag gi gnas su song / /chu skyes gdong ldan mig gnyis kyi/ /rnam 'phrul yid 'ong 'di la ni/ /dpyid kyi bung ba'i rnam 'phrul gyis4/ /co 'dri byed pa ci yin smros/ /'dod pa g.yul du dpa' bo 5yi/ /glang po'ang bzung 4dka' rta med kyis/ /gang phyir bdag cag mthar byas pa/ /de phyir khyod kyi rnam gnon mtshar7/ /g.yul du rno bas mdzes pa yi/ /mi bdag khyod 'dra ༄ nor 'dzin ni/ /rgyal bar gyur te nor 'dzin nyugyis/ /tshim pa dag kyang thob par gyurakye/ /sa hā kā ra'i me tog gsar / /bdag yid mchog tu sred ldan byed/ /khu byug stsos pa dag gi sgra/ /110—1072

yid du 'ong ba 'dis kyang ngo / /khyod la dmigs pa'i re ba dang kye/ /ma bral 'di la de 'dra yi/ /gnas skabs lus ni 'jig byed pas/ /bud med 'dzeg nus ji ltar min/ /yal 'dab gsar pas mdzes pa yi/ /ljon pas drangs pa'i gzhon nu rnams/ /padmar mngon phyogs bung ba yis3/ /mig nas bzung ste 'gugs par byed/ /myos pa'i bzhad ni rab 'jug pa/ /rdzing gi chu la dkar ba yi/ /ngang pa 1'di yi ca co yis/ /bdag ni mthar byed zas su byed/ /dri bral zla ba'i cha dag dang / /lhan byug ma la ya yi rlung / /bdag dga' mi byed 'dod pa ni/ /mi bzad jedug gi rjes su 'gro/ /bdag bstan snyemi 'dod khengs pa can/ /do shal dang ldan 'phrog byed ma/ /lus med nyid kyi dngos po khyod/ /phra 'gyur bdag 'grogs bde rgyas 6mdzod/ /khyod kyi gdong gis bdag las rgyal/ /chu yi rgyun gyur bung ba can/ /'dab ldan padma gtam med las/ /ji ltar mi rgyal bdag dga' ma/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis dmar gyur pa'i / /chu lha mo bzhin pā ṭa la/ /dmar ba'i gos can dri bzang gnas/ /bdag gi dga' ma dga' bar bya)/ /de ltar rkang pa'i thog ma yi —/ /zung ldan bar chod med rnam rtog /de rmyeni bar du chod pa yi— / /rnam rtog 'ga' yang bstan par bya/ /sa hā kā ra las 'khrungs nyid/ /yid 'ong dri bzang ldan pa yi/ /dpyid kyi e ṇa'i — cemig can gyirkye/ /khengs pa sgra yi lhag mar byed//dga' ma'i lag pa shin tu dmar/ /rgyud mangs la bsnun rnam 'phrul laskye/ /phrag dog ldan par mdza' ④bo la'ang / /rna ba'i utpal gyis snun 8byed/ /rlung gis gar bsgyur sprin gyi phreng / /mtha' dag chu ni 'thor bar byedakye/ /de rjes mjug ma rab bslangs pa'i7 bye/ /mjug sgo ldan pa rkugar dag byed/ /110byed1073

'dod ldan ma dag khyod kyi yid/ /khengs rtsod rang nyid nyams 'gyur rmyete/ /byā pa'i kā li kā rtemathong nas/ /gnas skabs ci la reg gyur tam1/ /rtse dga'i ri yi zla shel gyi/ /thang 'di la ni rab 'dzegs nas pye/ /mdongs mtha' mchog tu mdzes pa yi— —/ /gtsug phud can 'di gar byed do/ /gang zhig sbrul mchog steng gnas shing / /phag pas bzung ba'i ④sa 'di ni/ /rgyal po'i tshogs las rab blangs nas/ /da lta khyod kyi lag pas bzung / /g.yul du dgra yi glang po rnams/ /khyod kyi lag pa mthar byed kyis/ /bsnun pas khrag ni rab zags pa/ /thun mtshams dag gi sprin bzhin mdzesadu —/ /rlung gis ri yi 'khri shing shebazhin/ /gzhan gyi sde ni dpa' bas ⑫bcom mtha' ni ga shed song ba bzhin/ /rdul kyis nam mkha' khyab par gyur/ /legs ldan chu 'dzin gsar pa'i 'od/ /lha min dag gi rigs nyams byed/ /sbyin tshuldan glang po mchog bcom pa/ /khyab 'jug des khyod rtag tu srungs/ /khyod kyi mag — skra bung ba 'dra/ /gdong rgo padmar phrag dog byed/ /dpal gyi bzhin du rab myos pa / /khyod kyis sasu zhig rtsi mi byed/ /rgya che rin chen rgyan dang ldan/ /rgyags slopas mig 'khor dza gha na/ /chung ba min pas mdza' bo ni/ /dga' ba ldan pa bya bar bzod/ /gzhan gsos rnams kyis bsgrags pa dang / /khyod kyis 1 brjod pa'i sgra dang ni/ /lho yi phyogs kyi rlung gis kyang / /bdag yid 'phrogs so pho nya mo/3/ /rked pa phra zhing rdul zags pas/ /gdong gi zla ba rab mdzes pa bye / /bud med chang gis ngo tsha bcom/ /skyes pa'i lus la 'dzeg par byed/ /de ltar bar chod zung ldan gyi/ /rab tu dbye ba 'di yang bstan / /bar chod ma chod bdag nyid kyi/ /rnam rtog kyang yod 'di lta ste//110byed1074

kā li ka 'phyang yal ga can/ /sā la blta bar des mi nus/ /ba ku lar chags bung ba dang / /grogs mos padma can yang min/ /sprin nag chen po ldan pa'i dus / /snang dang rgyu skar kun mi mtshon/ /gsang mthor dga' ba sgrog byed pa'i1 / /dus 'dra su yis lta bar nus/ /thun gsum dbang gyur ring ba yi/ /mtshan mo 'di yis bdag shi zhig /gang la bdag song 4srog gzir 'go/ /de ni blo med bdag gis bcom/ /zhes rkang dang po zung ldan gyi/ /rnam rtog lugs ni 'di 'dra ste/ /'di lta kho nar 5zung ldan gyi/ /rnam rtog gzhan pa rnams kyang ngo / /spros pas 'jig phyir dbye ba ni/ /mtha' dag brjod par mi 'dod de/ /de la bya dka' 3mngon 'dod gang / /'ga' zhig dag /ni bstan par bya/ / brtan dang dbang po rab bsdoms pa/ /khyod ni sdom brtson muphyir mi nyams/ /sgyu med khrod kyi bde 'jig par/ /mi 'gyur 'di snyed ched du'ang 'gyuramu/ /rgyal po mdun sar sa yi lha —rnams dag gi zhal/ /chang gis ma bcom nor kyis samadzes pas rab bstod pa'i/ /khyod kyi yon tan rab gsal chags bdag skye dgu la/ /phung po nyid gyur lha rnams su ni mi 'gro min / /dam pa'i spyod lam labag med khyod kyi dga' ma gang / /dga' ba'i dga' ston dga' ba'i khyad par du dzimyos ma/ /de yis 'dir ni 'od ldan rgyan rnams gzung — 5bar 'os/ /bdag la mdzes ldan nyid kyi 'bras bu 'ga' yang med / /mgon po khyod ltas dud — pa'i ro ni mi mkhyen te/ /dman pa nyid dang mchog nyid dag ni nges par 'gal/ /gang zhig dman pa rnams ni —1khyod la mgos 'dud 3cing / /de dag kho na dman pa'i ro des mchog tu gyur / /rol pa'i 'dzum 3dkar dag dang 'jam por smra ba dang / /chung ngu'i lta ba dang 110—1075

ni lci ba'i 'gro ba dang / / kun du glal dang —1dza gha na dag ston pa du desaX — / /bsnun pa des na bdag ni 'tsho bas dman par gyur/ /dpal ldan 3mi ṣyoshong 7 brtan 8ldan gang gi 9bdag nyid ni/ /'chi med ༄ lam dang nyu1mnyam pa'i tshad ldan 5rab dud pa'i/ /'go ba 7rgyas byed mchod ldan tshad blamed ming can ni// 'jal byed tshad med mang po bkod la phyag dag 7mdzod/ /bcud la zhugs te brang gis dga' byed cing / /snying por gyur pa'i bcud mang rab tu 'dzin/ /bzhad 1 kyi rjes mtshungs sgra ldan dril chung can/ /des na — neebacud len snying po min pa rig /brtan rgyas tshul dang tshul min brtan pa 'di yis ni/ /tshul med dge ba'i thabs la long rnams rnam par thul/ /bzhon pas ma 3'gro rgyal ba'i theg 'gro dag gis gang / /tshul ma thob rnams ༄ thob pa dag la brten pa bskyed / /mtshungs med lci ba'i mtshon ldan g.yul du sa skyes ni/ /rgyal mtshan la gnas dpa' bo bya yi sgra yis bros/ /nyi ma bzhin du drag po'i 'phrog byed 'di mdun du/ /'jigs rung g.yul du dgra rnams lugs 5dang mtshungs par rig /mtshan mo tshad med thun ldan dpal med tshad med cing / /mthar spyoni bgrod bya min pas zad nad la brten pa / /cha yi rang bzhin nad can 'bral ba'i nad kyis gzir/ /skal ldan ma 'di snying rje'i rang bzhin 'bral med mdzod/ /ngal — med khyod kyi blo la mnyam nyid bzlog pa nyid/ /ma yin bla med rjes su mi mthun 'go ma yin/ /gdung med 1kyis thob rtemachog gi rjes su mthun pa nyid/ /dga' med 'dod med rnams kyi bzhed pa dag las rgyal/ /dus kyi dus kyi mgrin nag ngo nag nag po nyid dag 'dzin/ /snyan sgrog dag gi sgog byed bung tshogs sprin nag dus ltar gnag /dus kyi mi bzung bye dus cha'i 110—1076

gtso bo chu 'dzin kyis mdzes su/ /dka' bas 'tsho ba'i bud med len snabu'i phreng bas mgo nag bsten/ /rkang pa gnyis kyi mtha' thog ni/ /rab sbyar zung ldan gnas skabs 'di/ /brjod pa'i khongs su 'du 1mod kyang / /rang dbang nyid kyis 'dir bshad do/ /myos pas chags pa nye bar gnas kyang bud med des/ /bdag nyid ma sbyar bdag gi sdig pas khro ba yi/ /ro dang sbyar te lus med dag gis gdungs gyur kyang / /bdag ni 'di snyed gdung ba'i slad du ma bsdad do/ /phyed bzlas yang dag sbyar ba yin/ /'di la dbye ba gsum du 'dod/ /rkang pa bzlas 4pa'ang du ma yi/ /bdag nyid de dag dpes gsal bya/ /skyes bu brtan gang snying stobs can5/ /khengs pa rab spangs spang bya ste/ /khyod kyis tremachog tu 'bad pa yis/ /yid brten bya'o 'bad med — ma/ /khyod kyi bgrod pa khyab bdag gzi byin gyis/ /yang yang rab sbyar mdzes pa med pa yi/ /mi rnams tshul dang nga rgyal nyams byas nas/ / gdungs shing kye ma byas zos rnam par bcom9/ /sgra yis sprin bgrod dbyar skyes rma bya yi/ /tshogs rnams mdzes pa nyid du nye bar 'gyur7/ /rlung gi tshogs stug bral ba chur sgrogs kyang / /tshogs rnams sgra dang sabral ba nyid du gyur—/ /'tsho ba'i dbang phyug dud pa'i brang la kho mo ni/ /dman zhing khengs pa nges par bsgrub pa'i dbang gyur ma/ /brtse ba spang ba'i sabadag nyid yid kyi 'o ma 'dzin/ /gnyis po nye bar gtad nas kun du ma 'khyud do/ /lha rnams 'dun sar 8stobs med rnam par brgyad pa ru6/ /khyed kyi yon tan pad rtsa dri ma med pas 'dzegs/ /de ni phyi nas grong bzang rnams kyis 7phun sum tshogs/ /brgyan pa'i bud med dag dang rnam par rtse zhig spyod/ /snyan par smra dang lus 110—1077

rked 1 dud dang nu gnyis mas / /khyod las gzhan pa su zhig ma bcom de yi phyir / /'byung po lus ldan skyon las grol ba khyod la sogs/ /bgrad pa la ni ming med nye bar 'gro ma yin/ /khyod kyi dmag dpung khyab 'jug lta bu go bgos pa / /mtshon rnon ldan pa dpa' bo dag gis phyogs rnams —su/ /grags pa dang ni rngul dag rgyas byed g.yul kyi 4ni/ /dgra rigs lus bral gzi med rgyags pa 5nyams par byed/ /dran ldan bdag las phan pa'i tshig gcig mnyan par mdzod/ /khyod kyi lag pa dpal dang lhan cig lag 'go yis/ /sa yi dkyil 'khor rnam 'dzin de phyir sa gzhi 'dzin/ /rang lag rig nas rgyags par rgyas pa yod mi 6byed/ /'dod pa'i me gang khengs pas rab bsgrubs 3pa/ /skad cig dang mnyam rgyas te padma'i mig /ro med khyod kyi bde ba de dag ni/ /kun nas nyams pa nyid du cis mi byed/ /ma dud khyod ni 'jig rten bdag gyur tshe / /mthu yis mthu ldan rin chen mang gis btud/ /de phyir gsar ba'i btung 9ldan mchod sbyin ni/ /nges pa nyid du chad par ma gyur to/ /dpung gi glang po rnams ni gzhan dang gzhan/ /stobs ldan sgra sgrogs rab tu brgyud pa yis / /thang la rngul sgrub shā3nam mkha' 'gog byed cing / /g.yul gyi stobs ldan mchog tu gzhan la rgyug /khyod ltar mnyam par ma bzhag ༷srid par ni/ /rnam gnyis mi mnyam phan pa med rnams glutshig /log par gyur pa sgrub byed mi mnyam pa/ /sbrul bgrod mtshungs la mi dad ngo tsha med/ /dgra yi mdzes nyams rgyal po'i sde yis btud/ / skyes mchog tshi.u mas phan rje mudapal med min/ / go bgos u mas btud pa mda' 'dra ste/ /mchod thob dam pa rdul med 6mi mdzes min/ /de ltar rkang pa lan — cig dang / /gnyis dang gsum dang ༄ 110—1078

bzlas pa bstan/ /tshigs bcad gnyis dang ldan pa'i don1/ /tshigs bcad bzlas pa yin te dper/ /zlum zhing rgyas pa'i lag pa can/ /grogs min rab tu 'joms byed pa/ /rnam 'dren khyod kyis bstan pa'i sa mi mtshungs pa 'di 'jigs pa med/ /'dren pa dag dang bral gyur cing / /lag pa sreg khang nye gyur pa/ /rang grogs kyis btang dgra yis ni/ / mtshungs med pa thu'adi mngon par bsten/ /rkang bzhi rnam pa gcig pa gang / /zung ldan chen por brjod pa yin/ /de la'ang bzlas pa mthong ste de/ /zung ldan bya ba gzhan yin no/ /mnyam med dpal ldan mtshungs med ma/ /khengs ldan ngal ba dag dang ni/ /khengs pa mnyam ldan tshul min dag /dor ba'i tshad 'dis 'grogs su chugs /'dzin ma 'dzin ma'i rnam 'dzin 'dzin ma spyod rnams kyi/ /lag pa rnam gnon mi dman 'phral la dgra 'joms pa7/ /myur ba dang ldan mchod pa'i khur ni brten 8pa yis/ /sa gzhi dag ni rim pas bsrung bar bzod pa yin/ /rkang phyed tshigs bcad spyod yul can/ /lugs las bzlog pas bskor ba ni/ /zung ldan lugs las bzlog pa'i phyir/ /lugs las bzlog pa zhes pa 9bshad/ /gang la 'bad byas phra mo nyid/ /de ni bdag gis thob mdza' bo/ /re 'dod med pas 7byed med lha/ /bstod nas 'ongs nyu1khyod 'gro gyur cig /nā da ldan bdag rang gi blo/ /stsos min 'dod pa 'ga' yang med/ /dul ba 'joms pa'i 'dod pa yis 5/ /rang dbang gdung ba dag kyang med/ /yid 'gro bdud skyong lcags mi dman/ /gang zhig dbang gyur skye bo 'joms/ /gang la bdag song skye bo 3/brgya'i/ /dbang gyur de la byon zhes smras/ /ston 'di yis ni gzir gyur cing / / brten mi ⑩shes 710—1079

pa de yis ni/ /nyin mo'i nad dag 17ma thob min/ /mya ngan bral slad khengs ma — byed/ /gal te phyed kyi yi ge rnams/ /gcig gis bar chod gzugs gcig nyid/ /de ni bya dka'i de nyid rig /ba lang gcin zhes smras te she dper / /chang 'dra'i mig ldan zur mig gi/ /mtshon gyis sa'adod pa 'di rgyal te/ /gal te bdag kyang sdig zad 9na/ /'dod pa la ni thal mo sbyor/ /gal te tshigs bcad phyed 'khor na/ /phyed du 'khor ba zhes par brjod/ /gal te kun du 'khor ba na/ /kun du bzang po zhes par 'dod/ /ma dud yid 'byung khyod dar 7phyir/ /sde ni khangs ldan ma yin min/ / yang na 9 'jigs las dpag med na / /bdag cag sdig pa'i rang bzhin no/ /zla dang nad ring cis min gang sa/ /dga' ma bdud kyi rgyar ma lhung / /bgrod bzlog sgra med dpal med ma/ /stobs ldan sgyu gnas 'chi slad du'o/ /dbyangs dang gnas dang yi ge rnams/ /nges pa gang sa'adi bya dka' la/ /bzhi la sogs pa rab bstan 'di/ /gzhan ni bya sla dag tu 'dod/ /rig byed rnam thar tshig smras pa'i7/ /glu dang dga' ba yams nad 'jigs7 / /longs spyod nad dang dga' dang rmongs/ /dge ba'i yul du sems 'dod zung — 8//sa las rnam rgyal brtan pa sgrub byed pa'i/ /brtul zhugs la dga' mchog rtogs ku ru pas/ /g.yul du rang gi rigs kyi dgra —rtarnams ni/ /che — bar bkag cing lci bar 'dar bar byas/ /dpal gzi ngo tsha grags dang / /blo lugs tshig dang dga' dag /khyod la 'phel ba nyid gang / /'di gnyis lha dbang la med/ /zla dang nad ring cis min gang / /dga' ma bdud gyi rgyar ma lhung / /bgrod bzlog sgra ༄ 5med dpal med ma/ /stobs ldan sgyu 6gnas 110byed1080

'chi slad du'o/ /'dren byed kun dga'i 1skyed byed ma༄ sna/ /rgyu skar tshogs rnams dag gi gnas/ /sprin med mkha' la lus can ma/ / lan cig mig gnyis sbyin pa shumadzod/ /nu sdug khyod gdong len byebu yi/ /'khri shing bung ba ltar sngo zhing / /'dren byed padma'i gzugs brnyan can/ /zla ltar mdzes pas su ma bcom/ /rtag tu sdig med kun dga' mchog /lus dud dag dang 'grogs la chags/ /btsun mo lus med kyis 'gongs sate/ /'jigs pa du mas reg par 'gyur— —/ /ha ha mi sgogs 7mkha' 'gros mtshan/ /ri 'gro dbang 'khrog ldan mi — chags/ /'khyog sgogs gaṅgā'i chur 'jug sdig /bya rog 'joms pa mtho ris 'gro/ / bye kye sgra sgrogs ḍaru ru'i brang / /'joms sdig pa ri ri char 'gro/ /nga can ma 'ong bdag gi ma / /bya rog rma bya'i sgra bsgyur saci/ /lha rnams dga' bar byed pa'i lha/ /rig byed la smod 'gog pa pos / /lha min dga' byed bcom pa na/ /sgra yis mtho ris gang bar gyur/ /mkhas pa lha dang lha min la/ /'gro stobs ldan pa'i byin legs can/ /chang gi ro ldan gshol 'dzin de/ /bzhad kyi sgra ldan mtsho ru song / /'di yis bdag cag rnams kyi bzhin/ /bzhin gyis nges par ma bcom min/ /bdag srog mi dman 'di dang sbyoras/ /rje bo skyes min sdig med min/ /de ltar bya dka'i lam la yang / /rim pa cung zad kun du bstan/ /gab tshig dag gi rnam pa yi/ /lugs kyang rab tu bstan par bya/ /rtsed mo'i 'dun 1 sar bzhad gad dang / /de shes tshogs su gsang smra dang / /pha rol kun du rmongs byed la/ /gab tshig dag ni nyer mkho ldan/ /tshig mtshams sbyar bas don sbas pa—/ /kun du tshogs pa zhes par brjod/ /gzhan la grags pa'i sgra dag gis/ /110—1081

byed—gang du slu ba slu byed nyid/ /spyor ba shin tu 'khrugs pa yis/ /rmongs byed rim pa bral ba ste/ /gang la don rtogs dka' ba yi/ /tshig phreng de ni rab bcom yin/ /phal pa'i don bkod tshig dag gis/ /bsdebs 1pa dag ni mthun pa'i gzugs/ /mtshan nyid yod tsam nges tshig dang / /bden 2pa'i tshig ni rtsub mo'o/ /gang du grangs kyis ༄ kun rmongs par/ /byed pa grangs nyid ces bya ste/ /gang du ngag don rnam pa gzhan/ /snang ba de ni rab brtags nyid/ /gang du ming la sna tshogs don/ / btags de sdeming du 'dus pa nyid/ /tshig ni chos mtshungs la reg pas/ /don gzhan bsgrib snyepa bsgrib pa'o / /sgra yi ju rnam grangs bkod pa yis/ /bsgrub pa dag ni mthun pa'i sgra/ /gang zhig mngon sum 7don bstan yang / /rmongs phyir de ni rmongs zhes bya/ /gang la sbyor phreng bdag nyid can/ /de ni yongs su 'phrog ces bya/ gang du rten ni gsal byed de/ /brten pa sbas pa gcig bsgrib pa'o/ /gang du gnyis ka sbas gyur pa/ /de ni gnyis ka bsgrib pa'o/ /gang la 9mtshan nyid sna tshogs 'dres / /de ni yongs su 'dres zhes bya/ /'di rnams — gab tshig bcu drug ste/ /sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis bstan/ /gab tshig ngan pa gzhan dag kyang / /bcu bzhi de dag rnams kyis brjod/ /ngan pa mtshan nyid med gang de/ /skyon gyes yongs bgrang — bya min par/ /rig nas slar yang bdag cag gis/ /legs pa kho na brjod par bya/ /mā yāḥgo ra 2sems kyis ni/ /shes pa med la ci slad khro/ /gnas min du ba 'di yis ni/ /ci byed kun du mig dmar ma/ /kubyā bstan / pa khyod kyi ni/ /dga' ba ji ltar 'phel gyur pa1zi/ /'chi med bu mor co 'dri lamu/ /mi mo spyad pas de lta min/ /yu bar 'o byed pad 170—1082

can gyi/ /ngang pa tsher ma rtsub mo can/ /zhal kyel sgra snyan sgogs byed byung / /lus ni 'dar bar byed cing mchus/ /bu mo khrod kyi rkang mdzes la/ /rkang gdub rgyas pa sgra snyan sgrogs/ /mngon sum nyid du gyur pa 'dir/ /bdag gi srog ni brtan ma yin/ /gang gi yal ga 4yal 'dab la/ /me tog dmar po'i dog 3pa can/ /'khri shing yal 'dab lnga pa ni/ /skyed mos tshal 'dir bdag gis mthong / / lha rnams lha yi khang pa ru/ /so so'i 'od kyis dal bur rgyu—/ /dri bzang rdzing bur myos byas pa/ /de rnams da ni rgan mo bzhin/ /6 sna ldan dbus na gsal byed bzhis/ /yongs su rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /gong khyer 'ga' yod gang zhig na/ /mi bdag mi 7brgyad ming can yod/ /tshig rnams rab tu 'khrugs pa dang / /mgo bo dud cing mig dman pa/ /'dug kyang 'dar ldan bdag la ni/ /rgan mo rjes su mi brtse 'am/ /mig mi brtan ma sa ldan 'ga'/ /dang po rā dza zhes par 9sgrogs/ /sa nā ta na yang ste 'di//rgyal po ma yin khyab 'jug min/ /rdzas bral mi ni btang byas nas/ /nor ldan rnams can bgrod pa gang / /sna tshogs skyogs brgyas 'jig rten 'gugs/ /gzung — dka' smad 'tshong ma yin no/ /khyod kyi sa min ming mthun gang / /rab gyur skra 7ming can las rgyal/ /de yis ding bdag mchog tu ni/ /sred ldan byed do snyan sgogs ma/ /'dod ldan dag ni mal stan la/ /khro bas phyir bzlog nyal bar 'gyur/ /chags pas chade bzhin nyed nyal te/ /dal bu yis ni kha dag sbyor8/ /bya rgyal zas skyes dgra yis ni/ /bla ma'i 'od kyis bcom skye'o—/ /kha 'joms grogs min 'dzin pa yis/ /khyab pa'i mkha' la mngon par dga'/ /nam yang mtshon dang bud med kyi/ /nu ma'i dkyil 'khor la ma 110—1083

reg /mi ma yin pa 'ga' zhig ni/ /lag ni rmye'abras med yin no lo/ /su zhig gang dang 'gogs pa yis/ /bya ba thams cad nye bar ni/ /thob cing zas kyi dus dag 2tu/ /gal te mthong na 'dor bar byed/ /ha ya ga dza bha ṭa can / /sde 'di gal te ma rgyal na/ /mā tri ka med nged kyi bu/ /'di ni yi ge shes kyang blun/ /de ni ming du 'dus par sgobasres/ /bslus pa yi jeni gzugs dang ldan/ /de bzhin nyid du gzhan kyi yang / /'dres pa'i rim pa shes par bya/ /don nyams don 'gal 5don gcig pa/ /the tshom can dang rim pa nyams/ /sgra nyams ༄ gcod mtshams nyams pa dang / /sdeb sbyor nyams dang mtshams sbyor bral/ /yul dus sgyu rtsal 'jig rten dang / /lung rigs dag dang 'gal ba ste/ /skyon bcu de dag snyan ngag la/ /snyan ngag mkhan kyis spang bar bya/ /dam bca' gtan tshigs dpe nyams pa/ / zhes pa 'di yang skyon min nam7/ /phal cher dpyad par dka' ba nyid/ /spyor 9ba de yi 'bras bu ci/ /tshogs pa'i don gyis stong pa gang / /de ni don nyams zhes par 'dod/ /myos pa spyon 7pa byis pa yi/ /brjod las gzhan du — de skyon no/ /'di ni rgya mtsho 'thung byed de/ /bdag ni de ring rgas mupas gzir/ /sprin 'di rab tu sgrogs byed de / /'phrog byed sa srung —dag la dga'/ /'di sems rnal du mi gnas pa'i/ /mngon par brjod la smad min te/ /gzhan du de lta bu la sogs/ /snyan ngag mkhan po su zhig sbyor/ /ngag gcig gis sani rab sbyar bas/ /snga ma phyi ma gzhan 'joms pa/ /'gal ba'i don can nyid kyi skyon/ /don 'gal zhes par bye rab tu brjod/ /dgra rigs mtha' dag 'joms pa dang / /sna tshogs khur ni 3rgyal gyur cig /'byung po 110—1084

kun la brtse ba can/ /khyod la dgra ni su yang med/ /mngon par chags ldan sems la ni/ /skabs de 'ga' zhig yod pas —rten/ /gang la 'gal ba'i don can kyi/ /tshig kyang mngon par 'dod par 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi bud med la sred pa/ /'phags pa dag gis ga la rigs/ /de yi so sgrib g.yo ba dag /bdag ni nam zhig 'thung 'gyur ram/ /don nyid dam ni sgra la yang / /khyad par med par sngar brjod pa/ /gal te slar yang rab bsgrags pa/ /de ni don gcig par 'dod dper/ /sred pa sred byed bu mo rnams/ /de yi len 5bu'i 'od zer can/ /chu 'dzin glog dang ldan pa dang 4/ /zab mo sgra sgrogs 'di dag go/ /rjes su brtse sogs khyad par las/ /gal te 'ga' zhig brjod 'dod na/ /yang brjod pa la 3skyon med de/ /'di ni rgyan du rigs pa yin/ /'dod pa skabs min 'khon pa yis/ /bud med mchog 'di 6bcom par gyur/ /yan lag kun mdzes bcom par gyur/ /'jam par sgrog 7ma bcom par gyur/ /nges pa'i don du rab sbyar ba'i/ /tshig rnams nyid kyis gal te na/ /the tshom skyed par byed na 'di/ /the tshom can zhes rab tu brjodaḍa/ /re 'dod dga' ba lta sab yi/ /ro la mig g.yo grogs mo dag /rgyang na 'dug pa'i ma ma 'dis/ /'di 'dra blta bar bzod ma yin/ /'di 'dra the tshom slad nyid du/ /gal te 'ga' zhig tu sbyar na/ /'di ni rgyan nyid du 'gyur gyi/ /de la skyon med 'di lta ste/ /ma smad de ni lus skyes kyi1 / /'jigs pas gzir zhing rtsub mo yi/ / dus nyid kyis ni bzung 5ba mthong / /bdag cag khyod la re ba ci skye/ /'dod pas gzir ram tsha bas gdungs/ /zhes pa nges med byed pa'i tshig / rtsed 'jos skyes pa 'khrugs rdzupar ni/ /bya phyir pho nya 110—1085

mos smras so/ /mdor bstan rjes su yon tan 1don/ /gal te rjes bstan ma byas na/ /rim pa nyams par mngon brjod pa'i/ /skyon du de ni bshad de dper / /'gro ba rnams kyi gnas pa dang / /sprul dang 'jig rgyu ma skyes pa/ /bde 'byung sred med chu skyes kyi/ /skye gnas can gyis sde khyed rnams srungs/ /'brel pa nges par shes pa'i rgyur/ /gang yang gal te 'bad byas na/ /rim pa bzlas kyang skyon min par/ /mkhas pa rnams ni smra ste dper/ /gnyen gtong ba dang lus gtong dang / /yul gtong zhes pa gsum po la/ /dang po tha ma nyon mongs ring —/ /bar pa skad cig gdung ba'o/ /mtshon bya mtshan nyid lam la 5mtshon/ /tshig sbyor mchog min 'dod pa ni/ /sgra nyams yin te mchog rnams dag /'dod pa nyid ni skyon ma yin/ /sa gzhi rgya mtsho'i ska na rags can/ /rgyal chen khyod la dpung pas srungs/ /zhes pa shes 'dod med pas na/ /tshig 'di la ni nyams yod min/ /lho yi ri las nyer btud pa'i/ /rlung gis tsū ta'i rkang 'thung ni/ /yal 'dab rol par bskyod pa yis— —/ /myu gu mdzes dang ldan par byed/ /ces sogs bstan bcos bdag nyid che/ /lta la g.yel ba'i sems ldan pas9/ /sgra nyams bzhin du snang mod kyi/ /skal bzang nam yang gtang ma yin/ /tshigs bcad rnams la nges pa'i gnas/ /tshig gi gcod mtshams ngal gsor rigs— / /de nyams gcod mtshams nyams pa ste/ /nyan po dga' min skyed de dper/ /bud med rnams kyis yang dag brjod pa'i cho ga ro nyams med la 'dir/ /mchog rnams dang 'grogs mi dbang nyi ma'i rigs 'dis lta byed la sogs thuskyon/ /bya dang bya min ma tshang med la lung nyid kyis ni lta byed cing / /mi bdag 'di yi dbang gyur sa 'dzin 110byed1086

zhes pa de ltar sbyor ba yod/ /ji ltar tshig mtha' phyis pa la/ /lhag ma tshig nyid du nges pa/ /de bzhin mtshams sbyor rnam 'gyur mtha'/ /tshig nyid ces ni brjod pa yin/ /de lta na yang rna bar rtsub/ /snyan ngag mkhan rnams mi sbyor te/ /rgyal po de yi rgyal mtshan gyi1/ /tog gi chu 'dzin bsgul zhes 'di'o//gang du yi ge chad lhag dang / /lci yang ji lta bzhin mi gnas/ /de ni sdeb sbyor nyams pa ste/ /skyon 'di shin tu smad pa'o/ /zla ba'i 'od zer rab bsil bas/ /reg ces yi ge nyung ba nyid/ /sa hā kā ra'i lo 'dab gsar pa rnams / /snum zhes yi ge lhag pa'o/ /'dod pas mda' rnon ri dwags mig can la/ /rnam par 'phong zhes lci 5ba ji bzhin min/ /mdzes pa'i mig can dag la myos byed kyi/ /mda' rnon lhung zhes yang ba ji bzhin min/ /bsnyus pa brjod par mi 'dod ces/ /tshig la mtshams sbyor med pa dang / /ya phyis la sogs rgyu med pa/ /de ni mtshams sbyor bral zhes bstan/ /mkha' dang bdag gi yid la yang / /rlung ni dal bur 5rgyu ba yis/ /bud med 'gram pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rdul gyi chu rgyas sel bar byed/ /mtshan mo 'di la zhes 'di 'dra/ /mkhas pas nyams par rigs 7mi byed/ /ri nags yul 'khor la sogs yul/ /nyin mtshan dus drug la sogs dus/ /'dod pa'i don la bstan pa yi/ /gar dang glu sogs sgyu rtsal te/ /'byung ba rgyu dang mi rgyu ba'i/ /'jug pa 'jig rten ming can no/ /rigs pa gtan tshigs rigs 9 bdag nyid/ /thos bcas gsungs pa lung nyid de/ /snyan ngag mkhan po bag med las/ /de der ji ltar grags pa bzhin/ /min par gal te rab zhugs na//'di ni yul sogs 'ga' zhes brjod/ /ga bur rkang 'thung la reg pa'i (1 / /110—1087

ma la ya rlung dri bzang can/ /ka ling ka —1yi nags skyes pa'i/ /glang po dag ni ri dwags rigs/ /tso la kā pa ri ngogs pa / /a ka ru ni nag po 1sngo/ /zhes pa yul dang 'gal ba yi/ /tshig gi 'jug pa 'di 'dra ste/ /padma can ni mtshan mo rgyas/ /nyin par ku mud ldan pa gsal/ /dpyid ni ni tsu la rab rgyas—/ /sos 4ka dag ni sprin gyis gtibs/ /ngang pa'i sgra ni dbyar mnyan lta'os / /ston ni rma bya myos pa ste/ /dgun ston 6nyi ma dri ma med/ /dgun ni tsandan bsngags par 'os/ /zhes pa 'di 'dra dus dang ni/ /'gal ba'i lugs dag bstan pa yin/ /sgyu rtsal dag dang 'gal ba'i lam/ /cung zad bstan par bya ste dper/ /dpa' ba sgeg pa dag gi dngos/ /brtan pa khro dang ya mtshan no/ /dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa 'di dag ni/ /tha dad lam du rab tu 'jug /'di ltar sgyu rtsal drug cu bzhir/ /'gal ba legs par rtogs par bya/ /sgyu rtsal yongs su bcad pa las7/ /de yi rang bzhin gsal bar 'gyur/ /glang po dag ni ral pa g.yo/ /rta yi rwa ni rno ba yin/ /e raṇḍa ni snying pos lci/ /seng ldeng ljon pa snying po med/ /ces pa 'di ni 'jig rten pa/ /nyid dang 'gal ba kun gyis smad/ /rigs pa zhes bya gtan tshigs kyi/ /rig pa dang 'gal bstan par bya/ /bde gshegs 'dus byas 'jig par ni/ / gsungs pa bden mod de lta na'ang / /tsa ko ra yi mig can de/ /bdag gi snying la da dung gnas/ /ser skyas gnas la yod min ༄ nyid / /rab tu skye bar nye bar brjod/ /med pa nyid ni bdag cag gis/ /rab tu skye bar mthong gang phyir6/ /rigs pa dag dang 'gal ba yi/ /lugs ni kun du bstan mupar bya/ /de nas lung dang 'gal ba yi/ /'jug 110—1088

pa dag ni bstan par bya/ /me ni bzhag pa ma yin yang / /bu skyes bram ze ma nyams pa'i/ /spyod pas brgyan pa 'di dag ni/ /bee shwa na ri mchod sbyin byed/ /'di hūṃni cho ga ma byas kyang / /bla ma dag las rig byed bklags/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i shel dag ni/ /'du byed gzhan la ltos pa med/ / skyon ni — mtha' dag 'di la yang / /res 'ga' snyan ngag mkhan mkhas pas/ /skyon gyi grangs las rab 'das nas④/ /yon tan lam ni rnam par 'dzin/ /rgyal po de yi mthu yis ni/ /de yi skyed tshal lha rnams kyi/ /ljon pa yal 'dab gos dmar dang / /ldan pa dag gi zhiganas su gyur/ /rgyal po 'jigs pa gsal byed pa/ /ka dam pa yi rdul dang 'grogs/ /'dab bdun las 'khrungs skyod byed cing / /dran po yi ni rlung dag rgyu/ /khyogs kyis 6rab bskul skrag pa yi/ /skye bo bud med khas brjod glu/ /stabs 7mi mnyam pas 'dod ldan gyi/ /chags pa dag ni 'phel bar byed/ /zla ba'i 'od zer rab bsil bas8/ /bsreg bya 'dzin pa 9'dod ldan ni/ /bud med dang bral nyon rngo/ngas kyis / /'khrugs pa 'di yis rtsi bar byed/ /gzhal 4bya yin yang gzhal bya min/ /cha ldan yin yang cha ldan min/ /gcig nyid yin yang gcig nyid min/ /sna tshogs gzugs khrod la phyag 'tshal/ /skya bseng bu lnga dag gi ni/ /chung ma lnga len bu mo ste/ /dag pa rnams kyi mchog tu 'gyur7/ /'di 'dra lha yi sgrub byed do/ /sgra don rgyan ni bkra ba dang / /bya sla bya dka' dag gi —lam/ /snyan ngag rnams kyi nayon tan skyon/ /de ltar mdor bsdus rab tu bstan/ /sgrub byed bstan pa'i lam 'dis skyon dang yon tan dag /rab tu rtogs pa'i blo can skal bzang dbang gyur pa'i/ /tshig dang mngon par 'grogs byas chang 110—1089
